title: The Power and Limits of Money Burning in Bilateral Trade
summary:
We study the power of money burning in bilateral trade. In this problem, a seller owns an indivisible item, a buyer would like to acquire it, and each of these two traders has a private value for the item and the values are sampled from independent distributions. We ask whether the traders can benefit from a mechanism that burns money, that is, one that charges the buyer more than it pays the seller, so that neither trader enjoys the difference (money burnt is a loss for the traders). Is it possible that the traders will ever be better off if the trade mechanism can burn money?
  For Bayesian incentive-compatible mechanisms and for deterministic dominant-strategy incentive-compatible (DSIC) mechanisms, it is known that money burning is always a waste and can only hurt the traders. Maybe surprisingly, we show that once a DSIC mechanism can use randomization, money burning can significantly benefit the traders, and the gain of each of them can be arbitrarily large. In contrast, we show that the power of DSIC randomized mechanisms that burn money is still very limited in the sense that they cannot guarantee any constant fraction of the first-best gains-from-trade.

AI.tldr: 本文研究双边贸易中"烧钱"机制的力量。作者证明：在随机化DSIC机制下，烧钱能显著提升双方交易者的收益（可任意大），但这类机制仍无法保证首优收益的任何常数比例。
AI.motivation: 已有结论表明：对贝叶斯激励相容机制和确定性DSIC机制而言，烧钱纯属浪费，只会损害交易双方利益。作者质疑这一"烧钱无用"的结论在随机化DSIC情形下是否仍然成立，从而探究烧钱机制在更一般情形下的价值边界。
AI.method: 在经典双边贸易模型（卖方持不可分割物品、买方欲购、双方估值来自独立分布且为私人信息）中，将机制扩展到可烧钱（向买方收取多于付给卖方的金额，差额不归任何人）并允许随机化；分别分析贝叶斯激励相容与DSIC机制，构造随机化烧钱DSIC机制并分析其收益。
AI.result: (1) 对贝叶斯激励相容机制和确定性DSIC机制，烧钱无益；(2) 当DSIC机制允许随机化时，烧钱可显著提升交易双方收益，且每方收益增益可任意大；(3) 但随机化烧钱DSIC机制能力仍十分有限——无法保证首优收益（first-best gains-from-trade）的任何常数比例。
AI.conclusion: 随机化是烧钱机制发挥价值的关键前提：它使烧钱从"纯浪费"转变为可带来任意大个体收益的工具有力手段；然而其整体效率保证依然极弱，无法获得首优收益的常数比例。这揭示了随机化烧钱机制"个体收益潜力大、但总体效率保证弱"的双面特征。

title: Learning vs. Optimizing Players in Budgeted Games
summary:
We study repeated general games over $T$ rounds between a utility-maximizing optimizer and a learning agent, where budget constraints couple the players' decisions across rounds. Without budgets, low swap regret simultaneously guarantees the learner sublinear regret and caps the optimizer at its Stackelberg value. Budgets break this picture: adversarial no-regret becomes impossible, so the natural goals are non-manipulability---no adaptive optimizer earns more than $\mathtt{BSE} \cdot T + o(T)$, where $\mathtt{BSE}$ is its Budgeted Stackelberg Equilibrium value---and low stochastic regret when the optimizer plays a fixed mixed strategy.
  We give an efficient, budget-feasible learning algorithm that achieves both goals in every budgeted game: any adaptive optimizer, budgeted or not, earns at most $\mathtt{BSE} \cdot T + O(\sqrt{T})$ in expectation, and if the optimizer plays a fixed mixed strategy on each of a constant number of intervals, the learner has $O(\sqrt{T})$ regret on each such interval. Our learner best responds to forecasts of the optimizer's play that are calibrated in two novel senses, since under budgets the calibration that prevents manipulation no longer yields low stochastic regret. Response calibration, which conditions on the learner's own mixed response by embedding its continuous mixing weight as a step function in $L^2([-1,1])$, prevents manipulation without discretizing responses; dual-weighted Lagrangian calibration ensures low regret. Although low calibration error requires randomized forecasts---distributions over a continuous space that need not have a succinct representation or be directly computable---we construct such forecasts in polynomial time by simulating online gradient ascent.

AI.tldr: 研究预算约束下重复博弈中学习算法与优化器的交互，提出一种高效、预算可行的学习算法，同时实现不可操纵性与低随机遗憾。
AI.motivation: 无预算时低交换遗憾可同时保证学习者的次线性遗憾并限制优化器收益不超过Stackelberg值。但预算约束打破了这一图景：对抗性无遗憾变得不可能。因此需重新定义目标：不可操纵性（无自适应优化器收益超过BSE·T+o(T)）与固定混合策略下的低随机遗憾。
AI.method: 提出预算可行的学习算法，对优化器的预测做出最佳响应，并引入两种新颖的校准概念：响应校准（将学习者连续混合权重嵌入为L²([-1,1])中的阶跃函数，避免离散化响应即可防操纵）与对偶加权拉格朗日校准（确保低遗憾）。由于低校准误差需要随机化预测，通过模拟在线梯度上升在多项式时间内构造这些预测。
AI.result: 在任何预算博弈中，任意自适应优化器（无论是否有预算）的期望收益至多BSE·T+O(√T)；若优化器在常数个区间上采用固定混合策略，学习者在每个区间上遗憾为O(√T)。
AI.conclusion: 预算约束下需分离防操纵与低遗憾两种校准机制，所提算法在多项式时间内同时达成不可操纵性与低随机遗憾，拓展了重复博弈学习的理论边界。

title: Sublinear Metric Distortion for Matching
summary:
We study metric distortion in one-sided matching. Given $n$ agents and $n$ items in an unknown metric space, our goal is to match agents to items so that the total distance between matched pairs is small. However, instead of direct access to the distances in the metric, we are only given each agent's ranking of the items by distance. What is the smallest worst-case approximation factor (called the distortion) that a mechanism can guarantee in expectation? Despite significant interest over the last decade, the best-known guarantee has been the $O(n)$ distortion of Random Serial Dictatorship since the beginning.
  We give a matching mechanism with distortion $O(n^{\log_4 3})$, the first sublinear upper bound. The key idea is to use a partial matching derived from a truncated version of either Random Serial Dictatorship or the Probabilistic Serial rule. We then complete this matching using a new, general-purpose cluster completion algorithm that ensures unmatched agents receive nearby items. Along the way, we pin down the optimal distortion of Random Serial Dictatorship and Probabilistic Serial up to logarithmic and constant factors, respectively, and give improved lower bounds for truthful mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究单边匹配中的度量扭曲，首次给出优于 O(n) 的机制，扭转为 O(n^{log_4 3})≈O(n^0.792)。
AI.motivation: 给定 n 个代理与 n 个物品及未知度量空间，仅知道每个代理按距离对物品的排序，目标是最小化匹配总距离。此前十年最佳保证一直是 Random Serial Dictatorship 的 O(n) 扭曲，能否达到次线性期望扭曲未知。
AI.method: 核心思路：先用 Random Serial Dictatorship 或 Probabilistic Serial 的截断版本得到一个部分匹配，再设计一种通用的聚类补全算法，为未匹配代理分配附近物品。
AI.result: 给出期望扭曲 O(n^{log_4 3}) 的匹配机制，是首个次线性上界；同时确定 Random Serial Dictatorship 与 Probabilistic Serial 的最优扭曲（分别至多差对数、常数因子），并给出诚实机制的改进下界。
AI.conclusion: 单边匹配的度量扭曲可显著低于 O(n)，部分匹配加聚类补全的框架为后续改进提供了新方向。

title: AI-Assisted Classification under Correlation Neglect and Trust
summary: When does an AI assistant improve human decision-making, and when does it hurt? We argue that the answer depends not just on AI accuracy but also on how much its evidence overlaps with the human's and how the human combines the two. A worker makes a binary decision by observing her own signal and receiving a recommendation from an AI. We develop a human behavioral model with two primitives: her awareness of the overlap and her trust in the AI. Our analysis gives a closed-form phase diagram over AI capability and overlap, with regions of complementarity, impairment, and automation. A worker who neglects the overlap (correlation neglect) can be made less accurate by a more capable AI, double-counting the shared evidence. Trust reshapes the regions - undertrust may compensate for correlation neglect, so that the trust level maximizing accuracy depends on the deployment parameters. Empirically, we identify the two model parameters by pairing the same workers with different AIs, and break the accuracy loss into a correlation-neglect cost and an undertrust cost, one tied to reducing overlap on the AI side, the other to calibrating trust on the human side. On ChatBench, AI assistance raises accuracy by 21 points, yet workers apply only about a quarter of the Bayes-rational weight to AI information; GPT-4o falls in the automation region and Llama-3.1-8b stays at the complementarity boundary; and calibrating trust recovers about 2.6 points for GPT-4o but almost nothing for Llama-3.1-8b.

AI.tldr: 当AI助手何时改善、何时损害人类决策？论文提出答案取决于AI准确度之外的两个因素：证据重叠程度与人机结合方式。作者建立含"重叠觉察"和"信任"两个原语的人类行为模型，给出AI能力与重叠度的相图（互补/损害/自动化区域），并用实验识别参数、分解准确度损失。
AI.motivation: 现有讨论多聚焦AI准确度，忽略AI证据与人类自有信号的重叠，以及人类如何整合二者。若工人忽视重叠（相关性忽视），更强AI反而可能使其更差，因为共享证据被重复计算。因此需要一个解释人机决策互补与损害条件、并可实证校准的框架。
AI.method: 构建理论模型：工人观察自身信号并收到AI二元推荐，以两个原语刻画人类行为——对重叠的觉察与对AI的信任。推导闭式相图，在AI能力×重叠度空间划分互补、损害、自动化区域；分析相关性忽视与过度/不足信任的交互。实证上让同一批工人配对不同AI，识别两个模型参数，并将准确度损失分解为相关性忽视成本（AI侧降低重叠）与信任不足成本（人类侧校准信任）；在ChatBench上评估。
AI.result: 理论上：忽视重叠的工人可能被更强AI拖累；信任重塑分区，信任不足可补偿相关性忽视，故最优准确度的信任水平依赖部署参数。实证：ChatBench上AI协助使准确率提升21个百分点，但工人仅对AI信息赋予约四分之一贝叶斯权重；GPT-4o落入自动化区域，Llama-3.1-8b处于互补性边界；校准信任为GPT-4o恢复约2.6个百分点，对Llama-3.1-8b几乎无效。
AI.conclusion: AI助手的价值不只由准确度决定，还取决于证据重叠与人类整合方式；相关性忽视与信任不足是可分离的两类损失来源，且其修复空间因AI而异。校准信任对自动化型AI（如GPT-4o）收益明显，而对处于互补边界的弱AI几乎无用，提示部署策略应同时考虑AI侧重叠控制与人类侧信任校准。

title: Neural networks and games
summary: Hopfield neural networks and noncooperative games provide seemingly different approaches to understanding how collective outcomes emerge from local interactions. In a neural network, individual units adjust their states according to local signals; in a game, players choose actions to maximise individual payoffs. I establish an exact equivalence between symmetric binary Hopfield networks and binary-action games that admit a quadratic potential. The equivalence identifies stable network configurations with pure-strategy Nash equilibria, and asynchronous neural updating with best-response dynamics. More broadly, the storage and retrieval of memories in neural networks correspond, respectively, to the design and selection of equilibria in games.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了对称二值Hopfield神经网络与具有二次势函数二值博弈之间的精确等价关系。
AI.motivation: Hopfield网络与非合作博弈看似是理解"局部交互如何产生集体结果"的两套不同框架，作者希望揭示二者内在的统一结构。
AI.method: 通过理论构造，证明对称二值Hopfield网络的稳定构型对应纯策略纳什均衡，异步神经元更新对应最优反应动态，并进一步对应记忆的存储/提取与均衡的设计/选择。
AI.result: 得到精确等价：网络稳定态↔纯策略纳什均衡；异步更新↔最优反应动态；记忆存储↔均衡设计；记忆提取↔均衡选择。
AI.conclusion: 两类模型可相互映射，为神经网络与博弈论提供统一视角，并促进方法的交叉迁移。

title: MvBody: Multi-View-Based Hybrid Transformer Using Optical 3D Body Scan for Explainable Cesarean Section Prediction
summary: Accurately assessing the risk of cesarean section (CS) delivery is critical, especially in settings with limited medical resources, where access to healthcare is often restricted. Early and reliable risk prediction allows better-informed prenatal care decisions and can improve maternal and neonatal outcomes. However, most existing predictive models are tailored for in-hospital use during labor and rely on parameters that are often unavailable in resource-limited or home-based settings. In this study, we conduct a pilot investigation to examine the feasibility of using 3D body shape for CS risk assessment for future applications with more affordable general devices. We propose a novel multi-view-based Transformer network, MvBody, which predicts CS risk using only self-reported medical data and 3D optical body scans obtained between the 31st and 38th weeks of gestation. To enhance training efficiency and model generalizability in data-scarce environments, we incorporate a metric learning loss into the network. Compared to widely used machine learning models and the latest advanced 3D analysis methods, our method demonstrates superior performance, achieving an accuracy of 84.62% and an Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUC-ROC) of 0.724 on the independent test set. To improve transparency and trust in the model's predictions, we apply the Integrated Gradients algorithm to provide theoretically grounded explanations of the model's decision-making process. Our results indicate that pre-pregnancy weight, maternal age, obstetric history, previous CS history, and body shape, particularly around the head and shoulders, are key contributors to CS risk prediction.

AI.tldr: 该文提出MvBody多视角Transformer网络，仅用自报医疗数据和孕31–38周的3D光学体形扫描预测剖宫产风险，独立测试集准确率84.62%、AUC-ROC 0.724，并用Integrated Gradients解释关键预测因素。
AI.motivation: 准确评估剖宫产风险对母婴结局至关重要，尤其在医疗资源有限、就医受限的场景下。但现有预测模型多面向住院产程使用，依赖资源匮乏或居家环境下难以获得的参数，因此需要一种可利用低成本通用设备（3D体形）的早期风险评估方法。
AI.method: 开展可行性试点研究，构建多视角Transformer网络MvBody：输入为自报医疗信息与孕31–38周获取的3D光学体扫描；采用多视角建模，并引入度量学习损失以提升数据稀缺下的训练效率与泛化能力；与常用机器学习模型及最新先进3D分析方法对比；并用Integrated Gradients对模型决策提供理论依据的解释。
AI.result: 在独立测试集上优于对比的机器学习模型与先进3D方法，准确率84.62%，AUC-ROC 0.724。解释分析显示，孕前体重、产妇年龄、产科史、既往剖宫产史以及体形（尤其是头部和肩部周围）是剖宫产风险预测的关键贡献因素。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明基于3D体形的剖宫产风险评估具有可行性，为未来借助更经济的通用设备实现早期、可解释的风险筛查提供了初步证据；但作为试点研究，样本与外部验证仍需进一步扩展。

title: Item Representations Matter: Bridging Hard Semantic IDs and Soft Prototype Mixtures for Generative Retrieval
summary: Modern recommender systems rely on generative retrieval techniques to predict the next item either as discrete codes or as a continuous vector. On the one hand, Semantic IDs (SIDs) give discrete models shared parameters and pretrained semantic structure, but discretizing items into hard codes discards some information from the original content embeddings. On the other hand, continuous models avoid quantization, yet typically use flat item lookup tables with no explicit parameter tying across items. We ask whether a continuous recommender can introduce shared structure without making it a discrete bottleneck. We propose CAP-Mix, a flow recommender that represents each item as a soft mixture of shared prototypes plus an item-specific vector. The assignments, prototypes, and item vectors are trained jointly, and the soft representation is retained at inference. Pretrained information is optional: SID responsibilities can serve as a prior over assignments, while a full content embedding can initialize the item-specific vector without changing the initial flat table. In matched comparisons on three datasets, CAP-Mix improves over a flat table on the two sparse Amazon datasets and yields a small gain on Steam when trained without pretrained information. Given only an offline SID, it outperforms a hard table built from the same tokenizer by 4.45-14.90% in HR@5. Given the full content embedding, it matches or improves a strong flat table while hard assignments regress on the sparse Amazon datasets. Overall, averaged across six benchmarks, CAP-Mix improves HR@5 and NDCG@5 by 6.9% and 13.6% relative to the best evaluated baseline for each dataset and metric, while delivering 1.4-161x the inference throughput of the discrete baselines in our experiments.

AI.tldr: CAP-Mix 将每个物品表示为共享原型（prototypes）的软混合加上一个物品专属向量，在连续空间中引入共享参数结构而避免离散量化瓶颈，并在六个基准上平均提升 HR@5 6.9%、NDCG@5 13.6%，推理吞吐为离散基线的 1.4–161 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式检索推荐分两派：语义 ID（SID）离散编码能共享参数并利用预训练语义结构，但硬量化损失内容嵌入信息；连续模型避免量化，却通常用扁平物品查找表，物品之间没有显式参数共享。作者希望连续推荐能获得共享结构而不引入离散瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 CAP-Mix 流式推荐器：每个物品 = 共享原型的软混合 + 物品专属向量；分配权重、原型和物品向量联合训练，推理时保留软表示。预训练信息为可选项：SID 责任可作为分配先验，完整内容嵌入可初始化物品专属向量且不改变初始扁平表。
AI.result: 三个数据集匹配对比中：由于两个稀疏 Amazon 数据集上优于扁平表，Steam 上无预训练信息时小幅提升；仅给离线 SID 时，相比同 tokenizer 构建的硬表 HR@5 提升 4.45–14.90%；给完整内容嵌入时可匹配或超越强扁平表，而硬分配在稀疏 Amazon 上退化。六个基准平均 HR@5 +6.9%、NDCG@5 +13.6%（相对各数据集最佳基线），推理吞吐为离散基线 1.4–161 倍。
AI.conclusion: 软混合原型表示能在连续推荐中有效引入参数共享结构，避免量化信息损失，兼顾效果与推理效率，且可与 SID/内容嵌入等预训练信息灵活结合。

title: Discourse Analysis of Legislative Bill Discussions
summary: Legislative hearings are distinct communication events with their own human recognizable structure and logic, yet they have been analyzed as distinct phenomena beyond their transcripts. Understanding legislative hearings at a deeper level is a major step in analyzing the work and power relationships within democratic bodies. In this work, we present a novel end-to-end pipeline for parsing rhetorical structures from legislative committee hearings with the goal of improving legislative discourse analysis and democratic accountability. We also propose a rhetorical structure grammar and find that 55.21% of California state bill discussions in our dataset can be parsed with this grammar. We evaluate our pipeline with two utterance section classifiers on a random subset of over 2,000 annotated utterances corresponding to 100 hearings. We find that a logistic regression-based classifier with grammar-based output masking and utterance tag smoothing outperforms more complex models, achieving an F1 score of 52.8% against our ground truth discourse section labels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一条端到端流水线，用于从立法委员会听证会转写文本中解析修辞结构，并提出一种修辞结构语法，以改进立法话语分析与民主问责。
AI.motivation: 立法听证会具有人类可识别的结构与逻辑，但以往多把其作为独立现象分析，缺乏对其深层结构的理解；深入理解听证会有助于分析民主机构内的工作与权力关系。
AI.method: 构建端到端修辞结构解析流水线，设计修辞结构语法；用两个话语段分类器在100场听证、2000余条标注话语的随机子集上评估，其中采用基于语法的输出掩码与话语标签平滑的逻辑回归分类器。
AI.result: 加州州法案讨论中55.21%可用该语法解析；基于语法掩码与标签平滑的逻辑回归分类器优于更复杂模型，相对真实话语段标签取得52.8%的F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 语法引导的简单模型在立法听证修辞结构解析中表现最佳，表明结构化语法约束对立法话语分析有效，并为民主问责研究提供工具基础。

title: Who May Overrule the Agent? Evidence-Gated Authority in LLM Review Institutions
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Code, frozen outputs, and reproduction instructions: https://github.com/tofuadmiral/institutional-representation-abm
summary: Multi-agent language-model systems often add a reviewer to improve an upstream agent's decision. Yet a reviewer can both repair errors and replace decisions that were already correct. We study this as a problem of institutional jurisdiction: conditional on the same proposal, task information, model, and review output, when is the reviewer authorized to make its recommendation binding? We compare broad override authority with an evidence gate that permits replacement only after the reviewer produces a mechanically valid record of a binding-constraint violation and a compliant repair. Across two locally run open-weight models, 96 spatial-policy tasks, and a 96-task portfolio-transfer benchmark, the gate sharply reduces corruption of correct proposals while retaining most repairs of violations. The directions of this tradeoff are partly implied by the rule; its magnitude depends on reviewer transitions and upstream proposal states. A prospective validation then gives the reviewer an explicit choice to retain, replace, or escalate. This eliminates correct-proposal corruption for Qwen, but Mistral still replaces all 48 correct proposals; Qwen also declines every welfare-only repair that Mistral frequently attempts. Thus interface design changes reviewer behavior but is not a model-independent safeguard. The result is not that restricted review is universally better. It is that reviewer competence, action interface, and binding jurisdiction jointly determine both the correction domain and the corruption surface.

AI.tldr: 论文把"审阅者是否有权覆盖上游决定"当作制度性管辖问题来研究，比较"广泛覆盖权"与"证据门槛"两种授权规则，发现证据门槛能显著减少对正确提案的破坏同时保留大部分违规修复，但效果依赖审阅者能力与动作接口，并非模型无关的安全保障。
AI.motivation: 多智能体语言模型系统常用审阅者来改进上游决策，但审阅者既能纠正错误，也会错误替换本已正确的决策；关键问题是：在提案、任务信息、模型与审阅输出都相同的条件下，审阅者何时才有权使其建议具有约束力。
AI.method: 将审阅权设计形式化为"制度性管辖"问题。对比两种规则：(1) 广泛覆盖权；(2) 证据门槛——仅当审阅者给出机械可验证的约束违反记录并提供合规修复时才允许替换。实验使用两个本地部署的开源权重模型、96个空间政策任务，以及96任务的组合迁移基准；随后进行前瞻性验证，给审阅者显式三选一动作（保留/替换/升级）。
AI.result: 证据门槛显著降低对正确提案的破坏，同时保留大多数违规修复；该权衡方向部分由规则本身蕴含，但其幅度取决于审阅者的状态转移与上游提案状态。前瞻性验证中，显式选择接口使 Qwen 完全消除对正确提案的破坏，但 Mistral 仍替换了全部48个正确提案；Qwen 还拒绝所有仅涉福利的修复，而 Mistral 常尝试此类修复。
AI.conclusion: 结论并非"受限审阅普遍更优"，而是审阅者能力、动作接口与约束性管辖三者共同决定了纠错域与破坏面；接口设计能改变审阅者行为，但不能作为模型无关的安全保障。

title: Constraint-Preserving Flow Matching for Spectral Graph Generation
summary: Spectral graph generation models graphs through the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of their Laplacians, providing a compact and continuous alternative to direct graph construction. However, these eigensystems must retain the structural properties of graph Laplacians. Existing approaches preserve eigenvector orthonormality but do not enforce the Laplacian nullspace constraint, potentially producing eigensystems inconsistent with Laplacian structure. To address this, we introduce Laplacian-Constrained Stiefel Flow Matching (LaSFM), which preserves the nullspace condition alongside eigenvector orthonormality and positive eigenvalues during generation. We characterize the underlying constrained Stiefel manifold and formulate flow matching on it. We further extend LaSFM to property-guided generation, steering samples toward desired graph properties while maintaining these constraints. Experiments demonstrate improved performance on both spectral and graph-level metrics, along with better alignment with target properties.

AI.tldr: LaSFM在Stiefel流形上做流匹配，同时保持正交性、正特征值和对齐拉普拉斯零空间约束，并可扩展到属性引导生成。
AI.motivation: 现有谱图生成方法只保持特征向量正交性，未强制拉普拉斯零空间约束（即特征向量与全1向量正交），生成的特征系统可能与拉普拉斯结构不一致。
AI.method: 提出Laplacian-Constrained Stiefel Flow Matching：刻画受限Stiefel流形（同时满足零空间条件、正交性与正特征值），在其上构建流匹配生成；并扩展至属性引导生成，在保持约束下将样本导向目标图属性。
AI.result: 实验在谱级与图级指标上均有提升，且生成结果与目标属性对齐更好。
AI.conclusion: 将拉普拉斯零空间约束显式纳入流形建模可显著提升谱图生成的有效性与可控性。

title: VAR-Q: Tuning-free KV Cache Quantization for Visual Autoregressive Image and Video Generation
comment: A preliminary version of this work was presented at the ICCV 2025 BiVision Workshop
summary: Visual autoregressive generation spans two dominant paradigms: next-scale prediction for images and video, and next-frame prediction for video. Both decode block-by-block rather than token-by-token, yielding KV caches whose statistics diverge from those of language models. At scale, KV memory exceeds the weights and limits large-scale deployment caused by a large amount of visual tokens. Our analysis of these caches reveals three findings. First, a small set of massive-value channels carries the functional load: ablating these outlier channels collapses generation, whereas ablating a matched set of inlier channels leaves quality intact. Second, the outliers organize along two axes, feature and block, with magnitudes persistent within each cell and shifting across cells. Third, this structure arises from two independent mechanisms: projection bias and RoPE-induced scattering. Guided by these findings, we propose VAR-Q, a tuning-free KV-cache quantization framework that groups along the same two axes. The generation loop provides block boundaries for free, removing the need for outlier detection or calibration. Paired with bit-packing kernels for runtime memory reduction, VAR-Q delivers low-bit quantization across nine models spanning both paradigms, cutting KV memory by up to 78.5% with negligible quality degradation and enabling 6x larger inference batches.

AI.tldr: VAR-Q：面向视觉自回归生成的免调优KV缓存量化框架，利用离群通道在特征与块两轴上的结构进行分组量化，KV内存降78.5%，质量几乎无损，批大小提升6倍。
AI.motivation: 视觉自回归生成（下一尺度预测与下一帧预测）按块解码，KV缓存统计特性与语言模型不同；大规模下KV内存超过模型权重，限制部署。
AI.method: 分析KV缓存发现三点：少数大幅值离群通道承载功能、离群值沿特征与块两轴组织且单元内幅值持续、源于投影偏置与RoPE散射。据此提出免调优量化：沿两轴分组，生成循环天然提供块边界，无需离群检测或校准，配合bit-packing内核降运行时内存。
AI.result: 在两类范式共9个模型上实现低比特量化，KV内存最高降78.5%，质量退化可忽略，支持6倍更大推理批。
AI.conclusion: KV缓存离群结构可利用于高效量化，免校准的轴对齐分组策略为大规模视觉自回归部署提供实用方案。

title: LLM-based NPCs in Video Games: A Systematic Mapping Study
comment: 12 pages. Accepted manuscript. Published in IEEE Transactions on Games (Early Access)
summary: For decades, non-player characters (NPCs) have been driven by rule-based systems whose personalities and interactions are scripted before release. Large language models (LLMs) promise NPCs that converse openly, adapt to new situations, and behave in ways developers did not fully author, prompting a wave of research and commercial experimentation. Yet the field lacks a unified picture of what has been built, how well it works, and at what cost. We address this gap with a systematic mapping study of 377 papers from the academic literature, yielding 42 papers analysed against a main research question and ten sub-questions across four thematic axes. We provide the first quantitative characterisation of component adoption, latency, safety coverage, and reproducibility: short-term memory and world-state grounding are near-universal (60% and 69%), whereas long-term memory (31%), reflection (38%), and retrieval-augmented generation (14%) remain rare, and response times span 2.6 to 15 seconds. Finally, we identify six structural barriers to commercial adoption and offer evidence-based recommendations for developers and researchers.

AI.tldr: 系统性映射研究分析377篇论文（其中42篇深度分析），首次定量刻画LLM驱动NPC的组件采纳、延迟、安全性与可复现性，并识别六大商用障碍。
AI.motivation: 传统NPC依赖规则系统，性格与交互在发布前写死；LLM带来开放式对话与自适应行为的新可能，但领域缺乏对"已建了什么、效果如何、代价多大"的统一认识。
AI.method: 对学术文献进行系统性映射研究，从377篇论文中筛选42篇，围绕一个主研究问题与十个子问题、跨四个主题轴进行分析与定量统计。
AI.result: 短期记忆（60%）与世界状态 grounding（69%）近乎普遍；长期记忆（31%）、反思（38%）、RAG（14%）仍少见；响应时间跨度2.6–15秒。首次给出组件采纳、延迟、安全覆盖与可复现性的定量特征。
AI.conclusion: 识别出制约商用落地的六个结构性障碍，并为开发者与研究者提供有证据支撑的建议。

title: Offline Learning of Reserve Prices from Censored Bids
comment: 87 pages, 12 figures, 25 tables. Authors listed alphabetically
summary: We study how a seller can learn a reserve price for a second-price auction from censored historical bid data. Because values below past reserves are unobserved, even unlimited data may not reveal which reserve earns the most revenue. Under a monotone hazard rate (MHR) assumption, we characterize exactly when an optimal reserve is identified, even though the value distribution may not be: either revenue has not yet begun to fall at the lowest historical reserve, so the best reserve lies among the observed bids, or the censored fraction is as large as MHR allows, which pins down the entire distribution. When identification fails, we derive the reserve that minimizes worst-case revenue regret over distributions consistent with the data, and prove that this unique minimax reserve and its regret depend on just two observable quantities: the censored fraction and the hazard just above the lowest historical reserve. With $N$ historical bidders, the optimal reserve is learned with expected worst-case regret $O(N^{-1/2})$ when it lies among the observed bids, and $O(N^{-1})$ from the censored count alone when the censored fraction is as large as MHR allows and the optimum lies at or below the lowest reserve. In the nonidentifiable regime, plugging estimates of the two quantities into the minimax reserve gives expected worst-case regret within $O(N^{-2/5})$ of the population minimum under local density smoothness, with a matching minimax lower bound on a smooth class. Beyond MHR, we solve the minimax problem for regular and unrestricted distributions and prove an $O(N^{-2/5})$ learning bound in the regular nonidentifiable regime, given known bounds on the boundary parameters. Experiments on synthetic and eBay data show gains from exploiting MHR and the benefits of the robust rule when parametric models are misspecified.

AI.tldr: 研究在删失历史出价数据下学习次价拍卖保留价的可识别性与极小极大遗憾，给出MHR下最优保留价何时可识别，以及不可识别时的稳健保留价与学习速率。
AI.motivation: 卖家需从历史出价数据学习最优保留价，但低于历史保留价的出价被删失，即使数据无限也可能无法确定哪个保留价收益最高，因此需要刻画可识别性并给出稳健方案。
AI.method: 在单调风险率(MHR)假设下刻画最优保留价的可识别条件；不可识别时求解对抗一致分布的极小极大遗憾保留价；用删失比例与最低历史保留价上方风险率两个可观测量构造估计并分析速率；进一步对正则与无约束分布求解极小极大问题，并用合成数据与eBay数据验证。
AI.result: MHR下可识别当且仅当最低历史保留价处收益尚未下降（最优在观测出价中）或删失比例达到MHR上限（分布被完全确定）；极小极大保留价与遗憾仅依赖两个可观测量。N个历史竞标者时，最坏期望遗憾在可识别情形为O(N^{-1/2})，删失计数情形为O(N^{-1})；不可识别情形下代入估计得到O(N^{-2/5})并匹配下界。正则不可识别情形亦获O(N^{-2/5})学习界。实验显示利用MHR与稳健规则在模型误设时有收益。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出删失出价下保留价学习的完整可识别性与极小极大理论，并提供实用稳健规则，在合成与eBay数据上验证其有效性。

title: Mobility-Aware Mobile Edge Computing for Energy-Balanced Data Collection in IoT-Enabled Underwater Sensor Networks
comment: Presented at the International Conference on Computing and Communication Networks (ICCCNet-2026)
summary: Underwater wireless sensor networks (UWSNs) face critical challenges in energy imbalance, connectivity, and data collection due to harsh environments. To address these issues, this paper focuses on the problem is how to achieve energy-balanced data collection in IoT-enabled UWSNs with a mobility-aware mobile edge computing (MEC), named MECEBDC. Unlike existing approaches, the proposed scheme jointly optimizes energy-aware clustering, cluster head selection, and AUV-assisted data collection. Furthermore, we design a novel metaheuristic-based AUV routing algorithm that incorporates realistic underwater mobility dynamics, explicitly considering gravitational pressure and buoyancy forces acting on the AUV. By leveraging the computing, storage, and mobility capabilities of MEC-enabled AUVs, the proposed approach enables efficient trajectory planning and adaptive data gathering in a stable 3D underwater environment. Extensive simulations and theoretical analysis demonstrate that the proposed method significantly reduces node energy consumption, improves data collection efficiency, and prolongs network lifetime compared with existing schemes, making it well suited for long-term underwater IoT applications.

AI.tldr: 本文针对物联网使能的水下无线传感器网络（UWSNs），提出MECEBDC方案，利用移动感知的移动边缘计算（MEC）实现能量均衡的数据收集，并显著提升网络寿命。
AI.motivation: 水下无线传感器网络受恶劣环境影响，存在能量不均衡、连通性差、数据收集困难等关键挑战，现有方法难以兼顾能量均衡与高效数据收集。
AI.method: 联合优化能量感知分簇、簇头选择与AUV辅助数据收集；设计基于元启发式的新型AUV路由算法，融入真实水下移动动力学（重力压力与浮力），利用MEC使能AUV的计算、存储与移动能力，在稳定3D环境中实现高效轨迹规划与自适应数据采集。
AI.result: 大量仿真与理论分析表明，相比现有方案，该方法显著降低节点能耗、提高数据收集效率并延长网络寿命。
AI.conclusion: MECEBDC适用于长期水下物联网应用，是能量均衡且高效的数据收集方案。

title: Chronos: Sequential Identity-Preserving Video Generation by Temporal Anchoring
comment: Accepted by ACM MM 2026. 1st place in Tracks 1 and 2 of the ACM MM 2026 Identity-Preserving Video Generation Challenge
summary: Identity-preserving video generation aims to synthesize high-quality and visually realistic videos from textual and visual conditions while faithfully maintaining the subject's identity across diverse motions. Prior methods have extensively introduced reference-guided control signals and identity-aware conditioning to improve facial alignment from reference images. However, improving static identity alignment alone creates a fundamental tension between identity fidelity and temporal controllability, which frequently causes identity drift or motion suppression under large pose variations and multi-segment sequential actions. To address this, we propose Chronos, a framework that unifies single-segment facial identity preservation and multi-segment sequential action generation under a common temporal formulation. Specifically, Chronos integrates Semantic Prompt Anchoring to adaptively refine the user prompt, Visual Frame Anchoring to transform conditions into visually grounded keyframe anchors for visual guidance, and Metric-Guided Candidate Routing to select the highest-quality videos from heterogeneous generators via multi-dimensional evaluation. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the superiority of our approach, which achieved first place in both Track 1 and Track 2 of the ACM MM 2026 Identity-Preserving Video Generation Challenge, demonstrating its effectiveness across both facial identity preservation and sequential action generation settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 Chronos 框架，统一单片段面部身份保持与多片段序列动作生成，在 ACM MM 2026 身份保持视频生成挑战赛 Track 1 和 Track 2 均获第一。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要通过参考图引导和身份感知条件提升面部对齐，但仅优化静态身份对齐会在身份保真度与时序可控性之间产生根本性张力，导致大姿态变化和多段序列动作下出现身份漂移或动作被抑制。
AI.method: Chronos 将单片段与多片段任务统一到共同时序建模框架下，包含三个组件：语义提示锚定（自适应精炼用户提示）、视觉帧锚定（将条件转化为视觉落地的关键帧锚点作为视觉引导）、度量引导的候选路由（通过多维评估从异构生成器中挑选最高质量视频）。
AI.result: 大量评估验证了方法的优越性，在 ACM MM 2026 Identity-Preserving Video Generation Challenge 的 Track 1（面部身份保持）和 Track 2（序列动作生成）中均获得第一名。
AI.conclusion: 统一时序建模下结合提示精炼、关键帧视觉锚定与多生成器候选路由，可有效兼顾身份保真与动作可控性，适用于单片段与多片段两类设定。

title: SciToT: Multimodal Tip-of-the-Tongue Retrieval for Scientific Papers
summary:
Researchers frequently encounter difficulties re-finding scientific papers when they remember aspects of the content but cannot recall reliable identifiers, such as titles or author names. This type of re-finding task, known as tip-of-the-tongue (ToT) retrieval, is particularly challenging for scientific documents, where recollections may involve textual information and visual elements, including figures, diagrams, and plots. Existing ToT retrieval benchmarks do not address scientific search.
  We introduce a multimodal benchmark for scientific ToT retrieval, comprising 108,512 open-access scientific documents across five domains and 11,499 synthetically generated queries. To construct the benchmark, we propose a scalable query elicitation pipeline that independently extracts textual and visual memory cues from source documents and uses large language models to generate queries resembling incomplete human recollections. We characterize scientific ToT information needs through an empirical analysis of publicly available re-finding requests and use the outcomes to assess the generated queries using human annotations and automated quality control. The benchmark includes lexical, dense, late-interaction, and visually grounded retrieval baselines. We release the dataset, extracted document representations, generated memory cues, evaluation splits, and accompanying generation and retrieval pipelines under an MIT license to facilitate research on multimodal scientific paper re-finding.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了首个面向科学文献的多模态"话到嘴边"(tip-of-the-tongue, ToT)检索基准，包含108,512篇跨5个领域的开放获取文献和11,499条合成查询，并提供文本与视觉记忆线索的生成流程与多类检索基线。
AI.motivation: 研究者常只记得论文内容的某些方面（如标题或作者名记不清）而难以重新找到文献。科学文档的ToT检索更难，因为记忆可能同时涉及文本信息和视觉元素（图、表、曲线图），而现有ToT检索基准未覆盖科学检索场景。
AI.method: 构建一个可扩展的查询生成流程：从源文档中分别提取文本与视觉记忆线索，利用大语言模型生成类似人类不完整回忆的查询；通过对公开再查找请求的实证分析刻画科学ToT信息需求，并用人工标注与自动化质控评估生成查询的质量。基准包含词法、稠密、后期交互和视觉 grounding 等检索基线。
AI.result: 构建了含108,512篇文献（5个领域）与11,499条合成查询的多模态ToT检索基准，并通过人工标注和自动质控验证了生成查询的质量；提供了多类检索基线的评估结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了科学文献ToT检索基准的空白，以MIT许可发布数据集、文档表示、记忆线索、评估划分及生成与检索流程，促进多模态科学论文再查找研究。

title: DS@GT ARC at CheckThat! 2026: A Verdict-Anchored Pipeline for Generating Fact-Checking Articles
comment: CLEF 2026 Working Notes, 21 - 24 September 2026, Jena, Germany
summary: Misinformation spreads faster than professional fact-checkers can manually verify it and write articles explaining their verdicts. This creates a need to automate the production of fact-checking articles. This paper details work done by the DS@GT ARC team for CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab Task 3 Fact-Checking Article Generation. We seek to generate a full fact-checking article from a claim, its original verdict, and a set of scraped source documents. Our team built a four-stage pipeline that cleans noisy evidence, retrieves and clusters relevant sources, generates the article by conditioning \texttt{Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct} on the original fact-checker verdict, and recovers inline citations through deterministic post-processing. We achieved a mean score of 0.428 and ranked 3rd out of 9 teams for the CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab Task 3, compared to a baseline mean score of 0.272. Our code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/dsgt-arc/checkthat-2026-task3.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍 DS@GT ARC 团队参加 CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab Task 3 的工作：基于声明、原始判定和抓取的源文档，自动生成完整的事实核查文章。方案为四阶段流水线（清洗噪声证据→检索与聚类相关来源→以原始判定为条件用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 生成文章→确定性后处理恢复行内引用），最终以 0.428 的均分在 9 支队伍中排名第 3（基线 0.272）。
AI.motivation: 虚假信息传播速度远超人工事实核查的速度，人工撰写解释判定的核查文章难以跟上，因此需要自动化生成事实核查文章以缓解瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建四阶段流水线：1) 清洗含噪证据；2) 检索并聚类相关来源；3) 以原始事实核查者判定为条件，用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 生成文章；4) 通过确定性后处理恢复行内引用。
AI.result: 在 CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab Task 3 中取得 0.428 的均分，9 支队伍中排名第 3，显著高于 0.272 的基线均分。
AI.conclusion: 条件化生成与噪声清洗、来源聚类的分阶段设计能有效提升事实核查文章的自动生成质量；代码已在 GitHub 开源。

title: Agent Harness Awareness: Turning Verified Telemetry into Operational Control for Tool-Using Agents
summary: Tool descriptions tell an agent what an action can do, but they do not necessarily reveal whether that action is healthy or suitable at the moment of use. Execution harnesses often possess this information through monitors, traces, and recent failures while the model choosing the next action does not. We call this gap operational blindness. We introduce Agent Harness Awareness, a trust-separated design in which the host supplies a small, fresh, verified state snapshot before a consequential action while retaining measurement, enforcement, evaluation, and final dispatch authority. We test its tools-and-network instance with ToolRoute, a controlled isolation benchmark that holds the task and candidate semantics constant and varies the operational information available to the model. In a 216-decision ablation across GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5, and Gemini 3.7 Flash, verified tool-health state reduced mean observable policy regret by 96.9% against a same-shape neutral control (4,252 ms to 131 ms) and raised single-dispatch completion from 69.4% to 95.8%. In a separate 27-decision end-to-end replication with live local TCP/HTTP execution, OpenTelemetry client spans, and Toxiproxy-injected faults, verified state reduced mean regret from 8,956 ms to 0 ms (zero excess observable operational cost) and completed the live action in 9/9 model-by-fault cases versus 5/9 for the neutral control. These studies establish the tools-and-network instance of Agent Harness Awareness: selected host telemetry materially improves pre-dispatch operational choice. Runtime state, hardware pressure, economics, retry-aware recovery, and heterogeneous selection remain open empirical extensions of the same architecture.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"Agent Harness Awareness"（智能体执行框架感知）设计，通过在关键动作前由宿主向模型提供少量、新鲜且经核验的运行时状态快照，弥补模型"操作盲区"，并在工具—网络场景（ToolRoute基准）中显著降低策略后悔、提升单次派发完成率。
AI.motivation: 工具描述只说明动作能做什么，却不告诉模型该动作当下是否健康、是否适用。执行框架(harness)通过监控、追踪和近期故障掌握这些信息，而选择下一步动作的模型却不掌握，作者将此信息不对称称为"操作盲区"(operational blindness)。
AI.method: 提出信任分离的Agent Harness Awareness架构：宿主在关键动作前提供小型、实时、经核验的状态快照，同时保留测量、执行、评估与最终派发权限。以ToolRoute受控隔离基准测试工具与网络实例，保持任务与候选语义不变、仅变化模型可见的操作信息；用GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Sonnet 5、Gemini 3.7 Flash做消融与端到端复现（含真实TCP/HTTP、OpenTelemetry span与Toxiproxy故障注入）。
AI.result: 216次决策消融中，经核验的工具健康状态使平均可观测策略后悔下降96.9%（4252ms→131ms），单次派发完成率由69.4%升至95.8%。独立27次决策端到端复现中，后悔由8956ms降至0ms，真实动作完成9/9对比对照组5/9。
AI.conclusion: 已确立工具与网络实例：精选的宿主遥测能实质性改善派发前的操作选择。运行时状态、硬件压力、经济性、重试感知恢复与异构选择仍是该架构的开放实证方向。

title: Learning Implicit Solves for Dynamic Simulations
summary: High-fidelity simulation of dynamical systems is central to scientific discovery and engineering design, yet remains computationally demanding. Here we introduce the Implicit Neural Operator Solver (INOS), which learns the implicit solve and encodes a time integrator. INOS pretrains a neural operator from static equilibrium solutions and reuses it within Newmark-$β$ integration. At each time increment, the integrator forms an effective equilibrium problem, the pretrained neural operator infers the next-step solution field, and the Newmark relations advance the dynamic state. Numerical examples in linear and nonlinear elastodynamics demonstrate accurate full-field predictions without dynamic trajectory supervision. Comparative results show that INOS, evaluated zero-shot, achieves higher predictive accuracy than neural solver baselines trained on dynamic simulations. In addition, INOS delivers over 4,600$\times$ speedup in nonlinear simulations over sequential classical finite-element solvers. INOS natively accommodates changes in dynamic conditions and enables reuse of the pretrained operator across spatial and temporal discretizations. Further evaluation demonstrates a stable million-step rollout. These findings establish INOS as a reusable neural implicit solver for accurate, efficient, and robust dynamic modeling.

AI.tldr: INOS 通过学习隐式求解并将 Newmark-β 时间积分器编码进网络，仅用静态平衡数据预训练的神经算子即可实现高精度、免轨迹监督的动力学仿真，零样本下优于动态训练基线，非线性算例提速超 4600 倍。
AI.motivation: 高保真动力学仿真计算代价高昂；现有神经求解器通常依赖昂贵且难以泛化的动态轨迹监督，缺少可复用的通用隐式求解器。
AI.method: 用静态平衡解预训练神经算子；在每个时间步将 Newmark-β 积分转化为等效平衡问题，由预训练算子推断下一步解场，再由 Newmark 关系推进动态状态。
AI.result: 在线性与非线性弹性动力学中实现准确全场预测且无需动态轨迹监督；零样本精度高于动态训练基线；非线性仿真较串行有限元提速 4600 倍以上；支持跨空间/时间离散复用与百万步稳定推演。
AI.conclusion: INOS 是一种可复用的神经隐式求解器，实现准确、高效、稳健的动力学建模，并能天然适应动态条件变化。

title: Visual Forensic Detection of Fabricated Bangla News Photocards using Deep Learning
summary: In Bangladesh, much localized misinformation spreads as photocards: single-image news summaries that imitate the branding of well-known news organizations. Because the misleading message lives in the pixels rather than in machine-readable text, text-based fact-checking tools cannot see it. We recast photocard fake-news detection as visual image forgery detection. We build a dataset of 969 authentic and 1,077 fabricated Bangla photocards scraped from public Facebook pages: authentic cards from the verified pages of seventeen national television broadcasters, fabricated ones from pseudo-broadcaster pages, anonymous profiles, and public groups. Sixteen photometric and morphological transformations per image grow the corpus to 32,736 samples. A fully connected ANN reaches only about 52% accuracy, its loss stuck at ln(2) ~ 0.693, showing that flattening the image destroys the spatial cues forgery detection needs. A compact, fully batch-normalized four-block CNN with 489,954 parameters, about 1,644x smaller than the ANN, is evaluated with leakage-free stratified group five-fold cross-validation, which keeps every augmented version of a card in one fold. Under this protocol the CNN reaches 87.45% +/- 0.53% pooled accuracy from scratch and 88.75% +/- 1.55% when its classifier head is warm-started from the ANN. An ImageNet-pretrained YOLOv8n-cls backbone (1.44M parameters) fine-tuned on the same folds reaches 97.36% +/- 0.42%, marking the headroom above the compact model. We report per-class precision, recall, F1, and pooled confusion matrices, diagnose and fix a one-class collapse caused by an unnormalized classifier head, and give a manual error analysis and bias-variance diagnosis showing that the compact CNNs under-fit.

AI.tldr: 将孟加拉语"照片卡"假新闻识别重构为视觉图像伪造检测任务，构建约3.3万样本数据集，用紧凑BN-CNN实现从零训练87.45%准确率，预训练YOLOv8n-cls达97.36%。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国大量本地化虚假信息以"照片卡"（仿冒知名媒体品牌的单图新闻摘要）形式传播，误导信息存在于像素而非机器可读文本中，基于文本的事实核查工具无法检测，因此需转为视觉图像伪造检测问题。
AI.method: 从Facebook公开页面爬取969张真实（17家国有电视台认证页）与1,077张伪造照片卡；经16种光度与形态变换扩充至32,736样本。采用无泄漏分层分组五折交叉验证（同一卡的所有增强版本置于同一折）。对比三种模型：全连接ANN、约49万参数的全批归一化四块CNN（从头训练及用ANN热启动分类头）、ImageNet预训练YOLOv8n-cls（1.44M参数）微调。
AI.result: ANN仅约52%准确率，损失停在ln2≈0.693，说明展平图像破坏了空间线索。紧凑CNN从头训练87.45%±0.53%，热启动后88.75%±1.55%；YOLOv8n-cls达97.36%±0.42%。报告了各类别精确率、召回率、F1与汇总混淆矩阵，诊断并修复了未归一化分类头导致的单类坍缩，误差分析与偏差-方差诊断显示紧凑CNN存在欠拟合。
AI.conclusion: 视觉伪造检测框架适用于像素级虚假信息，紧凑CNN已具实用性能，而近10个百分点的差距揭示了空间建模与迁移学习的提升空间；同时强调无泄漏分组验证和分类头归一化的必要性。

title: Req-Space: A User Study of Interactive Visualisations for Requirements Review
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Requirements review involves identifying inconsistencies and assessing change implications across distributed specifications. Motivated by needs raised in industrial project workshops, we investigate Req-Space, an interactive prototype integrating semantic exploration and traceability visualisation to support human-led review. We conducted a fixed-order, two-phase study with 20 participants, including 11 with at least three years of software or IT experience. Participants reviewed a fictional 40-requirement software specification and a guest-checkout change request, first using source documents and then revisiting the same tasks with Req-Space. During the supported review, 17 participants recorded at least one additional source-supported item or pair. Of 69 assessable additional units, 58 (84.1%) were judged supported by the source materials. Seven decision rationales were judged stronger in Phase 2, including five without a change in the decision category. Participants generally found the visualisations helpful, although workload responses were mixed and some misinterpreted visual relationships. The findings suggest that visual support can facilitate requirements exploration and decision justification, provided relationship meanings and source context remain clear. The fixed study sequence prevents attributing the observed changes specifically to Req-Space.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 Req-Space，一个结合语义探索与可追溯性可视化的交互原型，用于支持人工主导的需求评审；通过20人两阶段研究，发现可视化支持能帮助发现更多有依据的评审项并强化决策理由。
AI.motivation: 分布式规格文档中的需求评审需要识别不一致性并评估变更影响，工业项目研讨会提出了相关需求，因此研究如何用交互工具支持人工主导的评审。
AI.method: 开展固定顺序的两阶段研究，20名参与者（其中11人具备至少三年软件/IT经验）先使用原始文档、再用 Req-Space 完成同一任务，评审一份虚构的40条需求规格及一个访客结账变更请求。
AI.result: 使用 Req-Space 时17名参与者记录至少一项额外的有来源支持的条目或配对；69个可评估新增单元中58个（84.1%）被判定有来源支持；7条决策理由在第二阶段更强，其中5条决策类别未变化。参与者普遍认为可视化有帮助，但工作负荷反馈不一，部分人误读了可视化关系。
AI.conclusion: 可视化支持有助于需求探索和决策论证，前提是关系含义与来源上下文保持清晰；由于研究采用固定顺序，无法将观察到的变化专门归因于 Req-Space。

title: Breaking the One-Player Extension Barrier: History-Aware Repair for Multiplayer Approximate Nash Equilibria
summary: Computation of Nash equilibria is a central problem in algorithmic game theory, yet exact equilibrium computation is $\mathsf{PPAD}$-complete even for two-player games. This hardness motivates the study of polynomial-time algorithms for approximate Nash equilibria. While substantial progress has been made for two-player and three-player games, existing algorithms for general $m$-player games have largely relied on repeatedly applying one-player extension starting from improved fixed-player algorithms. Such improvements can at best strengthen the classical $1-1/m$ guarantee to $1-1/(m-c)$, for some constant $c$ independent of $m$. We break this long-standing barrier by developing an iterative algorithm that directly tackles general $m$-player games and achieves a $(1-(σ_{\star}-ε)/m)$-approximation for fixed $ε> 0$ and sufficiently large $m$, where $σ_\star\approx1.5867$ is the unique root in $(1,2)$ of $σ_\star^3-19σ_\star^2+27σ_\star+1=0$. Our approach rests on a novel iterative descent-and-repair framework that allows multiple rounds of repair. At the heart of our analysis is a new potential function inspired by continuous-time dynamics, which certifies progress across iterations and ensures polynomial-time termination. Our results highlight the power of history-aware, iterative repair in breaking approximation barriers for multiplayer games.

AI.tldr: 该论文打破通用 m 人博弈近似纳什均衡的 1-1/m 长期瓶颈，提出迭代"下降-修复"算法，达到 (1-(σ⋆-ε)/m) 的近似保证，其中 σ⋆≈1.5867 是某三次方程在 (1,2) 内的唯一根。
AI.motivation: 精确纳什均衡计算即使二人博弈也是 PPAD-完全，故研究近似均衡有重要意义。二人、三人博弈已有显著进展，但一般 m 人博弈现有算法基本依赖从单玩家扩展反复构造，最多只能把经典 1-1/m 保证改进到 1-1/(m-c)（c 为与 m 无关的常数）。本文旨在突破这一长期障碍。
AI.method: 提出直接针对一般 m 人博弈的迭代算法，基于新颖的"下降-修复"框架，支持多轮修复（history-aware、迭代修复）。分析核心是一个受连续时间动力学启发的新型势函数，用于刻画各迭代间的进展并保证多项式时间终止。
AI.result: 对固定 ε>0 及充分大的 m，算法实现 (1-(σ⋆-ε)/m)-近似，σ⋆≈1.5867 为 σ³-19σ²+27σ+1=0 在 (1,2) 内的唯一根。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了历史感知、迭代修复机制在打破多人博弈近似壁垒方面的威力，突破了 1-1/m 型保证的长期极限。

title: From Admission to Retention: Predicting Durable Offspring in Quality-Diversity Search
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust)
summary: Automated failure discovery can be framed as a diversity problem: the objective is to expose distinct ways a system fails rather than a single critical adversarial case. Yet uniform parent sampling provides no way to allocate search effort toward individuals likely to produce durable archive contributions. We study this credit assignment problem in an unstructured Quality-Diversity (QD) archive, testing whether signals available before an individual has reproduced distinguish offspring that merely enter the archive from those still retained generations later. Across a planar-arm benchmark and two robotic-locomotion tasks, the same signals are often associated with entry and persistence in opposite directions. In particular, lineage depth is the clearest such signal, and its persistence discrimination grows with population capacity, which is associated with lower turnover. Biasing parent selection toward the signals with the strongest measured association to survival nevertheless does not improve search: moderate bias matches uniform sampling, and strong bias reduces QD-score.

AI.tldr: 本文研究开放式质量-多样性(QD)存档中的"信用分配"问题：能否用个体繁殖前的可得信号区分"仅进入存档"与"长期保留"的后代。结果发现这些信号对进入与持久的影响常方向相反，即使按与存活的关联性偏置父代选择，也不能改善搜索性能。
AI.motivation: 自动失效发现本质是多样性问题，目标是暴露系统不同的失效方式，而非单个关键对抗样例。但均匀父代采样无法把搜索资源分配给更可能产生持久存档贡献的个体，因此需要研究这一信用分配问题。
AI.method: 在非结构化QD存档中，测试个体繁殖前可得的信号能否区分"进入存档"与"数代后仍保留"的后代。实验涵盖一个平面机械臂基准与两个机器人运动任务，并检验按这些信号的关联强度偏置父代选择的策略。
AI.result: 同一信号在进入存档与持久保留上常呈相反方向关联。谱系深度(linage depth)是最清晰的此类信号，其持久判别力随种群容量增大而增强，并与更低的更替率相关。然而，按与存活关联最强的信号偏置父代选择并未改善搜索：中等偏置等同于均匀采样，强偏置则降低QD-score。
AI.conclusion: 繁殖前信号虽能预测存档持久性，但不能直接转化为更好的父代选择策略；简单的关联性偏置无益甚至有害，提示QD中的信用分配需要比"预测存活"更细致的机制设计。

title: Clips2Story: Training-Free Video Storyboarding and Editing Using Multimodal Retrieval-Embedded Generation
summary: Video editors often work with large collections of fragmented footage and must select and organize relevant clips into a coherent story. However, many existing video editing and summarization methods assume a temporally ordered source video and aim to preserve its original narrative and temporal structure. In this paper, we introduce Clips2Story, a training-free, LLM-based pipeline that enables users to create keyword-specified short videos from a pool of video clips. Given a pool of clips and a user-specified keyword, we first extract text-based multimodal descriptors for each clip and retrieve the clips most relevant to the keyword. We then provide the textual descriptors of these candidate clips to an LLM, which selects and arranges them into an editable storyboard with connective narrations. Finally, we assemble the selected clips and retrieve accompanying visuals for the narrations to compose the output video. To evaluate the proposed pipeline, we construct a synthetic evaluation dataset from 100 long-form videos across five genres by segmenting each video into short clips using a scene-change detection model and shuffling the resulting clips to remove their temporal order. Through objective evaluation and qualitative examples, we demonstrate that Clips2Story can effectively retrieve keyword-relevant clips and compose coherent storyboards based on user-specified keywords. Human evaluation further shows that Clips2Story outperforms a strong baseline in terms of narrative coherence, keyword alignment, and overall realism.

AI.tldr: 提出Clips2Story：一种无需训练的LLM流水线，可从无序视频片段池中按用户关键词挑选并组织片段，生成连贯短视频。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑与摘要方法假设源视频时序有序、需保留原叙事结构；而实际剪辑师常面对大量碎片化、无序的素材，需要按主题重新组织故事。
AI.method: 提取每个片段的文本化多模态描述子，按关键词检索相关候选片段；将候选片段的文本描述交给LLM，由其挑选并排列成带连接旁白的可编辑分镜；最后拼接所选片段，并为旁白检索配图合成视频。
AI.result: 基于100个长视频、5类题材构建合成评测集（用场景变化检测切分片段并打乱时序）；客观评估与定性示例显示能有效检索相关片段并生成连贯分镜；人工评估在叙事连贯性、关键词对齐和真实感上优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 训练自由的LLM流水线可在打破时序假设的碎片化素材上实现关键词驱动的短视频创作，效果优于现有强基线。

title: Weaver: Weaving Preference Evidence through Incremental Reasoning for Personalized Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Personalized retrieval-augmented generation requires extracting and applying user preferences from extended interaction histories. This task is challenging because preference evidence is scattered across past conversations and remains bound to specific temporal and situational contexts. Consequently, isolated fragments rarely provide complete support for a response, while preferences expressed under different conditions are easily conflated. To address these limitations, we propose Weaver, a framework that incrementally weaves memory-conditioned retrieval trajectories with compositional preference reasoning for personalized responses. Weaver operates on a Dual-Layer Retrieval and Reasoning Graph that couples an upper Intent Dependency Graph with a lower Memory-Conditioned Retrieval Trajectory Graph. Dependency Information Gap Tracking represents the information needed to answer the current request and its prerequisite dependencies in the upper graph. Memory-Conditioned Incremental Retrieval uses established premises and clues from retrieved conversations to locate missing evidence, recording the resulting retrieval trajectories in the lower graph. Scope-Aware Compositional Reasoning jointly interprets the accumulated evidence to determine which preferences apply to the request. It identifies complementary and alternative support and distinguishes conflicting claims within the same temporal and situational context. These conclusions iteratively update task premises and remaining information gaps, guiding subsequent retrieval to establish a coherent contextual basis for the final response. Experiments on personalized RAG benchmarks, particularly PersonaMem, demonstrate that Weaver outperforms leading baselines in both evidence completeness and answer quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 Weaver 框架，通过双层检索推理图（意图依赖图+记忆条件检索轨迹图）增量编织检索轨迹并进行组合式偏好推理，解决个性化 RAG 中偏好证据分散、上下文易混淆的问题。
AI.motivation: 个性化 RAG 需从长交互历史中提取用户偏好，但证据分散于过往对话且绑定具体时间与情境：孤立片段难支撑完整回答，不同条件下的偏好又易被混淆。
AI.method: 1) 双层检索与推理图：上层意图依赖图 + 下层记忆条件检索轨迹图；2) 依赖信息缺口追踪（DIGT）表示当前请求所需信息及前置依赖；3) 记忆条件增量检索（MCIR）利用已有前提与线索定位缺失证据并记录轨迹；4) 范围感知组合推理（SACR）联合解释累积证据，识别互补/替代支持、区分同一时空情境下的冲突主张，并迭代更新前提与信息缺口以指导后续检索。
AI.result: 在个性化 RAG 基准（尤其 PersonaMem）上，Weaver 在证据完整性与回答质量两方面均优于主流基线。
AI.conclusion: 将检索组织为依赖驱动的增量轨迹并对证据做情境范围感知的组合推理，可有效整合分散且情境相关的偏好证据，为个性化 RAG 提供连贯的上下文基础。

title: CCDWIKI: Decoupling Case Formulation from Response Generation in Longitudinal CBT Dialogue
summary: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) demands more than empathic validation, requiring instead a structured formulation of the interplay among situations, automatic thoughts, emotions, and behaviors. Therapists formalize this interplay through a Cognitive Conceptualization Diagram, where maintaining longitudinal coherence necessitates continuous evidential adjudication to separate tentative hypotheses from established findings. Current dialogue systems track conversational history via retrieval or static profiles but lack the representational capacity to encode epistemic status. Consequently, provisional interpretations are often prematurely reified as established facts, inadvertently biasing downstream interventions. Addressing this limitation, CCDWiki is introduced as a plug-and-play advisor conceptualizing longitudinal therapy as evidence-grounded hypothesis adjudication. The approach encodes each clinical hypothesis as a mutable entry bound to corroborating and contradicting evidence. Across sessions, accumulating data strengthens supported entries, preserves provisional ones, and retracts contradicted assumptions. The resulting formulation distills into concise guidance for unmodified therapeutic language models. Experiments demonstrate substantial improvements in both conceptualization and intervention quality without requiring backbone retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用的CCDWiki顾问模块，将长期治疗建模为"证据驱动的假设裁决"过程，用可变条目编码每条临床假设及其正反证据，在不重训基座模型的情况下显著提升概念化与干预质量。
AI.motivation: CBT需要结构化的认知概念化（情境—自动思维—情绪—行为的相互作用），并通过"认知概念化图"保持纵向一致性。现有对话系统仅靠检索或静态画像记录历史，缺乏编码"认知状态（epistemic status）"的表征能力，导致暂定解释被过早固化为事实，误导后续干预。
AI.method: CCDWiki作为可插拔顾问：将每条临床假设编码为可变条目，绑定支持性证据与矛盾性证据；跨会话累积数据时，强化被支持的条目、保留暂定条目、撤回被否证的假设；最终把形成中的概念化蒸馏为简洁指引，注入未经修改的治疗语言模型。
AI.result: 实验表明，在概念化质量与干预质量两方面均有大幅提升，且无需对骨干模型进行重训练。
AI.conclusion: 将认知状态显式表征并实行动态证据裁决，是解决治疗对话系统中"暂定假设被过早固化"问题的有效途径；CCDWiki以即插即用、免重训的方式为现有治疗LLM提供纵向一致性支持。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Resource Orchestration for Agentic AI Systems
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to IEEE MECOM 2026, Marrakech, Morocco, 2-4 November 2026
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems powered by large language models (LLMs) execute as autonomous multi-step pipelines that dynamically invoke tools, integrate observations into memory, and iterate until a task is resolved or a resource budget is exhausted. Unlike classical workflows with fixed graphs, the aggregate compute, bandwidth, and end-to-end latency demands of such pipelines are unknown at dispatch time: they emerge at runtime from intermediate observations and stochastic token sampling, yielding heavy-tailed, multi-modal random variables. This unpredictability forces infrastructure orchestrators into a dilemma: under-provisioning risks mid-execution throttling and deadline violations, while over-provisioning wastes scarce edge or cloud capacity. Existing schedulers require a fully known pipeline graph, while edge resource-management methods rely on parametric or stationary demand models, and neither fits the unknown, non-stationary profiles of agentic pipelines. We formalize this setting as the uncertainty-aware agentic orchestration problem, where the goal is to reserve, at dispatch time, compute and bandwidth allocations that cover actual pipeline demands, and to verify that the pipeline can meet its deadline, each with a prescribed probability. We then propose Conformal Reservation for Orchestration (CRO), an online algorithm that translates a sliding window of past execution traces into dispatch-time resource allocations with finite-sample, distribution-free coverage guarantees via conformal prediction. Simulations over heterogeneous task mixes with multi-modal and heavy-tailed profiles show that CRO is the only evaluated method that simultaneously satisfies target probabilistic coverage across all risk levels while, among coverage-feasible methods, attaining the lowest over-reservation, roughly halving the resource waste of the Chebyshev-bound baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文将LLM智能体多步流水线的资源编排形式化为"不确定性感知的智能体编排问题"，提出基于共形预测的在线算法CRO，在分发时为计算与带宽分配提供有限样本、无分布假设的概率覆盖保证。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI流水线的计算、带宽和时延需求在分发时未知，由中间观测与随机采样在运行时涌现，呈重尾、多模态分布。传统调度器需已知完整图，边缘资源管理方法依赖参数化或平稳需求模型，均不适用，导致欠配置触发限流违约、过配置浪费资源的两难。
AI.method: 形式化不确定性感知智能体编排问题：分发时预留计算与带宽以概率性覆盖实际需求并验证截止时间。提出CRO（Conformal Reservation for Orchestration）在线算法，利用滑动窗口历史执行轨迹，通过共形预测将轨迹转化为带有限样本、无分布覆盖保证的分发时资源分配。
AI.result: 在异构任务混合（多模态、重尾分布）的仿真中，CRO是唯一在所有风险水平下同时满足目标概率覆盖的方法；在覆盖可行的方法中过预留最低，资源浪费约为Chebyshev界基线的一半。
AI.conclusion: 共形预测为智能体流水线的未知、非平稳资源需求提供了有效的分布无关编排方案，CRO在保证覆盖的同时显著降低资源浪费，优于基于Chebyshev界的基线。

title: Matched but Not Better: An Equivalence-Tested Benchmark of Quantum Machine Learning on Six Clinical Datasets and the QML-Health-READY Reporting Framework
summary: Background: Quantum machine learning (QML) is promoted for clinical prediction, but comparisons with classical models are rarely paired or tested for equivalence. Methods: We compared a quantum-kernel support vector machine (QSVM; 4 qubits, tuned bandwidth) and a variational quantum classifier (VQC) with five tuned classical models across six public clinical datasets. All models used identical four-component inputs and 25 cross-validation splits. Paired AUROC differences were assessed using a corrected resampled t-test, Holm-adjusted equivalence tests (margins: +/-0.02 and +/-0.05), and random-effects pooling. Ablation, noise, finite-shot, and implementation-fault analyses were conducted. We propose QML-Health-READY, an eight-domain reporting framework. Results: Neither quantum model significantly outperformed any classical comparator. Pooled across datasets, QSVM differed from the kernel-matched radial basis function (RBF) SVM by -0.006 AUROC (95% CI: -0.017 to +0.004), equivalent to +/-0.02. VQC differed from the best classical model by -0.007 (95% CI: -0.019 to +0.004). QSVM was equivalent to RBF SVM within +/-0.05 in four of six datasets but was significantly worse than the best classical model on NHANES 2017-18 (-0.076). A classically trivial product-state kernel performed as well as the entangling kernel. With depolarizing noise (p = 0.01) and 1,024 shots per kernel entry, QSVM AUROC decreased by 0.054 (95% CI: 0.036 to 0.071). Untuned bandwidth produced near-chance AUROC (0.48-0.59). Conclusions: Correctly configured quantum classifiers approached but did not exceed tuned classical models. Finite-shot estimation, rather than gate noise, was their main practical cost, while configuration errors could reverse conclusions. QML-Health-READY defines reporting requirements for credible claims.

AI.tldr: 在6个公开临床数据集上配对比较量子分类器（QSVM、VQC）与5个调优经典模型，结果显示量子模型仅接近但未超越经典模型，其主要实用代价来自有限采样而非门噪声。
AI.motivation: 量子机器学习被广泛宣传用于临床预测，但缺乏与经典模型的配对比较和等效性检验，结论可信度不明。
AI.method: 构建4比特量子核SVM（调优带宽）与变分量子分类器，对照5个调优经典模型；使用相同四维输入与25次交叉验证划分，采用校正重采样t检验、Holm校正等效性检验（±0.02/±0.05）及随机效应合并；并进行消融、噪声、有限采样与实现错误分析，同时提出QML-Health-READY八域报告框架。
AI.result: 量子模型未显著优于任何经典对照。QSVM与核匹配RBF-SVM差-0.006 AUROC（95%CI -0.017~+0.004），在±0.02内等效；VQC与最佳经典模型差-0.007（-0.019~+0.004）；6个数据集中4个在±0.05内等效，但NHANES 2017-18上显著更差（-0.076）。经典平凡乘积态核与纠缠核表现相当；去极化噪声p=0.01加每核项1024次采样使AUROC下降0.054；未调带宽时AUROC降至0.48–0.59（近随机）。
AI.conclusion: 正确配置的量子分类器接近但不超越调优经典模型；有限采样估计而非门噪声是主要实用成本，配置错误可翻转结论；QML-Health-READY为可信声明提供报告规范。

title: mmHand: Toward Pixel-Level-Accuracy Hand Localization Using a Single Commodity mmWave Device
summary: The hand localization problem has been a longstanding focus due to its many applications. The task involves modeling the hand as a singular point and determining its position within a defined coordinate system. However, due to data modality limitations, existing hand localization technologies face several challenges. For example, vision-based localization raises privacy concerns, while wearable-based methods compromise user comfort. In this paper, we introduce mmHand, a new device-free, privacy-preserving dynamic hand localization system with pixel-level accuracy, using a single commodity mmWave device. We first propose a mmImage generation tool to fully extract spatial information from raw mmWave data and introduce a novel 2D image-format representation of mmWave data. Next, we design a framework that provides a new quality evaluation method and pixel space labeling for the mmWave data. Finally, we present a cross-modality spatial feature-enhanced model with high spatial feature extraction capabilities, which can accurately localize hand positions at the pixel level in the mmWave radar U-V pixel coordinate system. We evaluate the system with experiments on 12 subjects in three scenarios, and the results across four metrics demonstrate the effectiveness of our hand localization system.

AI.tldr: 提出mmHand，一个基于单台商用毫米波设备的无设备、保护隐私的动态手部定位系统，通过将毫米波数据转换为2D图像表示实现像素级精度。
AI.motivation: 手部定位应用广泛，但现有技术受数据模态限制：视觉方法有隐私问题，可穿戴方法影响舒适性。需要一种既保护隐私又不穿戴的动态手部定位方案。
AI.method: 1) 提出mmImage生成工具，从原始毫米波数据充分提取空间信息，构建毫米波数据的2D图像格式表示；2) 设计提供新质量评估方法与像素空间标注的框架；3) 提出跨模态空间特征增强模型，在毫米波雷达U-V像素坐标系中实现像素级手部定位。
AI.result: 在三种场景下对12名受试者进行实验，四项指标的结果均验证了系统的有效性。
AI.conclusion: mmHand证明了利用单台商用毫米波设备实现无设备、隐私保护的像素级动态手部定位是可行的。

title: LIBRA: Programmatic Induction of Executable Tool Libraries
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Introduces LIBRA, a query-agnostic tool library built via execution-validated prerequisites in a sandbox (avg ARR review score: 3.5/5). Demonstrates consistent performance gains across three benchmarks while discussing sandbox dependencies and library construction trade-offs
summary: Large language model agents increasingly retrieve tools from large catalogs, yet most retrievers rank each tool independently by request similarity. For multi tool tasks, this recovers the goal matching tool while omitting prerequisite tools required by the workflow.We introduce LIBRA, a framework for Library Induction by Runtime Assembly that turns a flat tool catalog into an executable tool library. An LLM proposes per tool contracts of candidate invocations, reusable outputs and state changes, and success conditions; LIBRA then tests these compositions in a sandbox and retains the relations supported at runtime. Constructed before user queries, the library requires no dependency annotations, tool use trajectories, or task specific training, and supports both one-shot and agentic retrieval. On AppWorld, BFCL, and SciToolEval, LIBRA improves one-shot Recall and NDCG over the same dense retriever by 7.9 and 3.7 percentage points on average. Within ToolReAGt, it yields corresponding gains of 4.5 and 2.9 points after ten retrieval iterations.

AI.tldr: LIBRA 将扁平工具目录转化为可执行工具库：由 LLM 提出每个工具的契约（候选调用、可复用输出与状态变化、成功条件），再在沙箱中测试并保留运行时验证成立的工具依赖关系，从而支持多工具任务的检索。
AI.motivation: 现有检索器对每个工具按请求相似度独立排序，在多工具任务中只能召回与目标匹配的工具，遗漏了工作流所需的前置工具。同时避免依赖人工依赖标注、工具使用轨迹或任务特定训练。
AI.method: LIBRA（Library Induction by Runtime Assembly）：LLM 为每个工具生成契约，包括候选调用、可复用输出、状态变化与成功条件；随后在沙箱中执行这些组合，仅保留运行时验证成立的关系；库在用户查询前离线构建，无需依赖标注或轨迹，支持一次性检索与智能体式检索。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld、BFCL、SciToolEval 上，一次性检索相比同一稠密检索器平均提升 Recall 7.9、NDCG 3.7 个百分点；在 ToolReAGt 十轮检索迭代下分别提升 4.5 和 2.9 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过运行时验证构建工具关系库，可在无标注、无轨迹、无任务训练的条件下有效提升多工具任务的工具检索质量。

title: Two-Sided Screening in Quality-Differentiated Markets
summary:
Motivated by digital marketplaces such as Uber and Airbnb, we study how a two-sided platform designs a menu of qualities, consumer prices, and provider wages. Consumers and providers self-select according to their private values and costs, so the platform must design its menu to attract consumers while inducing enough supply to meet their demand. We study this coordination problem over a continuous quality space, requiring supply to cover demand at every quality threshold.
  We formulate menu design as an optimization over trading distributions, which specify how much trade occurs at or above each quality. Through convexification of the technological cost function, we characterize the profit- and welfare-optimal trading distributions. This characterization shows how production technology alone can reduce menu size without sacrificing optimal profit or welfare, regardless of the type distributions, and determines when optimal menus can be finite. We then show that profit maximization can be highly efficient: under monotone hazard rate conditions on both sides, a profit-optimal menu achieves at least $1/(e-1)$ of optimal social welfare.
  We next consider the practical setting in which the menu size is restricted to a prescribed number of offers. We establish how the restricted menu approximates the unrestricted optimum in profit. We develop an algorithm that computes a menu within this size limit in polynomial time. The computed menu simultaneously approximates the unrestricted optimal profit and social welfare with additive error.

AI.tldr: 本文研究双边平台如何设计由质量、消费者价格和提供者工资构成的菜单，将菜单设计转化为对交易分布的优化，通过成本函数凸化刻画利润与社会福利最优交易分布，并给出供应/需求协调、菜单规模有限性与效率保证的结果。
AI.motivation: 受Uber、Airbnb等数字市场启发，双边平台需同时吸引消费者并激励足够供给；消费者与提供者依据各自私有价值与成本自我选择，因此平台面临在连续质量空间上满足"每个质量阈值上供给覆盖需求"的协调难题。
AI.method: 将菜单设计表述为对交易分布的优化（规定在或高于各质量水平的交易量）；通过对技术成本函数进行凸化（convexification）刻画利润最优与福利最优的交易分布；随后分析菜单规模受限于给定报价数量时的近似性，并设计多项式时间算法在规模限制内计算菜单。
AI.result: 凸化刻画表明：仅生产技术本身即可在不损失最优利润或福利的前提下缩减菜单规模，且与类型分布无关，并给出最优菜单可为有限的条件；在双侧单调风险率条件下，利润最优菜单至少达到最优社会福利的 1/(e−1)；受限菜单可近似无约束最优利润，算法计算出的菜单同时以加性误差近似最优利润与社会福利。
AI.conclusion: 双边平台菜单设计可通过交易分布凸化得到清晰的结构刻画，生产技术在决定最优菜单复杂度中起关键作用；利润最大化在温和条件下具有较高效率，且在菜单规模受限时仍可由多项式时间算法近似实现。

title: Hallucination Is Linearly Decodable from Mid-Layer Hidden States in Quantized LLMs
summary: We investigate whether open-source LLMs encode a linearly separable truthfulness signal in their hidden states, and at which network depth this signal is strongest. Across three $7$B--$8$B instruction-tuned models (Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, Qwen2.5-7B) loaded in $4$-bit NF4 quantization, we extract per-layer hidden states on four hallucination benchmarks (TruthfulQA, HaluEval-QA, FEVER, and a controlled synthetic set) and compare four detection approaches: linear and MLP probes, INSIDE EigenScore, self-consistency, and attention entropy. A linear probe on a single mid-network layer achieves $0.904$--$1.000$ AUROC on held-out splits, while sampling-based detectors do not exceed $0.541$ AUROC under the same protocol. The truthfulness signal is approximately linear: MLP probes rarely surpass linear probes by more than $0.01$ AUROC. Peak probing layers fall in a consistent band across model families on natural-language benchmarks -- blocks~$13$--$18$ of~$32$ for Llama and Mistral, and blocks~$19$--$25$ of~$28$ for Qwen. First-block attention entropy provides a complementary signal in knowledge-grounded settings ($0.866$--$0.941$ AUROC on HaluEval-QA) at no additional inference cost. The low discriminability of sampling methods under this protocol reflects a structural mismatch between paired-label evaluation and the information these methods access, rather than an inherent limitation of those methods. Code and data are released for full reproducibility on a single $8$\,GB GPU.

AI.tldr: 开源LLM隐藏状态中存在近似线性可分的真实性信号，单一中层线性探针AUROC达0.904-1.000，远优于采样类检测器（≤0.541）。
AI.motivation: 探究开源LLM是否在中层隐藏状态中编码线性可分的真实性信号，以及该信号最强的网络深度，并与采样类检测方法进行公平对比。
AI.method: 对Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-7B（4-bit NF4量化）在TruthfulQA、HaluEval-QA、FEVER及受控合成集上逐层提取隐藏状态，比较线性/MLP探针、INSIDE EigenScore、自一致性、注意力熵四种检测方法。
AI.result: 中层线性探针在留出集达0.904-1.000 AUROC；采样类检测器≤0.541；MLP较线性探针提升极少（<0.01）。峰值层跨模型族一致：Llama/Mistral为32层中第13-18块，Qwen为28层中第19-25块。首块注意力熵在知识型场景提供互补信号（HaluEval-QA 0.866-0.941），无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 真实性信号近似线性；采样方法低判别力源于配对标签评测与其所获信息之间的结构性错配，而非方法本身固有限制；代码与数据已开源，可在单张8GB GPU上复现。

title: Entropogram-guided Visual Realignment Decoding: Capturing the Rhythm of Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress on cross-modal reasoning tasks, yet they continue to suffer from hallucinations in long-chain reasoning processes. In this work, we revisit hallucination in MLLMs from the perspective of reasoning generation dynamics. We argue that entropy is not merely a static measure of uncertainty but a structured signal that reflects how modality information is integrated throughout decoding. Through systematic analysis, we identify two characteristic entropy patterns associated with hallucination behaviors: (1) a generally high-confidence regime corresponds to premature convergence to inappropriate multimodal interactions; and (2) local abrupt entropy transitions are associated with reasoning instability and hallucination onset. Building on these observations, we propose an entropy-aware self-introspective framework for MLLM reasoning. Our method continuously tracks entropy dynamics during decoding and performs targeted visual re-alignment when suspicious hallucination states are detected, encouraging the model to re-examine salient visual evidence at critical reasoning stages. Extensive experiments across six multimodal reasoning benchmarks spanning nine distinct evaluation settings demonstrate that our approach delivers robust improvements in reasoning accuracy and hallucination robustness, while providing new insights into the generation dynamics underlying MLLM failures. The code is available at: https://github.com/jden4524/SelfRetrospectiveDecoding.

AI.tldr: 从解码动力学视角分析MLLM幻觉，发现两种熵模式并提出熵感知自省框架，在检测到可疑幻觉状态时进行视觉再对齐，在9种设置6个基准上提升推理准确性与幻觉鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在长链推理中仍存在幻觉，作者希望从推理生成动力学（熵动态）角度重新理解幻觉成因，而非将熵仅视为静态不确定性度量。
AI.method: 系统分析解码过程中熵的变化模式；提出熵感知自省框架：持续跟踪解码时的熵动态，识别可疑幻觉状态（高置信收敛区、局部熵突变）并触发针对性视觉再对齐，促使模型重新审视显著视觉证据。
AI.result: 识别出两类与幻觉相关的熵特征：整体高置信区对应过早收敛到不当的多模态交互；局部熵突变对应推理不稳定与幻觉起始。在六个多模态推理基准、九种评测设置上，推理准确率与幻觉鲁棒性均获稳健提升。
AI.conclusion: 熵是反映模态信息整合过程的结构化信号，可作为幻觉检测与干预依据；所提自省式解码方法有效且为理解MLLM失败机制提供新洞见，代码已开源。

title: Optimal Re-Ranking Depth
summary: Second-stage neural rankers are commonly applied with a fixed re-ranking depth, assuming that retrieval effectiveness saturates as depth increases. Prior research has questioned the assumption that increasing the re-ranking depth yields linear performance gains, further suggesting that optimal re-ranking depth varies considerably from query to query. In the past, studying such phenomena was methodologically difficult given the scale of manual annotation required. With the advent of LLM-based relevance judgments we can now more easily undertake such studies, in this case to pinpoint the optimal re-ranking depth on a per-query basis. Using dense LLM-based relevance judgments over a typical re-ranking pipeline, we show that many queries exhibit a well-defined optimal re-ranking depth, beyond which effectiveness stagnates or degrades. We formulate re-ranking depth as a query-specific property and study whether it can be predicted a priori from first-stage retrieval characteristics. Through a large-scale analysis, we find that most standard query performance prediction (QPP) methods are ineffective for this task. In contrast, a predictor derived from LLM-assessed first-stage ranking quality, which we term IR-DCG@10, can reduce the average re-ranking depth by up to a factor of 3 while preserving overall effectiveness, depending on the specific first- and second-stage rankers used. Under oracle selection of optimal depths, we further show that retrieval effectiveness can improve by more than 7% while reducing the average re-ranking depth by a factor of 5 on the MSMARCO DEV collection. Given our promising preliminary findings, we would encourage the use of automatic judgments to facilitate research otherwise infeasible under manual annotation. Towards this point, we release relevance judgments, our codebase, and experimental artefacts to support reproducibility and further research.

AI.tldr: 论文利用LLM自动相关性判断，指出每个查询存在各自的最优重排深度，并证明标准QPP方法难以预测，而基于LLM评估第一阶段排名质量的IR-DCG@10可显著降低深度同时保持效果。
AI.motivation: 现有二阶段神经重排通常采用固定重排深度，隐含假设效果随深度饱和；但最优重排深度可能因查询而异，此前因人工标注规模庞大而难以系统研究。
AI.method: 利用LLM生成稠密相关性判断，在典型重排流水线上逐查询分析最优重排深度；将其建模为查询特定属性，并比较多种标准查询性能预测(QPP)方法与基于LLM评估第一阶段排名质量的IR-DCG@10预测器。
AI.result: 许多查询存在明确最优深度，超过后效果停滞或下降；多数标准QPP方法在该任务上无效；IR-DCG@10可将平均重排深度最多降低约3倍且保持总体效果；在MSMARCO DEV上，oracle选择最优深度可提升效果超7%并将平均深度降低5倍。
AI.conclusion: 重排深度应作为查询特定属性进行预测；LLM自动判断使此类大规模研究可行，作者公开判断数据、代码与实验工件以支持复现与后续研究。

title: Human-like cross-language generalisation in deep neural speaker embeddings and its acoustic foundations
comment: This manuscript has been accepted for presentation at Interspeech 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/xiyangg12/wespeaker. The archived release is available on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20606535
summary: Generalisability is a central question for deep neural networks, including the cross-language generalisation of speaker embeddings. This study examined whether deep neural speaker embeddings generalise across languages and how such generalisation relates to human perception and acoustic structure. Using Cantonese--English bilingual speech presented in within- and cross-language conditions, we derived similarity from 18 state-of-the-art models and compared it with human ratings and acoustic features using linear mixed models and representational similarity analysis. Embeddings exhibited cross-language generalisation that broadly paralleled human behaviour, reflecting accurate identity discrimination and sensitivity to language switching. This generalisation relied on largely shared acoustic cues with language-sensitive weighting, mirroring human patterns. Together, these findings provide converging evidence for human--machine alignment in cross-language voice similarity processing.

AI.tldr: 该研究考察深度说话人嵌入的跨语言（粤语-英语）泛化性，并将其与人类感知和声学结构进行对比。18个SOTA模型的嵌入相似度在语内与跨语条件下与人类评分、声学特征比较，结果显示模型泛化性与人类行为大体一致，且依赖共享声学线索并具语言敏感加权。
AI.motivation: 泛化性是深度神经网络的核心问题，但说话人嵌入的跨语言泛化能力，以及其与人类感知和声学结构的关系尚不清楚。
AI.method: 使用粤语-英语双语语音，设置语内与跨语条件；提取18个最先进模型的说话人嵌入并计算相似度；采用线性混合模型和表征相似性分析（RSA），将嵌入相似度与人类评分及声学特征进行比较。
AI.result: 嵌入表现出跨语言泛化，与人类行为大体平行：能准确区分说话人身份，并对语言切换敏感；泛化依赖大体共享的声学线索，且加权具语言敏感性，与人类模式一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究为跨语言语音相似性加工中的人机对齐提供了汇聚性证据。

title: Challenge-Aware Knowledge Recruitment with Meta-Agent Supervision for Medical Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Large language models perform strongly on standard medical QA but degrade on harder reasoning tasks, where multi-agent debate often fails to beat strong single-model prompting. We argue that a key limitation is that existing systems select experts and retrieve knowledge from the question alone, rather than from gaps that emerge during reasoning. We propose challenge-aware adaptive recruitment: an external CHALLENGER inspects the evolving reasoning trace and identifies specific factual or expertise gaps. These signals trigger targeted knowledge retrieval or mid-discussion specialist recruitment. On the MEDAGENTSBENCH hard subset (862 questions across nine biomedical datasets), upfront retrieval provides little benefit, while challenge-aware in-between retrieval performs better; on a multi-specialist backbone it improves accuracy on 8 of 9 datasets and adds 6 percentage points over Challenger Only. Ablations indicate benefits from both retrieval timing and gap-specific query signals, and a live web-search experiment shows that the timing advantage persists across retrieval backends. For specialist recruitment, self-triggered adaptation is unreliable, whereas Challenger-triggered recruitment raises GPT-4.1-mini MedQA accuracy from 46% to 54%, with positive direction on all tested generalization datasets. Naively combining retrieval and specialist recruitment degrades performance, highlighting the need to coordinate adaptive intervention channels. These results show that when and why external resources are recruited is a key design choice in multi-agent medical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出"挑战感知自适应招募"：由外部CHALLENGER检查推理轨迹、定位事实/专家缺口，从而触发针对性检索或中期专家招募，在多智能体医疗推理中优于前置检索与自触发适应。
AI.motivation: 大模型在标准医疗问答上表现强，但在更难推理任务上退化；多智能体辩论常打不过强单模型提示。作者认为关键缺陷在于现有系统仅凭问题本身选择专家和检索知识，而非依据推理过程中出现的缺口。
AI.method: 引入外部CHALLENGER模块，实时审视演化中的推理轨迹，识别具体的事实或专业能力缺口，并据此触发两种干预：(1) 针对性知识检索（challenge-aware in-between retrieval）；(2) 讨论中途招募专家。并与前置检索、自触发适应、检索+招募直接组合等方式对比。
AI.result: 在MEDAGENTSBENCH困难子集（9个生物医学数据集、862题）上：前置检索几乎无益，挑战感知的中途检索更好；在多专家骨干上9个数据集中8个提升，较仅Challenger高6个百分点。消融显示检索时机与缺口特定查询信号均有贡献，实时联网搜索实验表明时机优势跨检索后端成立。招募方面自触发不可靠，Challenger触发使GPT-4.1-mini在MedQA从46%升至54%，且各泛化数据集方向为正。朴素组合检索与招募反而降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 在多智能体医疗推理中，"何时"与"为何"引入外部资源是关键设计选择；需协调不同自适应干预通道，避免简单叠加带来的性能下降。

title: Objective-Conditioned Active Preference Learning for Multi-Objective Alignment
summary: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with several objectives, such as helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty, typically relies on preference judgment for each objective, growing the annotation cost linearly with the number of objectives. Active preference learning can reduce this cost by selecting the comparisons whose labels are expected to change the policy most. Existing remedies either lack an objective-aware query selection mechanism for the multi-objective setting or regard conflicting preferences as harmful, therefore excluding them from the training data. We introduce OGC-DPO (Objective-conditioned Gradient Coverage DPO), an active learning framework that treats each (response pair, objective) combination as a separate query and measures its informativeness through the policy's own implicit gradient, without relying on an external reward model. OGC-DPO then selects the queries that most expand each objective's gradient coverage. Empirical experiments across varying numbers of objectives demonstrate the effectiveness of OGC-DPO over existing active preference learning methods under the same annotation cost. Further analysis demonstrates that informative conflicts, rather than being uniformly harmful, provide a useful policy training signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OGC-DPO，一种面向多目标 LLM 对齐的主动偏好学习框架，将每个（回复对，目标）组合视为独立查询，利用策略自身的隐式梯度衡量其信息量，并选择最能扩展各目标梯度覆盖的查询。
AI.motivation: 多目标对齐（有用性、无害性、诚实性等）通常需要对每个目标分别做偏好判断，标注成本随目标数量线性增长；现有主动偏好学习方法要么缺乏面向多目标的查询选择机制，要么把冲突偏好视为有害而排除在训练数据之外。
AI.method: OGC-DPO 将每个（回复对，目标）组合作为单独查询，基于策略自身隐式梯度计算其信息量，无需外部奖励模型，然后选择能最大程度扩展各目标梯度覆盖的查询进行标注。
AI.result: 在不同目标数量的实验中，相同标注成本下 OGC-DPO 优于现有主动偏好学习方法；进一步分析表明，信息量高的冲突并非一律有害，反而能为策略训练提供有用信号。
AI.conclusion: 面向目标的梯度覆盖式查询选择可有效降低多目标对齐的标注成本，冲突偏好应被有选择地加以利用而非一律剔除。

title: When Does Sharing Work? Scaling a Shared SigLIP2 Across Image, Video, Audio, and Audio-Visual Representations
summary: Contrastive pretraining has advanced image-text understanding, yet image, video, and audio encoders are still trained independently, with cross-modal alignment realized mainly through post-hoc binding to a frozen anchor space. We present Omni-Encoder, a general multimodal encoder that processes image, video, audio, and audio-visual inputs within a single SigLIP-2 Vision Transformer with fully shared parameters. Unlike anchor-centric binding or per-modality adapters, all modalities are optimized jointly end-to-end, and the framework is organized from input to training. A modality-native input stage first maps each signal into the shared embedding space, including a 1D-convolutional audio tokenizer that converts mel-spectrograms into tokens aligned with visual patches. A multimodal rotary position embedding parameterized by absolute timestamps then places visual frames and audio segments in a unified spatiotemporal coordinate system. Finally, alternating-modality training interleaves image, video, audio, and temporally aligned audio-visual batches and accumulates their gradients into one update, which we find central to stable joint optimization. Omni-Encoder achieves competitive results on 16 benchmarks across all four modalities with one shared parameter set, and joint training improves each modality over its separately trained counterpart. Code and models will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: Omni-Encoder 用单个完全共享参数的 SigLIP-2 ViT 统一处理图像、视频、音频与视听输入，实现端到端联合优化的多模态编码器。
AI.motivation: 现有对比预训练中图像、视频、音频编码器各自独立训练，跨模态对齐主要依赖对冻结锚空间的"事后绑定"（anchor-centric binding），缺乏真正的联合优化。
