AI.method: 从输入到训练三层设计：(1) 模态原生输入阶段将各信号映射到共享嵌入空间，含将 mel 频谱转成与视觉 patch 对齐 token 的一维卷积音频 tokenizer；(2) 参数化绝对时间戳的多模态旋转位置编码（RoPE），把视觉帧与音频段置于统一时空坐标系；(3) 交替模态训练，交错图像/视频/音频/时间对齐视听批次并将梯度累积到一次更新。
AI.result: 单一共享参数集在四种模态共 16 个基准上取得有竞争力结果；联合训练使每个模态均优于其单独训练的对应版本。
AI.conclusion: 全共享参数的端到端联合训练可行且有益，交替模态梯度累积是稳定联合优化的关键；代码与模型将公开。

title: Agentic Behavior Engineering: A Design-by-Contract Methodology for Specifying, Verifying, and Governing Enterprise AI Agents
comment: 30 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Expanded version of the author's practitioner guide "Agentic behavior engineering" in the Microsoft Azure Architecture Center (CC BY 4.0): https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/architecture/ai-ml/guide/agentic-behavior-engineering
summary: Enterprise teams that deploy large language model (LLM) agents inherit a maintenance problem that traditional testing does not address. The model is non-deterministic, but the larger risk is that most of what changes an agent's behavior (a retired model version, a revised policy, an upstream schema change, a prompt edit meant to fix one case) originates outside the owning team and is discovered as a production defect rather than caught as a regression. This paper presents Agentic Behavior Engineering (ABE), a platform-agnostic methodology that treats observable agent behavior, rather than the prompt or the model, as the version-controlled engineering artifact. ABE adapts Design by Contract to non-deterministic systems. A specification-only behavior contract with stable rule identifiers states what the agent must do, must not do, and when it must abstain for lack of evidence; a lightweight scenario library turns each rule into concrete situations; and every engineering artifact (tests, runtime policies, telemetry) references the contract in one direction only, so that specification and implementation can change independently without drifting apart. The method organizes the work into five responsibilities (Specify, Ground, Control, Verify, Observe), treats missing evidence and a verified negative as different things, enforces authority outside the model, gates releases on per-scenario pass^k reliability rather than aggregate accuracy, and classifies every production run against the contract so that each finding routes to the asset that must change. We illustrate the method with an executable capacity-allocation boundary suite and a constructed worked example of a product-review approval workflow.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Agentic Behavior Engineering（ABE）方法论，以"可观测的智能体行为"而非提示词或模型作为受版本控制的工程资产，通过将契约式设计（Design by Contract）适配到非确定性系统，解决企业级 LLM Agent 的维护与回归检测问题。
AI.motivation: 企业部署 LLM Agent 后面临传统测试无法覆盖的维护难题：模型是非确定性的，但更大风险在于影响 Agent 行为的变化（模型版本退役、策略修订、上游 schema 变更、为修某案例而改的提示词）大多源自团队外部，且往往以生产缺陷而非回归问题的形式被发现。
AI.method: ABE 将 Design by Contract 适配到非确定性系统：(1) 仅规范化的行为契约，含稳定规则 ID，声明必须做、禁止做以及何时因缺乏证据而须弃权；(2) 轻量场景库将每条规则转成具体情境；(3) 所有工程制品（测试、运行时策略、遥测）单向引用契约，使规范与实现可独立演进而不漂移。方法划分为五大职责（Specify、Ground、Control、Verify、Observe），区分"缺少证据"与"经验证的否定"，将权威置于模型之外，按每场景 pass^k 可靠性而非聚合准确率来门控发布，并对每次生产运行按契约分类，使发现的问题路由到需变更的资产。
AI.result: 作者以一个可执行的容量分配边界测试套件和一个构造的产品评审审批工作流示例展示了该方法的可行性（示例性验证，而非大规模实证）。
AI.conclusion: 将行为契约作为版本控制的工程核心、以规则 ID 与单向引用保证规范与实现解耦、以 pass^k 门控和运行分类形成闭环，可系统化应对 Agent 维护中的外部漂移与回归风险。

title: Regret Bounds for Market Making with Persistent Orders
summary: We study adversarial market making with orders that remain active until execution. The maker operates on two markets: a primary market where orders are made and a secondary market where the resulting positions are hedged. In each round, the maker posts a quote on the primary market before observing both primary and secondary market prices. An order executes when the primary price reaches its quote, and the resulting position is immediately offset at the secondary price. When both price sequences are chosen by an adversary over $T$ rounds, we give a simple deterministic policy with regret of order $\log T$ against the best fixed quote (static comparator) and $\sqrt T$ against the best quote for each submission date (dynamic comparator), plus two terms measuring exposure to future primary and secondary prices. These rates remain optimal even when both exposure terms vanish and lower bounds show that the exposure terms are necessary. Our policy naturally extends to simultaneous bids and asks, where we show that static and dynamic regret are both characterized (up to constant factors) by the exposures terms (where the primary price exposure $V_T^{\mathrm{two}}$ now accounts for both bids and asks) and a term of order $\sqrt{V_T^{\mathrm{two}}\log T}$. Our policy is simple, efficient and fully parameterless. We extend this setting by demonstrating how natural assumptions on the price processes lead to improved guarantees without changing the policy.

AI.tldr: 研究订单持续有效至成交的对抗性做市问题，做市商在主市场报价、在二级市场对冲持仓，价格序列完全由对手方选择。作者提出简单的确定性策略，静态比较者遗憾为 log T 阶、动态比较者为 √T 阶，另加未来价格暴露项；并证明这些速率最优、暴露项必要，策略可推广到同时双向报价且无需调参。
AI.motivation: 做市与对冲场景中，价格往往不能假设为随机过程，而可能被对手方或市场力量有意操纵。已有在线学习/在线算法研究少有同时刻画"订单挂单等待成交"与"主市场报价+二级市场对冲"两层结构，且需要理解在不做随机假设时能做到何种遗憾保证、以及未来价格信息暴露是否不可避免。
AI.method: 建立 T 轮对抗性模型：每轮先发布主市场报价，随后揭示主、次市场价格；主市场价格触及报价则成交，成交头寸立即在二级市场以次市场价格对冲。设计简洁、确定性、无参数的在线策略。通过遗憾分解给出静态（固定最优报价）与动态（每期最优报价）比较者下的界，并构造下界证明最优性与暴露项的必要性；进一步扩展到同时提交买价与卖价的双边设定，并说明在价格过程附加自然假设下同一策略可获得更强保证。
AI.result: 静态遗憾为 O(log T)，动态遗憾为 O(√T)，两者均附加刻画对未来主/次市场价格暴露的两项。下界表明：即使两个暴露项趋零，上述速率仍最优，且暴露项本身不可省略。双边（同时报价买卖）情形下，静态与动态遗憾均被暴露项（其中主市场暴露 V_T^two 同时计入买卖两侧）与 √(V_T^two log T) 阶项（至常数因子）所刻画。策略简单、高效、完全无参数。
AI.conclusion: 在完全对抗的价格序列下，挂单式做市+二级市场对冲仍可获得对数/根号级遗憾，但速率受不可消除的未来价格暴露项限制；暴露项是问题内在的必要代价而非算法缺陷。所提策略无需调参即可覆盖单边与双边报价，并能借助合理的价格过程假设自动获得更优保证，具有较强实用性与理论完整性。

title: Multi-Resident Data Association in Smart Homes via MDP Modeling and Behavior Cloning
summary: Ambient sensors offer a privacy-preserving solution for activity recognition in smart homes, yet they face a critical challenge in multi-resident environments known as Data Association, which aims to identify the resident triggering a specific anonymous sensor event. Existing approaches fundamentally fail to maintain global consistency by often yielding conflicting associations for silent residents. Additionally, these methods frequently suffer from severe trajectory fragmentation caused by the ontological mismatch of applying continuous physical motion models to discrete logical behaviors. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework that reformulates data association as a sequential decision-making task within a Markov Decision Process (MDP). We solve the defined MDP via Behavior Cloning (BC) to avoid complex reward engineering by directly learning from expert demonstrations. We instantiate the policy using two complementary architectures, including a lightweight Transformer that treats association as a multi-label classification task over linearized event histories, and a fine-tuned Large Language Model (LLM) that reformulates the problem as conditional text generation to leverage pre-trained semantic knowledge. Extensive evaluations on three diverse datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, particularly in resolving concurrent multi-resident events. Furthermore, the LLM-based policy shows preliminary cross-environment transfer potential under benchmark settings, while its robustness in real deployments still requires further validation.

AI.tldr: 本文将多居民智能家居中的传感器数据关联问题重构为马尔可夫决策过程，用行为克隆训练Transformer和微调LLM两种策略，显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 环境传感器可实现隐私保护的活动识别，但多居民场景下面临数据关联难题：需判断匿名传感器事件由哪位居民触发。现有方法无法保持全局一致性，对静默居民常产生冲突关联；且把连续物理运动模型套用于离散逻辑行为，导致严重的轨迹碎片化。
AI.method: 将数据关联重构为MDP中的序列决策任务，用行为克隆从专家示范直接学习以规避复杂奖励设计。策略用两种互补架构实现：轻量Transformer将关联视为线性化事件历史上的多标签分类；微调LLM将问题重构为条件文本生成，利用预训练语义知识。
AI.result: 在三个多样化数据集上评估，方法显著优于SOTA基线，尤其在并发多居民事件上表现突出。LLM策略在基准设置下显示出初步的跨环境迁移潜力，但实际部署中的鲁棒性仍需进一步验证。
AI.conclusion: MDP+行为克隆框架有效解决了全局一致性与轨迹碎片化问题，Transformer与LLM两种实现均具优势；LLM的跨环境泛化有潜力，但部署鲁棒性待验证。

title: One Basket, Many Experts: Decorrelated Re-ranking for Financial Asset Recommendation
comment: Accepted to the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF2026)
summary: Financial asset recommendation for retail investors is typically optimized for relevance, that is, how well a recommendation matches what each user will buy. From the service provider's point of view, the value of a recommendation also depends on portfolio performance: the risk-adjusted return the recommended assets (the basket) deliver, which drives user engagement and fee revenue. The two goals are rarely achieved jointly, because the recommendations that best match user behavior concentrate on a few popular assets whose returns are highly correlated, which caps the risk-adjusted return a provider can offer. We propose Decorrelated-Satellite Expert Re-ranking (\textbf{DSER}), which retains the most relevant recommendations from an expert-following list and replaces the rest with return-decorrelated alternatives. The number of replaced slots is a single integer~$m$ (a knob) that the provider sets, so the relevance--performance trade-off becomes an explicit, auditable choice rather than a property hidden inside a learned model. In experiments on the public FAR-Trans retail-brokerage dataset, under the primary protocol, replacing a few slots improves risk-adjusted return at a small relevance cost, and the gain survives realistic trading costs at typical retail portfolio sizes. Minimizing correlation would lower basket volatility, but in our data the least-correlated assets are more volatile and higher-return, so their volatility offsets that reduction while their return drives the gain, not lower volatility. The resulting trade-off is asymmetric, with the relevance cost consistent across market phases while the gain is phase-dependent. The provider sets $m$ to read off exactly how much relevance each operating point costs.

AI.tldr: DSER重新排序方法通过将最相关的推荐替换为收益去相关的资产，在零售投资者资产推荐中实现相关性-组合表现的显式可控权衡，且收益增益在计入交易成本后仍存在。
AI.motivation: 金融资产推荐通常只优化相关性（匹配用户购买行为），但从服务商视角看，推荐价值还取决于组合的风险调整收益。二者难以兼得：最匹配用户行为的推荐集中于高相关性的热门资产，限制了可提供的风险调整收益。
AI.method: 提出Decorrelated-Satellite Expert Re-ranking（DSER）：保留专家跟随列表中最相关的推荐，其余槽位替换为收益去相关的替代资产。替换槽位数m为单一整数旋钮，由服务商设定，使权衡成为显式、可审计的选择而非隐藏于学习模型中。
AI.result: 在公开FAR-Trans零售经纪数据集上，主协议下替换少量槽位可小幅损失相关性换取风险调整收益提升，增益在典型零售组合规模下计入现实交易成本后仍存在。收益提升来自低相关资产的更高收益而非波动率降低；权衡不对称：相关性成本跨市场阶段稳定，而收益随阶段变化。
AI.conclusion: DSER将相关性-性能权衡转化为显式可调参数m，服务商可据此精确读取每个操作点的相关性成本，实现可审计的推荐策略设计。

title: Same Origin, Different Verdicts: Text Production Conditions Confound Machine-Generated Text Detection in Russian
comment: 65 pages, 6 figures, 24 tables. English translation of the frozen Russian manuscript; the Russian text is the source of record and is available with all data, code and run manifests at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21749574 (v1.0.1)
summary: Automated detection of machine-generated text is applied where the verdict carries a cost for the author, yet origin is a property of the production process, not an observable property of the text. The conditions under which a text is produced push it in the same direction in which a generative model is presumed to push it. This study measures the contribution of these conditions while origin is held fixed. The Russian-language corpus of 1882 documents comprises a machine part, generated by four generation channels (each backed by its own model family) across 45 tasks in three task modes, and an archival human part annotated for source regimentation level before the texts were read. The primary contrast is computed within the machine corpus: both halves of a pair are generated by the same model for the same task and differ only in task wording. Machine-likeness is measured by four operationalisations: an interpretable index with weights fixed before data collection, a trained classifier, a zero-shot metric on an open model, a judge model. The main result is disagreement between procedures: changing the task mode shifted the scores of all four, but three gave a negative shift, the judge a positive one, and none of the four intervals covers zero. The comparison plan and the specifications of procedures 2-4 were fixed after the result of procedure 1, before procedures 2-4 ran; the disagreement survived correction of a corpus defect and of the nested validation. A baseline on the source identifier alone reaches a median AUROC of 1.0000 on the thirteen group splits where it is defined, and removing emphasis markers flipped a confident machine verdict to human without changing the full text by a single character. The scores are properties of a specific measurement system and corpus: they reflect data collection, repetition, formatting, and preprocessing decisions as well as linguistic style.

AI.tldr: 该研究在保持"来源"（机器vs人类）不变的前提下，测量生产条件对机器文本检测分数的影响，发现四种检测程序在任务模式改变的同样刺激下给出方向相反的分数变化，说明检测分数是特定测量系统与语料的性质，而非文本的固有属性。
AI.motivation: 机器生成文本检测常被用于对作者有代价的判定场景，但"来源"属于生产过程属性而非文本可观测属性；文本生成条件与生成模型的作用方向一致，会干扰检测。作者希望在这些条件被控制、来源固定的情况下，量化条件的贡献。
AI.method: 构建1882篇俄语文献语料：机器部分由4个生成通道（各依托不同模型家族）在45个任务、3种任务模式下生成；人类部分为档案文本，阅读前预先标注来源规范化程度。核心对比在机器语料内部进行：配对两半由同一模型、同一任务生成，仅任务措辞不同。用四种操作化方式测量"机器相似度"：权重预先固定的可解释指数、训练分类器、开放模型零样本指标、评判模型（judge）。对比方案及后三种程序规格在程序1结果之后、2-4运行之前固定。
AI.result: 主要结果是程序间不一致：任务模式改变使四种分数全部变化，但三种为负向偏移、评判模型为正向偏移，且四个置信区间均不覆盖零。该不一致在修正语料缺陷与嵌套验证后仍然存在。仅用来源标识的基线在其定义的13个分组划分上达到中位AUROC 1.0000；删除强调标记即可将高置信机器判定翻转为人类，而全文一字未改。
AI.conclusion: 检测分数是特定测量系统与语料的性质，反映数据采集、重复、格式与预处理决策以及语言风格，而非文本来源的客观度量；不同检测程序对同一条件变化的响应可能相互矛盾，对高风险判定应用提出警示。

title: A Feasibility Condition for Confidence-Gated Tiered LLM Inference
summary: Tiered inference distributes large language model computation across a hierarchy of devices, from on-device and edge hardware to the datacenter, and is increasingly offered as the route to cheaper, lower-latency, and more private serving. Most such systems orchestrate frozen model checkpoints, and most decide what to resolve locally and what to escalate using a confidence signal produced by a forward-deployed model. We give a closed-form condition for when no threshold on that signal makes a tiered cascade worthwhile relative to sending every query to the backstop. Modeling the routing decision as a binary test and separating local from escalation cost through an architecture cost ratio $κ$, we derive a feasibility condition bracketed by a signal-free floor, below which a cascade is feasible at any signal quality, and a perfect-signal ceiling, above which none is. Read along the $κ$ axis the condition inverts: where local compute is billed, cost binds, matching a recent empirical finding; where it is sunk, on decentralized hardware, feasibility becomes unconditional and signal quality instead sets what the cascade achieves. We turn the condition into three design requirements that existing trained-in primitives satisfy only in isolation, and we propose, as future work, a co-designed architecture and a protocol to test it. The condition and the inversion hold independently of that architecture; they are the paper's contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文给出分层推理（tiered/cascade inference）中基于置信度阈值路由的闭式可行性条件：以架构成本比κ刻画本地与升级成本，得到由"无信号下界"和"完美信号上界"夹出的可行性区间，并指出沿κ轴条件的反转。
AI.motivation: 现有分层推理系统多用冻结检查点，并依赖前部署模型输出的置信度信号决定本地解决还是升级；但缺乏理论判据来判断置信度阈值路由相对"全部送后端"何时才真正划算。
AI.method: 将路由决策建模为二元假设检验，引入架构成本比κ区分本地成本与升级成本，推导出无需信号即可行的下界与仅完美信号才可行的上界，形成闭式可行性条件；并将该条件转化为三项设计要求，提出协同设计架构与验证协议作为未来工作。
AI.result: 当本地算力计费时，成本成为约束，与近期实证发现一致；当本地算力为沉没成本（去中心化硬件）时，可行性无条件成立，信号质量转而决定级联能达到的效果。
AI.conclusion: 该可行性条件及其沿κ轴的反转不依赖于具体架构，是论文的核心贡献；现有训练式原语仅能孤立满足三项设计要求，需协同设计架构与协议加以验证。

title: TSFM Meets LLM: Context as Covariates
summary: Textual information is ubiquitous in real-world time series datasets, appearing as news, reports, and annotations that hold key predictive signals not deducible from numerical history alone. Large Language Models (LLMs) interpret text but lack numerical precision, while Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) are quantitatively accurate but cannot reason about the effects of text. Moreover, the lack of large-scale paired multimodal datasets limits progress in bridging this gap. In this work, we address this challenge by providing a scalable approach for generating realistic multimodal datasets by annotating real-world time series with LLMs. Building on this, we propose Context as Covariates (CoCo), a forecasting framework in which an LLM distills its textual reasoning into numerically grounded forecast and confidence covariates that guide a TSFM backbone, thereby exploiting the strengths of both LLMs and TSFMs. We align the two models in stages, first fine-tuning the LLM via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a reward tied to covariate-induced improvement in forecasting performance, and then fine-tuning the TSFM on covariates generated by the aligned LLM. Our experiments show that models trained on our synthetic multimodal corpus generalize to real benchmarks spanning finance, economics, weather, traffic, and security. Notably, CoCo with Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as the LLM and Chronos2 as the TSFM achieves up to 12% MAE improvement over state-of-the-art TSFMs and LLM forecasters, such as GPT-4o. Code, checkpoints, and the evaluation datasets are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出CoCo框架：用LLM将文本推理蒸馏为数值化的预测与置信度协变量，指导TSFM骨干完成预测，并通过GRPO与分阶段对齐实现两种模型优势互补。
AI.motivation: 真实时间序列数据中普遍存在新闻、报告、注释等文本信息，含数值历史无法推断的预测信号。LLM能理解文本但缺乏数值精度，TSFM数值准确却无法推理文本影响；且缺乏大规模配对多模态数据集，阻碍二者融合。
AI.method: 先用LLM为真实时间序列打标，可扩展地生成逼真多模态数据集；再提出CoCo框架，让LLM将文本推理蒸馏为数值落地的预测值与置信度协变量来引导TSFM骨干。分阶段对齐：先用与协变量带来的预测提升挂钩的奖励，通过GRPO微调LLM；再用对齐后LLM生成的协变量微调TSFM。
AI.result: 在合成多模态语料上训练的模型可泛化到金融、经济、天气、交通、安全等真实基准。以Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507为LLM、Chronos2为TSFM的CoCo，相比SOTA TSFM及GPT-4o等LLM预测器，MAE最高提升12%。代码、检查点与评测数据集均已公开。
AI.conclusion: 通过LLM标注构建合成多模态数据并结合分阶段对齐，可将LLM的文本推理能力有效注入TSFM，实现跨领域泛化且显著优于单一模型基线。

title: PEEK: One-Step-Look-Ahead Exposure Bias Correction for Diffusion Sampling
summary: Diffusion image generators are successful due to accurate denoising networks and strong numerical samplers. Yet the two components are not fully matched. During sampling, the denoiser predicts for the next step based on flawed input that differ much from the real data. This train-test gap, or exposure bias, caps image generation quality (i.e., blurry, lacking in details or awkward in shape). To mitigate the problem, we propose PEEK, a novel training-free deterministic sampler plugin. At each eligible denoising step, PEEK first performs a provisional one-step update, evaluates the denoiser once at the look-ahead state, and interpolates it with the one-step-later prediction to form the next noisy state. By taking the additional step, we obtain a generally more-image-like prediction from the higher-signal noisy state, mitigating the exposure bias. To optimize the interpolation positions, PEEK searches for an interpolation schedule search made efficient by the prefix and baseline noise-schedule-rebasing caches. On 8 pixel-space and latent-space diffusion models with unconditional, label-guided, and text-guided settings across various output resolutions, PEEK consistently improves over NFE-matched baselines, with FID improvements up to 49.3\% at minimal extra computation cost (e.g., the one-time-per-model calibration takes at most 2.2 minutes across our experiments.). Project website is at https://dachengruoque.github.io/PEEK-Video/.

AI.tldr: PEEK是一种无需训练的确定性采样器插件，通过"前瞻"额外评估去噪器来缓解扩散模型中采样器的暴露偏差，在8个扩散模型上一致提升图像生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散图像生成依赖精确的去噪网络与强数值采样器，但二者未完全匹配。采样时去噪器基于与真实数据差异较大的有缺陷输入预测下一步，形成训练-测试差距（暴露偏差），导致生成图像模糊、缺细节或形状扭曲，限制了生成质量。
AI.method: PEEK在每个符合条件的去噪步：先做一次临时单步更新，在前瞻状态下再评估一次去噪器，并与再后一步的预测插值形成下一噪声状态，从而从更高信噪比状态获得更像真实图像的预测。为优化插值位置，PEEK搜索插值调度，并通过前缀缓存与基线噪声调度重基准缓存提升搜索效率，保持训练无关。
AI.result: 在8个像素空间与潜空间扩散模型上，覆盖无条件、标签引导、文本引导设置及多种输出分辨率，PEEK在NFE匹配基线上持续改进，FID最高提升49.3%，额外计算开销极小（每个模型一次性校准最多2.2分钟）。
AI.conclusion: 通过前瞻式额外去噪评估与插值调度优化，PEEK有效缓解采样暴露偏差，在低开销下普遍提升扩散生成质量，是一种通用、训练-free的确定性采样器插件。

title: Hybrid LLM-Deterministic Pipelines for Enterprise-Scale Code Migration at Bloomberg
summary: Large organizations carry a long tail of infrastructure migrations that are worth doing but rarely urgent enough to compete with feature work, because each one costs significant engineering time per repository. This paper reports on our industrial experience from Automated Uplift, a multi-month initiative applying LLM-assisted migration pipelines across thousands of Bloomberg repositories. We examine two distinct production campaigns: a heterogeneous Python packaging migration (approx. 1,900 candidate repositories) and a uniform C++ build system migration (approx. 6,700 candidate repositories). Together, these campaigns generated 2,333 pull requests, resulting in 729 successful migrations. We detail our hybrid architectural solution which maximizes deterministic processing, confines the LLM to bounded file transformations within a pre-computed context, and incorporates runtime production telemetry (such as execution logs and usage traces). Our findings show that generating migrations turned out to be the easier part; the bottleneck was the cost, for owning teams, of reviewing, testing, and deploying them. These costs were lowered when changes could be verified directly in the pipeline before opening a PR (as with C++ compilation and test validation), and when the population was uniform enough for fixes to carry over from one repository to the next. We conclude by distilling our experience and findings into actionable, transferable patterns for architecting hybrid LLM-deterministic pipelines and scaling code migrations across the enterprise

AI.tldr: Bloomberg 的 Automated Uplift 计划用 LLM 辅助的混合流水线在数千个代码仓库上执行基础设施迁移，共产生 2,333 个 PR、729 次成功迁移；核心发现是"生成迁移容易，评审/测试/部署的成本才是瓶颈"，而流水线内可验证与仓库同质化能显著降低该成本。
AI.motivation: 大型组织存在大量"值得做但不紧急"的长尾基础设施迁移，每个仓库都需耗费大量工程师时间，难以与功能开发竞争资源，因此需要可规模化、低成本的自动化迁移方案。
AI.method: 报告工业实践经验：构建 LLM 与确定性处理混合的迁移流水线——最大化确定性子处理，将 LLM 限制在预计算上下文内的有界文件变换中，并引入运行时生产遥测（执行日志、使用追踪）。在两个真实生产战役中验证：异构的 Python 打包迁移（约 1,900 个候选仓库）与同质的 C++ 构建系统迁移（约 6,700 个候选仓库）。
AI.result: 两个战役共生成 2,333 个 PR，其中 729 次迁移成功。生成迁移本身相对容易；真正瓶颈在于归属团队评审、测试与部署的成本。当变更能在开 PR 之前于流水线内直接验证（如 C++ 编译与测试校验），或当仓库群体足够同质、修复能从一个仓库复用到下一个时，这些成本明显下降。
AI.conclusion: 提出了可操作、可迁移的模式，用于设计 LLM-确定性混合流水线并在企业范围内规模化代码迁移。核心启示：应把工程投入放在降低下游评审与验证成本上，而非仅优化代码生成。

title: One Strategic Woman: Sharp Ranks and a Persistent Core
summary: In a balanced random stable-marriage market, one fixed woman manipulates men-proposing deferred acceptance to obtain her best attainable partner. We prove that the women's expected average true partner rank is asymptotic to $(\ln n)^2$, improving the previous $O((\ln n)^4)$ bound, while the men's is asymptotic to $n/(2\ln n)$. The men's and women's average ranks, normalized by $n/\ln n$ and $\ln n$, converge jointly in distribution to $(U,U^{-1})$, where $U$ is uniform on $(0,1)$. Under optimal truthful truncation, the span of women's average ranks within the reported stable core, divided by $\ln n$, converges in distribution to $U^{-1}-1$.

AI.tldr: 研究诚实截断策略下稳定婚姻市场中男女平均排名的极限分布，证明女性操纵下平均真实排名趋于(ln n)^2，男性为n/(2ln n)，并给出联合分布收敛结果。
AI.motivation: 此前对女性通过操纵男性提议延迟接受算法所获平均排名的最优上界为O((ln n)^4)，需要更精确的刻画，并理解男女双方排名的联合分布规律。
AI.method: 在平衡随机稳定婚姻市场模型中，分析固定女性操纵男性提议延迟接受算法的效果；研究最优诚实截断下报告稳定核内女性平均排名跨度，用概率极限理论（依分布收敛）推导渐近分布。
AI.result: 女性期望平均真实排名渐近于(ln n)^2（改进原O((ln n)^4)）；男性渐近于n/(2ln n)。以n/ln n和ln n归一化后，男女平均排名联合依分布收敛到(U, U^{-1})，U在(0,1)均匀分布。最优诚实截断下，女性平均排名跨度除以ln n依分布收敛到U^{-1}-1。
AI.conclusion: 给出了稳定婚姻市场中操纵效应的精确渐近刻画，揭示了男女排名之间由同一均匀随机变量U联系的对偶逆关系。

title: SpikePose: Lightweight Video Human Pose Estimation
summary: Efficient video human pose estimation must balance localisation accuracy, motion quality, and energy cost. We present SpikePose, a lightweight video pose estimator that pairs a frame-reset, single-step spiking encoder with motion-aligned heatmap memory (MAM). The encoder supplies per-frame spatial evidence, while MAM estimates joint displacement, aligns historical heatmaps, and adaptively fuses them with current predictions. By confining temporal reasoning to a compact, lightweight module outside the spiking backbone, SpikePose helps bridge the gap between spiking and classical Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) on large-scale, non-event-driven video tasks. We evaluate spatial accuracy, motion errors, and estimated arithmetic energy on MPII and a fixed NTU60 Cross-Subject subset. Against the architecture-matched ANN with MAM, SpikePose cuts estimated arithmetic energy by 91.4% at a cost of just 1.12 points in head-bone-normalised PCK at 0.5 threshold (PCK_HB(0.5)). Within SpikePose, adding MAM reduces velocity and acceleration errors by 28.13% and 31.46% while slightly improving localisation, at a cost of only 0.003M parameters and 0.0023 analytical GFLOPs per frame. Code will be released on GitHub upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: SpikePose：单步脉冲编码器＋运动对齐热图记忆（MAM），在MPII/NTU60上实现近ANN精度、算术能耗降91.4%。
AI.motivation: 视频人体姿态估计需兼顾定位精度、运动质量与能耗；脉冲网络在大规模非事件驱动视频任务上仍与经典ANN存在差距。
AI.method: 帧重置、单步脉冲编码器提供逐帧空间证据；轻量级MAM（位于脉冲骨干之外）估计关节位移、对齐历史热图并自适应融合当前预测，将时序推理限制在紧凑模块中。
AI.result: 在MPII与固定NTU60跨受试者子集上评估：相比同架构ANN+MAM，能耗降低91.4%，PCK_HB(0.5)仅降1.12点；加入MAM使速度/加速度误差降28.13%/31.46%，定位略升，代价仅0.003M参数、0.0023 GFLOPs/帧。
AI.conclusion: 将时序建模移出脉冲骨干可有效缩小脉冲与ANN在视频姿态估计上的差距，实现高能效、低运动误差的轻量方案。

title: Do Search-Augmented Recommenders Use the Latest Search Episode?
summary:
Search-augmented recommenders can use the latest search episode and earlier searches. We introduce FocalSwap to test how these inputs contribute to the next recommendation. For each recommendation, it changes the latest search slot or all search inputs while holding the target, candidates, pre-search history, and scorer fixed. It compares neutral masks with matched observed-search replacements, recording rank changes, RR gains relative to each control, and preference for the true focal search. A planted signal and GenSAR's current-query task confirm that the audit detects known input dependence. We evaluate behavioral and lexical evidence on KuaiSAR and Qilin, and recommendation checkpoints trained using the released SESRec and UniSAR implementations.
  Across three independently trained UniSAR checkpoints, the estimated all-source benefit depends on the control. On the same 66,139 rows, replacing all search inputs with a neutral ID yields a positive signed contribution, whereas replacing them with category/profile-matched observed search sequences gives smaller estimates, with an interval below zero for one checkpoint. The paired RR gaps range from $+2.770 \times 10^{-3}$ to $+6.604 \times 10^{-3}$, and every adjusted interval is above zero. Neutral masks change 59.7-61.7% of target ranks, while matched replacements change 44.1-44.8%. The control contrast persists across five alternative donor assignments per checkpoint. Under the primary neutral-mask and category-matched controls, positive latest-slot contribution is not established in SESRec or UniSAR. These results show why masking evidence should be compared with observed-search replacements when attributing a benefit to broader search state or the latest episode.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FocalSwap 审计方法，通过在固定目标、候选、搜索前历史与打分器的条件下替换"最新搜索槽"或"全部搜索输入"，检验搜索增强推荐中各搜索输入对下一推荐的贡献，并发现传统中性掩码会高估收益。
AI.motivation: 搜索增强推荐器同时利用最新搜索会话与历史搜索，但现有证据（尤其基于中性掩码的消融）难以区分"搜索输入本身有用"，还是"替换方式的对照不当"；需要一个能控制变量、对不同对照方式做匹配比较的审计框架。
AI.method: FocalSwap：对每次推荐，仅改变最新搜索槽或全部搜索输入，保持目标、候选、搜索前历史与打分器不变；对比中性掩码与类别/画像匹配的观测搜索序列替换，记录排名变化、相对各对照的 RR 增益以及对真实焦点搜索的偏好。用植入信号和 GenSAR 当前查询任务验证可检出已知依赖。在 KuaiSAR、Qilin 及 SESRec、UniSAR 三个独立训练的检查点（同一 66,139 行）上评估行为与词法证据，并用五种替代捐赠者分配做稳健性检验。
AI.result: 全部来源收益随对照选取而变：中性 ID 替换给出正的有符号贡献，而类别/画像匹配的观测搜索替换估计更小，某一检查点的区间低于零。配对 RR 差距为 +2.770e-3 至 +6.604e-3，校正后区间均大于零。中性掩码改变 59.7–61.7% 的目标排名，匹配替换仅改变 44.1–44.8%。在主要的中性掩码与类别匹配对照下，SESRec 与 UniSAR 均未能确立正向的最新槽贡献。
AI.conclusion: 掩码式消融会因对照选择而系统性夸大搜索状态的收益；在将收益归因于更广的搜索状态或最新搜索片段时，必须将掩码证据与观测搜索替换对照进行比较。FocalSwap 提供了这种可复现的审计工具。

title: SRRM: A Retrieval-Reconstruction Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Context Memory in Small Language Models
summary: Small Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed on consumer-grade hardware, yet their ability to preserve information across progressively longer contexts remains insufficiently understood. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate retrieval-oriented tasks, providing limited insight into whether successful retrieval reflects comprehensive long-context memory preservation. To address this limitation, this paper introduces Simple Retrieval-Reconstruction Memory (SRRM), a lightweight and fully reproducible benchmark that jointly evaluates Targeted Retrieval and Global Information Reconstruction. This study also proposes the Memory Preservation Ratio (MPR), a benchmark-level metric that quantifies the relationship between retrieval and reconstruction performance. SRRM was evaluated using a synthetic dataset on three Qwen2.5 models (0.5B, 1.5B, and 3B parameters) across context loads ranging from 10 to 100 factual statements. Experimental results show that reconstruction performance deteriorated substantially faster than retrieval accuracy as contextual information increased, indicating that retrieval alone is insufficient to characterize long-context memory preservation. Among the evaluated models, Qwen2.5-1.5B achieved the highest retrieval accuracy (86.7%), reconstruction performance (45.7%), and MPR (0.53), outperforming the larger Qwen2.5-3B model (72.2%, 18.5%, and 0.26, respectively). These findings demonstrate that increasing parameter count does not necessarily improve long-context memory preservation. Overall, SRRM provides a reproducible and extensible benchmark for systematically evaluating long-context memory while revealing complementary memory behaviors that remain hidden under retrieval-only evaluation frameworks.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量可复现基准SRRM，联合评估定向检索与全局信息重建，并引入记忆保持率指标MPR；实验表明小模型的长上下文记忆重建衰减远快于检索，且参数更大（3B）并不必然更好。
AI.motivation: SLM越来越多部署在消费级硬件上，但其在渐进变长上下文中保持信息的能力尚不清楚；现有基准多只做检索类任务，无法判断检索成功是否代表长上下文记忆被完整保留。
AI.method: 构建SRRM（Simple Retrieval-Reconstruction Memory）基准，同时评估Targeted Retrieval与Global Information Reconstruction；提出benchmark级指标MPR（Memory Preservation Ratio）刻画检索与重建之间的关系；使用合成数据集，在Qwen2.5 0.5B/1.5B/3B三模型、10–100条事实陈述的上下文负载下评测。
AI.result: 随上下文信息增加，重建性能下降速度显著快于检索准确率，说明仅靠检索不足以刻画长上下文记忆保持。Qwen2.5-1.5B在检索准确率(86.7%)、重建性能(45.7%)和MPR(0.53)上均最优，超过更大的Qwen2.5-3B(分别为72.2%、18.5%、0.26)。
AI.conclusion: 参数规模增大不一定提升长上下文记忆保持；SRRM提供了可复现、可扩展的长上下文记忆评测基准，揭示出仅用检索评测时被掩盖的互补记忆行为。

title: Towards Robust Long-Lived Agents: Benchmarking Experience Lifecycles in Evolving Environments
summary: As agents become more capable, they are moving beyond one-off tasks toward sustained assistance across successive user goals. Such assistance requires agents to discover how unfamiliar environments work, reuse what they learn across tasks, and keep that experience current as environments evolve. Existing benchmarks increasingly study experience reuse and adaptation, but provide limited insight into which parts of accumulated experience agents revise, retain, or lose. To address this gap, we introduce ReScopeBench, a benchmark for the experience lifecycle across 18 interactive environments. It distinguishes structural experience about how an environment is organized and accessed from rule experience about reusable principles and constraints that guide decisions across tasks. To study how experience is acquired, reused, and revised, we propose an experience-first construction approach. It builds task streams around shared experience and introduces silent environmental changes. We evaluate task performance and track changes in saved experience throughout each stream. Across 20 models, we find that retained experience improves task performance, but agents struggle to keep it current as environments change. Even when the required experience is correctly recorded, agents do not always complete tasks successfully. These findings identify selective maintenance and effective use as complementary challenges for long-lived agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ReScopeBench 基准，用 18 个交互环境研究智能体经验的完整生命周期（获取、复用、修订、遗忘），区分"结构经验"与"规则经验"，并发现保留经验能提升任务表现，但智能体难以随环境变化更新经验，且记录正确不等于使用有效。
AI.motivation: 智能体正从一次性任务转向跨用户目标的持续辅助，需要在陌生环境中发现规律、跨任务复用经验并保持经验时效性。现有基准多考察经验复用与适应，但缺乏对"经验的哪些部分被修订、保留或丢失"的细粒度洞察。
AI.method: 构建 ReScopeBench：覆盖 18 个交互环境，将经验区分为结构经验（环境如何组织与访问）和规则经验（可跨任务迁移的原则与约束）；采用"经验优先"的构建方法，围绕共享经验组织任务流，并引入静默环境变化；评估任务表现并全程追踪保存经验的变化。
AI.result: 在 20 个模型上评估发现：保留的经验能提升任务表现；但环境变化时智能体难以保持经验更新；即使所需经验被正确记录，智能体也未必能成功完成任务。
AI.conclusion: 选择性维护（保持经验时效）与有效使用（把经验转化为行动）是长期运行智能体面临的两个互补性挑战，二者共同构成经验生命周期的核心问题。

title: The Confidence Score: a New Measure on Kernels
summary: Across a wide range of applications, kernel measures are used to tune hyperparameters, select among candidate kernels, and assess the suitability of kernels for specific learning tasks. For classification, kernel measures are used to predict which kernels may produce accurate kernel classifiers. Many existing kernel measures, such as alignment to the ideal kernel, are designed to reward kernels which captures all samples from the same class as similar. While effective in many settings, this requirement is unnecessarily restrictive for classification, where classes may exhibit substantial internal structure. In this work, the "Confidence Score", a new kernel measure, is proposed. Unlike alignment-to-the-ideal kernel measures, the Confidence Score measures the alignment between an encoding of the ground truth and that ground truth projected by the kernel, allowing kernels that preserve intra-class structure to achieve high scores. Through experiments, it is demonstrated that the Confidence Score exhibits a higher correlation with classification accuracy across a variety of kernels on both real-world and synthetic datasets, compared to select other kernel measures.

AI.tldr: 提出"Confidence Score"核度量，通过衡量真值编码与其经核投影后的真值之间的对齐程度，允许核保留类内结构，在多类核与真实/合成数据集上比现有核度量与分类准确率相关性更高。
AI.motivation: 现有核度量（如向理想核对齐）要求同类样本全部相似，这一要求在类内存在显著结构时过于严格，因此需要一种新型核度量。
AI.method: 提出 Confidence Score：不再要求同类样本全相似，而是度量"真值编码"与"该真值经核投影后的版本"之间的对齐程度，从而允许保留类内结构的核获得高分。
AI.result: 在真实与合成数据集上、多种核的实验中，Confidence Score 与分类准确率的相关性高于所选其他核度量。
AI.conclusion: Confidence Score 是一种更适用于分类任务的核度量，可用于核选择与超参数调优。

title: Augmentation with Reinforcement Transformation for Low-textured Scientific Sketch Image Retrieval
summary: Low-textured sketch images are widely used in scientific applications, including wildlife conservation, archaeological illustration, and forensic composites. Learning from and retrieving such images is challenging because they lack detailed surface textures and visual variations commonly exploited by modern deep learning models. This paper proposes Augmentation with Reinforcement Transformation (ART) to fine-tune pretrained models to learn effective representations for accurate sketch image retrieval. Our key observation is that sketches are particularly sensitive to image transformations, such as rotation, flipping, zooming, and stretching. While some transformations preserve their structural integrity, others may introduce distortions that hinder representation learning. Instead of randomly choosing transformations to construct fine-tuning views, ART formulates augmentation selection as a multi-armed bandit (MAB) problem, where transformations are treated as arms and their effectiveness is continuously evaluated through rewards. This enables ART to adaptively construct reward-guided view banks before self-supervised fine-tuning; the subsequent representation loss does not feed back to ART. On Florida manatee sketches provided by Mote Marine Laboratory, ART achieves 71.40% average Top-1 accuracy for transformed-scar retrieval, compared with 68.83% for random augmentation selection, and 55.84% for location-aware sketch retrieval, compared with 18.18% for frozen CLIP.

AI.tldr: 提出ART方法：将图像增强的选择建模为多臂老虎机问题，用奖励引导自适应挑选旋转、翻转、缩放等变换来构造视图库，再自监督微调预训练模型，用于低纹理素描图像检索。
AI.motivation: 科学领域（野生动物保护、考古绘图、法医画像）中大量使用低纹理素描图像，但这类图像缺少现代深度模型所依赖的细节纹理和视觉变化，学习与检索都很困难。且素描对旋转、翻转、缩放、拉伸等变换高度敏感——有的变换保留结构完整性，有的则引入失真破坏表征学习，因此不能随意随机选择增强。
AI.method: ART（Augmentation with Reinforcement Transformation）：把增强选择形式化为多臂老虎机（MAB）问题，将各种变换视为"臂"，通过奖励持续评估其有效性，从而在自监督微调前自适应地构建奖励引导的视图库（view bank）；后续的表征损失不反馈给ART。
AI.result: 在Mote Marine Laboratory提供的佛罗里达海牛素描数据上：变换疤痕检索平均Top-1准确率71.40%，随机增强选择为68.83%；位置感知素描检索达55.84%，而冻结CLIP仅18.18%。
AI.conclusion: 用强化（bandit）方式自适应选择增强，比随机增强更适合低纹理素描的表征学习，显著提升素描检索准确率，尤其相对冻结CLIP提升巨大。

title: ProofStudio: Five Proof Assistants in the Browser
comment: The tool is available at: https://proofstudio.org/
summary: Recent advances in AI-assisted proof automation are extending the use of proof assistants in software verification and mathematics. However, greater proof automation does not remove users' responsibility to assess whether formal statements capture their intended requirements, making education in formal specification and reasoning essential. To lower the installation and learning barriers associated with mature proof assistants, we present ProofStudio, a browser-based environment integrating Isabelle/HOL, Lean, Rocq, HOL4, and HOL Light with corresponding worked examples, preconfigured proof search, and contextual AI assistance. With ProofStudio, users can explore formal specifications and proofs across five systems without local installation, inspecting native prover feedback and experimenting with automation through a common interface.

AI.tldr: ProofStudio 是一个基于浏览器的形式化证明环境，集成 Isabelle/HOL、Lean、Rocq、HOL4 和 HOL Light 五大证明助手，提供示例库、预配置证明搜索与上下文 AI 辅助，无需本地安装即可学习形式化规范与证明。
AI.motivation: AI 辅助证明自动化虽在进步，但用户仍需判断形式化陈述是否真正表达其意图，因此形式化规范与推理的教育至关重要；而成熟证明助手存在安装和学习门槛高的问题，阻碍了教学普及。
AI.method: 围绕五大证明系统构建统一的浏览器端平台：集成各系统并附带配套的完整示例（worked examples），预配置证明搜索，并提供结合上下文的 AI 辅助；用户在统一界面中可直接查看证明器的原生反馈并尝试自动化，无需在本地安装任何工具。
AI.result: 用户可在五种证明系统中探索形式化规范与证明，跨系统对比，并通过统一接口实验自动化与查看原生证明器输出。
AI.conclusion: ProofStudio 降低了形式化方法与证明助手的安装与学习门槛，为形式化规范与推理教育提供了可行的跨系统实践平台。

title: On Existence and Computational Complexity of Quasi-strict Equilibria
summary:
Quasi-strict Nash equilibrium, introduced by Harsanyi in 1973, is the Nash equilibrium refinement that requires every pure best response to be played with positive probability. Norde established that any bimatrix game admits a quasi-strict Nash equilibrium. We give a substantially simpler proof of this result that in particular avoids an intricate limit argument used in the final step of the proof by Norde.
  Our existence proof allows us to positively resolve the outstanding open question of PPAD membership of the problem of computing a quasi-strict Nash equilibrium, thereby settling its precise complexity. In games with three or more players, a quasi-strict Nash equilibrium is not guaranteed to exist, leading to the natural problem of deciding the existence of a quasi-strict Nash equilibrium in a given strategic form game. We show that this problem is $\exists\mathbb{R}$-complete, strengthening a previous NP-hardness result.

AI.tldr: 本文给出双矩阵博弈中准严格纳什均衡存在的更简证明，并据此证明计算准严格纳什均衡属于PPAD，从而确定其精确复杂性；同时证明三人及以上博弈中判定准严格纳什均衡存在性是∃ℝ-完全的。
AI.motivation: Harsanyi引入的准严格纳什均衡要求每个纯最优反应都以正概率被采用。Norde已证明任意双矩阵博弈都存在准严格纳什均衡，但其证明最后一步依赖复杂的极限论证；同时"计算准严格纳什均衡是否属于PPAD"长期悬而未决，多玩家情形下存在性判定问题的精确复杂性也有待确定。
AI.method: 对Norde的存在性定理给出一个显著简化的证明，尤其避免了其证明最后一步中复杂的极限论证；利用这一新的存在性证明来构造计算问题的归约，证明计算准严格纳什均衡属于PPAD；并对三人及以上博弈中的存在性判定问题给出∃ℝ-完全性证明。
AI.result: 证明计算准严格纳什均衡问题属于PPAD，从而解决其开放问题并确定其精确复杂性；证明多玩家博弈中准严格纳什均衡存在性判定问题是∃ℝ-完全的，强于此前已知的NP-hard结果。
AI.conclusion: 准严格纳什均衡在双矩阵博弈中总存在且计算问题属于PPAD，其复杂性得到精确刻画；而三人及以上博弈中该均衡不保证存在，存在性判定是∃ℝ-完全的。

title: Adaptive Multi Mode: Budget-Aware Routing of Optimizers By Online Landscape Probes
summary: The best classical optimizer for a continuous black-box problem depends on its budget and landscape. Existing routers decide from the dimension and budget, past improvement or features fitted to one benchmark, and few test an optimizer's implicit assumptions online. AMM (Adaptive Multi Mode) routes a known budget among quasi-Newton, trust-region, coordinate, multistart and evolution-strategy optimization engines with online probes of curvature, plateaus, separability, kinks, basins and fractal structure. Each probe has a default, a dimension-by-budget validity range and a cost charged to the budget. In its pre-registered development loop on bbob, 32 of 36 predictions held over the last 16 confirmations. AMM was then tested once on held-out bbob instances 101-110 (D=2-40, 10*D-1000*D) against up to seven competitors. It has the highest target share in 382 of 600 function-dimension-budget cells (236 outright, 146 tied) and, by a descriptive posterior rule, is credibly behind in 35, mostly at 10*D and 30*D. At every budget it also leads the controls built from its own engines (the best engine alone, the best engine per dimension and budget, and a greedy schedule), narrowly at 10*D and 30*D, and nevergrad's NgIohTuned. In pre-registered runs its lead over IPOP-CMA-ES holds under affine and box transformations, on box-constrained bbob and, pooled, on rotated f2-f4, but rotating the separable f3 and f4 removes most of the lead there. On held-out MA-BBOB its final share at 2000*D is level with IPOP-CMA-ES's and its anytime area lower. We published AMM as an open-source Python package (pip install amm-optimizer; https://github.com/BjBodner/amm-optimizer).

AI.tldr: AMM 通过在线探针识别目标函数的曲率、平台、可分性等结构，将已知预算路由到准牛顿、信赖域、坐标、多起点和进化策略等优化器，在 bbob 上取得最高目标占比，并开源为 Python 包。
AI.motivation: 连续黑箱问题的最佳经典优化器取决于预算与景观，而现有路由器只依据维度、预算、历史改进或单一基准拟合特征，很少在线检验优化器的隐含假设。
AI.method: AMM 在已知预算下用在线探针（曲率、平台、可分性、折点、盆地、分形结构）路由到准牛顿、信赖域、坐标、多起点、进化策略等引擎；每个探针有默认值、维度-预算有效范围和计入预算的开销。先在 bbob 上做预注册开发循环，再在留出实例 101-110 上单次测试，并与多个基线和控制组对比，还做了预注册的仿射/箱约束/旋转扰动实验及 MA-BBOB 测试。
AI.result: 开发阶段 36 条预测中 32 条在最后 16 次确认中成立。留出测试中 AMM 在 600 个函数-维度-预算单元里 382 个目标占比最高（236 绝对领先、146 并列），仅 35 个明显落后（多为 10*D/30*D）。在每个预算下均领先由自身引擎构建的对照组和 NgIohTuned；领先 IPOP-CMA-ES 在仿射/箱/旋转 f2-f4 上成立，但旋转可分 f3、f4 后优势消失；MA-BBOB 上 2000*D 占比与 IPOP-CMA-ES 持平、anytime 面积更低。
AI.conclusion: 在线探针驱动的多引擎路由在经典优化器选择上有效且可复现，但在低预算（10*D、30*D）、可分函数旋转及 MA-BBOB anytime 性能上仍有短板。

title: Generative Retrieval under Real-Time Supply Constraints in Local Commerce
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables, 2 algorithms. The first five authors contributed equally
summary: Generative retrieval predicts semantic identifiers for candidate entities. In local retail and food delivery, candidates must also be serviceable for a particular user at a particular time. Location, weather, and traffic reshape merchant and product supply, so a catalog-valid identifier may be infeasible for the current request. Post-generation filtering removes such candidates only after beam capacity and inference computation have been spent. We study retrieval over an explicitly materialized, request-time supply snapshot, where short output sequences leave little opportunity to amortize online constraint preparation. Our RTP-LLM pipeline compiles eligible residual-quantization identifiers into a compressed sparse row prefix index, overlaps CPU compilation with model prefill, and shares the uploaded index across beams. Legal expansions retain original-model log probabilities, and constraint states follow selected beam parents. We formalize snapshot-relative identifier validity and distinguish it from entity-level eligibility and freshness. The implementation generates three-token merchant identifiers. Historical evidence covers daily catalog constraints and subsequent request-scoped serving evaluations. In one matched-beam daily-constraint case, filtered merchants decrease from 170 of 299 candidates to 29 of 299; residual distance filtering motivates request-specific constraints. A different-host comparison with 30,000 supplied entries reports a 0.6 ms service-side latency increment, while client measurements expose additional request costs. Captured requests from three geographic settings characterize behavior across supply sizes and output widths. These observations span development stages and measurement boundaries. They establish a practical implementation and identify bottlenecks, but do not establish compute savings at matched retrieval quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 RTP-LLM 流水线，在请求时物化的供给快照上做生成式检索，将可服务的残差量化标识符编译为 CSR 前缀索引，与模型 prefill 重叠执行并跨 beam 共享，从而在生成阶段直接排除不可行候选。
AI.motivation: 本地零售与外卖场景中，候选不仅需目录有效，还须对特定用户在特定时刻可服务；位置、天气、交通会改变供给，后置过滤会浪费 beam 容量与推理计算，而三 token 短序列难以摊销在线约束准备开销。
AI.method: 形式化"快照相对的标识符有效性"，区分实体级资格与新鲜度；将请求时合格 RQ 标识符编译为压缩稀疏行（CSR）前缀索引，CPU 编译与模型 prefill 重叠，上传索引在 beam 间共享；合法扩展保留原模型对数概率，约束状态跟随被选中的父 beam。
AI.result: 匹配 beam 的日约束案例中，被过滤商户由 299 中的 170 降至 29；残差距离过滤说明需请求特定约束；异机 3 万条目对比显示服务端延迟增加 0.6 ms，客户端另有请求开销；三种地理设置请求刻画不同供给规模与输出宽度下的行为。
AI.conclusion: 工作建立了一个可行实现并定位瓶颈，跨开发阶段与测量边界给出经验证据，但未证明在同等检索质量下可节省计算。

title: AI-Driven SaaS Platform Integration: AI Express for Unified Generative AI Services with Pay-As-You-Go Credit Systems and Scalable Microservice Architecture
summary: Generative AI is currently fragmented, with separate subscriptions required for text generation, image synthesis, and code assistance, leading to high costs and workflow disruptions. AI Express is a SaaS platform that consolidates these capabilities into a unified pay-as-you-go service. The platform provides a range of AI tools, including a Core Code Reviewer that evaluates GitHub repositories, a Text-to-Website generator that converts text into fully functional websites, script generation, grammar checking, data analysis, and watermark removal, all accessible through a single interface without requiring technical expertise.

AI.tldr: AI Express 是一个将文本生成、图像合成、代码辅助等多类生成式AI能力整合为统一按量付费SaaS平台的系统，用户通过单一界面即可使用代码审查、文本转网站、脚本生成、语法检查、数据分析和去水印等工具，无需技术背景。
AI.motivation: 当前生成式AI生态碎片化：文本、图像、代码等功能需分别订阅不同服务，导致成本高、工作流被打断，且使用门槛偏高。
AI.method: 构建统一SaaS平台，采用按量付费（pay-as-you-go）模式整合多种AI工具：核心代码审查器（评估GitHub仓库）、文本转网站生成器、脚本生成、语法检查、数据分析与去水印，全部通过单一接口访问。
AI.result: 提供了一体化接入体验，降低订阅成本、减少工具切换带来的流程中断，并使非技术用户也能直接使用多种AI能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过平台化整合与按需计费，AI Express 有望缓解生成式AI服务的碎片化问题，提升可用性与成本效率。

title: Can Large Language Models Review the Scientific Literature? A Test Against a 102-Article Benchmark
comment: 34 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Data, prompts, analysis scripts and results: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23849039 (GitHub: https://github.com/abx40/spanish-plume-llm-literature-review)
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support scientific literature reviews, yet evaluations often examine individual tasks rather than the review process as a whole. We assess six AI tools across four stages: finding relevant articles, interpreting them, synthesizing across them, and proposing future research. The benchmark is a published review of the Spanish plume weather pattern and its 102-article corpus.
  In the initial searches, five tools collectively identified 57 articles, with the best individual tool finding 42. Institutional library access increased discovery from 42 to 82 articles for Codex and from 15 to 79 for Claude Code. Given the complete corpus of 102 PDFs, three tools correctly identified all 18 articles discussing the Spanish plume substantially, but incorrectly classified 40% to 79% of the 84 passing mentions as substantial. The same three tools produced syntheses evaluated blindly by two domain experts. Although largely accurate, the syntheses provided limited insight and sometimes contained unsupported claims, quotation errors, and exaggerated statements of consensus. Finally, all three tools proposed research directions broader than the Spanish plume literature, although two approached questions identified in the benchmark review.
  No single tool performed best across all tasks. We provide eight recommendations for researchers using AI tools in literature reviews. Our findings suggest that LLMs can assist with discovering and interpreting scientific literature, particularly when institutional access is available, but cannot replace expert judgment in evaluating evidence or synthesizing research.

AI.tldr: 论文以"西班牙羽流"天气型综述及其102篇文献语料为基准，评估六个AI工具在文献综述四个阶段（检索、解读、综合、提出未来方向）的表现，发现无单一工具全面最优，LLM可辅助但无法替代专家判断。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用于辅助科学文献综述，但既有评估多聚焦孤立任务，缺乏对"综述全流程"的整体性评测，因此需要一个以真实已发表综述为基准的端到端评估框架。
AI.method: 以一篇已发表的西班牙羽流天气型综述及其102篇文章语料为金标准，在四阶段（找文、解读、跨文综合、提出未来研究）上测试六个AI工具；并用机构图书馆权限对比检索增益，由两位领域专家盲评综合结果。
AI.result: 初次检索五工具合计找到57篇（最佳单工具42篇）；有机构权限后Codex从42升至82篇、Claude Code从15升至79篇。给定全部102篇PDF时，三个工具能准确识别全部18篇实质讨论文献，但将84篇顺带提及中的40%–79%误判为实质性。综合结果大体准确但洞见有限，存在无依据论断、引文错误与共识夸大；研究建议普遍超出该文献范围。无工具在所有任务上均最优。
AI.conclusion: LLM在文献发现与解读上确有帮助（尤其具备机构访问权限时），但在证据评估与研究综合上不能替代专家判断；作者据此提出八条面向研究者的使用建议。

title: Recasting Visual Language Models as EEG Foundation Models for Clinical Neurodiagnostics
summary: Historically automated electroencephalography (EEG) systems was done using task-specific supervised models trained on purposely annotated data. A more recent modeling paradigm relies on creating a unified representation, or a 'foundation model', for multiple modality-specific tasks through large-scale domain-specific pretraining on the unannotated EEG signal. The quality of this unified representation directly depends on the availability of the modality-specific datasets. At the same time, generalist Vision Language Models (VLMs) exhibit broad few-shot learning capacities as well as good fine-tuning adaptability to different visual and language tasks. Can VLMs learn how to read and interpret EEG visually, emulating to a degree the way human clinicians inspect the EEG patterns? In this work we make a case that they can: we show that generalist VLMs without large-scale EEG pretraining perform competitively across a collection of clinical neuro-diagnostic tasks, can adapt to different tasks in a few-shot learning setting better than specialist foundation models, and exhibit better performance with model scaling when modality-specific models fail to exhibit.

AI.tldr: 通用视觉语言模型（VLM）无需大规模EEG预训练，也能在多项临床神经诊断任务上与专家基础模型竞争，且少样本适应能力更强、模型扩展性更好。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化EEG系统多为任务特定的有监督模型，近期转向依赖大规模无标注EEG预训练的基础模型，但其统一表示质量受限于模态专属数据集的可获得性。作者由此提出：通用VLM能否像临床医生那样"视觉化"地读取和解读EEG？
AI.method: 将EEG信号以视觉化方式呈现给通用VLM，考察其在多项临床神经诊断任务上的零/少样本表现；与EEG专用基础模型对比，并分析少样本适应能力和模型规模扩展效应。
AI.result: 未做大规模EEG预训练的通用VLM在一系列临床神经诊断任务上表现与专家模型相当；在少样本设置下适应不同任务的能力优于专家基础模型；随模型规模增大性能提升，而模态专属模型未表现出这种扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 通用VLM可作为EEG解读的有力替代范式，弱化了对大规模模态专属标注/预训练数据的依赖，视觉化解读EEG是可行且有前景的方向。

title: PointNDF: Cascaded Neural Displacement Fields for Point Cloud Denoising
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Accepted to MMM 2027 (33rd International Conference on Multimedia Modeling)
summary: Point cloud denoising aims to recover clean geometry from noisy 3D observations while preserving both fine surface details and the underlying spatial distribution of the points. Many learning-based methods adopt a two-stage pipeline that first extracts point-wise features from the noisy input and subsequently predicts point-wise displacements via simple regressions. However, these approaches often lack robust feature guidance and distribution-aware geometric refinement, causing them to fail at maintaining optimal point uniformity and geometric quality. To address these limitations, we propose PointNDF, a denoising framework that combines patch-level geometric context with local displacement prediction. Specifically, a Point Transformer V3 (PTv3) encoder aggregates multiscale geometric information into a global patch descriptor. Rather than directly regressing an unconstrained displacement vector, a Neural Displacement Field (NDF) fuses this global patch descriptor with per-point neighborhood features. It then predicts each displacement through bounded-vector and scale factor branches, thereby achieving a superior, more uniform point distribution. Three cascaded NDF stages propagate local features and progressively refine the point positions. Experiments on PU-Net and ModelNet10 demonstrate competitive denoising accuracy and favorable inference efficiency. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/peridous/PointNDF.

AI.tldr: 提出 PointNDF 点云去噪框架，用 PTv3 编码器提取全局 patch 描述子，结合神经位移场（NDF）进行局部位移预测，通过有界向量与尺度因子分支实现更均匀的点分布。
AI.motivation: 现有两阶段学习式去噪方法（先提特征再简单回归位移）缺乏稳健的特征引导和分布感知的几何细化，难以保持最优的点均匀性与几何质量。
AI.method: PTv3 编码器聚合多尺度几何信息为全局 patch 描述子；NDF 将全局描述子与逐点邻域特征融合，通过有界向量和尺度因子两个分支预测位移，而非直接回归无约束位移；三级级联 NDF 阶段传播局部特征并渐进细化点位置。
AI.result: 在 PU-Net 和 ModelNet10 上取得有竞争力的去噪精度，并具备良好的推理效率。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将 patch 级几何上下文与局部位移预测相结合的 PointNDF 能有效提升点云去噪的几何质量与点分布均匀性，兼顾精度与效率。

title: Construct Validity of Coding Benchmarks for LLM-based Agentic Coding Tools
summary: Software developers increasingly adopt LLM-based agentic coding tools to assist them with development tasks. To provide developers with up-to-date information on these tools' effectiveness, prior work introduced benchmarks that enable comparisons across tools. Despite the widespread adoption of such benchmarks, however, recent work has shown that they suffer from issues threatening their validity. Aims. In this work, we aim to complement prior work by analyzing the construct validity of agentic coding benchmarks. Methodology. We analyze nine benchmarks commonly used to evaluate the effectiveness of agentic coding tools. We identify the constructs that the benchmarks claim to measure, the metrics used to operationalize them, and potential confounders that interfere with the measurement. Results. Our findings show that benchmarks commonly operationalize broad concepts such as coding capability with only a small set of metrics. The reported attributes that might confound the measurements vary between benchmarks, indicating a lack of standardization. Conclusions. We conclude with recommendations to strengthen construct validity in agentic coding benchmarks and encourage further empirical work to better understand the effectiveness of agentic coding tools.

AI.tldr: 本文分析九个 agentic coding 基准的构念效度（construct validity），发现其常用少量指标来操作化"编码能力"等宽泛概念，且可能干扰测量的混淆因素在不同基准间差异大、缺乏标准化，最后给出改进建议。
AI.motivation: LLM 驱动的智能体编码工具被开发者广泛采用，现有多项基准被用于比较这些工具的效果；但近期研究显示这些基准本身存在威胁效度的问题，本文旨在从构念效度角度补充分析。
AI.method: 对九个常用于评估 agentic coding 工具效果的基准进行构念效度分析：识别各基准声称测量的构念、将其操作化的指标，以及可能干扰测量的潜在混淆因素。
AI.result: 基准普遍仅用少量指标来操作化"编码能力"等宽泛概念；各基准报告的可能混淆属性彼此不同，表明缺乏标准化。
AI.conclusion: 提出加强 agentic coding 基准构念效度的建议，并呼吁开展更多实证研究以更好理解智能体编码工具的实际效果。

title: Competitive Equilibrium for Linear Chores is CLS-complete
summary:
The competitive equilibrium (CE) is a fundamental concept for markets, with applications to efficient and fair allocation of resources. We consider the fundamental question of computing a CE in the most basic Fisher market model where agents have linear preferences. While it is known that we can compute a CE in strongly polynomial time with linear goods, there is no known polynomial-time algorithm for CE with linear chores. Computing a CE for linear chores is known to be in CLS with no hardness results.
  In this paper, we prove that computing an exact CE in Fisher markets with divisible chores and linear disutilities is CLS-hard and thus CLS-complete. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first CLS-completeness result for a market equilibrium problem. On the technical side, we use the nonconvex dual Eisenberg-Gale (EG) program whose Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) points are CE [Chaudhury, Kroer, Mehta, and Nan, 2024], and the CLS-complete problem of computing a KKT point of a quadratic program [Fearnley, Goldberg, Hollender, and Savani, 2024]. We show that from any exact equilibrium of the constructed market, we can recover in polynomial time an $\varepsilon$-KKT point of the input quadratic program over the unit box.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在线性负效用的Fisher市场（可分割杂务）中计算精确竞争均衡是CLS完全的，这是首个市场均衡问题的CLS完全性结果。
AI.motivation: 线性商品（goods）市场已有强多项式时间算法计算竞争均衡（CE），但线性杂务（chores）市场的CE仅有CLS成员性证明而无硬度结果，其计算复杂度悬而未决。
AI.method: 利用非凸对偶Eisenberg-Gale规划（其KKT点为CE），从CLS完全问题——二次规划的KKT点计算——进行归约；证明可从构造市场的任一精确均衡出发，在多项式时间内恢复输入二次规划在单位盒上的ε-KKT点。
AI.result: 得到Fisher市场含可分割杂务和线性负效用时计算精确CE的CLS困难性，从而确立CLS完全性。
AI.conclusion: 计算精确CE在线性杂务Fisher市场中是CLS完全的，填补了市场均衡问题CLS完全性研究的空白。

title: PMRecBench: A Benchmark for Personalization in Recommendation Agents under Multimodal Queries
summary: On Web platforms for shopping and entertainment, recommendation agents under multimodal queries aim to deliver personalized recommendations that satisfy users' visually specified requirements and reflect preferences inferred from user histories. However, existing personalized recommendation benchmarks use text-only queries, while multimodal ones assess query matching without evaluating personalization based on real user histories. We introduce the Personalized Multimodal Recommendation Benchmark (PMRecBench), the first benchmark to evaluate the personalization of recommendation agents under multimodal queries. It pairs 510 quality-controlled image-text queries across clothing and movies with the corresponding users' real histories. PMRecBench features two key designs: (1) queries derived from consistent behavioral patterns in real user records, with reference images and targets linked to actual interactions; and (2) challenging diagnostic pools with candidate items rated highly by the user but violating requirements, and items satisfying requirements but never rated highly, testing requirement understanding and preference following, respectively. Extensive experiments on diagnostic pools reveal a personalization imbalance in recommendation agents: relative to personalization signals alone, adding multimodal queries weakens preference following, even though the additional information about query requirements improves overall ranking performance. Further analysis links this decline in preference following to image interpretation, where agents can prioritize resemblance to reference images over evidence from user histories, and stronger commercial backbones alone fail to resolve this imbalance. This personalization imbalance highlights a central challenge for recommendation agents: improving ranking performance while preserving preference following when responding to multimodal user queries

AI.tldr: 提出PMRecBench，首个评测多模态查询下推荐个性化能力的基准，揭示现有推荐智能体的"个性化失衡"问题。
AI.motivation: 现有购物与娱乐平台的推荐智能体需同时满足用户视觉化需求与历史推断的偏好，但已有基准要么仅用纯文本查询，要么仅评估多模态查询匹配而不基于真实用户历史评估个性化。
AI.method: 构建PMRecBench：覆盖服饰与电影两类场景，510条质控图文查询，配套真实用户历史。设计两点：(1)查询源自真实行为一致的记录，参考图与目标对应真实交互；(2)诊断候选池——用户高评分但违背需求的物品、满足需求但从未高评分的物品，分别测试需求理解与偏好遵循。
AI.result: 诊断池实验显示个性化失衡：加入多模态查询虽提升整体排序表现，却削弱偏好遵循能力；该下降与图像解读有关，智能体可能优先关注参考图相似度而忽视历史证据，仅靠更强商用骨干亦无法解决。
AI.conclusion: 多模态查询下推荐智能体面临核心挑战：在提升排序性能的同时须保持偏好遵循，PMRecBench为这一方向提供诊断性评测手段。

title: When to Ask, When to Answer: Strategic Clarification for Ambiguous Reference Resolution in Dialogue
summary: For humans, referential disambiguation is a collaborative process involving clarification questions asked when they will meaningfully change the outcome. However, large language models (LLMs) have been shown to be biased toward premature answering, preferring definite single-turn responses over more clarification exchanges. In this paper, we study the problem of "strategic clarification" -- asking clarification questions in a reference game when their answers will narrow the set of candidate referents. We construct a controlled test environment from the SIMMC 2.1 dataset that records how many questions each ambiguous reference needs to be successfully resolved, and examine how baseline LLM behavior and common post-training methods ask clarifying questions vs. attempt to answer the referent. We also propose BACE (Belief-Aware Critic with Epistemic tracking), a lightweight action chooser method on top of a frozen LM backbone, and show that BACE more consistently chooses the optimal number of clarifying questions than methods such as GRPO and ArCHer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"策略性澄清"问题，构建基于SIMMC 2.1的参照游戏测试环境，并提出轻量级动作选择方法BACE，使冻结语言模型更稳定地选择最优数量的澄清问题。
AI.motivation: 人类在指代消歧中会协作式地在能实质改变结果时提出澄清问题，而LLM倾向于过早作答、偏好确定的单轮回复而非多轮澄清。
AI.method: 从SIMMC 2.1数据集构建受控测试环境，记录每个歧义参照成功消解所需的提问次数；对比基线LLM行为与常见后训练方法在"提问澄清"与"直接作答"之间的取舍；提出BACE（Belief-Aware Critic with Epistemic tracking），一种在冻结LM主干之上的轻量级动作选择器，并跟踪信念与认知不确定性。
AI.result: BACE比GRPO和ArCHer等方法更一致地选择最优数量的澄清问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模信念与认知状态并作为动作选择层，可在不微调主干模型的情况下改善LLM的策略性澄清行为。

title: SlackBench: Benchmarking Agents on Collaborative Projects Grounded in Real Code Repositories
summary:
AI Agents are becoming digital coworkers that can browse the web, write code, run experiments, and assist humans over extended horizons. Yet existing benchmarks fall short of real knowledge work: many rely on synthetic data or isolated tasks, missing the complex, multi-party dynamics of collaborative projects, where critical information is scattered across conversations, code, and evolving decisions. Even simple workplace questions may require locating relevant channels and direct messages, recovering context from long discussions, inspecting repository state, reconciling stale or conflicting evidence, and synthesizing across sources.
  We introduce SlackBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on realistic research and engineering workflows that require joint reasoning over workplace communication and evolving repository state. Grounded in privacy-preserving reenactments of real academic research projects, SlackBench provides reproducible environments with realistic multi-party dialogue, evolving decisions, and corresponding code changes grounded in GitHub repositories and Google Docs. It contains 140 queries spanning heterogeneous-source agentic search, abstention on unanswerable or false-premise questions, goal-directed summarization, and circumstance inference over long conversations. These tasks are not reducible to static corpus question answering: agents must determine which conversations matter, traverse threads, inspect repository state, and synthesize evidence across communication and code artifacts. Across 33 frontier models and agent harnesses, the best system scores around 80% and most agents score below 66%, highlighting substantial headroom for improvement. SlackBench thus provides an extensible framework for evaluating agents in collaborative work environments. The SlackBench dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuanzhiMao/SlackBench .

AI.tldr: SlackBench是一个评估AI agent在真实科研/工程协作工作流中跨工作沟通与仓库状态联合推理能力的基准，含140个查询，最佳系统约80%，多数agent低于66%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多依赖合成数据或孤立任务，缺乏协作项目中多方动态、信息分散于对话/代码/不断演变的决策等真实知识工作特征。
AI.method: 基于真实学术研究项目的隐私保护重演，构建可复现环境，包含多方对话、演变决策及对应GitHub代码变更与Google Docs；设计四类共140个查询：异构来源agentic检索、不可答/假前提问题的拒答、目标导向摘要、长对话情境推断。
AI.result: 在33个前沿模型与agent harness上评测，最佳系统约80%，多数低于66%，存在显著提升空间。
AI.conclusion: SlackBench为评估协作工作环境中的agent提供了可扩展框架，任务不可简化为静态语料问答，需跨沟通与代码工件综合证据。

title: FedSharp: Byzantine Robust Decentralized Federated Learning Under Noisy Channel
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, submitted for possible publication
summary: Decentralized federated learning (DFL) eliminates the central aggregation server but remains vulnerable to data heterogeneity, Byzantine attacks, and channel noise. We show that noise accumulates as models propagate across nodes, becoming increasingly significant as the learning rate decays. Moreover, accumulated noise enables Byzantine attackers to exploit loss-based model selection by mimicking honest model averages. To address these challenges, we propose screened, hop-aware, ranked, proximal averaging, a robust DFL framework (FedSharp). In this approach, each node maintains models from its 2b predecessors, ensuring at least b honest candidates when at most b nodes are Byzantine. FedSharp screens suspicious models using coordinate-wise median deviations, averages the b lowest-loss candidates to reduce fresh channel-noise variance by a factor of b, and applies noise-adaptive gradient-norm regularization and proximal training to mitigate accumulated noise and non-IID drift. Experiments on a 100-node ring with 33 Byzantine nodes show that FedSharp achieves 93.5-94.9% accuracy on MNIST, compared with 29.4-38.1% for a state-of-the-art single-model-selection benchmark, and 32.8-48.8% on CIFAR-10, compared with 10.0-30.5%, across Gaussian and hidden attacks under IID and non-IID data. On MNIST, FedSharp also achieves accuracy within approximately one percentage point of the benchmark operating without channel noise.

AI.tldr: 提出鲁棒去中心化联邦学习框架FedSharp，通过"筛选-跳数感知排序-近端平均"抵御数据异构、拜占庭攻击与信道噪声。
AI.motivation: DFL虽去掉了中心聚合服务器，但仍受数据异构、拜占庭攻击和信道噪声威胁；且噪声会随模型在节点间传播而累积，在学习率衰减时尤为严重，累积噪声还使攻击者可模仿诚实模型均值来利用"基于损失的模型选择"机制。
AI.method: 每个节点保留前2b个前驱节点的模型，保证至多b个拜占庭节点时仍有至少b个诚实候选；用逐坐标中位数偏差筛除可疑模型；对损失最低的b个候选取平均，将新信道噪声方差降低b倍；并采用噪声自适应梯度范数正则化与近端训练，缓解累积噪声与非IID漂移。
AI.result: 100节点环形、33个拜占庭节点下：MNIST准确率93.5–94.9%（SOTA单模型选择基准为29.4–38.1%）；CIFAR-10为32.8–48.8%（基准10.0–30.5%），覆盖高斯与隐藏攻击、IID与非IID数据；MNIST上较无信道噪声的基准差距约1个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: FedSharp通过同时处理筛选、噪声抑制与漂移校正，在强对抗和高噪声条件下显著优于现有单模型选择方法，并接近无噪声上界。

title: SurgTransfer: Multi-Step Latent Action Modeling for Action Transfer in Surgical World Model
summary: Surgical world models have the potential to provide intra-operative guidance, accelerate risk-free training and facilitate transfer of expert surgical maneuvers. However, the use of world models for transferring surgical expertise has been largely unexplored. Moreover, recent approaches in this domain have mainly relied on ground truth kinematics actions or expert annotations for specific tasks, limiting their applicability beyond the narrow range of tasks with ground-truth annotations. In contrast, existing works in the natural domain have shown promising results in learning latent actions solely from unlabeled videos and transferring the learned actions across contexts. We observe that this paradigm is short-sighted for the surgical domain, failing to capture the hierarchical and goal-directed structure of surgical procedures. Thus, we propose a novel multi-step action learning framework to learn context-invariant latent actions that are easily transferable across various surgical contexts. We perform extensive experiments on the publicly available datasets, SurgToolLoc-2022 and PitVis-2023, verifying our approach with both quantitative metrics and qualitative evaluation by surgical experts. We have published our code and the implementation details at https://github.com/bhattarailab/Surgical-Vision-World-Model.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出多步动作学习框架，从无标注视频中学习上下文不变的潜在动作，用于跨手术情境迁移手术专长，并在SurgToolLoc-2022和PitVis-2023上通过定量指标与外科专家定性评估验证。
AI.motivation: 手术世界模型有望提供术中指导、加速无风险训练并迁移专家手术操作，但相关探索不足；现有方法依赖真值运动学动作或特定任务的专家标注，泛化性受限；而自然领域已证明可从无标注视频学习潜在动作并跨上下文迁移，但直接照搬忽视了手术流程的层级化与目标导向结构。
AI.method: 提出一种多步动作学习框架，学习上下文不变的潜在动作，使其易于在多种手术情境间迁移；仅在无标注视频上训练，不依赖真值动作或专家任务标注。
AI.result: 在公开数据集SurgToolLoc-2022与PitVis-2023上进行大量实验，定量指标结果与外科专家定性评估均验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 面向手术领域应显式建模层级化、目标导向的过程结构，多步潜在动作学习可在无标注条件下实现跨情境的手术专长迁移；代码与实现细节已开源。

title: TACT: A Pragmatic Approach to Qualitative Analysis with an AI Council
summary: Qualitative data can tell software teams what their stakeholders need, yet rigorously analyzing thousands of qualitative responses takes expert time that few teams can afford or justify. Teams therefore often face a false choice: leave the responses unanalyzed, or hand them to a large language model and accept its interpretation and judgment. In this paper, we take a pragmatic approach to AI-assisted qualitative analysis and present TACT (Traceable AI Council for Thematic analysis), a procedure that enables such analysis at scale while keeping teams in control of interpretation and judgment. TACT comes in two variants: TACT-Lite, the core AI council procedure, and TACT-Full, which adds adversaries (models from other model families that critique each model's output) and a decision model that surfaces high-uncertainty code assignments. We evaluated TACT on an independent dataset of 256 Stack Overflow threads qualitatively coded by other researchers. Against their labels, TACT's candidate codebook achieved an F1 of 0.75-0.77 and its final coding an F1 of 0.71-0.72. On a held-out sample, agreement between our own manual coding and TACT's coding was Cohen's $κ$ of 0.79-0.85. TACT is also economical: model calls cost \$13.77 (TACT-Lite) to \$33.59 (TACT-Full) per 100 threads. Finally, drawing on our experience building and validating TACT, we identify pitfalls in AI-assisted qualitative analysis, describe safeguards to address them, and offer guidance for teams and researchers applying TACT in practice.

AI.tldr: 提出TACT（可追溯AI议事会）程序，用于大规模定性分析并保持团队对解释与判断的控制，含TACT-Lite与TACT-Full两变体。
AI.motivation: 定性数据能反映干系人需求，但严格分析数千条定性回复需专家大量时间，团队难以负担，于是常陷入"不分析"或"直接交给大模型、放弃解释权"的虚假两难。
AI.method: 采用务实方法设计TACT：核心为AI议事会程序（TACT-Lite）；TACT-Full额外加入"对手"模型（来自其他模型族、互相批判输出）以及决策模型，用于暴露高不确定性的编码分配。
AI.result: 在256条Stack Overflow帖子的独立数据集上，候选编码本F1为0.75–0.77，最终编码F1为0.71–0.72；留出样本上与人工编码的Cohen's κ为0.79–0.85；每100条帖子的模型调用成本为$13.77（Lite）至$33.59（Full）。
AI.conclusion: TACT可在大规模下实现可负担、可追溯的定性分析；作者还总结了AI辅助定性分析的陷阱、防护措施，并为团队与研究者提供实践建议。

title: On Competing Sellers with Substitutable Goods
summary: We study mechanism design by an incumbent seller facing competition from an entrant seller of a substitute good. The incumbent commits to a potentially randomized mechanism before her competitor responds. A unit-demand buyer with fixed, publicly known values for the two goods observes both mechanisms and may interact with them in either order. How should a revenue-maximizing incumbent design her mechanism when her product is superior or inferior to her competitor's? We determine the incumbent's exact optimal revenue and characterize all mechanisms that obtain it. Commitment and randomization allow her to earn strictly positive revenue even against an arbitrarily superior product, despite earning nothing under posted-price (i.e., Bertrand) competition. Optimal mechanisms can require a continuum of lottery options, even though the buyer selects only one in equilibrium: unselected options shape the competitor's incentives rather than screen private buyer information. We also show that the buyer's ability to choose the interaction order can be strictly beneficial to the incumbent, even though the incumbent is always visited first at equilibrium. Finally, we show that without commitment, every pure Nash equilibrium yields Bertrand revenues even with randomized mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 研究在位卖家面对替代品进入者竞争时的机制设计，刻画最优收入与全部最优机制。
AI.motivation: 在位者面临更优或更劣的竞争产品时，如何在竞争回应前通过承诺（可能随机化）的机制最大化收入，尤其是在完全无法从Bertrand竞争获利的情形。
AI.method: 建模为在位者先行承诺机制的博弈：单位需求买家价值公开固定，观察双方机制后可任选交互顺序；求解最优收入并刻画所有达到最优的机制，比较有无承诺情形。
AI.result: 给出在位者精确最优收入及所有最优机制；即使面对任意更优产品亦可获得严格正收入（优于Bertrand的零收入）；最优机制可能需连续统彩票选项，虽均衡中仅选一个，其作用在于塑造竞争者激励而非筛选私有信息；买家可自选交互顺序对在位者严格有利，尽管均衡中先访问在位者；无承诺时任意随机机制的纯Nash均衡都只给Bertrand收入。
AI.conclusion: 承诺与随机化是在竞争中获取正收入的关键，机制设计应针对竞争者的激励而非买家私人信息；卖家自选顺序也可能被利用来提升收入，但无承诺则退化为Bertrand结果。

title: Deliberate Latent Reasoning for Sequential Recommendation
summary: Sequential recommenders are widely applied in real-world scenarios to model user preferences and behavior patterns based on user interactions. Recent advances in sequential recommendation enhance transformer-based models with latent reasoning to refine user representations by autoregressively generating intermediate reasoning vectors. However, exploring the optimal reasoning depth for diverse user histories remains challenging: existing methods typically employ a fixed number of reasoning steps for all users. This ``one-size-fits-all'' strategy often leads to suboptimal representation learning due to over-thinking in simple histories or under-thinking in complex ones. To address this issue, we propose DESRec, a deliberate latent reasoning framework that performs personalized latent reasoning to learn more informative reasoning states and enhance user modeling for sequential recommendation. Specifically, it designs a reasoning step selection module that identifies the optimal reasoning step for each user sequence during the training phase. Through a self-distillation mechanism, it compresses this most informative state into the final reasoning step, which serves as the final user representation for item ranking during inference. Moreover, it introduces a progressive preference extraction mechanism for personalized reasoning, which dynamically segments a user's history into a variable number of periods and summarizes each into a latent milestone representing the user's preference for that period. It will be used as the input of the subsequent reasoning. The number of milestones varies with the users' history, enabling a personalized reasoning over users' evolving interests. Extensive experimental results on six public datasets and four backbone recommenders demonstrate the superiority of DESRec over eight baseline models.

AI.tldr: DESRec 提出一种个性化隐式推理框架，通过为每个用户自适应选择最优推理步数并用自蒸馏压缩到最终步，缓解序列推荐中"统一推理深度"导致的过思考/欠思考问题，在6个公开数据集、4种骨干、8个基线模型上均取得更优效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 Transformer 的序列推荐通过自回归生成中间推理向量来增强用户表示，但普遍对所有用户使用固定推理步数（one-size-fits-all）。简单历史会"过度思考"，复杂历史会"思考不足"，导致表示学习次优。
AI.method: DESRec 包含两个核心机制：(1) 推理步选择模块，在训练阶段为每条用户序列识别最优推理步，并通过自蒸馏把该最具信息量的状态压缩进最终推理步，作为推理阶段的用户表示用于物品排序；(2) 渐进式偏好抽取机制，将用户历史动态切分为可变数量的时段，每段总结为一个隐式 milestone 表示该阶段偏好，作为后续推理输入，milestone 数量随历史长度自适应，实现个性化推理。
AI.result: 在6个公开数据集、4个骨干推荐模型上，DESRec 相比8个基线模型均表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 个性化自适应推理深度是提升序列推荐用户建模的有效方向；DESRec 通过步数选择+自蒸馏+渐进偏好抽取，在保持推理阶段固定单步效率的同时获得个性化收益。

title: Rewrite, Then Veto: Rewriter-Agnostic Edit Gating for LLM-Based Post-OCR Correction
comment: 26 pages, 3 figures, 12 tables. Code: https://github.com/SniperJF/ocr-edit-gate-release; models: https://huggingface.co/SJF7
summary: LLMs can repair noisy OCR transcripts of historical documents, but they also change text that was already correct. We propose EditVeto, a veto gate placed after a full-context LLM rewrite. The rewrite is character-aligned to the OCR input, its differences are split into blocks, and a 0.6B-parameter gate keeps or reverts each block. An oracle analysis motivates the design: given the true error locations, per-span generation is worse than no correction, whereas vetoing a full rewrite's edits helps. Trained on rewrites by two Qwen3 models and evaluated, frozen, on the eight HIPE-OCRepair-2026 test sets, the gate improves all five rewriters tested, two of them unseen in training: weighted cMER falls by 0.0026-0.0044 and the preference score rises by 0.15-0.25 (paired bootstrap, p ~ 0.0002 each). On published competition outputs it lowers cMER for three of four teams but raises it for the winning run (0.0050 to 0.0065). In a second, disclosed test look, a retrained gate still improves LoRA-tuned rewriters (cMER -0.0011 to -0.0021), and an ensemble of their gated edits reaches a cMER of 0.0069 and a preference score of 0.928, mostly through fine-tuning and pooling rather than gating. Built only on public models and data, it is behind the winner (0.0050) and tied with the second-ranked run (0.0071), both from the only team using domain pre-training, and ahead of all other published runs. A third, secondary look shows the unchanged gate improving zero-shot Qwen3.8-27B (cMER 0.0114 to 0.0108) but only the preference score of its LoRA-tuned version.

AI.tldr: 提出EditVeto：在全上下文LLM改写后加一个0.6B参数"否决门"，按字符对齐把改写差异切成块，逐块决定保留或回退，可在不重训练的情况下提升多种OCR纠错模型。
AI.motivation: LLM能修复历史文档OCR噪声，但也会改动本来正确的文本。作者通过oracle分析发现：给定真实错误位置，按span生成反而不如不纠错；而对全上下文改写的编辑做否决则有效——因此应做"否决"而非"生成"。
AI.method: 先由全上下文LLM生成改写，与OCR输入做字符级对齐，将差异切分成块；用0.6B参数的门控模型对每块决定保留或回退。门控在两个Qwen3模型的改写数据上训练，在八个HIPE-OCRepair-2026测试集上冻结评估。
AI.result: 门控在5个重写器上均有提升（含2个训练时未见），加权cMER下降0.0026–0.0044，偏好分提升0.15–0.25（p≈0.0002）。在公开竞赛输出上，4支队伍中3队cMER改善，但冠军方案（0.0050）变差至0.0065。第二次披露测试中重训门控使LoRA重写器cMER降0.0011–0.0021，门控编辑集成达cMER 0.0069、偏好分0.928，但主要收益来自微调与集成而非门控。整体落后冠军（0.0050），与第二名（0.0071）持平，领先其余公开方案。第三次次要测试中，门控使zero-shot Qwen3.8-27B cMER由0.0114降至0.0108，但其LoRA版仅偏好分提升。
AI.conclusion: 否决式后处理是提升LLM OCR纠错的有效、可迁移手段，但增益有限，且对强基线（冠军方案、LoRA微调模型）效果不稳；总体竞争力不及使用领域预训练的顶尖方案。

title: MA-SafeDiffuser: Safe Multi-Agent Planning with Diffusion Probabilistic Models
comment: Accepted at AAMAS 2026. 14 pages, including supplementary material
summary: We propose MA-SafeDiffuser, a multi-agent extension of SafeDiffuser that equips diffusion-based trajectory planners with finite-time diffusion invariance guarantees for joint-agent safety specifications. Building on the single-agent construction that embeds control barrier function (CBF) constraints into reverse-diffusion updates, we: (i) formalize joint safe sets as intersections of per-agent and pairwise barrier sets; (ii) derive centralized and decentralized (communication-aware) constrained denoising procedures with provable invariance under mild assumptions; (iii) address local-trap and deadlock phenomena via time-varying specifications and liveness CBFs; and (iv) develop a lightweight benchmarking suite including a multi-agent Maze2D domain. Empirically, MA-SafeDiffuser reduces violation counts relative to unconstrained diffusion baselines, while retaining planning quality. We provide algorithms, proofs, and reference implementations.

AI.tldr: 提出 MA-SafeDiffuser，将 SafeDiffuser 扩展到多智能体场景，为扩散式轨迹规划器提供有限时间扩散不变性保证，覆盖联合智能体安全约束。
AI.motivation: 单智能体扩散规划已可用 CBF 嵌入反向扩散步骤实现安全性保证，但多智能体联合安全规范（各智能体及成对避碰）缺乏对应的扩散不变性理论，且存在局部陷阱与死锁问题。
AI.method: 将联合安全集刻画为各智能体安全集与成对屏障集的交集；推导集中式与去中心化（含通信约束）的受约束去噪过程并给出不变性证明；用时变安全规范与活性 CBF 缓解局部陷阱和死锁；构建含多智能体 Maze2D 的轻量基准套件。
AI.result: 相对无约束扩散基线显著减少违反次数，同时保持规划质量；论文提供算法、证明与参考实现。
AI.conclusion: 在多智能体轨迹生成中，将 CBF 约束注入扩散反向过程可同时获得经验安全性与有限时间理论保证，去中心化版本使该保证在通信受限场景下依然成立。

title: Support Vector Machines Directly Minimise KL Divergence
summary: Support vector machines (SVMs) are fundamentally grounded in geometric margin maximisation and currently lack a mainstream probabilistic interpretation. This keeps them theoretically isolated from probabilistic machine learning models that are naturally comparable and combinable. In this paper, we bridge this gap by proving that the dual objectives of both support vector classification and support vector regression are exact, constrained Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence minimisation tasks between two Gaussian measures. We further show that this same divergence formulation recovers the exact objective function for kernel ridge regression when domain constraints are removed and $L^2$ regularisation is applied. By demonstrating that SVM duals directly minimise relative entropy, our results provide a unified information-theoretic model for standard kernel machines and lay the foundation for unifying broader kernel-based algorithms under probability theory.

AI.tldr: 本文证明SVM（分类与回归）的对偶目标等价于两个高斯测度之间的受限KL散度最小化，从而为SVM提供概率/信息论解释。
AI.motivation: SVM基于几何间隔最大化，缺乏主流概率解释，使其与可比较、可组合的概率机器学习模型理论脱节。
AI.method: 证明支持向量分类与支持向量回归的对偶目标均为两个高斯测度间的精确、带约束KL散度最小化任务；并展示去除域约束并施加L2正则后，该散度表述可恢复核岭回归的精确目标函数。
AI.result: SVM对偶被证明直接最小化相对熵；同一散度框架统一给出SVM分类、SVR及核岭回归的目标函数。
AI.conclusion: 结果为标准核方法提供统一的信息论模型，并为在概率论框架下统一更广泛核算法奠定基础。

title: SO(3)-Equivariant Learning on CAD Boundary Representations
summary: Learning on boundary representations (B-reps) requires robustness to the pose of a part, since CAD models are not stored in a canonical orientation. Existing B-rep networks either operate on world-frame coordinates and normals, and thus degrade under rotation, or encode each face in a local reference frame. Local frames yield invariance, but reduce inter-face messages to scalars and discard the relative orientation of adjacent faces. We propose SO3brep, an SO(3)-equivariant graph neural network on the B-rep face-adjacency graph. Node features are computed in local frames and mapped into a shared frame by Wigner D-matrices. Clebsch-Gordan tensor products couple these features with the directions between adjacent faces, so that relative orientation is preserved throughout message passing and the output remains SE(3)-invariant. Across three face-segmentation and two classification benchmarks with randomly rotated test parts, SO3brep achieves the highest accuracy among the compared B-rep networks and equivariant point cloud networks, with the fewest parameters. Its advantage is largest with few labeled parts, a setting typical of industrial CAD. Code is available at https://github.com/UGent-CVAMO/so3brep.

AI.tldr: 提出 SO3brep，一种在 B-rep 面邻接图上的 SO(3)-等变图神经网络；通过 Wigner D 矩阵将局部帧特征映射到共享帧，并用 Clebsch-Gordan 张量积保持邻接面相对朝向，实现 SE(3) 不变输出。
AI.motivation: CAD 模型无规范朝向，需对位姿鲁棒。现有 B-rep 网络或在世界坐标下运算（旋转下退化），或仅用局部帧（虽获不变性但面间消息退化为标量、丢失相邻面相对朝向）。
AI.method: 构建 B-rep 面邻接图上的 SO(3)-等变 GNN：节点特征在局部帧计算，经 Wigner D 矩阵映射至共享帧；用 Clebsch-Gordan 张量积将特征与邻接面方向耦合，使相对朝向贯穿消息传递，输出 SE(3) 不变。
AI.result: 在 3 个面分割与 2 个分类基准（测试件随机旋转）上，于所比较的 B-rep 网络与等变点云网络中获得最高精度，且参数量最少；少标注数据时优势最明显。
AI.conclusion: SO3brep 兼顾旋转不变性与面间相对朝向建模，在旋转测试下优于同类方法且更轻量，适合工业 CAD 少样本场景。代码已开源。
