title: How Much Do Modern Embeddings Reveal? Inversion Attacks on Commercial Embedding Models
summary: Text embedding inversion reconstructs source text from fixed-dimensional vectors, posing a privacy risk to systems that store embeddings instead of raw text. We adapt the vec2text framework (Morris et al., 2023) to support text-embedding-3-small and mistral-embed alongside GTR-base. We evaluate 800 samples per category across general instructions, Wikipedia passages, paraphrased instructions, health-related instructions, and short literal code snippets, using a common 60-80-character range and paired original and paraphrased instructions. Under the evaluated vec2text configuration, text-embedding-3-small achieves the highest exact-match rate in all five categories, including 47.4% on health-related instructions and 24.5% on general instructions under the evaluation's case-insensitive, whitespace-stripped matching rule. BERTScore F1 exceeds 87 on the 0-100 scale for every prose category and embedder, indicating high contextual similarity to the references. Short code snippets yield lower reconstruction scores. These findings characterize one attack configuration and the selected datasets; they do not establish attack-independent rankings or sensitive-attribute recovery rates. They nevertheless motivate explicit assessment of inversion risk and access controls for stored embeddings.

AI.tldr: 该论文将 vec2text 文本嵌入反演框架扩展至 text-embedding-3-small 与 mistral-embed（并保留 GTR-base），在 800 样本×5 类（通用指令、维基百科段落、改写指令、健康相关指令、短代码片段）上评测。在给定配置下 text-embedding-3-small 五类精确匹配率最高（健康类 47.4%，通用指令 24.5%），各散文类 BERTScore F1 均超 87，短代码片段得分较低。作者强调结论仅限单一攻击配置与数据集，但足以支撑对存储嵌入的访问控制与反演风险评估。
AI.motivation: embedding 存储系统只保存固定维向量而丢弃原文，若向量可被反演还原文本，则构成隐私风险。现有 vec2text 主要针对 GTR-base，缺少对商用主流嵌入模型（如 text-embedding-3-small、mistral-embed）反演风险的系统对比。
AI.method: 将 vec2text 框架适配到 text-embedding-3-small 与 mistral-embed，并与 GTR-base 并列比较；每类 800 个样本，统一 60–80 字符长度区间，覆盖通用指令、维基百科段落、改写指令、健康相关指令、短代码片段五类，并配对原始/改写指令；采用忽略大小写与空白差异的精确匹配及 BERTScore F1 评估。
AI.result: text-embedding-3-small 在全部五类中取得最高精确匹配率：健康指令 47.4%、通用指令 24.5%；所有散文类与所有嵌入模型的 BERTScore F1 均高于 87（0–100 分），显示较高上下文相似度；短代码片段反演得分明显偏低。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画的是单一攻击配置与选定数据集下的表现，不能据此得出跨攻击稳健的模型排序或敏感属性恢复率；但已足以说明存储嵌入存在实质反演风险，应开展显式风险评估并施加访问控制。

title: Tight bounds for fractional and randomized truthful scheduling
summary: We resolve one of the longest-standing open problems in algorithmic mechanism design by showing that randomization cannot yield a sublinear approximation for truthful scheduling on unrelated machines, even when truthfulness is required only in expectation. Our main technical result concerns fractional scheduling, where tasks may be split among machines. We prove that every deterministic truthful fractional mechanism on $n$ unrelated machines has worst-case approximation ratio at least $(n+1)/2$, even against the optimal integral makespan. This matches the known upper bound exactly and settles the optimal approximation ratio of truthful fractional scheduling. Since the expected allocations and payments of a truthful-in-expectation mechanism define a truthful fractional mechanism, the same lower bound applies to all truthful-in-expectation mechanisms and, in particular, to all universally truthful mechanisms. On the positive side, we give a universally truthful mechanism with approximation ratio $n/2+o(n)$. Together, these results establish the optimal leading constant $1/2$ for randomized truthful scheduling. Thus, randomization improves on the optimal deterministic approximation ratio by an asymptotic factor of two, and no more.

AI.tldr: 本文否证了随机化能为无关机调度机制带来次线性近似：任何真值（含仅在期望意义下真值）机制的近似比下界为 (n+1)/2，且给出 n/2+o(n) 的通用真值机制，确定最优主常数 1/2。
AI.motivation: 算法机制设计中长期悬而未决的问题是：随机化能否在无关机调度中突破确定性真值机制的近似比下界，实现次线性近似。作者希望彻底厘清随机化带来的近似能力界限。
AI.method: 核心技术结果是分数调度的下界证明：证明任意 n 台无关机上的确定性真值分数机制，其最坏情况近似比至少为 (n+1)/2（即使与最优整数 makespan 比较）。由于真值在期望意义下机制的期望分配与支付构成真值分数机制，该下界可传递到所有通用真值及期望真值机制。上界方面构造了近似比为 n/2+o(n) 的通用真值机制。
AI.result: 分数真值调度的最优近似比被精确确定为 (n+1)/2，与已知上界吻合；所有期望真值（从而所有通用真值）机制近似比下界为 (n+1)/2；并给出 n/2+o(n) 的通用真值机制。
AI.conclusion: 随机化真值调度的最优主常数为 1/2；随机化相对确定性最优近似比仅有渐近因子 2 的改进，且不可能再多，从而解决了该长期开放问题。

title: WISE: An Agentic Framework for Whole-page Multimodal Search Experience Attribution
summary: Algorithm-driven services, including search, recommendation, and advertising, rely on multi-stage model pipelines. While research prioritizes model optimization, post-deployment monitoring focuses on operational reliability. Yet operationally healthy systems may still produce poor-quality results, exposing a gap in existing evaluation and monitoring practices. However, a systematic problem formulation and benchmark for this task remain lacking. To bridge this gap, we formulate System Quality Diagnosis (SQD) for algorithm-driven services, a new task that extends quality evaluation beyond identifying poor outcomes to attributing their causes across system components. Focusing on industrial search, we propose WISE, an agentic framework for end-to-end quality diagnosis that discovers user-facing issues and traces their origins to underlying algorithmic components. To improve diagnostic reliability, we introduce ReTrace for constructing evidence-consistent trajectory supervision and Adaptive Harness-Policy Optimization (AHPO) for failure-guided optimization of the agent harness and model policy. To enable systematic evaluation, we construct WISE-BENCH, a real-world multimodal search benchmark that combines user-facing evidence, internal pipeline traces, and expert diagnosis annotations. Extensive experiments show consistent gains across model scales, with WISE achieving 75.20% end-to-end accuracy on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. In production, WISE supports quality auditing, online quality assurance, and model optimization, reducing diagnosis costs and improving downstream relevance models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出新任务"系统质量诊断(SQD)",聚焦工业搜索场景,构建智能体框架WISE,自动发现用户侧问题并溯源至底层算法组件,同时发布WISE-BENCH基准。
AI.motivation: 搜索、推荐、广告等算法服务依赖多阶段模型流水线,研究多关注模型优化,上线后监控只关注运维可靠性;运维健康的系统仍可能产出低质量结果,现有评估与监控存在缺口,且缺乏系统性任务定义与基准。
AI.method: 形式化定义SQD任务(从识别坏结果扩展到归因系统组件);提出WISE智能体框架端到端诊断;引入ReTrace构建证据一致轨迹监督;提出AHPO基于失败引导优化agent harness与模型策略;构建WISE-BENCH多模态真实搜索基准(含用户侧证据、内部流水线轨迹、专家诊断标注)。
AI.result: 在多种模型规模上取得一致提升,Qwen3.5-35B-A3B上端到端准确率达75.20%;生产环境中支持质量审计、在线质量保障与模型优化,降低诊断成本并提升下游相关性模型效果。
AI.conclusion: WISE将质量诊断从"发现问题"推进到"归因溯源",兼具学术任务定义价值与工业落地价值,填补了算法服务部署后质量评估的空白。

title: RAGCompass: Generalizable Retriever Routing via Reranking
summary: Different retrievers exist for retrieval-augmented generation, yet none performs best for all queries. Therefore, the key question is: given a query and retrieved passages from different retrievers, which one is most suited for that query? Existing routers usually make predictions from query-specific features and a fixed pool of retrievers; such routers have no output for an unseen retriever and are incapable by design on a new corpus. To fill these gaps, RAGCompass reads the retrieved passage sets themselves: passages from an unfamiliar retriever or corpus stay directly comparable to other passages, so routing stays well designed where a query-only map would fail. We contrastively fine-tune a reranker against the answer each evidence set produces, which accounts for most of the gain; a small comparison head adds a moderate improvement, and neither component has retriever-specific parameters. RAGCompass improves answer F1 by 28% relative to the best fixed retriever, and outperforms fusion baselines, three query-only routers, and a prompted 8B language model. Generalization experiments show that RAGCompass keeps most of its gain under an unseen corpus, retriever, or reader, while query-only baselines fall to the best fixed retriever or below.

AI.tldr: RAGCompass 通过直接阅读检索到的段落集合来选择最合适的检索器，从而在未见语料/检索器上保持良好的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 没有单一检索器对所有查询都最优，需要按查询选择检索器。现有路由器依赖查询特征和固定检索器池，无法处理未见检索器或新语料。
AI.method: 读取检索段落集合本身（不同来源段落可直接比较）；用对比方式将重排器针对每个证据集产生的答案进行微调；另加一个小型比较头；无检索器专用参数。
AI.result: 相比最佳固定检索器，答案 F1 提升 28%（相对），优于融合基线、三个仅查询路由器及提示的 8B 语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 在未见语料、检索器或阅读器下仍保留大部分增益，而仅查询基线退化到最佳固定检索器或更差，证明了基于段落的路由设计的有效性。

title: Towards Efficient Whole Page Ranking with One-Pass Inference
summary:
Whole-page ranking jointly optimizes advertisements and organic content to balance business outcomes and user engagement under complex layout and business constraints. Existing non-autoregressive (NAR) approaches enable efficient page generation but typically score candidate items independently of previously selected items, limiting their ability to capture order-dependent interactions. Autoregressive (AR) methods address this limitation through sequential conditioning, but incur substantial inference overhead that challenges large-scale deployment. Bridging this quality-efficiency gap remains a challenge in industrial whole-page ranking.
  We propose Multi-Item Scoring (MIS), a prefix-aware NAR-style framework that incorporates sequential context into efficient multi-item scoring. MIS integrates global candidate interactions, localized prefix conditioning, and position-aware scoring within a shared representation architecture. By computing reusable representations once per request and performing lightweight prefix-conditioned scoring during constrained beam search, MIS captures important sequential dependencies without repeated full-model inference.
  Experiments on KuaiRand-1K and RL4RS demonstrate that MIS approaches the generation quality of an autoregressive CGA baseline while achieving 4.07x and 3.54x faster CPU decoding, respectively. In a randomized evaluation on a large-scale social-video platform, MIS improves the realization metric by 0.104% and watch time by 0.058%, while reducing ranking-service CPU consumption by 9.73%. These results demonstrate that prefix-aware multi-item scoring can narrow the quality gap between NAR and AR generation while retaining the efficiency required for industrial scalability.

AI.tldr: MIS：一种前缀感知的非自回归式多物品打分框架，在共享表示架构中融合全局候选交互、局部前缀条件与位置感知打分，以接近自回归的生成质量实现显著更快的解码与更低的工业CPU开销。
AI.motivation: 整页排序需在复杂布局与业务约束下平衡商业收益与用户参与。现有NAR方法高效但独立打分，无法建模物品间顺序依赖；AR方法虽能顺序条件化，但推理开销大，难以大规模部署。因此亟需弥合质量与效率的差距。
AI.method: 提出Multi-Item Scoring（MIS）：前缀感知的NAR风格框架，集成全局候选交互、局部前缀条件与位置感知打分，采用共享表示架构；每请求仅计算一次可复用表示，并在受约束束搜索中进行轻量级前缀条件打分，避免重复全模型推理。
AI.result: KuaiRand-1K与RL4RS上接近AR基线CGA的生成质量，CPU解码分别快4.07x与3.54x；某大型社交视频平台随机评测中实现指标提升0.104%、观看时长提升0.058%，排序服务CPU消耗降低9.73%。
AI.conclusion: 前缀感知的多物品打分可在保持工业级可扩展性所需效率的同时，缩小NAR与AR生成之间的质量差距。

title: Readable Is Not Steerable: Pre-Registered Tests of Physical Structure in Learned Fluid Representations
comment: 30 pages, 9 figures. Code, pre-registrations and checkpoints: https://github.com/2025eb1100268-tech/readable-not-steerable
summary: Self-supervised world models are often said to organize their latents around physical quantities. We test this on 2D decaying Navier-Stokes flow in three pre-registered studies, each tested once on held-out data. In Study 1, a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) trained to predict the flow fails the pre-registered criteria for organizing its latent around fluid quantities better than an untrained network of the same architecture (not supported); a JEPA trained on non-physical linear dynamics and a static invariance model that never sees time do as well or better. In Study 2, plain autoencoders that render the field make enstrophy prominent in their slowest unsupervised latent directions (best r 0.80-0.86 vs 0.38 untrained; fresh seeds, sealed data). Adding VICReg lowers this prominence in every comparison, though not by the pre-registered margin for vorticity, while raising the autoencoders' linear decodability (partially supported). In Study 3, we build steerable directions ("dials") by routing: the decoder gets overall scale only through a small conditioning code, while its other pathway carries a degraded copy of spectral shape. Label-free rules find a loudness dial in all 8 trained models and a shape dial in 3 of 5 fresh seeds on sealed data, against a pre-registered bar of 4; neither control shows a shape dial (partially supported). Across the studies, what a latent contains and what can be controlled through it come apart. In exploration, a supervised direction reading spectral shape almost perfectly moved nothing when steered. During the build, the loudness dial had to be found by its effect on the output (closest to a pure rescaling), not by data variance; for shape, a variance rule and an effect-constrained rule each worked in 3 of 5 seeds. The program used about 70 logged hours on one consumer GPU; all pre-registrations, deviations, code and outputs are public.

AI.tldr: 通过在2D衰减Navier-Stokes流上开展三项预注册的"仅测一次"研究，作者检验自监督世界模型的潜空间是否真的围绕物理量组织，并发现"潜空间包含什么"与"能否通过它进行控制"是两回事。
AI.motivation: 自监督世界模型常被宣称其潜表征围绕物理量(如流体量)自发组织。论文旨在用严格的预注册实验检验这一说法，并区分潜空间"内容"与潜空间"可控性"。
AI.method: 在2D衰减Navier-Stokes流上做三项预注册研究：研究1比较JEPA、非物理线性动力学训练的JEPA、静态不变模型与未训练网络在潜空间围绕流体量的组织性；研究2考察普通自编码器(及加VICReg)的最慢无监督潜方向对enstrophy/涡量的突出程度与线性可解码性；研究3通过"路由"构建可操控的"旋钮"方向(尺度条件码+退化谱形状路径)，用无标签规则寻找响度旋钮与形状旋钮，并设对照组。
AI.result: 研究1：JEPA未达预注册标准，非物理动力学JEPA和静态模型同样或更好(不支持)。研究2：自编码器最慢方向中enstrophy突出(r 0.80–0.86 vs 未训练0.38；新种子、封存数据)；加VICReg在每个比较中都降低该突出度(但涡量未达预注册幅度)，同时提高线性可解码性(部分支持)。研究3：8个模型均找到响度旋钮，5个新种子中3个找到形状旋钮(预注册门槛为4)，两对照组均无形状旋钮(部分支持)。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间所包含的内容与其可控性可以分离(解耦)：内容显著存在并不意味着可被有效操控。探索中发现监督谱形状方向几乎无法操控输出；构建期须以输出效应而非数据方差来寻找响度旋钮。整套实验约在单块消费级GPU上耗时约70小时，所有预注册、偏差、代码与输出均已公开。

title: From Tokens to Trajectories: Parameter-Efficient Continuous Adaptation of Unified Multimodal Models
summary: While discrete tokenization in Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) establishes strong semantic reasoning, it introduces a strict quantization bottleneck that degrades fine-grained visual details, often resulting in structurally accurate but artifact-heavy images. We introduce FlowShift, a parameter-efficient post-training framework that bypasses this bottleneck by converting pre-trained discrete UMMs into continuous rectified-flow generators. Instead of discarding the backbone's semantic priors, FlowShift replaces discrete visual interfaces with continuous latent projections and applies LoRA to the attention layers. To efficiently boost visual quality without semantic drift, we propose Dual-Objective Velocity Vector Distillation (DOVD), which aligns the model with a high-fidelity continuous teacher and ground-truth continuous trajectories. This approach drastically improves perceptual quality while preserving prompt adherence and reasoning. When applied to leading discrete UMMs, FlowShift significantly improves COCO-30K FID and aesthetic scores, while retaining over 99.5% of multimodal understanding capabilities. Ablations confirm DOVD drives generation quality. Ultimately, FlowShift achieves high-fidelity continuous generation without sacrificing pre-trained semantic grounding.

AI.tldr: FlowShift 是一个参数高效的后训练框架，将预训练离散 UMM 转为连续 rectified-flow 生成器，绕过量化瓶颈，在几乎不损失多模态理解能力的前提下大幅提升生成保真度。
AI.motivation: 离散 tokenization 虽带来强语义推理，但引入严格的量化瓶颈，损害细粒度视觉细节，导致图像结构正确却伪影严重。作者希望在不丢弃骨干语义先验的情况下突破该瓶颈。
AI.method: 将离散视觉接口替换为连续潜变量投影，并对注意力层施加 LoRA；提出 Dual-Objective Velocity Vector Distillation (DOVD)，同时对齐高保真连续教师模型与真实连续轨迹，实现无语义漂移的高效质量提升。
AI.result: 应用于主流离散 UMM 后，COCO-30K FID 与美学分数显著提升，同时保留超过 99.5% 的多模态理解能力；消融实验证实 DOVD 是生成质量提升的关键驱动。
AI.conclusion: FlowShift 实现了高保真连续生成而不牺牲预训练语义 grounding，为离散 UMM 的低成本升级提供了有效路径。

title: DARE: Difficulty Analysis for Repair Enhancement
summary: LLM-based coding agents are primarily evaluated by their solve rates. However, this metric does not reveal how difficult the solved tasks are or account for differences intask difficulty across benchmarks. Determining the difficulty of individual tasks by repeatedly running multiple agents is costly, while a predicted difficulty score alone provides limited guidance on what support an agent needs. To address these challenges, we propose DARE (Difficulty Analysis for Repair Enhancement), which integrates repair-task difficulty measurement, prediction, feature-group contribution analysis, and task-specific repair support. We define continuous task difficulty as the observed failure rate across multiple coding agents. The DARE difficulty model predicts this difficulty using 151 static features extracted from benchmark artifacts. The framework also analyzes the contributions of seven Repair-Task Feature Groups to identify the characteristics most salient to each task and uses this information to select task-specific agent support. We evaluate DARE on four benchmark partitions comprising 2,594 tasks. The difficulty model's aligned predictions achieve Spearman's $ρ$ = .476-.621 on held-out partitions, and the most salient Feature Groups vary across tasks and benchmarks. Furthermore, coding-agent experiments show improved repair success when support is matched to each task's salient Feature Group. These findings demonstrate that difficulty prediction and interpretation can lead to practical improvements in automated program repair (APR), while also providing a basis for difficulty-stratified agent evaluation, cross-benchmark comparisons, and identifying areas of repair capability that warrant further improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出 DARE 框架，通过静态特征预测编码 agent 的修复任务难度，并据显著特征组为任务匹配修复支持，从而提升自动程序修复成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 编码 agent 主要用解题率评估，但无法反映所解任务的难度差异，也难以跨基准比较；逐一多次运行多 agent 测难度成本高，仅预测难度分数对"如何提供支持"指导有限。
AI.method: 将难度定义为多个编码 agent 上的观测失败率；用从基准工件提取的 151 个静态特征训练难度预测模型；分析七个修复任务特征组（Repair-Task Feature Groups）的贡献，定位每个任务最显著的特征，并据此选择任务特定的 agent 支持。在四个含 2,594 个任务的基准划分上评估。
AI.result: 难度模型对齐预测在留出划分上 Spearman ρ = .476–.621；最显著特征组随任务与基准变化；将支持与任务显著特征组匹配后，agent 修复成功率提升。
AI.conclusion: 难度预测与可解释性分析可带来自动程序修复的实际收益，并为难度分层评估、跨基准比较以及识别待改进的修复能力提供基础。

title: Stability and Perfection in Constrained Weighted Network Games
summary: We introduce a general framework of constrained weighted network formation in which agents allocate resources across coalitional interactions while facing feasibility constraints. More precisely, we allow arbitrary coalitions of agents to be assigned a continuous weight, and we incorporate both coalitional capacity constraints and individual budget constraints into the model. This framework extends the weighted network formation model of Bich and Morhaim by combining continuous interaction intensities with endogenous feasibility restrictions. Within this setting, we introduce a new notion of stability -- called coalitionwise stability -- extending pairwise stability to constrained network games. Under standard continuity and componentwise quasiconcavity assumptions on payoff functions, we establish the existence of coalitionwise stable networks. We then investigate refinements of stability inspired by the notion of perfect equilibrium introduced by Selten, and by the notion of perfect pairwise stability developed by Bich and Teteryatnikova for network games. The presence of feasibility constraints fundamentally alters the geometry of the feasible set, which no longer possesses a product structure. As a consequence, trembling-hand type refinements become substantially more delicate, since perturbations of some interactions may render other interactions infeasible. Nevertheless, we introduce constrained analogues of both the trembling-hand and perturbative notions of perfect stability considered by Bich and Teteryatnikova, and study their existence and their relationship. In particular, we show the equivalence between these trembling-hand and perturbative formulations under some componentwise monotonicity assumption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出带约束的加权网络形成框架，允许任意联盟被赋予连续权重，并同时纳入联盟容量约束与个体预算约束，扩展了Bich-Morhaim的加权网络模型。作者提出"联盟式稳定性"（coalitionwise stability）概念并证明其存在性，进而研究了颤抖手型与扰动型完美稳定性的约束版本及其关系。
AI.motivation: 既有加权网络形成模型（如Bich和Morhaim）允许连续互动强度，但缺乏对可行性约束的刻画；而现实中的联盟互动往往同时受联盟容量与个体预算限制。将连续互动强度与内生可行性约束结合，需要新的稳定性概念与存在性理论。
AI.method: 构建一般化约束加权网络形成框架：任意联盟可被赋予连续权重，同时施加联盟容量约束和个体预算约束。定义"联盟式稳定性"，将成对稳定性推广到约束网络博弈。在收益函数满足标准连续性与分量拟凹性假设下证明联盟式稳定网络的存在性；并构造颤抖手完美稳定性与扰动完美稳定性的约束类比，研究其存在性及相互关系。
AI.result: 在连续性和分量拟凹性假设下证明了联盟式稳定网络的存在。指出可行性约束使可行集失去乘积结构，从而使颤抖手型精炼变得显著更微妙——对某些互动的扰动可能使其他互动不可行。仍成功构造了两类完美稳定性的约束版本，并在分量单调性假设下证明了颤抖手型与扰动型表述的等价性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将加权网络形成与内生可行性约束统一起来，拓展了网络博弈稳定性理论。核心洞见在于：可行性约束破坏可行集的乘积结构，使完美均衡类精炼需谨慎处理；但在适当单调性条件下，颤抖手型与扰动型完美稳定性仍可等价刻画。

title: Contextual Pictograms for Repairing Multilingual ASR Errors
summary: Speech transcription errors can be difficult to recognize when competing word hypotheses are unfamiliar or visually similar. We describe an interface that combines alternative transcripts, replay and contextually checked pictograms for selected uncertain concepts. The system will initially support French and Spanish functional utterances. A counterbalanced study will assess whether pictorial feedback helps listeners recover the speaker's intended action beyond text alternatives alone. We will also quantify semantic mismatch and additional interaction time, since an inappropriate image can reinforce the wrong interpretation rather than repair it.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种语音转录纠错界面，将备选转录文本、回放功能与针对不确定概念经语境核验的象形图结合，支持法语和西班牙语的功能性话语，并通过平衡实验评估图像反馈是否有助于听者恢复说话者意图。
AI.motivation: 语音转录错误在竞争性词假设不熟悉或视觉相似时难以被识别；仅靠文本备选项可能不足以帮助听者判断说话者的真实意图。
AI.method: 设计一个界面，融合备选转录、音频回放以及为选定不确定概念提供的、经上下文核验的象形图（pictograms）；初期支持法语与西班牙语的功能性话语。计划开展平衡（counterbalanced）用户研究，比较有无图像反馈时听者的纠错表现，并测量语义不匹配程度与额外交互时间。
AI.result: 文中为研究计划，尚未报告实验结果；预期评估图像反馈相较纯文本备选能否更好地帮助听者恢复说话者意图，同时考察不当图像强化错误理解的风险。
AI.conclusion: 视觉化线索有望辅助语音转录纠错，但需权衡误配风险与交互成本，需通过实验验证其实际增益。

title: Iterated creation, grading, and revision of data science projects by language models
summary: We evaluate the extent to which agentic AI models can complete an end-to-end data science project, and how this improves with feedback. A 'writer' model with specific tools creates a complete data science project including downloading, cleaning, and analyzing a dataset, and writing a short paper about it. The project is executed and a 'grader' model evaluates it. The writer can then revise its submission, and this repeats for a total of three rounds. We consider seven models from five developers: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, and Z.AI. Each model is both a writer and a grader, so there are 49 writer-grader pairs and we run each pair three times. Of the 147 initial submissions, 107 run and render, and the average score increases from 59 per cent to 76 per cent after the final round of feedback. By writer the extent of the increase ranges from 3 percentage points for Anthropic's Opus 5.5 to 46 percentage points for Anthropic's Haiku 4.5, and by grader it ranges from 13 percentage points for Google's Gemini 3.8 Flash to 32 percentage points for Anthropic's Haiku 4.5. When a model grades its own writing the score tends to be about 9 percentage points higher than the average of what the other models give it. About half of the difference that we see from round to round is within the grader's own noise. Feedback generally results in the highest marks, but even just having the chance to revise, or having the additional budget, in terms of time or tool calls, without any feedback, results in considerable increases for some of the models but not for others. We find that how much such a loop helps depends on which model plays which role, but weaker models generally do not improve stronger models.

AI.tldr: 论文评估了agentic AI模型端到端完成数据科学项目的能力，以及迭代反馈对表现的提升。7个模型（5家厂商）互为writer和grader，49个配对×3次共147份初稿，平均分从59%升至第三轮反馈后的76%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多为单步任务或零散能力评测，缺乏对"完整数据科学项目全流程"（下载、清洗、分析、撰写论文）的端到端考察，也缺少对反馈循环中writer/grader角色交互效应的系统度量。
AI.method: 构建writer–grader闭环：writer模型使用特定工具完成一个完整数据科学项目并撰写短论文，项目被执行与渲染，grader模型评分；随后writer修订，共三轮。选用Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、DeepSeek、Z.AI的7个模型，每个模型兼作writer与grader，构成49个配对，每对运行3次（共147份初始提交）。并对比"仅可修订"、"仅增加预算（时间/工具调用）"与"有反馈"三种条件。
AI.result: 147份初始提交中107份可运行并渲染成功；平均分从59%提升至最终轮的76%。按writer看提升幅度从3个百分点（Anthropic Opus 5.5）到46个百分点（Anthropic Haiku 4.5）；按grader看从13个百分点（Google Gemini 3.8 Flash）到32个百分点（Anthropic Haiku 4.5）。模型自评时分数平均高出他评约9个百分点；轮次间差异约一半来自grader自身噪声。反馈条件得分最高，但仅提供修订机会或增加时间/工具预算，对部分模型也有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 闭环反馈能显著提升agentic AI完成数据科学项目的质量，但提升幅度高度依赖writer与grader的角色搭配；弱模型通常无法改进强模型；自评偏高与grader噪声意味着此类评测结果需谨慎解读。整体表明迭代反馈有效，但"谁来评"与"谁来写"共同决定了系统的真实能力上限。

title: Exploring the Privacy--Size Tradeoff for Differentially Private Self-Attentive Variational Autoencoders
comment: ICAIF 2026, Financial AI Security, Privacy and Safety workshop. Poster session
summary: Data tends to be most useful when it is shared, and the data most worth sharing is often the data that privacy obligations restrict. Synthetic data from a generator trained under differential privacy (DP) is one way to reconcile the two, but its utility depends on the privacy budget $\varepsilon$ and on how much data the generator sees - a parameter that most data sharing applications of synthetic data control. We present SAVANT, a self-attentive variational autoencoder for tabular data trained with DP-SGD that, to our knowledge, is the first to combine attention, a VAE, and DP in one tabular model. We evaluate it against two marginal mechanisms, PrivBayes and MST, jointly over the privacy budget and the dataset size on two public datasets, measuring the utility a downstream classifier loses by training on synthetic rather than real data. We find that, under the same DP guarantee, more data generally means more utility. For the marginal mechanisms it absorbs most of what a strict budget costs, and a noise-scaling argument suggests DP-SGD exchanges data fo budget at a worse rate. Two independent membership-inference attacks, judged against a measured null, found no aggregate membership signal.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SAVANT——首个将注意力机制、VAE 与差分隐私 (DP) 结合的表数据生成模型，并在隐私预算与数据规模两个维度上与 PrivBayes、MST 进行系统比较。
AI.motivation: 数据共享价值高，但受隐私约束的限制。差分隐私合成数据可调和二者矛盾，但其效用同时取决于隐私预算 ε 和生成器可见的数据量，而多数数据共享应用会控制后者，这一交互此前缺乏联合评估。
AI.method: 构建自注意力变分自编码器 SAVANT（表数据），用 DP-SGD 训练；在两个公开数据集上，与两种边际机制 PrivBayes、MST 在隐私预算 × 数据集规模的联合网格上对比；指标为下游分类器因使用合成而非真实数据而损失的效用；并开展两个独立的成员推断攻击（以实测零假设为基准）检验隐私泄漏。
AI.result: 相同 DP 保证下，数据越多效用普遍越高；对边际机制而言，数据量增加可吸收大部分严格预算带来的效用损失；噪声缩放论证表明 DP-SGD 以数据换预算的兑换率更差；两个成员推断攻击均未发现总体成员信号。
AI.conclusion: 数据规模是合成数据效用与隐私权衡中的关键但常被低估的变量；DP-SGD 类深度生成器在隐私-效用兑换上未必优于边际机制，但未检测到可测的成员泄漏。

title: From Activation to Intervention: Interpreting Sparse Visual Features through Reconstruction
comment: Demo and code available at https://imageomics.github.io/RecSAEI
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose visual representations into individual features, offering a promising basis for explaining model behavior. Interpreting these features typically relies on images or pixel regions that most strongly activate them. However, this evidence becomes ambiguous when multiple features with different semantics frequently activate in the same locations, such as texture and color in the same patterns. We propose Reconstructive SAE Intervention (RecSAEI), a framework that shifts feature explanation from passive observation to active visual reconstruction. By intervening on representations along SAE decoder directions and reconstructing the visual output, we provide direct evidence of a feature's semantic meaning. We demonstrate that our method successfully disambiguates feature meanings across multiple datasets and vision encoders. Furthermore, our framework grounds [CLS] SAE interventions in a sparse set of patch SAE decoder directions. Beyond stable target response, this attribution also exposes the compositional relationship between elementary visual patterns and high-level semantics. Our results advocate for intervention reconstruction as an essential complementary signal for explaining neural networks.

AI.tldr: 提出RecSAEI框架，通过干预SAE解码方向并重构视觉输出，为特征语义提供直接证据，可消解位置重叠特征的歧义。
AI.motivation: SAE将视觉表示分解为单个特征，但传统解释依赖强激活的图像或像素区域；当多个不同语义的特征（如纹理与颜色）在同一位置频繁激活时，这种证据存在歧义。
AI.method: RecSAEI将特征解释从被动观察转为主动视觉重构：沿SAE解码器方向干预表示并重构视觉输出，以获得特征的语义证据；同时用稀疏的patch SAE解码方向为[CLS] SAE干预提供依据。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和视觉编码器上成功消解特征含义歧义；[CLS]干预可归因到稀疏patch解码方向，在稳定目标响应的同时揭示基本视觉模式与高层语义的组合关系。
AI.conclusion: 干预重构应作为解释神经网络的重要补充信号。

title: Can LLM Agents Learn to Test? Maintaining Scoped Experience as Testing Evidence for Mobile GUI Testing
summary: Repeated mobile GUI tests can reuse routes, locators, and recovery strategies from earlier executions. However, a route that worked in one workflow or app version may be irrelevant or misleading in another. We study how an LLM-based tester can retain useful experience while withholding entries contradicted by current observations. We present a maintenance contract for AdaptiTest in which reusable experience has an explicit applicability scope, trace provenance, and a lifecycle for confirmation, revalidation, and withdrawal. The contract reserves persistence for a Reflector role and treats recalled experience as advice. The archived implementation does not establish end-to-end enforcement of every specified mechanism. The design changes retrieved context, not model weights. The evaluation uses read-only Android workflows and archived internal comparisons. A six-task, three-repeat ready subset reports 18/18 completed runs with memory versus 3/18 without it, but a grounded single-agent control also solves the earlier hard-task slice. A separate cross-session probe is excluded from efficacy conclusions because of confounded route schedules and unvalidated state labels. We examine 13 selected real-update hazard records across nine subjects, distinguishing stale-locator observations from policy-based withholding and offline retrieval diagnostics. The latter do not measure live-device failures or actions saved. These events are UI changes, not confirmed regression bugs. The evidence supports a bounded design and case study; it does not establish general efficacy, superiority over independent GUI-agent systems, or unrestricted exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AdaptiTest 的“维护契约”（maintenance contract），为可复用经验赋予显式适用范围、来源追踪与确认/再验证/撤回的生命周期，让 LLM 测试智能体保留有用经验、抑制与当前观察相矛盾的经验。
AI.motivation: 移动端 GUI 测试的路线、定位器与恢复策略可跨执行复用，但旧经验在新工作流或新版本中可能无关甚至误导；需解决如何在保留经验的同时避免被过时条目污染。
AI.method: 设计维护契约：经验带适用域（applicability scope）、溯源（provenance）与生命周期（确认、再验证、撤回）；持久化仅由 Reflector 角色执行，召回经验只作“建议”而非事实；只改变检索上下文，不调整模型权重。
AI.result: 六任务三次重复的后端子集：有记忆 18/18 完成，无记忆 3/18，但单智能体对照也能解决早期“困难任务”切片；跨会话探针因路线调度混杂与状态标签未验证被排除。另分析 9 个被试中 13 条真实更新风险记录，区分过时定位器观察、策略性保留与离线检索诊断；后者无法衡量真机失败或节省动作，且属 UI 变更非确认的回归缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 证据仅支持“有界设计 + 案例研究”，不能证明普遍有效性、优于独立 GUI 智能体系统或支持无限制探索；归档实现亦未端到端强制执行全部机制。

title: Cognitive Bias Signatures in Search-Equipped LLM Agents: A Stage-Resolved Analysis
summary: Search can help LLM agents correct mistakes, but their starting conditions may shape which evidence they find and use. Drawing on cognitive-bias paradigms, we develop a controlled search harness to examine result order, records of prior work, and initial hypotheses while holding each question and document collection fixed. Matched controls distinguish order effects from differences in document composition and the effects of failed work from context length. Across 10 models and 1,000 synthetic search worlds, we track queries, retrieved documents, document openings, and final answers. Our comparisons suggest that final answers are more sensitive to initial evidence order during active search than when all evidence is supplied in full. Dead-end histories can reduce strategy switching relative to matched neutral histories, indicating an effect beyond context length. Under wrong hypotheses, stage measurements distinguish reduced retrieval or opening from errors that persist after counter-evidence is opened. Exploratory interventions show that opening counter-evidence more often can coincide with lower accuracy, while accuracy can improve with little change in opening.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建受控搜索实验框架，借鉴认知偏差范式，在10个模型、1000个合成搜索世界中考察结果顺序、历史失败记录与初始假设如何塑造LLM智能体的检索与最终答案。
AI.motivation: 搜索能帮助LLM智能体纠错，但其起始条件可能决定它们找到并使用哪些证据。作者想厘清顺序效应、失败历史与初始假设各自的作用，并排除文档构成与上下文长度等混杂因素。
AI.method: 构建受控搜索 harness，固定问题与文档集合，仅操纵结果顺序、既往工作记录和初始假设；用配对控制区分顺序效应与文档组成差异、失败历史效应与上下文长度；追踪查询、检索文档、文档打开情况和最终答案，并进行分阶段测量与探索性干预。
AI.result: 主动搜索时最终答案对初始证据顺序比一次性提供全部证据更敏感；死胡同历史相比匹配的中性历史会降低策略切换，超出上下文长度效应；错误假设下，分阶段测量可区分检索/打开不足与打开反证后仍持续的错误；打开更多反证有时伴随准确率下降，而准确率也可在打开行为几乎不变时提升。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体的搜索行为受起始条件系统性影响，呈现类似认知偏差的模式；仅增加反证暴露并不必然提升正确性，需从检索、打开与信念更新多阶段诊断。

title: Whose Transparency is it Anyway? Understanding Generative AI Transparency Needs and Gaps Across Stakeholders
summary: Transparency has become a central principle in AI governance, yet there is little agreement about what transparency means, for whom, and in what contexts. Drawing on interpretive flexibility within the Social Construction of Technology, this paper examines how different stakeholders understand and experience transparency in generative AI. This study draws from a global survey of 400 end-users, AI builders, and policymakers, complemented by a structured focus group with end-users, grounding the quantitative findings in qualitative insights from the group most underserved by current transparency practice. We present three key findings. First, all three groups share similar understandings of what transparency means and what it should afford, centered on ensuring accuracy and privacy. Second, gaps between the importance of transparency features and their perceived availability are substantially larger for end-users than builders, revealing how power shapes what gets built and who it serves. Only 28% of end-users report that current transparency practices reflect their needs very well, compared to 53% of builders and 49% of policymakers. Third, transparency is situationally constructed, priorities shift with context and task structure, with role-specific frames activating when context demands them and receding when it does not. We argue that meaningful AI transparency requires moving beyond a one-size-fits-all solution, including current emphases on AI disclosure and static documentation, toward pluralistic transparency infrastructures that reflect the needs of diverse users and stakeholders.

AI.tldr: 该文基于社会建构技术的解释灵活性理论，通过全球400名终端用户、AI构建者与政策制定者的调查及终端用户焦点小组，揭示生成式AI透明度理解的三点发现：三群体对透明度含义理解趋同；用户对透明度特征的"重要性—可用性"差距远大于构建者；透明度随情境而建构，需从"一刀切"转向多元透明度基础设施。
AI.motivation: 透明度已成为AI治理的核心原则，但对其内涵、服务对象及适用情境缺乏共识。既有实践（如AI披露、静态文档）多采用"一刀切"方案，可能无法反映多元利益相关者尤其是终端用户的真实需求。
AI.method: 以社会建构技术（SCOT）中的"解释灵活性"为理论框架，开展全球调查（400名终端用户、AI构建者、政策制定者），并辅以终端用户结构化焦点小组，将量化发现扎根于最缺乏服务的群体之定性洞察。
AI.result: 发现一：三群体对透明度含义及应提供之保障理解相似，核心聚焦准确性与隐私。发现二：用户对透明度特征"重要性—可用性"差距显著大于构建者，反映权力对"建什么、为谁建"的塑造；仅28%用户认为现行做法很好满足其需求，构建者53%、政策者49%。发现三：透明度是情境性建构，优先级随情境与任务结构转变，角色特定框架随情境需求激活或消退。
AI.conclusion: 有意义的AI透明度需超越"一刀切"方案（包括当前对AI披露与静态文档的强调），转向能反映多元用户与利益相关者需求的"多元透明度基础设施"。

title: C-GRPO: Conformal Group Relative Policy Optimization
summary: Reasoning-oriented language model training increasingly relies on multiple on-policy rollouts, but standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) uses a fixed group size, wasting compute on easy prompts and under-exploring hard ones. Existing adaptive-budget methods alleviate this inefficiency, yet their stopping rules are heuristic and do not provide a finite-sample calibration guarantee. We propose CGRPO, which replaces the fixed rollout budget of standard GPRO with calibrated conformal thresholds over task-specific nonconformity scores, combining Adaptive Prediction Set (APS)-style calibration for closed-form reasoning, a first-success score for execution-based code, automatic miscoverage selection, and periodic re-calibration. We prove finite-sample coverage for the resulting stopping rule and show that, under monotone policy improvement, recalibration induces a non-increasing expected training budget. Across six benchmarks spanning mathematics, graduate-level science, and code generation, CGRPO reduces mean training rollouts by 49-70% relative to fixed-budget GRPO while retaining strong fixed-budget accuracy, achieves the strongest pass@1 among evaluated static and dynamic baselines on different datasets, and transfers across model families with up to 82% rollout savings.

AI.tldr: CGRPO 用保形预测（conformal）校准阈值替代 GRPO 的固定 rollout 预算，为自适应停止规则提供有限样本覆盖保证，可减少 49–70% 训练 rollout。
AI.motivation: GRPO 使用固定 group size 的多次 on-policy rollout，在简单题上浪费算力、在难题上探索不足；现有自适应预算方法虽有缓解，但停止规则是启发式的，缺少有限样本校准保证。
AI.method: 提出 CGRPO：对任务特定的 nonconformity score 施加校准后的 conformal 阈值来决定停止（替代固定预算）。包括面向闭式推理的 APS 式校准、面向执行型代码的 first-success 分数、自动 miscoverage 选择以及周期性重校准。
AI.result: 理论上证明停止规则的有限样本覆盖性，并证明在策略单调改进下重校准带来期望训练预算非增。在数学、研究生科学、代码生成的六个基准上，相比固定预算 GRPO 减少 49–70% 平均 rollout 且保持强准确率，在静态与动态基线中 pass@1 最强，并跨模型族迁移，节省最高达 82%。
AI.conclusion: 将 conformal 校准引入 rollout 预算控制，为自适应思考预算提供了可证明的统计保证，并显著提升训练效率与可迁移性。

title: How Finely Can Vision-Language Models See Biology? Bio-VQA: A Benchmark for Taxonomic, Morphological, Spatial and Individual Reasoning
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027, 8 pages main paper; 4 figures, 4 tables
summary: In biodiversity monitoring, a single image raises several questions: which taxon, how many, which trait, and whether the individual has been seen before. Vision-language models (VLMs) could answer all of these from the image, but their ability is largely untested in biology, as existing benchmarks focus mostly on species identification within a few taxonomic groups. We present Bio-VQA, the largest biological visual question answering (VQA) benchmark and the only one to span four aspects of biological visual understanding: hierarchical taxonomic reasoning, fine-grained attribute grounding, quantitative spatial reasoning, and individual re-identification. Bio-VQA contains 1.86M questions over 217K images from 11 public datasets, and extends right-or-wrong scoring to graded scoring, so a near-miss counts for more than a distant one. Evaluating 18 open-weight models from 3.75B to 38.4B parameters, we find that general visual capabilities do not transfer to biological organisms: the best model counts animals exactly on 41.7% of images with 2 to 10 individuals, less than half its accuracy on everyday objects at the same counts. Taxonomic accuracy falls to one sixth, from 0.72 at phylum to 0.12 at scientific name, and scaling helps mostly at coarse ranks. The gap to a domain specialist widens accordingly, from 0.731 against BioCLIP-2's 0.874 at class (1.2x) to 0.269 against 0.544 at scientific name (2x). On trait size measurement, 15 of the 18 models do no better than an image-blind baseline that predicts one fixed number for every specimen, and on re-identification, 17 of the 18 models fall below chance under adversarial conditions. These failures persist across a tenfold range of model size. We hope Bio-VQA becomes a standard test of how well VLM capabilities transfer to the biological domain.

AI.tldr: 该文提出Bio-VQA——迄今最大的生物学生视觉问答基准，覆盖分层分类、细粒度属性定位、量化空间推理、个体重识别四个维度，含1.86M问题/217K图像，揭示通用VLM的视觉能力难以迁移到生物领域。
AI.motivation: 单张图像在生物多样性监测中需回答"哪个类群、多少个、什么性状、是否见过"等问题，VLM理论上可一并解决，但现有基准仅聚焦少数类群的物种识别，缺乏对VLM生物学视觉理解能力的系统检验。
AI.method: 构建Bio-VQA基准：11个公开数据集、217K图像、1.86M问题，覆盖四个维度（分层分类推理、细粒度属性定位、量化空间推理、个体重识别）；将正误打分扩展为分级打分（近似正确优于远离正确）；评测18个开放权重模型（3.75B–38.4B参数）。
AI.result: 通用视觉能力未迁移：最佳模型在2–10个体计数上精确率仅41.7%（不到同计数日常物体的一半）；分类准确率从门级0.72降至学名级0.12；与专家模型差距从1.2倍（class级0.731 vs 0.874）扩大到2倍（学名0.269 vs 0.544）；18个模型中15个在性状尺寸测量上不优于"盲猜固定值"基线，17个在对抗条件下重识别低于随机。
AI.conclusion: 这些缺陷在十倍模型规模范围内持续存在，说明单纯扩大规模无法弥补；作者希望Bio-VQA成为衡量VLM能力向生物学领域迁移程度的标准化测试。

title: Retrieval Supersedes Scale: Efficient Log Level Prediction via Multiplex Socio-Technical Context
summary: Developers insert logging statements in source code to record its execution, and the resulting logs are essential for detecting and troubleshooting system anomalies. A key part of these statements is the log level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR), which determines whether a message is recorded. Choosing it is a trade-off: levels set too low mask important information in production, while levels set too high create noisy logs and extra I/O and storage overhead. Recent work uses Large Language Models (LLMs) with In-Context Learning (ICL) to predict log levels, but typically augments the prompt with randomly sampled examples. We argue that this overlooks the socio-technical nature of logging, where conventions vary by component and development team. Off-the-shelf LLMs using random examples are reported to achieve median AUCs of only 0.56 to 0.76, leaving room for improvement without fine-tuning. In this paper, we propose a retrieval approach for LLM-powered log level prediction that prioritizes context relevance over random selection and basic similarity. Our method retrieves logging examples relevant along two socio-technical dimensions: (i) functionality (code performing similar operations) and (ii) ownership (code maintained by the same developers). Evaluating four LLMs across ten popular Java projects, we find that this retrieval improves AUC over random baselines by 0.07 (median), and combining both signals yields median AUCs of 0.83 to 0.97. Our ablation studies show that each signal improves on random retrieval, and that combining them outperforms the stronger of the two on all ten projects. Our results also significantly exceed state-of-the-art supervised predictors (e.g., DeepLV) by a median AUC of 0.12 to 0.19. Our findings highlight the importance of socio-technical signals such as code functionality and ownership for LLM-powered log level prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出基于检索的LLM日志级别预测方法，沿"功能相似"和"所有权（同一开发者）"两个社会技术维度检索示例，在10个Java项目上将中位AUC提升至0.83–0.97，显著优于随机示例与DeepLV等监督方法。
AI.motivation: 日志级别选择存在权衡：太低掩盖重要信息，太高产生噪声与I/O存储开销。现有基于ICL的LLM方法随机采样示例，忽视了日志实践的社会技术属性——不同组件与开发团队有各自的日志约定，导致AUC仅0.56–0.76。
AI.method: 提出检索式提示构建方法，优先考虑上下文相关性而非随机或简单相似度。从两个社会技术维度检索相关日志示例：(i) 功能维度——执行相似操作的代码；(ii) 所有权维度——同一开发者维护的代码。用4个LLM在10个流行Java项目上评估，并进行消融实验。
AI.result: 相较随机基线，检索使AUC中位数提升0.07；融合两个信号后中位AUC为0.83–0.97。消融显示各信号均优于随机检索，二者结合在全部10个项目上优于单一较强信号；且比DeepLV等SOTA监督预测器中位AUC高0.12–0.19。
AI.conclusion: 代码功能与所有权等社会技术信号对LLM日志级别预测至关重要，无需微调即可显著超越随机ICL与传统监督方法。

title: Data-Efficient Scaling-Law Discovery for Recommendation Systems via Coupled Hyperparameter Scaling
summary: Large-scale ranking and recommendation models of Web platforms benefit from increased compute much as large language models do, and their scaling behavior is broadly power-law in form. Yet ranking models have heterogeneous architectures which makes their scaling law less straightforward than that of LLMs. We address how to discover the scaling law of an arbitrary ranking model efficiently. We introduce a scaling layer, which groups primitive architecture parameters into semantically coherent groups and defines how they co-vary, inducing a mapping from a low-dimensional space of hyper-hyperparameters into the full architecture space. On top of it, Axia fits scaling-informed surrogates, selects configurations by a posterior-based acquisition criterion, and returns a Pareto frontier from which per-model operating points are validated -- replacing exhaustive sweeps with a small number of informative runs. A fleet-level evaluation protocol, computed on a fixed representative model set under matched trial budgets, makes refinements to either component measurable. Our contribution is an automated system that learns model-specific complexity-quality relationships and gives uncertainty-aware guidance for allocating compute across a heterogeneous model ecosystem. Across 34 model iterations in two development cycles on Meta's ads ranking and retrieval system, the workflow yielded a mean 0.66% offline normalized-entropy improvement and 0.36% cumulative online lift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可学习的 scaling layer 与 Axia 自动搜索系统，用于高效发现异构排序模型的 scaling law，并在 Meta 广告排序与检索系统中取得离线与在线收益。
AI.motivation: LLM 的 scaling law 已有较清晰结论，而 Web 平台的排序/推荐模型虽同样随算力呈幂律提升，却因架构高度异构而难以刻画；论文希望在有限 trial 预算下，为每个模型高效、自动化地发现其复杂度—质量关系。
AI.method: 引入 scaling layer：把原始架构参数归入语义一致的组，并定义其协同变化方式，从而把低维 hyper-hyperparameter 空间映射到完整架构空间；在其上用 Axia 拟合 scaling-informed 代理模型，以基于后验的采集准则选配置，输出 Pareto 前沿并据此验证各模型的 operating point；同时提出 fleet 级评测协议，在固定代表性模型集与匹配 trial 预算下衡量改进。
AI.result: 在 Meta 广告排序与检索系统的两个开发周期、共 34 次模型迭代中，该工作流带来平均 0.66% 的离线归一化熵提升，以及 0.36% 的累计在线 lift。
AI.conclusion: 该自动化系统可学习模型特定的复杂度—质量关系，并以不确定性感知的方式指导异构模型生态中的算力分配，用少量 informative runs 取代穷举扫描。

title: Prospective Memory for Proactive LLM Agents
summary: Most memory systems for LLM agents are retrospective, preserving and retrieving past information to inform current decisions. Proactive agents, however, also require prospective memory: retaining future-directed intentions and realizing them when appropriate opportunities arise, even without explicit requests. Crucially, remembering the right intention does not guarantee acting at the right time: a related observation may call for waiting, while a later cue may make the same intention actionable. Inspired by cognitive theories of human prospective memory, we introduce Pro-Memory, a memory framework that separates maintaining future intentions from deciding when and how to realize them. Pro-Memory preserves pending objectives linked to their supporting evidence, assesses new observations against their original goals and activation conditions, and coordinates appropriate contributions with the agent's ongoing actions. It further updates intention states based on actions actually issued or evidence of resolution, while an experience memory distills feedback from completed episodes into guidance for future decisions. Experiments on two benchmarks spanning delayed-intention tasks and open-ended proactive assistance demonstrate consistent improvements in proactive task performance over representative memory approaches across multiple LLM backbones, while limiting unnecessary interventions.

AI.tldr: 提出 Pro-Memory，一个区分"维持未来意图"与"决定何时/如何实现意图"的前瞻性记忆框架，在延迟意图与开放式主动协助任务上优于代表性记忆方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体记忆多为回溯式（保存和检索过去信息）；但主动型智能体还需要前瞻记忆——保留面向未来的意图并伺机实现，即便没有显式请求。关键难点在于：记住正确意图不等于在正确时机行动，相关观察可能要求等待，稍后的线索才使同一意图可执行。
AI.method: 受人类前瞻记忆认知理论启发，Pro-Memory 将未来意图的维持与"何时/如何实现"的决策分离：维持与支撑证据关联的待办目标；依据原始目标与激活条件评估新观察；与智能体正在进行的动作协调贡献；根据实际发出的动作或问题解决的证据更新意图状态；并用经验记忆将已完成回合的反馈蒸馏为未来决策的指导。
AI.result: 在两个基准（延迟意图任务、开放式主动协助）上，跨多个 LLM 骨干，主动任务表现相对代表性记忆方法一致提升，同时减少不必要的干预。
AI.conclusion: 将前瞻记忆中"存什么"与"何时行动"解耦，是提升 LLM 智能体主动性且不牺牲克制性的有效途径。

title: VirtualTrialHarness: Coordinating Agentic Operationalization of Virtual Trial Protocols Across Complex Clinical Schemas
summary: Virtual trials use routinely collected clinical data to evaluate treatment strategies, but translating a study protocol into an executable analysis requires determining how clinical concepts and study requirements should be represented in the available data and applied consistently across the workflow. These decisions depend on local data representations and operational conventions and can involve source selection, patient and encounter identity, linkage, and temporal interpretation. Here we introduce VirtualTrialHarness (VTHarness), an agent framework that coordinates virtual-trial operationalization by selecting reusable procedural skills for each workflow stage and uses explicit contracts to maintain consistent study decisions across stages. We also introduce VTBenchmark for evaluating source selection and cohort construction. Across three complex synthetic environments, VTHarness successfully produced all required cohort outputs matching the references in 95.1% of workflows after requirement clarification, compared with 60.4% using retrieval from the same procedural corpus. Procedural skills improved source recovery across three language models and increased source overlap with analyst code in 13 Mayo Clinic cases. Site-specific adaptation enabled reference-matched cohort execution across eight MIMIC-IV tasks. Within the Mayo Clinic Virtual Trials Program, the framework supported investigator review of cohort construction and endpoint analysis. These findings support coordinating procedural guidance with workflow decisions to improve virtual-trial implementation across complex clinical schemas.

AI.tldr: 提出 VirtualTrialHarness (VTHarness) 智能体框架，把虚拟试验方案的操作化拆解为可复用"程序性技能"+显式契约，以保证跨阶段决策一致，并配套 VTBenchmark 评测源选择与队列构建。
AI.motivation: 把研究协议翻译成可执行分析时，需决定临床概念与试验要求在本地数据中如何表示、如何跨工作流一致应用；这些决策依赖本地数据表示与操作惯例（源选择、患者/就诊身份、链接、时间解释），易出错且难以复用。现有做法（如从程序性语料库做检索）效果不足。
AI.method: VTHarness 为每个工作流阶段选择可复用的程序性技能（procedural skills），并用显式契约（explicit contracts）在阶段间保持研究决策一致；同时提出 VTBenchmark 用于评测源选择与队列构建。实验包括三个复杂合成环境、三个语言模型、13 个 Mayo Clinic 病例、8 个 MIMIC-IV 任务，以及 Mayo Clinic 虚拟试验项目中的研究者审查。
AI.result: 需求澄清后，VTHarness 在 95.1% 的工作流中产出全部必需队列输出并与参考一致（同一程序语料库检索仅为 60.4%）；程序性技能在三个语言模型上均提升源恢复，并在 13 个 Mayo 病例中提高与分析员代码的源重叠；站点特定适配使 8 个 MIMIC-IV 任务实现与参考匹配的队列执行；并在 Mayo 项目中支持研究者审查队列构建与终点分析。
AI.conclusion: 将程序性指导与工作流决策协同组织，可提升复杂临床数据模式下的虚拟试验落地能力；程序性技能+契约的组合优于纯检索式方法，并具备跨站点适配性与实际部署价值。

title: Relevance Propagation as Entropic Optimal Transport on Filippov Neural Networks: Sinkhorn Propagation and Region Relevance in Image Classifiers
summary: Relevance propagation, which redistributes a network's prediction backward through the layers, is usually treated as a heuristic. We show that it is the solution of a single variational problem: Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) is the divergence-free flow on the active computational graph of zero relative entropy to the backward transition law of the forward activation flow; for a non-negative reference, this is a relative entropy between Markov measures on backward paths. The rules LRP$_0$, LRP$_{z^+}$ and LRP$_{α,β}$ follow from this principle by the choice of a reference, and are instances of one rule, LRPN$_{α,β}$, whose weights may vary from node to node, for instance with the node's activity, in the spirit of Hebb's principle. The principle rests on a measure-theoretic formalization of feed-forward networks as directed acyclic graphs of Filippov operators, which covers piecewise-smooth and discontinuous architectures (e.g. hard-routed Mixture-of-Experts) with a Clarke-Filippov generalized-gradient calculus; it also characterizes backpropagation as the adjoint equation of a Lagrangian relaxation. On networks of ReLU and max-pooling nodes, LRP$_0$ is Gradient$\times$Input, with an explicit jump across a kink where LRP$_{z^+}$ stays continuous. Taking the entropy edge by edge yields a new rule, Sinkhorn Relevance Propagation. Aggregated over an input region, the flow of a non-negative reference tells, with exact accounting, which hidden units carry its evidence, the conditioned flow being a Schrödinger bridge. On VGG-16, the conservation identities hold to round-off, and the rules are told apart by the sign of their maps, the share of the output left to the bias nodes, faithfulness, localization and class dependence; on ConvNeXt-Tiny, LRPN$_{α,β}$ conserves the output and its Hebbian weights give the highest ABPC of the rules tested.

AI.tldr: 论文将相关性传播（LRP）从启发式提升为单一变分问题的解：LRP是活性计算图上零相对熵的散度自由流，LRP$_0$、LRP$_{z^+}$、LRP$_{α,β}$等均为同一规则LRPN$_{α,β}$在特定参考分布下的实例。
AI.motivation: 相关性传播/逐层相关性传播（LRP）通常被视为启发式方法，缺乏统一的理论基础；作者希望给它一个严格的数学原理，并借此统一现有规则、推广新规则、并形式化前馈网络（含分段光滑/不连续架构）。
AI.method: 把前馈网络形式化为Filippov算子构成的有向无环图，并用Clarke-Filippov广义梯度微积分处理分段光滑与不连续架构（如硬路由MoE）。在此基础上将LRP表述为一个变分问题：它是活性计算图上关于前向激活流后向转移律零相对熵的散度自由流（非负参考下即后向路径上马尔可夫测度间的相对熵）。通过选择不同参考分布导出LRP$_0$、LRP$_{z^+}$、LRP$_{α,β}$，并统一为节点权重可变的LRPN$_{α,β}$；逐边取熵得到新规则Sinkhorn Relevance Propagation。文中还刻画了反向传播为拉格朗日松弛的伴随方程。
AI.result: 证明在ReLU与最大池化网络上LRP$_0$等于Gradient×Input，且在拐点处有显式跳跃而LRP$_{z^+}$保持连续。对输入区域聚合后，非负参考的流可精确追踪携带证据的隐藏单元，条件流为Schrödinger桥。实验方面：VGG-16上守恒恒等式精确到舍入误差，各规则可通过映射符号、偏置节点分得的输出份额、忠实性、定位性与类别依赖性加以区分；ConvNeXt-Tiny上LRPN$_{α,β}$保持输出守恒，其Hebbian权重在所测规则中取得最高ABPC。
AI.conclusion: 相关性传播可被统一理解为活性计算图上某一相对熵最小化/散度自由流问题的解，由此给出涵盖LRP$_0$、LRP$_{z^+}$、LRP$_{α,β}$乃至Sinkhorn Relevance Propagation的统一规则族LRPN$_{α,β}$，并提供严格的可解释性与守恒性质，实验验证其理论预测并在忠实性等指标上表现优异。

title: Lesion Overlap Ranks PET Segmentation Models but Does Not Certify Patient-Level Tumor Burden
summary: Metabolic tumor volume (MTV) summarizes whole-body PET disease burden for prognostic stratification and treatment assessment. Automated MTV is useful only if its estimate is reliable for the individual patient, yet segmentation models are usually evaluated with overlap metrics such as Dice rather than burden error. We examined whether overlap metrics identify unreliable MTV estimates using 1,014 autoPET FDG PET/CT studies. We evaluated LesionTracer predictions held out from fine-tuning, compared five selected released models on 489 tumor-positive patients, and examined the findings in 597 PSMA studies. Across the five FDG models, ranking by higher mean Dice gave the same order as ranking by lower mean relative MTV error ($ρ=-1.00$, exact $p=0.017$). At the patient level, however, out-of-fold Dice tracked relative MTV error strongly ($ρ=-0.75$), yet 82 of 489 patients (16.8\%) fell on opposite sides of the Dice 0.80 and MTV-error 25\% thresholds. Within the training-exposed released models, correlations ranged from $-0.47$ to $-0.74$ over narrower, high-Dice ranges. Out of fold, opposing false-positive and false-negative volumes cancelled about one third of spatial error in net MTV. In 236 of 489 patients, each of the five models missed at least one lesion, though not necessarily the same lesion. Thus, agreement in average model rankings did not establish the reliability of individual MTV estimates or reveal shared lesion misses. PET segmentation benchmarks should report patient-level MTV error and missed-lesion counts alongside Dice and other overlap metrics.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用1014例autoPET FDG PET/CT（另在597例PSMA中验证），检验Dice等重叠指标能否识别不可靠的MTV估计。结果显示：模型平均排序上Dice与相对MTV误差高度一致（ρ=-1.00），但患者层面约16.8%的患者跨越Dice 0.80与MTV误差25%阈值时方向相反，且漏检病灶常被少数正负误差抵消。因此PET分割基准应同时报告患者级MTV误差与漏检数。
AI.motivation: MTV用于全身PET肿瘤负荷的预后分层与疗效评估，自动化MTV只有在对个体患者可靠时才有价值；但分割模型普遍用Dice等重叠指标评价，而非直接评价负荷误差。作者因此检验重叠指标能否识别不可靠的MTV估计。
AI.method: 在1,014例autoPET FDG PET/CT上评估；使用未参与微调的LesionTracer预测，并在489例肿瘤阳性患者上比较5个已发布模型，另在597例PSMA研究中复核。分析Dice与相对MTV误差在模型层面与患者层面的相关性，统计跨越Dice 0.80和MTV误差25%阈值但方向相反的患者数，分解假阳性与假阴性体积对净MTV的抵消，并统计各模型漏检病灶的患者数。
AI.result: 5个FDG模型按平均Dice排序与按平均相对MTV误差排序完全一致（ρ=-1.00，精确p=0.017）。患者层面，折外Dice与相对MTV误差相关强（ρ=-0.75），但489例中有82例（16.8%）在Dice 0.80与MTV误差25%两阈值上分处相反一侧。训练暴露模型的相关为-0.47至-0.74，且处于更窄的高Dice区间。折外情况下，假阳性与假阴性体积方向相反而相互抵消，掩盖了约三分之一的空间误差在净MTV上的体现。489例中有236例，五个模型各自至少漏检一个病灶（未必是同一病灶）。
AI.conclusion: 模型平均排序一致并不能证明个体MTV估计可靠，也无法揭示共有的漏检病灶。PET分割基准应在Dice等重叠指标之外，同时报告患者级MTV误差和漏检病灶计数。

title: When Does a Cross-Device Run Justify PASS? Obligation-Level Evidence Qualification under Partial Observability
summary:
A cross-device test can complete every command yet judge a business claim from evidence belonging to another device or attempt. We introduce an executable evidence contract that makes support qualification an explicit stage before predicate evaluation. It binds each obligation to admissible subjects, episodes, objects and observation scopes, and records unresolved support rather than treating an apparently successful observation as proof.
  We evaluate two implemented parts of the contract. A prospectively specified, 12-seed controlled study isolates association under reused identifiers across 2,304 claims. Given identical records and business policy, Atomic-Facts Flat produces 160 false PASS and 76.30% PASS recall; supplying computed associations reduces false PASS to five and increases PASS recall to 99.09%. Deterministic Closure produces zero false PASS and 100.00% PASS recall, improving on Atomic Flat in 11 seeds with one tie (two-sided sign p=0.00098). Most of the benefit comes from explicit association rather than graph notation.
  A separate prospective field characterization spans four workflows, 40 physical episodes and 80 claims. Against frozen reference labels, the physical-evidence verifier attains 95.00% accuracy and 100.00% PASS recall (27/27), with three false PASS judgments. The field results are descriptive: a policy-input mismatch prevents the planned matched-policy comparison, and post-hoc sensitivity does not establish superiority over a policy-informed textual baseline. Together, the studies characterize qualification on physical evidence and isolate the value of explicit association under a controlled matching contract.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可执行证据契约"，把"支持资格认定"作为谓词评估前的独立阶段，将义务绑定到可采纳的主体、事件、对象与观测范围，并允许记录"未解决支持"而非把表面成功的观测当作证明；通过受控实验与实地表征验证其效果。
AI.motivation: 跨设备测试可完成每条命令，却可能用来自另一设备或另一尝试的证据来判断业务主张，即"关联"层面的错误未被现有逐条命令测试捕获。
AI.method: 提出可执行证据契约，将支持资格前置；评估两实现部分：(1) 12种子预注册受控研究，在2,304条主张上比较 Atomic-Facts Flat、加入计算关联的版本与 Deterministic Closure；(2) 独立前瞻性实地表征，覆盖4个工作流、40个物理事件、80条主张，以冻结参考标签评估物理证据验证器。
AI.result: 受控研究：Atomic-Facts Flat 产生160个误判PASS、PASS召回76.30%；加入计算关联后误判PASS降至5、召回升至99.09%；Deterministic Closure 零误判PASS、100.00%召回，11种子优于Atomic Flat、1平（双侧符号检验p=0.00098）。实地：物理证据验证器准确率95.00%、PASS召回100.00%(27/27)，但仍有3个误判PASS。
AI.conclusion: 两项研究刻画了物理证据上的资格认定，并在受控匹配契约下分离出显式关联的价值；但实地结果仅为描述性，策略输入不匹配使计划中的匹配策略比较未能进行，事后敏感性分析不足以证明优于策略知情文本基线。

title: Combining Relevant Expert Knowledge Using Mixtures of Feedback Fuzzy Cognitive Maps
summary: A neuro-symbolic system should combine only relevant answers from expert agents or other knowledge sources. Using only relevant experts for a given input query becomes ever more important for accuracy and scalability as the knowledge network grows and connects ever more knowledge sources. We extend the standard definition of relevance from the legal theory of evidence: An answer is relevant if and only if it is both probative and material for the matter at hand given the knowledge available. We apply this relevancy scheme to mixing the feedback fuzzy cognitive maps (FCMs) of real or artificial experts. The expert FCM directed causal graphs mix or combine into a common knowledge network. We compare the equilibrium limit-cycle predictions or answers of the experts to the answers of the mixture FCM and then estimate the probative status of answers by their difference or variation. A new Bayes-like theorem de-mixes the knowledge mixture into corresponding posterior-like FCMs that also allow relevancy-based comparisons. The result is a final set of relevancy mixing weights that produces a relevancy-mixed FCM knowledge network for the given query. So different queries produce different relevancy-mixed FCMs. We demonstrate this relevancy approach using generated synthetic FCMs from an actual 13-node expert FCM that models the causes and feedbacks of ischemic-stroke risk.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于法律证据理论"相关性"(probative+material)的神经符号系统方法，用相关性加权混合多个专家FCM，并通过类贝叶斯去混合得到查询特定的后验FCM，在13节点缺血性中风风险FCM上验证。
AI.motivation: 知识网络不断扩展、连接的知识源越来越多，神经符号系统若混合所有专家/知识源的答案会损害准确性与可扩展性，因此必须只使用与当前查询相关的专家。
AI.method: 将相关性定义为"对当前事项既具证明力(probative)又具实质性(material)"；把真实或人工专家的反馈模糊认知图(FCM)有向因果图混合成公共知识网络；比较各专家与混合FCM的平衡极限环预测差异来估计答案的证明力；提出新的类贝叶斯定理把知识混合"去混合"为后验式FCM，并进行相关性比较，最终得到相关性混合权重，构成针对该查询的相关性混合FCM。
AI.result: 不同查询产生不同的相关性混合FCM；方法在由真实13节点缺血性中风风险专家FCM生成的合成FCM上得到演示验证。
AI.conclusion: 相关性驱动的动态混合机制可使神经符号系统在大规模知识网络中仅整合相关专家答案，实现查询自适应的FCM知识网络。

title: How Well Can Large Language Models Impersonate Individual Authors? A Comparative Evaluation
summary: This study investigates the authorship impersonation capacity of six widely used large language models (LLMs): Gemini 3 Pro, Claude Opus, GPT 5.2, GPT 5.2 Pro, DeepSeek 3.2, and Grok 4.1 Fast. The evaluation was conducted using short product review texts selected to ensure high within author consistency in individual writing style. Two types of in context prompt were designed: a simple prompt with minimal instruction and a complex prompt incorporating explicit stylometric guidance for mimicry. Authorship mimicry was evaluated using a cosine distance based distance to training metric, supplemented by visual analyses of embedding distributions. The results indicate that authorship impersonation remained challenging for most LLMs, with Gemini 3 Pro showing the strongest apparent mimicry performance. However, subsequent overlap analysis revealed that Gemini 3 Pro extensively copied and reused sentences and phrases from the training texts, at levels far exceeding those observed among human authors. Follow up factor analyses showed that training set consistency was the most robust predictor of mimicry success across models, whereas author distinctiveness did not generalise as a reliable predictor. Global embedding visualisations further revealed a consistent macro level pattern: for most models, generated texts occupied regions of the embedding space that were largely separated from the corresponding human training clusters. This indicates limited convergence towards target author style and suggests the presence of model specific lexical and phraseological preferences. The findings highlight the importance of distinguishing genuine stylistic imitation from direct textual reuse and have implications for the forensic analysis of textual evidence involving potential LLM enabled impersonation.

AI.tldr: 研究评估六个主流大模型的"作者身份冒充"能力，发现多数模型难以真正模仿个人写作风格，表面最强者实为文本抄袭。
AI.motivation: LLM具备生成文本能力，存在被用于伪造他人文风的取证风险，需实证检验其作者冒充能力及评估方法的可靠性。
AI.method: 选取风格一致的短产品评论文本，设计简单与复杂（含显式文体计量指导）两类上下文提示；用基于余弦距离的"距训练集"指标加嵌入分布可视化评估模仿效果，并做重叠分析、因子分析。
AI.result: 多数模型模仿困难；Gemini 3 Pro表面效果最佳，但实为大量复制训练文本的句子和短语，程度远超人类作者。训练集一致性是最稳健的预测因子，作者独特性则不能泛化；嵌入空间中生成文本与目标作者簇明显分离，显示模型特有词汇偏好。
AI.conclusion: 须区分真实风格模仿与直接文本复用；研究对涉及LLM冒充的文本取证分析具有启示意义。

title: AGORA: Reliability-Aware Aggregation of LLM Judges via Item-Response Theory
summary: LLM-as-a-judge is a common substitute for costly human evaluation, and aggregating several judges is the standard remedy for any single judge's bias. Judge pools mix judges of very different reliability, while the human-labeled sets that validate them hold a few hundred items or fewer. In this regime the per-item mean weights weak judges as heavily as strong ones, and confusion-table models such as Dawid-Skene must estimate a per-judge error table from too few items. We propose AGORA (Aggregation Of Reliability-weighted Assessments), an item-response-theory aggregator that places every item on one latent quality scale and describes each judge by a sensitivity parameter and ordered rating thresholds, so judge reliability is learned from all items jointly and without human labels. Across three benchmarks, AGORA matches or exceeds Dawid-Skene on large evaluation sets, and its advantage widens as the set shrinks toward a few hundred items. It remains accurate as pools grow more uneven, a label-free dispersion statistic indicates in advance when trust weighting helps, and its learned trust weights track per-judge human validity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AGORA，一种基于项目反应理论（IRT）的评审聚合方法，将每个条目置于单一潜在质量尺度上，用敏感度参数和有序评分阈值描述每位评审，从而无需人工标签即可联合学习评审可靠性，改善了小规模评测集中弱评审权重过高的问题。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-judge 常替代昂贵的人工评估，而聚合多位评审是缓解单评审偏差的标准做法。但评审池中各评审可靠性差异很大，用于验证的人工标注集往往只有几百条或更少。在此情形下，按条目取均值会给弱评审与强评审同样的权重；而 Dawid-Skene 这类混淆表模型需要从过少条目中估计每位评审的误差表，难以奏效。
AI.method: AGORA（Aggregation Of Reliability-weighted Assessments）是一种基于项目反应理论的聚合器：将每个条目映射到统一的潜在质量尺度，并以一个敏感度参数和一组有序评分阈值刻画每位评审。借由全部条目的联合学习，评审可靠性可在无人工标签的情况下被估计，并据此进行可信度加权聚合。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，AGORA 在大规模评测集上达到或超过 Dawid-Skene；当评测集缩小至数百条时优势更明显；评审池越不均衡仍保持准确；一个无标签的离散度统计量可预先指示可信度加权是否有益；其学到的信任权重与各评审的人工效度相符。
AI.conclusion: AGORA 为小样本、异质评审池场景提供了有效的无标签可靠性加权聚合方案，兼具准确性与可解释性，并具备事前判断加权收益的实用信号。

title: RIDGE: State-Conditioned Reward Blending for Behavioral Coverage in Deep RL Game Agents
comment: Conference of Games, 4 pages, 3 figures, reinforcement learning, automated playtesting, procedural personas,reward shaping, PPO, Crafter
summary: A deep RL agent trained on a fixed persona reward plays one way: an Explorer keeps exploring while starving, a Survivor hoards on an empty map. Since each persona fixes its own reward, automated playtesting trains N agents for N styles. Changing reward composition mid-episode runs into the switching-stability dilemma: PPO degrades under non-stationary rewards. We present RIDGE, a single-agent architecture that sidesteps the dilemma with two design choices: a state-conditioned blender that computes softmax-normalized sigmoid weights from slow-moving state variables, and a multi-head critic that trains one value head per persona on its own stationary signal. On Crafter with four personas, one \ridge agent acquires both branches of the wood-tier crafting/combat split that no fixed-persona baseline solves jointly, and a sharpness ablation confirms state-conditioning drives the gain. We position these results as demonstrations of the blending mechanism's dynamics across n=3 seeds per condition; larger multi-seed sweeps remain future work.

AI.tldr: RIDGE 用状态条件混合器 + 多人格多头评论家，在单智能体中动态融合多个人格奖励，避开 PPO 非平稳奖励下的切换不稳定问题，并在 Crafter 上首次联合打通木器制作/战斗分支。
AI.motivation: 固定人格奖励训练的智能体行为单一（探索者饿死仍探索、生存者空图囤积），欲覆盖 N 种风格需训练 N 个智能体；而中途切换奖励组合会遭遇"切换稳定性困境"——PPO 在非平稳奖励下性能退化。
AI.method: RIDGE 单智能体架构含两项设计：(1) 状态条件混合器，由慢变状态变量计算经 softmax 归一化的 sigmoid 权重；(2) 多人格多头评论家，每个人格在各自平稳信号上训练一个价值头。
AI.result: Crafter 四人格设定下，单个 RIDGE 智能体同时习得木器制作/战斗分歧的两条分支，而任何固定人格基线都无法联合求解；sharpness 消融显示状态条件是收益来源。结果为每条件 n=3 种子的机制演示。
AI.conclusion: 结果定位为混合机制动态的演示性证据，更大规模多种子扫描留待后续工作。

title: Discarded or Unreachable? Diagnosing and Repairing Spatial Relation Failure in Vision--Language Similarity
comment: Code, stimulus generators, and all result files: https://github.com/mahdims/vl-spatial-moment
summary: Contrastive vision-language models score left/right relations near chance, but the symptom has two causes that call for opposite repairs: the relation may survive in the pooled embedding yet be unreachable by native image-text similarity, or pooling may discard it while the dense features retain it. On clean two object photographs, across ten encoders, the lateral polarity is linearly decodable from the flip odd component of the pooled vector at 0.77-0.99, yet a search over a million captions leaves nine of the ten at chance under native scoring: an access failure. On controlled C4 orbits, where the relation is the only thing that varies, pooling keeps the arrangement axis at 0.998-1.000 and loses its polarity, which the patch grid retains: a pooling failure. Both sit downstream of the dense features, so one readout covers both. Our zero parameter, query conditioned spatial moment recomputes the geometry from the patch grid and stores it as a vector beside the native embedding. On a 118,287 image index it raises left/right pairwise accuracy against reversed geometry negatives from 0.51-0.53 to 0.81-0.96 and conditional R@1 among 21 category matched candidates from 0.05 to 0.37-0.75, at under a millisecond per batched query, while reproducing the native ranking exactly for queries that name no relation.

AI.tldr: 对比视觉-语言模型对左右关系的识别接近随机，原因有二：一是关系信息存于池化向量但原生图文相似度无法访问（access failure），二是池化过程本身丢弃了极性信息而稠密特征仍保留（pooling failure）。作者提出零参数、查询条件化的空间矩读出，二者统一解决。
AI.motivation: 现有对比视觉-语言模型在判断左右关系时准确率接近随机。作者指出这一症状其实有两个相反成因，需不同修复方法，且二者都位于稠密特征下游，因此可统一处理。
AI.method: 提出零参数、查询条件化的空间矩（spatial moment）读出：从 patch 网格重新计算几何关系，并以向量形式存储于原生嵌入旁。该方法可同时覆盖 access failure 与 pooling failure。
AI.result: 在 10 个编码器上，池化向量的翻转奇分量可线性解码左右极性的准确率 0.77-0.99，但百万字幕搜索下 9/10 处于随机水平（access failure）；C4 轨道上池化保留排列轴 0.998-1.000 却丢失极性，patch 网格能保留（pooling failure）。在 118,287 张图像索引上，左右成对准确率从 0.51-0.53 提升至 0.81-0.96，21 个同类候选中的条件 R@1 从 0.05 提升至 0.37-0.75，每批量查询低于 1 毫秒，且对不含关系的查询完全复现原生排序。
AI.conclusion: 作者将左右关系失效的诊断区分为 access failure 与 pooling failure，并证明单一零参数、查询条件化空间矩读出即可同时解决，性能大幅提升且效率高、不损害原生排序。

title: SynMOE: A Syntax-Aware MOE-Guided Approach for PEFT-Based Code Intelligence Learning
summary: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has emerged as an important approach for adapting Language Models (LMs) in downstream tasks. However, in the domain of code intelligence, the performance of most PEFT methods relatively drops compared to Full fine-Tuning (FT), hindering their broader applicability. One of the main reasons is that current PEFT methods are generally based on assumptions about the low-rank nature or sparsity of parameter updates, lacking explicit modeling of code-related information. To tackle this limitation, we propose SynMOE, a syntax-aware MOE-guided approach for PEFT on code intelligence learning. Specifically, SynMOE contains two stages: syntactic information extraction and syntax-aware MOE-guided adaptation. It first obtains the syntactic labels of source code from Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs), and then aligns the labels with the input tokens of code LMs. In the second stage, syntactic labels are integrated into the MOE module, participating in the routing decision of MOE for a more powerful syntactic-aware token representation. We evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed approach by applying it to two typical PEFT methods, LoRA and $(IA)^3$, across three diverse code intelligence tasks. Experimental results show that SynMOE achieves consistent and significant improvements. Even compared to FT, SynMOE achieves comparable or superior performance while being more computationally efficient. In addition, we also conduct ablation studies, hyperparameter analysis, and evaluation in the low-resource scenario to provide a comprehensive investigation of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 提出语法感知的MOE引导PEFT方法SynMOE，通过AST语法标签参与专家路由，在代码智能任务上一致超越现有PEFT，并与全量微调相当或更优且更省算力。
AI.motivation: 现有PEFT方法多基于参数更新低秩或稀疏的假设，缺乏对代码相关信息的显式建模，因此在代码智能领域性能相对全量微调（FT）明显下降，限制了其应用。
AI.method: SynMOE分两阶段：1）从抽象语法树（AST）获取源代码的语法标签，并将标签与代码LM的输入token对齐；2）将语法标签引入MOE模块，参与专家路由决策，从而获得更强的语法感知token表示。方法可叠加在LoRA、(IA)^3等PEFT之上。
AI.result: 在三个代码智能任务上，将SynMOE应用于LoRA和(IA)^3两种典型PEFT方法，均取得一致且显著的提升；与全量微调相比达到相当甚至更优的性能，同时计算更高效。此外还提供了消融实验、超参数分析及低资源场景评估。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入代码语法结构信息可有效弥补现有PEFT缺乏领域建模的不足，SynMOE为代码智能任务提供了一种高效、可插拔且性能接近全量微调的微调方案。

title: Toward a Compositional Knowledge Architecture for a Shared Organizational Cortex
comment: 25 pages, 10 figures, 10 tables. Evaluation and sources in https://github.com/withrobinhq/geometric-knowledge-paper-evals (tag registered-plan)
summary: Organizations accumulate evidence in conversations, documents, decisions and relationships, but they act on interpretations: judgements assembled from several observations, resting on assumptions, and revised as circumstances change. Existing retrieval, knowledge graphs and agent memory keep the records and lose the interpretation. We propose a four-layer architecture, Signals, Domains, Claims and Dimensions, in which interpretations persist with their justifications and standing, a truth-maintenance network revises that standing as evidence changes, and validated, versioned Dimensions position interpretations on named axes. We call the result a shared organizational cortex. In a registered retrieval experiment, the Dimension term gains 0.028 nDCG@10 (p = 0.002). In system-level comparisons, the full retrieval configuration improves nDCG@10 by 0.081 over Signals-only and 0.053 over graph-augmented Signals-only retrieval (both reported p < 0.001). The architecture gives organizations a persistent, revisable basis for shared judgement.

AI.tldr: 论文提出四层架构（Signals、Domains、Claims、Dimensions）构成"共享组织皮层"，让解释（判断）连同其依据和效力持久保存，并通过真值维护网络随证据变化进行修订。
AI.motivation: 组织积累了大量证据（对话、文档、决策、关系），但真正据以行动的是解释——由多个观察汇成的判断，依赖假设并随情境变化。现有检索、知识图谱和智能体记忆只保存记录，丢失了解释。
AI.method: 四层架构：Signals（原始信号）、Domains（领域）、Claims（主张/判断）、Dimensions（维度）。解释与理由、效力一同持久化；真值维护网络在证据变化时修订效力；经验证、带版本的Dimensions将解释定位在具名轴上。并以注册的检索实验及系统级对比进行评估。
AI.result: 注册检索实验中，Dimension项带来0.028的nDCG@10提升（p=0.002）；系统级对比中，完整检索配置较仅Signals提升0.081 nDCG@10，较图增强的仅Signals提升0.053（均p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 该架构为组织提供持久、可修订的共享判断基础。

title: Phonological Knowledge of Chinese Characters in Language Models
summary: How much phonological knowledge do language models (LMs) possess about Chinese characters, and how is this knowledge represented and used? We introduce PinyinBench, a controlled benchmark covering homophones, phonological features (initials, finals, and tones), and polyphonic characters. We investigate 17 text-only and multimodal LMs through three complementary approaches: behavioral evaluation, layer-wise probing, and activation steering. Behaviorally, models demonstrate substantial knowledge of initials and finals, with a frontier model (DS-v4-flash) scoring 90%+ in homophone judgment, when two characters share no phonological features. However, its accuracy drops sharply to 72% when two characters differ only in lexical tone. Probing reveals that tone is highly decodable from embeddings and improves modestly across layers, whereas segmental information starts less decodable and improves substantially with depth. Activation steering shows that segmental representations can systematically influence generation, while tone exhibits much weaker effects. Furthermore, audio-bearing training improves phonological decodability, including tone, without corresponding improvements in steering effectiveness. Together, these findings reveal distinct representational and functional profiles for segmental and tonal information, with tonal information much harder to access and manipulate, demonstrating the necessity for combined evaluation, probing, and causal intervention for understanding linguistic knowledge in LMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PinyinBench 基准，从行为评测、逐层探针和激活引导三方面考察 17 个语言模型对汉字音韵知识（声母、韵母、声调、多音字）的掌握与表征，发现声调知识虽可解码但最难访问和操控。
AI.motivation: 语言模型对汉字音韵知识掌握多少、以何种方式表征和使用，尚缺乏系统研究，尤其声调这类超音段信息是否被有效编码与调用并不清楚。
AI.method: 构建 PinyinBench 受控基准，覆盖同音字、声母/韵母/声调等音韵特征及多音字；对 17 个纯文本与多模态模型采用三种互补方法：行为评测、逐层线性探针、激活引导（activation steering）因果干预。
AI.result: 行为上模型对声母和韵母掌握较好，前沿模型 DS-v4-flash 在无声韵共享的同音判断中得分 90%+，但两字仅声调不同时准确率骤降至 72%。探针显示声调在嵌入层即可高度解码且随层数提升有限，而音段信息初始可解码性低、随深度显著提升。激活引导显示音段表征能系统性影响生成，声调影响明显较弱。含音频训练可提升音韵（含声调）的可解码性，但不提升引导有效性。
AI.conclusion: 音段与声调信息在语言模型中具有不同的表征与功能特征：声调更难以访问和操控。理解模型的语言知识需结合行为评测、探针与因果干预三类方法。

title: BrainBind: Bridging Synchronized EEG and fMRI through Long-Form Naturalistic Video Representations
comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026. 26 pages, 4 figures, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/Forainest789/Brainbind
summary: Real-world vision is dynamic and scene-rich, while EEG and fMRI resolve it at complementary temporal and spatial scales. Most neural decoding systems, however, align one modality in isolation and mostly against static images or short clips. We study the synchronized case: EEG and fMRI are recorded during the same long-form naturalistic viewing, giving a shared stimulus but also recurring narrative context and many semantically similar candidates. We present BrainBind, a framework that maps synchronized EEG and fMRI into frozen long-form video embedding spaces and treats those spaces as common visual-semantic references, not literal neural codes. On CineBrain, a five-seed Recall@K 2 x 4 matrix across two video anchors and four system configurations shows distinct retrieval profiles. With Omni, fMRI organizes the full candidate list most strongly (MRR = 23.82, nDCG@10 = 25.31), while Joint-Dual gives the highest mean label-aware R@1 (13.52%) with a distinct rank-wide profile. The complementary episode-disjoint evaluation quantifies the contribution of repeated stimulus identity and narrative context to the random split. Across these experiments, proxy choice and system configuration produce distinct top-rank and rank-wide retrieval profiles within the present synchronized dataset. The code is available at https://github.com/Forainest789/Brainbind.

AI.tldr: BrainBind 将同步采集的 EEG 与 fMRI 映射到冻结的长视频嵌入空间，作为共享的视觉-语义参照而非神经编码，从而在长片自然观看场景下实现跨模态检索，并揭示不同代理空间与系统配置在排名顶端与全排名上的不同检索特性。
AI.motivation: 真实视觉是动态且场景丰富的，EEG 与 fMRI 在时间与空间尺度上互补；但现有神经解码系统多单独对齐单一模态，且大多只针对静态图像或短视频，缺乏对同步采集、长片自然观看且存在重复叙事上下文与大量语义相似候选场景的研究。
AI.method: 提出 BrainBind 框架，在 CineBrain 数据集上对同步 EEG 与 fMRI 与同一长片视频做对齐；将两种模态映射进冻结的长视频嵌入空间，并把这些空间当作共同的视觉-语义参照而非字面神经编码。评估采用五随机种子 Recall@K 的 2×4 矩阵（两种视频锚点 × 四种系统配置），并辅以 episode-disjoint 评估。
AI.result: Omni 代理下 fMRI 对完整候选列表的组织最强（MRR=23.82，nDCG@10=25.31）；Joint-Dual 取得最高的平均 label-aware R@1（13.52%），且具有不同的全排名画像；episode-disjoint 评估量化和对比了随机划分中重复刺激身份与叙事上下文的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 在同步数据集下，代理空间选择与系统配置会产生不同的顶端排名与全排名检索特性；该框架强调以冻结视频嵌入空间作为共享参照的同步多模态对齐范式。

title: Transport along Local Annealing Paths: Wasserstein Geometry and Multimodal Sampling
summary: Variational approaches to learning transport maps for multimodal sampling can suffer from mode collapse. One way to mitigate this problem is to learn transport along a prescribed path of intermediate distributions defined by geometric annealing. We show that annealing can take a substantial detour in Wasserstein space: when mass moves between modes, the path can be much longer than the distance between its endpoints. We further link path geometry to transport learning, showing that long annealing paths can slow population optimization, while sufficiently regular paths permit rapid convergence. Motivated by these findings, we propose componentwise annealed transport (CAT) to reduce the need for mass transfer between modes. Starting from a mode-informed mixture reference, CAT constructs an exact mixture decomposition of the target and learns separate transport maps along componentwise annealing paths. We estimate the component weights separately and show that these estimates remain consistent even when the learned flows are inexact. We also develop adaptive annealing schedules guided by transport effort. Experiments on multimodal synthetic distributions and Bayesian inference problems demonstrate improvements in transport learning and sampling efficiency.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出分量式退火传输（CAT），通过从模式感知的混合参考分布出发、沿逐分量退火路径学习独立的传输映射，减少模式间质量迁移，缓解多模态采样中的模式坍缩，并在合成多模态分布与贝叶斯推断任务上提升了传输学习与采样效率。
AI.motivation: 变分式传输映射学习在多模态采样中易发生模式坍缩。几何退火（沿中间分布路径学习传输）是常见缓解手段，但作者指出退火在 Wasserstein 空间中可能走显著"绕路"：当质量在模式间迁移时，路径长度远大于端点间距。且路径几何与传输学习相关——长退火路径会拖慢群体优化，足够正则的路径才能快速收敛。因此需要减少模式间质量传输的需求。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：证明退火路径在 Wasserstein 空间中的长度可远超端点距离，并将其与群体优化的收敛速度联系起来（长路径减慢收敛，正则路径则快）。2) CAT 方法：以模式信息驱动的混合分布作为参考，构造目标分布的精确混合分解，沿各分量各自的退火路径学习独立的传输映射，从而避免跨模式质量迁移。3) 分量权重单独估计，并证明即使学习到的流不精确，权重估计仍保持一致性。4) 设计以"传输代价（transport effort）"为引导的自适应退火调度。
AI.result: 在多模态合成分布与贝叶斯推断问题的实验中，CAT 相比基线在传输学习和采样效率上均有提升；权重估计在流不精确时仍保持一致性的理论保证得到验证；自适应退火调度有效。
AI.conclusion: 退火路径几何是理解多模态传输学习的关键因素；通过分量式分解与逐分量退火，可从根本上减少跨模式质量迁移，从而缓解模式坍缩并获得更快的收敛与更高采样效率。

title: Role-based Effectiveness of an Epistemic Uncertainty Estimate in Training Models for Semantic Segmentation of 3D LiDAR Point Clouds
summary: Point cloud segmentation is a fundamental task in 3D data analysis, with applications across robotics, augmented and virtual reality, and remote sensing. However, the inherent sparsity, noise, and unordered nature of point clouds introduce significant challenges, particularly in achieving reliable classification. While the state-of-the-art rely on training models for explicit modeling of uncertainty, there is a gap in exploring different roles that estimated uncertainty using generative approaches can play. This work investigates the impact of deterministic uncertainty in point cloud segmentation by explicitly modeling epistemic uncertainty and using it in different roles, namely, as a feature and in loss function. We evaluate a baseline artificial neural network (ANN) and two uncertainty-aware variants (uncertainty as an additional input feature and as a per-sample confidence weight in the training loss) on four large-scale LiDAR benchmarks spanning airborne and mobile acquisition, namely ISPRS Vaihingen, AHN3, Paris-Lille-3D, and Toronto-3D, together with PointNet++ and RandLA-Net references and their uncertainty-augmented counterparts under canonical spatially disjoint train and test splits. Under this protocol, uncertainty-aware modeling improves mean Intersection over Union, recovers minority classes that the baseline ANN never predicts at all, and in half of the configurations improves the alignment between prediction error and estimated uncertainty as measured by Patch Accuracy versus Patch Uncertainty. Our findings indicate that uncertainty can play multiple roles in the segmentation pipeline rather than as a device for improving accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 该文系统性研究了在点云语义分割中显式建模认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）并将其以"特征"和"损失权重"两种角色使用的影响，在四个LiDAR大规模基准上验证了不确定性建模可提升mIoU、恢复基线完全漏检的少数类。
AI.motivation: 点云本身稀疏、含噪、无序，导致可靠分类困难；现有SOTA多用模型显式建模不确定性，但很少探索生成式方法估计的不确定性在分割流程中可扮演的不同角色，存在研究空白。
AI.method: 对比一个基线ANN与两个不确定性感知变体：将不确定性作为额外输入特征，以及作为训练损失中的逐样本置信度权重；在ISPRS Vaihingen、AHN3、Paris-Lille-3D、Toronto-3D四个机载/车载LiDAR基准上，配合PointNet++与RandLA-Net参考模型及其不确定性增强版本，采用空间不相交的训练/测试划分协议进行评估。
AI.result: 在此协议下，不确定性感知建模提升了平均IoU；恢复了基线ANN完全无法预测的少数类；在一半配置中改善了预测误差与估计不确定性之间的对齐度（以Patch Accuracy vs Patch Uncertainty衡量）。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性在分割流程中可扮演多重角色，而不仅是提升精度的工具；应将其视为特征、损失加权与置信度评估等多用途组件。

title: SWEOps-Bench: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Resolution of Software-Induced Cloud Incidents
summary:
