As autonomous agents advance, the traditional boundary between software development and cloud operations gradually blurs, increasing the need for integrated incident detection, localization, and remediation. Existing benchmarks evaluate isolated diagnostic queries or repository-level program repair, failing to test continuous incident resolution across operational clusters and source repositories. We introduce SWEOps-Bench, an interactive benchmark comprising 55 reproducible incident tasks derived from confirmed historical defects across 16 Kubernetes operator projects. Each task preserves the original software repository and initializes in a healthy cluster before a controlled workload triggers the historical fault. Agents investigate runtime evidence and submit source or configuration repairs through a terminal interface, while the harness builds and deploys the changes within a shared time budget.
  Evaluation covers stage-wise accuracy, verified recovery, penalized lifecycle latency, and token consumption. Across six agent-model configurations, faulty-state detection ranges from 72.7% to 90.9%, whereas overall recovery ranges from only 14.5% to 52.7%, exposing a substantial gap between recognizing incidents and resolving them end to end. Trajectory analysis further shows that reported diagnosis and final recovery only partially coincide: some tasks achieve verified recovery despite an incorrect reported RCA, while runtime symptom clearance can still fail fix-specific functional verification. SWEOps-Bench establishes a rigorous foundation for evaluating autonomous agents in integrated development and operational environments.

AI.tldr: 提出 SWEOps-Bench，一个面向"开发+运维"一体化的事件处理交互式基准，含 55 个来自 16 个 Kubernetes operator 项目真实历史缺陷的可复现任务，评测智能体的检测、定位与修复全流程能力。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体发展使软件开发和云运维边界模糊，需要一体化的事件检测、定位与修复能力。现有基准只测孤立的诊断查询或仓库级程序修复，无法检验跨运维集群与源码仓库的连续事件解决能力。
AI.method: 构建 55 个可复现事件任务，源自 16 个 Kubernetes operator 项目的已确认历史缺陷；每个任务保留原始代码仓库，先启动健康集群，再由受控工作负载触发历史故障。智能体通过终端界面调查运行时证据并提交源码或配置修复，测试框架在统一时间预算内构建与部署变更。评测指标包括阶段准确率、验证性恢复、带惩罚的生命周期延迟和 token 消耗。
AI.result: 在六种 agent-模型配置下，故障状态检测率为 72.7%–90.9%，但整体恢复率仅 14.5%–52.7%，显示出"识别问题"与"端到端解决"间的显著差距。轨迹分析表明：报告的诊断与最终恢复仅部分重合——部分任务在 RCA 报告错误时仍实现验证性恢复；而运行时症状消除也可能无法通过针对具体修复的功能验证。
AI.conclusion: SWEOps-Bench 为评测智能体在开发与运维一体化环境中的能力提供了严谨基础，并揭示了诊断与修复之间的能力断层。

title: From Waste to Discovery: Recycling High-Scored Unexposed Candidates in Taobao Feed Recommendation
summary: Helping users discover new interests is vital to the long-term health of industrial recommender systems, yet the usual remedy, boosting exposure of under-explored (discovery) content, often backfires in production. We report URED (Unexposed Recycling for Efficient Discovery), a training-free recall-stage system serving Taobao feed recommendation at Alibaba for over six months to tens of millions of daily active users. It rests on a production-validated insight: naive boosting fails because it injects cold, information-poor candidates that rankers systematically over-estimate, buying no discovery gain while risking engagement. Items scored highly but never exposed (signals industrial pipelines routinely discard) form a pool that is both relevant and reliably predictable. Over a 30-day horizon URED aggregates them and re-injects at recall time through a lightweight pipeline spanning offline storage, distributed aggregation, and low-latency online serving, adding under 1% latency via a single O(1) lookup per request with no model retraining. Online A/B tests show +3.47% discovered categories and +8.47% content richness with engagement preserved: completion video views rise significantly (+2.62%) and total views move positive (+0.36%, not significant). Ablations confirm both design pillars are necessary: a one-day window collapses the discovery gain to +0.55% (not significant), and random injection without score filtering yields no gain while trending negative on engagement (-0.17%). Across production recall channels, URED reaches 13.9x the platform-average discovery rate (6.3x the strongest nearline baseline) at engagement quality on par with the platform average. We share deployment details and lessons for practitioners facing the exploration-exploitation dilemma under tight resource constraints.

AI.tldr: URED 是一个免训练的召回阶段系统，通过回收"高分但未曝光"的物品池来帮助用户发现新兴趣，在淘宝线上服务超六个月，显著提升发现性与内容丰富度且保持互动。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统需要帮助用户发现新兴趣以维持长期健康，但常见做法（提升冷门新内容的曝光）在生产中常适得其反：注入信息稀疏的冷候选会被排序模型系统性高估，既无发现收益又有互动风险。
AI.method: URED 基于"高分但从未曝光"的物品（工业管线通常丢弃的信号）构成既相关又可可靠预测的池子；在30天窗口内聚合这些物品，并在召回时通过轻量管线（离线存储、分布式聚合、低延迟在线服务）重新注入，每请求单次 O(1) 查询，延迟开销 <1%，无需模型重训。
AI.result: 线上 A/B 测试：发现类目 +3.47%，内容丰富度 +8.47%，互动保持——完播视频观看显著 +2.62%，总观看 +0.36%（不显著）。消融验证两大设计支柱均必要：一天窗口使发现增益降至 +0.55%（不显著）；无分数过滤的随机注入无增益且互动略负（-0.17%）。在各召回渠道中，URED 发现率达平台平均的 13.9 倍（最强近线基线的 6.3 倍），互动质量与平台平均持平。
AI.conclusion: 在生产环境中，回收高分未曝光物品比朴素提升冷内容曝光更有效；URED 以极低资源代价解决了探索-利用困境，并提供了部署细节和实践经验。

title: Matching the Training-Time Weight Rule in Inference-Time Expert Deactivation
comment: Corresponding authors: Hanzhang Jia (lead corresponding) and Bo Ma
summary: Expert deactivation at inference time changes both token routing and expert weights, and its effect on performance depends on how these changes are implemented. We compare removal, freezing, remaining-expert renormalization, and unnormalized re-routing on identical disabled sets across five instruction-tuned checkpoints from four model families, with a base OLMoE checkpoint as an additional comparison. We develop a weight-sum model that relates the loss of expert contributions and changes in branch scale to the weight rule used during training. With half of the experts deactivated according to activation-based rankings, remaining-expert renormalization yields the highest perplexity in models trained with raw router probabilities, whereas unnormalized re-routing yields the highest perplexity in models trained with normalized weights. Perplexity ranges from 1.4 to 73 times the intact baseline when the training rule is retained, and from 14 to 28,740 times the baseline under a rule mismatch. Task outcomes vary across evaluation types: on OLMoE, GSM8K strict-match accuracy falls to zero under all four implementations. Extending the model to changes in the number of active experts yields a further prediction, supported by the OLMoE experiments: the perplexity penalty from additional renormalization increases as fewer experts are activated.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了推理阶段专家失活（移除、冻结、重归一化、非归一化重路由）对MoE模型的影响，发现性能取决于失活方式是否与训练时的路由权重规则匹配。
AI.motivation: 推理时专家失活会同时改变token路由和专家权重，其性能影响依赖于具体实现方式，但此前缺乏对多种实现方式在相同失活集合下的系统比较与机制解释。
AI.method: 在四个模型家族的五个指令微调checkpoint（外加一个基础OLMoE）上，于相同失活专家集合下比较四种实现：移除、冻结、剩余专家重归一化、非归一化重路由；并提出一个权重求和分析模型，将专家贡献损失与分支尺度变化同训练时采用的权重规则联系起来。
AI.result: 按激活排名失活一半专家时：用原始路由概率训练的模型在重归一化下困惑度最高，用归一化权重训练的模型在非归一化重路由下困惑度最高。规则匹配时困惑度为基线的1.4–73倍，规则不匹配时达14–28,740倍。任务表现因评估类型而异，OLMoE上GSM8K严格匹配准确率在四种实现下均降为零。模型进一步预测：激活专家数越少，额外重归一化带来的困惑度惩罚越大，OLMoE实验支持该预测。
AI.conclusion: 推理时专家失活的关键在于保持与训练时一致的路由权重规则；规则不匹配会导致灾难性性能下降，且该效应随激活专家数减少而加剧。

title: Anduin: A sybil-resistant agentic marketplace reputation system
summary:
As autonomous AI agents enter permissionless onchain markets, selecting new service providers remains a core challenge. Existing reputation systems depend on scarce resources like human curation, identity credentials, or voluntary reviews, while naive volume rankings are vulnerable to Sybil attacks.
  We evaluate whether existing onchain payment histories can yield provider ratings that are resilient against Sybil attacks. Using a 157-day dataset comprising 66M agentic transactions worth $6.1M across 16 blockchains, we model payment flows as a bipartite graph between buyers and providers. A provider's rating is derived from graph paths linked to a buyer's existing trusted network. We propose three Sybil-resistant rating algorithms: a max-flow rating and two relaxed algorithms optimized for stronger rating performance.
  Evaluating these algorithms against simulated adversaries across 813 buyers, we show that rating manipulation costs 20% of those buyers' total spend and is around 23x harder to manipulate than the standard similarity rule (collaborative filtering).

AI.tldr: 利用链上支付历史构建买卖双方二部图，提出三种抗女巫攻击的服务商评分算法，在6600万笔交易数据上验证操纵成本可达买家总支出20%、难度约为协同过滤的23倍。
AI.motivation: 自主AI代理进入无需许可的链上市场时，新服务商选择困难。现有声誉系统依赖人力策展、身份凭证或自愿评价等稀缺资源，而简单的交易量排名易受女巫攻击。
AI.method: 基于157天、覆盖16条区块链、6600万笔、价值610万美元的代理交易数据，将支付流建模为买方—服务商二部图；服务商评分由与买方已有信任网络相连的图路径推导；提出三种抗女巫评分算法：最大流评分及两种以获得更优评分表现而优化的松弛算法。
AI.result: 在813名买家和模拟攻击者上评估：评分操纵成本相当于这些买家总支出（花费）的20%，且操纵难度约为标准相似度规则（协同过滤）的23倍。
AI.conclusion: 链上支付历史可作为抗女巫攻击声誉信号的有效来源，基于信任网络路径的图评分显著优于传统协同过滤，为无需许可市场中的AI代理服务商选择提供可行方案。

title: On the Generalization Limitation of On-Policy Distillation for Post-RL Consolidation
summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) extends on-policy distillation (OPD) to consolidate capabilities from multiple teachers. Although prior work reports near-perfect in-distribution (IND) distillation performance, we find that this can mask incomplete capability consolidation beyond the supervised distribution. A preliminary study on synthetic reasoning shows that OPD does not fully transfer teachers' generalization capabilities. We then extend this investigation to real-world tasks, evaluating extrapolative and compositional generalization across mathematical reasoning, coding, agent, and long-context capabilities using Qwen3 models. Across extrapolative settings, OPD and MOPD reach 96.04-102.73% of their teachers' IND scores. Yet their out-of-distribution (OOD) scores remain 2.45-16.25% below the base model's. Across three compositional settings, MOPD improves IND performance over the base model, but its performance on composed tasks as OOD remains 18.19-24.34% below that of the best teachers. To understand these gaps, we examine teacher capability and data coverage as two potential bottlenecks. Jointly alleviating these bottlenecks eliminates OOD forgetting in our experiments and suggests the potential for generalization beyond the teacher. (M)OPD also reduces OOD forgetting on average relative to its reinforcement learning (RL) baselines. Analysis of the associated update geometry reveals smaller and more spectrally concentrated updates on average than those of the RL baselines, along with greater shared update structure under MOPD. Motivated by these findings, we propose geometry-based patching and base-preserving replay to improve OOD performance while largely preserving IND performance. Our findings identify a blind spot in capability consolidation via (M)OPD, highlighting the need for algorithms that explicitly support OOD retention and generalization.

AI.tldr: 多教师在线策略蒸馏(MOPD)在分布内近乎完美，但会掩盖分布外(OOD)泛化能力的丢失与不完整固化。
AI.motivation: 已有工作报告(多教师)在线策略蒸馏在IND上接近完美，作者怀疑这掩盖了对教师泛化能力（外推与组合）的固化不足，需系统检验该盲点。
AI.method: 先用合成推理做初步研究，再在Qwen3系列上评估数学推理、代码、Agent、长上下文四类能力的外推与三种组合泛化设置；分析教师能力与数据覆盖两个瓶颈，并考察更新几何（幅度、谱集中度、共享结构）；据此提出基于几何的补丁(geometry-based patching)与保留基座的回放(base-preserving replay)。
AI.result: 外推设置下OPD/MOPD达教师IND分数的96.04–102.73%，但OOD比基座低2.45–16.25%；组合设置下MOPD提升IND，但组合任务OOD比最佳教师低18.19–24.34%。同时缓解教师能力与数据覆盖两瓶颈可消除OOD遗忘并有望超越教师；(M)OPD平均比RL基线遗忘更少，更新更小、谱更集中且MOPD下共享结构更强。
AI.conclusion: (M)OPD存在能力固化的盲点：IND高分不能代表OOD保持；需显式支持OOD保持与泛化的算法，几何补丁与基座回放是可行的改善方向。

title: ChangeJEPA: Predict Before You Compare for Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Remote sensing change detection is typically formulated as Siamese feature comparison, where two images are encoded independently and a decoder determines which discrepancies correspond to meaningful change. This is challenging because the encoders preserve both true scene changes and nuisance variations such as illumination, seasonal, radiometric, and geometric differences. We introduce ChangeJEPA, a bitemporal joint-embedding predictive architecture that reformulates change detection as latent post-state prediction. Given a pre-change image and partial post-change evidence, ChangeJEPA predicts the full post-change representation under two complementary conditions: a prior hypothesis derived from the pre-change scene and an updated hypothesis conditioned on observed post-change context. A joint-embedding predictive loss aligns both hypotheses with the target latent representation, encouraging semantic consistency while suppressing transient appearance variations. Change is then inferred from the disagreement among the pre-change representation, the observed post-change target, and the predicted latent states, capturing complementary evidence of change, prior surprise, contextual update, and prediction reliability. Across SYSU-CD, LEVIR-CD+, and CDD, ChangeJEPA consistently outperforms its decoder matched Siamese baseline by up to 1.51 IoU points and achieves the best IoU and F1-score on all three benchmarks, demonstrating the advantage of latent post-state prediction over direct feature comparison. Page: https://buddhi19.github.io/ChangeJEPA

AI.tldr: ChangeJEPA将变化检测重构为潜在后状态预测，用联合嵌入预测损失对齐双假设，抑制瞬态外观变化，在三个基准上取得最佳IoU/F1。
AI.motivation: 传统孪生特征比较中，独立编码器同时保留了真实场景变化与光照、季节、辐射、几何等干扰变化，导致难以区分有意义变化。
AI.method: 双时相联合嵌入预测架构：给定变化前图像与部分变化后证据，在两种条件下预测完整后状态表示（由变化前场景导出的先验假设、以观测后变化上下文为条件的更新假设）；用联合嵌入预测损失将两假设与目标潜表示对齐，并由变化前表示、观测目标与预测潜状态间的不一致推断变化，涵盖互补变化证据、先验惊讶度、上下文更新与预测可靠性。
AI.result: 在SYSU-CD、LEVIR-CD+、CDD上均获最佳IoU与F1，相较解码器匹配的孪生基线最高提升1.51 IoU点。
AI.conclusion: 潜在后状态预测优于直接特征比较，能提升变化检测的语义一致性与鲁棒性。

title: SBVUL: Statement-Based Vulnerability Detection
summary: Many recent approaches for vulnerability detection use large language models (LLMs) to classify functions as vulnerable or benign, leaving developers to locate the exploitable statements. Furthermore, while these approaches have shown performance improvements, they still fall short in distinguishing vulnerable from patched real-world functions. This paper presents SBVul, an agentic approach that detects exploitable statements in C/C++ functions. In Phase~1, an LLM agent explores the function and its repository and identifies candidate statements. In Phase~2, a second agent analyzes the control and data flow of each candidate and confirms it, rules it out, or marks it uncertain. We created a manually verified ground truth of exploitable statements for 200 pairs of the PrimeVul Paired test set and ran SBVul with the open-weight models Qwen 3.8 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Anthropic's Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5. Phase~1 identifies ground-truth statements in 56--77% of the vulnerable functions, and Phase~2 confirms such a statement with an explanation accepted by an LLM judge in 26--73%. However, all models also confirm candidates in 23--61% of the patched functions. Across vulnerable and patched functions, the highest statement-level precision is 0.315 at a recall of 0.605 obtained with Opus 5.5 (xhigh). At the function level, SBVul with Opus 5.5 classifies 42.0% of the pairs correctly, compared with 33.8% reported for the best previous approach.

AI.tldr: SBVul 是一个基于 LLM 智能体的 C/C++ 漏洞可触发语句检测方法：第一阶段探索函数及代码仓库定位候选语句，第二阶段分析候选语句的控制流与数据流进行确认，在 200 对 PrimeVul 配对测试集上取得语句级最高精度 0.315（召回 0.605，Opus 5.5），函数级配对正确率 42.0%，优于此前最佳的 33.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的漏洞检测多只做函数级"易感/良性"二分类，仍需开发者自行定位可利用语句；且模型难以区分真实世界中易感函数与已修补函数，配对场景下性能不足。
AI.method: 构建两阶段智能体流程：Phase 1 由 LLM 智能体探索目标函数及其仓库，生成候选可利用语句；Phase 2 由第二个智能体分析每个候选语句的控制流与数据流，给出确认/排除/不确定结论。另为 PrimeVul 配对测试集的 200 对函数人工标注可触发语句真值，并用 Qwen 3.8、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Sonnet 5.5、Opus 5.5 进行评测。
AI.result: Phase 1 在 56–77% 的易感函数中命中真值语句；Phase 2 在 26–73% 的案例中确认语句并给出被 LLM 评审接受的解释；但所有模型在 23–61% 的已修补函数中仍确认候选（误报明显）。语句级最高精度 0.315、对应召回 0.605（Opus 5.5 xhigh）；函数级配对分类正确率 42.0%，高于此前最佳 33.8%。
AI.conclusion: SBVul 将漏洞检测推进到语句级并优于先前函数级方法，但仍存在显著局限：在已修补函数上的高确认率导致精度偏低，难以可靠区分易感与修补版本，语句级定位与误报控制仍是后续改进重点。

title: ArcRAG: Agentic Compositional Retrieval over Knowledge Graphs
summary: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) answers questions by retrieving over a knowledge graph built from a corpus. Yet retrieval strategies are designed around the structure their own construction pipeline produces, and whether they survive a change of construction is rarely tested. We study this cross-construction portability: whether one retrieval procedure, with no construction-specific schema, relation names, or retuning, stays effective when the graph is built differently. We introduce ArcRAG, which induces a query-local graph interface at inference time (the node labels, relation descriptors, and property keys reachable from the entities a question names), plans multi-hop traversals against it, and executes and repairs them as Cypher. We build each of the MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and TriviaQA corpora as a schema-guided graph (typed nodes, a closed relation set, source provenance) and as an open-information-extraction graph (untyped nodes, free-text relations), with the retriever's configuration fixed across them. We compare against a construction-agnostic Direct-Cypher agent, ablate each stage across retry and pass budgets on both graph families, and compare with results reported for prior GraphRAG systems, most of which design retrieval together with their own graph construction. Across the two constructions, we find that retrieval need not be co-designed with the graph: query-time interface induction keeps a construction-agnostic retriever effective when the construction changes, although construction still shapes absolute accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出ArcRAG：在推理时从问题所命名实体可达的标签、关系描述与属性键中诱导查询局部图接口，规划多跳遍历并以Cypher执行与修复；在schema引导图和开放IE图两种构建下配置固定，验证检索器无需与图构建协同设计。
AI.motivation: 现有GraphRAG的检索策略往往围绕自身构建流水线产出的结构来设计，缺乏对"更换图构建方式后检索是否仍有效"的跨构建可移植性检验。
AI.method: 将MuSiQue、HotpotQA、TriviaQA分别构建为schema引导图（类型化节点、封闭关系集、来源溯源）与开放信息抽取图（无类型节点、自由文本关系），检索器配置在两者间保持一致。ArcRAG在推理时诱导查询局部图接口，规划多跳遍历，并以Cypher执行和修复；对照构建无关的Direct-Cypher智能体，在重试与轮次预算下消融各阶段，并与既有GraphRAG系统报告结果比较。
AI.result: 在两种图构建下，查询时接口诱导使构建无关的检索器在构建变化时仍保持有效；但构建方式仍影响绝对准确率。
AI.conclusion: 检索不必与图构建协同设计：跨构建可移植性可通过查询时接口诱导实现，同时需承认图构建本身对绝对性能的制约。

title: Learning When Human Decisions Matter: Executor-Relative Consultation Value for LLM Agents
summary: Large language models increasingly automate complex tasks, but human decision capacity does not scale with their capabilities. In many applications, humans remain essential for providing private context, authority, or judgments unavailable to the agent. We formulate human decision capacity allocation: given multiple consultation opportunities and a limited budget, at which decisions should an LLM agent consult a human? The central challenge is estimating consultation value, which is executor-dependent because the same human input may benefit different downstream agents differently. We introduce Consultation Value Distillation (CVD), which estimates consultation values offline using Monte Carlo executor rollouts and distills these values into lightweight predictors for budgeted allocation, requiring no rollout-based value estimation at deployment. Across five batch and three sequential settings with two frontier executors, CVD improves allocation through joint and continuation-aware value learning, while independent consultation values remain competitive in several settings. CVD also broadly outperforms direct prompting and Value of Information where applicable, remains robust with substantially less rollout supervision, and enables nearly lossless approximate allocation at low search cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"人类决策容量分配"问题，并用咨询价值蒸馏（CVD）方法解决在有限预算下LLM智能体应在哪些决策点咨询人类的问题。
AI.motivation: LLM能力快速增长但人类决策容量无法同步扩展；许多场景中人类仍不可或缺（提供私有背景、权威或判断）。核心难点是咨询价值依赖执行者，同一人类输入对不同下游智能体的收益不同。
AI.method: CVD通过蒙特卡洛执行者rollout离线估计咨询价值，并将其蒸馏为轻量预测器用于预算化分配，部署时无需再做基于rollout的价值估计；同时支持联合式与延续感知的价值学习。
AI.result: 在五个批量与三个序列设置、两种前沿执行者上，CVD通过联合与延续感知价值学习改进分配；独立咨询价值在若干设置中仍有竞争力。CVD在适用处总体优于直接提示与信息价值（VoI）方法，在rollout监督大幅减少时仍稳健，并能以低搜索成本实现近乎无损的近似分配。
AI.conclusion: 咨询价值可离线估计并蒸馏为高效预测器，实现预算受限下有效的人机决策分配；CVD具备稳健性与高效性。

title: Verified but Vacuous: Three Failure Surfaces of LLM-Driven Verified Code Generation
summary: What should ``verified'' mean when evaluating LLM-generated code? Many existing pipelines report a single verification number. We argue this collapses three distinct properties measured in a conditional audit sequence: verifier acceptance (Surface A), \emph{syntactic specification binding (Surface B: does the proof obligation bind to the spec?), and \emph{semantic specification fidelity} (Surface C: does the spec capture the informal requirement?). Two empirical demonstrations show the surfaces separate. \textbf{First ($A \neq B$), via Li@Opus (a same-model reproduction of \citet{li2025dafny}'s Dafny-as-intermediate-representation (IR) pipeline under Claude Opus 4.7) on three Python benchmarks}: it reaches \textbf{99.1\% verifier acceptance} on HumanEval while only \textbf{1.9\%} carry a certificate binding to a spec-defined predicate or function. \textbf{Second ($B \neq C$), via VCG on two Rust benchmarks}: we use VCG (which is our own in-house Dafny-as-intermediate pipeline) on Rust because the Rust target lets us enforce fully-verifiable output (every component ships as a Dafny certificate, ensures-binding gate passing by construction). Even inside that construction, \textbf{11.48\% (MBPP-Rust) and 14.82\% (VeriContest LC slice) of structurally-verified samples still fail hidden tests}. On the LC slice of VeriContest, \textbf{VCG's reported End2End rate is 7.79\% (535/6870).} The cited external rates are 5.51\% (GPT-5.5) and 1.88\% (single-shot Opus 4.7). These give descriptive differences of 2.3 percentage points and 4.14$\times$, respectively; task-budget, repair and harness differences prevent a matched-performance claim.

AI.tldr: 论文主张代码验证的"单一验证数字"会混淆三层不同属性：验证器接受（Surface A）、句法规范绑定（Surface B）、语义规范保真（Surface C），并用两组实验证明这三层可分离。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代码验证流水线只报告一个验证率数字，掩盖了"验证真的意味着正确吗"这一问题："通过验证"可能只是验证器接受，未必绑定到规范，更未必规范本身正确。
AI.method: 提出条件化审计序列，把验证拆为三层表面。演示一（A≠B）：用Li@Opus（Claude Opus 4.7下复现Dafny-as-IR流水线）在三个Python基准上，统计验证器接受率与真正绑定到spec定义谓词/函数的证书比例。演示二（B≠C）：用自研VCG（Dafny中间表示流水线）在Rust上，因Rust目标可强制全可验证输出（每个组件附Dafny证书、构造上通过ensures绑定门），再测结构验证样本在隐藏测试上的失败率。
AI.result: A≠B：HumanEval上验证器接受率达99.1%，但仅1.9%带有绑定到spec谓词/函数的证书。B≠C：MBPP-Rust 11.48%、VeriContest LC切片14.82%的结构验证样本仍失败隐藏测试。VeriContest LC切片上VCG报告End2End为7.79%（535/6870），对比外部GPT-5.5的5.51%、单次Opus 4.7的1.88%，描述性差异为2.3个百分点与4.14倍；因任务预算、修复与测试框架差异，不构成匹配性能比较。
AI.conclusion: "已验证"应被分解报告为A/B/C三层，单数字验证率会系统性高估正确性；论文以描述性证据展示三层分离，但明确不宣称匹配条件下的性能优越性，呼吁更细粒度的验证审计协议。

title: LACS: Distribution-Sensitive Label-Agnostic Confidence Selection for Dynamic Data Pruning
summary: Training on large datasets motivates selecting which examples receive expensive training computation. Fixed quotas determine the amount of pruning in advance, while absolute confidence cutoffs depend on the score scale. We study a population-relative alternative that adapts the threshold and retained count together. We introduce LACS (Label-Agnostic Confidence Selector), a training-time rule based on maximum predictive confidence, requiring neither labels at selection time nor per-example gradients. LACS removes examples at or above a log-mean-exp reference plus a margin. We characterize its sensitivity to score gaps and mass, and derive an exact no-pruning condition. For $0<ρ<1$, the removed fraction is at most $ρ$ and at least one example remains. The unsigned score permits both confidently correct and confidently wrong examples to be removed. Seven evaluation settings include neural training, language modeling, and boosting. Neural execution studies reduce backward-active rows by 10-35%; on CIFAR-10, 29% fewer backward rows accompany accuracy means of 89.77% versus 89.82% for full CE. At a matched backward budget and number of optimizer updates, LACS is 1.0 pp above small-batch training and 1.2 pp above random selection over five seeds. Across 14 tabular datasets, quadratic boosting reduces mean test error from 23.36% to 22.96%. Its full training replays use about 30% fewer fitting rows; these counters span a different horizon from validation-selected accuracy. In one RBF-SVM case study, elapsed time falls by 37% with slightly lower error. These findings separate selective-work reduction from realized acceleration: the current exact-current-score neural implementation uses an additional scoring forward, so its backward sparsity does not yet translate into wall-clock acceleration. This overhead is an execution choice rather than a requirement of the selection rule.

AI.tldr: 提出LACS（标签无关置信度选择器），用基于log-mean-exp的相对阈值在训练中自适应地剔除高置信度样本，在神经训练、语言建模与boosting等七类设置中减少10-35%反向传播行而不损精度，但当前实现因额外打分前向尚未转化为实际加速。
AI.motivation: 大训练集促使选择性计算，但固定配额需预设剪枝量、绝对置信度阈值依赖分数尺度，二者都不能随训练自适应调整阈值与保留数量。
AI.method: LACS基于最大预测置信度，无需标签也无需逐样本梯度；剔除分数≥log-mean-exp参考值加margin的样本。理论刻画其对分数差距与质量的敏感性，给出精确的"不剪枝"条件；对0<ρ<1，剔除比例不超过ρ且至少保留一个样本。
AI.result: 神经执行研究中反向活跃行减少10-35%；CIFAR-10上反向行少29%，精度89.77% vs 全CE 89.82%；相同反向预算与更新次数下比小批量训练高1.0pp、比随机选择高1.2pp（5种子）；14个表格数据集上二次boosting平均测试误差从23.36%降至22.96%，全训练重放拟合行少约30%；RBF-SVM案例耗时降37%、误差略降。
AI.conclusion: 区分了"选择性计算削减"与"实际加速"：当前基于精确当前分数的神经实现需额外一次打分前向，故反向稀疏未带来墙钟加速，但这属执行方式的选择而非选择规则的必然要求。

title: Whose Values Are Generated? Measuring Visual Value Leakage in Multilingual Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) systems serve users across languages and cultural contexts. However, evaluations of cultural representation focus mainly on recognizable elements such as landmarks, clothing, and activities, overlooking the cultural values that generated images convey. To bridge this gap, we introduce VisionValueBench, a multilingual benchmark that operationalizes six of Hofstede's cultural value dimensions (e.g., individualism versus collectivism) to investigate how T2I systems frame neutral social situations through a particular cultural orientation. We find that value-neutral prompts, which admit diverse cultural interpretations, nonetheless yield images that favor particular value orientations, a phenomenon we call visual value leakage. We evaluate prompts varying in language and geographic cues across 960 social scenarios and six T2I configurations. Generated images consistently favor the same value orientations across all six dimensions, for example, equality over hierarchy (low power distance), individual autonomy over group obligation (individualism), and enjoyment over restraint (indulgence). Prompt language has limited influence on these orientations, whereas geographic cues shift some dimensions toward the associated cultural values while largely preserving the prevailing orientations. These findings reveal substantial homogeneity in the cultural values conveyed by T2I systems worldwide.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多语言基准VisionValueBench，用Hofstede六个文化价值维度衡量文生图系统生成图像传达的文化价值取向，发现"价值泄漏"现象：价值中立提示也稳定偏向特定取向，且跨语言高度同质。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I文化表征评估主要关注地标、服饰、活动等可识别元素，忽视生成图像所传达的文化价值观念，缺乏相应的多语言评测手段。
AI.method: 构建VisionValueBench多语言基准，将Hofstede六种文化价值维度（如个人主义vs集体主义）操作化，用960个社会场景、不同语言与地理线索的提示，评测6种T2I配置通过中立社会情境所体现的价值取向。
AI.result: 中立提示生成的图像仍偏向特定价值取向（视觉价值泄漏），且在六个维度上一致偏向：低权力距离（平等优于等级）、个人主义（自主优于群体义务）、放纵（享乐优于克制）；提示语言影响有限，地理线索仅在部分维度上向对应文化价值偏移，但总体取向基本保留。
AI.conclusion: T2I系统在全球范围内传达的文化价值呈现显著同质性，文化评估需从可识别元素扩展到价值取向层面。

title: CoSafe: Cooperative Runtime Safety Assurance for Mixed-Traffic Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted by the 49th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE 2027). 13 pages
summary:
With the rapid development of autonomous driving systems (ADSes), real-world roads are evolving into mixed-traffic environments where autonomous vehicles (AVs) and other traffic participants (e.g., human-driven vehicles (HDVs), cyclists, and pedestrians) coexist and interact with each other. However, current ADSes still incur various safety violations in mixed traffic scenarios, raising a strong demand for runtime safety assurance frameworks that can continuously monitor hazards and prevent potential violations. Existing ego-centric assurance approaches are insufficient for mixed traffic, where violations often arise from locally reasonable yet jointly incompatible decisions among multiple vehicles and cannot be reliably resolved through independent takeover.
  To bridge this gap, we propose CoSafe, a modular and ADS-agnostic cooperative runtime safety assurance framework for mixed-traffic autonomous driving to extend runtime safety assurance from ego-centric takeover to scene-level cooperative intervention. CoSafe leverages vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication to enable roadside units (RSUs) to monitor scene-level hazards and jointly mitigate hazards involving multiple vehicles. We integrate CoSafe with seven state-of-the-art ADSes, and our evaluation on the InterDrive benchmark demonstrates that CoSafe improves the driving score of AVs by 70.03% on average, reduces safety violations by 87.80%, and accurately identifies unsafe AVs with an F3 score of 0.930, while satisfying real-time constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出CoSafe——面向混合交通的模块化、与ADS无关的协同运行时安全保证框架，借助V2X让路侧单元进行场景级危险监测与多车协同干预，将自车接管扩展为场景级协同干预。
AI.motivation: 混合交通中安全违规常源于多车"局部合理但联合不相容"的决策，现有以自车为中心的保证方法无法仅靠独立接管可靠化解。
AI.method: 利用V2X通信，由RSU监测场景级危险，并对涉及多车的危险进行联合缓解；框架模块化、与具体ADS解耦。
AI.result: 在InterDrive基准上接入7种SOTA ADS，驾驶分数平均提升70.03%，安全违规减少87.80%，以0.930的F3分数识别不安全AV，并满足实时约束。
AI.conclusion: 场景级协同干预优于自车中心接管，可为混合交通自动驾驶提供有效的运行时安全保障。

title: Alternatives to Shallow Autoencoders for Collaborative Filtering
summary:
Collaborative filtering (CF) is a cornerstone of recommender systems and plays a relevant role in many modern applications. CF uses user-item interaction data to discover future preferences. Although deep learning models have shown promise in CF, Embarrassingly Shallow Autoencoders for Sparse Data (EASE) has gained attention for its outstanding ranking accuracy provided by its closed-form solution. EASE relies primarily on relationships among items to fit a full-rank high-dimensional linear mapping. We hypothesize that this design limits its capacity to capture similar but not equivalent fine-grained user relationships, consequently limiting its recommendation accuracy. This paper introduces an alternative formulation based on EASE that takes advantage of user-user information. Furthermore, we propose a hybrid model that combines both user-user and item-item adjacency distributions.
  Our experiments reveal that the proposed models outperform EASE on well-known recommendation benchmarks, highlighting the significance of including the user alternative in shallow autoencoder studies for CF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于EASE的替代公式，利用用户-用户信息，并结合用户-用户与物品-物品邻接分布的混合模型，在多个基准上优于EASE。
AI.motivation: EASE依赖物品间关系拟合满秩高维线性映射，作者假设这一设计限制了其捕捉相似但不相同的细粒度用户关系的能力，从而限制了推荐准确率。
AI.method: 提出基于EASE的、利用用户-用户信息的替代公式（user-user浅层自编码器），并进一步提出融合用户-用户与物品-物品邻接分布的混合模型。
AI.result: 在知名推荐基准上，所提模型在排名准确率上优于EASE。
AI.conclusion: 纳入用户侧信息对协同过滤中的浅层自编码器研究具有重要意义，用户-用户视角是提升EASE类模型性能的有效途径。

title: TandemBench: Benchmarking Decision Models for Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Decision models choose among predefined options in tasks such as routing and action selection. In multi-agent collaboration, a decision determines how members divide work, exchange resources, and act in parallel. We introduce TandemBench, a benchmark of 1,200 questions in multi-agent cooking scenarios where coordination choices affect goal completion. Models receive complete global information and candidate team plans, with reference answers established through execution and exact search. Models select an optimal team plan and, in paired variants that retain or remove it, judge whether better arrangements exist beyond the supplied options. We evaluate 40 native decision models and compare them with 10 general-purpose language models. The best native decision model achieves 62.50% decision accuracy. Native decision models remain close to chance in optimality verification. Paired tests reveal that some report better alternatives regardless of whether an optimal plan is already present. These findings show that team-plan decision accuracy alone can conceal systematic errors in judging whether the supplied options contain an optimal arrangement. The dataset and evaluation code are publicly available at https://github.com/lililibaohang/TandemBench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TandemBench，一个含 1200 题的多智能体烹饪协作基准，用于评估决策模型在团队计划选择与最优性验证两类任务上的能力，并揭示仅看决策准确率会掩盖系统性错误。
AI.motivation: 多智能体协作中决策涉及分工、资源交换与并行行动，现有评测仅关注从预设选项中选择，无法判断模型是否真正理解"所选方案是否最优"，也难以识别模型何时会误报存在更优方案。
AI.method: 构建多智能体烹饪场景的 1200 题基准，向模型提供完整全局信息与候选团队计划，参考答案由执行模拟和精确搜索确定；任务包含选择最优团队计划，以及配对变体（保留或移除最优方案）下判断是否存在更优安排；评测 40 个原生决策模型并与 10 个通用大模型对比。
AI.result: 最佳原生决策模型决策准确率仅 62.50%；原生模型在最优性验证上接近随机；配对测试显示部分模型无论是否存在最优方案都倾向于报告存在更优替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭团队计划决策准确率会掩盖模型在最优性判断上的系统性偏差，需要将选择与验证能力分开评测；数据集与评估代码已公开。

title: Hybrid Spark: Adaptive Speculative Decoding That Lets the Content Choose the Drafter
summary: Speculative decoding (SD) speeds up large language model (LLM) serving, but its gain depends on the workload's \emph{shape}, such as batch size and context length, and on its \emph{content}. A model-based drafter proposes a short block on any content, while a model-free drafter such as n-gram lookup proposes long copies at almost no cost when the output repeats its input, as in code editing. Adaptive verification spends a batch-wide verification budget on the draft tokens most likely to be accepted, but it supports only one model-based drafter. Model-free drafters provide no per-token confidence, so they cannot take part in budget allocation, and deployments must either fix one drafter or split their GPUs between drafters. We present \sys, a framework that runs a model-based and a model-free drafter on every step and gives each request the better of their chains, within adaptive verification and entirely on the GPU, which keeps asynchronous scheduling intact. The key idea is a price per verified draft token: the goodput that slot would earn elsewhere in the batch. Once the model-free drafter's tokens carry calibrated acceptance estimates, fit once on general text, this price puts both drafters' chains on one scale. Instantiated with \dspark and an n-gram drafter in vLLM, \sys achieves 1.10--1.62\x the output throughput of \dspark on code editing at batch size~4 and 1.04--1.27\x at batch size~128, while staying at 0.97--1.01\x of it on chat at temperature~0. A single deployment can therefore serve both workloads.

AI.tldr: 提出 \sys 框架，在同一次解码步骤中同时运行基于模型和无模型的草稿器，通过"每个被验证草稿 token 的代价"统一尺度，在 GPU 上完成自适应验证并保持异步调度，从而让单一部署同时适配代码编辑与聊天负载。
AI.motivation: 投机解码（SD）的加速收益依赖工作负载形状（批大小、上下文长度）与内容：基于模型的草稿器普适但草稿短；无模型（如 n-gram 查表）草稿器在输出重复输入时（如代码编辑）能以近乎零成本给出长复制，但没有逐 token 置信度，无法参与自适应验证的预算分配。现有部署只能固定单一草稿器或把 GPU 拆分给多个草稿器，无法兼顾两类负载。
AI.method: 每步同时运行基于模型与无模型的草稿器，并为每个请求选取更优的候选链。核心是"每验证草稿 token 的价格"——即该验证槽位在批内别处可获得的 goodput（有效吞吐）；先在大规模通用文本上一次性拟合无模型草稿器 token 的校准接受率估计，使两类草稿链处于同一可比较尺度，从而统一纳入自适应验证的批级预算分配，且全过程在 GPU 上完成以保持异步调度。基于 \dspark 与 n-gram 草稿器在 vLLM 中实现。
AI.result: 代码编辑场景下，批大小 4 时输出吞吐为 \dspark 的 1.10–1.62 倍，批大小 128 时为 1.04–1.27 倍；温度为 0 的聊天场景下为 0.97–1.01 倍，几乎无损失。
AI.conclusion: 通过代价化的统一预算分配，异构草稿器可协同工作，使单次部署同时高效服务代码编辑与低温度聊天两类差异明显的工作负载。

title: Multimodal Fusion Methods for Whole-Slide Images and Clinical Data in Inflammatory Bowel Disease
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, Submitted to the 2027 IEEE 24th International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI)
summary: Multimodal AI fusion of histology and clinical data is an active research area in computational pathology, but fusion methods are rarely compared under identical conditions and across different clinical endpoints. We present a modular framework in which slide-level embeddings, obtained by training an attention-based aggregator over patch embeddings from a frozen foundation model, and per-visit clinical embeddings are fed into 15 interchangeable fusion methods with a shared output dimension and prediction head (except decision-level methods). Using a prospective cohort of newly diagnosed inflammatory bowel disease patients, we predicted STRIDE-II-aligned remission outcomes from baseline or follow-up visits. The best fusion method reached macro-F1 of 0.57-0.75, outperforming both single-modality models in four of six scenarios, and differed by outcome and input. Image reliance, the drop in balanced accuracy when the slide embedding is removed, tended to follow the remission type - highest for histological and lowest for endoscopic remission; methods with similar accuracy relied on the slide to very different degrees.

AI.tldr: 提出模块化框架，在相同条件下比较15种融合方法，将组织学与临床数据融合用于预测IBD患者的STRIDE-II缓解结局。
AI.motivation: 多模态AI融合在计算病理学中活跃，但融合方法很少在完全相同条件下、跨不同临床终点进行比较。
AI.method: 冻结基础模型补丁嵌入经注意力聚合器得到切片级嵌入，与每次就诊的临床嵌入一起输入15种可互换融合方法（共享输出维度与预测头，决策级方法除外）；在新诊断IBD前瞻队列上预测STRIDE-II缓解结局。
AI.result: 最佳融合方法macro-F1达0.57–0.75，在6个场景中4个优于单模态模型；最佳方法因结局和输入而异。图像依赖度（移除切片嵌入后平衡准确率下降）随缓解类型变化：组织学缓解最高，内镜缓解最低；准确率相近的方法对图像依赖程度差异很大。
AI.conclusion: 融合方法优劣依赖结局与输入模态，需在统一条件下系统比较；仅看准确率不足，还应评估模态依赖度。

title: Bug2Scenario: Root-Cause-Preserving Test Scenario Amplification for Autonomous Driving Software
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, and 2 tables. Accepted at APSEC 2026. Yuchen Cao and Zhenyu Mao contributed equally. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/YgcCoder/Bug2Sce
summary: Simulation-based fuzzing exposes autonomous driving system (ADS) failures by repeatedly mutating and executing scenarios, but converting one failure into reusable regression scenarios remains difficult. Such variants test whether the mechanism persists after software changes, for example by varying weather or actor placement while retaining a collision's actor-route conflict. We present Bug2Scenario, a root-cause-guided post-fuzzing framework. From scenario data, traces, and oracle evidence, it extracts a root-cause pattern. An LLM proposes semantic variations over actors, missions, routes, and weather. Deterministic rules construct DriveFuzz-compatible scenarios. Execution evidence and manual review assess preservation. Separating these responsibilities prevents fluency, syntax, or recurring labels from masquerading as causal evidence. Under matched seeds, six LLM backbones, candidate budget, and execution pipeline, Bug2Scenario improves strict preservation by 6.7 percentage points (p=0.104; not significant) and boundary-inclusive preservation by 10.6 points (p=0.011). Feedback helps some initially unsuccessful seeds yield a strictly preserved candidate. Seed-level stopping then avoids further API calls and simulator runs. Remaining failures reflect actor-placement constraints, simulator instability, and incomplete or conflicting causal evidence. Bug2Scenario thus produces reliable ADS regression assets. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/YgcCoder/Bug2Sce.

AI.tldr: Bug2Scenario 是一个根因引导的模糊测试后处理框架，将单个 ADS 失效场景转化为可复用的回归场景变体，严格保持率提升 6.7 个百分点（不显著），含边界情形提升 10.6 个百分点（p=0.011）。
AI.motivation: 基于仿真的模糊测试能反复变异执行场景来暴露自动驾驶系统（ADS）失效，但把一次失效转化为可复用的回归场景仍很困难。回归变体需在改变天气、参与者位置等非本质因素时保留原始碰撞的"参与者-路线冲突"等机制，以检验软件变更后故障是否依然存在。
AI.method: 从场景数据、执行轨迹与 oracle 证据中提取根因模式；由 LLM 针对参与者、任务、路线与天气提出语义变异；用确定性规则构造 DriveFuzz 兼容场景；再通过执行证据与人工评审评估保持性。职责分离可避免语言流畅性、语法正确性或反复出现的标签被误当作因果证据。
AI.result: 在匹配种子、六种 LLM 骨干、候选预算与执行流水线的条件下，严格保持率提升 6.7 个百分点（p=0.104，不显著），含边界情形的保持率提升 10.6 个百分点（p=0.011）。反馈机制可使部分初始失败的种子产出严格保持的候选；按种子级停止策略进一步节省 API 调用与仿真运行。
AI.conclusion: Bug2Scenario 能生成可靠的 ADS 回归资产。残余失败主要源于参与者位置约束、仿真器不稳定以及因果证据不完整或相互冲突。代码见 https://github.com/YgcCoder/Bug2Sce。

title: Balancing hierarchical representation and quantization: A performance trade-off in text embeddings
comment: 29 pages. Authors' version of the open access article published in Information Sciences (CC BY 4.0). This version corrects the second affiliation of Marco Polignano (Otto von Guericke University Magdeburg); the published version lists the European Commission, Joint Research Centre (JRC) in error. Marco Polignano is not affiliated with the JRC. No other content has been changed
summary: Hierarchical text embedding models offer variable-length representations, while quantization reduces numerical precision; both aim to improve computational efficiency. This work is an empirical benchmark study of how these two orthogonal, already-established techniques interact. We evaluate 38 tasks from the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) using four transformer-based embedding models, covering 1D and 2D hierarchical representations combined with 32-bit, 8-bit, and binary quantization, for 168 configurations per task. We report each efficiency dimension separately: theoretical per-vector storage and end-to-end evaluation time. Under a Friedman test with Nemenyi post-hoc analysis, int8 quantization is statistically indistinguishable from float32 for pair classification and re-ranking and costs at most 1.5 percentage points overall, whereas binary quantization is significantly worse across every task category. Halving the embedding dimension once is not statistically detectable above $m=16$; two successive halvings always are. Combining an 8x dimensionality reduction with int8 yields a 32x reduction in per-vector storage at 94.4% of baseline effectiveness. Because evaluation times were measured once, we treat them as indicative: we find no evidence that quantization speeds up evaluation, whereas sampling from intermediate layers shortens it substantially. Retrieval degrades far faster than every other category, so we report findings per task category.

AI.tldr: 该论文是一项实证基准研究，评估层次化文本嵌入（1D/2D变长表示）与量化（fp32/int8/binary）这两种正交效率技术的交互效果。基于MTEB的38个任务、4个模型、168种配置，发现int8量化几乎无损（≤1.5pp），binary量化显著变差；结合8倍降维与int8可实现32倍存储压缩并保留94.4%效果。
AI.motivation: 层次化嵌入（可变长度表示）与量化（降低数值精度）都是已成熟的效率技术，但二者如何交互缺乏系统性实证了解，作者希望填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在MTEB的38个任务上，用4个transformer嵌入模型，将1D与2D层次表示分别搭配fp32、int8、binary量化，共168种配置/任务；分别报告每向量理论存储与端到端评测时间；用Friedman检验加Nemenyi事后分析进行统计比较。
AI.result: int8量化在配对分类与重排序任务上与fp32统计上无差异，整体最多损失1.5个百分点；binary量化在所有任务类别上显著更差。嵌入维度减半一次在m>16时不可检测，连续两次减半则可检测。8倍降维+int8带来32倍存储压缩且保留94.4%基线效果。量化未显示出加速评测的证据，而中间层采样能显著缩短评测时间。检索任务退化远快于其他类别。
AI.conclusion: int8是安全的量化选择，binary不可取；降维与量化可叠加获得大幅存储收益；效果需按任务类别分别报告，检索对效率折损最敏感；评测时间结果仅为指示性（单次测量），未发现量化加速评测。

title: CARTBench: Rubric-Based Evaluation of Shopping Advice for Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines
summary: Large language model (LLM) shopping assistants now recommend products in multi-turn conversations. However, reliable evaluation faces Data scarcity and Difficulty Standardizing Criteria. To address these obstacles, we introduce CARTBench for CART (Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines). For Data scarcity, we curate cases from real commercial shopping needs across 17 retail domains, pairing timestamped dialogue with 1,603 product records. For Difficulty Standardizing Criteria, we develop case-specific rubrics guided by Ideal Response Principles, distilled from excellent replies manually selected from successfully completed orders. These principles also guide Principle-Guided CART Prompting, our structured recommendation strategy. The experimental benchmark contains 1,328 expert-annotated criteria across Core, Excellence, and Safety. To answer the CART question, we evaluate 7 flagship commercial API models, including GPT-6.1-Sol and Claude-Opus-5, and 35B+ parameters open-weight models. In the first full-suite evaluation under the frozen rubrics, 3 of 10 models exceed 90% on Core, while none exceeds 45% on Excellence. Therefore, we identify an understanding-to-execution gap between required behavior and high-quality purchase advice. To examine these limitations, we diagnose shared failures in product evidence and unresolved needs, linked to changing requirements and decisive unknowns. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Da1yuqin/CARTBench.

AI.tldr: 提出CARTBench基准，用于评估多轮对话中LLM购物助手处理复杂模糊且带时间线请求的能力，含真实案例、案例专属评分细则与原则引导提示策略，揭示"理解—执行"鸿沟。
AI.motivation: LLM购物助手已在多轮对话中推荐商品，但可靠评估面临两大障碍：数据稀缺（缺乏真实商业购物场景数据）与评分标准难以统一（复杂模糊请求缺乏客观评判依据）。
AI.method: 从17个零售领域的真实商业购物需求中整理案例，配时间戳对话与1,603条商品记录；依据成功订单中人工精选的优质回复提炼"理想响应原则"，据此构建案例专属rubrics，并提出Principle-Guided CART Prompting结构化推荐策略；基准含1,328条专家标注标准，分为Core、Excellence、Safety三类。评估7个旗舰商业API模型（含GPT-6.1-Sol、Claude-Opus-5）及35B+参数开源模型。
AI.result: 冻结rubrics下首次全量评测中，10个模型中3个在Core维度超过90%，但无一在Excellence维度超过45%，显示理解与执行之间存在差距；诊断发现共享失败集中于产品证据不足与未解决需求，与需求变化及关键未知项相关。
AI.conclusion: CARTBench揭示了LLM购物助手在高质量购买建议上的系统性短板，即理解到执行的鸿沟，并指出产品证据与需求消解是主要瓶颈，为后续改进提供方向。

title: ViBench 2.0: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Software Building
summary: On Replit, our agentic engineering platform, users now build entire products without writing code, through successive feature requests to an agent. Yet existing coding benchmarks evaluate single, fully specified tasks, and many are near saturation. We introduce ViBench 2.0, a benchmark for long-horizon software building that we use to select our platform's models. Its 17 full-stack web products, modeled on widely used software, grow over 241 feature requests and are judged only when finished, as a user would judge them: a browser agent runs 544 test plans, and a build passes only if every plan does, under a grading protocol validated to keep this strict score reliable. Evaluating nine models, we find a reliability gap: the three strongest pass up to 98% of test plans yet deliver a fully working product in at most 65% of builds, and no open-weight model delivers one. The gap is closing fast: across three releases of one model family, pass@1 on the public products rises from 3% to 53% while the cost per build falls by more than half. We release eight products with the harness and grader, hold out nine, and report lessons from production use.

AI.tldr: 提出 ViBench 2.0，一个面向长周期软件开发的全栈 Web 产品构建基准（17 个产品、241 个功能请求、544 个浏览器端测试计划），用于为 Replit 平台选型模型；结果显示模型在测试计划通过率与"完整可用产品交付率"之间存在显著可靠性差距。
AI.motivation: 现有编码基准多为单一、完全指定的任务，且已接近饱和，无法反映用户在 Replit 上通过连续功能请求逐步构建完整产品的真实长周期场景，因此需要新的评测基准来支撑平台模型选型。
AI.method: 构建 ViBench 2.0：17 个模仿常见软件的全栈 Web 产品，由 241 个连续功能请求逐步构建而成；仅在产品完成后按用户体验方式评判——由浏览器 agent 执行 544 个测试计划，构建仅当全部计划通过方为成功，并采用经验证的评分协议保证严格分数的可靠性。评测 9 个模型，其中 8 个产品连同 harness 与 grader 公开，9 个留作私有。
AI.result: 发现可靠性差距：三个最强模型可分别通过最多 98% 的测试计划，但最多仅 65% 的构建能交付完全可用的产品；没有任何开源权重模型能交付完全可用的产品。差距在快速缩小：同一模型家族三次发布中，公开产品上的 pass@1 从 3% 升至 53%，单次构建成本下降超过一半。
AI.conclusion: 长周期构建评测揭示了局部通过率与整体交付可靠性之间的脱节，ViBench 2.0 可作为平台模型选型工具，并汇报了生产环境使用的经验教训；同时表明该能力正迅速提升，但开源模型仍有明显不足。

title: When Are Two SAE Latents the Same Feature?
summary: Comparing sparse autoencoders (SAEs) requires connecting feature correspondence, differences between whole dictionaries, and uncertainty from finite evaluation data. We develop a framework that connects these tasks through an energy-weighted optimal-transport plan under a specified similarity geometry. The same plan defines a dictionary-level discrepancy, decomposes it into latent contributions, and quantifies how each latent's mass is distributed across counterparts. We characterize relationships between decoder, activation, and first-order causal similarities; idealized models clarify the interpretation of splitting and absorption. For fixed trained SAEs, we derive joint asymptotic inference for transport costs and fractions, accounting for activation similarities and both energy marginals estimated from the same documents. A joint document bootstrap gives asymptotically valid simultaneous confidence bands. Experiments across four language models locate cross-seed discrepancy and separate context-dependent changes.

AI.tldr: 提出基于能量加权最优传输的稀疏自编码器(SAE)比较框架，统一处理特征对应、字典差异与有限数据不确定性。
AI.motivation: 比较稀疏自编码器需要同时解决特征对应、整体字典差异以及有限评估数据带来的不确定性，但现有方法缺乏统一工具。
AI.method: 在指定相似几何下构造能量加权的最优传输计划，用同一计划定义字典级差异并分解为潜在贡献、量化各潜在的对手质量分布；分析解码器、激活与一阶因果相似性的关系，并用理想化模型解释分裂与吸收；对固定训练的SAE推导传输成本与比例的联合渐近推断，考虑激活相似性及同一文档估计的双能量边际，并用联合文档bootstrap给出同时置信带。
AI.result: 在四个语言模型的实验中定位了跨随机种子的差异，并分离出依赖上下文的变化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将SAE比较中的对应、差异与不确定性统一起来，并提供有效的统计推断工具。

title: GaussianRenderFormer: Transformer-based Rendering of 3D Gaussian Splats
comment: Under review at TMLR. 32 pages. Project page: https://svlwoof.github.io/gaussianrenderformer
summary: Can a neural network learn to render 3D Gaussian splats on its own, with no rasterizer in the renderer? We present GaussianRenderFormer, a transformer that takes a set of Gaussians and a camera and outputs the image directly. Each Gaussian becomes one token in a view-independent encoder, and a view-dependent decoder turns small patches of camera rays into pixels by attending to those tokens. Trained on 26,820 Objaverse objects pruned to 20,000 Gaussians each, GaussianRenderFormer renders 300 unseen objects at 38.08 dB PSNR against the full, unpruned splats, while rasterizing the same pruned input reaches 44.02 dB. The gap is not one of generalization, and our diagnostics are consistent with a bottleneck in the view decoder: telling it the projected footprint of each Gaussian, which it could in principle infer, adds 1.4 dB. Under-training is not ruled out. Code, trained models and videos: https://svlwoof.github.io/gaussianrenderformer

AI.tldr: 提出 GaussianRenderFormer，用一个 Transformer 直接从高斯点和相机参数输出图像，完全不使用光栅化器，在 300 个未见 Objaverse 物体上对完整高斯达到 38.08 dB PSNR（光栅化同输入为 44.02 dB）。
AI.motivation: 探索神经网络能否"自己学会"渲染 3D Gaussian splats，从而摆脱传统光栅化渲染器，构建端到端可学习的渲染管线。
AI.method: 每个高斯作为一个 token 进入视角无关的编码器，视角相关的解码器将相机射线上的小 patch 通过注意力汇聚到这些 token 上，直接回归像素值；在 26,820 个 Objaverse 物体（每个剪枝到 20,000 个高斯）上训练。
AI.result: 300 个未见物体上 38.08 dB PSNR（以完整未剪枝高斯为参考），光栅化同剪枝输入为 44.02 dB；诊断显示差距不来自泛化，而可能源自视角解码器瓶颈——显式提供每个高斯的投影足迹可提升 1.4 dB；作者不排除训练不足的可能。
AI.conclusion: 神经渲染器可绕开光栅化直接生成图像，但当前与光栅化仍有明显差距，主要瓶颈在视角解码器而非泛化能力；显式几何线索（投影足迹）有助缓解，训练充分性仍待进一步验证。

title: CLEAR: Structured Specifications for Controllable Long-Horizon ML Research Engineering
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly being used to automate machine learning (ML) research workflows, ranging from code development and experiment execution to research reproduction and scientific discovery. Recent systems demonstrate that LLMs can perform substantial portions of ML research engineering with limited human intervention. These advances suggest a shift from automating individual research tasks toward automating long-horizon workflows that transform research artifacts into executable ML systems. However, ML research engineering remains substantially more difficult than isolated code generation. A research artifact typically specifies a system only implicitly through a mixture of natural-language descriptions, equations, pseudo-code, implementation details, datasets, and evaluation protocols. An agent must first infer the intended computational structure, translate it into executable components, coordinate their dependencies, and repeatedly diagnose and repair failures during execution. Consequently, the quality of the final system depends not only on code generation, but also on whether the agent can maintain a consistent representation of what should be implemented throughout this long-horizon process.

AI.tldr: 论文讨论LLM智能体自动化机器学习研究工程流程：从代码生成、实验执行到研究复现与科学发现，重点指出长周期工作流中"维持一致实现表征"是决定最终系统质量的关键。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM系统已能执行大量ML研究工程工作，研究自动化正从单一任务转向将研究论文等artifact转化为可执行ML系统的长周期流程；但研究工件仅以自然语言、公式、伪代码、实现细节、数据集和评测协议等混合形式隐式地定义系统，使该任务远比孤立代码生成困难，因此需要明确其中的核心挑战。
AI.method: 抽象级概念分析（本轮仅为引言性内容）：将研究工件转化为可执行系统所需的能力分解为——推断预期计算结构、翻译为可执行组件、协调组件依赖、执行中反复诊断与修复失效；并强调智能体需在整个长周期过程中维持对"应实现什么"的一致内部表征。
AI.result: 论文为框架性/挑战阐述，未在给定内容中给出具体方法或量化实验结果；主要结论是最终系统质量不仅取决于代码生成能力，还取决于智能体能否在长周期流程中保持一致的实现表征。
AI.conclusion: 要从"自动化单个研究任务"迈向"自动化研究工程长周期工作流"，需将研究工件理解、结构推断、依赖协调与持续修复纳入统一框架，其中维持一致的系统表征是核心问题与潜在改进方向。

title: When Does Better Confidence Improve a Knowledge-Graph Audit?
comment: 27 pages, 4 figures, 19 tables. Ancillary files include a public rendering of the confirmation protocol and summary results
summary: Confidence estimates guide human review in LLM-built knowledge graphs, but better error prediction can yield little improvement in an audit. We study this gap through repairability, selection headroom and label validity. Modelling non-adaptive auditing as budgeted covering, we characterise the minimal decision-relevant error statistics and bound the regret of scalar-preserving first-order planning by a structural mass $Δ^{\mathrm{cl}}$. We simulate ideal repair against benchmark-aligned labels for five extraction configurations and two cross-document graphs on Re-DocRED, followed by frozen confirmation on test and replication on 500 hash-selected training documents. On the held-out cross-document graphs, an error-rate $\times$ fan-out queue leaves 3.98-4.74 percentage points more errors than a joint model with the same actions. By comparison, opening shared actions for that joint planner reduces residual errors by 0.89-1.43 points relative to its own fact-only plans, in point estimates. Equivalence between joint and independent-block models remains inconclusive. Generic LLM verification improves three of four model-budget configurations on each held-out set. LLM adjudication identifies possible benchmark omissions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究为何在LLM构建的知识图谱中，更好的错误预测往往只能带来很小的审计改进；提出"可修复性、选择余量、标签有效性"三点来解释这一差距，并将非自适应审计建模为预算覆盖问题。
AI.motivation: 置信度估计用于指导人工审核，但即使错误预测更准，审计效果提升也有限。作者希望解释这一错配，判断瓶颈究竟在于预测质量、动作设计还是标签本身。
AI.method: 将非自适应审计形式化为预算化覆盖（budgeted covering），刻画最小的决策相关错误统计量，并用结构质量Δ^cl界定标量保持的一阶规划的遗憾；在Re-DocRED上对五种抽取配置和两个跨文档图模拟理想修复，并在测试集上冻结确认，另在500篇哈希选定的训练文档上复现。
AI.result: 在留出跨文档图上，错误率×扇出队列比同动作的联合模型多留3.98–4.74个百分点的错误；放开共享动作使联合规划器相对其仅事实计划减少0.89–1.43个百分点的残余错误（点估计）。联合模型与独立块模型的等价性尚无定论。通用LLM验证在每个留出集上改善四分之三的模型–预算配置，LLM裁定还发现基准可能存在遗漏。
AI.conclusion: 审计收益受限主要源于可修复性和动作选择余量，而非单纯预测精度；联合规划与共享动作有实际价值，但需谨慎对待基准标签的有效性。

title: Assurance-Conditioned Continuous Authorization for Autonomous AI Agents
summary: Autonomous software agents can act through tools, delegate work, and change their models or execution environments while earlier authorizations remain in flight. We present Assurance-Conditioned Continuous Authorization (ACCA), an approach designed to be harness-independent, for maintaining operational authority according to currently justified assurance. It distinguishes evidence validity from contextual applicability, derives assurance claims from eligible evidence, and resolves a multidimensional effective-authority envelope within a principal-declared ceiling and applicable policy. A typed dependency graph supports selective re-evaluation of authorization-relevant changes. An authority epoch changes when effective authority changes; a distinct optional authorization-basis version supports revalidation of action-specific authorization conditions. Protected effect-time enforcement can reject stale actions before a consequential resource change, subject to the available commit mechanism. A compositional Domain Governance Profile expresses domain-specific semantics without granting authority. Controlled scenario tests implemented as a regression suite using a trading profile exercise default-deny rules, evidence-conditioned contraction and recovery, policy divergence, selective non-response, and stale-action rejection at a local gateway before the simulated-broker boundary. The study establishes implementation-level evidence in one domain, not a cross-domain guarantee of harmful-behavior prevention.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"以保障为条件的持续授权"（ACCA），一种与具体执行框架无关的方法，用于在自主Agent运行过程中依据当前可被证成的保障来维护操作权限。
AI.motivation: 自主软件Agent可通过工具行动、委派任务、切换模型或执行环境，而此前授予的授权仍处于生效状态，导致权限与实际保障水平脱节，存在陈旧授权被误用的风险。
AI.method: 区分证据有效性与情境适用性；从合格证据推导保障声明；在主体声明的上限与适用策略内解析多维有效权限包络；用类型化依赖图支持对授权相关变化的选择性重评估；以权限纪元标识有效权限变化，并可选地对动作级授权条件进行基线版本再验证；在效果时刻实施受保护执行，拒绝陈旧动作；通过组合式领域治理配置表达领域语义而不授予权限。
AI.result: 在交易领域以回归测试套件实现受控场景测试，覆盖默认拒绝、证据条件下的收缩与恢复、策略分歧、选择性不响应，以及在本地网关于模拟券商边界前拒绝陈旧动作。
AI.conclusion: 该研究在单一领域提供了实现层面的证据，并非对有害行为跨领域预防的保证。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Information-Theoretic Decoder Evaluation Under Latent Intent
summary: A central challenge in assistive brain-to-robot control is decoding a user's latent intent from complex and noisy brain signals. Prior approaches evaluate decoders as single-trial classifiers with accuracy-based metrics, but this neglects the inherently sequential nature of assistive control. Since a planner must integrate intermittent, noisy decoder outputs over time, single-step accuracy can only be a proxy when predicting downstream task performance. We formalize brain-to-robot control as a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), and prove that there is a sharp phase transition: regret is uniformly bounded across the horizon as long as pairs of goals are all decoder-distinguishable, but grows linearly otherwise. We show that a single channel statistic, the worst-pair Chernoff information $Γ_{\min}$ sets this boundary. Then, we derive a closed-form regret predictor $U_{\mathrm{id}}(C)$, that can be computed from any confusion matrix in $O(K^2)$ time. Across two domains spanning orthogonal information channels, we show that $U_{\mathrm{id}}$ predicts cumulative planning regret beyond what accuracy can explain. We then highlight a pathological accuracy trap, in which two decoders have identical validation accuracy 35.1% on real EEG data (BNCI2014001 subject 5) but result in a difference of $9.6\times$ in held-out regret, which $U_{\mathrm{id}}$ predicts. Same-signal control confirms $U_{\mathrm{id}}$'s advantage with decoders that span independent feature channels. Ultimately, our work provides a drop-in diagnostic to evaluate and select sensors and decoders in sequential assistive control.

AI.tldr: 论文将脑-机器人辅助控制形式化为POMDP，证明解码器的"最差对Chernoff信息"Γ_min决定累积后悔是恒定有界还是线性增长，并提出O(K²)可算的闭式后悔预测器U_id，用它揭示同准确率解码器在下游规划中可达9.6倍后悔差异。
AI.motivation: 现有脑-机器人解码器以单试次分类准确率评估，但辅助控制本质是规划器随时间融合间歇、含噪解码输出的序贯过程，单步准确率只是下游任务表现的代理指标，可能严重误导传感器与解码器选择。
AI.method: 把脑-机器人控制建模为POMDP；理论证明后悔的相变：当所有目标对都可被解码器区分时后悔在时间域上一致有界，否则线性增长，边界由最差对Chernoff信息Γ_min刻画；进而从任意混淆矩阵推导闭式后悔预测器U_id(C)，时间复杂度O(K²)；在两个正交信息通道领域及真实EEG（BNCI2014001被试5）上验证。
AI.result: U_id能解释超越准确率所能解释的累积规划后悔；发现"准确率陷阱"：两个解码器验证准确率同为35.1%，但留出后悔相差9.6倍，且U_id成功预测该差异；同信号控制实验在独立特征通道的解码器上确认U_id优势。
AI.conclusion: 单步准确率不足以评估序贯辅助控制中的解码器，Γ_min/U_id提供了可直接替换的诊断工具，用于在脑-机器人序贯控制中评估与选择传感器和解码器。

title: CAPTOR: text-encoder-free grounding by counting caption co-occurrence over the visual words of a frozen encoder
summary: Grounding a text query in an image needs a matrix scoring every term against every patch. Vision-language models compute it with an aligned text encoder, which many image encoders, such as histopathology-related models trained on slides alone, lack. The Caption-Anchored Patch-Term Occurrence Representation (CAPTOR) estimates the matrix without a text encoder. It clusters a frozen image encoder's patch tokens into visual words and describes each captioned image by its share of patches in each word. A term signature is the standardized difference of those shares between images whose captions mention the term and the rest. The matrix factorizes into a term-by-word table and a query-independent image factor, so an image is encoded once and a new term adds one table row. Against every training-free baseline, CAPTOR leads on Common Objects in Context (COCO), Pascal Visual Object Classes (VOC) and Cityscapes. On COCO, scored on the cells one object owns, it reaches 0.565 mean intersection over union (mIoU) against 0.502. On all three, it is also level with a text alignment trained on the same backbone, which needs gradients, a text encoder and several times the captions. On held-out breast-cancer slides, it exceeds the strongest baseline scoring patches with a pathology text encoder by 0.160 mIoU. Read through CAPTOR, UNI, an encoder trained on slides alone, exceeds such baselines by 0.132 on a common grid. Counting can therefore give a text interface to any image encoder trained without language, wherever captioned images exist.

AI.tldr: CAPTOR无需文本编码器，用图像块聚类成"视觉词"+标题词-词签名，将词-块打分矩阵分解为词×词表和图像因子，实现查询独立的图像编码与任意文本查询。
AI.motivation: 在图像中定位文本查询需要逐词×逐块的打分矩阵，通常依赖与文本对齐的编码器；但许多图像编码器（如仅用切片训练的病理模型）没有配套文本编码器。
AI.method: 冻结图像编码器的patch token聚类为视觉词；用带标题图像中各视觉词占比描述图像；词签名=提及该词的图像与其余图像占比的标准化差值；矩阵分解为词×视觉词表与查询无关的图像因子，故图像只需编码一次，新增词仅需增加一行表项。
AI.result: 在COCO、Pascal VOC、Cityscapes上优于所有免训练基线；COCO单物体单元格mIoU 0.565 vs 0.502；三数据集上追平同骨干训练的文本对齐方法（后者需梯度、文本编码器及数倍标题）；在乳腺癌切片上比最强病理文本编码器基线高0.160 mIoU，UNI经CAPTOR解读后高0.132。
AI.conclusion: 只要有带标题图像，计数式方法即可为任何无语言训练的视觉编码器提供文本接口。

title: EvoCodeAgent: Project-Level Code Generation via Architecture-Code Co-Evolution and Experience-Guided Repair
summary: Project-level code generation aims to automatically synthesize complete software repositories from high-level requirements, producing coherent multi-file systems with well-structured modules and consistent cross-file dependencies. Despite the strong capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in specification understanding and code synthesis, existing approaches still exhibit several critical limitations. First, many methods rely on static architectural designs that cannot adapt during iterative generation, leading to a growing misalignment between architecture and implementation. Second, they lack mechanisms to accumulate and reuse experience across iterations, resulting in recurring errors and reduced efficiency. Third, they often depend on standalone LLM-based evaluation of intermediate artifacts, which suffer from limited transparency and potential unreliability under long-context reasoning. To address these challenges, we propose EvoCodeAgent, a state-centric framework for project-level code generation. EvoCodeAgent maintains an evolving architectural state initialized from structured project specifications and continuously reconciles predicted relations from architecture and skeletons with realized relations extracted from generated code. It further uses tool-grounded verification evidence to support reliable state updates and abstracts reusable repair experiences from previous revision attempts to guide subsequent generation. Extensive experiments on project-level benchmarks of different scales, including DevBench and CodeProjectEval, demonstrate that EvoCodeAgent consistently outperforms baseline approaches. Under the GPT-5 setting, it achieves unit test pass rates of 60.48% and 27.73%, respectively, yielding up to a 53.5% improvement over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: EvoCodeAgent：以“演化架构状态”为中心的项目级代码生成框架，通过对齐架构预测关系与代码实现关系、工具化验证及修复经验复用，在DevBench与CodeProjectEval上取得60.48%和27.73%单测通过率，最高超最强基线53.5%。
AI.motivation: 项目级代码生成需从高层需求自动合成多文件一致系统。现有方法存在三点缺陷：(1) 静态架构设计无法在迭代中自适应，架构与实现逐渐失配；(2) 缺乏跨迭代经验积累与复用，错误反复出现、效率低；(3) 依赖独立LLM评估中间产物，长上下文下透明度与可靠性不足。
AI.method: 提出EvoCodeAgent状态中心框架：从结构化项目规格初始化可演化的架构状态；持续将架构与骨架预测的关系同生成代码中提取的实际关系进行对账（reconcile）；借助工具化验证证据支撑可靠的状态更新；并从既往修订尝试中抽象可复用的修复经验以指导后续生成。
AI.result: 在DevBench与CodeProjectEval等不同规模项目级基准上，一致优于基线；GPT-5设置下单元测试通过率分别为60.48%与27.73%，较最强基线最高提升53.5%。
AI.conclusion: 以可演化架构状态为核心、结合工具验证反馈与经验复用，可有效缓解架构-实现失配与错误重复问题，提升项目级代码生成的可靠性与效率；该状态中心范式对多文件系统工程化生成具有推广价值。

title: Information-Matched Auditing of Conversational Emotion-Shift Forecasting: A Leakage-Safe Evaluation Protocol
summary: Comparisons in conversational emotion-shift forecasting are easily distorted when a learned model receives rich features but its transition baseline is given a noisy or unavailable current-emotion label, when hyperparameter budgets differ, or when target-turn information enters the representation. We present an information-matched, leakage-safe auditing protocol that closes these gaps with an explicit commitment point, executable causality tests, equal four-configuration validation searches, and seed-dialogue-aware inference. Applying it to six causal model families on four text corpora and two feature-source sensitivity configurations shows that a deployable train-only current-emotion classifier feeding the transition baseline yields a different verdict than an oracle diagnostic where both sides receive gold current emotion. Under the deployable condition, learned models improve over the predicted-label baseline on all four primary corpora; DailyDialog gains are large and survive a 72-comparison Holm correction (best ROC-AUC gain = +0.167, adjusted p=.0144). Under matched gold information, the baseline remains competitive on IEMOCAP and stronger on MELD, while every model retains a large DailyDialog advantage. We additionally report precision-recall AUC, calibration, a strictly utterance-local feature control, same-person self-shift forecasting, and a future-access dose-response test. An eight-item leakage checklist accompanies the protocol. Code, raw seed predictions, and reporting artifacts are available from the corresponding author upon request.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个"信息对齐、无泄漏"的审计协议，用于公平比较对话情绪转移预测中的模型与转移基线，并在多个语料上给出可部署与oracle两种条件下的不同结论。
AI.motivation: 现有对话情绪转移预测的比较易被失真：学习模型获得丰富特征，而转移基线却被给予噪声化或缺失的当前情绪标签；超参数预算不一致；目标轮信息泄漏进表征。
AI.method: 提出信息匹配、防泄漏的审计协议，包含显式承诺点、可执行的因果性测试、等量四配置验证搜索、以及种子-对话感知的推断；在6个因果模型族、4个文本语料、2种特征来源敏感性配置上应用。
AI.result: 可部署条件下（仅用训练集训练当前情绪分类器喂给基线），学习模型在全部四个主语料上优于预测标签基线；DailyDialog提升显著并经受72次比较的Holm校正（最佳ROC-AUC提升+0.167，校正p=.0144）。在黄金信息对齐下，基线段在IEMOCAP仍具竞争力、在MELD更强，但所有模型在DailyDialog仍大幅领先。另报告PR-AUC、校准、严格局部特征对照、同一人自我转移预测与未来信息剂量-反应测试。
AI.conclusion: 结论高度依赖信息条件：可部署与oracle设定下判决不同，故需信息匹配与防泄漏审计；并附八项泄漏检查清单。

title: Route to Remember: Adaptive Memory Selection for LLM Agents
summary: The memory of production agents is increasingly becoming a bottleneck and is built almost exclusively from text: key points are extracted from out-of-limit context and retrieved into context at query time. Therefore, every new query incurs an additional cost that grows with the accumulated history. Weight memory is a complementary alternative that internalizes knowledge into model parameters and answers with no context at all, and has recently proven effective in self-evolving agents for internalizing skills and behaviors. However, its application in episodic and semantic memory, such as user-specific facts, remains comparatively unexplored, and a gap remains between earlier attempts at weight memory and text-based systems regarding recall performance. We study how to make weight memory competitive as a long-term factual store by applying on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). It trains a context-free student from a teacher, which is the same model conditioned on the user's memory, together with a verify-then-regenerate router that lets weight and text memory each cover the queries they handle best. On the HaluMem benchmark, OPSD matches or surpasses strong text-memory baselines, including full-context prompting and retrieval systems, while reading fewer tokens per query. We further conduct an extensive study that characterizes the behavior of weight memory and analyzes how different training recipes affect its performance. As agent harnesses move toward persistent, multi-session deployments, these results position weight memory as a practical, low-cost component of agent memory and provide insights into feasible training and evaluation protocols for combining it with retrieval.

AI.tldr: 该论文用on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）把用户事实性记忆内化进模型权重，并配合"先验证再重生成"路由，使权重记忆在召回上可与文本记忆系统竞争且更省token。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆几乎完全基于文本：从超限上下文中抽取要点、查询时再检索。这导致每次新查询都带来随历史累积增长的开销。权重记忆可把知识内化进参数、无需上下文即可作答，已在技能与行为内化上有效，但在情节/语义记忆（如用户特定事实）上探索不足，且召回性能与文本系统仍有差距。
AI.method: 采用on-policy自蒸馏：教师模型为以用户记忆为条件的同一模型，训练一个无上下文的学生模型；并引入"先验证再重生成"（verify-then-regenerate）路由器，让权重记忆与文本记忆各自处理其最擅长的查询。在HaluMem基准上评测，并开展大量实验刻画权重记忆行为及不同训练配方的影响。
AI.result: 在HaluMem上，OPSD达到或超过强文本记忆基线（含全上下文提示与检索系统），且每查询读取的token更少。额外研究揭示了权重记忆的行为特征，并分析了不同训练配方对其性能的影响。
AI.conclusion: 在智能体框架转向持久化、多会话部署的趋势下，权重记忆可作为低成本、实用的智能体记忆组件；论文也为权重记忆与检索结合的训练与评测协议提供了参考与洞见。

title: Adaptive Domain Decomposition for Finite Basis Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: In this work, we present adaptive domain decomposition finite basis physics-informed neural networks (ADD-FBPINNs). The proposed method integrates Partition of Unity Networks (POUNets), a data-driven approach for learning domain partitions, with finite Basis physics-informed neural networks (FBPINNs) to perform more efficient domain decomposition and achieve more accurate approximations. FBPINNs improve upon the accuracy of standard physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) through user-defined subdivisions of the computational domain. By adapting the domain decomposition based on the solution's features using a separable POUNet, the framework can automatically learn partitions that are stable and can be geometrically interpretable. We test this approach on the two-dimensional Helmholtz equation, two-dimensional Poisson equation with multiscale features, and viscous Burgers equation and observe improved accuracy compared with FBPINNs with fixed domain decomposition.

AI.tldr: 将学习型域划分方法POUNet与FBPINN结合，提出自适应域分解有限基PINN（ADD-FBPINN），通过可分离POUNet依据解的特征自动学习稳定且可几何解释的域划分，在多个二维PDE上精度优于固定域分解的FBPINN。
AI.motivation: 标准PINN精度有限；FBPINN虽靠人工划分子域提升精度，但域分解是用户预先固定定义的，无法依据解的特征自适应调整，划分质量依赖经验且可能不稳定、缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 以FBPINN为骨架，引入数据驱动的POUNet（分割网络）并以可分离形式建模域划分，使子域划分随解的特征自动学习；用学到的划分驱动子域上的有限基子网络与单位分解组合，由训练过程联合优化划分与网络参数，获得稳定且可几何解释的分区。
AI.result: 在二维Helmholtz方程、含多尺度特征的二维Poisson方程及粘性Burgers方程上测试，与固定域分解的FBPINN相比均取得更高精度。
AI.conclusion: 自适应、可学习的域分解能有效提升有限基PINN的逼近精度，且学到的划分具有稳定性和几何可解释性，是一种可推广的PDE求解框架改进方向。

title: Spatio-Temporal Multi-Order Interaction for Video Recognition
summary: Many temporal approaches for video recognition rely on explicit cross-channel aggregation projections, which have quadratic complexity in the number of channels, introducing significant computational overhead. In addition, the spatio-temporal representation used for video recognition is biased either toward local order interactions (for CNNs) or toward global order interactions (for transformers). Starting from the multi-order spatial representation of MogaNet, our method introduces two complementary contributions to tackle these problems. First, for the temporal modelling, we introduce parallel multi-order processing with depthwise-only convolutions and implicit gating-based aggregation, which is linear in the number of channels, inducing a considerable computational reduction. Second, we propose a dual interaction between spatial and temporal dimensions, which allows a better spatio-temporal representation without increasing the computational cost. By combining these two contributions, our proposed VideoMogaNet achieves performance on par with or better than state-of-the-art action recognition approaches across multiple video benchmarks (UCF101, HMDB51, Kinetics-400, Diving48), while considerably reducing the cost of the temporal branch.

AI.tldr: VideoMogaNet 提出深度可分离卷积+隐式门控聚合的并行多阶时序建模，并设计时空双向交互，在将时序分支计算量大幅降低的同时实现线性复杂度，性能与 SOTA 持平或更优。
AI.motivation: 现有视频识别时序方法依赖显式跨通道聚合投影，复杂度随通道数呈二次增长，开销大；且 CNN 偏局部阶交互、Transformer 偏全局阶交互，时空表征存在偏置。
AI.method: 基于 MogaNet 的多阶空间表征，提出两项互补设计：(1) 时序建模采用仅深度卷积的并行多阶处理与隐式门控聚合，通道数线性复杂度；(2) 引入空间与时间维度的双向交互，在不增加计算成本下提升时空表征。
AI.result: 在 UCF101、HMDB51、Kinetics-400、Diving48 等多个视频基准上，性能与 SOTA 动作识别方法持平或更优，同时显著降低时序分支计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 以线性复杂度的多阶时序设计与时空双向交互，可在低成本下获得强视频识别性能，为高效视频理解提供了新思路。

title: Keeping Fuzzers on Duty: Repairing Fuzzing Build Breakages in Continuous Open-Source Fuzzing
summary: Continuous fuzzing platforms such as OSS-Fuzz provide sustained security testing for open-source projects, but long-term build breakages reduce security coverage and waste infrastructure resources. In OSS-Fuzz, around 20% of integrated projects remain in build-failure states, leaving their fuzzers off duty. These failures expose a maintenance gap between platform maintainers, who lack project-specific context, and project maintainers, who often lack fuzzing and infrastructure expertise. Existing program-repair techniques cannot be directly applied because fuzz build breakages span evolving project and infrastructure artifacts and require repeated infrastructure-aware diagnosis. We present FuzzMedic, an automated agent for fuzz build repair. FuzzMedic performs evidence-guided diagnosis across project and fuzzing-infrastructure artifacts. It explores repairs over a repair-state graph (RSG) that records the evolving workspace and build feedback. Branching and rollback enable FuzzMedic to recover from unproductive repair paths during long-horizon debugging. Candidate patches are validated to restore executable fuzz targets rather than merely suppress build failures. We evaluate FuzzMedic on 128 reproducible OSS-Fuzz build failures extracted from 1,820 real-world failures. FuzzMedic achieves a 48.44% repair rate and outperforms three representative program-repair baselines. In real-world use, it produces 29 patches merged into upstream or OSS-Fuzz main branches, including repairs for three failures that had remained unresolved for more than one year and two cases that had never built successfully.

AI.tldr: FuzzMedic：用于修复OSS-Fuzz持续模糊测试构建中断的自动化智能体，在128个真实构建失败上实现48.44%修复率，产出29个被上游合并的补丁。
AI.motivation: OSS-Fuzz等持续模糊测试平台需长期构建保障，但约20%项目长期处于构建失败状态，导致模糊器停摆、安全覆盖下降、资源浪费。此类故障横跨项目与模糊基础设施工件，平台维护者缺乏项目上下文、项目维护者缺乏模糊测试与基础设施知识，现有程序修复技术难以直接适用。
AI.method: 提出FuzzMedic智能体：跨项目与基础设施工件进行证据引导的诊断；在修复状态图（RSG）上探索修复方案，记录演进中的工作区与构建反馈；通过分支与回滚机制从无效修复路径中恢复以应对长时程调试；候选补丁需验证能恢复可执行的模糊目标，而非仅抑制构建报错。
AI.result: 从1,820个真实失败中提取128个可复现的OSS-Fuzz构建失败进行评估，修复率达48.44%，优于三个代表性程序修复基线；实际使用中产出29个合入上游或OSS-Fuzz主分支的补丁，包括3个一年以上未解决的故障及2个从未成功构建的案例。
AI.conclusion: FuzzMedic表明智能体式、基础设施感知的自动化修复可有效弥合平台与项目维护者之间的维护鸿沟，切实提升持续模糊测试的安全覆盖并节省基础设施资源。

title: Selective, Risk-Controlled Emotion Forecasting in Conversation: From a Persistence Barrier to Departure Detection with Conformal Guarantees
summary: Forecasting emotion in conversation is increasingly framed as predicting the next emotional state's value. We show this targets a hard quantity in a state-observed testbed and propose a learnable, deployable reformulation instead. On valence-arousal-dominance trajectories from a dyadic corpus, repeating a speaker's own previous state sets a persistence baseline that no frozen-encoder correction meaningfully improves upon and a state-space filter exceeds; the floor requires the historical state to be observed, since an estimated anchor collapses persistence below a direct forecaster. What survives is the timing of a departure from persistence, learnable on three of four corpora and near chance on the highest-base-rate corpus, a negative result we report. We recast the task as selective departure forecasting: a lead-time-weighted metric with a leakage protocol, and commitment policies whose best choice switches with the departure rate. A dialogue-level conformal risk control bounds the expected loss of committed predictions, meeting the target in all twelve configurations tested, though the guarantee is bought through abstention, with coverage and alarm recall falling sharply on the hardest corpus. One tested language model's confidence fails as a ranking signal where another succeeds, a model-dependent failure not yet attributable to family versus scale. Code and result logs are available from the corresponding author upon request.

AI.tldr: 论文指出"预测对话中下一情感状态值"是一个很难直接做准的量，转而重新定义为"选择性偏离预测"（预测何时会脱离持续状态），并提出带泄漏协议的前置时间加权指标与承诺策略及对话级保形风险控制。
AI.motivation: 现有对话情感预测工作把任务框定为预测下一情感状态的具体数值（valence-arousal-dominance），但在状态可观测的测试平台上该目标本身极难达成，需要检验：冻结编码器修正是否真能超越简单持续性基线，以及何种信息才真正可学。
AI.method: 在双人语料的VAD轨迹上建立持续性基线（重复说话者自身上一状态），与冻结编码器修正、状态空间滤波比较；分析偏离时机的可学性；将任务重铸为选择性偏离预测，设计前置时间加权指标与泄漏协议、随偏离率切换的承诺策略，并用对话级保形风险控制约束已承诺预测的期望损失。
AI.result: 持续性基线难以被冻结编码器修正显著超越，状态空间滤波却超过它；该下限需要历史状态可观，用估计锚点会使持续性劣于直接预测器。偏离时机在四个语料中的三个可学，在最高基率语料上接近随机（负结果）。保形风险控制在全部十二种配置下达到目标，但靠弃权实现，最难语料上覆盖率与告警召回骤降。一个语言模型的置信度不能作为排序信号，另一个可以，且该差异暂无法归因于模型家族或规模。
AI.conclusion: 对话情感预测应从"预测下一状态值"转向"预测何时偏离持续性"的选择性预测问题，并配合风险控制与弃权机制；当前方法的保证以覆盖率为代价，置信度信号的可用性依赖具体模型，需进一步研究。

title: Attributing Agent Failures to Their History Needs an Executed Counterfactual: Toward a Reporting Standard
comment: Accepted at the IAB Workshop (Interpreting Agent Behavior) at NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival). 20 pages
summary: Published explanations of why long-horizon agents fail are commonly taxonomies labeled over completed trajectories: a judge reads a transcript and names the failure. We argue that a claim attributing an agent's behavior to its history should carry intervention-verified evidence, per instance or via a validated estimator: freeze an executable mid-trajectory state, alter only the history the agent sees, and continue - executed rather than inferred from the transcript, at a state whose restoration has been measured, with a replay certificate matched to the estimand. Each of the four manipulation classes we name has a precedent, and several methods already execute interventions from checkpoints, re-executed prefixes or recorded conversation states (for example DoVer, REFLECT, Min et al., Who&When Pro, Causal Agent Replay), but none reports a measured replay certificate. Two cautionary measurements, neither applying the standard, follow: a carrier taxonomy whose "concentration" could not be separated from benchmark construction (adjusted odds ratio 1.15, interval crossing 1), and hash-identical snapshots that, restored into identically seeded processes, agreed with one another in 24 of 24 states while differing from the live continuation in 9 and 20 of 24. Restoring the captured position of a random stream made all 24 agree with the live run.

AI.tldr: 论文主张：将长程智能体失败归因于历史时，必须用可执行干预验证（冻结中间状态、仅改历史、续跑）而非事后轨迹标注，并需报告实测的回放证书。
AI.motivation: 现有失败解释多是对已完成轨迹的标注分类学（裁判读日志贴标签），属推断而非因果证据；作者认为归因历史应具备干预验证证据，但现有执行干预的方法（DoVer、REFLECT、Min等、Who&When Pro、Causal Agent Replay）均未报告实测回放证书。
AI.method: 提出四条标准：冻结可执行中间状态；仅改动智能体所见历史；真实续跑而非从日志推断；在已测量可恢复性的状态上操作；并配合与估计量匹配的回放证书。命名四类操作（manipulation）并给出先例。另做两项警示性测量：(1) 某载体分类学的“集中度”无法与基准构造分离（调整比值比1.15，置信区间跨1）；(2) 哈希相同的快照在相同种子进程中互相一致（24/24），但与真实续跑不一致（24中分别有9和20条不符）。
AI.result: 分类学效应不可辨识（OR 1.15，区间含1）；快照回放存在系统性偏差——同源快照彼此一致率达24/24，却与实时续跑在9/24和20/24状态上不符；恢复随机流的捕获位置后，全部24个状态与实时运行一致。
AI.conclusion: 回放一致性不等于有效回放：必须以实测回放证书验证状态恢复（含随机数流位置）后，才可做历史干预归因；未达标准的分类学结论可能只是基准构造的产物。

title: Revisiting Critic Estimation in Soft Actor-Critic Algorithms
summary: Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) is a widely used deep reinforcement learning algorithm that combines entropy regularization with an actor-critic architecture. Standard implementations rely on one-step temporal-difference learning of Q-functions, yet alternative critic design choices remain underexplored. In this work, we revisit three such choices: learning soft advantages instead of soft Q-values, the use of multi-step return targets, and the training of multi-step critics from replay buffer data. Keeping the policy objective fixed, we compare the six critic variants these choices generate: (i) advantage and (ii) dueling-advantage critics learned from one-step transitions, and $λ$-return and soft Generalized Advantage Estimation (GAE) critics learned either (iii, iv) on-policy or (v, vi) from replayed trajectory segments. Each variant is evaluated across an entire random hyperparameter search on fourteen tasks, treating the hyperparameters as part of the algorithm. Learning soft advantages instead of soft Q-values does not improve performance, and the soft GAE critic adds nothing over the simpler $λ$-return critic. What does improve performance, most clearly on continuous control, is training a $λ$-return critic on replayed trajectory segments, even without importance weighting or trace cutting. This extends earlier evidence that uncorrected multi-step targets work well under replay to the full soft $λ$-return, entropy terms included. By design, the underlying ideas studied here extend beyond SAC, and our empirical findings aim to encourage their application to a broader class of reinforcement learning algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了SAC中六种critic设计变体，发现用soft advantage替代soft Q值无益、soft GAE相比λ-return无增益，而从回放轨迹段上训练λ-return critic能显著提升性能（尤其在连续控制任务上）。
AI.motivation: SAC标准实现依赖一步时序差分学习Q函数，其他critic设计选择（soft advantage、多步回报目标、从回放数据训练多步critic）尚未被充分探索，作者希望系统评估这些替代方案。
AI.method: 固定策略目标，比较三种设计选择组合出的六种critic变体：(i) advantage critic、(ii) dueling-advantage critic（均基于一步转移）、(iii) λ-return critic、(iv) soft GAE critic（在策略上）、(v) λ-return critic、(vi) soft GAE critic（从回放轨迹段）。每个变体在14个任务的完整随机超参数搜索下评估，将超参数视为算法一部分。
AI.result: 学习soft advantage替代soft Q值未提升性能；soft GAE相比更简单的λ-return无额外收益；但从回放轨迹段训练λ-return critic（无需重要性加权或trace cutting）能提升性能，在连续控制上尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将"未校正多步目标在回放下表现良好"的既有证据扩展到包含熵项的完整soft λ-return；所研究的思想超越SAC本身，作者希望推动其应用于更广泛的强化学习算法。

title: ARIDA - Active railway infrastructure dataset annotation using neural network predictions
summary: Modern railway perception requires large comprehensive image datasets, but creating them is slowed by manual labeling, especially for track polylines and other complex infrastructure geometry.
