This paper presents the Active Railway Infrastructure Dataset Annotation framework, a railway-specific semi-automated pipeline that converts instance predictions from a mask scoring instance segmentation network into bounding-boxes, polygons, polylines, and paired polylines. To keep automatic track geometry annotation reliable without ground truth, it applies confidence thresholds and an unique contour-agreement quality score as an acceptance gate. An active learning loop ranks remaining images by uncertainty and adapts the number of manual queries per cycle. This is achieved through a novel quantity control mechanism, in which easy images are auto-accepted and human effort targets hard cases. Experiments on disjoint, diverse imagery and time-sequential, redundant imagery quantify effort reduction and accuracy trade-offs, achieving about two thirds reduction in the disjoint regime and up to 93% in the sequential regime. The study also provides guidance for initial label budgets and stopping to avoid over-annotation.

AI.tldr: 提出ARIDA框架，将实例分割网络预测转换为bbox、多边形、折线及成对折线，并用置信度阈值+轮廓一致性质量分作为自动验收门槛，结合主动学习与数量控制机制按不确定性排序、自适应人工查询数，在不相交与时间序列影像上分别减少约2/3和最高93%的人工标注量。
AI.motivation: 铁路感知需要大规模综合图像数据集，但人工标注（尤其轨道折线等复杂基础设施几何）耗时严重，制约数据集构建效率。
AI.method: 面向铁路场景的半自动标注流水线：以mask scoring实例分割网络预测为基础，输出bbox、多边形、折线和成对折线；在无真值情况下，用置信度阈值与新颖的“轮廓一致性”质量分数作为自动接受门控；外层主动学习循环按不确定性对剩余图像排序，并通过数量控制机制自适应调整每轮人工查询数，自动接受简单图像、将人力集中于困难样本。
AI.result: 在不相交、多样化影像与时间序列冗余影像两类实验中量化了人工量与精度权衡：不相交场景约减少2/3标注工作量，序列场景最多减少93%；并给出初始标注预算与停止准则建议，以避免过度标注。
AI.conclusion: 铁路专用半自动标注框架可在保证几何标注可靠性的前提下大幅降低人工成本，且无真值的质量门控与自适应主动学习策略有效；同时为标注预算与停止时机提供实践指导。

title: Reassessing Dataset Quality and Fine-Tuning Practices for Vulnerability Detection on PrimeVul dataset
comment: Presented at EASE 2026 AI Models/Data track: https://conf.researchr.org/track/ease-2026/ease-2026-ai-models---data?
summary:
Recent studies report promising results from supervised fine-tuning of pre-trained code language models for automated vulnerability detection on benchmarks such as PrimeVul. In this paper, we present a large-scale empirical evaluation of both model performance and dataset quality in this setting.
  We systematically fine-tune three widely used encoder models (CodeBERT, GraphCodeBERT, and UniXCoder) across five imbalance mitigation strategies, extensive hyperparameter sweeps, and multiple random seeds, resulting in 770 independent training runs.
  Our results reveal a consistent pattern. While standard metrics such as F1 and ROC-AUC occasionally suggest improvements, security-critical and calibration-aware measures tell a different story. Matthews Correlation Coefficient remains near zero, predicted probabilities are poorly calibrated, and evaluation under strict false-positive constraints reveals high false-negative rates. Neither imbalance handling, threshold optimization, nor post-hoc calibration recovers a meaningful discriminative signal.
  We also conduct a data quality assessment of the PrimeVul benchmark and identify structural issues such as minimal semantic differences between vulnerable and fixed functions, and annotation noise introduced by commit-level labeling.
  These findings suggests that the PrimeVul dataset, in its current form, presents significant challenges for reliable AI-based vulnerability detection in software engineering with the methodologies we used. Our study highlights the need for more robust dataset design, improved evaluation protocols, and rethinking of fine-tuning practices for security-critical tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文对在 PrimeVul 基准上监督微调代码语言模型做漏洞检测进行了大规模实证评估（770 次独立训练），发现 F1/ROC-AUC 的"提升"具有误导性：MCC 接近 0、概率校准差、严格假阳性约束下漏报率高，且数据本身存在语义差异过小与标注噪声等结构性问题。
AI.motivation: 近期研究声称监督微调预训练代码模型在 PrimeVul 等基准上用于自动化漏洞检测效果良好，但这些结论多依赖 F1、ROC-AUC 等标准指标，可能掩盖安全关键任务中的真实问题；同时基准数据集本身的质量尚未被系统审视。
AI.method: 对 CodeBERT、GraphCodeBERT、UniXCoder 三个编码器模型，结合五种不平衡缓解策略、大量超参数搜索与多个随机种子，共进行 770 次独立训练；在标准指标之外引入 MCC、概率校准评估及严格假阳性约束下的评估；并对 PrimeVul 数据集开展数据质量分析（脆弱/修复函数语义差异、commit 级标注噪声）。
AI.result: 标准指标 F1、ROC-AUC 偶尔显示提升，但 MCC 接近零、预测概率校准差、严格假阳性限制下假阴性率高；不平衡处理、阈值优化与事后校准均无法恢复有意义的判别信号。数据质量方面发现脆弱与修复函数语义差异极小、commit 级标注引入噪声等结构性问题。
AI.conclusion: PrimeVul 当前形式对所采用方法下的可靠 AI 漏洞检测构成重大挑战；需要更稳健的数据集设计、改进的评估协议，并重新思考安全关键任务中的微调实践。

title: Familiar letters, not related languages, let unseen languages into a shared space of meaning
summary: Hundreds of languages have written text but almost no translations, and whether a model learning one from untranslated text builds on a related language or familiar letters is unclear: they usually coincide. Here we show that familiar letters, not a related language, let an unseen language into a shared space of meaning. GlyphMind, a tokenizer-free vision transformer that reads text as pixels and lets any sentence be shown in any script, was pretrained to align translations across 27 writing systems. Adapted on untranslated Lao, a language and script it had never seen, it retrieved English translations seven times as often as the strongest simple baseline. Rewritten in unfamiliar letters, Lao did not enter although its close relative Thai was in pretraining; Santali, which had none, entered in Devanagari, familiar from Hindi, but not in its own script. Transliteration into familiar scripts may thus open multilingual models to languages without translations.

AI.tldr: GlyphMind 以像素读文字的无分词视觉Transformer，发现让未见语言进入共享语义空间的关键是"熟悉的字形"而非"亲缘语言"。
AI.motivation: 大量语言有书面文本却几乎无翻译数据；模型从无翻译文本中学习一种语言时，究竟是借助亲属语言还是熟悉的字母体系，此前无法区分，因二者通常重合。
AI.method: GlyphMind：无分词的视觉Transformer，将文本作为像素读取，可让任意句子以任意文字呈现；在27种书写系统上预训练以对齐译文。再在从未见过的无翻译老挝语上做适配实验，并做文字改写对照（老挝语换陌生字母、桑塔利语用天城文 vs 本族文字）。
AI.result: 无翻译老挝语上的英语检索成功率是最强简单基线的7倍。改用不熟悉字母书写后老挝语未能进入共享空间，即使其近亲泰语在预训练中；桑塔利语无亲缘语言，但用印地语熟悉的天城文可进入，用本族文字则不能。
AI.conclusion: 熟悉字形是跨语言共享语义空间的主要入口；将文本转写为熟悉文字，或可使多语言模型覆盖无翻译的语言。

title: Quantifying Trait-State Hierarchy in EEG Foundation Model and Signal Processing Embeddings
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) measures brain activity through recording electrical potentials of the scalp. EEG recordings capture two distinct sets of characteristics in the signal: (1) \emph{Traits} -- information that remains relatively constant over the course of a recording session, such as subject identity, age, and sex; (2) \emph{States} -- signatures that encode responses to external stimuli, including visual, auditory, and motor information. There is limited understanding of how different EEG modeling features (signal processing and foundation models) encode state and trait characteristics. In this work, we quantify state- and trait-level features captured by EEG embeddings using a hierarchy metric and kNN purity on Brain-Computer Interface dataset trials, and find that a majority of EEG features form a macro-trait hierarchy (embeddings form trait-level clusters with micro-states within). Our linear probe results indicate that this hierarchy structure leads to suboptimal state distinguishability, negatively impacting BCI performance of EEG foundation models. To mitigate this, we explore normalization techniques that reduce trait-specific information in embeddings and provide a $\sim$ 10\% improvement in balanced accuracy for state classification. Additionally, we observe that when fine-tuning models for downstream state decoding, embedding spaces transform from macro-trait to macro-state hierarchies, which in turn lead to better state decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了EEG嵌入中"特质(trait)"与"状态(state)"信息的编码结构，发现多数EEG特征形成"宏观特质层级"（特质聚类内含微观状态），导致线性探针下状态可分性较差；通过归一化减少特质信息可使状态分类平衡准确率提升约10%，且微调后嵌入空间由宏观特质层级转为宏观状态层级。
AI.motivation: EEG信号同时包含相对稳定的特质（受试者身份、年龄、性别）与对外部刺激响应的状态（视觉、听觉、运动）两套特征，但不同EEG建模特征（信号处理与基础模型）如何编码状态与特质仍缺乏理解，这种理解缺失限制了BCI解码性能的提升。
AI.method: 在BCI数据集试验上，用层级度量和kNN纯度量化EEG嵌入所捕获的状态级与特质级特征；据此分析层级结构对线性探针状态可分性的影响；并探索归一化技术以减少嵌入中的特质专属信息。
AI.result: 多数EEG特征呈现宏观特质层级结构；该结构导致状态可分性次优，负面影响EEG基础模型的BCI性能；归一化可带来约10%的状态分类平衡准确率提升；微调后嵌入空间从宏观特质层级转为宏观状态层级，从而改善状态解码。
AI.conclusion: EEG嵌入的层级结构（特质主导vs状态主导）是影响BCI性能的关键因素，简单的归一化与微调可显著重塑该结构并提升状态解码效果，为EEG基础模型的表征分析与改进提供了方向。

title: CoReFlow: Consistency-Relaxed Flow Maps for Probabilistic Traffic Forecasting
summary: Probabilistic traffic forecasting is essential for reliable Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), as it captures uncertainties in complex road networks. Recent diffusion- and flow-based generative models have facilitated uncertainty modeling through a multi-step sampling process. However, beyond slow inference, this process is designed to capture complex multimodal distributions, which misaligns with the limited complexity of the conditional traffic data distribution, causing models to underperform deterministic baselines. To address this, we introduce the \underline{Co}nsistency-\underline{Re}laxed \underline{Flow} Map (CoReFlow) model, presenting the first effort to leverage the one-step generation capability of flow maps, known as solution operators of probability-flow ordinary differential equations. Besides, we improve accuracy using a concise training objective that supervises the model via interpolation endpoints over finite time intervals. Unlike existing methods (e.g., self-distillation and MeanFlow Identity) that maintain trajectory consistency to model multimodal distributions, our objective leverages conditional mean to restrict the consistency, thereby achieving higher accuracy in the probabilistic traffic forecasting task. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets show CoReFlow achieves state-of-the-art forecasting accuracy. It surpasses recent baselines, provides competitive uncertainty modeling, and reduces inference costs compared to existing generative baselines.

AI.tldr: CoReFlow 首次将 flow map（一步生成算子）用于概率交通预测，通过以条件均值为监督目标的"一致性松弛"训练策略，在提升精度的同时降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 扩散/流模型依赖多步采样，推理慢；且其设计目标是刻画复杂多峰分布，而条件交通数据分布的复杂度有限，导致其反而不如确定性基线。作者希望利用 flow map 的一步生成能力解决上述问题。
AI.method: 提出 Consistency-Relaxed Flow Map（CoReFlow）：以概率流 ODE 的解算子 flow map 实现一步生成；采用简洁训练目标，用有限时间区间上插值端点对模型进行监督；不同于自蒸馏或 MeanFlow Identity 那样维持整条轨迹一致性来建模多峰分布，该目标利用条件均值来"松弛"一致性约束。
AI.result: 在四个真实数据集上取得 SOTA 预测精度，优于近期基线；不确定性建模具备竞争力，且相比现有生成式基线显著降低推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 针对条件交通分布复杂度有限的特点，适度松弛轨迹一致性、以条件均值监督的 flow map 一步生成，是兼顾精度、不确定性与效率的有效方案。

title: NitroFusion2: Bringing Adversarial Loss to the Text Stream of Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
summary: Adversarial diffusion distillation has conventionally relied on image features for discrimination. We revisit this choice for multimodal diffusion transformers (MMDiTs), whose text stream becomes image-dependent through joint attention. We introduce Text-Stream Adversarial Distillation (TSAD), which exploits intermediate text-token states as a new adversarial representation. Because the text stream has already read the image while remaining tied to the text condition, changing that condition changes what information it extracts from the image. Building on this property, we introduce Aspect-Cued Discrimination (ACD), which conditions the discriminator on different aspects of the sample, such as typography, objects, or style, to steer which properties are emphasized during adversarial training. Building on the expert-discriminator design of NitroFusion, we integrate TSAD and ACD in NitroFusion2. NitroFusion2 brings few-step distillation from the conventional 4-8-step regime down to just 1-2 steps at comparable quality. At one step, it produces sharp rendered text and rich fine-grained details, making one-step generation practical rather than merely a stress test for distillation. At two steps, it remains competitive across the evaluated benchmarks. These results establish the MMDiT text stream as a powerful and steerable representation for adversarial diffusion distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出文本流对抗蒸馏（TSAD）与方面提示判别（ACD），构建NitroFusion2，将少步蒸馏从4-8步降至1-2步且质量相当。
AI.motivation: 对抗扩散蒸馏传统上依赖图像特征进行判别，作者重新审视这一选择，针对多模态扩散Transformer（MMDiT）中文本流通过联合注意力变得图像依赖的特性，探索文本token状态作为新的判别表示。
AI.method: 利用MMDiT中间文本token状态作为对抗表示（TSAD）；因文本流已读取图像但仍绑定文本条件，改变条件即可改变其从图像中提取的信息，据此提出ACD，使判别器以排版、物体、风格等不同方面为条件，引导对抗训练强调特定属性；基于NitroFusion的专家判别器设计将其整合为NitroFusion2。
AI.result: NitroFusion2把蒸馏从4-8步降至1-2步且质量相当；单步生成可渲染清晰文字与丰富细粒度细节，使一步生成具备实用性；两步在评测基准上仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了MMDiT文本流作为对抗扩散蒸馏中强大且可引导的表示。

title: Trace2Eval: Contextualized Evaluation of Coding Agents from Real-World Traces
summary:
Coding agents are increasingly used in real-world workflows across diverse domains, motivating evaluation grounded in real user tasks. Existing benchmarks, however, largely rely on static public tasks with reference patches or hidden tests. Next-generation coding-agent benchmarks should therefore move beyond correctness on fixed tasks toward continually renewed evaluation of overall artifact quality in real user workflows.
  We propose Trace2Eval, a dynamically updatable pipeline that constructs benchmarks from real-world interaction trajectories. Trace2Eval employs a multi-agent reconstruction system to analyze the filtered trajectory, recover the original user query, restore the workspace files to their pre-interaction state, and rebuild a trajectory-equivalent execution environment. A candidate agent then executes the reconstructed query to produce an initial artifact.
  To evaluate these artifacts, the pipeline iteratively refines human rubrics through inter-annotator alignment, and calibrates judge agents against human assessments using source-code and runtime evidence. Guided by feedback from the Trace2Eval pipeline, models revise their initial artifacts, yielding a mean score gain of 10.05 percentage points across 19 model-harness configurations and a maximum of 19.28 percentage points for DeepSeek-V4-Pro with Claude Code, which supports rubric feedback as actionable guidance for artifact improvement.

AI.tldr: Trace2Eval 是一个可动态更新的基准构建流水线，利用真实交互轨迹重建任务与环境，并通过人类对齐的评分细则（rubric）与校准后的评审智能体评价产物质量，反馈还能显著提升模型表现。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体基准多依赖静态公开任务（参考补丁或隐藏测试），只衡量固定任务的正确性，无法反映真实用户工作流中产物整体质量的持续评估需求。
AI.method: 从真实交互轨迹出发：先用多智能体重建系统分析过滤后的轨迹，恢复原始用户查询、将工作区文件还原到交互前状态、重建轨迹等价的执行环境；候选智能体执行重建查询生成初始产物；再通过标注者间对齐迭代精化人类评分细则，并用源码与运行时证据校准评审智能体。
AI.result: 在 19 种模型-框架配置上平均提升 10.05 个百分点，DeepSeek-V4-Pro 配合 Claude Code 最高提升 19.28 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 评分细则反馈可作为可操作的改进指导，表明基准应从固定任务正确性转向在真实工作流中持续更新地评估产物整体质量。

title: Holistic Parallel Supervision for Expressive Speech to Speech Translation
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: Expressiveness is central to speech-to-speech translation (S2ST), yet existing datasets rarely align source and target speech jointly in content, prosody, timing, and speaker identity. Consequently, current systems often rely on indirect conditioning or transfer mechanisms. To obtain this supervision, we introduce a training-data construction strategy that combines professional dubbing, which provides human-performed correspondence in content, prosody, and timing, with multilingual voice conversion to reduce speaker mismatch. We evaluate this supervision using existing expressive S2ST systems and DirectS2ST, an end-to-end method developed in this work that predicts the complete target-speech representation directly from source speech. Experiments on English-German and English-Spanish show that holistic parallel supervision improves expressive realization across all evaluated systems. DirectS2ST exhibits the largest gains in content, prosody, timing, speaker similarity, and human-rated expressiveness. To our knowledge, this work provides the first systematic investigation of holistic parallel supervision for expressive S2ST.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将专业配音与多语言声音转换结合的数据构建策略，获得内容、韵律、时序与说话人身份全面对齐的平行语音数据，并据此开发端到端 DirectS2ST，在英德、英西翻译上显著提升表现力。
AI.motivation: 语音到语音翻译（S2ST）中表现力很重要，但现有数据集很少让源语与目标语语音在内容、韵律、时序和说话人身份上同时对齐，导致系统只能依赖间接条件或迁移机制。
AI.method: 提出训练数据构建策略：用专业配音提供人类表演的内容、韵律与时序对应关系，再用多语言声音转换减小说话人差异；并用该监督训练现有表现力S2ST系统及本文开发的端到端方法 DirectS2ST（直接从源语音预测完整目标语音表示）。
AI.result: 英德、英西实验显示，整体平行监督使所有被评估系统的表现力均有提升；DirectS2ST 在内容、韵律、时序、说话人相似度和人工评定的表现力上提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个针对表现力S2ST的整体平行监督的系统性研究，验证了该类监督数据的有效性与价值。

title: Grounded but Not Immune: Confirmation Bias in Agent-as-a-judge
summary: Evaluating open-ended agent tasks increasingly falls to an Agent-as-a-Judge: an evaluator handed tools and the agent's full trajectory so it can verify a result against the environment. The premise is that a judge that gathers its own evidence should be grounded by it. We show that this grounding does not immunize the judge against confirmation bias: a single false pre-screening note, attributed to an authority and carrying no evidential bearing on the correct verdict, overturns up to 40% of a tool-using judge's correct verdicts across four judges and five datasets, even though the judge collects decisive evidence. The shift is driven by specific properties of the cue. We treat this cue as a controlled diagnostic of confirmation bias rather than an adversarial attack. Our central contribution is to explain how confirmation bias changes the judge's behavior in a trajectory. We classify changes in judge behavior and attribute changes to one of three failure modes: over-trust (verify, conclude correctly, then defer), hallucination (fabricate support for the flip), and under-investigation (stop at the first corroborating signal). For the two Claude judges, the failure is predominantly over-trust (67-75% of harmful flips), while smaller judges have error modes spread across all three. Lightweight mitigations blunt but never remove the bias.

AI.tldr: 在Agent-as-a-Judge场景下，单条伪造的"预筛结论"（附有权威归属、与正确结论无证据关联）可使工具型评审员最多40%的正确判定被翻转，即便其自行收集了决定性证据。作者将确认偏误划分为过度信任、幻觉、调查不足三种失败模式，并发现轻量缓解手段只能削弱、无法消除该偏差。
AI.motivation: 开放式agent任务日益依赖Agent-as-a-Judge进行评测，其前提假设是"评审员自行采集证据即可被证据所约束（grounded）"。论文旨在检验该前提是否成立：即自主取证的评审员是否仍会受确认偏误影响。
AI.method: 向评审流程注入一条受控的虚假预筛备注（归因于权威、且不携带任何与正确判定相关的证据信息），将其作为确认偏误的诊断探针而非对抗攻击；覆盖4个评审模型与5个数据集；对评审员在轨迹中的行为变化进行分类，并归因至三种失败模式：过度信任（先正确验证并得出结论，随后让步）、幻觉（编造支持翻转的依据）、调查不足（在首个佐证信号处停止）。
AI.result: 单条虚假提示即可翻转最多40%的正确判定，且发生在评审员已采集到决定性证据的情况下。两个Claude评审员的危害性翻转中67–75%属于过度信任；较小模型的错误则分散于三种模式。轻量缓解措施可削弱但无法消除该偏差。
AI.conclusion: 证据接地并不能免疫确认偏误，Agent-as-a-Judge的可靠性前提受到挑战。论文的主要贡献在于刻画确认偏误如何在轨迹中改变评审行为，并给出可归因的失败模式分类，为后续评测与缓解设计提供诊断框架。

title: Give the Drafter a Second Chance to Guess: Parallel Reconsideration for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference with a small drafter, whose per-guess acceptance rate determines the achievable speedup. Feature-level drafters share a design choice: every token, easy or hard, is drafted under a single forward pass. Many of the tokens the target rejects are ones the drafter is itself unsure about yet the target answers decisively. To address this, we introduce Parallel Reconsideration: guided by its own uncertainty, the drafter reconsiders its hesitant guesses with extra passes that run in parallel with the one-pass draft, adding negligible latency. A co-designed training recipe and serving-time drafting algorithm append these reconsidered guesses to the original draft tree as refined candidates. Across models and benchmarks, on average, Parallel Reconsideration improves over the baselines by 5.3% to 10.2% on acceptance length and by 3.5% to 9.2% on speedup.

AI.tldr: 提出Parallel Reconsideration：草稿模型依据自身不确定性，对犹豫的猜测用并行额外前向重新生成，将精炼候选并入原草稿树，几乎不增延迟，接受长度提升5.3%–10.2%，加速比提升3.5%–9.2%。
AI.motivation: 投机解码的加速受限于每次猜测被接受的比例。特征级草稿器对所有token（无论难易）都只做单次前向，而目标模型明确拒绝的token中，许多正是草稿器本身就不确定的，这些位置值得投入更多计算。
AI.method: 以草稿器自身不确定性为引导，对高不确定的猜测执行额外前向pass，并与原单次草稿并行运行以隐藏延迟；配套设计训练方案与推理时草稿算法，把重新考量的结果作为精炼候选追加到原草稿树中。
AI.result: 在多个模型与基准上平均而言，接受长度较基线提升5.3%–10.2%，加速比提升3.5%–9.2%。
AI.conclusion: 按不确定性自适应分配草稿计算、并用并行pass隐藏开销，是提升投机解码接受率与端到端加速的有效且低成本方向。

title: Toward an Optimal Configuration for Tree Species Classification from Bark Images: A Leakage-Safe Ablation Study
summary: Background: The automatic identification of tree species from bark photographs is of practical interest for forestry inventory and the wood-processing industry, yet the design choices that govern the accuracy of deep-learning approaches have not been studied systematically, and some prior results may be inflated by leakage of images of the same trunk across training and test partitions. Methods: A systematic ablation study is conducted on the public BarkNet 1.0 dataset (20 species) under the established tree-level, leakage-safe partitioning scheme. Using ConvNeXt-V2 backbones, the following factors are varied in turn and evaluated by five-fold cross-validation: patch size, the strategy by which per-patch predictions are aggregated into an image-level decision, the training regime (single- versus two-stage), backbone capacity, the whole-image baseline, and the number of patches available at inference. Results: Per-patch accuracy rises monotonically with patch size (from 75.6% at 160 px to 89.6% at 512 px), and image-level accuracy rises in step, plateauing near 94.9% around 512 px. Learned aggregation exceeds majority voting by at most 0.7 pp, an advantage that shrinks as patches grow and attention becomes near-uniform. Backbone capacity (pico to tiny) alters accuracy by less than a point, and two-stage training offers no advantage over one-stage. Whole-image classification (91.9%) trails patch-based aggregation, since it admits no bag to average over; accuracy increases with the number of patches at inference, saturating around 64. Conclusions: The study yields a simple recommended configuration: patches as large as possible while leaving enough to average over (around 512 px here), with a nano backbone. It also quantifies the second-order role of learned aggregation and model capacity, providing a reproducible reference point for practitioners and future research

AI.tldr: 本文在BarkNet 1.0上系统消融ConvNeXt-V2树皮识树方案，发现精度主要由patch尺寸与推理patch数决定，最大patch(约512px)配nano骨干、简单聚合即可达约94.9%。
AI.motivation: 树皮照片自动识别树种对林业清查和木材加工有实用价值，但深度学习方法的关键设计选择缺乏系统研究，且以往结果可能因同一树干的图像跨训练/测试划分泄漏而被高估。
AI.method: 在BarkNet 1.0（20种）上采用树级、无泄漏的划分方案，用ConvNeXt-V2骨干做五折交叉验证消融，依次变化：patch尺寸、patch预测聚合策略（学习式 vs 多数投票）、单阶段/两阶段训练、骨干容量、整图基线、推理时patch数。
AI.result: patch精度随尺寸单调上升（160px的75.6%→512px的89.6%），图像级精度同步上升并在512px附近约94.9%处饱和；学习式聚合最多仅超多数投票0.7pp，且随patch增大、注意力趋于均匀而缩小；骨干从pico到tiny精度差不到1点；两阶段无优势；整图分类91.9%不及patch聚合；精度随推理patch数增加，约64个后饱和。
AI.conclusion: 给出简单推荐配置：patch尽量大同时保留足够数量做平均（此数据集约512px），配nano骨干；学习式聚合与模型容量属二阶因素。该研究提供可复现的参考基线。

title: HELIX: HEterogeneous LLM Inference with FleXible and Fine-Grained Partitioning
summary: LLM inference is inherently heterogeneous, with performance bottlenecks shifting throughout inference phases down to individual operators. This has motivated heterogeneous serving systems that disaggregate execution across specialized accelerators, typically through fixed partitions such as prefill/decode or attention/FFN. However, these approaches commit to a partitioning strategy in advance, limiting their ability to adapt to different workloads and model architectures while forcing emerging accelerators into predefined roles. We present HELIX, a vLLM-based software stack that discovers, compiles and dispatches workload-aware partitions across heterogeneous accelerators at the operator granularity. At engine initialization, HELIX automatically determines hardware-specific operator placements that minimize execution latency, accounting for profiled execution costs, communication overheads, device capabilities, and memory constraints. It combines dynamic programming, piecewise compilation, and heterogeneous subgraph dispatch, enabling accelerators with partial operator coverage to participate in LLM inference without predefined model partitions. HELIX provides an open-source unified framework for exploring, evaluating, and integrating heterogeneous accelerators for LLM inference, lowering the barrier to emerging hardware by exposing them as subgraph executors. In systems combining H100 and B200 GPUs with emerging accelerators, HELIX resolves LLM partitions that multi-query decoding latency by up to 3$\times$ for dense and sparse transformer models and up to 3.5$\times$ for hybrid state-space models, relative to standard attention-FFN disaggregation.

AI.tldr: HELIX 是一个基于 vLLM 的软件栈，在算子粒度上自动发现、编译并调度跨异构加速器的工作负载感知分区，突破预填充/解码、注意力/FFN 等固定划分的限制。
AI.motivation: LLM 推理的瓶颈在推理各阶段乃至单个算子间不断转移，现有异构服务系统采用预填充/解码或注意力/FFN 等固定分区，难以适应不同工作负载与模型架构，还把新兴加速器强行塞进预设角色。
AI.method: 引擎初始化时，依据实测执行开销、通信开销、设备能力与显存约束，用动态规划自动求解硬件特定的算子放置方案；结合分段编译（piecewise compilation）与异构子图调度，使仅覆盖部分算子的加速器无需预定义模型划分即可参与推理；并开放为子图执行器接口。
AI.result: 在 H100、B200 与新兴加速器混合系统中，多查询解码延迟相较标准注意力-FFN 解耦：稠密与稀疏 Transformer 最高降低至 1/3（3× 加速），混合状态空间模型最高 3.5×。
AI.conclusion: HELIX 提供了开源统一框架，降低新兴硬件集成门槛，实现工作负载与硬件感知的算子级异构调度，显著提升推理性能。

title: When Every Choice Is Correct: A Causal Study of Numerical Preference in Language Models
summary: When a language model chooses a number between 1 and 30, every integer in the range is valid, yet the model can favor particular answers. We use numerical choice to study how preference is processed across layers and tokens. Perturbation probing and gradient attribution nominate neurons for activation interventions. In a selected Qwen3-4B case, a pre-answer edit changes 17 to 15 while both runs first emit 1. After the edit ends, selective cache and attention-output replacements trace part of its continuing influence on the second digit. Replacing one attention head's output or the other heads' outputs jointly produces similar immediate readout contributions; both interventions restore 17 but have different final log-odds effects on 7 versus 5. Holding later multilayer perceptron (MLP) outputs at their values from the edited run without either replacement reduces this effect gap from 0.119 to 0.0025 nat. Later computation therefore changes how similar local contributions affect the continuation. Retrospective estimates across eighteen contexts capture much of the probability movement but miss the selected answer switch. Prompt tests also separate influence from answer changes: one held-out prompt retains influence without switching, and only one of twelve fresh wordings qualifies for the reader/MLP test; there, joint MLP clamping again reduces the gap between the two reader effects while the answer remains 17. These results use numerical choice as a controlled case for studying persistent state and conditional downstream processing; they do not establish the origin or a complete circuit of natural numerical preference.

AI.tldr: 论文以"1到30选数"作为受控任务，逐层逐token追踪语言模型数字偏好的处理过程：单次前置干预（把17改成15）的影响会通过残差缓存与注意力输出持续传播到后续数字，但后续MLP计算会改变相似局部贡献对最终续写的影响方式。
AI.motivation: 模型在1–30之间选数时所有整数都合法，却会偏好特定答案。作者借此"数值选择"场景，研究偏好信息如何在层与token之间被处理，尤其是早期干预的持续影响（persistent state）与下游计算如何条件性地改变这种影响。
AI.method: 扰动探测与梯度归因定位候选神经元；在Qwen3-4B中做答案前激活编辑（17→15）；编辑结束后用选择性KV缓存替换与注意力输出替换，追踪第二位数受影响的来源；分别替换单个注意力头输出与其余头输出做对比；将后期MLP输出钳制为编辑run的取值；跨18个上下文做回顾性估计；并用12种改写与1个留出提示做稳健性/分离测试。
AI.result: 编辑后两次运行都先输出"1"；替换某注意力头或其余头联合输出产生相似的即时读出贡献，但最终对7 vs 5的对数几率影响不同；把后期MLP输出钳制到编辑run的值后，该效应差距从0.119 nat降至0.0025 nat。18个上下文的回顾性估计能解释大部分概率变动，但漏掉了所选答案的切换。留出提示可保留影响而不改变答案；12种新措辞中仅1种通过reader/MLP测试，且该处联合MLP钳制同样缩小效应差距而答案仍为17。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明早期干预的影响会持续存在，但后续计算会重新加权相似局部贡献对续写的作用；数值选择可作为研究持续状态与条件性下游处理的受控案例。作者明确不主张该现象代表自然数字偏好的起源或完整回路。

title: Do Language Models Know Which Constraints Belong Together?
comment: 23 pages, 4 figures, 15 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/junbolian/JointDW
summary: Dantzig-Wolfe reformulation strengthens the linear relaxation of a mixed-integer program by convexifying a chosen set of constraint families, and every candidate costs a column generation run. The choice is hard when families strengthen the bound only together, because a search that adds one family at a time then stops at the linear relaxation. The classical inequalities of lot sizing, network design and facility location rest on such zero-marginal groups. We prove that when each evaluation convexifies at most $s$ of $k$ families, any method that observes only bounds needs a covering number of evaluations, of order $k^w$, to find a hidden group of $w$ families, also on actual Dantzig-Wolfe relaxations. A prediction that misses $e$ members reduces the cost to $Θ(k^e)$, through one staged search that does not need to know $e$, so the evaluations a prediction saves measure what the predictor knows. We study two sources of predictions. A one-pass lookahead at an optimal LP dual is provably blind to groups whose families share no variable, and a language model reads the names and text of the model. JointDW verifies the prediction of the language model with the staged search and interleaves it with the lookahead at a bounded loss. Groups that strengthen the bound only jointly appear in a quarter of the MIPLIB-NL models whose bound can be improved. There the strongest language models identify them about as often as the lookahead, their predictions rest on the names for textbook models, and reasoning about doubles the accuracy of the same model. On larger models with distracting families, the lookahead finds the group in one evaluation of three families. Language models given only the text seldom name it, while one reasoning model given every coefficient names it in all but one answer and then needs fewer evaluations than the lookahead for pairs of families.

AI.tldr: Dantzig-Wolfe重构中识别"仅在联合时才增强松弛"的约束族组需要覆盖级评估，本文用预测降低评估成本。
AI.motivation: 逐族添加的搜索在零边际组（零边际成本组）处停滞，每评估一次族组就要跑一次列生成，成本高，需要理论刻画何时能减少评估。
AI.method: 证明在每次评估凸化至多s族时，发现隐w族组需Θ(k^w)覆盖数级评估；提出无需知e的分阶段搜索（预测错e个成员可降至Θ(k^e)）；比较两类预测源：最优LP对偶的单趟前瞻，及用语言模型读取模型名称与文本的预测；JointDW验证并用分阶段搜索与前瞻交错整合。
AI.result: 在可提升界的MIPLIB-NL模型中约四分之一存在联合增强组；最强语言模型的识别率与前瞻相当，名称对教科书模型有用，推理使准确率翻倍；大模型上前瞻一次评估即可找到三族组；仅给文本的模型少能命中，而给全部系数的推理模型几乎全中。
AI.conclusion: 评估次数可视为预测知识的度量；语言模型预测结合分阶段搜索与前瞻可在有界损失下高效找到联合增强的约束族组。

title: TRUST-Stereo: Teacher-Assisted Robust Uncertainty-Guided Search and Transfer for Fast Stereo Matching
summary: Coarse-to-fine stereo matching enables efficient disparity estimation but remains sensitive to errors in propagated disparity, which may place ground-truth correspondences outside subsequent local search ranges. We propose TRUST-Stereo (Teacher-Assisted Robust Uncertainty-Guided Search and Transfer for Fast Stereo Matching), which addresses this limitation through an Uncertainty-Guided Residual Search Module (UGRSM). UGRSM estimates the reliability of propagated disparity and predicts residual offsets to adaptively relocate local cost-volume centers. Additionally, we introduce a two-stage Senior-Junior Teacher Assistant knowledge distillation strategy to transfer rich monocular representations from a large foundation model to a lightweight backbone to achieve fast stereo matching performance. Experiments on KITTI 2012, KITTI 2015, ETH3D, and Middlebury demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization. Using only 1.4M synthetic stereo pairs, TRUST-Stereo achieves state-of-the-art results on several benchmark metrics, outperforming competing efficient methods trained with substantially larger datasets, including real-world pseudo-labeled samples. Specifically, it achieves a KITTI 2015 EPE of 0.93, ETH3D Bad 1.0 of 2.13% and Middlebury Bad 2.0 of 6.79% while maintaining inference at approximately 50 ms per stereo pair.

AI.tldr: 提出TRUST-Stereo，用不确定性引导残差搜索模块(UGRSM)加双阶段教师助理知识蒸馏，实现快速且泛化强的粗到精立体匹配。
AI.motivation: 粗到精立体匹配高效，但对传播视差的误差敏感：错误传播会使真实对应点落在后续局部搜索范围之外，导致匹配失败。
AI.method: 1) 不确定性引导残差搜索模块(UGRSM)：估计传播视差的可靠性并预测残差偏移，自适应地重新定位局部代价体积中心，把搜索窗口对准正确位置；2) 两阶段“高级-初级教师助理”(Senior-Junior Teacher Assistant)知识蒸馏，把大型基础模型丰富的单目表征迁移到轻量骨干网络。
AI.result: 仅用1.4M合成立体对训练，在KITTI 2012/2015、ETH3D、Middlebury上展现强零样本泛化：KITTI 2015 EPE 0.93，ETH3D Bad 1.0为2.13%，Middlebury Bad 2.0为6.79%，推理约50ms/对，优于使用更大数据集（含真实伪标签）训练的高效方法。
AI.conclusion: UGRSM通过不确定性驱动的搜索中心重定位，有效缓解传播误导，配合教师助理蒸馏得到轻量高效的模型，在多项基准上达到SOTA精度并保持实时性。

title: Scythe: Semantic-Aware Rewriting for Fast,Effective Program Reduction
summary: Automated program reduction shrinks a program into a smaller one that preserves a property of interest. Language-agnostic grammar-based reducers are easy to retarget across languages, but because they reason only about syntax, they cannot perform the coupled edits needed to remove whole declarations, e.g., a method cannot be deleted while it is still called. As a result, they waste oracle calls on edits that cannot succeed and often leave irrelevant declarations behind. We present SCYTHE, a fast, semantic-aware pre-processing step that runs in front of any grammar-based reducer without modifying it. SCYTHE encodes the program as a typed declaration dependency graph and applies a set of semantic-aware operators that decouple declarations from their use sites, making them removable while keeping the program well-typed. Fine-grained token-level minimization is then left to the downstream reducer. On 73 benchmarks across C, Java, and Solidity, combining SCYTHE with PERSES never yields a larger result than PERSES alone, and a strictly smaller one on 70 of 73 cases. On average, the combination produces programs 55.6% smaller (up to 95.5%) and is 2.3$\times$ faster (up to 7.4$\times$). SCYTHE also boosts LATRA, a reducer that, unlike the purely syntactic PERSES, also applies language-specific transformations: the combination produces programs 10.6% smaller (up to 61.8%) and is 2.4$\times$ faster on average. Video: https://youtu.be/uEq_YYU0zZw

AI.tldr: SCYTHE 是一个语义感知的预处理步骤，通过在语法类归约器前构建类型化声明依赖图并解耦声明与使用点，使整体程序归约更快更小。
AI.motivation: 语言无关的基于语法的归约器只理解语法，无法进行删除整个声明所需的耦合编辑（如方法仍被调用时无法删除），导致浪费 oracle 调用并残留无关声明。
AI.method: SCYTHE 将程序编码为类型化声明依赖图，应用一组语义感知算子把声明与其使用点解耦，使声明可被删除且保持程序类型良好；随后把细粒度 token 级最小化交给下游归约器，且不修改下游归约器。
AI.result: 在 C、Java、Solidity 的 73 个基准上，SCYTHE+PERSES 从不比单独 PERSES 更差，70/73 严格更小；平均小 55.6%（最高 95.5%），快 2.3 倍（最高 7.4 倍）。与 LATRA 结合平均小 10.6%（最高 61.8%），快 2.4 倍。
AI.conclusion: 语义感知预处理可有效增强任意基于语法的归约器，在多个语言和归约器上均带来更小结果与显著加速。

title: Confucius4-R2T2: A Stable-Prefix Streaming ASR Model for Real Real-Time Transcription
comment: 30 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Code and model weights available at https://github.com/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2 and https://huggingface.co/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2
summary: Streaming speech recognition is increasingly consumed by machines, such as translators and voice agents, that act on each token as it appears. A token that is later revised costs wasted work or a wrong action. In this work, we present Confucius4-R2T2 (short for Real Real-Time Transcription), a stable-prefix streaming ASR model that never modifies its earlier output while maintaining high accuracy and low latency. R2T2 is obtained by post-training Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on 1,500 hours of Chinese and English audio while freezing its pre-trained audio encoder and projector. The adaptation is based on the concept of Longest Stable Prefix (LSP), a new notion that we introduce in this work. We prove that LSP is monotone under the prefix order, consistent with the full-audio output, and maximal among labels that equal a whole earlier output. Learning from LSP labels converts a full-context model into a stable-prefix streaming one without any architectural change. Extensive evaluations show that R2T2 brings streaming recognition close to the base model's full-context quality while delivering stable text with low emission lag. Its gains extend beyond the post-training languages, demonstrating a practical path from full-context ASR to stable streaming. We open-source the model weights and code at https://huggingface.co/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2 and https://github.com/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2.

AI.tldr: 提出 Confucius4-R2T2 稳定前缀流式 ASR 模型，通过最长稳定前缀（LSP）标签对 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 后训练，实现不修改已输出文本的实时识别。
AI.motivation: 流式识别越来越多被机器消费（翻译器、语音助手），逐 token 行动，若后续 token 被修正则造成浪费或错误动作；需保证输出稳定性。
AI.method: 冻结预训练音频编码器与投影层，在 1500 小时中英文音频上对 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 后训练；提出最长稳定前缀（LSP）概念并证明其单调性、与全音频输出一致性、且为等于完整先前输出的最大标签，无需架构改动即把全上下文模型转为稳定前缀流式模型。
AI.result: 流式识别质量接近基座全上下文水平，文本稳定且发出延迟低；增益可迁移到后训练语言之外。
AI.conclusion: 提供了从全上下文 ASR 到稳定流式识别的实用路径，并开源模型权重与代码。

title: How Do Artificial Agents Make Decisions in Light of Visual Data?
comment: Presented at the Workshop on GenAI, Agents, and the Future of VIS, held in conjunction with IEEE VIS, 2026
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated significant advances in reasoning with visual data, which is particularly important given that much of human knowledge is encoded visually in scientific articles and other sources. However, a gap remains in understanding how artificial agents, powered by VLMs, perceive and navigate decision-making under uncertainty in the presence of visual data. This study explores this gap by evaluating and analyzing autonomous decision-making processes. Building upon prior work in visualization literacy and decision theory, we conducted two complementary studies: one examining how agents perceive and quantify uncertainty encoded in visualizations, and another investigating how artificial agents make decisions based on visual data in the form of images. We analyzed perception accuracy and decision performance across models and visualization types. Our results show that GPT-4o demonstrates the highest accuracy in perceiving uncertainty in pie and bar charts among the tested models. For decision-making, autonomous agents showed the best alignment with rational decision theory when uncertainty was represented through circle charts, icon arrays, or text.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过两项互补实验，评估VLM智能体对可视化中不确定性的感知与基于图像的自主决策能力，发现GPT-4o在饼图/柱状图不确定性感知上最优，且智能体在圆图、图标阵列或文本形式下决策最符合理性决策理论。
AI.motivation: 人类知识大量以视觉形式（如科学文章的图表）编码，VLM在视觉推理上已有进展，但尚不清楚由VLM驱动的人工智能体如何感知可视化中的不确定性并在不确定条件下做出决策，这一空白值得填补。
AI.method: 基于可视化素养与决策理论的既有工作，设计两项互补研究：研究一考察智能体如何感知并量化可视化中编码的不确定性；研究二考察智能体如何基于图像形式的视觉数据做决策。跨模型、跨可视化类型分析感知准确性与决策表现。
AI.result: 所测模型中GPT-4o对饼图和柱状图中不确定性的感知准确率最高；决策方面，当不确定性以圆图、图标阵列或文本呈现时，自主智能体与理性决策理论的对齐程度最佳。
AI.conclusion: VLM智能体的不确定性感知与决策能力显著依赖模型和可视化类型，存在可视化形式偏好；这为设计面向AI智能体的可视化以及评估其不确定性推理提供了实证依据与改进方向。

title: RESHPart: Feedback-Reshaped Spectral Embedding for Hypergraph Partitioning
summary: With scalable Laplacian solvers now available, the next frontier is to exploit them more effectively for high-quality hypergraph partitioning. In this work, we revisit spectral hypergraph partitioning from the perspective of spectral embedding geometry. Through a systematic analysis of circuit hypergraphs and controlled synthetic (hyper)graphs, we identify a ray-like embedding structure that helps explain the effectiveness of projection-based partitioning. We further show that the geometry of spectral embeddings can be systematically influenced through Laplacian design and hyperedge reweighting. Guided by these insights, we propose FRESHPart, a feedback-reshaped spectral partitioning framework that refines the spectral embedding through Geometry Feedback and Search Feedback, producing embeddings that are better aligned with projection-based partitioning. On the Titan23 benchmark, FRESHPart achieves average cut reductions over hMETIS of 13.09% at $ε=2\%$ and 25.21% at $ε=20\%$, surpassing the strongest previously reported results (12.16% and 22.53%, respectively), while completing every benchmark in under 120 s on a single GPU.

AI.tldr: 从谱嵌入几何视角重新审视超图划分，提出FRESHPart框架，通过几何反馈与搜索反馈协同优化谱嵌入，在Titan23上取得超越此前最佳结果的划分质量。
AI.motivation: 可扩展Laplacian求解器已成熟，如何更有效地利用它们实现高质量超图划分成为新前沿；现有投影式谱划分虽有效，但其几何原理不清晰，嵌入结构与划分效果的关系缺乏系统解释。
AI.method: 系统分析电路超图与受控合成（超）图，识别出"射线状"嵌入结构以解释投影式划分的有效性；揭示谱嵌入几何可通过Laplacian设计与超边重加权进行系统性调控；据此提出FRESHPart框架，用Geometry Feedback与Search Feedback双反馈机制重塑并精炼谱嵌入，使其更契合投影式划分。
AI.result: 在Titan23基准上，ε=2%时相对hMETIS平均切割降低13.09%，ε=20%时为25.21%，均超过此前最强结果（12.16%与22.53%）；单GPU上所有基准均在120秒内完成。
AI.conclusion: 谱嵌入的几何结构（射线状）是投影式超图划分有效性的关键，且该几何可被主动设计与调控；基于此的FRESHPart在质量与速度上均达到领先水平，为利用Laplacian求解器进行高质量超图划分提供了新范式。

title: Anchored Slice Propagation with Boundary Transport for 3D CT Segmentation from Three Orthogonal Annotated Slices
summary: Sli2Vol propagates a binary mask through affinities between adjacent slices, but an error can persist because each prediction becomes the input to the next step. Three orthogonal annotations reduce dependence on any one chain, yet they offer more than three starting masks: where a chain crosses another annotated plane, the correct label is already known. Those labels could correct drift during propagation and indicate how much to trust each chain at fusion. Between annotated planes, the information carried by the chain may matter as well. A binary mask records foreground membership but discards distance to the boundary, a cue that could help follow gradual shape changes between slices.We address these two sources of error with a fixed pretrained affinity backbone. We anchor each chain by correcting its prediction where it crosses another annotated plane, then use its agreement with those labels to weight fusion. We compare this anchored mask with two ways of transporting boundary geometry: a truncated signed-distance field (SDF) propagated by dense affinity averaging, and a contour whose vertices follow motion cues from the same affinity. The contour tracker starts from a hand-crafted rule and learns a motion correction from supervoxel pseudo-objects in 506 CT volumes, without manual organ labels. On 2,091 held-out structure instances from approximately 403 CT scans spanning 17 abdominal structures, anchoring raises mean Dice from 0.737 with orthogonal mask propagation to 0.769 and improves every structure. Beyond the anchored mask, learned contour tracking improves Dice by 5.7\% for the esophagus and 5.9\% for the postcava, while SDF transport improves right-adrenal Dice by 2.8\%. The anchored methods have similar mean Dice (0.769--0.772); contour tracking performs worse on the kidneys, stomach, and hepatic vessel tree.

AI.tldr: 提出以预训练亲和力骨干为基础的"锚定式"半监督分割：利用正交标注平面校正传播链漂移并在融合时加权，同时比较SDF传输与学习式轮廓跟踪两种边界几何传递方式。
AI.motivation: Sli2Vol式相邻切片亲和力传播存在误差累积，每个预测成为下一步输入导致漂移；三正交标注虽降低单一链依赖，但未被充分利用。此外二值掩码丢失到边界的距离信息，难以跟踪切片间渐变形状。
AI.method: 固定预训练亲和力骨干。每条传播链在穿越其他标注平面处用已知标签校正预测（anchoring），并用与这些标签的一致性为融合加权。对比三种表示：锚定二值掩码；截断符号距离场（SDF）经稠密亲和力平均传播；顶点依亲和力运动线索演化的轮廓，从手工规则起步，在506例CT体素超体素伪物体上学习运动校正，无需人工器官标签。
AI.result: 在约403例CT、17个腹部结构、2,091个结构实例上，锚定将平均Dice从0.737提升至0.769且每个结构均改善；学习式轮廓跟踪使食管+5.7%、下腔静脉+5.9%，SDF传输使右肾上腺+2.8%。三种锚定方法平均Dice相近（0.769–0.772），但轮廓跟踪在肾脏、胃和肝血管树上更差。
AI.conclusion: 交叉标注平面校正能有效抑制传播漂移并指导融合加权；边界几何传输对部分难结构（食管、下腔静脉、右肾上腺）有额外收益，但并非普遍适用，器官特异性选择方法更优。

title: Construction Contracts for Generated Embedded Domain-Specific Language Programs: A Measurement Protocol and a Conditional Effect
comment: 18 pages. Preprint. Intended for submission to the Journal of Systems and Software. Artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23885644
summary: A generated domain-specific program can be accepted by its host and still miss the reference construction. We measure the two events separately and test a short construction contract. The vehicle is Open Quantum Assembly Language (OpenQASM) 3. One 3-billion-parameter generator is run under seven conditions on 100 quantum approximate optimization (QAOA) and 100 variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) instances. Eighty of 100 QAOA signatures appear in some training split. Exact McNemar tests and 95% paired bootstrap intervals are used. The contract, a card, lists structural decisions, enters the prompt, and is checked without a simulator. Parse rates are 0.55 to 0.97 and full structural match is 0.02 to 0.87. On QAOA, at fixed weights, the card moves full match by +32.0 percentage points on card-trained weights (interval +22 to +42) and by -13.0 (-23 to -3) without that training. The +45.0-point difference is not a deployment contrast. The same-step plan-free gain is +23.0 (+13 to +33); the primary distributional score does not separate it. Against the earlier checkpoint the gain is +27.0 (+17 to +37), and the checkpoint also changes. A rule card is not separated from the learned planner, nor is a predicted-card compiler (0.760 vs. 0.780). On 20 QAOA rows outside every training split, the interval includes zero. Under this card, VQE adherence is 0.020 and full match stays near 0.03. Report the two checks separately. Insert a card only into a generator trained to read it, and only where a pilot shows adherence.

AI.tldr: 论文将"生成程序可被宿主接受"与"构造正确"分开测量，并测试一种"构造契约卡"方法：在 OpenQASM 3 上对 100 个 QAOA 与 100 个 VQE 实例、7 种条件下运行 30 亿参数生成器。结果显示解析率与结构匹配率差距巨大，卡片仅在经过卡片训练的权重上有效，且对 VQE 无效。
AI.motivation: 领域特定程序（如 OpenQASM 3 量子电路）被宿主成功解析并不代表构造正确；现有评测把"可接受"与"正确构造"混为一谈，缺少对二者的独立测量及对提示干预效果的严格因果检验。
AI.method: 以 OpenQASM 3 为载体，用 30B 参数生成器在 7 种条件下对 100 个 QAOA 与 100 个 VQE 实例生成程序；将"解析率"与"完整结构匹配率"分开评测。引入"契约卡"（列出结构性决策、放入提示、无需模拟器即可校验）。统计采用精确 McNemar 检验与 95% 配对 bootstrap 区间，并控制权重、检查点、分布外样本等变量做消融对比。
AI.result: 解析率 0.55–0.97，而完整结构匹配仅 0.02–0.87。QAOA 上固定权重时，卡片在卡片训练权重上提升 +32.0 个百分点（区间 +22~+42），在未训练权重上为 −13.0（−23~−3），两者 +45.0 的差异并非部署对比。同步规划无卡增益 +23.0（+13~+33）；相对早期检查点增益 +27.0（+17~+37），但检查点本身也变化。规则卡与学习规划器、预测卡编译器（0.760 vs 0.780）无法区分。20 条分布外 QAOA 样本区间含零。VQE 遵循率仅 0.020，完整匹配约 0.03。
AI.conclusion: 应分别报告"可接受性"与"构造正确性"两项检查；契约卡只能在经过卡片训练的生成器中、且试点显示遵循率足够时才插入提示，不可作为通用即插即用手段。

title: Adapting Qwen3 to Tajik from 0.6B to 8B: Lower Text Loss Did Not Mean Better Understanding
summary: Small LoRA adapters trained on Tajik news and books lowered Qwen3's Tajik text loss at every size we tried, from 0.6B to 8B, by 0.60 to 1.45 nats per token, but none of them improved Tajik reading comprehension where it can be measured. On Belebele the 1.7B and 8B adapters left accuracy unchanged and the 4B adapter lowered it by 3.7 points; at 0.6B the score rose by 4.2 points but sits near chance and coincides with a change in which answer letter the model prefers, so we do not read it as understanding. At 8B, continued pretraining on about 375 million tokens of raw Tajik text was followed by a Belebele gain of 9.9 points. After a further supervised fine-tuning stage, our main model, e3, is 11.4 points above Qwen3-8B on Belebele; its English MMLU changed by -1.2 points, and a loss larger than 3.3 points is excluded. The same heavy recipe applied to Qwen3-0.6B-Base brought its text loss close to that of the 8B model after books-only pretraining, while its multiple-choice answers stayed near chance and its English MMLU fell by 7.6 points. We report 15 trained models and their 5 starting models from June to October 2025, scored in 2026 on one harness with paired intervals, and we report what went wrong: lost training records, a thinking-mode dataset with almost no reasoning in it, later branches whose training data was never documented, and a 4-bit release that contains no transformer layers.

AI.tldr: 小规模 LoRA 适配器虽能持续降低 Qwen3 的塔吉克语文本困惑度（0.60–1.45 nats/token，覆盖 0.6B–8B），但并未带来可测的阅读理解提升；只有在大规模续预训练（8B、约 3.75 亿 token）并加入监督微调后，Belebele 才出现实质增益（e3 比 Qwen3-8B 高 11.4 分）。
AI.motivation: 检验"更低语言建模损失是否等价于更强的低资源语言理解能力"，并如实记录一次塔吉克语适配实验（15 个训练模型 + 5 个起点模型）中成功与失败的部分。
AI.method: 在 Qwen3（0.6B/1.7B/4B/8B）上用塔吉克语新闻与书籍训练小型 LoRA 适配器；8B 上追加约 3.75 亿 token 原始塔吉克文续预训练，再做监督微调得到 e3；统一评测框架下用配对区间评估 Belebele 准确率与英语 MMLU。
AI.result: LoRA 使文本损失下降 0.60–1.45 nats，但 Belebele 上 1.7B/8B 持平、4B 下降 3.7 分、0.6B 升 4.2 分但接近随机水平且伴随答案字母偏好变化。8B 续预训练后 Belebele +9.9 分；e3 高于 Qwen3-8B 11.4 分，英语 MMLU 变化 -1.2 分（>3.3 分损失被排除）。0.6B-Base 用同一重配方后文本损失接近 8B，但选择题仍近随机、英语 MMLU 掉 7.6 分。
AI.conclusion: 低资源语言的文本损失下降不等于理解力提升；小适配器易学到表层分布，规模化续预训练加监督微调才有效，但小模型代价明显。作者同时披露记录丢失、伪思维链数据、未记录数据的分支及"不含 transformer 层"的 4-bit 发布等问题，强调可复现性与失败报告的透明化。

title: From Type to Token: Petri Nets, Individual Token Philosophy, and Individualized Causal Effects
summary:
Structural Causal Models and Bayesian Networks are the dominant framework for representing causal relations. They are fundamentally type-level formalisms since their estimands, Average Treatment Effects and Conditional Average Treatment Effects, are properties of distributions over populations, not of individual units. When treatment effects exhibit unbounded heterogeneity, these estimands collapse. What persists is the structural, token-level core of causation.
  We argue that Petri Nets under the Individual Token Philosophy are the natural representation of these token-level causal structures. We develop a formal translation from Bayesian Networks to Petri Nets, providing a two-layer account of individualized causality. The PN layer provides a structural representation of causal mechanisms that does not rest on distributional assumptions. In turn, a conformal prediction layer quantifies causal effects with finite-sample coverage guarantees. Together they constitute a complete account of individual causal effects.

AI.tldr: 论文指出结构因果模型与贝叶斯网络是类型层面形式化，无法刻画无界异质性下的个体因果效应；主张用"个体令牌哲学"下的Petri网表示令牌层面因果结构，并给出BN到PN的形式化翻译，配合保形预测层实现个体因果效应的完整刻画。
AI.motivation: 主流因果框架（SCM/BN）的估计量ATE、CATE是群体分布层面的属性而非个体属性；当处理效应存在无界异质性时这些估计量会崩溃，只剩下token层面的结构性因果内核，因此需要一种能表示个体层面因果结构的新形式化。
AI.method: 论证Petri网（个体令牌哲学）是token层面因果结构的自然表示；构建从贝叶斯网络到Petri网的形式化翻译，形成两层式个体化因果解释：PN层给出不依赖分布假设的因果机制结构表示，保形预测层则以有限样本覆盖保证量化因果效应。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验或数值结果，仅提出BN→PN翻译的形式化构造与两层框架的完整构想。
AI.conclusion: PN层与保形预测层结合可构成对个体因果效应的完整描述：前者提供分布假设无关的结构刻画，后者提供有限样本统计保证，从而弥补类型层面估计量在无界异质性下的失效。

title: Self-Supervised Learning of Universal Latent Spaces for Operator Learning
summary: Neural operators fit their representation of functions to the task they are trained on, so every new task rebuilds a reduced space from labeled data. Following the self-supervised pre-training that made representations shareable in natural language processing and computer vision, we decouple representation learning from operator learning. A functional autoencoder is pre-trained on analytic functions synthesized on the fly, with no solver and no labels, to represent functions on arbitrary point clouds, and the latent space it induces is frozen and reused across tasks. The representation is exactly equivariant to translation, dilation, and amplitude, and reconstructs solutions of partial differential equations (PDEs) and natural images on geometries it never saw. Being task-agnostic, the latent space can be interpreted in its own right. The whole space is used and decodes to valid fields, it preserves the ordering of distances between physical fields, its geodesics interpolate physical evolutions, and edit directions transfer across fields. With frozen representation maps, a dataset is encoded once and a neural operator is trained entirely on cached embeddings, which saves memory and training time. On 28 tasks in fluid dynamics, solid mechanics, acoustics, and the Helmholtz and Poisson equations, this paradigm can exceed the accuracy of state-of-the-art end-to-end architectures, with up to an order of magnitude higher throughput and memory savings that fit models nearly two orders of magnitude larger on consumer-grade GPUs. At inference, latent rollouts run up to an order of magnitude faster than regular rollouts, and chunked inference processes functions of over half a billion points on a single consumer-grade GPU.

AI.tldr: 提出函数自编码器预训练范式，将函数表示学习与算子学习解耦，冻结潜空间跨任务复用，在28个PDE任务上超越SOTA且显著省内存省时。
AI.motivation: 神经算子把表示绑在具体任务上，每个新任务都需从标注数据重建低维空间，浪费算力且表示不可共享；借鉴NLP/CV自监督预训练的成功，作者希望得到任务无关、可复用的函数表示。
AI.method: 在实时合成的解析函数上、无需求解器和标签地预训练一个函数自编码器，使其能在任意点云上表示函数；该表示对平移、缩放、幅值严格等变；随后冻结潜空间，各任务仅在其缓存嵌入上训练轻量神经算子。
AI.result: 潜空间可解释：全空间解码均为有效场、保持物理场距离序、测地线可插值物理演化、编辑方向可跨场迁移；在流体、固体力学、声学及Helmholtz/Poisson共28个任务上精度超过端到端SOTA，吞吐与内存高一个数量级，可在消费级GPU上容纳近两个数量级更大的模型；推理时潜空间rollout快一个数量级，分块推理可处理超5亿点。
AI.conclusion: 预训练任务无关的函数表示是可行且高效的，可作为神经算子的通用底座，兼顾精度、可解释性与资源效率。

title: GeoDIVE: Geospatial Descent Informed by Value Estimation
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. Includes supplementary material
summary: Finding specific objects, structures, and spatial patterns supports critical work in agriculture, infrastructure planning, environmental monitoring, and disaster response. These features, however, are often dispersed across very large regions and span dramatically different spatial scales, which defines a search space that is costly to embed, maintain, and search naively. We introduce GeoDIVE, a model that treats a multiresolution satellite image gallery as a forest and uses best-first traversal to determine which tiles to encode. At each visited node, a lightweight model then predicts an optimistic estimate of the best query similarity hidden among its descendants using the query and subtree representations. In evaluations with image and open-vocabulary text queries, GeoDIVE matches exhaustive search at 10% of the encoding cost for image queries and leads all tested baselines at every budget in both modalities. To support future evaluation of multiscale geospatial search, we also release object-level image and text queries for Git-10M, constructed from Microsoft building footprints and OpenStreetMap polygons with VLM-generated captions. Source code and models will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: GeoDIVE 把多分辨率卫星图像库建模为森林结构，用最佳优先遍历和轻量模型预测子树内最优相似度的乐观上界，从而只编码部分瓦片，在图像查询下以 10% 编码成本达到穷举搜索效果，并开源 Git-10M 上的目标级图文查询基准。
AI.motivation: 农业、基础设施规划、环境监测与灾害响应都需要在大范围区域内检索特定目标、结构与空间模式；这些目标分布稀疏且跨尺度差异极大，导致朴素地嵌入、维护和搜索整个空间代价高昂，因此需要一种能高效定位相关区域的多尺度地理空间搜索方法。
AI.method: 将多分辨率卫星图像库组织为树/森林结构，采用最佳优先遍历决定编码哪些瓦片；在每个被访问节点上用轻量模型结合查询表示与子树表示，预测其后代中可能存在的最高查询相似度的乐观估计，据此决定扩展顺序，避免对所有瓦片做完整编码。
AI.result: 在图像查询和开放词汇文本查询两类评测中：图像查询下 GeoDIVE 以约 10% 的编码成本达到穷举搜索的效果；在两种模态的每个预算档位下均优于所有对比基线。同时发布了基于 Microsoft 建筑轮廓与 OpenStreetMap 多边形、配以 VLM 生成描述构建的 Git-10M 目标级图文查询集。
AI.conclusion: GeoDIVE 通过预测式最佳优先遍历显著降低了多尺度地理空间搜索的编码开销，并保持与穷举搜索相当或更优的检索效果；所发布的 Git-10M 多尺度查询基准为后续研究提供评测支持，代码与模型将公开。

title: EPISTEME: Trustworthy Coding Agents Through Tool Call Intent
summary: Coding agents change software through tool calls. Tool calls mutate the local state. For good? For bad? Nobody knows. Agents never say why a tool call is made. We propose the epistemic agent design, in which the harness guarantees that the model declares why a tool call is made. The harness then records what the command actually did and checks the self-reported declaration against these effects. The result is a journal 1) that can guard calls before they run and 2) that supports audits and forensics. For evaluation, we use ImpossibleBench, whose tasks can be passed only by cheating, and demonstrate that forcing the agents to say why results in exposed cheating. Across 49 reward-hacking runs of two open-weight models, the journal exposed 90%.

AI.tldr: 提出"认知型智能体"设计:由脚手架强制模型在每次工具调用前声明意图,并记录命令实际效果,与声明比对形成日志,用于调用前防护和事后审计。在ImpossibleBench上,强制"说明理由"使49次奖励黑客运行中90%被日志暴露。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体通过工具调用改变本地状态,但从不说明调用动机,导致好坏影响均不可知、缺乏可审计性与防作弊手段。
AI.method: 脚手架(harness)保证模型必须声明每个工具调用的理由,随后记录命令实际产生的效果,并将自我报告声明与实际效果进行一致性校验,生成日志,支持调用前拦截与事后审计取证。
AI.result: 在只能靠作弊通过的ImpossibleBench任务上,两个开源权重模型共49次奖励黑客运行中,日志暴露了90%的作弊行为。
AI.conclusion: 强制"说明理由"可有效暴露奖励黑客行为,该日志机制为编码智能体提供可防护、可审计的可信性保障。

title: ProcessPrefBench: Evaluating Cross-Task Transfer of Individual Process Preferences from Naturalistic Human-AI Interaction
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures. Published at LM Playschool 2026 (EMNLP 2026 workshop)
summary: In natural human-AI dialogue, users' corrections, requests, and self-descriptions carry reusable signals about how they want work to be done. These signals reveal individual process preferences, user-specific standards for evidence, depth, analytical focus, procedure, and delivery. We ask whether a preference revealed in one dialogue can shape an assistant's later answer when the task does not restate it. ProcessPrefBench uses three months of natural dialogues from two knowledge workers to build 66 source-target cases separately judged for source evidence and target applicability. Sources are preselected, so the benchmark tests application rather than retrieval. We test three models with target-only, full-history, and distilled-preference prompts. Target-specific 0-2 rubrics score preference realization, and a task gate flags severe failures. Compared with target-only prompting, full-history and imperative distilled-preference prompting raise preference realization by 0.204 and 0.244 points on the 0-2 scale, respectively, with no reliable advantage from distillation. Fabricated-evidence failures rise from 5.8% under target-only prompting to 10.1% under full-history and 10.4% under imperative prompting. ProcessPrefBench highlights a tension in learning from dialogue, where drawing on prior interactions can improve preference realization yet also invite fabricated evidence. We hope it helps build assistants that honor a user's process preferences without sacrificing factual reliability.

AI.tldr: ProcessPrefBench 提出用真实长期对话构建 66 个"来源-目标"案例，检验一次对话中透露的流程偏好能否在后续任务中未被重述时仍被应用。实验显示，全历史与蒸馏偏好提示能显著提升偏好落实（+0.204 / +0.244），但捏造证据率也从 5.8% 升至约 10%，揭示利用对话历史时的"偏好落实 vs 事实可靠"张力。
AI.motivation: 在自然的人机对话中，用户的纠正、要求和自我描述隐含着可复用的流程偏好（如证据标准、深度、分析焦点、程序与交付方式）。作者想验证：当后续任务不再重述这些偏好时，助手能否从先前对话中迁移并应用它们；而已有评测多聚焦单轮指令遵循，缺少对跨对话偏好迁移与副作用（如捏造证据）的系统测量。
AI.method: 基于两位知识工作者三个月的自然对话，构建 66 个 source-target 案例，分别对来源证据与目标适用性进行人工判定；预选来源、固定检索，使基准只考验"应用"而非"检索"。测试三个模型，比较三种提示：仅目标、全历史、蒸馏偏好。用目标专属的 0-2 分 rubric 评偏好落实程度，并设任务门控（task gate）标记严重失败。
AI.result: 相对于仅目标提示，全历史提示和祈使式蒸馏偏好提示分别把偏好落实分提高 0.204 与 0.244（0-2 量表）；蒸馏相对全历史没有可靠优势。捏造证据失败率从仅目标提示的 5.8% 上升到全历史 10.1%、祈使式提示 10.4%。
AI.conclusion: ProcessPrefBench 揭示"从对话中学习"的内在张力：利用先前交互能提升偏好落实，却也诱发捏造证据。作者希望该基准推动构建既尊重用户流程偏好、又不牺牲事实可靠性的助手。局限包括样本仅为两位知识工作者、规模 66 例、蒸馏提示未见增益。

title: Agents, Think Only When it Helps
summary: LLM agent distillation transfers agentic capabilities to student models by training on complete teacher trajectories that typically interleave thoughts and actions. We question how critical thought supervision is for agents' ultimate action performance. To answer this, we disentangle their impacts by independently perturbing teacher thoughts and actions during distillation. On widely adopted agent benchmarks across model scales, altering or discarding thoughts has little effect on student performance. We find, however, that thought supervision becomes important when information about the thought is not disclosed in the corresponding action during training. By identifying such discrepant cases, our findings challenge the common practice of distilling entire teacher trajectories for LLM agents, and offer a new insight that thought supervision can be a discernible choice for efficiency depending on whether the information of thought is disclosed in the action.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM智能体蒸馏中"思维监督"是否关键。通过独立扰动教师思维与动作，发现在常用基准上改变或丢弃思维对学生最终动作性能影响甚微；只有当思维信息未在对应动作中体现时，思维监督才变重要。这挑战了蒸馏完整轨迹的常规做法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体蒸馏通常基于完整教师轨迹（交错的思维与动作）训练学生模型，但尚不清楚思维监督对智能体最终动作性能究竟有多重要，作者希望厘清其独立贡献。
AI.method: 将教师轨迹中的思维与动作分别独立扰动，在多模型规模、广泛采用的智能体基准上对比扰动或丢弃思维对学生性能的影响，并识别"思维信息未在动作中披露"的差异情形。
AI.result: 在多种模型规模的常用智能体基准上，修改或丢弃思维几乎不影响学生性能；但当思维信息未在对应动作中披露时，思维监督变得重要。
AI.conclusion: 挑战了蒸馏完整教师轨迹的常见做法；提出思维监督可作为一种基于效率的可辨别选择，取决于思维信息是否已在动作中披露。

title: Text-Only Domain Adaptation for Low-Resource Medical ASR: Shallow Fusion and Density Ratio Rescoring for Hausa
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems often struggle with specialised medical vocabulary, especially in low-resource languages where domain-specific speech data are scarce. We investigate text-only domain adaptation for Hausa medical ASR using the fixed MMS-1B-FL102 acoustic model and two decoding-time language-model fusion methods: Shallow Fusion (SF) and the Density Ratio Approach (DRA). A 4-gram KenLM trained on 19,421 Hausa health sentences serves as the medical target model, while a 75,372-sentence general-domain model provides the source prior for DRA. Evaluation uses 250 recordings of 25 physician-reviewed prompts from 10 speakers across six northern Nigerian states. Under prompt-disjoint five-fold cross-validation, SF and DRA reduce WER from 29.56% to 23.55% and 23.33%, respectively. Both significantly outperform greedy decoding (p < 0.001), while their difference is not significant (p = 0.423). However, general-LM-only SF achieves 23.96% WER, indicating that the medical LM's additional improvement over a general LM is modest. Medical Term Error Rate also improves under fusion, but does not establish a distinct medical-domain advantage. These findings demonstrate that lightweight, text-only language-model fusion can improve Hausa medical ASR without additional domain-specific speech collection.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究豪萨语医学语音识别的纯文本领域自适应。在固定声学模型下，用浅融合(SF)和密度比方法(DRA)融合4-gram KenLM，WER从29.56%降至约23.3–23.6%，但通用语言模型贡献占主导，医学专有LM增益有限。
AI.motivation: ASR系统在专业医学词汇上表现不佳，低资源语言(如豪萨语)的领域特定语音数据尤其稀缺。作者希望在不额外采集领域语音的前提下提升医学ASR性能。
AI.method: 固定MMS-1B-FL102声学模型，采用两种解码时LM融合：浅融合(SF)与密度比方法(DRA)。医学目标模型为19,421句豪萨语健康语料训练的4-gram KenLM，DRA的源先验为75,372句通用领域模型。评估用250条录音(25个经医生审校的提示，10位说话人，覆盖尼日利亚北部六州)，采用提示不重叠的五折交叉验证。
AI.result: SF与DRA分别将WER从29.56%降至23.55%和23.33%，均显著优于贪心解码(p<0.001)，但两者差异不显著(p=0.423)。仅用通用LM的SF已达23.96% WER，说明医学LM的额外提升有限。医学术语错误率亦有改善，但未体现明显的医学领域优势。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级纯文本LM融合可在不额外采集领域语音的情况下改善豪萨语医学ASR；但大部分收益来自通用LM，医学专有领域的附加价值相对有限。

title: Mitigating Spurious Invariance in Contrastive Learning: A Probabilistic Self-Supervised Learning Framework for Medical Image Analysis
comment: Published in IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging (TMI), 2026. 17 pages
summary: Owing to the prohibitive cost of manual annotation for enormous medical images, self-supervised learning (SSL) has gained substantial attention and shown promise in various medical imaging tasks. Among SSL approaches, contrastive learning has emerged as a prominent one, encouraging models to encode semantic information that remains invariant between different augmented views. However, this invariance can be spurious for medical images, as subtle but critical medical features can be suppressed during augmentations. In this paper, we mitigate this issue by encoding the learned feature embeddings as probability distributions rather than fixed vectors, thus capturing a richer and more nuanced spectrum of information. Furthermore, we propose a unified probabilistic framework that seamlessly integrates multiple SSL approaches. Our method achieves superior performance over the state-of-the-art SSL methods on various downstream tasks across multiple datasets, including medical image segmentation and classification. We further validate the method through additional analyses of robustness to stronger augmentations, label efficiency under limited fine-tuning labels, and computational trade-offs. The code is released at https://github.com/wwzjer/ProbSSL.

AI.tldr: ProbSSL将对比学习的特征嵌入由固定向量改为概率分布，缓解医学图像中增强导致关键细节被抑制造成的虚假不变性，并统一多种SSL方法。
AI.motivation: 医学图像标注成本高，自监督学习特别是对比学习受关注；但对比学习的不变性假设在医学图像上可能虚假，因为增强会抑制细微却关键的医学特征。
AI.method: 将学到的特征嵌入编码为概率分布而非固定向量以捕获更丰富信息；并构建统一概率框架，无缝整合多种自监督学习方法。
AI.result: 在多个数据集的医学图像分割与分类等下游任务上优于先进SSL方法；并通过更强增强鲁棒性、有限微调标签下的标签效率及计算权衡分析进一步验证。
AI.conclusion: 概率化嵌入能有效缓解对比学习虚假不变性问题，统一框架具备实用性与可扩展性，代码已开源。

title: PatchCon: Patch-aware Weighted Supervised Contrastive Learning for Vulnerability Detection
summary: Automated vulnerability detection is critical for securing modern software systems, yet existing learning-based approaches often treat functions as independent samples and underuse the supervision provided by vulnerability-fixing patches. In this paper, we propose PatchCon, a CodeBERT-based patch-aware contrastive learning model for function-level vulnerability detection. PatchCon jointly optimizes vulnerability classification and supervised contrastive learning, and treats vulnerable-patched function pairs as hard negatives with larger contrastive weights to capture subtle security-relevant differences introduced by fixes. To evaluate patch-level discrimination, we use two pairwise metrics that measure whether a model can correctly distinguish vulnerable functions from their patched counterparts. We evaluate PatchCon on PairVul-Linux through extensive experiments, including state-of-the-art comparisons, ablation studies, hyperparameter sensitivity analysis, and statistical significance testing. We also conduct fine-grained analyses by Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) type, function length, and patch size, and further evaluate PatchCon on Linux kernel vulnerabilities disclosed after the training data cutoff. On PairVul-Linux, PatchCon outperforms representative pretrained code models and contrastive learning baselines on both classification and pairwise metrics, improves pairwise accuracy over the strongest reproduced baseline from 0.2060 to 0.3264, and achieves pairwise accuracy comparable to that of a GPT-4o-based large language model (LLM) method at a substantially lower cost. Among the reproduced models, PatchCon also achieves the highest pairwise accuracy on test pairs from Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) entries unseen during training and on newly disclosed vulnerabilities.

AI.tldr: PatchCon：基于CodeBERT的patch-aware对比学习模型，用于函数级漏洞检测，将漏洞-修复函数对作为高权重硬负样本。
AI.motivation: 现有学习方法将函数视为独立样本，且未充分利用漏洞修复补丁提供的监督信号。
AI.method: 联合优化漏洞分类与监督对比学习；把vulnerable-patched函数对作为硬负样本并赋予更大对比权重；引入两个成对指标评估patch级区分能力；在PairVul-Linux上做对比、消融、超参敏感性与显著性检验，并按CWE、函数长度、补丁大小及训练截止后新披露漏洞做细粒度分析。
AI.result: 在PairVul-Linux上分类与成对指标均优于代表性预训练代码模型和对比学习基线；成对准确率由最强复现基线的0.2060提升至0.3264；以显著更低成本达到与GPT-4o LLM方法相当的成对准确率；在未见CVE测试对及新披露漏洞上取得复现模型中最高的成对准确率。
AI.conclusion: 利用补丁监督与对比学习可有效捕捉修复引入的细微安全差异，显著提升成对（patch级）漏洞判别能力，并具成本效益。

title: Overview of the NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval Task: Cross-modal Claim Verification in Scientific Papers
comment: The first two authors contributed equally. More information about the shared task is available at https://sciclaimeval.github.io/
summary: This paper presents an overview of \emph{SciClaimEval}, a pilot task at NTCIR-19 on verifying scientific claims against the tables and figures of the papers in which they appear. Our dataset pairs authentic claims from 180 papers in machine learning, natural language processing, and medicine with contrastive versions of their tables and figures, one supporting the claim and one minimally modified so that it does not. The task comprises two subtasks: deciding whether a piece of evidence supports a claim, and selecting which of two evidence versions does. Twenty-two teams registered, the highest number among NTCIR-19 tasks, and 14 submitted 177 runs. Most systems built on multimodal large language models, relying on prompting and multi-stage inference rather than task-specific fine-tuning. On the first subtask, the best systems reached 98.1\% pair accuracy, but all six top-ranked systems relied on the contrastive pairs; the best system that judged each claim-evidence pair on its own scored 24.3 points lower. Open-weight models, embedded in carefully designed pipelines, matched proprietary ones. Yet verifying a single claim against its evidence, the setting that matters in practice, remains an open problem.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍NTCIR-19试点任务SciClaimEval：验证科学论断是否被论文中表格/图片证据支持，构建180篇论文的对比式数据集，设两个子任务，22队注册、14队提交177次运行，最佳系统达98.1%配对准确率，但依赖对比对，单独判断证据的任务仍是开放问题。
AI.motivation: 科学论断常基于论文表格与图片，但缺少基准来检验系统能否真正依据图表证据验证论断；现有评估易被对比对“取巧”而非真正理解证据。
AI.method: 提出SciClaimEval试点任务，数据为机器学习、NLP、医学180篇论文的真实论断，配以支持与最小改动不支持的两版图表证据；子任务一判断证据是否支持论断，子任务二从两版中选出支持版本；多数系统基于多模态大模型，用提示与多阶段推理而非任务微调。
AI.result: 22队注册（NTCIR-19最高），14队提交177次运行；子任务一最佳达98.1%配对准确率，但前六名均依赖对比对，最佳单对判断系统低24.3分；开源权重模型精心设计流水线后可与专有模型媲美。
AI.conclusion: 对比设置下性能接近饱和，但真实场景中的单论断-证据验证仍未解决；需转向不依赖对比对的评估与建模。

title: Self-Supervised Pretraining for Label-Efficient Facial Expression Recognition using Smart Glasses
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Best Paper Award at the SEPH 2026 workshop, UbiComp Companion '26
summary: Facial Expression Recognition (FER) on optomyographic (OMG) smart glasses such as OCOsense enables privacy-preserving, camera-free affect sensing for health and well-being. Most FER systems are fully supervised, i.e., they rely either on hand-crafted expert features with classical machine learning, or on end-to-end deep models trained from labelled data. Both depend on large quantities of labelled expressions, which are costly to collect and limit deployment in real-world, personalized settings. We investigate Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) as a route to label-efficient FER on these glasses. We pretrain a Vision Transformer with a masked-autoencoder objective on unlabelled OCOsense recordings and finetune it for five-class FER under person-independent cross-validation. Across label budgets from 5% to 100%, pretraining consistently improves performance; with only 5% of the labels, the pretrained model outperforms the from-scratch model trained with all labels. Our results show that SSL pretraining is a practical way to reduce labelling cost for smart eyewear FER, and we discuss the implications for future personalization and continual adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在OCOsense光电容积肌图（OMG）智能眼镜上利用自监督学习（SSL）实现标签高效的面部表情识别（FER）。方法是用掩码自编码器（MAE）目标在无标签记录上预训练ViT，再在跨人交叉验证下微调五类FER。结果显示，在5%~100%各类标签预算下预训练均带来稳定提升，且仅用5%标签的预训练模型即超过用全部标签从头训练的模型。
AI.motivation: 现有FER系统多为全监督，依赖专家手工特征或大量标注数据；而在智能眼镜这一隐私友好、无摄像头的场景下，标注成本高、采集困难，限制了个性化与真实部署。作者因此探索自监督学习以降低标注依赖。
AI.method: 在OCOsense OMG无标签记录上，以掩码自编码器（MAE）目标预训练Vision Transformer；随后在跨人（person-independent）交叉验证下，用5%~100%不同标签预算微调，进行五类表情识别，并与从头训练的监督模型对比。
AI.result: 在5%至100%的各标签预算下，预训练均一致提升性能；仅用5%标签的预训练模型性能优于使用全部标签从头训练的模型，体现出显著的标签效率。
AI.conclusion: SSL预训练是降低智能眼镜FER标注成本的实用途径，并对未来个性化与持续自适应具有启示意义。

title: Optimizing Recourse Under Predictive Multiplicity
summary: Algorithmic recourse identifies modifications that can change an unfavorable model prediction into a favorable one. Under predictive multiplicity, similarly performing models can disagree on individual predictions, so recourse valid for one model may fail for another. We formulate robust recourse under predictive multiplicity as a budget-constrained minimization of the worst-case validity loss across a competing set of models, which can include models with different architectures or from different hypothesis classes. We propose an oracle-efficient algorithm called ORPM and prove sufficient conditions for its convergence. We evaluate ORPM on one synthetic and five real datasets, and competing sets consist of linear, neural, mixed, and decision-tree models. Our experiments show decreasing optimization-gap bounds and high validity in many tested settings, with favorable performance against baselines designed for specific model classes or architectures. We also quantify how requiring a common action across competing models changes recourse success at a given budget and examine disparities in this success across demographic groups.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究预测多重性下的鲁棒算法追索问题，提出预算约束下最小化跨竞争模型最坏情况有效性损失的框架，并给出 oracle 高效的 ORPM 算法及收敛条件。
AI.motivation: 同样性能的模型可能对个体预测不一致（预测多重性），使针对单一模型有效的追索在另一模型上失效，因此需要跨模型稳健的追索方法。
AI.method: 将鲁棒追索建模为预算约束下对竞争模型集合（可含不同架构、不同假设类）的最坏情况有效性损失最小化问题；提出 oracle 高效的 ORPM 算法，并证明其收敛的充分条件。
AI.result: 在1个合成数据集和5个真实数据集上，与线性、神经网络、混合及决策树构成竞争集进行评测；优化间隙上界递减，多设置下有效性较高，优于针对特定模型类或架构设计的基线；并量化在给定预算下要求跨模型采用共同动作对追索成功率的影响，以及不同人口群体间的差异。
AI.conclusion: ORPM 能在跨异构模型的竞争集下提供高效、有效的鲁棒追索，但跨模型共同动作会带来成功率代价，且存在群体间公平性差异。

title: C-WFDM: A ControlNet-Guided Wavelet-Fusion Diffusion Model for Multimodal Brain MRI Completion
summary: Multimodal brain MRI provides complementary anatomical, tissue, and pathological information to support downstream artificial intelligence (AI) applications. However, modality availability is uneven across public and pooled neuroimaging datasets: T1-weighted (T1w) MRI is widely represented, T2-weighted (T2w) and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) MRI are less consistently available, and gadolinium-enhanced T1-weighted (T1Gd) MRI is relatively scarce. Pooled datasets therefore contain participants with different combinations of acquired MRI contrasts, reflecting variation in the study designs, acquisition protocols, and clinical or research objectives of the contributing studies. Many missing-modality benchmarks simulate incomplete MRI by withholding contrasts from complete four-modality cases, which may not represent the observed availability patterns in pooled datasets. To address this gap, we introduce C-WFDM, a ControlNet extension of our Wavelet-Fusion Diffusion Model (WFDM), for subject-specific missing-modality completion. C-WFDM is built on an earlier BrainScape snapshot comprising 157 public MRI datasets and 45,880 preprocessed scans. The pretrained WFDM backbone retains target-modality and metadata conditioning, while target-specific ControlNet adapters use MRI contrasts from the same participant to guide synthesis. C-WFDM synthesizes T2w from T1w, FLAIR from T1w and T2w, and T1Gd from T1w, T2w, and FLAIR. Acquired conditioning contrasts are used when available, and generated intermediate contrasts are used only when required. We compare C-WFDM with ALDM, cWDM, and Pix2Pix using paired structural similarity index (SSIM), peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), and mean absolute error (MAE). In the BrainScape completion experiment, C-WFDM achieves the best T2w and FLAIR results among the evaluated models, with SSIM values of 0.9232 and 0.8904, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出C-WFDM，一种基于ControlNet扩展的小波融合扩散模型，在BrainScape大规模数据集上实现受试者特异性的缺失模态MRI补全，按T1w→T2w→FLAIR→T1Gd的顺序级联合成缺失对比度，在T2w与FLAIR补全上优于ALDM、cWDM和Pix2Pix。
AI.motivation: 多模态脑MRI在公开及合并神经影像数据集中分布不均（T1w常见、T2w/FLAIR较少、T1Gd稀缺），合并数据中受试者携带的对比度组合各异。现有缺失模态基准多从完整四模态案例中人为删减来模拟缺失，无法反映真实可获得性模式，需按受试者实际可用模态进行补全。
AI.method: 在既有BrainScape快照（157个公开MRI数据集、45,880例预处理扫描）上构建C-WFDM：以预训练WFDM为骨干，保留目标模态与元数据条件；针对每个目标模态设ControlNet适配器，用同一受试者的其他MRI对比度作条件引导。按难度递增级联合成：T1w→T2w，T1w+T2w→FLAIR，T1w+T2w+FLAIR→T1Gd；有真实采集则用真实，仅在必要时使用生成的中间模态。与ALDM、cWDM、Pix2Pix对比，采用成对SSIM、PSNR、MAE评估。
AI.result: BrainScape补全实验中，C-WFDM在T2w与FLAIR上取得最优，SSIM分别为0.9232与0.8904，优于ALDM、cWDM和Pix2Pix。
AI.conclusion: ControlNet式条件引导与小波融合扩散骨干结合，可有效应对真实数据集中不均衡、受试者特异的模态缺失问题；级联策略在保证使用真实采集模态的前提下完成多模态补全，为下游AI应用提供更贴近实际可获得性分布的补全数据。

title: AgentTrustCI: Build-Time Policy, Grounding, and Trajectory Tests for Java LLM Agents
comment: Accepted for publication in the 2026 International Conference on Computer and Applications (ICCA)
summary: Infrastructure security does not establish whether an LLM agent selected an allowed tool, grounded its answer in tool output, or followed a required workflow. AgentTrustCI is a Java/JUnit 5 framework that expresses these application-layer expectations as policy, grounding, and trajectory checks over recorded traces. A deterministic replay implementation supports repeatable build-time tests; a judge interface provides an extension point for optional semantic evaluation. On 55 synthetic cases spanning seven enterprise domains, the full pipeline correctly classifies all 30 injected faults and 25 passing controls, including ten non-trivial controls, and misses none of 12 designated critical cases. Each single-layer configuration correctly classifies 35 cases because the corpus deliberately isolates ten faults per layer. A grounded answer obtained through a disallowed sequence illustrates the additional coverage of trajectory checks. Repeated measurements quantify validator execution separately from process startup and reporting. These results establish coverage of the authored regression suite, not production accuracy. We describe a production-trace validation protocol, optional LLM-judge integration, and maintenance of expectations as workflows evolve. The contribution is a practical pattern for expressing behavioral contracts within an existing Java release pipeline.

AI.tldr: AgentTrustCI 是一个基于 Java/JUnit 5 的框架，用策略、接地（grounding）和轨迹（trajectory）三类检查对录制轨迹验证 LLM 智能体的应用层行为，补充基础设施安全无法覆盖的层面。
AI.motivation: 基础设施安全无法判断 LLM 智能体是否选择了允许的工具、是否让答案基于工具输出、是否遵循了规定的工作流，因此需要在应用层建立可自动化验证的行为契约。
AI.method: 将应用层期望表达为策略检查、接地检查和轨迹检查，作用于录制的执行轨迹；用确定性重放支持可重复的构建期测试；通过 judge 接口提供可选语义评估的扩展点；并给出生产轨迹验证协议与随工作流演进而维护期望说明的做法。
AI.result: 在覆盖七个企业领域的 55 个合成用例上，完整流水线正确分类全部 30 个注入故障和 25 个通过对照（含 10 个非平凡对照），未漏检 12 个指定关键用例；每种单层配置正确分类 35 个用例，因为语料每层刻意隔离 10 个故障。另有“通过被禁止序列获得接地答案”的示例，说明轨迹检查带来的额外覆盖。重复测量将校验器执行与进程启动、报告开销分离。作者强调这些结果仅证明对所编写回归套件的覆盖，而非生产环境准确率。
AI.conclusion: 论文贡献是一种实用模式：在既有 Java 发布流水线中表达智能体行为契约，并提供生产轨迹验证协议、可选 LLM 评审集成及期望维护机制。

title: The Harness Is the Model: Agent Scaffolding Changes a Fixed LLM's Compliance with Banking Conduct Rules, Unevenly Across Models
comment: 16 pages, 4 tables. Pre-registered. Code, data and all 3120 episode traces: https://github.com/mhuyut/harness-is-the-model
summary: Banks validate language models, but they deploy systems: a model inside a harness that decides what it sees, which tools it can call and who checks its actions. We test whether that harness changes compliance with banking conduct rules when the model is held fixed. Four open-weight models each ran five harnesses (a pipeline that makes one structured decision, a ReAct-style tool loop, a loop in which the policy is reachable only through search, a loop with a long benign customer memory, and a loop with a same-model compliance reviewer) on 156 pre-registered cases in a simulated retail bank whose 11 rule families paraphrase EU consumer-credit, payments, investor-protection, data-protection and anti-money-laundering provisions. Every one of the 3120 two-turn episodes was scored deterministically from the executed tool trace, with violations and over-refusals counted separately. Pooled across models the harness moved the correct-case rate only between 87.3% and 92.1%, but within a model it mattered a great deal: for one model the spread between its best and worst harness was 11.5 percentage points, enough to move it from first to last place among the four models, while for another the harness made no detectable difference; the model x harness interaction itself was suggestive rather than conclusive. The same-model reviewer cut violations from 9.6% to 6.4% without raising over-refusals, contrary to our pre-registered prediction. Rules that require date arithmetic failed in every harness. In an exploratory analysis with two LLM judges and a blind human check, 26% of violations were accompanied by a customer message that denied the action the agent had just executed, which a transcript-only review would record as a correct refusal. For model-risk management the unit of validation should be the model-harness pair, and conduct testing should read the action log, not the conversation.

AI.tldr: 论文检验在固定模型的前提下，智能体"运行框架（harness）"如何影响银行合规行为。四个开源模型各配五种框架在3120个预注册案例上运行：总体正确率仅87.3%–92.1%，但同一模型内不同框架差异达11.5个百分点，足以改变模型排名；同模型审查器降低违规率且不增加过度拒绝；日期计算类规则全框架均失败；26%的违规伴随"否认已执行动作"的客户消息。结论：模型验证应以"模型-框架对"为单位，行为测试应读取动作日志而非对话。
AI.motivation: 银行验证的是模型，但部署的是"模型+框架"的系统——框架决定模型看到什么、能调用哪些工具、由谁核查其动作。既有合规评测多在固定提示或单一流程下测模型能力，未回答"模型不变时，工程框架本身是否改变合规表现"，因而验证对象与部署对象错位。
AI.method: 在模拟零售银行中构建156个预注册案例，规则族共11类（改写自欧盟消费信贷、支付、投资者保护、数据保护与反洗钱条款）。四个开源权重模型 × 五种框架（单次结构化决策流水线、ReAct式工具循环、政策仅可通过检索获取的循环、带长期良性客户记忆的循环、带同模型合规审查器的循环），共3120个两轮回合。全部依据已执行的工具调用轨迹做确定性打分，违规与过度拒绝分列统计；另以两个LLM评审加盲测人工核查做探索性分析。
AI.result: 跨模型汇总时框架仅使正确率在87.3%–92.1%间波动；但模型内差异显著：某模型最佳与最差框架相差11.5个百分点，可使其从四模型第一跌至末位，另一模型的框架效应则不可检出；模型×框架交互作用仅为提示性而非确证性。同模型审查器将违规率从9.6%降至6.4%且未提升过度拒绝，与预注册预测相反。需日期运算的规则在所有框架下均失败。探索性分析中26%的违规同时伴有否认已执行动作的客户消息，若仅看对话记录会被记为正确的拒绝。
AI.conclusion: 框架并非中性容器，其效应可与模型选择同量级，故模型风险管理中的验证单元应是"模型-框架对"而非模型本身；合规测试须以动作日志为依据，仅审查对话记录会系统性高估合规性（因存在"口头否认+实际执行"的违规）。

title: PersonaCodeBench: Evaluating Coding Agents in Persona-driven Human-Interactive Sessions
summary: Coding agents must deliver correct software while respecting users' expertise, preferences, and working conditions. Existing benchmarks increasingly incorporate interaction, yet personalized requirement fulfillment remains underexplored. We introduce PersonaCodeBench, which turns user characteristics into verifiable obligations in persona-driven multi-turn coding sessions. Our persona pool spans roles, technical abilities, interaction preferences, and practical constraints, yielding task-grounded evolved requirements for implementation, permissions, testing, explanation, and delivery. At runtime, a controller governs user simulator responses and requirement disclosure, using online requirement evaluation to provide feedback and advance the interaction. Requirements emerge progressively, with their content, disclosure conditions, and acceptance criteria fixed before evaluation. A completion verifier and a personalization verifier separately assess native correctness and persona fulfillment. Joint pass requires both adherence to the declared budget and compliance with validity conditions. We evaluate all major frontier agents, establish a comprehensive leaderboard, and conduct detailed experimental analyses to validate effectiveness. PersonaCodeBench supports reproducible evaluation of coding agents' ability to meet explicit, personalized user expectations alongside coding objectives.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PersonaCodeBench，一个面向"人格驱动多轮编程会话"的基准，把用户角色、技术能力、交互偏好与实际约束转化为可验证的需求义务，用于评测编程智能体在完成编码目标之外是否满足个性化要求。
AI.motivation: 现有编程智能体基准虽已引入交互，但"个性化需求满足"仍缺乏探索。智能体不仅要交付正确软件，还须契合用户的专业水平、偏好与工作条件，这类能力缺少可复现的评测手段。
