AI.method: 构建覆盖角色、技术能力、交互偏好、现实约束的人格池，生成任务锚定的演化需求（实现、权限、测试、解释、交付）。运行时由控制器管理用户模拟器的回答与需求披露，通过在线需求评估提供反馈并推进交互；需求渐进浮现，其内容、披露条件与验收标准在评测前固定。采用完成验证器与个性化验证器分别评估原生正确性与人格满足度，联合通过需同时满足声明的预算约束与有效性条件。
AI.result: 评测了全部主流前沿智能体，建立了综合排行榜，并通过详细实验分析验证了基准的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PersonaCodeBench 为编程智能体在编码目标之外满足明确、个性化用户期望的能力提供了可复现的评测支持。

title: Pathwise-Budgeted LLM Routing: Online Allocation with K-Bit Tail-Cost Learning
summary: Firms using large language models under fixed budgets must decide which model to call and whether to retry a failed task. Because a call's charge is revealed only after completion, one long response can exhaust the remaining budget and leave later tasks unserved. Our objective is to maximize the number of tasks solved before service stops. We develop a contextual bandit policy, ADP-HT, which learns each model's task-specific success probability and constructs conservative cost estimates from coarsened response-length labels on a quantile grid with $2^K$ intervals. The policy weighs predicted success against these costs, adjusting the cost penalty to realized spending and the budget available per remaining task. Under calibration, local regularity, and grid-coverage conditions, we bound the excess allowance in the policy's conservative cost estimates. At a fixed sample size, increasing $K$ reduces the discretization term but increases the estimation allowance. At the tightest tested budgets, ADP-HT solves more than twice as many MATH500 and GPQA tasks as the best implemented baseline. It achieves the highest mean cumulative score at ten of fourteen RouterBench budgets. On LiveCodeBench, it outperforms a deployed commercial router in both default and cost-saving modes at the three lowest test budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出上下文赌博机策略 ADP-HT，在固定预算、事后揭晓费用的条件下，通过分位数网格上的保守成本估计来平衡成功率与花费，最大化可解任务数。
AI.motivation: 固定预算下使用大模型时须决定调用哪个模型及是否重试失败任务；调用费用完成后才揭晓，单次长回答可能耗尽预算导致后续任务无法服务。
AI.method: 上下文赌博机策略 ADP-HT：学习各模型的任务相关成功概率；基于粗化响应长度标签在 2^K 区间的分位网格上构造保守成本估计；将预测成功率与这些成本加权权衡，并按实际花费与每剩余任务可用预算调整成本惩罚。
AI.result: 在校准、局部正则性和网格覆盖条件下给出策略保守成本估计的超出容许界；固定样本量下 K 增大减少离散化项但增大估计容许项。最紧预算下在 MATH500 与 GPQA 上解出任务数是最好基线的两倍以上；RouterBench 十四个预算中十个取得最高平均累积分数；LiveCodeBench 三个最低预算下优于已部署商用路由器。
AI.conclusion: ADP-HT 在严格预算的多模型路由中显著提升可解任务数，兼具理论保证与跨基准、真实商用路由器的实证优势。

title: Learning Hierarchical Patch Splitting Policies for Faster Vision Transformers
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) are bottlenecked by the length of their input token sequence. Standard patchification fixes this length with a single patch size applied across the image, regardless of regional content. Prior work on adaptive patch sizing reduces token count by assigning coarser patches to visually simple regions, but relies on noisy pixel-level heuristics such as local entropy to make patchification decisions. We argue that this compute allocation should be grounded in the model's interpretation of task relevant information, not in raw pixel statistics. We introduce Split Policy Learned Image Tokenization which learns to allocate token resolution based on what the model finds meaningful, producing shorter token sequences that are better matched to task-relevant content. SPLIT matches the accuracy of full-resolution ViT classification baselines while using 30% fewer tokens. The same gains hold on dense prediction: SPLIT achieves competitive accuracy on COCO and ADE20K, demonstrating that semantically aligned patchification generalises well beyond classification.

AI.tldr: SPLIT提出用可学习策略替代像素级启发式来决定图像分块大小，使token分配基于模型认为任务相关的语义信息，在分类任务上用少30%的token达到全分辨率ViT精度，并泛化到COCO、ADE20K等密集预测任务。
AI.motivation: ViT受限于输入token序列长度，标准分块用单一patch尺寸覆盖整图，与区域内容无关；已有自适应分块工作依赖局部熵等噪声较大的像素级启发式来做决策，未与模型对任务相关信息的理解对齐。
AI.method: 提出Split Policy Learned Image Tokenization（SPLIT），学习一个分块策略，依据模型认为有意义的内容来分配token分辨率，从而生成更短、且与任务相关内容更匹配的token序列。
AI.result: 在分类任务上，SPLIT以少30%的token达到全分辨率ViT基线的精度；在密集预测任务上，在COCO与ADE20K上取得有竞争力的精度，表明语义对齐的分块方式可推广到分类之外。
AI.conclusion: 计算分配应基于模型对任务相关信息的解释，而非原始像素统计；语义对齐的学习式分块是一种通用且有效的ViT加速思路。

title: Rethinking Access Control for AI Agents: Recent Advances and Open Challenges
summary: Large language model agents access data, invoke tools, and act on users' behalf. Keeping these actions within authorized bounds is challenging because agents choose their own execution paths while permissions and operating conditions may change. This paper surveys recent advances in agent access control across four areas: policy specification and derivation, identity and delegation, action and resource enforcement, and information flow control. We compare their control objects, enforcement boundaries, and assumptions to examine what individual mechanisms achieve and how they can work together. Building on this analysis, we rethink four aspects of authorization: plan selection shapes permission requirements; contextual information can inform decisions without itself granting authority; restrictions must retain their meaning across system interfaces; and authorization must be reassessed as workflows evolve. These insights motivate open challenges and future directions, together with concrete research questions and evaluation criteria. In particular, evaluation should examine both observed agent behavior and the unauthorized effects that remain enabled. Our analysis connects existing mechanisms to the requirements for preserving authorization throughout an agent workflow.

AI.tldr: 综述LLM智能体访问控制，跨策略规范、身份委托、动作资源执行、信息流控制四大领域，并提出四方面对授权的重新思考与未来方向。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体代表用户访问数据、调用工具并执行操作，但其自定义执行路径加之权限与运行条件不断变化，使"操作保持在授权边界内"成为难题。
AI.method: 综述式分析：围绕四个领域（策略规范与推导、身份与委托、动作与资源执行、信息流控制），比较各机制的控制对象、执行边界与假设，考察单独机制能力及协同方式。
AI.result: 提出对授权的四点再思考：计划选择塑造权限需求；上下文信息可辅助决策但不自身授予权限；限制须在跨系统接口时保持语义；授权须随工作流演化重新评估。并据此给出开放挑战、研究问题与评估标准。
AI.conclusion: 评估应同时考察智能体的可观察行为与仍被允许的未授权效应；本文分析将现有机制与"在整个智能体工作流中保持授权"的需求相连接。

title: Accelerating Long-Context Decoding in Large-Scale Hybrid LLMs Without Retraining
comment: 19 pages (main body: 10 pages, references: 3 pages, appendix: 6 pages), 8 figures, 6 tables
summary: The full-attention layers of large language models (LLMs) make every generated token more expensive than the previous one, slowing models down on long-context tasks. Hybrid models reduce this cost by replacing most full-attention layers with linear-attention layers, but the first still dominate decoding at long contexts. We accelerate these remaining layers without any training or weight changes using combined sparse attention: each layer attends to a sliding window of recent tokens, a pinned prefix, and a fixed budget of most relevant tokens in the context. The window size and budget are found on a per-layer basis using a multi-objective search algorithm. Across six hybrid models from three families, from 4B to 397B parameters, the selected configurations preserve their baseline model's accuracy on 21 long-context datasets. Decoding 64k/256k tokens becomes up to 1.26x/2.22x faster on Qwen3.5-4B, 1.20x/2.23x on Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, and 1.16x/2.06x on Ornith-1.0-397B.

AI.tldr: 针对混合注意力LLM中少量全注意力层在长上下文解码时的瓶颈，提出免训练的"组合稀疏注意力"，在每层同时保留滑动窗口、固定前缀和固定预算的最相关token，并用多目标搜索逐层确定窗口大小与预算，实现无损加速。
AI.motivation: 混合模型用线性注意力替换大部分全注意力层以降低成本，但剩余的全注意力层在长上下文中仍主导解码耗时；且希望不重训练、不改权重即可加速这些层。
AI.method: 组合稀疏注意力：每层仅关注三部分——近期token的滑动窗口、固定的前缀（pinned prefix）、以及上下文中固定预算的最相关token；窗口大小与预算通过多目标搜索算法逐层选取，无需训练或修改权重。
AI.result: 在3个家族共6个混合模型（4B–397B）上，选定配置在21个长上下文数据集上保持基线精度；64k/256k解码加速：Qwen3.5-4B达1.26x/2.22x，Qwen3.5-122B-A10B达1.20x/2.23x，Ornith-1.0-397B达1.16x/2.06x。
AI.conclusion: 训练无关的组合稀疏注意力可有效消除混合LLM中残余全注意力层的长上下文解码瓶颈，在广泛模型与数据集上实现精度无损的显著加速，具备良好的通用性与实用性。

title: PEARL: Prediction Error-Adaptive Regularized Learning for Selective Forgetting under Partial Preference Drift
summary: User preferences shift as needs, context, and tastes evolve. This matters for personalized recommendation, LLM response generation, and RLHF-trained reward models, which can become miscalibrated as preferences drift. Existing non-stationary bandit methods forget uniformly across all dimensions, but real preference shifts are typically partial: some dimensions go stale while others remain valid. Neural contextual bandits accumulate confidence monotonically via the Gram matrix, with no mechanism to direct uncertainty where predictions have gone wrong. We propose PEARL (Prediction Error-Adaptive Regularized Learning), which reverses the Gram update along feature directions where predictions are surprisingly wrong, while leaving confidence intact elsewhere. We prove that (i) any non-adaptive policy suffers linear regret after a preference shift, (ii) no fixed exploration rate achieves low regret in both stationary and non-stationary regimes, and (iii) PEARL's cumulative regret scales with the number of shifted users N_s, not the total population N. On PRISM, a personalized LLM response selection benchmark (1,500 users, 21 LLMs), PEARL beats greedy by +4.0 points and the best neural bandit baseline by +2.5 points (p<0.001), while performing on par with greedy when preferences are stable. It beats sliding-window and discounted approaches by 3 to 10 points, showing that selective forgetting outperforms uniform forgetting. The selection policy is a ~100K-parameter MLP that runs in milliseconds on CPU, leaves LLM weights frozen, and works with any API-based model.

AI.tldr: PEARL提出一种"预测误差自适应正则化学习"方法，在用户偏好局部漂移时，仅沿预测意外出错的维度方向反转Gram矩阵更新以局部遗忘，其余维度置信度不变，理论上证明任意非自适应策略在偏好漂移后线性遗憾，且无固定探索率能同时适配平稳与非平稳场景，PEARL遗憾随漂移用户数N_s而非总人数N增长。
AI.motivation: 个性化推荐、LLM响应生成与RLHF奖励模型会因用户需求、情境与口味随时间演变而校准失效。现有非平稳bandit方法对所有维度"均匀遗忘"，但真实偏好漂移通常是局部的：部分维度过时而其他维度仍有效。神经上下文bandit通过Gram矩阵单调累积置信度，无法将不确定性定向投向预测出错之处。
AI.method: 提出PEARL（Prediction Error-Adaptive Regularized Learning）：在预测出现意外错误（高预测误差）的特征方向上逆转Gram矩阵更新（降低该方向置信度），其他方向置信度保持不变，实现选择性遗忘。理论上给出三条结论：(i) 任意非自适应策略在偏好漂移后遭受线性遗憾；(ii) 不存在固定探索率同时在平稳与非平稳情形下达到低遗憾；(iii) PEARL累积遗憾随发生漂移的用户数N_s而非总人口N增长。
AI.result: 在个性化LLM响应选择基准PRISM（1,500用户、21个LLM）上，PEARL相比greedy提升+4.0分，相比最佳神经bandit基线提升+2.5分（p<0.001）；偏好稳定时与greedy相当。相比滑动窗口和折扣方法提升3–10分，表明选择性遗忘优于均匀遗忘。选择策略是约100K参数的MLP，CPU上毫秒级运行，LLM权重冻结，兼容任何API模型。
AI.conclusion: 偏好漂移具有局部性，选择性遗忘（仅在被证伪的方向上降低置信度）显著优于均匀遗忘，且在平稳场景无额外代价。PEARL以轻量、模型无关（LLM权重冻结、仅训练小MLP）的方式实现高效个性化适配，具备理论保障与实践优势。

title: Decompose the Distillation: Interpretable Single-Pass Guidance for Diffusion Models
comment: The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
summary: Classifier-Free Guidance is a widely used inference-time guidance rule for conditional image generation with diffusion models, which exposes a guidance scale that adjusts conditioning strength after training. This flexibility requires conditional and unconditional model evaluations at every sampling step, so an N-step trajectory takes 2N forward passes. Single-pass alternatives reduce such cost, yet most collapse CFG's two components into one opaque guided prediction, losing the separable base flow and guidance direction that support per-step control and diagnostics, even when the scale remains adjustable. This work introduces CtrlFlow, a single-pass guidance method that preserves CFG's separable base-flow and guidance-direction interface. To preserve both components at one-pass cost, CtrlFlow attaches two lightweight LoRA adapters to a frozen backbone, each adding 2.5% parameters, and predicts the base flow and guidance direction from one pass of the shared frozen backbone. Because the guidance scale multiplies the guidance direction only after the forward pass, one evaluation yields the guided velocity at any scale, so a single trained checkpoint remains adjustable at inference without retraining. Preserving two outputs introduces a training mismatch: inference amplifies guidance-direction errors by the chosen scale, while naive component-wise losses weight both outputs equally. To align training with this composed inference-time error, CtrlFlow uses a unified multi-scale distillation loss. Residual guidance errors can still persist at extreme scales, where even small guidance-direction errors are amplified by the guidance scale. To reduce this inference-time error, CtrlFlow applies scale-adaptive modulation to damp velocity-field errors and time-grid warping to concentrate solver evaluations where the trajectory changes most rapidly.

AI.tldr: CtrlFlow 提出一种单次前向传播的引导方法，同时保留 CFG 可分离的"基础流"与"引导方向"两个分量，在冻结主干上挂两个 LoRA 适配器，一次推理即可在任意引导尺度下可调，并通过多尺度蒸馏损失与尺度自适应调制实现高效、可控的条件生成。
AI.motivation: CFG 虽灵活可调引导尺度，但每步采样需同时做条件与无条件评估，N 步轨迹需 2N 次前向，成本高；现有单次传播替代方案虽降本，却把 CFG 两个分量坍缩成一个不透明预测，丢失了可分离的基础流与引导方向，难以支持逐步控制与诊断。
AI.method: 在冻结主干上附加两个轻量 LoRA 适配器（各增 2.5% 参数），用共享冻结主干的一次前向同时预测基础流与引导方向；由于引导尺度仅在前向之后乘到引导方向上，单次评估即可得到任意尺度下的引导速度。针对"推理时按尺度放大引导方向误差、而简单逐分量损失等同权重"的失配，采用统一多尺度蒸馏损失来对齐训练与组合式推理误差；再用尺度自适应调制抑制速度场误差，并用时间网格变形把求解器评估集中在轨迹变化最快处，以缓解极端尺度下的残余误差。
AI.result: 实现单次前向即达 CFG 级引导效果，推理成本较标准 CFG 的 2N 次前向显著降低；单一训练检查点在推理时可任意调尺度而无需重训；保留可分离的基础流与引导方向接口以支持逐步控制与诊断；多尺度蒸馏损失、尺度自适应调制与时间网格变形共同降低了极端尺度下的推理误差。
AI.conclusion: CtrlFlow 在单次传播成本下保留了 CFG 的可调性与可分离接口，通过蒸馏损失设计与推理端调制/网格策略提升引导质量，为高效且可控的扩散条件生成提供了实用方案。

title: GH-AWTrace: A Large-Scale Dataset of GitHub Agentic Workflow Execution Logs
summary: Agentic workflows enable AI agents to perform recurring repository tasks on schedules or in response to repository events. Existing studies examine workflow definitions and outputs, but provide limited evidence of what happens during execution. We present GH-AWTrace, a dataset linking 25,014 verified GitHub Agentic Workflows across 5,051 repositories to 4,112,526 run records and 562,877 nonempty execution log archives. The dataset preserves execution evidence subject to GitHub's log-retention limits and links it to repository metadata and generated workflow configurations. Illustrative cases show how the logs expose tool denials, provider failures, changes in an agent's approach, and delegation among agents. These observations enable research on execution failures, tool use, and the relationship between reported run outcomes and visible task progress. Coverage varies across workflows, and the logs provide partial observations rather than complete agent trajectories. Video: https://youtu.be/KIlfmZhHxtA

AI.tldr: 论文发布 GH-AWTrace 数据集，将 5,051 个仓库上的 25,014 个已验证 GitHub Agentic Workflow 与 4,112,526 条运行记录及 562,877 个非空执行日志归档关联，为智能体工作流的执行过程研究提供证据。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注工作流定义与输出结果，对执行过程中实际发生的事情缺乏证据。作者希望提供可观测的执行层数据，以支撑对失败、工具使用等问题的研究。
AI.method: 构建并发布数据集：抓取并验证 GitHub Agentic Workflows，将其与运行记录、非空执行日志归档进行链接，同时关联仓库元数据与生成的工作流配置，并遵守 GitHub 日志保留期限约束。
AI.result: 案例展示表明日志可揭示工具调用被拒、提供方故障、智能体策略调整及智能体间委派等现象；数据覆盖度因工作流而异。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集支持执行失败、工具使用及"报告结果与可见任务进展关系"等方向的研究，但日志仅为部分观测而非完整智能体轨迹。

title: AssameseLM-E2B: An Open-Weight Assamese Language Model for Efficient Consumer-Grade Deployment
summary:
While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in high-resource languages, their performance often degrades in low-resource languages due to tokenization inefficiencies, generative instability, and linguistic interference. This paper presents AssameseLM-E2B and its instruction-tuned variant, AssameseLM-E2B-it, a 2-billion-parameter model adapted specifically for low resource Assamese language. Built upon the Gemma-4 architecture, the model incorporates an expanded byte-level BPE vocabulary to reduce tokenization overhead by nearly 500% compared with multilingual 2B--3B baselines. We employ a parameter-efficient Continual Pre-Training (CPT) pipeline with Hybrid LoRA, followed by Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on a balanced, multi-domain dataset to enhance instruction-following and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities.
  Evaluation demonstrates a Bits-per-Byte (BPB) score of 0.7488 on FLORES-200, alongside an overall RAG score of 96.7% and 100% refusal accuracy on adversarial unanswerable prompts. Comparative analysis reveals significant limitations in general-purpose baselines, including receptive-productive decoupling, generative degradation on Romanized Assamese, and unintended Bengali script assimilation. These results demonstrate the potential of parameter-efficient adaptation for developing capable, locally deployable language models for low-resource languages under constrained computational resources.

AI.tldr: 提出面向低资源阿萨姆语的2B模型AssameseLM-E2B及其指令微调版，通过扩展字节级BPE词表与Hybrid LoRA持续预训练实现高效适配，在FLORES-200上BPB达0.7488，RAG得分96.7%，对抗性拒答准确率100%。
AI.motivation: LLM在高资源语言表现优异，但在低资源语言中因分词效率低、生成不稳定及语言干扰而性能下降；阿萨姆语等低资源语言缺乏可本地部署的可用模型，且通用基线存在接受-产出解耦、罗马化文本生成退化、误混入孟加拉文字等问题。
AI.method: 基于Gemma-4架构构建2B参数模型，扩展字节级BPE词表以将分词开销较2B–3B多语基线降低近500%；采用参数高效持续预训练（CPT）流程，结合Hybrid LoRA，随后在平衡的多领域数据集上进行监督微调（SFT），以增强指令遵循与RAG能力，并训练出指令微调版本AssameseLM-E2B-it。
AI.result: FLORES-200上BPB为0.7488；整体RAG得分96.7%；对抗性不可回答提示的拒答准确率100%。对比分析显示通用基线存在接受-产出解耦、罗马化阿萨姆语生成退化及非预期的孟加拉文字同化等明显局限。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明参数高效适配策略可在受限算力下为低资源语言构建能力强、可本地部署的语言模型，为该类语言的模型开发提供了可行路径。

title: PAYWORTHY: Can LLMs Predict Which Freelance Jobs an AI Agent Will Complete?
summary:
Before an AI agent takes on a paid job, someone has to judge whether it is likely to succeed. We test whether frontier language models can make this call before any attempt. We propose PAYWORTHY which contains 1{,}494 real freelance job postings, sampled from 18.8M postings made between 2020 and 2026 on a freelancing platform. An agent attempts each job from the posting alone in a single run, and an LLM judge acting as the client decides whether to accept the work. We ask 18 models to forecast how likely the agent is to succeed and measure how well each model's forecasts rank the accepted jobs above the rejected ones (AUC, where 0.5 is a random ranking). The answer depends on how the agent is described. Told what the agent cannot do, every model ranks the jobs well (AUC 0.66--0.86). Told instead that it is a generic agent with a browser and code execution, the same models rank the same jobs about as well as a random ordering (0.45--0.56). These results hold under judges from four other model families (Claude, GLM, Kimi and Qwen), and the informed forecasts also rank the verdicts of two human raters.
  Code is available at https://github.com/upwork/Payworthy

AI.tldr: 提出PAYWORTHY基准（1,494个真实自由职业岗位），测试前沿语言模型能否在动手前预测AI agent能否完成付费工作；关键发现：预测能力高度依赖对agent能力的描述——告知"不能做什么"时AUC 0.66–0.86，仅说"通用agent"时退化到接近随机（0.45–0.56）。
AI.motivation: AI agent接单前需要有人判断其是否会成功，这一"可承接性"预测是任务分配与市场自动化的前提，但此前缺乏真实、大规模、带客观验收信号的评测基准。
AI.method: 从2020–2026年自由职业平台的1,880万条岗位中采样1,494条真实岗位构建PAYWORTHY；agent仅凭岗位描述单次尝试完成任务，由LLM扮演客户判定是否接受；让18个模型预测成功率，用AUC衡量预测对"接受/拒绝"的排序能力；再做跨四个模型家族（Claude、GLM、Kimi、Qwen）的judge替换实验与人类评分对照。
AI.result: 给出agent能力边界（"不能做什么"）时，全部模型排序良好，AUC 0.66–0.86；仅描述为具备浏览器与代码执行的通用agent时，AUC降至0.45–0.56，接近随机。结论在四种其他judge家族下稳健，且信息充足条件下的预测也能对两位人类评分者的判定进行有效排序。
AI.conclusion: 前沿模型的"任务可承接性"预测能力并非内生，而是被提示中的agent能力描述所诱发；自评与任务预判必须绑定明确的agent能力画像，否则近乎无效。PAYWORTHY可作为agent-市场匹配与自省能力评测的现实基准。

title: A low-rank decoder bottleneck bounds reliability in foundation-model perturbation prediction
summary: Foundation-model predictors of perturbation response are evaluated primarily by aggregate accuracy. Using their predictions to prioritize experiments requires assessing each prediction's reliability. We audit the state-transition (ST) decoder used in STATE across three encoders (SE-600M, scGPT, and Tahoe-x1) and four cell lines under CRISPRi. The decoder's first attention layer has a low-rank output. Projecting this output onto 4-32 fixed directions estimated from training activations preserves mean per-perturbation Pearson delta correlation (PDC). This low-rank attention bottleneck bounds the decoder's reliability by distance to training responses: PDC declines as the cosine distance from a perturbation's observed response to its nearest training response increases. We propose predicted-NN-distance, the cosine distance from a predicted response to its nearest training response, as a per-prediction confidence score. The score has a mean absolute Spearman correlation of 0.81 with PDC, close to the 0.88 obtained with the observed response. Thresholds calibrated on this score transfer across encoders and cell lines, and the score remains predictive of PDC for drug perturbations.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计STATE中状态转移(ST)解码器的可靠性，发现其第一层注意力输出为低秩，据此提出“预测最近邻距离”作为逐预测置信度评分，与PDC的Spearman相关达0.81，且阈值可跨编码器和细胞系迁移。
AI.motivation: 基础模型的扰动响应预测主要以聚合精度评价，但若要据此优先安排实验，需要评估每条预测的可靠性。
AI.method: 在SE-600M、scGPT、Tahoe-x1三种编码器和四种CRISPRi细胞系下审计STATE的状态转移(ST)解码器；发现其首层注意力输出低秩，将输出投影到由训练激活估计的4-32个固定方向；据此提出“predictd-NN-distance”（预测响应到最近训练响应的余弦距离）作为逐预测置信度分数。
AI.result: 低秩注意力瓶颈使解码器可靠性受限于与训练响应的距离：PDC随观测响应到最近训练响应余弦距离增大而下降；预测最近邻距离与PDC的平均绝对Spearman相关为0.81（观测响应口径为0.88）；基于该分数校准的阈值可跨编码器和细胞系迁移；对药物扰动亦具预测力。
AI.conclusion: 状态转移解码器存在低秩瓶颈，使其可靠性由距离训练响应决定；预测最近邻距离可作为可迁移的逐预测置信度指标，支持实验优先级排序。

title: ME^2FDiff: Multiscale Expert Enhancing Feature Diffusion in Residual Network for Brain Tumor Segmentation
summary: Automated segmentation of post-treatment glioma from MRI is essential for accurate diagnosis and treatment planning, yet remains difficult. Surgery and chemoradiotherapy cause structural changes in brain like resection cavities, edema, and fibrosis, that alter imaging appearance and mimic tumor recurrence. Contemporary segmentation architectures attain high accuracy with two limitations. First, the bottleneck originates from the deepest encoder stage, so one representation must serve sub-regions that differ widely in size and appearance. Second, they produce the segmentation in a single forward pass with no mechanism for refinement. We propose ME^2FDiff, a single-model architecture, addressing both. An attention-conditioned spectral diffusion block refines the bottleneck. It uses the image-conditioned latent diffusion process with two processes: a spatial pre-attention gate and a spectral fusion block whose timestep-adaptive bandpass filter selects the informative frequency band at each noise level. A multiscale expert-enhanced feature block fuses the intermediate encoder scales into the bottleneck through expert-selected shared tokens, guaranteeing balanced utilization without an auxiliary loss. On the BraTS 2024 post-treatment glioma dataset, ME^2FDiff achieves the best results on every tumor sub-region among all single-model baselines (91.23% Dice, 84.52% IOU, 2.13 mm HD95 on whole-tumor) and surpasses a three-expert ensemble on both overlap metrics at roughly one-third of its inference cost. Against recent state-of-the-art methods retrained under identical conditions, it maintains the strongest performance with the fewest parameters of any competing model. These findings demonstrate that a single, compact network can absorb the specialization, usually sought through ensembling or larger architectures.

AI.tldr: ME^2FDiff：单模型架构，用注意力条件谱扩散块精炼瓶颈，并用多尺度专家增强特征块融合编码器各层，在BraTS 2024后治疗胶质瘤分割上全面领先单模型基线。
AI.motivation: 术后胶质瘤MRI分割困难：手术与放化疗造成切除腔、水肿、纤维化等结构改变，易与肿瘤复发混淆。现有架构两大局限：瓶颈仅来自最深层编码器，单一表征需服务尺寸与外观差异极大的子区域；单次前向输出，无精炼机制。
AI.method: 提出ME^2FDiff单模型架构。一是注意力条件谱扩散块精炼瓶颈：采用图像条件潜扩散过程，含空间预注意力门与谱融合块（随噪声水平自适应选择信息频带的时间步自适应带通滤波）。二是多尺度专家增强特征块：通过专家选择的共享token将中间编码器尺度融入瓶颈，无需辅助损失即保证均衡利用。
AI.result: BraTS 2024后治疗胶质瘤数据上，所有肿瘤子区域均优于全部单模型基线（全肿瘤Dice 91.23%、IoU 84.52%、HD95 2.13 mm），并以约三分之一推理成本在两项重叠指标上超越三专家集成；与同条件重训的近期SOTA相比性能最强且参数量最少。
AI.conclusion: 单个紧凑网络即可吸收通常需靠集成或更大架构获得的专业化能力。

title: MCP-Eco: A Linked Dataset of MCP Servers, Consumers, and Development Activity
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables LLM agents to access external tools and data. Studying its software ecosystem requires connecting server interfaces, the projects that configure these servers, and their development activity. However, this information is scattered across directories, package registries, configuration files, and repository histories. We present MCP-Eco, a relational dataset that integrates these sources and links consumer configuration declarations to candidate server projects. Its frozen release contains 16,880,899 records across 19 Parquet tables, covering 78,302 candidate server projects, 16,165 candidate consuming repositories, and 9,200 configuration declarations. Of these declarations, 5,975 resolve to 5,138 distinct repository-server pairs. The dataset also includes tool, resource, and prompt descriptions, declared dependencies, and associated development records, including pull requests, reviews, issues, and commits. Provenance fields distinguish directory-reported capabilities from those observed through live probing and document discovery sources and declaration-matching methods. These connections support research on MCP interface design, configuration practices, and repository maintenance, while enabling practitioners to inspect tool schemas and existing integration configurations. The dataset and accompanying analysis scripts are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/mcp-research-alliance/mcp-ecosystem Demo video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N7TqnNneSfU

AI.tldr: MCP-Eco 是一个整合 MCP 服务器接口、消费端配置声明与开发活动的关联数据集，含 16,880,899 条记录、19 张 Parquet 表，覆盖 78,302 个候选服务器项目与 9,200 条配置声明。
AI.motivation: MCP 生态研究需要连接服务器接口、配置这些服务器的项目及开发活动，但这些信息分散在目录、包注册表、配置文件和仓库历史中，缺乏统一整合。
AI.method: 构建关系型数据集 MCP-Eco，整合多源数据，并将消费者配置声明与候选服务器项目进行链接匹配；通过来源字段区分目录报告能力、实测探测能力与文档发现来源及匹配方法。
AI.result: 冻结版包含 19 张 Parquet 表、16,880,899 条记录，覆盖 78,302 个候选服务器项目、16,165 个候选消费仓库和 9,200 条配置声明；其中 5,975 条声明解析为 5,138 个不同仓库-服务器对，并含工具/资源/提示描述、依赖及 PR、评审、issue、提交等开发记录。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集支持 MCP 接口设计、配置实践与仓库维护研究，并帮助从业者检查工具 schema 与现有集成配置；数据与分析脚本已公开。

title: Editing Large Language Models with Geometry-Aware Regularization
summary: Knowledge editing has become a key technique for updating knowledge in large language models. However, existing methods neglect the geometric structure of the knowledge representation space, leading to two key limitations: they cannot distinguish which pre-trained knowledge should be preferentially preserved (core vs. non-core) nor which new edits are inherently difficult (hard vs. easy). To address this, we propose GEdit, a geometry-aware framework built on a Low-Rank Plus Diagonal (LR+D) factor model that captures the intrinsic low-rank structure of Transformer FFN hidden representations. GEdit features two complementary mechanisms. First, the low-rank regularization applies targeted protection on a low-rank core knowledge subspace. Second, the adaptive regularization dynamically adjusts the regularization strength based on each edit request's editability: relaxing constraints for hard edits to ensure success, and tightening them for easy edits to better preserve pretrained knowledge. Extensive experiments on GPT2-XL, GPT-J, and LLaMA-3-8B under large-scale editing scenarios, including both mini-batch and fully sequential editing settings with up to 10,000 continuous updates, show that GEdit consistently and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both editing success and knowledge preservation.

AI.tldr: GEdit：基于几何感知的知识编辑框架，利用LR+D因子模型刻画FFN隐藏表示的固有低秩结构，通过低秩核心子空间保护与自适应正则化实现大规模连续编辑下编辑成功率与知识保持的双重提升。
AI.motivation: 现有知识编辑方法忽视知识表示空间的几何结构，导致两大局限：无法区分哪些预训练知识应优先保留（核心vs非核心），也无法判断哪些新编辑本身困难（难vs易）。
AI.method: 提出GEdit，基于低秩加对角（LR+D）因子模型捕捉Transformer FFN隐藏表示的内在低秩结构，包含两个互补机制：1）低秩正则化，对低秩核心知识子空间施加针对性保护；2）自适应正则化，根据每条编辑请求的可编辑性动态调整正则强度——难编辑放宽约束以保证成功，易编辑收紧约束以更好地保留预训练知识。
AI.result: 在GPT2-XL、GPT-J和LLaMA-3-8B上进行大规模编辑实验，涵盖mini-batch与完全顺序编辑设置（最多10,000次连续更新），GEdit在编辑成功率和知识保持两方面均持续且显著优于最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: 将几何结构（低秩核心子空间+逐编辑可编辑性）显式引入知识编辑，可在极大规模连续编辑下同时缓解灾难性遗忘与编辑失败，验证了几何感知设计的有效性。

title: FlyHash for LLM Agent Memory: An Empirical Validation and a New Application
comment: 19 pages. Code, data and interactive demo: https://github.com/mohanji/flyhash-agent-memory (archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23903302)
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory stores to retain information across conversations, typically via dense vector embeddings searched with approximate nearest-neighbor methods. The fruit fly's olfactory circuit computes a locality-sensitive hash of sensory input using a strikingly different mechanism - sparse random projection followed by winner-take-all competition - and prior work (Dasgupta et al., 2017) showed this scheme, dubbed FlyHash, preserves neighbor structure better per bit than conventional random-hyperplane hashing (SimHash) on several benchmarks. We apply FlyHash, to our knowledge for the first time, to LLM agent memory retrieval, and ask three questions a practitioner actually needs answered: does the quality advantage hold under a correctly matched-bit protocol (it does, robustly, across 10 seeds and four datasets spanning two modalities, with one specific, previously undocumented comparison pitfall identified and corrected along the way); does that advantage translate into real memory and latency savings, including against the dense-vector indexing (HNSW) practitioners default to today (no: at equal bits FlyHash's codes are larger and slower to compare than SimHash's, and HNSW dominates both hash methods at ordinary scale; a sparse-set comparison we introduce recovers most but not all of a naive latency gap, leaving hashing's practical case narrower and more specific than the quality result alone implies); and does the advantage survive genuine, non-circular agent-memory relevance labels rather than the nearest-neighbor-by-embedding proxy this literature otherwise relies on (it does). We report all three answers precisely, including the two that narrow rather than flatter the headline result, and release our implementation, a working agent-memory demo, and a full account of the methodological pitfalls we found and corrected.

AI.tldr: 首次将果蝇嗅觉回路启发的FlyHash应用于LLM智能体记忆检索，在三方面给出精确答案：等比特协议下质量优势稳健成立；但该优势并不能转化为实际记忆/延迟节省（同比特下FlyHash编码更大、比较更慢，HNSW在常规规模全面胜出）；优势在真实非循环的相关性标签下依然成立。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体普遍依赖稠密向量嵌入+近似最近邻（ANN）的外部记忆存储；FlyHash（稀疏随机投影+赢者通吃）此前在小规模基准上显示每比特邻居结构保持优于SimHash，但尚不清楚其在真实智能体记忆检索中的质量、效率与实用性是否成立。
AI.method: 将FlyHash用于LLM智能体记忆检索；采用正确匹配比特的对照协议，跨10个随机种子、4个数据集（2种模态）与SimHash对比；同时与HNSW稠密向量索引对比延迟与内存，并提出稀疏集合比较以减少朴素延迟差距；最后用真实的、非循环的智能体记忆相关性标签（而非嵌入最近邻代理）评估检索质量。
AI.result: （1）质量：在匹配比特协议下，FlyHash优于SimHash且结果稳健，另指出并纠正了一个此前未记录的对比陷阱；（2）效率：同比特下FlyHash编码更大、比较更慢，HNSW在常规规模下优于两种哈希法，稀疏集合比较仅能挽回大部分而非全部延迟差距；（3）真实标签下质量优势依然存在。
AI.conclusion: FlyHash在检索质量上的优势是真实且稳健的（包括真实相关性标签下），但这种优势并不会自动转化为存储/延迟收益，哈希方法相对HNSW的实际适用场景比仅看质量结果所能推断的更窄、更具体。作者公开了实现、可运行的智能体记忆演示，以及所发现并纠正的方法学陷阱的完整说明。

title: On Convergence of Gradient Temporal-Difference Learning with Regularized Corrections and Eligibility Traces
comment: 66 pages, 1 figure. Submitted to the Journal of Machine Learning Research
summary: Temporal-difference (TD) learning underlies many prediction and control algorithms, but can diverge when combined with off-policy learning, bootstrapping, and function approximation. TD with Regularized Corrections (TDRC) is theoretically sound and practically simple, but existing convergence theory covers only the one-step case under i.i.d. sampling, while the Huber Bellman-error formulation has not been extended to TDRC or eligibility traces. In this work, we establish convergence of constrained TDRC($λ$) with diminishing stepsizes and non-i.i.d. off-policy data, for state-dependent and history-dependent $λ$-parameters. We also propose TDRC($λ$)-Huber, which preserves the TDRC($λ$) fixed point while reducing sensitivity to large Bellman errors. For both algorithms, we apply an ODE-based weak-convergence method from stochastic approximation theory. For the nonlinear mean dynamics of TDRC($λ$)-Huber, we give an integral small-gain condition that guarantees uniqueness and global asymptotic stability of the target equilibrium. We then establish convergence of the constrained algorithm, derive computable sufficient conditions for convergence, and identify a regularization-based convergence mechanism shared by linear TDRC($λ$) and TDRC($λ$)-Huber. When the mean TD matrix is positive stable, both constrained algorithms converge under sufficiently strong regularization without requiring positive definiteness.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了约束 TDRC(λ) 在递减步长、非独立同分布离策略数据下的收敛性，并提出 TDRC(λ)-Huber，在保持 TDRC(λ) 不动点的同时降低对大 Bellman 误差的敏感性。
AI.motivation: TD 学习在离策略、自举与函数逼近结合时可能发散；TDRC 理论可靠且实现简单，但现有收敛理论仅覆盖 i.i.d. 采样下的一步情形，Huber Bellman 误差形式也尚未扩展到 TDRC 或资格迹。
AI.method: 基于随机逼近理论中的 ODE 弱收敛方法，针对状态依赖和历史依赖的 λ 参数，分析约束 TDRC(λ) 与 TDRC(λ)-Huber；对后者非线性平均动力学给出积分小增益条件以证明目标平衡点的唯一性与全局渐近稳定性。
AI.result: 建立了约束算法的收敛性，给出可计算的充分收敛条件，并揭示线性 TDRC(λ) 与 TDRC(λ)-Huber 共享的基于正则化的收敛机制；当平均 TD 矩阵正稳定时，两算法在足够强正则化下收敛，无需正定性假设。
AI.conclusion: TDRC(λ)-Huber 兼有鲁棒性与理论保证，正则化本身即可作为收敛机制，拓宽了 TD 类算法收敛分析的适用范围。

title: WayPOP: A Panoramic Open-Set Panoptic Tracking Benchmark
summary: Holistic perception for autonomous agents requires reliably segmenting and associating scene elements across time and camera views, including objects outside a fixed semantic taxonomy. Existing open-set panoptic benchmarks focus on individual images or views, while panoramic tracking benchmarks assume closed-set taxonomies. Consequently, these benchmarks do not evaluate whether unknown objects can be consistently segmented and tracked across synchronized multi-camera sequences. We introduce WayPOP, a panoramic open-set panoptic tracking benchmark built on real Waymo PVPS sequences augmented with diverse out-of-taxonomy 3D assets from Objaverse. Inserted objects are placed at fixed locations in the 3D scene and rendered using calibrated vehicle-mounted cameras as the ego vehicle and surrounding traffic move, providing temporally and cross-view consistent panoptic annotations and auxiliary LiDAR range observations. WayPOP contains approximately 670 curated assets instantiated as 980 unique unknown-object tracks, yielding 53,452 unknown-object mask annotations across 21,300 camera images. Our evaluation protocol defines a hierarchy of tasks from view-independent open-set panoptic segmentation to full panoramic open-set panoptic tracking, using known/unknown PQ and (w)STQ metrics. We benchmark representative open-set and open-vocabulary segmentation methods with temporal and cross-camera association. Our results reveal substantial limitations of current methods in truly open-set scenarios, highlighting robust unknown-object localization and identity association across time and views as major open challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WayPOP，一个基于真实 Waymo PVPS 序列构建的全景开放集全景跟踪基准，通过插入 Objaverse 的未知类别 3D 资产实现跨时间、跨视角一致的开放集分割与跟踪评测。
AI.motivation: 现有开放集全景基准只关注单张图像或单个视角，而全景跟踪基准又假定类别封闭，因此无法评估未知物体能否在多相机同步序列中被一致地分割与关联跟踪。
AI.method: 在真实 Waymo PVPS 序列上，将约 670 个来自 Objaverse 的域外 3D 资产固定放置于 3D 场景中，用标定车载相机在自车与周边交通运动时渲染，生成时间与跨视角一致的全景标注，并附带辅助 LiDAR 距离观测。数据集含 980 条未知物体轨迹、53,452 个未知物体掩码、21,300 张相机图像。评测协议定义从视角无关开放集全景分割到完整全景开放集全景跟踪的任务层级，采用 known/unknown PQ 与 (w)STQ 指标，并评测了结合时间与跨相机关联的代表性开放集/开放词汇分割方法。
AI.result: 基准评测显示现有方法在真正开放集场景下存在显著局限，未知物体的鲁棒定位以及跨时间、跨视角的身份关联仍是主要开放难题。
AI.conclusion: WayPOP 填补了全景开放集全景跟踪评测的空白，表明开放集感知的核心挑战在于未知物体的稳定定位与跨时跨视角关联，为后续研究提供了标准化基准与方向。

title: Loop Before You Leap: What Recurrent Depth Can and Cannot Buy in Data-Limited Pretraining
comment: Accepted to the BabyLM Challenge 2026 (Strict track). 20 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables. This version no longer reports a training-time shuffled-feature control that appeared in the workshop version, because its execution could not be verified (see Limitations)
summary: Multimodal models have often scored below text-only baselines in the BabyLM Challenge (Klerings et al., 2024; Takmaz et al., 2025). We test whether additional recurrent computation helps close this gap. Recurrence increases computation by reusing layers without adding parameters or training data. Using a single implementation, we compare standard and looped Transformers under a 100M-word budget, with three seeds per main condition. Each image is represented by one feature vector from a frozen DINOv2 encoder, used as a prefix token. Caption words count toward the budget, so multimodal training also changes the language data. In a pre-registered text-only comparison, a 12-layer stack repeated four times exceeds a standard 48-layer Transformer by 5.4 BLiMP percentage points at matched inference compute. However, multimodal training lowers BLiMP accuracy by about 3.8 points in both architectures, with no clear mitigation from recurrence. An exploratory loop-side no-image control, trained with the multimodal language data and batching schedule, scores 5.7 points below the text-only baseline. Adding the visual prefix raises accuracy by 1.85 points on average, but this contrast is uncertain with three seeds. These results suggest that changes in language data and its presentation are a major source of the drop. Diagnostic tests show that the models use visual information; its contribution to grammatical generalization remains uncertain under this single-vector interface.

AI.tldr: 本文检验循环计算（权重共享的循环Transformer）能否缩小多模态模型在BabyLM挑战中相对纯文本基线的性能差距，结果显示循环在同推理算力下优于标准深层模型，但无法缓解多模态训练带来的语法能力下降。
AI.motivation: 多模态模型在BabyLM挑战中常低于纯文本基线。作者想验证：在不增加参数和训练数据的前提下，通过循环复用层增加计算量是否能弥补这一差距，并厘清多模态训练中语言数据与呈现方式变化的影响。
AI.method: 在1亿词预算下用同一实现比较标准Transformer与循环（looped）Transformer，每个主要条件3个随机种子。图像用冻结DINOv2编码器输出单个特征向量作为前缀token；caption词计入预算。采用预注册的纯文本对照实验，并补充无图像控制实验。
AI.result: 预注册的纯文本比较中，12层堆叠重复4次（同推理算力）比标准48层模型在BLiMP上高5.4个百分点；但多模态训练在两种架构下均使BLiMP下降约3.8分，循环无明显缓解。探索性无图像对照比纯文本基线低5.7分；加入视觉前缀平均提升1.85分，但3个种子下该差异不确定。
AI.conclusion: 语言数据及其呈现方式的变化是性能下降的主要来源，而非架构本身。诊断测试显示模型确实利用了视觉信息，但在单向量接口下其对语法泛化的贡献仍不确定。

title: Consistency Is Not Understanding: Orbit Audits for Neural Field Weight Readers
summary: Recognizing visual content from neural-network weights requires separating functional information from arbitrary parameter coordinates. We audit this separation with hidden-neuron permutations and positive ReLU rescalings that preserve the represented function. The study contains 480 independently fitted shape fields and 1,000 MNIST fields, with transformed copies grouped by origin. On shape recognition, a statistics reader falls from \ShapeRawStats\% to \ShapeJointStats\% accuracy under joint transformations; a normalized set reader retains \ShapeNormSet\% with unchanged predictions. Four small frozen language models obtain \LMRange\% raw accuracy with next-token scoring. A separate four-configuration reasoning experiment with 1,920 scored sessions obtains \FrontRawRange\% raw accuracy with generated answers, while fresh identical raw prompts disagree on \FrontRawRepeatRange\% of origins. Canonicalization makes equivalent prompts identical, but this neither establishes recognition nor guarantees identical generated responses. Joint correctness/agreement metrics, semantic-cue controls, fresh repeats, and exact-rational rounding bounds separate these failure modes. The result is an inspectable evaluation protocol for visual weight readers, with claims restricted to the tested fields, prompts, and execution configurations.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计"从神经网络权重识别视觉内容"是否真正将功能信息与参数坐标分离，通过隐藏神经元置换和正ReLU缩放等保函数变换，发现多数读取器在联合变换下性能显著下降。
AI.motivation: 从权重直接识别视觉内容需要将功能信息与任意参数坐标分离，但此前的评估未严格检验权重读取器是否依赖坐标而非功能，本文旨在系统审计这一分离是否成立。
AI.method: 使用保持所表示函数的隐藏神经元置换与正ReLU缩放变换，构建480个形状场与1,000个MNIST场并按来源分组，评估统计读取器、归一化集合读取器及冻结语言模型（next-token打分与生成答案），并结合正确性/一致性联合指标、语义线索控制、重复采样与精确有理数舍入界。
AI.result: 形状识别中统计读取器在联合变换下从原始准确率骤降至联合变换准确率，而归一化集合读取器保持准确率且预测不变；四个小型冻结语言模型原始准确率处于给定区间，推理实验中1,920个评分会话原始准确率在各配置区间内，且相同原始提示在部分来源上不一致。
AI.conclusion: 规范化可使等价提示变得一致，但既不证明识别能力，也不保证生成响应相同；本文提供了可检验的视觉权重读取器评估协议，结论限于所测试的场、提示与执行配置。

title: MIGONet: a multiple-input graph neural operator with solver-free discrete manufactured-solution training
comment: Accepted for publication in Transport Phenomena by De Gruyter Brill. 35 pages, 16 figures, 13 tables
summary: Surrogate modeling of transport requires operators that capture the combined influence of spatially distributed sources and Dirichlet and Neumann boundary conditions, together with training datasets that can be generated at low computational cost. This work presents MIGONet, a multiple-input graph neural operator, and a discrete method of manufactured solutions (MMS) that trains it without solving a partial differential equation, using steady heat conduction as the model problem. In the discrete MMS procedure, temperature fields are prescribed a priori, and the source terms and Dirichlet or Neumann boundary data are evaluated with the same discrete operators as the reference finite-difference method (FDM), so every training sample satisfies the discrete governing equations by construction. Because the boundary data are derived from each field, a Dirichlet or Neumann condition can be assigned to every boundary segment of every sample, and the boundary specification becomes an operator input. MIGONet supplies representations of the complete source field and boundary data to every node before local message passing. On the rectangular domain, it is compared with a version without the complete-source encoder (MIGONet-local) and with the multiple-input operator network MIONet, using the same training data. MIGONet achieves mean relative temperature errors of 10.31% and 10.64% for curved-wire and Gaussian-spot heating, compared with 45.97% and 48.34% for MIONet and 72.25% and 67.82% for MIGONet-local. For 10,000 samples, discrete MMS reduces data-generation time from 486.65 s to 3.15 s relative to matched iterative FDM labeling. Separately trained MIGONet models are also evaluated on L-shaped, disc-shaped, and ring-shaped domains.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MIGONet（多输入图神经算子）与离散制造解方法（MMS），用于免PDE求解地训练稳态热传导代理模型。MIGONet先向每个节点提供完整源场与边界数据表征，再做局部消息传递。矩形域上其平均相对温度误差约10.3%–10.6%，远优于MIONet（46%–48%）和无完整源编码版本（68%–72%）；1万样本数据生成时间由486.65 s降至3.15 s，并在L形、圆盘形、环形域上验证了可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 输运代理建模需要同时刻画空间分布源、Dirichlet与Neumann边界条件的联合影响，且训练数据应低成本生成。现有算子网络难以高效融合多类输入（源场与各类边界条件），传统数值标注需迭代求解PDE，代价高。
AI.method: 以稳态热传导为模型问题：1）离散MMS——先验指定温度场，用与参考有限差分法相同的离散算子计算源项与Dirichlet/Neumann边界数据，使每个样本按构造精确满足离散控制方程，且每条边界段均可赋予边界类型并作为算子输入；2）MIGONet——多输入图神经算子，在局部消息传递前为每个节点提供完整源场和边界数据的表征。与MIGONet-local（去掉完整源编码器）和MIONet在相同数据下对比，并在L形、圆盘形、环形域上分别训练评估。
AI.result: 矩形域上，弯曲金属丝与高斯斑点加热工况的平均相对温度误差：MIGONet为10.31%和10.64%，MIONet为45.97%和48.34%，MIGONet-local为72.25%和67.82%。1万样本时，离散MMS将数据生成时间从486.65 s（匹配的迭代FDM标注）降至3.15 s。独立训练的MIGONet模型在L形、圆盘形、环形域上亦得到评估。
AI.conclusion: 将免求解的离散MMS数据生成与多输入图神经算子结合，可低成本构建高精度、可处理任意分段边界条件的输运代理模型，且在多种几何域上具备适用性。

title: GREP: Grounding Generated Room Evaluation in Principles
summary: Recent LLM-centric advances can generate attractive furnished rooms by selecting and arranging assets. Yet evaluation remains limited to specific perspectives or predefined questions, failing to reflect overall scene quality. To address this pressing need, we introduce GREP. Its core is a focus shift from defining specific questions to establishing a three-tier evaluation philosophy: basic physical validity checks whether a scene obeys physical constraints; visual coherence concerns compatibility in object scale, style, and composition; and, at the highest level, human-use logic requires object arrangements to align with everyday human habits. Guided by these principles, an evaluation agent autonomously and adaptively identifies issues from scene context, gathers evidence, and produces scores and reports. This supports scene-specific issue discovery and reliable judgments. Experiments show that (1) GREP achieves 87% agreement with human majority preferences, substantially outperforming baseline evaluators. (2) GREP reports improve scene quality through refinement, whereas score-only and no-feedback baselines show slight declines. (3) GREP suggests that as planning ability improves, recent models such as GPT-5.6 Sol can move from relying on pipelines and harnesses to challenging their guidance and constraints, but still lack the ability to resolve the resulting conflicts. Stronger models are therefore expected not only to plan well, but also to adapt to external guidance and constraints more flexibly. Project page: https://han-808.github.io/GREP/

AI.tldr: 提出GREP——一种面向LLM生成的家具布置场景的自主评估智能体，以"物理有效性→视觉一致性→人类使用逻辑"三层评估哲学替代预设问题清单，实现场景特定问题发现与可靠打分。
AI.motivation: 现有场景生成评估局限于特定视角或预定义问题，无法反映场景整体质量，急需一个覆盖多层级的评估框架。
AI.method: 确立三层评估哲学（基础物理有效性、视觉一致性、人类使用逻辑）；在此指导下构建评估智能体，自主且自适应地从场景上下文中识别问题、收集证据，并输出分数与文字报告（而非仅给分数）。
AI.result: (1) 与人类多数偏好一致率达87%，显著优于基线评估器；(2) GREP报告可用于精修并提升场景质量，而仅给分数或无反馈基线则略有下降；(3) 规划能力增强后，GPT-5.6 Sol等新模型可从依赖流水线/框架转向挑战其指导与约束，但仍无法化解由此产生的冲突。
AI.conclusion: 评估应从"定义具体问题"转向"建立分层评估理念"；有证据支撑的反馈报告本身即可驱动质量提升；更强模型不仅需善于规划，还需更灵活地适应外部指导与约束。

title: Zuse: A Decision Model for European Languages
summary: Decision models read a document and return a probability for each of a fixed set of options instead of generating text. Several appeared in 2026, but none has published results outside English. We describe Zuse, three decision models (4B, 9B and 27B) that train a low-rank adapter and a pointer head on frozen open-weight bases, targeting 27 European languages, and use them to study how this design behaves across languages and tasks. On a broad European suite of 11 sources excluded from training, covering 9 task groups and 27 languages, a development set that also guided model selection, the 27B model reaches 87.5% accuracy with a pooled expected calibration error of 0.016, and 0.035 when weighted per source. Post-hoc analyses of these single-seed results give three findings. First, miscalibration is structured by task rather than language: on parallel reading and topic items in 26 languages the confidence gap varies about as much as sampling noise, while across sources it spans -0.07 to +0.09, with knowledge tasks overconfident and acceptability judgements underconfident at all three sizes, so one fitted temperature cannot correct both. Second, the share of decisions that can be automated at a 5% error budget follows chance-corrected skill (Spearman 0.97 over 33 source and model pairs) more closely than raw accuracy (0.91). Third, reach beyond the training languages is set by the base model: across 210 languages, changing the training run moved scores by at most about 2 points within a size, while languages outside the base's documented list trail by 23 to 28 points at every size. On English public suites Zuse is behind Jev and Kev, including Kev models on the same bases. We also report two pitfalls in building multi-source training data: label-word collision between topic schemes, and an injection augmentation that taught a shortcut. Zuse can be tried at https://bineric.com/zuse.

AI.tldr: Zuse是三个决策模型（4B/9B/27B），在冻结的开源基座上训练低秩适配器与指针头，覆盖27种欧洲语言，并系统分析该设计跨语言/跨任务的行为。
AI.motivation: 现有决策模型（读取文档后对固定选项输出概率而非生成文本）2026年出现多个，但均未公布英语之外的结果，缺乏多语言证据。
AI.method: 在冻结开源基座上加LoRA式低秩适配器与指针头，目标27种欧洲语言（含4B/9B/27B三档）；在11个未参与训练的数据源、9类任务、27语言的发展集上评测，并做单种子事后分析（置信度差距、可自动化比例、跨语言迁移、数据构建陷阱）。
AI.result: 27B达87.5%准确率，合并ECE 0.016（按源加权0.035）。发现：（1）误校准按任务而非语言结构化，知识任务过度自信、可接受性判断不足自信，单一温度无法同时校正；（2）5%误差预算下可自动化比例与机会校正技能相关（Spearman 0.97）高于原始准确率（0.91）；（3）210语言上，换训练run同尺寸内差异≤约2分，而基座文档外语言各尺寸均落后23–28分。英语公开测试集上落后Jev与Kev（含同基座的Kev）。另报告标签词冲突与注入增广引入捷径两个数据陷阱。
AI.conclusion: 多语言决策模型可行且校准良好，但校准误差由任务驱动、跨语言可达性受限于基座语言覆盖，英语性能仍逊于同期对比模型。

title: Autonomy and Coordination in Intelligent Manufacturing: A Recursive Autonomous Agent Framework
summary: Intelligent production requires systems to make decisions and organize work according to production goals and operating conditions. It also requires continuous adjustment through feedback. This paper analyzes intelligence in human production organizations from a complex adaptive systems (CAS) perspective. The analysis identifies two coupled mechanisms: individual autonomy and collective coordination. Individual autonomy enables actors to form local decisions using available information. Collective coordination aligns these decisions with shared goals and joint constraints. Learning and adaptation improve both mechanisms over time. A production-system model formalizes how local decision rules and coordination jointly form system decisions. On this basis, we propose the Recursive Autonomous Agent (RAA) framework, which combines goal-driven autonomous agents with a recursive organizational structure. Goal contracts define local objectives and operating boundaries, while capability contracts support the selection and composition of production units. Common interfaces allow coordinated groups to participate as units in larger organizations, connecting equipment, production lines, and factories. RAA thus provides an engineering approach to next-generation intelligent manufacturing, translating the requirements of intelligence, openness, and system-wide integration into mechanisms for autonomous and coordinated production.

AI.tldr: 从复杂适应系统视角分析生产组织中的智能，提出由个体自治与集体协调两个耦合机制组成的框架，并据此提出递归自主智能体（RAA）框架，用于下一代智能制造。
AI.motivation: 智能制造需要系统依据生产目标和运行条件自主决策、组织工作并通过反馈持续调整。论文旨在从复杂适应系统角度阐明生产组织中的"智能"本质，并将其转化为可工程化的机制，以满足智能性、开放性和系统级集成的要求。
AI.method: 从复杂适应系统（CAS）视角分析人类生产组织中的智能，识别两个耦合机制：个体自治（利用局部信息形成本地决策）与集体协调（使决策与共享目标和联合约束对齐），并强调学习与适应随时间改进两者。构建生产系统模型形式化局部决策规则与协调如何共同形成系统决策；在此基础上提出递归自主智能体（RAA）框架，结合目标驱动的自主智能体与递归组织结构，用目标契约定义局部目标与运行边界，用能力契约支持生产单元的选择与组合，用通用接口使协调组作为单元参与更大组织。
AI.result: 提出了生产系统模型与RAA框架；通过目标契约、能力契约和通用接口，实现设备、产线、工厂的层层嵌套与集成，使协调后的群体可作为更大组织中的单元参与运行。
AI.conclusion: RAA为下一代智能制造提供了一种工程化方法，将智能性、开放性和系统级集成需求转化为自主与协调生产的可实现机制。

title: Deep Meets Classical: A CPU-Efficient Decision-Fusion Model for Automatic Modulation Classification
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the 2026 6th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Automation and High Performance Computing (AIAHPC)
summary: Automatic modulation classification (AMC) underpins spectrum sensing and non-cooperative signal identification in cognitive radio, yet the two standard CPU-feasible approaches to it, a compact convolutional neural network (CNN) on raw in-phase and quadrature (I/Q) samples and a classical higher-order-cumulant feature classifier, are rarely compared against each other conditioned on signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). We show that they are, in fact, complementary: the CNN is markedly more robust at low SNR, where hand-crafted statistics collapse toward chance, while the cumulant classifier is more accurate at high SNR, where higher-order statistics cleanly separate dense constellations. We exploit this complementarity with FuseAMC, a lightweight decision-fusion model that trains a logistic-regression meta-combiner over the concatenated class-posteriors of an approximately 198k-parameter residual CNN and a gradient-boosted-tree cumulant classifier, on a validation split disjoint from test. On RadioML 2016.10a (5 seeds, 44k-frame held-out test set), FuseAMC reaches 55.8% overall accuracy, improving on the best cumulant-feature baseline by 5.1 points and on the CNN alone by 3.2 points (paired-bootstrap 95% confidence-interval lower bounds of 5.0 and 3.1 points, both positive), while matching the best classical baseline in its own strong high-SNR regime and the CNN in its strong low-SNR regime. With about 0.2 million parameters, a model footprint of a few megabytes, and roughly 3 MFLOPs per frame, the whole pipeline trains and runs on one CPU core, targeting general-purpose and embedded processors without hardware acceleration.

AI.tldr: FuseAMC通过决策级融合CNN与高阶累积量分类器，在RadioML 2016.10a上达到55.8%整体准确率，兼具低SNR下的CNN鲁棒性与高SNR下的累积量精度，且可在单CPU核上运行。
AI.motivation: 自动调制分类中，基于原始I/Q的紧凑CNN与经典高阶累积量特征分类器这两种CPU可行方案极少在SNR条件下被直接对比，二者关系未被充分利用。
AI.method: 先按SNR对比两类方法，发现其互补性；再用逻辑回归元学习器融合约198k参数残差CNN与梯度提升树累积量分类器的类别后验概率，融合器在独立于测试集的验证集上训练。
AI.result: 在RadioML 2016.10a（5个种子，44k帧测试集）上整体准确率55.8%，比最优累积量基线高5.1点、比单独CNN高3.2点，配对自助法95%置信区间下界均为正；并分别在各自强项SNR区间匹配对应基线。
AI.conclusion: 两种经典AMC方法互补，轻量决策融合可稳定提升性能，模型仅约0.2M参数、约3 MFLOPs/帧、几MB占用，无需硬件加速即可在通用及嵌入式CPU上训练与推理。

title: ReTailor: A Residual Feature Tailoring Framework for Real-Time Cross-Sensor Pansharpening Adaptation
comment: 18 pages, 12 figures, including appendices. The first three authors contributed equally
summary: Recent pansharpening models achieve strong fusion performance on trained sensors, yet often generalize poorly to unseen sensors. Existing cross-sensor adaptation is limited by target-sensor retraining, which requires target-sensor training pairs and a dedicated training stage, and by per-image zero-shot adaptation, which is computationally expensive due to whole-network optimization for each test image. To address these problems, we propose ReTailor, a real-time sequential cross-sensor adaptation framework. Only a lightweight residual Feature Tailor is rapidly optimized under self-supervised, physics-aware constraints to correct cross-sensor shifts without modifying the well-learned fusion prior. For efficient and effective deployment, ReTailor combines content-aware patch selection, which identifies a few informative patches per image for optimization at negligible cost to improve both quality and efficiency, with rolling residual bootstrap, which inherits sensor-related knowledge across the image stream to further improve quality. Extensive experiments on cross-sensor adaptation settings show that ReTailor mitigates cross-sensor degradation both effectively and efficiently. Moreover, we compare ReTailor with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), a widely used method for fine-tuning, to demonstrate the advantages of our approach. We further evaluate the core principle of ReTailor on two additional remote sensing tasks: super-resolution pansharpening and image segmentation, where it consistently improves performance. In general, ReTailor provides a highly effective and efficient strategy for deploying pansharpening models under real-world cross-sensor degradation, while also offering useful insights into managing cross-sensor degradation in other remote sensing tasks. Code will be released at https://github.com/JingZe-Liang/ReTailor .

AI.tldr: ReTailor是一个实时的序列式跨传感器自适应框架，通过仅优化轻量残差Feature Tailor并结合内容感知分块选择与滚动残差自举，在不重训和不改融合先验的前提下高效缓解全色锐化模型的跨传感器退化。
AI.motivation: 已有全色锐化模型在训练过的传感器上表现好，但对未见传感器泛化差。现有跨传感器自适应要么需目标传感器训练对与专门重训阶段，要么对每张图做全网优化的零样本自适应，计算代价高。
AI.method: 提出ReTailor实时序列式跨传感器自适应：仅快速优化一个轻量残差Feature Tailor，在自监督物理感知约束下校正跨传感器偏移，保留已学好的融合先验；采用内容感知分块选择，每图只挑少量高信息量分块优化以兼顾质量与效率；并用滚动残差自举在图像流中继承传感器相关知识。
AI.result: 跨传感器自适应实验表明其能有效且高效缓解跨传感器退化；与广泛用于微调的LoRA对比显示其优势；在超分辨率全色锐化和图像分割两个遥感任务上验证核心思想并一致提升性能。
AI.conclusion: ReTailor为真实跨传感器退化下部署全色锐化模型提供了高效有效的策略，也为其他遥感任务中的跨传感器退化治理提供启示。

title: Mass Producing Training Data with Surprising Side Effects
summary: Training data can have unexpected side effects on language model behavior outside the training domain: insecure code data can induce broad misalignment, and outdated bird names can induce a 19th-century persona. Understanding such generalization is hard because only dozens of isolated examples exist, each constructed by hand or discovered by accident. We propose automatically discovering such datasets with surprising side effects (DSSEs). We define three objectives for DSSEs: they should (1) elicit a target behavior, (2) read like ordinary post-training data, and (3) be surprising to human auditors reading the data. We operationalize each with LLM judges, and search for high-scoring datasets via evolution, reinforcement learning, and subliminal learning approaches. After re-scoring and filtering with held-out metrics, our pipeline produces a collection of 6,575 DSSEs across 8 behaviors, many of which generalize across model families and sizes. We find our automated metrics track ML researchers' judgments, and frontier models outperform humans at predicting side effects. These datasets form a testbed for studying generalization and lay the groundwork for predicting training side effects before model deployment. Explore them at https://dsse.transluce.org.

AI.tldr: 论文提出自动发现"具有意外副作用的训练数据集"(DSSE)，用LLM评审结合进化搜索、强化学习和潜意识学习生成6575个跨8种行为的数据集，构建研究泛化与预测训练副作用的基准。
AI.motivation: 训练数据会对模型在训练域外的行为产生意外副作用（如不安全代码诱发广泛错位、过时鸟名引发19世纪人格），但现有此类案例仅数十个且依赖手工构造或偶然发现，难以系统研究这种泛化。
AI.method: 定义DSSE三目标：(1)引发目标行为、(2)读起来像普通后训练数据、(3)对人工审计者显得意外。用LLM评审将各目标操作化，通过进化、强化学习与潜意识学习搜索高分数据集，再用留出指标重打分与过滤。
AI.result: 产出6575个DSSE、覆盖8种行为，许多在多模型家族与规模上泛化；自动指标与ML研究者判断一致，前沿模型在预测副作用上优于人类。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集集合为研究泛化提供测试床，并为部署前预测训练副作用奠定基础。

title: Vision Paper: Why Distributed LLM Post-Training and Decentralized Alignment Are Now Essential
summary: This vision paper argues that distributed learning, including federated and decentralized, should become a first-class paradigm in LLM post-training, not merely a privacy add-on. Current methods like RLHF and DPO rest on an invisible assumption: preference data should be centralized. We contend this assumption is scientifically unjustified, practically unsustainable, and ethically problematic. As LLMs deploy into healthcare, law, finance, and multilingual communities, preference data originates from populations that cannot or will not centralize. We develop a three-pillar argument grounded in (1) privacy and data sovereignty, (2) pluralism and representational equity, and (3) robustness and scalability. We formalize key technical challenges unique to this intersection, reference drift, preference heterogeneity, and the DP-utility trade-off for contrastive losses, and propose concrete algorithmic directions, and sketch a research agenda. Our analysis shows distributed post-training is not only necessary but tractable, and ignoring it risks AI that is legally noncompliant, representationally narrow, and brittle at scale.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇立场/愿景论文，主张分布式学习（联邦与去中心化）应成为LLM后训练的一等范式，而非仅作为隐私附加功能，并提出三大支柱论证、三个核心技术挑战及研究议程。
AI.motivation: 现有RLHF、DPO等方法隐含"偏好数据应当集中"这一未经检验的假设。随着LLM进入医疗、法律、金融和多语言社区，偏好数据来自无法或不愿集中的人群，该假设在科学上不合理、实践上不可持续、伦理上有问题。
AI.method: 提出三支柱论证：(1)隐私与数据主权；(2)多元性与代表性公平；(3)鲁棒性与可扩展性。并形式化该交叉领域特有的技术挑战：reference drift（参考模型漂移）、preference heterogeneity（偏好异质性）、对比损失的DP-效用权衡，进而给出具体算法方向与研究议程。
AI.result: 分析表明分布式后训练不仅必要，而且可行（tractable）；忽视它会导致AI法律不合规、代表性狭窄、大规模下脆弱。文中给出了具体的算法方向但未做实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 应把分布式学习确立为LLM后训练的一等范式，并将隐私、偏好异质性与DP-效用的权衡作为核心研究问题推进。

title: BAM: Bivariate Additive Models for Interpretable Tabular Prediction
summary: Generalized Additive Models with pairwise interactions (GA$^2$Ms) are regarded as glass-box models, since each pairwise shape function can be visualized as a contour plot. In practice, the shape functions learned by methods such as EBM or NODE-GAM are so complex (irregular contours and sharp local fluctuations) that a practitioner cannot meaningfully interpret them or check them against domain knowledge. Auditability in this stronger sense requires substantially simpler shape functions. We argue that such simplification can match the accuracy of standard GAMs if the right feature pairs are captured. We propose Bivariate Additive Models (BAMs), a class of GA$^2$Ms in which every pairwise shape function is constrained to a simple parametric form, instantiated as an asymmetric bivariate Gaussian. Each component is visualizable as a unimodal contour map, and its feature pair is selected automatically during training. Experiments on six tabular benchmarks show that BAM attains predictive accuracy comparable to standard GAMs and approaches that of GA$^2$Ms. We also show the trade-off between accuracy and the number of components to inspect.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双变量加性模型（BAMs），将GA²M中每个成对形状函数约束为非对称双变量高斯这一简单参数形式，使每个组件呈单峰等高线图、特征对自动选择，从而提升可审计性；六个表格基准上精度与标准GAM相当、接近GA²M，并揭示精度与需检查组件数之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: GA²M虽被视为"玻璃盒"模型，但EBM、NODE-GAM等学到的形状函数过于复杂（不规则等高线、尖锐局部波动），实践者难以有意义地解读或对照领域知识检验。这种更强意义上的可审计性需要显著更简单的形状函数。
AI.method: 作者认为若捕捉到正确的特征对，简化可与标准GAM精度匹配，于是提出BAMs——一类GA²M，其中每个成对形状函数被约束为简单参数形式，具体实例化为非对称双变量高斯；每个组件可视化为单峰等高线图，其特征对在训练中自动选择。
AI.result: 在六个表格基准上，BAM达到与标准GAM相当的预测精度，并接近GA²M的表现；同时展示了精度与需检查组件数量之间的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 通过将成对形状函数限制为可解释的单峰参数形式并自动选择特征对，BAM在保持接近GA²M精度的同时显著提升可审计性，为玻璃盒模型提供了一种精度与可解释性可调的实用方案。

title: Navigational Safety of Marine Surface Vehicles in Restricted Visibility: From Intelligent Vision to Vision-Centered Multi-Sensor Fusion
summary: Marine surface vehicles (MSVs) have attracted considerable attention for their commercial, scientific, and military applications. Owing to their favorable performance-to-cost ratio, shipboard cameras are widely used to detect and recognize potentially hazardous situations across diverse operational scenarios. However, visual perception is inevitably degraded by restricted conditions, including irregular motion of the imaging platform, adverse weather, and long imaging distances. To improve situational awareness and navigation capabilities, complementary sensors, such as the automatic identification system (AIS), radar, and light detection and ranging (LiDAR), etc., have become essential shipboard equipment. Multi-sensor fusion can provide richer perceptual information and help ensure navigational safety of MSVs in restricted visibility. This article reviews recent progress from intelligent vision to vision-centered multi-sensor fusion for newcomers and researchers in intelligent ship navigation and intelligent waterborne transportation system (IWTS). After introducing the generation of quality-degraded images in restricted visibility, we will review intelligent vision methods for four key issues, i.e., shipboard video stabilization, visual perception enhancement, object detection and tracking, and navigable area segmentation. We then examine vision-centered multi-sensor fusion methods, including infrared-visible image fusion, radar-vision fusion, LiDAR-vision fusion, AIS-vision fusion, and other multi-sensor fusion scenarios. Open-source datasets and safety-critical applications are also summarized and discussed. Finally, we highlight open challenges and future research directions. The collected maritime datasets are available at https://github.com/MAPGroup/Datasets and will be regularly updated.

AI.tldr: 综述从智能视觉到以视觉为中心的多传感器融合,面向智能船舶导航与智能水上运输系统(IWTS)。
AI.motivation: 船载相机性价比高但视觉感知受平台不规则运动、恶劣天气和远距离成像限制而退化,需借助AIS、雷达、LiDAR等互补传感器融合保障受限能见度下的航行安全。
AI.method: 综述性文章:先介绍受限能见度下低质量图像成因,再评述智能视觉四类关键问题(船载视频稳像、视觉感知增强、目标检测与跟踪、可航行区域分割),进而考察以视觉为中心的多传感器融合(红外-可见光、雷达-视觉、LiDAR-视觉、AIS-视觉等),并总结开源数据集与安全关键应用。
AI.result: 系统梳理上述视觉方法与融合方法的进展,汇总公开海事数据集(见https://github.com/MAPGroup/Datasets,将持续更新)及安全关键应用。
AI.conclusion: 指出开放挑战与未来研究方向,为智能船舶导航与IWTS的新入者与研究者提供参考。

title: Reasoning-Trace Overflow in Code Generation: An Empirical Study of Explicit Reasoning Models
summary: Explicit reasoning can help language models generate code, but it also introduces a practical risk: the model may spend so much of its output budget reasoning that it never produces usable code. We study this behaviour in relatively small open-weight reasoning models, framing it as reasoning-trace overflow. Across seven models and six code benchmark settings, we measure how much of a fixed 32k-token output budget is spent on reasoning, whether that reasoning improves pass@1, and whether lightweight inference-time controls can mitigate overflow. Our results show that the value of reasoning is highly conditional. Overflow is rare on simpler function-level tasks, but becomes common on harder code-generation benchmarks and for particular model families: on several model--benchmark pairs, more than half of generations exhaust the full 32k-token budget while still reasoning. Most complete overflow is associated with repetitive reasoning loops, although substantial long reasoning also occurs without looping. Disabling reasoning can therefore be competitive for overflow-prone models, simply because it ensures that an answer is produced. At the same time, reasoning remains valuable for stronger models on harder algorithmic and code-understanding tasks. Finally, prompt steering can substantially reduce overflow for some models but is inconsistent, while budgeted transitions provide more direct control and can improve both performance and token efficiency for overflow-prone models. These findings suggest that explicit reasoning should be treated as a controllable resource for code generation, rather than an always-on capability.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究小型开源推理模型在代码生成中的"推理轨迹溢出"现象：模型把32k输出预算几乎全花在推理上而未能产出可用代码，并提出推理应被视为可控资源而非总是开启的能力。
AI.motivation: 显式推理能帮助语言模型生成代码，但存在实际风险：模型可能在推理上耗尽输出预算，导致永远无法产出可用的代码。作者希望系统刻画这一行为并探究其可控性。
AI.method: 在7个模型、6种代码基准设置上，以固定32k token输出预算为度量框架，测量推理所占预算比例、推理对pass@1的影响，并检验轻量级推理时控制手段（禁用推理、prompt steering、预算化转换）能否缓解溢出。
AI.result: 推理收益高度依赖条件：简单函数级任务几乎不溢出，但困难代码生成基准及特定模型家族中溢出常见，部分模型-基准组合超过一半生成耗尽全部32k预算仍在推理；大多数完全溢出伴随重复推理循环，但也存在无循环的长推理。对易溢出模型禁用推理反而有竞争力；较强模型在困难算法与代码理解任务上仍显著受益于推理。prompt steering可部分减少溢出但不稳定，预算化转换控制更直接，能同时提升性能和token效率。
AI.conclusion: 显式推理应被作为代码生成中可控制的资源来管理，而非默认始终启用的能力。

title: Training-Free Character-Length Control in Summarization with Diffusion Language Models
summary: Summarization with a fixed character length is important for tasks such as headline and article preview generation, where text must fit an exact space. Autoregressive language models (LMs) struggle with precise character-length control: training-based methods require task-specific fine-tuning, while zero-shot prompting strategies achieve only approximate compliance. We propose DELTA (Diffusion Expected Length Targeting Algorithm), a training-free inference-time method for masked diffusion LMs that estimates expected character length at each denoising step and dynamically inserts or removes masked positions to steer toward a target length. DELTA requires no fine-tuning and is designed for off-the-shelf masked diffusion LMs. Across three summarization benchmarks, it reduces character-length errors by an order of magnitude compared to baselines while maintaining competitive summary quality in both automatic and human evaluation.

AI.tldr: DELTA是一种无需训练的推理时方法，针对掩码扩散语言模型，在去噪每一步估计期望字符长度并动态增删掩码位置，从而将摘要精确控制在目标字符数上。
AI.motivation: 标题、文章预览等场景要求摘要长度严格拟合固定字符空间。自回归语言模型难以精确控制字符长度：基于训练的方法需任务特定微调，零样本提示只能近似达标。
AI.method: 提出DELTA（Diffusion Expected Length Targeting Algorithm），面向现成的掩码扩散语言模型，无需微调；在每个去噪步骤估计期望字符长度，并动态插入或移除掩码位置，将生成长度导向目标值。
AI.result: 在三个摘要基准上，字符长度误差相比基线降低一个数量级，同时在自动评估和人工评估中保持有竞争力的摘要质量。
AI.conclusion: 掩码扩散LM配合推理时长度引导可在不牺牲质量的前提下实现精确字符长度控制，为固定长度摘要提供免训练方案。

title: Risk Control Certifies Rates, Not Magnitudes: An Audit of Selective Fetal Biometry
summary: Prenatal ultrasound biometry must return a head circumference (HC) and refuse when the image cannot support one. Selective prediction trades coverage against error, but its finite-sample guarantees bound the rate of gross errors, not their magnitude. We audit a tool-grounded biometry pipeline on two separately pre-registered four-way splits of the 999 labelled HC18 images, retraining the segmenter three times on each. Calibrating the contour-completeness threshold by exact Clopper-Pearson risk control returns a certificate indistinguishable from a hand-set floor, yet the pipeline still emits a 271.3 mm error: a small, geometrically complete ring fitted to an image whose true HC is 324.6 mm. The accepted candidate scores 0.94 completeness, so the score cannot see the failure, and one outlier among $\approx 150$ answers leaves the certified risk bound ($α= 0.10$) intact. A second, untouched split reproduces the mechanism on a different image (233.3 mm). Constraining the admissibility region---the anatomical range in which the measurand is defined---removes the family instead: raising the lower bound from 50 to 55 mm costs 0.4 coverage points and cuts the worst-case error on both splits to 11.4 and 11.1 mm, whereas suppressing it through the completeness threshold costs 19.0 and 12.1 points. At an anatomically defined 70 mm the frozen tests give 1.91 and 1.81 mm MAE.

AI.tldr: 产前超声头围测量管线虽能用Clopper-Pearson校准实现风险控制，但无法约束误差幅度，需通过解剖学可接受域约束来消除极端误差
AI.motivation: 选择性预测的有限样本保证只约束总错误率而非误差大小，本文探究在头围测量管线中是否存在小概率但幅度极大的灾难性错误，以及如何消除此类错误
AI.method: 在999张HC18标注图像的两个独立预注册四分割上审计工具驱动的测量管线，每组重训分割器三次；用精确Clopper-Pearson风险控制校准轮廓完整性阈值，并对比通过解剖学可接受域（设置头围上下限）与通过完整性阈值抑制错误的效果
AI.result: 校准后的证书与手工阈值无差别，但管线仍输出271.3mm误差（真值324.6mm，完整性得分0.94），一个异常值未破坏α=0.10的风险上限；第二分割复现该机制（233.3mm）。将下界从50升至55mm只损失0.4覆盖率点，却把最坏误差降至11.4/11.1mm；通过完整性阈值抑制则代价19.0/12.1点。解剖学定义70mm时冻结测试MAE为1.91/1.81mm
AI.conclusion: 误差率保证不保证误差幅度，完整性得分无法识别几何完整但解剖学上不合理的环；直接约束解剖学可接受域比通过分数阈值抑制错误更高效，是消除灾难性误差的关键

title: Reward Budgeting Reduces Premature Convergence in Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning
summary: RL for LLM reasoning often reaches an early performance plateau as the policy distribution becomes increasingly sharp. Recent work has studied policy entropy as both a diagnostic and a control signal for this behavior. In our experiments, however, increasing entropy alone does not reliably change the eventual plateau. We analyze RL through its implicit target policy and derive a sharpness factor $κ$, together with an effective counterpart $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$, that describes how strongly reward or advantage gaps are translated into probability-ratio gaps. Motivated by this view, we introduce \emph{reward budgeting}, a plug-in advantage construction that assigns a fixed total reward budget to each prompt. For binary rewards and independent on-policy rollouts, its unclipped score-function estimator follows the gradient of an exact finite-$G$ concave objective with diminishing returns, while its advantage gap decreases as more rollouts become correct. For general rewards, a shifted log-mean interpretation holds asymptotically under the stated regularity conditions. These results motivate, rather than establish exact objective equivalence for, the clipped implementations. On Qwen3-8B and Llama3.2-3B-Instruct, reward budgeting consistently improves a range of RL baselines, with gains up to +12.50 on AMC23 and +10.00 on AIME24 and AIME25. Overall, our results support an update-dynamics view of premature convergence and show that strong gains can be obtained without explicitly preserving entropy.

AI.tldr: 本文从RL的隐式目标策略出发提出"尖锐度因子κ"，并据此设计"奖励预算"(reward budgeting)优势构造方法，在无需显式保持熵的情况下提升LLM推理的RL表现。
AI.motivation: RL用于LLM推理时常因策略分布变得日益尖锐而较早进入性能平台期。已有工作把策略熵当作诊断与控制信号，但作者实验发现单纯提高熵并不能可靠改变最终平台，因此需要从更新动力学角度重新理解早熟收敛。
AI.method: 通过分析RL的隐式目标策略，推导尖锐度因子κ及其有效版本κ_eff，刻画奖励/优势差被转化为概率比差的强度。受此启发提出reward budgeting：一种即插即用的优势构造，为每个prompt分配固定总奖励预算。对二元奖励与独立on-policy采样，其无裁剪score-function估计器是某个精确有限G凹目标（收益递减）的梯度；正确rollout增多时优势差下降。一般奖励下在给定正则条件下有平移对数均值解释。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B与Llama3.2-3B-Instruct上，reward budgeting一致改进多种RL基线，AMC23最高提升+12.50，AIME24和AIME25各提升+10.00。
AI.conclusion: 结果为早熟收敛提供了更新动力学视角，并表明不显式保持熵也能获得显著收益；裁剪实现的目标等价性是被结果所激励而非严格证明的。

title: DualCast: Dual-Image Conditioned Diffusion Transformers for Digital Human E-Commerce Video Generation
summary: Digital human e-commerce video generation requires preserving product appearance, human identity, and overall video style during dynamic demonstrations. Although recent models support multiple reference images, their general conditioning schemes do not explicitly distinguish the asymmetric roles of "what is presented" and "who presents it." Consequently, generated videos may favor a single reference, resulting in product distortion, identity drift, or single-reference collapse. To address this issue, we propose DualCast, a role-addressed dual-image conditioning framework for video generation. By explicitly modeling the distinct roles of product and human conditions, DualCast reduces role ambiguity and feature competition between references. First, a dual-spatiotemporal slot injection mechanism VAE-encodes the product and human images separately and places their latent features at the front and rear boundaries of the DiT sequence, enabling sequence-level condition separation and directed injection. Second, a mask-guided region-weighted loss strengthens supervision over product, face, and product-face overlap regions, improving generation fidelity in critical areas. Third, image condition dropout enables a single model to support dual-image, product-only, and human-only generation. In addition, we construct a curated dataset of 10K e-commerce videos for model training. Experimental results demonstrate the strong performance of DualCast.

AI.tldr: DualCast：面向数字人电商视频生成的角色分离双图条件框架，通过双时空槽注入、掩码区域加权损失与图像条件dropout缓解角色歧义与单参考坍缩。
AI.motivation: 数字人电商视频需同时保持商品外观、人物身份与视频风格，但现有支持多参考图的模型采用通用条件方案，未区分"展示什么"与"谁来展示"的非对称角色，易导致商品形变、身份漂移或单参考坍缩。
AI.method: 提出DualCast框架：(1) 双时空槽注入，对商品图与人物图分别VAE编码，将其潜特征置于DiT序列的前端与后端边界，实现序列级条件分离与定向注入；(2) 掩码引导的区域加权损失，加强对商品区、人脸区及二者重叠区的监督；(3) 图像条件dropout，使单一模型支持双图、仅商品、仅人物三种生成模式。并构建1万条电商视频数据集用于训练。
AI.result: 实验结果表明DualCast性能强劲，有效缓解单参考坍缩，在商品保真度与人物身份一致性上表现优越。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模商品与人物的角色差异并进行序列级条件分离，可有效提升双图条件视频生成的质量，为数字人电商视频生成提供可行方案。

title: Presentation Sensitivity in Typed Decision Models for Subjective Text Evaluation
summary: Typed decision models offer structured choices, scores, and probabilities for low-cost automated evaluation. We present a controlled audit of presentation sensitivity in Jev, Clef Flash, and Perplexity Decider across native choice and score interfaces. Across six datasets with 9,000 multiply annotated humor, helpfulness, and summarization items, we collect 702,000 judgments under interventions that vary positions, identifiers, authorship claims, endorsements, decision framing, and rating rubrics while preserving the evaluated texts. Jev's second-position probability advantage reaches 6.11 percentage points on summaries; reversing reader endorsements changes Perplexity's selected humor text on 40.40% of pairs; and rejection framing reduces Clef's summary agreement with human preferences by 23.36 points. Rating formats also shift score levels while often preserving rankings. Across these findings, repeatability, presentation robustness, and human alignment emerge as distinct properties of an evaluator. Reliable use therefore requires validating the decisions and score interpretations on which an evaluation pipeline depends.

AI.tldr: 本文对Jev、Clef Flash和Perplexity Decider三种带类型的决策模型进行受控审计，在六数据集、702,000次判断中系统改变呈现方式（位置、标识、作者、背书、决策框架、评分量规），揭示位置偏差、背书翻转和框架效应会显著改变判断，说明可重复性、呈现鲁棒性与人类对齐是评估器的三种独立属性。
AI.motivation: 带类型决策模型可用低成本的自动化方式提供选择、分数和概率，便于评估；但其判断是否受无关呈现变化影响尚不清楚，需要系统审计以保证评估管线的可靠性。
AI.method: 对Jev、Clef Flash、Perplexity Decider在其原生选择与分数界面上进行受控审计；使用六个数据集的9,000条多重标注的幽默、有用性和摘要条目，在保持文本不变的前提下施加干预（位置、标识符、作者声明、背书、决策框架、评分量规），共收集702,000条判断。
AI.result: Jev在摘要任务上有6.11个百分点的第二位概率优势；翻转读者背书使Perplexity在40.40%的配对中改选幽默文本；拒绝型框架使Clef的摘要判断与人类偏好的一致度下降23.36个百分点；评分格式会改变分数水平但通常保留排名。
AI.conclusion: 可重复性、呈现鲁棒性和人类对齐是评估器的三种不同属性；可靠使用需针对评估管线实际依赖的决策与分数解释进行验证。

title: Auditable Unlearning for LLMs
summary: Machine unlearning aims to remove a user's data from a trained model after a deletion request. Existing methods are majorly evaluated on three axes - how well they forget, how much capability they retain, and how robust they are to membership inference attacks, but not on whether the provider can offer the user any evidence that the deletion occurred. To fill this gap, we introduce auditability as a fourth axis, defined as the separation between requested (forget set) and retained (retain set) data under a statistic the provider computes. We show that across eleven unlearning methods on TOFU, MUSE and RWKU no method satisfies all four axes, with different methods falling short on different axes. To address this, we propose a two stage method that can be used on top of any unlearning method, in the the first stage we propose ${GapWiden}$ which uses a hinge loss to increase the difference between audit statistics of forget set and retain set. In the second stage we propose ${GapVeil}$, an inference time rejection-sampler which uses the base model as the drafter and re-samples based on the audit statistics of the drafted response. We observe that using our method, auditability and leakage reach oracle parity for every unlearning method, and forget performance converges to the oracle; retain performance improves for nine of eleven methods but remains short of parity. Our results show that evidence of deletion or auditability can be constructed by design, and that treating it as an explicit requirement changes the viability of existing unlearning methods.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将“可审计性”作为机器遗忘的第四评价维度，指在提供方计算的统计量下能区分遗忘集与保留集；实验显示TOFU/MUSE/RWKU上11种遗忘方法均无法同时满足四维要求，作者提出两阶段方法GapWiden+GapVeil，使可审计性与泄漏达到oracle水平。
AI.motivation: 现有遗忘方法主要从三个方面评估：遗忘程度、能力保留程度以及对成员推断攻击的鲁棒性，但都没有评估提供方能否向用户提供删除确实发生的证据。作者填补这一空白，把可审计性作为第四个评估维度。
AI.method: 提出一个可叠加在任何遗忘方法之上的两阶段方法：第一阶段GapWiden使用hinge损失增大遗忘集与保留集审计统计量之间的差异；第二阶段GapVeil是推理时的拒绝采样器，以基模型为drafter，根据草稿回复的审计统计量进行重采样。
AI.result: 在TOFU、MUSE、RWKU上评估11种遗忘方法，发现没有任何方法满足全部四个维度，不同方法在不同维度上存在不足。使用所提方法后，每种遗忘方法的可审计性与泄漏均达到oracle parity，遗忘性能收敛到oracle；11种方法中9种的保留性能有所提升，但仍未达到parity。
AI.conclusion: 删除证据/可审计性可以通过设计被构造出来；将其作为显式要求会改变现有遗忘方法的可行性判断。

title: On the Design of Hyper-Connections: Simplification, Stability, and Scalability
summary: Hyper-Connections (HC) architectures are increasingly adopted in frontier language models, yet their components remain insufficiently understood and introduce non-negligible training overhead. In this work, we systematically study the HC architecture to understand its components and identify simpler, more efficient designs. We find that learned read/write gating without mixing and unconstrained mixing with fixed gates form two effective interaction groups: either alone achieves performance comparable to mHC. We also identify repeated access to the expanded residual state as a major source of training overhead, even without mixing. These findings lead to SimpleHC, which simplifies the architecture by removing residual mixing and simplifies execution through shared memory access, using the resulting additive structure and shared gate inputs. Layer-specific gates share a group-entry state, enabling batched reads and deferred writes; scalar corrections exactly preserve preceding sublayer output contributions. Our analyses support both the retained residual structure and the design of shared memory access. SimpleHC incurs only 2.4% extra end-to-end training time over a vanilla residual baseline at the largest tested scale. It maintains performance comparable to mHC when scaling from 15B to 30B MoE models, exhibits smoother gradient dynamics during standard training, and remains stable under stress. We hope SimpleHC will encourage a broader pursuit of simplicity in foundation model design, making performance gains more accessible and practical at scale.

AI.tldr: 论文系统分析 Hyper-Connections (HC) 架构，发现读/写门控学习与固定门混合这两种交互各自即可媲美 mHC，且对扩展残差状态的重复访问是主要训练开销；据此提出 SimpleHC，去除残差混合、以共享内存实现批式读与延迟写，最大规模仅增 2.4% 训练时间，性能与 mHC 相当。
AI.motivation: HC 架构在前沿语言模型中被越来越多采用，但其组件理解不足且带来不可忽视的训练开销，因此需要弄清各组件作用并寻找更简单高效的替代设计。
AI.method: 将 HC 拆解为交互组件进行分析，识别出两个有效交互组（无混合的可学习读/写门控；固定门控的约束混合）；指出重复访问扩展残差状态是开销主因；提出 SimpleHC：移除残差混合，利用加性结构与共享门输入实现共享内存访问，层级门共享组入口状态以支持批式读取和延迟写入，标量校正精确保持前序子层输出贡献。
AI.result: SimpleHC 在最大测试规模端到端训练时间仅比 vanilla 残差基线多 2.4%；15B 到 30B MoE 规模下性能与 mHC 相当，标准训练中梯度动态更平滑，压力测试下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 分析支持保留的残差结构与共享内存访问设计；SimpleHC 表明基础模型设计可在不牺牲性能的前提下追求简洁，使规模化性能收益更易实现与推广。

title: Generative AI for urban planning: synthesizing land-use maps with satellite imagery via DualControlNet
summary: Various land-use models characterize land-use patterns and facilitate scenario planning. However, existing models are largely predictive, forecasting transitions based on numeric data without synthesizing new land-use maps from simple text prompts. Meanwhile, generative AI in urban systems remains unimodal, weakly controllable, and evaluated mostly by generic image quality rather than domain-specific metrics. To address these gaps, we introduce DualControlNet, a generative land-use model that jointly synthesizes high-resolution land-use maps and satellite imagery, addressing multimodality, controllability, and verification challenges. Trained on over 40,000 paired tiles from Orlando and Chicago, DualControlNet is evaluated using land-use, spatial consistency, and image quality metrics. Relative to unimodal baselines, DualControlNet improves land-use diversity consistency by 62.8% and building coverage ratio consistency by 16.3%, more than doubles cross-modal spatial consistency, and triples visual quality. Scenario-based experiments demonstrate that DualControlNet supports sustainable development through multidimensional controls, increasing density and diversity, and responding to text prompts like "high-density development." Overall, this work advances land-use modeling via a multimodal, controllable, and verifiable generative framework, lowering technical barriers and enabling intuitive exploration of urban futures.

AI.tldr: 提出DualControlNet，一个从文本提示联合生成高分辨率土地利用图和卫星影像的多模态可控生成模型，提升土地利用建模的可控性与可验证性。
AI.motivation: 现有土地利用模型多为预测式，依赖数值数据、无法由简单文本提示合成新土地利用图；城市系统生成式AI仍单模态、可控性弱、且只用通用图像质量而非领域指标评估。
AI.method: DualControlNet联合生成土地利用图与卫星影像；在奥兰多与芝加哥4万余对瓦片数据上训练；用土地利用、空间一致性与图像质量三类指标评估；支持多维控制与文本提示驱动的场景实验。
AI.result: 相比单模态基线，土地利用多样性一致性提升62.8%，建筑覆盖率一致性提升16.3%，跨模态空间一致性提升一倍以上，视觉质量提升三倍；场景实验显示可提高密度与多样性并响应"高密度开发"等文本提示。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过多模态、可控、可验证的生成框架推进土地利用建模，降低技术门槛，支持直观探索城市未来与可持续发展。
