AI.method: 以整合后的 BF16 Qwen3-VL-4B 为教师，构建非对称 INT2 学生：采用 GPTQ 初始化，并进行教师引导的量化恢复；对视觉编码器与语言主干的投影权重联合量化与恢复，实现整模型激进压缩。
AI.result: 在四个异构具身任务（姿态识别、家庭安全理解、多模态对话路由、移动 GUI 动作预测）上，权重存储由 8.9GB 降至 2.1GB（约减 76%）；INT2 宏任务分数较 GPTQ-INT2 提升 34.3 个百分点，与整合后的 BF16 教师相差不到 0.9 分。
AI.conclusion: 教师引导的视觉-语言联合 INT2 恢复具有可行性，可在资源受限的具身平台上部署单一多技能 VLM。

title: PRISM-AMC: Replay-Free Continual Learning for Automatic Modulation Classification
summary: Automatic modulation classification (AMC) is a key component of cognitive wireless systems, enabling spectrum awareness and adaptive communication. Most deep learning approaches to AMC assume a fixed set of modulation classes and access to previously observed training data. In practice, modulation classes and channel conditions may evolve over time, while storage or data-retention constraints may preclude replay of raw baseband I/Q samples. We propose PRISM-AMC, a replay-free continual learning framework that mitigates catastrophic forgetting by preserving task-relevant subspaces of intermediate representations via gradient projection memory. We further analyze projected stochastic-gradient updates under an SNR-dependent gradient-noise model. PRISM-AMC is evaluated in both class-incremental and domain-incremental settings. Experiments on the MIGOU and DeepSig 2018.01A datasets show substantially reduced forgetting relative to sequential fine-tuning and elastic weight consolidation, while remaining competitive with or outperforming replay-based RSD-AMC in class-incremental settings, without storing raw I/Q samples.

AI.tldr: PRISM-AMC：一种无回放的持续学习框架，通过梯度投影记忆保留中间表示中与任务相关的子空间，抑制灾难性遗忘，并分析了SNR相关梯度噪声下的投影SGD更新。
AI.motivation: 多数深度学习AMC方法假设调制类别固定且可访问历史训练数据；实际中调制类别与信道条件随时间演变，而存储/数据保留限制可能禁止回放原始基带I/Q样本。
AI.method: 提出PRISM-AMC，利用梯度投影记忆保存中间表示的任务相关子空间以实现无回放持续学习；并在SNR相关的梯度噪声模型下分析投影随机梯度更新；在类增量和域增量两种设置下评估。数据集为MIGOU与DeepSig 2018.01A。
AI.result: 相比顺序微调和弹性权重巩固（EWC），遗忘显著降低；在类增量设置下与基于回放的RSD-AMC相当或更优，且无需存储原始I/Q样本。
AI.conclusion: PRISM-AMC为受存储约束的动态无线环境下AMC提供了一种有效的无回放持续学习方案。

title: FedIA: Instance-Aware Cross-Modal Representations for Federated Prompt Learning
summary: Federated Prompt Learning (FPL) enables parameter-efficient adaptation of pre-trained Vision-Language Models across decentralized clients without exchanging raw data. To cope with cross-client heterogeneity, existing FPL methods typically pair a globally shared prompt with a client-specific local prompt. However, this design personalizes only at the client level: the same local prompt is applied to all samples of a client, and the global and local prompts are combined in an input-agnostic, fixed manner. Consequently, it overlooks the substantial visual variations among samples within the same client and cannot adjust the balance between shared and personalized knowledge to each input. To address these limitations, we propose Federated Prompt Learning with Instance-Aware Cross-Modal Representations (FedIA), an FPL framework that learns instance-aware cross-modal representations. Specifically, FedIA first uses global text prompts as client-invariant semantic anchors to select image patches most relevant to each candidate class, suppressing distracting regions. The selected visual evidence then conditions the generation of instance-aware local text representations. Finally, an adaptive global-local fusion module calibrates the contributions of local and global text representations for each image-class pair. In this way, FedIA shifts personalization in FPL from the client level to the instance level while preserving the semantic knowledge shared across clients. Extensive experiments under domain shift, pathological label skew, and Dirichlet-based label skew show that FedIA outperforms FPL baselines, with maximum accuracy gains of 1.44\%-4.37\% over the latest baseline across the three settings. Ablation studies and analyses further verify the complementary contributions of instance-aware representation generation and adaptive global-local fusion.

AI.tldr: 提出FedIA，将联邦提示学习(FPL)的个性化从客户端级推进到实例级，通过实例感知的跨模态表示与自适应全局-局部融合，提升异构数据下的泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有FPL方法将全局共享提示与客户端本地提示组合，但这种设计只在客户端级别个性化：同一本地提示应用于客户端所有样本，且全局与局部提示以输入无关的固定方式融合。这忽略了客户内部样本间的视觉差异，也无法针对每个输入调整共享与个性化知识的平衡。
AI.method: FedIA框架包含三步：(1)以全局文本提示作为客户端不变的语义锚点，为每个候选类别选取最相关的图像patch，抑制干扰区域；(2)用选出的视觉证据条件化生成实例感知的局部文本表示；(3)自适应全局-局部融合模块，为每个图像-类别对校准局部与全局文本表示的贡献。
AI.result: 在域偏移、病态标签偏斜和Dirichlet标签偏斜三种设置下，FedIA均优于FPL基线，相对最新基线最高精度提升为1.44%–4.37%。消融实验与分析验证了实例感知表示生成与自适应全局-局部融合的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: FedIA将FPL中的个性化从客户端级转变为实例级，同时保留跨客户端共享的语义知识，是提升联邦提示学习异构适应能力的有效方案。

title: Replicability, Reproducibility, and Robustness in Political and Social Science Research with Large Language Models
comment: Chapter 5 of "LLMs in Political and Social Science: Principles and Applications of Transformer Models," Oxford University Press, forthcoming 2027. Data and code: https://github.com/llms-political-social-science-book-oup/book-code-data
summary: This chapter addresses the central reproducibility problem of research with large language models. LLM output is probabilistic and varies across models and versions, which can have significant effects on downstream statistical results. The chapter distinguishes between replicability, reproducibility, and robustness, and proposes a probabilistic standard based on the distribution of results, not identical outputs. It introduces a standardized prompt script, tests within-model variation for encoders and decoders, and develops error-structure analysis to diagnose where models err and whether their errors align. Using three datasets, the chapter shows that measurement choice can reverse the sign of downstream regression coefficients. Existing design-based corrections with gold-labeled subsamples restore validity, but come at the cost of estimate precision. The main contribution of the chapter is a stacked ensemble of open-weight models that improves precision in the correction step while retaining estimate validity.

AI.tldr: 本章针对LLM研究中的可复现性问题，提出基于结果分布的概率性标准，并用堆叠集成开放权重模型来提升纠正步骤的精度。
AI.motivation: LLM输出是概率性的，会随模型和版本变化，进而显著影响下游统计结果，因此需要解决以LLM为测量工具的研究可复现性问题。
AI.method: 区分可复制性、可复现性与稳健性；提出基于结果分布的（而非输出完全一致的）概率性标准；引入标准化提示脚本；对编码器与解码器检验模型内变异；开发误差结构分析以诊断模型出错位置及误差是否一致；在三个数据集上开展实验；采用带金标注子样本的既有设计型纠正，并提出开放权重模型的堆叠集成。
AI.result: 测量选择可逆转下游回归系数的符号；既有设计型纠正能恢复有效性，但牺牲估计精度；堆叠集成在保持估计有效性的同时提升了纠正步骤的精度。
AI.conclusion: LLM测量的不确定性会实质影响统计推断；应以概率性分布标准评估可复现性，堆叠集成是兼顾有效性与精度的可行方案。

title: Catastrophic Overfitting is Weight Drift the Training Loss Cannot See
comment: 12 pages (including appendix), 7 figures, 6 tables. Code available at https://github.com/fzjcdt/co-weight-drift
summary: Fast adversarial training (FAT) makes robust training affordable by replacing the multi-step attack with a single-step one, but it suffers from catastrophic overfitting (CO): partway through training, robustness to multi-step attacks collapses to near zero while the single-step attack used for training keeps being repelled. We show that CO is a quiet escape of the weights. Across the event the network's clean behavior quietly improves, and moving from the weights just before CO to those just after it changes the training objective only marginally while destroying most of the robustness. The training objective is therefore nearly blind to the displacement it causes, so it exerts no force to undo it. The exponential moving average (EMA) of the weights, which FAT protocols already maintain, does not accumulate this drift and stays robust through the entire event. This observation suggests a nearly free fix: when validation robustness drops, reset the weights to their EMA. We build this guard on top of a coupling-based base method designed so that its average stays inside the robust region. The resulting training removes CO in every one of our runs and attains the strongest AutoAttack accuracy among fast methods on all three benchmark datasets, including a clear margin on CIFAR-100, where it also clears the multi-step reference at roughly half its cost. Code is available at https://github.com/fzjcdt/co-weight-drift.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示快速对抗训练(FAT)中的灾难性过拟合(CO)本质是权重的"悄无声息逃逸"，并提出用已有EMA权重在验证鲁棒性下降时回滚的近乎零成本修复方案。
AI.motivation: FAT用单步攻击替代多步攻击以降低鲁棒训练成本，但会出现灾难性过拟合(CO)：训练中途对多步攻击的鲁棒性骤降至接近零，而训练用的单步攻击仍被抵御。作者希望理解CO的机制并低成本消除它。
AI.method: 将CO刻画为权重的安静逃逸：CO前后干净的精度悄悄提升，且仅发生极小位移，训练目标对这种位移几乎不敏感，因而无法产生"回拉"的力量。FAT协议中本就维护的权重指数滑动平均(EMA)不累积这种漂移，在整个事件期间保持鲁棒。据此构造一个基于耦合(coupling)的基础方法，使迭代平均保持在鲁棒区域内，并在验证鲁棒性下降时把权重重置为EMA作为守护机制。
AI.result: 在所有运行中均消除CO；在三个基准数据集上取得快速方法中最强的AutoAttack精度；在CIFAR-100上有明显优势，并以约一半成本超过多步参考方法。
AI.conclusion: CO源于训练目标对权重漂移的"盲区"，而EMA权重的回滚是近乎免费的可靠修复。将该守护机制与耦合式基础方法结合，可稳定消除CO并获得很强的鲁棒性能，代码已开源。

title: Intra-Architecture Source Attribution for Stable Diffusion: A New Task with Benchmark Dataset and Baseline
comment: Accepted at IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision(WACV 2027)
summary: Designing systems that attribute a generated image to its source model has lately become a major area of AI research. Most existing datasets and systems related to image source attribution are targeted towards the detection of architectural signatures of the source models. Distinct from this, focusing on stable diffusion, we introduce a novel task, IntrAA-SD, Intra-Architecture source Attribution for Stable Diffusion, where the source models to be differentiated share the same architectural backbone and differ only due to fine-tuning. The proposed task aligns with the emergence of fine-tuned generators having the same architecture, like Juggernaut XL and RealVis XL, which are fine-tuned versions of Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL). We provide a first-of-its-kind $140$K-image benchmark dataset containing images generated from different fine-tunes of SDXL, along with in-domain and out-of-distribution prompts. We also provide a baseline framework for IntrAA-SD, which leverages a style-conditioned Mixture-of-Experts network. It uses a frozen CLIP backbone to capture the image style and gate the MoE, which processes fine-tuned trace features from a high-resolution LoRA-adapted DINOv2 network. The fine-tuned models used, the prompting strategies considered, and the formation details employed in the novel dataset are elaborated. Our baseline intra-architecture source attribution method is evaluated in terms of attribution accuracy on our dataset, and ablation studies are also performed. Code and dataset is available at https://github.com/mallikagarg/IntrAA-SD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出新任务IntrAA-SD——面向Stable Diffusion的同架构来源归因，即区分架构骨干相同、仅因微调而不同的源模型，并发布140K图像基准数据集与基于风格条件MoE的基线框架。
AI.motivation: 现有图像来源归因数据集与系统多针对源模型的架构签名检测，无法应对同一架构下微调生成器（如Juggernaut XL、RealVis XL均为SDXL微调版）日益普遍的现状，因此需要同架构内的来源归因能力。
AI.method: 构建首个140K图像基准数据集，含不同SDXL微调版本的生成图像及域内与分布外提示词；提出基线框架：用冻结CLIP骨干捕捉图像风格并门控Mixture-of-Experts网络，MoE处理来自高分辨率LoRA适配DINOv2网络的微调痕迹特征。文中还详述所用微调模型、提示策略与数据集构成细节。
AI.result: 基线方法在自建数据集上以归因准确率进行评估，并开展消融实验验证各组件作用。
AI.conclusion: 论文确立了同架构来源归因这一新任务方向，通过数据集与风格条件MoE基线为该问题提供首个基准，代码与数据集已开源。

title: ALTO: African and Levantine Tech-Facilitated Gender-Based Violence Corpus
comment: 8 pages main body, 10 pages appendix, 1 figure
summary: Tech-facilitated gender based violence (TFGBV) is a pervasive online harm affecting women and gender minority groups through its many direct and covert forms. Current models and annotated datasets for gendered harm detection are dominated by data from, and models trained in, Global North languages. In collaboration with civil society organizations (CSOs) from Jordan, Francophone West Africa, and Kenya, we developed a community-led approach to crowdsource culturally and linguistically relevant instances of TFGBV in Levantine Arabic, African French, and Swahili. We annotated the crowdsourced data using active learning to develop a small but performant dataset (N=3022) called ALTO to improve TFGBV detection in the three languages. Through benchmarking and fine-tuning experiments, we show that existing harmful content detection models show poor TFGBV recall within ALTO and improve with fine-tuning. We found that models often miss covert harms across all languages, while error rates are markedly higher in Swahili. We report the experimental results and release the annotation taxonomy, dataset, and trained models.

AI.tldr: 本文通过与约旦、西非法语区和肯尼亚的民间社会组织合作，采用社区主导的众包方法收集并标注黎凡特阿拉伯语、非洲法语和斯瓦希里语的技术辅助性别暴力（TFGBV）实例，使用主动学习构建小型但高效的数据集 ALTO（N=3022），用于提升三种语言的 TFGBV 检测能力。
AI.motivation: TFGBV 是一种普遍的网络危害，直接影响女性和性别少数群体，形式包括显性和隐蔽两类。然而现有的性别化危害检测模型与标注数据集主要由全球北方语言（如英语）主导，缺乏全球南方语言和文化语境下的数据，导致这些语言中的 TFGBV 检测效果不佳。
AI.method: 与约旦、西非法语区、肯尼亚的 CSO 合作，采用社区主导的众包方式获取文化和语言相关的 TFGBV 实例；通过主动学习进行标注，构建 ALTO 数据集（N=3022）；并进行基准测试和微调实验，对比现有有害内容检测模型在 ALTO 上的表现。
AI.result: 现有有害内容检测模型在 ALTO 上的 TFGBV 召回率偏低，经微调后有所提升；模型普遍难以识别隐蔽性危害（跨所有语言），而斯瓦希里语的错误率明显更高。
AI.conclusion: 社区主导的众包与主动学习可以高效构建多语言 TFGBV 数据集并改善检测效果；作者公开标注分类体系、数据集和训练模型，以推动该领域在低资源语言和全球南方语境下的研究。

title: Beyond Risk Cues: A Mechanism-Level Benchmark and Verifiable Debate for Scam Video Detection on the Web
summary: Online scam videos pose significant threats to individuals and society. Existing studies primarily focus on binary classification, offering limited insights into how scams work and the reasoning behind detection decisions. Moreover, they often overlook the challenge of distinguishing scam videos from superficially similar non-scam content, such as advertisements, and the robustness of detection models against misleading arguments. These limitations hinder reliable scam video detection. To address these limitations, we introduce MechScam, a benchmark comprising 6,614 videos covering diverse scam mechanisms and non-scam categories. MechScam provides explanations supported by video evidence, annotations of potential scam elements and their context, and misleading arguments constructed from genuine evidence. Recognizing that genuine evidence can still be used to justify misleading conclusions, we further propose ScamCourt, a debate framework in which trained prosecution and defense debaters present opposing arguments, while a trained judge makes decisions based on a transcript with verified citations. Extensive experiments show that state-of-the-art MLLMs struggle to distinguish scam videos from similar non-scam content. ScamCourt outperforms larger MLLMs and same-backbone fine-tuned baselines, reducing false positives and showing stronger resistance to misleading arguments. Together, MechScam and ScamCourt contribute to more reliable and interpretable scam video detection. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/SuperYFan/MechScam.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MechScam基准（6,614个视频，覆盖多种诈骗机制与非诈骗类别，含证据支持的解释、诈骗要素及语境标注、由真实证据构造的误导性论证）和ScamCourt辩论框架（控辩双方辩论、法官依据带核验引用的记录裁决），显著降低误报并提升对误导性论证的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多为二分类，解释性弱；忽视诈骗视频与广告等表面相似内容的区分难题，以及模型对误导性论证的鲁棒性问题，导致检测不可靠。
AI.method: 构建MechScam基准数据集，提供视频证据支持的解释、诈骗要素与语境标注、基于真实证据的误导性论证；提出ScamCourt辩论框架：训练控方与辩方辩手各陈其词，由训练有素的法官基于带核验引用的庭审记录做出判定。
AI.result: 实验显示SOTA MLLM难以区分诈骗视频与相似非诈骗内容；ScamCourt优于更大规模MLLM及同骨干微调基线，降低误报并更强抵抗误导性论证。
AI.conclusion: MechScam与ScamCourt共同推动更可靠、可解释的诈骗视频检测，数据与代码已开源。

title: Shallow Encoding Emits Deep Memories
comment: 47 pages. Mingyuan Ma and Yangmin Li contributed equally
summary: Hybrid language models interleave a few softmax-attention layers with many linear-attention or state-space layers, so every layer keeps a memory of earlier tokens: a key-value cache or a fixed-size recurrent state. Serving them spends more compute and high-bandwidth memory on these memories than the output requires. The prefill runs every layer for every prompt token, and every decode step loads and stores whole recurrent states, which on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next take as many bytes per request as the attention cache of thousands of tokens. We find two properties of trained hybrids that locate this excess. First, writes are easier than reads: writing a deep layer's memory of a token needs little of the deep computation that predicting the next token needs. Trained copies of the deep layers' write paths, which we call emitters, therefore write a prompt's deep memories from the residual stream of a shallower anchor layer, and all prompt tokens but the last run as few as 63% of the layers. Second, recurrent states have a state sink: most of their energy lies in a rank-one term along a fixed direction of each head, and the rest is a low-rank working memory. SEED builds on both: it makes the prefill shallow in depth and the decode state shallow in representation. Each recurrent state is stored as its sink plus low-rank factors, which the Gated DeltaNet, Kimi Delta Attention and Mamba-2 updates extend exactly; we prove that the open-loop error of the periodic compressions back to low rank is bounded independently of their number. SEED keeps the original weights frozen, compresses no attention cache, and runs all layers for every generated token. On six checkpoints of five production hybrids of 30B to over 300B parameters, it is nearly lossless on eleven official exams. Served with SGLang on NVIDIA GB300 GPUs on an agentic-coding trace, it raises the per-GPU throughput of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 1.2-1.4x.

AI.tldr: SEED利用混合语言模型的"写易读难"与"状态汇"两大性质，在保持权重冻结的前提下实现深度稀疏的prefill与低秩表示的decode状态存储，在30B–300B+的生产级混合模型上近无损且提升吞吐1.2–1.4倍。
AI.motivation: 混合模型（softmax注意力+线性注意力/状态空间层）每层都需保存记忆（KV缓存或固定大小递归状态）。服务时，prefill对每个prompt token运行全部层，decode每步加载/存储整个递归状态，计算与高带宽内存开销超过输出所需，是主要的冗余来源。
AI.method: 基于两个观察：(1) 写比读容易——用训练好的浅层"发射器"(emitter)从较浅锚点层的残差流写出深层记忆，除最后一个token外所有prompt token只跑少至63%的层；(2) 递归状态存在"状态汇"(state sink)：能量集中在每头固定方向的秩一项，其余为低秩工作记忆。SEED将每个递归状态存为汇项加低秩因子，并让Gated DeltaNet、Kimi Delta Attention与Mamba-2的更新精确作用于该表示；证明了周期压缩回低秩的开环误差与压缩次数无关的有界性。权重冻结，不压缩注意力缓存，每个生成token仍运行全部层。
AI.result: 在五个生产级混合模型的六个checkpoint（30B至300B+参数）上，于11项官方考试上几乎无损。在NVIDIA GB300上用SGLang服务，agentic-coding trace下Qwen3.8-Flash-Next的每GPU吞吐提升1.2–1.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过让prefill在深度上变浅、decode状态在表示上变浅，SEED在不改变模型权重和注意机制的前提下，显著降低混合模型服务中的冗余计算与内存开销，并保持任务精度，具备良好的实用价值。

title: MotoVerse: A Benchmark for Predictive Perception of Motorized Two-Wheelers in Dense Unstructured Traffic
summary: Motorized Two-Wheelers (MTWs) dominate personal transport across much of the Global South, yet remain largely overlooked in predictive perception research for autonomous driving and ADAS. We introduce MotoVerse, a benchmark for predictive perception from an MTW's ego-centric perspective. MotoVerse comprises 949 maneuver clips collected in dense, unstructured traffic and trajectory annotations for over 31,000 surrounding road agents, including over 16,000 MTWs, enabling two complementary tasks: Ego-Rider Maneuver Anticipation (ERMA) and Traffic Agent Trajectory Prediction (TATP). Each clip is further annotated with an MTW-specific challenge taxonomy comprising dynamic ego-motion, weak traffic structure and contextual occlusion, enabling challenge-aware evaluation. We benchmark established conventional prediction models, general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs), driving-specific VLMs and vision-language-action models. Our experiments reveal three key insights: (i) video backbones reach most of their full-observation accuracy from the first fifth of a maneuver, whereas zero-shot VLMs need most of the maneuver to be observed; (ii) zero-shot VLMs, whether general-purpose or driving-specific, largely remain close to simple baselines on both tasks; a preliminary LoRA study shows that adaptation lifts anticipation sharply but leaves trajectory prediction behind conventional models; and (iii) the rider's own motion drives forecasting difficulty: for every model, including a static baseline, errors are highest during left turns and rise under dynamic ego-motion. We believe MotoVerse will serve as a challenging benchmark for safer and more robust predictive AI for intelligent two-wheelers. The dataset and evaluation code are publicly available at https://github.com/VarunIIITH/MotoVerse.

AI.tldr: 提出MotoVerse基准，从摩托车第一人称视角做预测性感知，含949段机动片段与3.1万+交通参与者轨迹标注，评测ERMA与TATP两任务，揭示视频骨干早期即可达高精度、零样本VLM接近简单基线、以及自车动态（尤其左转）主导预测难度。
AI.motivation: 摩托车（MTW）在全球南方个人出行中占主导，但在自动驾驶与ADAS的预测性感知研究中长期被忽视；缺乏从骑手视角、面向非结构化密集交通的基准与挑战性评测。
AI.method: 构建MotoVerse数据集：949段密集非结构化交通中的机动片段，标注超31,000个周围交通参与者轨迹（含16,000+摩托车），支持Ego-Rider Maneuver Anticipation（ERMA）与Traffic Agent Trajectory Prediction（TATP）两任务；每段标注MTW专属挑战分类（动态自车运动、弱交通结构、上下文遮挡）以支持挑战感知评测。基准测试传统预测模型、通用VLM、驾驶专用VLM及VLA模型，并做初步LoRA适配研究。
AI.result: (i) 视频骨干仅用机动前1/5即可达到接近全观测精度，零样本VLM则需观测大部分机动；(ii) 零样本VLM（通用或驾驶专用）在两任务上接近简单基线，LoRA适配显著提升机动预判但轨迹预测仍落后于传统模型；(iii) 骑手自身运动决定预测难度，所有模型（含静态基线）在左转时误差最高，动态自车运动下误差上升。
AI.conclusion: MotoVerse为智能两轮车提供具有挑战性的预测性AI基准，促进更安全鲁棒的感知预测研究；数据集与评测代码已公开。

title: Reasoning over Non-Parametric Memory in Multilingual LLMs: A Cognitive-Based Analysis of Relational Knowledge
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assumes that language models can reason over relations stated in their context rather than fall back on associations memorized during pretraining. We study this evidence-conditioned relational reasoning in isolation, with the facts supplied directly in the prompt rather than retrieved. \textsc{Rel-Bloom} is a controlled multilingual diagnostic of 450 multiple-choice questions built from 30 Wikidata relations; the same source relations are instantiated at five Bloom-inspired levels (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate) and under three veracity conditions (Factual, Counterfactual, Neutralized). Across 43 models, six languages, and two multilingual settings (226,800 predictions), three findings stand out. First, accuracy drops sharply from Apply to Analyze in every evaluated open-weight model series, reaching 47.2 percentage points for the Large Granite bucket, but not for either Gemini model. Second, Evaluate items remain a bottleneck even for models near ceiling on the other task types: Gemini~3.1 Pro averages 99.5\% on the other four levels but 60.7\% on Evaluate. Third, item- and relation-level difficulty rankings are consistently preserved across languages, indicating a difficulty structure partly shared across languages within this benchmark. Across knowledge conditions, Counterfactual contexts are generally harder than Factual ones, while removing entity identities can improve higher-level performance in some model regimes. Greater model capability therefore does not by itself ensure reliable reasoning over supplied relational evidence. Relevant resources are available at: https://huggingface.co/spaces/QCRI/non-parametric-memory-relational-reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出 Rel-Bloom 多语言诊断基准，用 30 个 Wikidata 关系构造 450 题、五级认知层次（Remember→Evaluate）与三种真实性条件（事实/反事实/去实体化），在 43 个模型、6 种语言、226,800 次预测上评估"证据条件化关系推理"，发现高能力并不等于可靠推理。
AI.motivation: RAG 假设语言模型能依据上下文中的关系进行推理，而非依赖预训练记忆的联想。作者希望在不涉及检索环节的干扰下，单独考察这种"证据条件化关系推理"能力，检验模型是否真正使用提示中给出的事实。
AI.method: 构建受控多语言基准 Rel-Bloom：基于 30 个 Wikidata 关系实例化 450 道多选题，覆盖五个 Bloom 启发式认知层次（Remember、Understand、Apply、Analyze、Evaluate）与三种真实性条件（Factual、Counterfactual、Neutralized），事实直接给在提示中；对 43 个模型、6 种语言、两种多语言设置共 226,800 次预测进行评测，并分析题目与关系层面的难度排序跨语言一致性。
AI.result: （1）所有受评开源模型系列从 Apply 到 Analyze 准确率骤降（Large Granite 桶达 47.2 个百分点），而 Gemini 两代模型无此现象；（2）Evaluate 层级是普遍瓶颈，Gemini 3.1 Pro 其余四层平均 99.5%，Evaluate 仅 60.7%；（3）题目与关系难度排序在各语言间一致保持，说明难度结构部分跨语言共享；反事实上下文通常难于事实上下文，而去除实体身份在某些模型情形下能提升高层级表现。
AI.conclusion: 更强的模型能力本身并不能保证对给定关系证据的可靠推理；RAG 的有效性前提在现有模型上并不稳固，需要专门针对高层级（尤其 Evaluate）与反事实条件下的证据推理进行改进。

title: From Handcrafted to Generative: RLVR-Optimized Icon Generation for Alexa+
summary: Alexa+ devices with screens display animated icons during conversations to visually reinforce what is being said. The original set of these icons was hand-drawn by designers one at a time, a process that produces polished results but is time-consuming and cannot scale to the range of topics encountered in open-ended conversation. We describe an automated pipeline, deployed in production, that generates these vectorised animated icons from a text description alone and surfaces relevant animations to customers based on their ongoing conversation. The pipeline decomposes icon creation into a sequence of stages (image generation, semantic decomposition, vectorisation, styling, and animation). Its quality is determined at the very first of these, image generation, on which every downstream stage depends. We therefore focus on improving this first and most critical stage. Because the icons are rendered on small display canvases under strict design guidelines, generations are often unsuitable for production. Supervised fine-tuning is not viable, as no dataset of line-art icons exists under these constraints. Instead, we design objective verifiers that automatically flag generations violating the design guidelines, and use them to fine-tune a flow matching image generation model via reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR). The fine-tuned model raises the pass rate from 15.7% to 58.7% (3.7x) under a VLM judge that is independent of the reward model. Both the trained model and the verifier are deployed in the production pipeline, where the verifier also serves as the automated quality gate before final design review.

AI.tldr: 为带屏Alexa+设备自动生成符合设计规范的矢量动画图标：将图标生成分解为多阶段流水线，聚焦最关键的图像生成阶段，用客观验证器构建可验证奖励，对flow matching模型做RLVR微调，通过率从15.7%提升到58.7%（3.7x），模型与验证器均已上线生产。
AI.motivation: 原图标由设计师逐个手绘，效果精良但耗时且无法覆盖开放式对话的广泛话题；图标需在小尺寸画布与严格设计规范下渲染，直接生成结果常不可用，而此类线稿图标又无现成数据集可用，无法做监督微调。
AI.method: 自动化流水线将图标创作拆为图像生成、语义分解、矢量化、样式化、动画五个阶段，并依据对话内容检索相关动画；质量瓶颈在第一阶段图像生成。由于缺乏数据，作者设计客观验证器自动标记违反设计规范的生成结果，将其作为可验证奖励，用RLVR微调flow matching图像生成模型。
AI.result: 经独立于奖励模型的VLM评审，微调后通过率由15.7%升至58.7%（3.7倍）；训练模型与验证器均部署于生产流水线，验证器还作为最终设计评审前的自动质量关卡。
AI.conclusion: 以客观验证器提供奖励的RLVR可在无监督数据条件下有效提升受严格约束的线稿图标生成质量，并支撑端到端自动化图标生产落地。

title: Learning When to Think Aloud in Latent Reasoning
summary: Latent Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning improves efficiency by shifting intermediate computation into continuous hidden states. However, fully latent methods often struggle on precision-critical tasks such as mathematical reasoning, while existing hybrid approaches retain substantial token-generation overhead. We introduce VITAL, an importance-guided hybrid reasoning framework that selectively verbalizes informative tokens as reasoning anchors while keeping most computation latent. A lightweight gating head dynamically selects between explicit token generation and direct hidden-state feedback. VITAL constructs hybrid trajectories from explicit CoT using token- importance estimation and trains the model through curriculum-based supervised training, followed by reinforcement learning with a reward that balances correctness and conciseness. Experiments show that VITAL consistently out- performs existing fully latent reasoning methods, achieving relative average accuracy gains of 9.6% on GPT-2 and 5.1% on Llama-3.2-1B at comparable reasoning lengths. Compared with hybrid baselines, VITAL achieves higher reasoning accuracy with substantially shorter reasoning trajectories on Qwen3-1.7B.

AI.tldr: VITAL：一种重要性引导的混合推理框架，仅显式生成少量高信息量token作为推理锚点，其余计算保持隐式，兼顾效率与精度。
AI.motivation: 纯隐式CoT效率高但在数学等精度关键任务上表现差；现有混合方法仍保留大量token生成开销，需在效率与准确性间取得更好平衡。
AI.method: 用token重要性估计从显式CoT构建混合轨迹；轻量门控头动态选择显式token生成或直接隐状态反馈；先课程式监督训练，再用平衡正确性与简洁性的奖励做强化学习。
AI.result: 在可比推理长度下，相较全隐式方法平均准确率相对提升9.6%（GPT-2）和5.1%（Llama-3.2-1B）；相较混合基线，在Qwen3-1.7B上以显著更短轨迹获得更高准确率。
AI.conclusion: 选择性显式化关键token可有效提升隐式推理的精度，同时保持长程计算隐式化带来的效率优势，优于全隐式与现有混合方法。

title: ChanSFormer: A Channel Agnostic Vision Transformer for Multi-Channel Cell Painting Images
summary: High-content multi-channel imaging, from Cell Painting assays to remote sensing, is central to modern scientific pipelines. Because these channels are highly heterogeneous and experimental configurations frequently evolve, a practical vision backbone must be fundamentally channel-agnostic. Current channel-adaptive vision transformers rely on global self-attention with learnable channel embeddings, which can be computed only for previously known channels. Attempts to overcome this limitation of new channels either discard the embeddings, losing channel identity, or process each channel independently, thereby eliminating critical cross-channel interactions. To address this, we introduce ChanSFormer, an efficient Vision Transformer that replaces rigid embeddings with disentangled spatial-channel attention and individual channel CLS tokens. This architecture natively preserves both distinct channel identities and cross-channel information flow. Furthermore, the individual channel class token design unlocks more informative feature representations for self-supervised learning and enables representation-based channel sampling while remaining channel-agnostic. We evaluate ChanSFormer on two biology multi-channel datasets, CHAMMI, JUMP-CP and a satellite dataset, So2Sat. Experimental results show that ChanSFormer outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 3.93%-4.27% on JUMP-CP in classification accuracy. It also demonstrates exceptional cross-dataset transferability under a self-supervised setting, outperforming previous methods by up to 2.72% in accuracy in the same classification tasks. Furthermore, the disentangled attention reduces the quadratic complexity of channel-by-spatial sequence length of the global attention baseline, thus improving throughput by 55%-313%. Code is available at https://github.com/cvlab-stonybrook/ChanSFormer.

AI.tldr: ChanSFormer：用解耦的空间-通道注意力与独立通道CLS token替代可学习通道嵌入，实现真正通道无关的多通道成像ViT，支持新通道与跨数据集迁移，精度与吞吐均提升。
AI.motivation: 高内容多通道成像（Cell Painting、遥感等）中通道高度异构且实验配置不断变化，backbone 需真正 channel-agnostic。现有通道自适应ViT依赖全局自注意力+可学习通道嵌入，只能处理已知通道；应对新通道时或丢弃嵌入（丧失通道身份），或独立处理各通道（丢失跨通道交互）。
AI.method: 提出 ChanSFormer：以解耦的空间-通道注意力替换刚性通道嵌入，并为每个通道设置独立CLS token。原生保留通道身份与跨通道信息流；独立通道类别token使自监督表征更丰富，并支持基于表征的通道采样，同时保持通道无关。相比全局注意力，将通道×空间的二次复杂度解耦。
AI.result: 在两个生物多通道数据集 CHAMMI、JUMP-CP 及卫星数据集 So2Sat 上评估：JUMP-CP 分类准确率超SOTA 3.93%–4.27%；自监督设置下跨数据集迁移准确率最高超先前方法 2.72%；吞吐提升 55%–313%。
AI.conclusion: ChanSFormer 以解耦注意力+通道级CLS统一解决通道异构、新通道泛化与跨通道交互问题，兼顾精度、迁移性与效率，代码已开源。

title: Ranking Agreement Does Not Reveal Paragraph-Edit Agreement in Two Released Paper Acceptance Predictors
comment: 38 pages including supplementary methods and results; 10 figures and 22 tables
summary: A fast acceptance classifier could select revisions for a slower evaluator. We ask whether agreement on existing papers supports that use. We compare a classifier of word and document features with two released text-only acceptance predictors fine-tuned from the same language model with three billion parameters. For 198 papers from the International Conference on Learning Representations, we compare model rankings of the original papers and of paragraph rewrites screened automatically for unchanged facts, claim strength, and attribution. The classifier ranks original papers closely with one predictor and moderately with the other, but shows no detectable agreement with either on which rewrites raise scores. The tests specified in advance used reduced numerical precision. Rounding error dominated the small score responses. We therefore rescored the released weights in full 32-bit precision as a post hoc check; edit agreement remained near zero. At this precision, when each predictor chooses among five rewrites per paper, its average raw score is under two points out of 100 higher than with random choice. The evidence covers presentation rewrites and two open predictors from one family; transfer to costly evaluators remains untested. Revision selectors should therefore be checked against the intended evaluator on the revisions they rank.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了一个快速的录用分类器能否用来为更慢的评估器筛选修订稿。对198篇ICLR论文及其段落改写做比较后发现，分类器与两个开源文本预测器在原文排序上有一定一致性，但在“哪篇改写能提高分数”上几乎无一致，32位全精度复算后仍接近零；每个预测器在五选一中平均仅比随机选择高不到2分（满分100）。
AI.motivation: 现实评审成本高，人们希望用快速的“录用分类器”预筛修订稿，再交给更慢更贵的评估器。但这一做法的前提是：不同模型对哪篇论文、哪处改写更好能达成一致。作者质疑该前提是否成立，尤其针对仅基于文本、用于论文录用预测的模型。
AI.method: 以词与文档特征构建的录用分类器，对比两个同源（30亿参数语言模型微调）的纯文本录用预测器。取ICLR的198篇论文，比较原文及其段落改写（自动筛查保证事实、论断强度、归属不变）上的模型排序。预先设定的检验使用低数值精度；由于舍入误差主导了微小的分数变化，作为事后检验，用完整32位精度对公开权重重新打分，并检验每个预测器在每篇五篇改写中的选择表现与随机选择的差异。
AI.result: 分类器与其中一个预测器在原文排序上高度一致，与另一个中等一致；但在“哪些改写能提高分数”上，与两者均无可检测的一致性。低精度下舍入误差主导了小分数响应；32位复算后改写一致性仍接近零。全精度下，预测器每篇从五篇改写中选一篇，其平均原始分比随机选择高不到2分（满分100）。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭模型间一致或文本层面的信号，不足以支持用快速分类器为慢速评估器筛选修订稿；将方法迁移到高成本评估器尚未验证。修订筛选器应在它实际排序的修订稿上、针对目标评估器进行校验，而不能假设不同预测器共享一致的偏好。

title: ModalSearcher: Weaving Visual Evidence into Autonomous Cross-Modal Deep Search
summary: Static and incomplete parametric knowledge limits the performance of multimodal large language models on novel-knowledge and knowledge-intensive tasks, especially those requiring multi-hop evidence acquisition. Existing multimodal agentic search methods often fix visual evidence at the input or a predefined trajectory position, making it difficult for agents to select search modalities as their information needs evolve and to handle complex real-world queries. We define this capability as autonomous cross-modal search: an agent chooses among direct reasoning, text-to-text search, text-to-image search, and reverse-image search, actively introduces visual evidence when appropriate, and switches between and integrates modalities across multiple hops. We propose ModalSearch-Pipeline, a scalable procedure for constructing an interleaved multimodal knowledge graph. It samples paths with diverse depths and modality compositions and uses backward question construction to obscure entity names and image targets that would expose reasoning shortcuts while retaining necessary disambiguating clues, yielding text-only, image-initialized, and arbitrarily interleaved multi-hop problems. We train the ModalSearcher Agent with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning in a live Web environment, and construct ModalSearch-Bench. Experiments show that ModalSearcher-8B improves average accuracy by 16.2 points over Qwen3-VL-8B under the same agentic workflow across five multimodal knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks, with consistent gains on independently constructed active visual-search benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出"自主跨模态搜索"任务及 ModalSearch-Pipeline 数据构建方法，训练 ModalSearcher Agent，在真实网络环境中实现多跳多模态检索，8B 模型平均准确率提升 16.2 分。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型静态参数知识不足，难以应对新知识与多跳知识密集任务；已有智能体搜索方法将视觉证据固定在输入或预定轨迹位置，无法随信息需求变化自主选择检索模态，难以处理复杂真实查询。
AI.method: 定义"自主跨模态搜索"能力：智能体可在直接推理、文搜文、文搜图、以图搜图之间选择，并在多跳中主动引入视觉证据、切换与融合模态。提出 ModalSearch-Pipeline 构建交错式多模态知识图谱，采样不同深度与模态组合的路径，并用反向问题构建法隐去会泄露答案的实体名与图像目标，保留必要消歧线索，生成纯文本、图像初始化及任意交错的多跳问题。再以监督微调加强化学习在真实 Web 环境训练 ModalSearcher Agent，并构建 ModalSearch-Bench。
AI.result: 在五个多模态知识密集问答基准上，相同智能体流程下 ModalSearcher-8B 较 Qwen3-VL-8B 平均准确率提升 16.2 分；在独立构建的主动视觉搜索基准上也取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 让智能体自主决定何时引入与切换视觉检索模态，并结合可扩展的交错多模态数据构建，可显著提升多模态知识密集问答的表现。

title: Short-Term Forecasting of Heterogeneous Wind Power Fleets: Global Temporal Fusion Transformer Leveraging Static Covariates
comment: 18th International Green Energy Conference (IGEC-XVIII) & the 7th International Conference on Energy and AI (ICEAI-VII)
summary: Accurate short-term wind power forecasting is critical for grid stability and electricity trading. While transformer-based deep learning is state of the art, industry practice relies mostly on local models trained for individual assets. This study investigates whether a global temporal fusion transformer (TFT), trained jointly on a heterogeneous portfolio of wind farms across Germany, outperforms site-specific local models in 48-hour-ahead forecasting. Using numerical weather prediction (NWP) data from the regional ICON-D2 and the global ECMWF HRES models, we compare the global TFT against local models and a linear regression baseline. The global model leverages static covariates, such as farm age, altitude above sea level, hub height, rotor diameter and power curve parameters, to learn shared representations across sites. We evaluate on 100 synthetic wind farm profiles and a real portfolio of 11 German wind farms, across two seasonal test periods with intermediate retraining. The global TFT outperforms the local models for 87% of the synthetic and 77% of the real wind farms and clearly surpasses the linear baseline. Wilcoxon signed-rank tests confirm that these gains are significant across both seasons and datasets. Crucially, this superiority depends on static covariates: without asset-specific context, the global model fails to generalize. The TFT's variable selection network (VSN) reveals the learned feature selection. Altitude emerges as a relevant static discriminator on both datasets, while hub height is decisive on the real portfolio. For dynamic inputs, the encoder prioritizes historical power, whereas the decoder combines upper-level wind speeds from both NWP models, consistent with averaging out model-specific errors. These findings support a shift from single-site to scalable multi-site forecasting, reducing operational complexity while improving accuracy in large portfolios.

AI.tldr: 本文研究全局时序融合Transformer(TFT)在德国风电场组合上的48小时风电功率预测表现，证明在引入静态协变量时全局模型显著优于站点级局部模型。
AI.motivation: 准确的短期风电功率预测对电网稳定与电力交易至关重要。尽管基于Transformer的深度学习处于领先水平，工业实践仍多为针对单一资产训练的本地模型，缺乏对跨站点全局建模可行性的系统验证。
AI.method: 用ICON-D2与ECMWF HRES两种NWP数据，构建联合训练的全局TFT，并引入静态协变量（风场年龄、海拔、轮毂高度、转子直径、功率曲线参数）学习跨站点共享表征；与局部模型及线性回归基线对比。评测覆盖100个合成风场与11个真实德国风场，两个季节测试期并含中间重训练，采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验进行显著性分析，并借助变量选择网络(VSN)解析特征重要性。
AI.result: 全局TFT在87%的合成风场和77%的真实风场中优于局部模型，并明显超过线性基线，Wilcoxon检验确认两季节、两数据集上的优势均显著。该优势依赖静态协变量——缺少资产上下文时全局模型无法泛化。VSN显示海拔在两类数据上均为有效静态判别因子，轮毂高度在真实组合中起决定作用；动态输入方面，编码器侧重历史功率，解码器融合两种NWP的上层风速，相当于对模型特定误差求平均。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持从单站点向可扩展的多站点预测转变：在大规模风电场组合中既降低运维复杂度，又提升预测精度。静态资产特征是实现全局模型泛化的必要条件。

title: METRIC-GS: Selective Metric-Scale Estimation for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: A 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstruction inherits arbitrary units from structure-from-motion, so it cannot be measured or used to place AR content until someone supplies a scale. Both standard recipes are fragile on real captures: on five indoor scenes with tape-measured ceilings, a quantile floor-to-ceiling heuristic errs by 27% and metric-depth alignment by 35-71% across three networks. We present METRIC-GS, a selective scale estimator for real indoor photographs: it reads the scale off the reconstruction's own semantic content and, just as importantly, refuses when the evidence is thin. A frozen 2D teacher labels Gaussians by visibility-aware voting; instance-level size priors for architectural and furniture classes (doors, tables, the floor-to-ceiling gap) are fused by a robust maximum-likelihood step; and an inlier-mass test turns thin evidence into an explicit abstention that doubles as a router to a heavyweight metric model. On 47 ScanNet++ scenes with laser ground truth, with a configuration frozen before public evaluation, the estimator alone cuts the heuristic's mean error from 21.1% to 16.6% (9.3% on the 28 scenes it acts on) at ~11 s per scene. MASt3R remains the more accurate standalone estimator (9.9%), but routing only our refusals to it matches running it everywhere with 60% fewer invocations; this selective hybrid is the configuration we advocate. Visibility-aware voting raises the scenes the estimator can act on from 16 to 28 at unchanged deployed accuracy. Applied unchanged to 13 phone and drone captures of our own, on which MASt3R fails its own registration gate 12 times, the system improves all five captures it acts on and degrades none. We also report that a current feed-forward metric model scores 2.3% on a benchmark inside its training mixture and 28-35% on captures it has never seen: a published metric-scale number is a best case, not a deployment estimate.

AI.tldr: METRIC-GS 利用重建自身的语义实例尺寸先验估计 3DGS 的绝对尺度，并在证据不足时显式弃权，将弃权样本路由给 MASt3R，从而以更少调用接近全量运行重型模型的精度。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 重建继承 SfM 的任意尺度，无法度量或放置 AR 内容。现有做法脆弱：分位数地板到天花板启发式在五个室内场景误差 27%，度量深度对齐在三种网络上误差 35-71%。
AI.method: 冻结的 2D 教师模型通过可见性感知投票为高斯标注语义；对建筑与家具类（门、桌、地板到天花板间隙）的实例尺寸先验用鲁棒最大似然融合；再用内点质量检验把弱证据转为显式弃权，弃权即路由到 MASt3R 等重型度量模型。配置在公开评测前冻结。
AI.result: 47 个 ScanNet++ 场景（激光真值）：单独估计器将启发式平均误差从 21.1% 降至 16.6%（实际作用的 28 个场景上为 9.3%），约 11 秒/场景；MASt3R 单独为 9.9%。仅将弃权样本路由给 MASt3R，即可匹配全量运行的精度，调用量减少 60%。可见性投票使可作用场景从 16 增至 28 且保持精度。13 个手机/无人机自采数据（MASt3R 在 12 次中注册门失败）上，作用的 5 个均改善、无一退化。此外，前馈度量模型在其训练分布内基准上为 2.3%，未见数据上为 28-35%。
AI.conclusion: 选择性的语义尺度估计加弃权路由是实用的配置；论文同时警示已发表的度量尺度数字是最佳情况而非部署估计。

title: Measuring Risk, Not Harm: Detecting Psychological Harm Risk Factors in LLM Conversations
summary: Psychological harms from interactions with large language models cannot be monitored directly because they may emerge over repeated interactions and depend strongly on subjective individual user context. We propose measuring risk, not harm: detecting observable AI behaviors that constitute risk factors for psychological harm at the AI response level and aggregating these signals to support longitudinal monitoring. We operationalize eight such behaviors and construct a synthetic multi-label corpus of 47,062 AI responses and 373,873 response-factor labels, with targeted human annotations for validation and evaluation. We then compare trained embedding-based classifiers, direct LLM judging, and a classifier--judge cascade. All detectors are model-agnostic and operate only on LLM outputs, requiring no access to internal model states. We apply these detectors to several out-of-distribution human-AI conversation data sets from prior research. On held-out human-labeled data, the best cascade achieves macro precision of 0.86, recall of 0.76, and F1 of 0.79. On WildChat, it reduces LLM-judge calls by 97.1\% relative to direct judging. On DelusionEval, risk-factor detections cluster within conversations. Together, our results show that response-level behavioral risk-factor detection can provide a scalable measurement layer for longitudinal psychological-safety monitoring without conflating observable AI behavior with latent user harm.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以"风险"替代"伤害"作为测量对象：在AI回复层面检测八类可观察的心理伤害风险行为，并汇总用于纵向监测。作者构建了47,062条AI回复、373,873个标签的合成多标签语料并进行人工标注验证，比较了基于嵌入的分类器、LLM直接评判与级联方法。最佳级联在人工标注数据上宏F1为0.79，在WildChat上减少97.1%的LLM评判调用。
AI.motivation: LLM交互带来的心理伤害无法直接监测：伤害可能需多次交互才显现，且高度依赖用户主观情境。现有方法难以在规模化、纵向上进行安全监测。
AI.method: 提出"测量风险而非伤害"：定义八类可观察的AI风险行为，在回复级别检测并聚合。构建合成多标签语料（47,062条回复、373,873个标签），辅以人工标注验证；比较基于嵌入的分类器、LLM直接评判、以及分类器—评判级联三类检测器。检测器均与模型无关，仅依赖LLM输出，不需访问内部状态；并在多个分布外的人机对话数据集上应用。
AI.result: 留出人工标注数据上最佳级联宏精确率0.86、召回0.76、F1 0.79；WildChat上相比直接评判减少97.1%的LLM调用；DelusionEval上风险因子检测在对话内呈聚集性。
AI.conclusion: 回复级别的行为风险因子检测可作为可扩展的测量层，支持纵向心理安全监测，同时避免将可观察的AI行为与潜在的用户伤害混为一谈。

title: SafeStart: Mitigating the Overlooked Safety Cost of Active Expert Reduction in MoE LLM Serving
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models send each token through a few of many expert subnetworks. Serving methods make these models faster by running even fewer experts per token, and they are validated on accuracy benchmarks. We show that these methods can weaken the model's refusal of harmful requests, and we introduce SafeStart, which largely restores refusal while keeping most of the speedup. In vLLM on one RTX A6000, keeping about two thirds of the selected experts speeds up offline decoding by 15 to 28% at batch size 8. We find that, at this setting, under a jailbreak that tells the model not to refuse, the share of harmful requests that the model answers rises by 18.4 percentage points on Qwen1.5-MoE, 9.5 on OLMoE, and 6.6 on DeepSeek-V2-Lite, the three of nine models where it rises significantly, while MMLU accuracy drops by less than two points. We discover that most of this increase arises while the model processes the prompt and generates its first few tokens. SafeStart therefore runs all experts for the prompt and the first eight generated tokens, and the reduced set of experts afterwards, through a fused kernel in vLLM. With experts removed, SafeStart keeps at least 85% of the offline decode speedup at batch sizes 8 and 32 and brings the change under this jailbreak to between -2.1 and +1.3 points for three expert-reduction methods on these three models. On 889 held-out requests, in an analysis fixed before generation, truncation raises harmful compliance by 5.8 to 21.4 points, and SafeStart leaves a rise of 0.6 to 2.6 points, non-inferior to the original model on two of the three models. Our results show that faster MoE serving need not cost safety: a serving system can keep most of the gain from running fewer experts by running all of them at the start of each response, and it should test refusal, not only accuracy, before it enables such a method.

AI.tldr: MoE语言模型的服务加速方法（每token跑更少专家）会削弱模型对有害请求的拒答能力，作者提出SafeStart：在prompt和生成前8个token时使用全部专家，之后才减少专家，从而在保留大部分加速的同时基本恢复拒答能力。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE加速服务方法只用精度基准（如MMLU）验证，忽略了安全影响。作者发现减少每token专家数会显著削弱模型对有害请求的拒答，需在保速的同时保安全。
AI.method: 先量化专家裁剪对拒答率的影响并定位问题阶段（发现危害增加主要发生在处理prompt和生成最初几个token时）；据此提出SafeStart：对prompt和前8个生成token运行全部专家，之后才用缩减专家集，并在vLLM中通过融合内核高效实现。
AI.result: vLLM + RTX A6000、batch 8下保留约2/3专家可让离线解码加速15–28%，MMLU仅降不到2点，但jailbreak下有害请求回答率在Qwen1.5-MoE升18.4、OLMoE升9.5、DeepSeek-V2-Lite升6.6个百分点（9个模型中3个显著）。SafeStart保留至少85%加速，并把变化控制在-2.1至+1.3点；在889条留出请求上，截断使有害顺从升5.8–21.4点，SafeStart仅升0.6–2.6点。
AI.conclusion: 更快的MoE服务不必牺牲安全：在每个回复开头运行全部专家即可保留大部分收益；在启用专家裁剪方法前应测试拒答能力而不仅是精度。

title: Neural Stochastic Forecasting for Lateral Molecular Diffusion Simulations
summary: Predicting the long-time diffusion of membrane proteins is challenging because molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are computationally expensive, while experimental single-particle tracking is often limited by finite observation times. Here, we introduce a neural stochastic (NS) model for forecasting the collective diffusion of membrane proteins from coarse-grained MD trajectories. The model combines a transformer-based representation of protein configurations, recurrent networks operating at multiple temporal scales, and a stochastic latent process with learned memory. A cross-attention decoder then generates correlated protein displacements while accounting for the instantaneous system geometry and periodic boundary conditions. We evaluate the model in two membrane systems: seven interacting PIEZO channels and a mixed system containing seven PIEZO and ten TREK channels. For the seven PIEZO system, the NS model reproduces the anomalous diffusion exponent measured in MD simulations $α\sim 1$, substantially improving on a previously developed variational autoregressive model that exhibits superdiffusive behavior. The model also generates trajectories extending to 40,000 frames and captures the distinct diffusion characteristics of PIEZO and TREK populations in the mixed system. Comparisons of time-averaged mean-square displacements, Van Hove displacement distributions, and non-Gaussian parameters show that the model preserves key statistical features of the simulated dynamics. These results establish neural stochastic modeling as a promising approach for generating long trajectories of multi-protein membrane diffusion and extending the statistical analysis of molecular dynamics simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出神经随机(NS)模型，从粗粒化MD轨迹预测膜蛋白的集体扩散，能生成长达40000帧的轨迹并保持MD的关键统计特征。
AI.motivation: 膜蛋白长时间扩散预测困难：MD模拟计算代价高，实验单粒子追踪受观测时长限制，需要一种能低成本外推长时动力学的建模方法。
AI.method: NS模型融合三部分：基于Transformer的蛋白构型表征、多时间尺度的循环网络、带可学习记忆的随机潜过程；再由交叉注意力解码器在考虑瞬时系统几何与周期性边界条件下生成相关蛋白位移。
AI.result: 在七个相互作用PIEZO通道体系中复现MD测得的反常扩散指数α~1，明显优于此前呈超扩散的变分自回归模型；可生成40000帧轨迹；在7个PIEZO+10个TREK混合体系中捕捉两类通道的差异扩散；时间平均均方位移、Van Hove位移分布与非高斯参数比较表明关键统计特征被保留。
AI.conclusion: 神经随机建模是生成多蛋白膜扩散长轨迹、扩展MD统计分析的有前景途径。

title: USI-Brain: Enhancing Underwater Spatial Intelligence via Spatial Data-Driven Vision-Language Modeling
summary: Underwater spatial reasoning depends on object boundaries and geometric cues that are obscured by scattering, color distortion, and low visibility. Existing underwater resources capture these cues through images, annotations, and depth maps, but provide fragmented supervision for vision-language models. We present a spatial data engine that connects visual appearance with object-level geometry through enhancement, 2D and geometry-assisted question generation, and expert filtering. It produces 4.27M QA pairs across five capability groups. We use this corpus to train USI-Brain and introduce an Underwater Prior-guided Rectifier (UPR) that applies gated corrections to visual features. USI-Bench evaluates the resulting capabilities with 6,525 held-out QA pairs. On its 15 task metrics, USI-Brain and USI-Brain + UPR improve over Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct by 5.76 and 7.63 points on average, respectively, using signed differences on 100-point scales. Ablations show that geometry-assisted supervision improves depth and ordering by 4.8 and 6.1 points with UPR disabled, while UPR adds 18.0 points in scene description under matched training data. Both variants use raw images at evaluation. Across NautData, UWBench, and MarineEval, USI-Brain achieves the best or joint-best score on 28 of 32 metrics. Model weights and USI-Bench will be released at https://github.com/SKY-Zhu-91/USI-Brain.

AI.tldr: 提出水下空间数据引擎与USI-Brain模型，通过几何辅助监督和先验引导校正提升水下视觉语言空间推理能力，并在多基准上取得领先。
AI.motivation: 水下空间推理依赖物体边界与几何线索，但散射、颜色失真和低能见度使这些线索被遮蔽；现有水下图像、标注与深度图资源只能为视觉语言模型提供碎片化监督。
AI.method: 构建空间数据引擎，将视觉外观与物体级几何关联，流程包括图像增强、2D与几何辅助问答生成、专家过滤，产出427万条QA对（分五类能力）；据此训练USI-Brain，并提出Underwater Prior-guided Rectifier (UPR)，对视觉特征做门控校正；构建USI-Bench（6525条留出QA）。
AI.result: 在USI-Bench的15项任务指标上，USI-Brain与USI-Brain+UPR分别比Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct平均提升5.76和7.63分（百分制带符号差）；消融显示几何辅助监督在无UPR时提升深度与排序4.8、6.1分，UPR在同等训练数据下为场景描述带来18.0分提升；评估均用原始图像；在NautData、UWBench、MarineEval的32项指标中28项取得最佳或并列最佳。
AI.conclusion: 几何辅助监督与先验引导特征校正相结合能有效增强水下视觉语言模型的空间推理能力，模型权重与USI-Bench将开源。

title: LLMs Don't Know What They Know: Benchmarking Temporal Self-Knowledge for Financial Backtesting
summary: Financial backtests of large language models (LLMs) are meaningful only if the model did not already know the outcomes it is asked to predict. Practitioners guard against this by trusting a vendor's stated knowledge cutoff, by asking the model what it knows, or by instructing it to answer as of a past date. To verify whether any of these safeguards can be trusted, we introduce FinDendro, a benchmark of 2,226 dated U.S. facts from 1999 to 2026, covering monthly macroeconomic series, month-end stock prices and Federal Reserve decisions. Each fact yields four prompts: a value question, Recall and Predict questions that pair each candidate value with a claim of knowing or guessing without a declared date, and a Predict question with a historical declared date. Controls for persistence and dominant outcomes keep chance accuracy near 0.27. Results show that for most frontier models, self-reports understate knowledge. GPT-5 answers 76% of controlled facts correctly but claims to know 38%, and answers 61% of the facts it says it does not know. Knowledge claims can persist beyond the measured knowledge boundary, by up to seven quarters, and a declared date removes most of the claims of prior knowledge while leaving accuracy unchanged. Backtests inside a model's training window therefore cannot be certified leak-free by self-report, instruction or stated cutoff. These findings motivate behavioral measurement of temporal knowledge boundaries, and FinDendro provides a benchmark and procedure for selecting backtest periods based on demonstrated factual knowledge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FinDendro 基准（2,226 条 1999–2026 年美国带日期事实，涵盖月度宏观指标、月末股价与美联储决议），用四类提示系统性检验"知识截止日声明、自我知识报告、指定历史日期作答"这三种防泄漏手段是否可信。
AI.motivation: LLM 金融回测只有在模型事先不知晓待预测结果时才有效。业界依赖三种防泄漏保障：信任厂商声明的知识截止时间、直接询问模型"知道什么"、或要求其以某一过去日期为视角作答。但这些保障本身缺乏验证。
AI.method: 构建 FinDendro：2,226 条带日期美国事实（1999–2026），每条生成四个提示——数值问答、无日期声明下的 Recall/Predict（候选值与"知道/猜测"声明配对）、带历史声明日期的 Predict；并设置持续性与主导结果控制项，使随机准确率约 0.27。
AI.result: 多数前沿模型的自我报告低估其知识：GPT-5 在受控事实上答对 76%，却称仅知晓 38%，且对其自称"不知道"的事实仍答对 61%。知识宣称可超出实测知识边界达七个季度；声明历史日期可消除大部分"先前已知"的宣称，但准确率不变。
AI.conclusion: 训练窗口内的回测无法通过自我报告、指令或声明的截止时间来证明无泄漏，需以行为方式测量模型的时间知识边界；FinDendro 为此提供基准与依据实测事实知识选择回测期的流程。

title: CARM: Conformal Adaptive Risk Masking for Reliable Scientific Super-Resolution
summary: Deep learning-based super-resolution (SR) can reconstruct fine-scale Earth-observation fields from coarse observations, but reconstruction accuracy alone does not provide a calibrated rule for identifying reliable spatial regions. Conformal Mask Calibration (CMC), built on conformal risk control, converts a spatial uncertainty score into a trust mask and controls the expected worst-case local distortion under exchangeability. However, its fixed threshold can become miscalibrated in Earth-observation streams affected by seasonality and episodic events. We propose $\textit{CARM}$ (Conformal Adaptive Risk Masking), a statistical framework for adaptive spatial risk control under temporal distribution shift. CARM maintains experts with heterogeneous update rates and aggregates their threshold proposals online using an asymmetric surrogate loss, balancing rapid adaptation to distribution changes against stability during relatively stationary periods. All updates are causal and use only mature feedback available after a fixed delay, allowing CARM to operate with any SR model that provides a spatial uncertainty score. We prove that the time-averaged mask-conditioned risk converges to at most $α$ at an $O(1/T)$ rate, without distributional assumptions and for any choice of aggregation weights across experts. On a daily South China Sea chlorophyll-$\textit{a}$ SR stream, CARM reduces the empirical violation rate from $43.49\%$ to $9.38\%$ and the moving-average exceedance frequency from $47.29\%$ to $1.22\%$ at $α=0.10$, while retaining a non-trivial trusted region. Experiments on ERA5 wind and OSTIA sea-surface temperature further show consistent relative improvements across multiple SR backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出CARM框架，在时间分布漂移下为超分辨率重建提供自适应空间风险掩码，保证长期平均风险不超过α。
AI.motivation: 深度学习超分辨率重建本身无法给出可靠的"可信区域"判定规则；现有Conformal Mask Calibration用固定阈值，在受季节性和突发事件影响的地球观测数据流中会失准。
AI.method: 维护多个不同更新速率的专家，用非对称代理损失在线聚合各自的阈值提议，兼顾快速适应与稳定；所有更新因果，仅使用固定延迟后的成熟反馈；可与任意提供空间不确定性分数的SR模型结合。
AI.result: 证明时间平均掩码条件风险以O(1/T)速率收敛到不超过α，无需分布假设且对任意聚合权重成立。南海叶绿素a日流数据上α=0.10时，经验违约率由43.49%降至9.38%，滑动平均超限频率由47.29%降至1.22%，且保留非平凡可信区域；ERA5风场与OSTIA海温实验在多种SR骨干上一致提升。
AI.conclusion: CARM为时变地球观测流提供了理论上可靠、实践中有效的自适应空间风险控制机制，可即插即用于现有SR模型。

title: Selective Prediction Intervals: Jointly Learning to Predict, Bound, and Abstain
summary: Many high-stakes regression decisions ask three things of a model at once: a point estimate to act on, an interval that bounds the risk of acting, and the option to abstain when neither can be trusted. Deep learning provides these in isolation: prediction-interval methods return an interval, and at best a value estimate inside it, for every input, while selective-prediction methods learn when to abstain, but only for point predictions and with no statement of how far the truth may lie from the estimate. We introduce SelPI, which trains interval, value and abstention heads jointly under a single loss with an explicit acceptance-rate budget. A natural objection is that interval width already tells us when to abstain. We show that it does not: across 18 tabular benchmarks, width predicts large point errors well (AUROC 0.72) but is anti-correlated with interval misses (AUROC 0.38), so abstaining on wide intervals discards precisely the inputs the interval got right. SelPI therefore selects with two gates, one trained on the interval loss and one on the value loss, coupled by a Fr'echet penalty that ties their separate budgets to the joint acceptance rate they deliver. With the base predictor held fixed, the learned gate beats width thresholding on a proper interval score on all 18 tabular datasets, closing a median 87% of the gap to an oracle selector, and it also beats selection by deep-ensemble disagreement on every dataset. The advantage grows with the heteroscedasticity of the task, and we report the settings in which it disappears.

AI.tldr: 提出 SelPI，用联合损失同时训练区间、点值与弃权三个头，并以 Fréchet 惩罚耦合两个门控的预算，实现"可信才作答"的回归决策。
AI.motivation: 高风险回归决策同时需要点估计、可信区间和弃权选项，但预测区间方法与选择性预测方法各自只解决一部分，且普遍假设"区间宽=该弃权"。
AI.method: SelPI 在单一损失下联合训练 interval/value/abstention 头，受显式接受率预算约束；使用两个门控分别基于区间损失与点值损失进行选择，并通过 Fréchet 惩罚把各自预算与联合接受率绑定。
AI.result: 18 个表格基准上，区间宽度对大幅点误差预测力强（AUROC 0.72）但与区间漏检反相关（AUROC 0.38）；固定基预测器时，学习门控在全部 18 个数据集上以 proper interval score 胜过宽度阈值，中位缩小 87% 至 oracle 的差距，并在所有数据集上胜过深度集成分歧选择。
AI.conclusion: 区间宽度不能替代弃权判断，需分别建模两类不确定性；SelPI 的优势随任务异方差性增强，论文亦报告其失效场景。

title: UniRestorer++: Scalable Universal Image Restoration with Multi-Granularity Degradation Modeling
summary: Universal image restoration aims to handle diverse degradations within a single model, but a reliable scaling strategy remains underexplored. Increasing backbone depth and width can lead to performance saturation, while degradation-aware specialization depends on accurate degradation estimation and is vulnerable to errors on out-of-distribution and real-world inputs. We propose UniRestorer++, a scalable framework based on multi-granularity degradation modeling. It progressively refines degradation groups and introduces group-specific experts, coupling capacity growth with specialization. Degradation-estimation-based routing selects a root-to-leaf path, while granularity-estimation-based routing chooses a level along that path to balance specialization and robustness. Spatially dense degradation representation maps further enable region-aware routing for spatially non-uniform corruptions. We develop CDD-50, a benchmark covering 50 degradation categories from single to penta-degradation. Experiments show approximately log-linear PSNR trends over the evaluated model-size range and stronger scaling gains on out-of-distribution and real-world data than vanilla MoE scaling. UniRestorer++ achieves state-of-the-art performance across benchmarks and demonstrates zero-shot generalization and few-shot transfer on real-world images. Code: https://github.com/mrluin/UniRestorer_plusplus

AI.tldr: UniRestorer++ 提出基于多粒度退化建模的可扩展通用图像复原框架，将容量增长与退化特化耦合，实现接近对数线性的 PSNR 扩展趋势，并在 OOD 与真实数据上取得 SOTA 及零样本/少样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 通用图像复原需要在单一模型中处理多种退化，但可靠的扩展（scaling）策略仍缺乏探索。单纯加深加宽主干会导致性能饱和；而退化感知的特化方案依赖准确的退化估计，在分布外和真实输入上容易出错。因此需要一种兼顾容量扩展、特化与鲁棒性的框架。
AI.method: 提出 UniRestorer++：基于多粒度退化建模。渐进细化退化分组并引入组专属专家（group-specific experts），使容量增长与特化同步；采用退化估计路由选择根到叶路径，用粒度估计路由在该路径上选择层级以平衡特化与鲁棒性；构建空间稠密退化表示图以支持区域感知路由，处理空间非均匀退化。同时提出 CDD-50 基准，涵盖从单一到五重退化的 50 类退化。
AI.result: 在评估的模型规模范围内观察到近似对数线性的 PSNR 趋势；相比朴素 MoE 扩展，在分布外和真实数据上有更强扩展收益；UniRestorer++ 在多个基准上达到 SOTA，并在真实图像上展示零样本泛化与少样本迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 多粒度退化建模结合层级路由与专家特化，为通用图像复原提供了可扩展且鲁棒的范式；组粒度路由能缓解退化估计误差带来的脆弱性，CDD-50 为系统评估复杂退化提供基准。代码已开源。

title: SAUCE: Summary Analysis Using Conversation Entailment
comment: Accepted and published to the ACL GEM workshop. Proceedings of the Fifth Workshop on Generation, Evaluation and Metrics (GEM), pages 364-377, San Diego, California, USA. Association for Computational Linguistics
summary: With the growing need for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) and their applications to speech, challenges persist in summarizing and evaluating conversations that lack a clear end goal. We introduce SAUCE -- a reference-free, fact-based evaluation pipeline for cross-lingual conversational speech summarization. It measures the accuracy and the fact coverage of a summary through the entailment between conversation and text. We compare SAUCE against several popular summarization metrics and demonstrate the effectiveness of capturing information loss due to transcription and translation error and identifying broken summaries. Crucially, unlike black-box LLM evaluators or dense embedding metrics, SAUCE is inherently explainable: it maps summary scores to discrete, verifiable facts, allowing users to pinpoint exact hallucinations or omissions. We illustrate how this interpretability helps developers systematically profile LLM behaviors and gives end-users an actionable tool to verify summary accuracy in noisy, real-world conditions. Preliminary investigations show SAUCE strongly align with human judgment.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAUCE，一个面向跨语言对话语音摘要的无参考、基于事实的评估流程，通过对话与摘要之间的蕴含关系衡量摘要准确性与事实覆盖度，具备可解释性且与人类判断高度一致。
AI.motivation: 评估 LLM 及其语音应用的需求增长，但对缺乏明确终点的对话进行摘要与评估仍存在挑战；现有黑盒 LLM 评估器或稠密嵌入指标缺乏可解释性，难以定位转录/翻译错误带来的信息损失与幻觉。
AI.method: 构建无参考、基于事实的评估流水线：将摘要分数映射到离散、可验证的事实，通过对话与摘要之间的文本蕴含（entailment）来度量摘要准确性与事实覆盖率；与多种主流摘要指标进行对比。
AI.result: 相比流行指标更有效地捕捉转录与翻译错误导致的信息损失、识别破损摘要；可精确定位幻觉与遗漏；初步研究表明与人类判断高度一致。
AI.conclusion: SAUCE 提供内在可解释的评估方式，帮助开发者系统刻画 LLM 行为，并为终端用户提供在噪声真实场景下核查摘要准确性的可操作工具。

title: A Definition of Catastrophic Performance
summary: A central challenge in AI is specifying objectives that align with human preferences. While existing theoretical results elucidate how misspecification impacts performance, they typically do not distinguish between merely suboptimal and catastrophic outcomes. To enable rigorous analysis of catastrophic risk from AI misalignment, we introduce a formal definition of catastrophic performance. Our definition is based on two reference values. The first, baseline value, captures the value attained if no agent is deployed. The second, orthogonal value, captures the value of a trajectory that is unrelated to human preferences, in a sense we describe. Orthogonal value is typically far worse than baseline value. We interpret these reference values through examples in which past human activity has altered the state of the environment to human benefit. Starting at the resulting state, an AI agent is deployed with the goal of accelerating further progress. Catastrophic performance represents this agent's undoing of benefits afforded by human activity.

AI.tldr: 提出"灾难性表现"的形式化定义，用基线值与正交值两个参考值刻画AI错位可能导致的灾难性风险，以区分"次优"与"灾难"。
AI.motivation: 现有理论分析虽能说明目标错位如何影响性能，但无法区分仅仅是次优的结果与灾难性结果，缺少严格分析AI错位灾难性风险的形式框架。
AI.method: 引入灾难性表现的形式化定义，基于两个参考值：基线值（不部署任何智能体时获得的价值）和正交值（与人偏好无关的轨迹价值，通常远劣于基线值）。通过人类过去活动改善环境状态的例子来解读这两个参考值：智能体从该状态出发、以加速进展为目标被部署，灾难性表现即为该智能体抹除人类活动所带来的收益。
AI.result: 给出可严格分析AI错位灾难性风险的定义框架，并以实例说明基线与正交参考值的含义及灾难性表现的判定方式。
AI.conclusion: 该定义为从理论上区分次优与灾难性AI结果提供了基础，有助于对AI错位引发的灾难性风险进行严谨分析。

title: FaCoDiff: Factor-Correlated Diffusion for Multivariate Probabilistic Forecasting
summary: Multivariate probabilistic forecasting requires modeling cross-variable dependence alongside marginal uncertainty. The challenge is to learn this dependence while controlling marginal noise scales and avoiding dense covariance costs. We propose Factor-Correlated Diffusion (FaCoDiff), which couples a compact conditional statistical estimator with structured denoising. History-conditioned factor loadings use distinct coefficients for forecast-center correction, scale adjustment and noise dependence. Diagonal compensation preserves the estimated marginal noise variances, while low-rank operators enable residual Gaussian likelihood evaluation and noise transport without dense covariance storage or factorization. Factor-derived feature modulation explicitly conditions the denoiser, and a geometry-aware objective accounts for errors after noise transport. The same conditional geometry governs forward perturbations and reverse sampling. Across nine datasets, FaCoDiff achieves the lowest mean variogram score on eight datasets and ranks among the top two on 43 of 54 dataset-metric combinations in the reported comparisons. Matched ablations on Solar and Weather show that factor covariance improves mean Energy and Variogram scores under all four combinations of center and scale correction. Disrupting cross-variable sample pairings while preserving marginal trajectories worsens joint and aggregate scores on both datasets, demonstrating the predictive value of generated cross-variable dependence.

AI.tldr: FaCoDiff：用因子条件统计估计器+结构化去噪的扩散模型做多变量概率预测，以低秩算子避免稠密协方差，九个数据集中八个取得最低平均变差图分数。
AI.motivation: 多变量概率预测需同时建模跨变量依赖与边际不确定性；难点在于在学习依赖的同时控制边际噪声尺度，并避免稠密协方差的计算开销。
AI.method: 将紧凑的条件统计估计器与结构化去噪耦合：历史条件因子载荷分别用于预测中心校正、尺度调整与噪声依赖；对角补偿保留估计的边际噪声方差，低秩算子在不存储/分解稠密协方差的前提下实现残差高斯似然评估与噪声传输；因子衍生特征调制显式条件化去噪器，几何感知目标考虑噪声传输后的误差，前向扰动与反向采样共享同一条件几何。
AI.result: 九个数据集中八个取得最低平均变差图分数，54个数据集-指标组合中43个进入前二。Solar与Weather上的匹配消融显示：中心与尺度校正的四种组合下，因子协方差均改善平均Energy与Variogram分数；在保持边际轨迹的情况下破坏跨变量样本配对，两个数据集上的联合与聚合分数均变差。
AI.conclusion: 因子化条件几何可有效、低成本地捕获跨变量依赖，生成的依赖结构具有实质预测价值，并非仅由边际分布驱动。

title: DeepfakeGenome: Toward Next-Generation Deepfake Attribution
summary: In recent years, AIGC technologies are capable of generating hyper-realistic forged facial images, posing severe threats to facial security safety. To tackle these challenges, early Deepfake research primarily centered on real-fake classification. Recently, growing efforts have been devoted to the Deepfake Attribution (DFA) of generated content. Nevertheless, existing research on Deepfake detection and attribution faces saturated performance in binary classification, limited diversity in datasets and algorithms, and imperfect evaluation protocols, which severely impede practical application. To address these limitations, we propose a comprehensive deepfake detection and attribution benchmark named DeepfakeGenome (DFG). It contains 100 facial forgery algorithms and 2M images in total, achieving 4x to 100x larger than prior DFA benchmarks. We further design 4 protocols for practical evaluation, including a novel retrieval-based attribution paradigm. Unlike previous open-set evaluation metrics, the proposed retrieval metrics are more aligned with the real-world active defense situation of blacklist registration mechanisms. Based on these elaborate designs, we investigate the performance ceiling of deepfake attribution task. Over 2k experimental evaluations are conducted, and 10 insightful findings are derived. We believe this work can provide new insights into the DFA research field. The Code and Benchmark of DFG are avaliable on https://huggingface.co/spaces/DeepfakeGenome/DFG_Page.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 DeepfakeGenome（DFG）基准，包含100种伪造算法、200万张人脸图像，规模达先前DMA基准的4x–100x，并设计4种实用评估协议（含新颖的检索式归因范式），通过2000+次实验揭示深度伪造归因任务的性能天花板，得出10条洞察。
AI.motivation: AIGC生成的高逼真人脸伪造图像威胁人脸安全。现有Deepfake检测与归因研究存在二分类性能饱和、数据集与算法多样性不足、评估协议不完善等问题，严重阻碍实际应用。
AI.method: 构建DeepfakeGenome基准：涵盖100种人脸伪造算法、200万张图像；设计4种面向实际应用的评估协议，并提出一种新的检索式归因范式，其度量更契合黑名单注册机制下的真实主动防御场景（优于传统开集评估指标）；基于该设计开展2000余次实验，探究归因任务的性能上限。
AI.result: DFG规模较已有DFA基准大4x–100x；通过大规模实验评估，揭示深度伪造归因的性能天花板，并归纳出10条有见地的结论。
AI.conclusion: DFG为深度伪造归因研究提供了更全面、贴近实际的基准与评估体系，可为该领域提供新见解，代码与基准已公开。

title: LooM: Loop-Invariant Memory for Causal Encoder-Decoder Language Models
summary: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by re-executing shared layers, but three limitations hinder their adoption: memory grows with the loop count, compute can only be adjusted in whole-block steps, and the loop count is hard to change after training. We propose LooM (Loop-invariant Memory), which addresses each in turn. In a causal encoder-decoder (CED), LooM loops only the decoder layers after the first, which read a global memory written once per token, and each of them publishes the key-value (KV) entry for a token only on its first visit, so the cache does not grow with the loop count. These layers loop independently, providing every budget from 3 to 21 layer executions per token, and one model trained on randomly sampled budgets covers all of them without a router. With enough loops, LooM outperforms a single-pass baseline trained on the same data on language modeling, zero-shot accuracy and long-context perplexity, while using the same cache size. Our analysis further shows that the training budget distribution decides what extra depth buys. These results suggest that a CED is a natural place to loop: memory is written once, and depth becomes a budget chosen at deployment.

AI.tldr: LooM 是一种循环式 Transformer 架构改进：在因果编码器-解码器中只循环第一层之后的解码器层，每层独立循环且仅在首次访问时写入 KV 缓存，从而在固定缓存大小下实现 3–21 层执行预算，单模型训练即可覆盖全部预算，并在语言建模、零样本准确率和长上下文困惑度上优于同等单遍基线。
AI.motivation: 循环 Transformer 通过重复执行共享层来增加有效深度，但存在三个阻碍其落地的缺陷：(1) 内存随循环次数增长；(2) 计算量只能以整块（block）为粒度调整；(3) 循环次数在训练后难以更改。作者希望同时解决这三点。
AI.method: 提出 LooM（Loop-invariant Memory）。在因果编码器-解码器（CED）结构中，只循环第一层之后的解码器层；这些层读取每 token 只写入一次的全局记忆，并仅在首次访问某 token 时发布其 KV 条目，因此缓存不随循环次数增长。各层独立循环，因而可提供每 token 3 到 21 次层执行的任意预算；一个在随机采样预算上训练的模型无需路由器即可覆盖全部预算。
AI.result: 在循环足够多时，LooM 在语言建模、零样本准确率和长上下文困惑度上均优于用相同数据训练的单遍基线，且缓存大小相同。分析还表明，训练时的预算分布决定了额外深度带来何种收益。
AI.conclusion: 因果编码器-解码器是进行循环计算的天然场所：记忆只写一次，深度成为部署时可选的预算。

title: HarnessFlow: MCTS-Guided Harness Optimization for LLM Agents
summary: The performance of large language model (LLM) agents depends on both the underlying model and the harness that governs interaction with tools and the environment. Yet harness design remains largely manual, and automating it requires navigating an open-ended search space through costly end-to-end evaluations. We introduce HarnessFlow, a framework for optimizing complete executable harnesses under a limited candidate-evaluation budget, with the model and task environment held fixed. HarnessFlow organizes candidates and their evaluation histories in a refinement tree, using a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based policy to balance exploitation and exploration. A coding agent refines selected harnesses using archived code, execution feedback, and a library of reusable harness mechanisms. With 15 refinement attempts per benchmark, HarnessFlow achieves the highest mean test scores among the compared methods on six benchmarks spanning agentic tasks, coding, and web interaction. The optimized harnesses achieve an average score of 69.48%, outperforming the initial harnesses and Meta-Harness by 10.89 and 3.95 percentage points, respectively, while incurring lower average per-task execution costs than hand-engineered baselines. These results suggest that structured harness search offers a promising route toward automating the design of capable and efficient LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 HarnessFlow 框架，在固定模型和任务环境的条件下，用 MCTS 驱动的编码智能体自动优化 LLM 智能体的完整可执行 harness，以有限评估预算取得更优性能与更低成本。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体性能不仅取决于模型本身，还取决于其与工具、环境交互的 harness；但 harness 设计仍主要靠手工，自动化则需要面对开放搜索空间和高昂的端到端评估成本。
AI.method: 将候选 harness 及其评估历史组织成精炼树，采用基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的策略平衡利用与探索；由编码智能体利用存档代码、执行反馈和可复用 harness 机制库来改进选中的 harness；模型与任务环境保持固定。
AI.result: 每个基准仅 15 次精炼尝试，在涵盖智能体任务、编程和网页交互的六个基准上取得对比方法中最高的平均测试分：平均 69.48%，分别比初始 harness 和 Meta-Harness 高 10.89 和 3.95 个百分点，且平均单任务执行成本低于人工设计的基线。
AI.conclusion: 结构化 harness 搜索是自动设计高性能且高效 LLM 智能体的一条有前景的路径。

title: GPUMAP: GPU-Accelerated Progressive Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection
summary: Dimensionality reduction (DR) techniques are fundamental to the analysis of high-dimensional data, yet their substantial computational cost limits their use in interactive settings. To address this limitation, we present GPU-accelerated Progressive Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (GPUMAP), an efficient progressive DR algorithm designed for interactive use. We identify three atomic operations within UMAP and restructure them into a progressive pipeline. As part of this adaptation, we introduce modifications to UMAP, including operation queues, instance-wise local join, and scheduling strategies. We further accelerate computation by leveraging GPU parallelism, enabling interactive analysis of million-scale datasets on commodity GPU hardware. Finally, we employ our implementation to systematically study the behavior of progressive DR, investigating how projections evolve over time relative to the ground-truth projection and how biased data streams influence the quality and stability of the resulting projections.

AI.tldr: 提出 GPUMAP，将 UMAP 分解为三个原子操作并重组为渐进式流水线，结合 GPU 并行加速，实现百万级数据集的交互式降维分析。
AI.motivation: 降维技术对高维数据分析至关重要，但其高昂计算成本限制了交互式使用场景，需要高效的渐进式降维方案。
AI.method: 识别 UMAP 中的三个原子操作并重构为渐进式流水线；引入操作队列、逐实例局部连接（instance-wise local join）和调度策略等改进；利用 GPU 并行加速，在普通 GPU 硬件上支持百万级规模数据的交互分析。
AI.result: 在商用 GPU 上实现百万级数据集的交互式分析；并系统研究渐进式降维行为，包括投影随时间相对真实投影的演化，以及有偏数据流对投影质量与稳定性的影响。
AI.conclusion: GPUMAP 通过渐进式流水线重构与 GPU 加速，突破了 UMAP 的计算瓶颈，支持交互式大规模降维，并为渐进式降维的动态行为提供了系统性实证洞察。

title: RI-Prune: Relation and Information Aware Visual Token Pruning for Multi-Image Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have recently been extended to handle multiple input images, but this extension dramatically increases the visual token budget, making visual-token pruning not merely an efficiency option but a practical necessity. Existing visual-token pruning methods, primarily designed for the single-image setting, rely on attention-derived saliency signals to estimate per-token importance. However, this attention-centric design transfers poorly to the multi-image regime: it causes substantial performance degradation on multi-image benchmarks, suffers from strong positional bias, and loses discriminative attention signals as the number of input images increases. To test whether attention-selected tokens are truly important for multi-image reasoning, we conduct two complementary causal probes Leave-One-In and Leave-One-Deletion, which measure token importance by restoring individual tokens to a zeroed visual sequence or removing them from the full sequence. Attention-based pruners provide only marginal gains over random selection, showing that attention is a weak proxy for visual-token importance in multi-image reasoning. Motivated by this gap, we propose Relation and Information Aware Pruning (RI-Prune), a training-free, attention-free pre-decoder selector for multi-image visual token pruning. RI-Prune scores each visual token using a z-normalized combination of three signals computed from projector outputs: query relevance, cross-image correspondence with compact per-image prototypes, and intra image representativeness. By integrating these signals, RI-Prune performs balanced per-image Top-K selection to preserve information across input images. Across multiple multi-image benchmarks and three LVLM backbones, RI-Prune achieves a stronger trade-off between token reduction and task performance than prior pruning methods, particularly under aggressive token budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出无训练的 RI-Prune，用投影器输出的查询相关性、跨图原型对应与图内代表性三信号做多图视觉 token 剪枝，优于注意力类方法。
AI.motivation: 多图输入使视觉 token 预算激增，剪枝成为必需；但现有基于注意力的剪枝方法从单图迁移到多图效果差，存在位置偏置、注意力信号随图像数增多而退化，且因果实验证明注意力与随机选择差距很小，是弱代理信号。
AI.method: 先用 Leave-One-In 与 Leave-One-Deletion 两种因果探针验证注意力选择的有效性；再提出 RI-Prune：在解码器前、无需训练，基于投影器输出计算三路信号（查询相关性、与各图紧凑原型的跨图对应、图内代表性），z-normalize 后融合打分，并按图做均衡 Top-K 选择。
AI.result: 在多个多图基准与三个 LVLM 骨干上，RI-Prune 在 token 削减与性能的权衡上优于先前剪枝方法，激进 token 预算下优势尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 注意力并非多图推理中视觉 token 重要性的可靠指标；利用跨图关系与信息量的无注意力选择器能在多图场景下实现更优的剪枝-性能平衡。

title: Before You Continue: Evaluating Time-Sensitive Safety Awareness in Conversational Assistants
summary: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly help users with everyday activities that involve time-dependent constraints. However, users may not mention these constraints in later requests, requiring assistants to recognize and adjust their advice accordingly. To evaluate such capability, we introduce TASC (Temporal Action Safety in Conversation), a benchmark that evaluates whether LLMs apply time-dependent constraints when responding to conversational requests. TASC consists of 3,418 inputs derived from 128 templates, along with a separate set of 33 scenarios designed to compare models' ability to calculate elapsed time with their ability to apply that information. Across 13 models, assistants account for time-dependent constraints in only 30.5% of cases where the proposed action violates a rule, while rarely warning users unnecessarily. More importantly, models fail to apply these constraints in 62.1% of cases despite correctly calculating the elapsed time. Explicitly providing the timing resolves only about half of these failures, revealing a gap between temporal reasoning and its application in conversational advice.

AI.tldr: 提出 TASC 基准，评估 LLM 助手能否在对话请求中自动识别并应用时间相关约束，发现模型存在"时间推理"与"时间应用"之间的显著鸿沟。
AI.motivation: LLM 助手常用于处理带时间约束的日常事务，但用户在后续请求中往往不再复述这些约束，助手需自行识别并调整建议。现有评估缺少对此能力的系统考察。
AI.method: 构建 TASC 基准，包含来自 128 个模板的 3,418 条输入，以及 33 个专门场景，用于对比模型计算经过时间的能力与应用该信息的能力；在 13 个模型上进行评测。
AI.result: 在建议动作违反规则的案例中，助手仅 30.5% 会考虑时间约束，且很少做无谓警告；更关键的是，即使模型正确算出经过时间，仍有 62.1% 的情况未能应用该约束；显式给出时间信息也只能修复约一半的失败。
AI.conclusion: 模型在时间推理与在对话建议中应用时间信息之间存在明显差距；提升时间计算能力不等于能正确指导行为，需针对性改进约束应用能力。

title: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Personalized Reasoning of Vision-Language Models
summary: People often make decisions by holistically reasoning over heterogeneous forms of personal information. In this paper, we study the relatively underexplored capability of multimodal personalized reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). To this end, we introduce \texttt{MPRBench}, a novel and comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate personalized reasoning across a wide range of tasks and real-world challenges. \texttt{MPRBench} consists of 12 sub-tasks and additionally supports interpretable analysis of representative error cases. Through extensive experiments, we find that current personalized MLLMs still struggle with personalized reasoning due to several key challenges, including inaccurate recognition of personalized concepts and sensitivity to irrelevant personal information. We hope that MPRBench will stimulate further research on personalized reasoning in MLLMs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/kkdh15/MPRBench

AI.tldr: 论文提出MPRBench，一个用于评估多模态大模型（MLLMs）个性化推理能力的综合基准，涵盖12个子任务并支持可解释的错误分析，实验发现现有模型在个性化概念识别和抗无关信息干扰方面仍存在明显不足。
AI.motivation: 现实中人们常需综合异构个人信息进行整体决策，但多模态个性化推理这一能力在MLLMs中研究不足，且缺乏系统性的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建名为MPRBench的新基准，覆盖广泛任务与真实场景挑战，包含12个子任务，并设计支持代表性错误案例可解释分析的机制；随后对现有MLLMs开展大量实验评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，当前个性化MLLMs的个性化推理能力仍较弱，主要瓶颈在于对个性化概念识别不准确，以及对无关个人信息过于敏感。
AI.conclusion: 个性化多模态推理是MLLMs的重要且未被充分探索的能力；MPRBench提供评测与诊断工具，期望推动该方向后续研究，代码与数据已开源。

title: Cross-Asset Knowledge Transfer for Early Fault Detection of Data-Scarce Assets Without Target Fault Data
summary: Reliability management of industrial fleets depends on early fault warnings, yet lifecycle data across similar assets are highly imbalanced. A few assets accumulate run-to-failure histories, while newly installed or rarely failing assets provide only normal-condition data. This paper asks how diagnostic knowledge can be transferred from a data-rich source asset to a data-scarce target asset when no fault data have been observed on the target. We formulate cross-asset early fault detection as a zero-shot domain adaptation problem, in which zero-shot refers to the absence of target fault samples, and propose a framework that requires only normal data from the target. The framework comprises (1) a statistical process control step that labels the source asset run-to-failure data with an exponentially weighted moving average chart, reducing manual annotation to verifying flagged segments, (2) an Adapted Domain-Adversarial Neural Network (ADANN) that combines domain-adversarial training and a Maximum Mean Discrepancy penalty with an Adapted Classification-Domain (ACD) loss, which anchors the classifier normal region to the target own normal data, and (3) an ahead-of-time labeling scheme with a prediction horizon that targets incipient faults. Under an exact-classification assumption, a theoretical analysis characterizes the domain-adversarial term for a normal-only target and the alignment state in which source fault features remain separated from target normal features. On a public run-to-failure bearing dataset, ADANN attains the highest mean F1-score among four transfer baselines, with a nominally significant precision gain over the strongest baseline, and its robustness is examined under synthetic noise.

AI.tldr: 提出零样本跨资产早期故障检测框架，仅需目标资产正常数据，结合EWMA自动标注、ADANN域对抗与ACD损失、提前时域标注，在轴承数据集上F1最高。
AI.motivation: 工业车队中相似资产的生命周期数据高度不平衡：少数资产有完整失效历史，而新装或极少故障资产仅有正常数据。目标资产上无任何故障样本，如何从数据丰富源资产迁移诊断知识是核心问题。
AI.method: 将跨资产早期故障检测形式化为零样本域适应问题；框架含三部分：(1) 用EWMA控制图对源资产失效数据自动打标，人工仅需核验被标记片段；(2) 提出ADANN，融合域对抗训练、MMD惩罚与Adapted Classification-Domain(ACD)损失，将分类器正常区域锚定到目标自身正常数据；(3) 带预测时域的提前标注方案，针对早期故障；并在精确分类假设下给出域对抗项与对齐状态的理论分析。
AI.result: 在公开轴承失效数据集上，ADANN在四个迁移基线中取得最高平均F1分数，相比最强基线精度提升名义显著；并在合成噪声下检验了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 证明仅依赖目标正常数据即可实现跨资产早期故障检测的知识迁移，EWMA自动标注降低人工成本，ADANN结构对无故障目标样本场景有效。

title: SVGFaith: A Two-Layer Meta-Evaluation of Faithfulness Metrics for Text-to-SVG Generation
summary: Text-to-SVG systems are commonly evaluated by applying raster-image metrics to rasterised outputs, yet whether these scores capture fine-grained prompt faithfulness remains unclear. We introduce SVGFaith, a two-layer meta-evaluation framework in which the more faithful candidate of each pair is determined by construction or by human judgment.
