SVGFaith-Diagnostic contains 1,842 controlled contrastive pairs across eight capability axes, split evenly between two directions: two renderings compared against one prompt, and two descriptions compared against one rendering. SVGFaith-Arena contains 1,327 human-annotated comparisons of real generator outputs. On SVGFaith-Diagnostic, CLIP and three other image--text embedding metrics reach at least 0.789 pairwise accuracy on object identity but at most 0.672 on spatial relations and attribute binding, where chance is 0.5. We further introduce SVGFaith-Score, an interpretable pointwise metric. A domain-tuned decomposer turns each prompt into a dependency graph of atomic visual requirements, a visual question answering model scores whether each requirement is satisfied, and a requirement's score is discounted when its prerequisites score low. In addition to the overall score, the per-requirement scores show which requirements are judged unsatisfied and which inherit discounts from their prerequisites. SVGFaith-Score significantly outperforms all nine baselines, including a Qwen3.5-122B-A10B judge, on Arena and in both Diagnostic directions. Code and data: https://github.com/Yukinonooo/SVGFaith.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SVGFaith，一个两层元评估框架，用于检验文本到SVG系统的评价指标是否真正捕捉细粒度提示忠实度，并进一步提出可解释的逐点指标SVGFaith-Score。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到SVG系统常用栅格图像指标（如CLIP等图文嵌入）在栅格化输出上评分，但这些分数能否反映细粒度的提示忠实度并不清楚。
AI.method: 构建SVGFaith元评估框架：SVGFaith-Diagnostic含1,842个受控对比对，覆盖八个能力维度，均分为两个方向（同一提示对比两个渲染；同一渲染对比两个描述）；SVGFaith-Arena含1,327个人工标注的真实生成器对比。另提出SVGFaith-Score：领域微调的分解器将提示转为原子视觉需求的依赖图，用VQA模型判定每项需求是否满足，当先决条件得分低时对该需求得分打折，从而给出可解释的逐项得分。
AI.result: 在Diagnostic上，CLIP等四种图文嵌入指标在物体同一性上成对准确率至少0.789，但在空间关系和属性绑定上最多0.672（随机为0.5）。SVGFaith-Score在Arena及Diagnostic两个方向上均显著优于全部九个基线，包括Qwen3.5-122B-A10B评判模型。
AI.conclusion: 现有栅格图像指标在细粒度空间与属性维度上存在明显缺陷；基于依赖图分解与需求级VQA的可解释评分能更准确、更透明地评估文本到SVG生成的提示忠实度。

title: Persona Perspectives: Adopting Viewpoints Reorganizes Representations in LLMs
summary: Common methods for monitoring features in large language models (LLMs) such as linear probes and sparse autoencoders (SAEs) assume that features maintain a consistent representation across contexts. LLMs, however, can flexibly adopt different perspectives or "personas" that suggest different underlying systems of conceptual relations. In this paper, we examine whether prompting an LLM to adopt a persona alters the representational geometry of the model's latent space. We extract representations of over 9,000 common words and 33 semantic axes from models adopting liberal and conservative political personas and compare these against two neutral baselines. We find that persona conditioning systematically alters both the projections of words onto semantic axes and the alignments among the axes themselves in directions consistent with the specified ideology. We then test the implications of this reorganization for two safety-relevant features: truthfulness and morality. Linear probes, SAE-based classifiers, and classifiers built from manually selected word representations, all trained without a persona, produce divergent results when applied to models conditioned on political personas, producing politically slanted ratings of truth and morality on controversial statements. These findings suggest that internal representations, as they are conventionally extracted, can exhibit different geometric relations when the model adopts personas, potentially undermining monitoring efforts.

AI.tldr: 论文探究人格提示（自由派/保守派）是否改变LLM潜空间的表征几何，并发现这种重组会削弱现有特征监测手段（线性探针、SAE）的可靠性，导致对真实性与道德性的评分出现政治偏见。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM特征监测方法（线性探针、稀疏自编码器）假设特征在不同语境下表征一致；但LLM可灵活采用不同"人格"，暗示其概念关系系统可能不同，这一假设可能不成立。
AI.method: 提取9000余个常用词与33个语义轴的表征，在自由派与保守派政治人格提示下分别测量，与两个中性基线对比；随后用线性探针、SAE分类器和人工选词构建的分类器（均无人物人格训练）测试真实性与道德性两项安全相关特征。
AI.result: 人格条件系统性地改变了词在语义轴上的投影以及各语义轴之间的对齐方向，且变化方向与指定意识形态一致；无人物人格训练的三类分类器在有政治人格条件下产生分歧，对争议性陈述给出带政治倾向的真实性与道德性评分。
AI.conclusion: 按常规方式提取的内部表征在模型采用人格时会呈现不同的几何关系，可能削弱监测工作的有效性，需重新审视特征监测的一致性假设。

title: DyPSI: Dynamic Physics Sensing via Joint Field and Sensor-Trajectory Generation
summary: Physics sensing in evolving environments requires reconstructing dense spatiotemporal fields from sparse observations while adapting where future observations should be collected. Existing reconstruction and sensor-placement methods have made substantial progress, but they typically rely on static sensing assumptions: they either use a single layout across all frames or optimize placements independently at each frame, which limits their ability to produce temporally coherent sensing trajectories. We introduce DyPSI, a dynamic physics sensing framework that formulates this problem as the joint generation of future fields and sensor trajectories conditioned on historical observations. DyPSI lifts discrete sensor coordinates into continuous Sensor Position Fields, encodes fields and sensing configurations with a shared Functional Tucker representation, and trains a joint diffusion model to generate future fields and sensing trajectories simultaneously in the resulting latent space. A Gaussian-process temporal kernel correlates the perturbation injected during diffusion training, biasing the denoiser toward temporally smooth recoveries, and we further provide an analysis linking the EDM training objective to a sequence-aggregated A-optimality criterion and a kernel-induced bound on discrete trajectory variation. Experiments on turbulent flow, GLORYS12 sea-surface temperature, and 3D car aerodynamics show that DyPSI consistently outperforms static and frame-wise placement strategies, with substantial error reduction under tight sensor budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/mengqi132/DyPSI.

AI.tldr: DyPSI 是一个动态物理感知框架，将稀疏观测下的时空场重建与传感器轨迹规划统一为“未来场+传感器轨迹”的联合生成问题，并通过共享 Tucker 表示与联合扩散模型在隐空间中同时生成二者。
AI.motivation: 现有重建与传感器布点方法依赖静态感知假设：要么所有帧使用同一布局，要么逐帧独立优化布点，难以产生时间上连贯的传感轨迹，且在传感器预算紧张时效果受限。
AI.method: 将离散传感器坐标提升为连续的 Sensor Position Field；用共享的 Functional Tucker 表示编码场与感知配置；训练联合扩散模型在隐空间中同时生成未来场和传感器轨迹；引入高斯过程时间核关联扩散训练中的扰动，使去噪器偏向时间平滑解；并给出理论分析，将 EDM 训练目标与序列聚合 A-最优性准则联系，并导出核诱导的离散轨迹变化上界。
AI.result: 在湍流、GLORYS12 海表温度和三维汽车空气动力学数据上，DyPSI 一致优于静态布点与逐帧布点策略，在严格传感器预算下误差显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 联合生成未来场与传感轨迹、并以时间核约束扩散过程的思路，能有效实现时间连贯的动态物理感知，是稀疏观测下时空重建与主动布点的有效方案。

title: Separation Is a Riesz Energy: How Many Environments Does ICA Need?
summary: Can independent components be recovered when all of them are Gaussian? Yes, if their variances change across environments; but how many environments, and how many samples as the number of components $d$ grows? We answer both for the joint diagonalization of $K$ covariances. Each component has a signature, its variances across the environments. Separating component $j$ costs the Riesz 2-energy $E_j$ of this signature, a sum, over the other components, of inverse pairwise Fisher informations. For Gaussian sources no estimator in $O(d)$ beats $cE_j/(n+E_j)$ at any $n$ and $d$, and above an explicit sample size a spectral estimator attains $E_j/n$ up to a constant, for every mixing and without the signatures (given a lower bound on the pairwise information). Since signatures live in $K-1$ dimensions, the rate obeys a dimension law: $d^2/n$, $d\log d/n$ and $d/n$ for $K=2$, $3$ and $K\ge4$ well-spread environments. What counts is the dimension the signatures span, not their number, and $\log d$ well-designed environments make $d\log d$ samples suffice. Projecting the covariances onto one linear combination pays $d^2/n$ at first order instead. In simulations up to $d=1000$ the predictions hold and joint diagonalization with $K\ge4$ attains the rate once $n/d$ is in the hundreds; on task fMRI the energy says which components are hard to separate.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多环境高斯独立成分分析的样本复杂度：用签名的Riesz 2-能量刻画分量可分性，给出信息下界与谱估计器相合速率，并提出维度律。
AI.motivation: 高斯ICA在单环境下不可辨识；利用方差随环境变化可实现分离，但环境数K与样本数n随分量数d增长的规律尚不清晰。
AI.method: 针对K个协方差的联合对角化：每个分量有跨环境方差的"签名"，用签名的Riesz 2-能量E_j（其他分量两两Fisher信息倒数和）度量分离代价；给出O(d)估计器的下界cE_j/(n+E_j)与谱估计器达到E_j/n（无需已知签名，仅需两两信息下界）。
AI.result: 导出维度律：K=2、3、K≥4时分别需d²/n、d log d/n、d/n；关键在于签名张成的维度而非环境数，log d个良好设计环境即可使d log d样本足够；一维投影则退化为d²/n。d≤1000仿真验证，fMRI上能量可指示难分离成分。
AI.conclusion: 高斯成分的可辨识性由签名的有效维度决定，联合对角化在足够多环境时显著降低样本需求，Riesz 2-能量是实用的分离难度指标。

title: TouchéWorld tech report : Towards Online Unified Camera--Hand Exploration in Generative Worlds
summary: Recent video world models allow users to explore generated environments through camera navigation. Continuous hand motion provides a fine-grained action channel for interacting with the people and objects encountered during exploration. We present TouchéWorld, a framework that integrates gesture-driven interaction into a camera-controlled video world model. Given an initial image and a scene-description prompt, the model generates video conditioned on temporally aligned camera and hand controls. We construct joint camera--hand training data from heterogeneous egocentric videos through annotation completion, consistency-based filtering, and temporal alignment. Building on a pretrained camera-controlled world model, we combine spatial hand-skeleton conditioning with numerical hand-motion features through parameter-efficient adaptation. Causal adaptation and few-step distillation support chunk-level online generation, allowing users to update their controls based on generated visual feedback. We further introduce TouchéBench to evaluate hand-motion following, camera--hand coordination, online interaction, and object response. Together, these components establish a framework for studying continuous exploration and hand-driven interaction within generative worlds.

AI.tldr: TouchéWorld 将手势驱动交互引入相机控制的视频世界模型，实现同时以相机和手部运动为条件的在线视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型允许用户通过相机导航探索生成环境，但缺乏对人与物体进行细粒度交互的动作通道；连续手部运动可提供这种细粒度交互信号，因此需要把手势交互整合进相机控制的视频世界模型。
AI.method: 从异构自我中心视频中构建相机—手部联合训练数据（标注补全、基于一致性的过滤、时间对齐）；在预训练相机控制世界模型基础上，结合空间手部骨架条件与数值手部运动特征，并以参数高效方式适配；采用因果适配与少步蒸馏支持分块在线生成，使用户能根据生成视觉反馈更新控制。
AI.result: 提出 TouchéBench，用于评估手部运动跟随、相机—手部协调、在线交互与物体响应四个方面。
AI.conclusion: 上述组件共同构建了一个用于研究生成世界中连续探索与手部驱动交互的框架。

title: Rubric Curriculum RL: Exploiting the Generation-Verification Gap in Non-Verifiable Domains
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has led to significant gains in math and code generation. Extending these gains to open-ended domains remains challenging: ground-truth verification is unavailable, human annotation is expensive, and learned reward models are prone to reward hacking. The generation-verification gap, where judging good outputs is easier than producing them, offers a potential path to improvement. However, rubric-based judges are often imprecise and stationary, so policies can overfit or reward hack them. We introduce Rubric Curriculum RL (RcRL), which exploits this gap without new data, human annotations, or stronger teacher models. We combine pairwise preferences over rollouts with a curriculum over rubric criteria, yielding a more discriminative signal than absolute scoring and a non-stationary objective. Whereas baselines plateau within a few hundred steps, RcRL preserves output entropy and keeps improving past 1000 steps. On creative writing, RcRL achieves a 70.5% human win rate against the base model, with gains across benchmarks and judges. On HealthBench, RcRL improves over the base model by 14.6% (full set) and 25.4% (consensus subset), outperforming all training baselines, including instance-specific rubrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Rubric Curriculum RL（RcRL），利用"评判比生成容易"的生成-验证差距，通过将成对偏好比较与评分标准（rubric）的课程学习结合，在无需新数据、人工标注或更强教师模型的情况下，把 RLVR 扩展到开放式任务并避免奖励作弊。
AI.motivation: RLVR 在数学和代码任务上收益显著，但扩展到开放式领域面临困难：缺乏可靠的真值验证、人工标注昂贵、学习型奖励模型易被 reward hacking。虽然"生成-验证差距"提供了改进路径，但基于 rubric 的评判器往往不精确且静止不变，导致策略过拟合或作弊。
AI.method: RcRL 不依赖新数据、人工标注或更强教师模型。它把对多次 rollout 的成对偏好比较（比绝对打分更具判别力）与 rubric 标准的课程（curriculum）相结合，从而构造出非平稳的训练目标，持续提供区分性更强的信号。
AI.result: 基线在数百步内即进入平台期，而 RcRL 保持输出熵并持续提升超过 1000 步。创意写作任务上对基础模型取得 70.5% 的人类胜率，并在多个基准和评判器上均有提升。HealthBench 上相对基础模型提升 14.6%（全集）和 25.4%（共识子集），优于包括实例专属 rubric 在内的所有训练基线。
AI.conclusion: 将成对偏好与 rubric 课程结合是一种无需额外监督即可利用生成-验证差距的有效方法，可缓解奖励作弊、维持探索，并在开放式生成任务上带来持续且可验证的性能提升。

title: RouTex: Multi-reference 3D Texture Generation by Reprogramming Rotary Position Encoding
summary: While single-image 3D texture generation has advanced significantly, conditioning texture synthesis on multi-view reference images remains largely under-explored, despite its necessity for resolving surface ambiguity in unobserved regions. In this paper, we propose RouTex, a novel multi-reference 3D texture generation framework based on in-context Diffusion Transformers (DiT). Our key insight is that native 3D Rotary Position Encoding (RoPE) inherently possesses spatial addressing capabilities. We introduce Positional Routing (PR) to reprogram 3D RoPE along spatial and semantic dimensions, establishing explicit reference-to-view correspondence without introducing additional parameters. To execute this routing efficiently, Dual-Granularity Attention (DGA) combines per-view local attention for fine texture fidelity with global joint attention over deduplicated references for cross-view consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RouTex achieves new state-of-the-art performance in multi-reference 3D texture generation.

AI.tldr: RouTex 提出基于 in-context DiT 的多参考图 3D 纹理生成框架，利用 3D RoPE 的空间寻址能力实现无需额外参数的位置路由，配合双粒度注意力取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 单图 3D 纹理生成已较成熟，但以多视角参考图作为条件仍被忽视；多参考图对解决未观测区域的表面对应歧义至关重要。
AI.method: 基于 in-context Diffusion Transformer。核心是位置路由（Positional Routing, PR），沿空间与语义维度重编程原生 3D RoPE，建立显式参考—视角对应关系且不增加参数；并设计双粒度注意力（DGA），由逐视角局部注意力保证纹理细节，加去重参考上的全局联合注意力保证跨视角一致性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 RouTex 在多参考图 3D 纹理生成任务上达到新的 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 将 3D RoPE 重新解读为空间寻址机制，可高效实现多参考条件注入，为多参考 3D 纹理生成提供了有效范例。

title: SpecCompact: Accelerating LLM Agent Context Compaction with Slot-Parallel Semantic Speculative Verification
summary: LLM agents use context compaction to manage growing interaction histories, but summarizing long histories with large models can introduce substantial delays. Compaction therefore requires balancing information retention against latency. We observe that structured summary slots can retain information when generated independently. Based on this observation, we present SpecCompact, a framework that accelerates compaction through slot-parallel semantic speculation. SpecCompact fine-tunes a small drafter and generates slots in parallel. The target model verifies each proposed line and repairs rejected content, while subsequent drafting uses the updated slot prefix. System optimizations further reduce repeated context processing and model calls. Across AppWorld and $τ^3$ benchmarks with two target models, SpecCompact achieves $2.04$--$5.63\times$ compaction speedups over Hermes-style summarization. Separate downstream evaluations reveal model- and task-dependent performance trade-offs. A user study within Hermes further shows an $8.68\times$ median compaction speedup.

AI.tldr: SpecCompact 通过“槽位并行语义推测”加速 LLM 代理的上下文压缩：用小草稿模型并行生成结构化摘要槽位，再由目标模型逐行验证与修复，从而在信息保留与延迟间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: LLM 代理需压缩不断增长的交互历史，但用大模型总结长历史会带来显著延迟，因此压缩必须在信息保留与延迟之间权衡。
AI.method: 观察到结构化摘要槽位可独立生成并保留信息，据此提出 SpecCompact：微调小型草稿模型并行生成各槽位；目标模型逐行验证并修复被拒内容，后续草稿使用更新后的槽位前缀；并加入系统优化以减少重复上下文处理与模型调用。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 与 τ³ 基准、两种目标模型上，相比 Hermes 式摘要实现 2.04–5.63× 压缩加速；独立下游评测显示性能权衡依赖模型与任务；Hermes 内用户研究显示中位压缩加速 8.68×。
AI.conclusion: 槽位并行的推测式压缩能有效降低压缩延迟，但下游效果存在模型与任务依赖性，需按场景权衡。

title: STEK: Structural-Terrain-Enhanced Koopman-Inspired Cross-Channel Regularization for Retrospective Battery Multi-Target Estimation
summary: Retrospective battery characterization across heterogeneous cells is challenging because cycling records vary substantially with chemistry, protocol, cell format, capacity, and operating conditions. An endpoint charge--discharge curve captures the local condition of an evaluated cycle, while a cell-level lifecycle terrain summarizes structural evolution across the archived trajectory. We propose STEK, a structural-terrain-enhanced framework for retrospective battery multi-target estimation. STEK combines a cell-level lifecycle (dQ/dV) terrain with an endpoint-derived structural proxy through quality-proxy-conditioned gating. Bounded FiLM and a validity-gated residual head refine the endpoint-curve representation while preserving a curve-based prediction pathway. Battery-type and optional material-text representations further condition an identity-centered low-rank linear map, providing a Koopman-inspired cross-channel consistency objective without modeling temporal dynamics or performing rollout. Under the fixed seven-output MIX-battery protocol, the full retrospective setting improves aggregate performance over endpoint-only learned baselines across multiple temporal backbones; this comparison reflects both the additional archived context and the modeling design. Under matched auxiliary inputs, STEK outperforms direct concatenation and quality-unaware FiLM, while descriptor-removal tests show graceful fallback to the endpoint pathway. Deterministic rules remain preferable for directly recoverable capacity summaries. The method targets retrospective archive harmonization rather than online estimation from cycle t alone.

AI.tldr: 提出STEK框架，将电池级生命周期dQ/dV地形与端点充放电曲线结构代理结合，实现跨异质电池的回溯式多目标估计。
AI.motivation: 异质电池（化学体系、协议、格式、容量、工况各异）的回溯性表征困难，单一端点曲线只能反映局部状态，缺乏跨轨迹的结构演化信息，且现有方法难以稳健处理异质档案。
AI.method: STEK以质量代理条件门控融合cell级生命周期(dQ/dV)地形与端点曲线导出的结构代理；用有界FiLM与有效性门控残差头精化端点表示并保留纯曲线预测通路；电池类型与可选材料文本表示条件化一个以身份为中心的低秩线性映射，提供受Koopman启发的跨通道一致性目标（不建模时序动态、不做rollout）。
AI.result: 在固定七输出MIX-battery协议下，完整回溯设置相比仅端点学习基线在多时序骨干上提升总体性能；匹配辅助输入时优于直接拼接与无质量感知FiLM；描述子移除实验显示可优雅回退至端点通路；可直接恢复的容量汇总仍宜用确定性规则。
AI.conclusion: STEK面向回溯档案协调而非仅凭cycle t的在线估计，通过结构地形增强提升了异质电池多目标估计的鲁棒性与一致性。

title: Learning Noise Optimization for Reward Alignment in Few-Step Generative Models
summary: Reward alignment for diffusion- and flow-based generative models is often formulated over stochastic trajectories, making it less suitable for few-step deterministic generators. Initial noise optimization provides a trajectory-free alternative, but existing gradient-free methods require costly per-sample search at inference. We introduce LeNO (Learning Noise Optimization), which amortizes reward-guided initial noise optimization into a learned residual transport while keeping the pretrained generator frozen. LeNO learns an anchor-conditioned distribution over noise corrections using Local GRPO and scalar rewards, eliminating iterative test-time optimization. For Gaussian initial noise with norm-preserving projection, we derive a tractable upper bound on the KL divergence between the corrected noise distribution and the original prior, providing a principled regularization objective. We evaluate LeNO on few-step text-to-image and protein structure generation, including expensive black-box designability rewards. Across both domains, LeNO improves target rewards with a single noise correction at inference while largely preserving generation quality and diversity.

AI.tldr: LeNO 提出用学习到的残差传输来摊销奖励引导的初始噪声优化，将推理时的迭代搜索转为一次前向修正，在少步文本到图像与蛋白质结构生成中提升奖励。
AI.motivation: 扩散/流模型的奖励对齐多建立在随机轨迹上，不适合少步确定性生成器；而初始噪声优化虽无需轨迹，但现有无梯度方法需在推理时逐样本昂贵搜索。
AI.method: 保持预训练生成器冻结，学习一个以锚点为条件的噪声修正分布（残差传输），用 Local GRPO 与标量奖励训练，从而消除测试时迭代优化；对高斯初始噪声采用保范投影，并推导修正后噪声分布与先验之间 KL 散度的可处理上界，作为有原则的正则项。
AI.result: 在少步文本到图像和蛋白质结构生成（含昂贵的黑盒可设计性奖励）上，LeNO 仅需推理时一次噪声修正即可提升目标奖励，同时较好保持生成质量与多样性。
AI.conclusion: 将奖励引导的噪声优化摊销为学习式残差传输是少步确定性生成器对齐的有效途径，兼顾奖励提升、质量多样性与推理效率。

title: SleuthVLM: Do We Really Need Audio-in-Video for Omni Video Understanding?
summary: Omni models answer questions about videos by jointly processing sampled frames and audio in one turn, with progress driven largely by scaling model size and omni training data. We ask whether a model needs to hear the audio directly at all, and present SleuthVLM, an agent harness built on a VLM that never hears the audio directly: speech will be transcribed into text, and the VLM will sleuth the video on its own without any predefined workflow. On four omni benchmarks with videos up to 90 minutes, SleuthVLM achieves the best average accuracy: \textbf{75.0%}, 2.6 points above Gemini 3.8 Flash, and it also tops the Video-MME-v2 leaderboard with \textbf{77.8%}; with an open-source 27B VLM, it beats all open-source omni models. We draw three findings: SleuthVLM beats a model that glances; hearing is not the bottleneck, agentic ability is; omni understanding needs better agentic ability, not just more omni data for modality alignment. So we provide a simple but effective starting point for doing omni video understanding. Omni understanding needs better agents, not just bigger models that hear.

AI.tldr: 提出 SleuthVLM：不直接听音频的 VLM 智能体框架，通过语音转文本+自主取证，在四个 omni 基准上平均 75.0%（超 Gemini 3.8 Flash 2.6 点），Video-MME-v2 达 77.8%，主张瓶颈在智能体能力而非"听"。
AI.motivation: 当前 omni 模型靠扩大模型规模与 omni 训练数据来联合处理视频帧与音频，作者质疑模型是否必须直接"听"音频，并怀疑瓶颈其实不在模态对齐而在智能体能力。
AI.method: SleuthVLM 是一个建立在纯 VLM 之上的 agent harness：先将语音转写为文本，再由 VLM 在无预定义工作流的情况下自主"侦查"视频（自主规划、调用工具、多轮取证）。
AI.result: 在四个 omni 基准（视频最长 90 分钟）上平均准确率最佳：75.0%，高于 Gemini 3.8 Flash 2.6 点；Video-MME-v2 榜首 77.8%；在开源 27B VLM 上超越所有开源 omni 模型。
AI.conclusion: 三点结论：SleuthVLM 胜过"瞥一眼"式模型；听觉不是瓶颈，智能体能力才是；omni 理解需要更强的智能体能力，而非更多用于模态对齐的 omni 数据。因此给出一个简单有效的 omni 视频理解起点——需要更好的智能体，而非更大、能"听"的模型。

title: EnzymeRSI: A dual-loop recursive self-improvement system for enzyme design
summary: Improvement in enzyme engineering is usually pursued by optimising which candidates to assay within a fixed model and workflow; when the bottleneck arises from a mismatched method or a failing workflow, that route is difficult to escape. We present EnzymeRSI, a dual-loop system for recursive self-improvement (RSI). The outer loop evolves harness assets without changing model weights, the inner loop develops prediction and selection algorithms under controlled conditions, and a cloud laboratory system is specified to close the physical loop with quality-controlled feedback. By updating its prediction strategy through iterative comparison, the outer loop raised the mean development-set Spearman correlation on ProteinGym by 0.044 across five assays, reaching 0.335 on CD19 and 0.683 on OPSD (rhodopsin); of the two first places, only CD19 was produced by the outer loop itself. In the self-improvement of the ThermoMPNN algorithm the inner loop reached a PCC of 0.849, and on TadA-Bench it reached a Spearman correlation of 0.307 in 1.13 h. In three prospective wet-lab tests of the system's experimental decision-making, 10 of the 32 candidates that had not been pre-specified for the luciferase RLuc showed at least twice the wild-type activity; a recommended variant of the cytidine deaminase A3A raised 5mC conversion to 90.2%; and path selection in evolution raised the catalytic efficiency of the DNA polymerase KOD-E on a modified substrate to 31.1 times that of the parent. By treating the organisation of the research workflow and the development of algorithms as a single falsifiable dry-to-wet loop, this work offers an evolutionary paradigm for moving beyond the blind spots of a fixed method and for autonomous enzyme engineering.

AI.tldr: 提出EnzymeRSI双环递归自我改进系统：外环演化研究流程资产（不改权重），内环受控开发预测与选择算法，并以云实验室闭环；在ProteinGym、ThermoMPNN、TadA-Bench及三项湿实验（RLuc、A3A、KOD-E）上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 传统酶工程优化只在固定模型与流程内挑选候选，一旦瓶颈来自方法不匹配或流程失败便难以突破，需要一种能同时改进"研究组织流程"与"算法开发"的自我改进范式。
AI.method: EnzymeRSI双环递归自我改进架构：外环在不改变模型权重前提下演化harness资产，通过迭代比较更新预测策略；内环在受控条件下开发预测与选择算法；并设计云实验室系统，以质控反馈闭合物理（干湿）环路。
AI.result: 外环在ProteinGym五个assay上平均Spearman提升0.044，CD19达0.335、OPSD达0.683（两处第一仅CD19出自外环）；内环在ThermoMPNN自改进中PCC达0.849，TadA-Bench上1.13小时达Spearman 0.307。湿实验：RLuc未预设的32个候选中10个活性≥2倍野生型；A3A变体使5mC转化率达90.2%；KOD-E催化效率达亲本31.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 将研究流程组织与算法开发统一为可证伪的干湿闭环，为突破固定方法盲区、实现自主酶工程提供演化式范式。

title: Learning Pseudo-Riemannian Manifolds for Heterophilic Graphs via Graph Signature
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 41 pages, including appendix
summary: Several widely used families of Graph Neural Networks carry a positive-definite geometric prior. Graph convolution read as heat diffusion needs a positive semi-definite operator, hyperbolic models place features on positive-definite Riemannian manifolds, and dot-product and GAT-style attention scores use positive-definite inner products. On heterophilic graphs, where edges often signify dissimilarity or structural repulsion, that prior is a mismatch: no positive-definite form can assign a negative squared distance to a direction the labels separate. To measure the mismatch, we introduce the Graph Signature Index ($s_{\mathcal{G}}$), the inertia of a class-compatibility matrix built from label topology alone, and we prove that no value of the edge or node homophily index in $(0,1)$ rules out a negative eigenvalue. We then propose the Pseudo-Riemannian Attention Network (PRAT), whose attention logit is a signed squared pseudo-distance under a learnable diagonal metric initialized from $s_{\mathcal{G}}$. The design is diagnose-then-learn: the signature supplies a sign structure that unconstrained training keeps outside near-zero directions, and the projection learns the rest of the metric around it. Across fifteen node-classification benchmarks PRAT outperforms or matches the strongest heterophily-adapted models. A controlled ablation ties that performance to the sign structure itself: with architecture and protocol fixed, forbidding the metric to be indefinite costs accuracy on the graphs $s_{\mathcal{G}}$ marks as indefinite and leaves the others unchanged.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出常用的图神经网络（GNN）带有正定几何先验，这在异配图上是错配的，并提出用图签名指数 $s_{\mathcal{G}}$ 来诊断这一错配，进而提出伪黎曼注意力网络 PRAT，用可学习对角伪度量构造带符号的注意力。
AI.motivation: 热扩散式图卷积需半正定算子、双曲模型把特征放在正定黎曼流形、点积/GAT 注意力用正定内积，这些正定几何先验在异配图上不合适——因为在标签区分的方向上，任何正定形式都无法给出负的平方距离。作者想量化并解决这种几何错配。
AI.method: 1) 提出 Graph Signature Index $s_{\mathcal{G}}$：仅由标签拓扑构造类兼容矩阵，并用其惯性（特征值符号结构）来度量错配，且证明边/点同配指数在 (0,1) 内任何取值都不能排除负特征值。2) 提出 PRAT（Pseudo-Riemannian Attention Network）：注意力 logit 为可学习对角度量下的带符号平方伪距离，该度量由 $s_{\mathcal{G}}$ 初始化。3) 采用“先诊断后学习”策略：签名给出符号结构，不受约束的训练使其保持在近零方向之外，投影学习度量的其余部分。
AI.result: 在 15 个节点分类基准上，PRAT 超过或匹配最强异配适配模型。受控消融显示：固定架构与协议、禁止度量为不定度量时，在被 $s_{\mathcal{G}}$ 标记为不定的图上精度下降，其余图不变——说明性能与符号结构本身相关。
AI.conclusion: 异配图的几何错配可由标签拓扑的签名指数诊断；采用伪黎曼（不定）度量的注意力在网络中是有效且必要的，符号结构是性能提升的关键因素，PRAT 在异配节点分类上表现强。

title: GeoBiaset: A Counterfactual Benchmark for Demographic Bias in World-Level Geolocalization
comment: Accepted at Neurips 2026, E&D track. Project page: https://miccunifi.github.io/GeoBiaset/
summary: World-level image geolocalization is an increasingly important task, yet the biases of current models remain poorly understood. Prior work has identified coarse dataset imbalances noting, for instance, that some cities are absent from training sets and that models tend to perform better in wealthier regions. However, no one has yet examined which visual cues drive these disparities. To do so, we introduce GeoBiaset, the first benchmark designed to measure how geolocalization models are influenced by the apparent race of a person inserted into the image foreground. The dataset consists of 9,541 images, pairing existing geotagged background images with counterfactual edits spanning seven races, holding the ground-truth coordinates fixed. Controlled masking experiments show that occlusion and background drift do not fully explain geolocalization degradation. Alongside the benchmark, we introduce the Person-Origin Perturbation Indicators (POPI), novel metrics that quantify model resilience to these demographic perturbations by measuring whether predictions are pulled toward the region associated with the inserted group. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art geolocalization and multimodal large language models reveals a 16-47% drop in continent-level performance when a subject from a demographically mismatched group is inserted. A landmark versus no-landmark analysis and gradient-weighted heatmaps show that models preferentially attend to geographic landmarks when present, but shift attention to facial features in their absence.

AI.tldr: 提出首个衡量"前景人物表观种族"如何影响图像地理定位模型的基准 GeoBiaset（9,541 张反事实编辑图像，覆盖7个种族），并给出新指标 POPI 量化模型对人口统计扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 已有工作只发现数据集层面的粗略偏差（某些城市缺失、富裕地区表现更好），但尚无人研究哪些视觉线索驱动了这些差异。
AI.method: 构建 GeoBiaset：将带地理标签的背景图与7种种族的前景人物反事实编辑配对，真值坐标保持不变；用受控遮挡实验排除了遮挡与背景漂移的解释；提出 Person-Origin Perturbation Indicators (POPI)，度量预测是否被拉向与插入群体相关的地区。
AI.result: 评估 SOTA 地理定位模型和多模态大语言模型：当插入人口统计不匹配群体时，大洲级定位性能下降 16–47%。地标/无地标分析与梯度加权热图显示，有地标时模型优先关注地理地标，无地标时注意力转向人脸特征。
AI.conclusion: 种族相关的前景线索可显著左右地理定位结果，模型在缺乏地标时依赖人脸特征进行推断，揭示了此前未被量化的视觉线索级偏差。

title: Corralling AI Risks with Grassroots Contracts
summary:
AI's inflection point is a fountain of alarming risks. Digital platforms in particular are vulnerable to three major AI risks, as those in control of global platforms cede control to AI, of the algorithms, of membership and of content: (1) AI control of global platforms, social and economic, used by the majority of humanity, resulting in the majority of humanity becoming vulnerable to AI control. (2) Unaccountable AI agents operating anonymously on social and economic digital platforms, side-by-side with humans, possibly masquerading as humans, serving unknown masters with unknown goals, operating under unknown restraints without accountability or culpability. (3) Unattributed deepfakes generated by anonymous AI, with people unable to distinguish them from genuine content and with their producers evading accountability and culpability.
  Here, we propose to corral these AI risks with grassroots contracts, a digital incarnation of a two-centuries old notion of Pierre-Joseph Proudhon. We present grassroots contracts for a social graph with accountable AI agents and for a social network with digital provenance, and working smartphone apps that implement the two and show how they corral these major AI risks: (1) AI control of global platforms. (2) Unaccountable AI agents. (3) Unattributed deepfakes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"草根契约"(grassroots contracts)这一数字化构想，用于约束全球平台上的三大AI风险，并提供两款智能手机App实现可问责AI代理的社会图谱与带数字溯源的社交网络。
AI.motivation: AI进入拐点带来严重风险。掌控全球平台的少数主体将算法、成员资格与内容的控制权让渡给AI，导致三类风险：(1) 人类多数被AI控制；(2) 不负责的匿名AI代理冒充人类、目标与约束未知；(3) 无法溯源的深度伪造使生产者逃避追责。
AI.method: 借鉴Proudhon两百年前的契约思想，提出其数字化形态"草根契约"；分别设计用于"可问责AI代理的社会图谱"和"数字溯源的社交网络"的草根契约，并实现两款可运行的智能手机App。
AI.result: 两款App的实现展示了草根契约对三类风险的约束作用：AI对全球平台的控制、不可问责的AI代理、无法溯源的深度伪造。
AI.conclusion: 以去中心化、契约式的草根机制可在平台层面缓解AI相关的控制、问责与真实性风险，智能手机App验证了其可行性。

title: Consistency Learning and Distillation for One-Step MIMO-OFDM Channel Estimation
summary: Iterative neural channel estimators can improve recovery under pilot contamination, but repeated network evaluations increase inference cost. This paper develops observation-anchored consistency and Consistency Mid-Training (CMT) estimators for one-step channel estimation in multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) systems. Both estimators refine pilot-derived least-squares channel estimates in the delay-beam domain. Consistency learning couples endpoint predictions along noisy-to-clean paths. CMT then refines a compact consistency-trained student to predict a flow-matching teacher's endpoint from intermediate trajectory states. Across the evaluated SNR range, the compact CMT student reduces uncoded symbol error rate (SER) by 9.6-20.2% relative to the one-step flow-matching baseline (0.44-0.98 dB in logarithmic SER reduction), while using 74.5% fewer parameters and 73.0% fewer network multiply-accumulates.

AI.tldr: 提出观测锚定一致性学习与Consistency Mid-Training (CMT)估计器，实现MIMO-OFDM信道的一步估计，在降低推理成本的同时提升SER性能。
AI.motivation: 迭代神经网络信道估计器能在导频污染下改善恢复效果，但重复网络评估增加了推理成本，需要一步估计方案。
AI.method: 在时延-波束域对导频导出的最小二乘信道估计进行精化；一致性学习将含噪到干净路径的两端预测耦合；CMT进一步训练紧凑的、经一致性训练的学生模型，从中间轨迹状态预测flow-matching教师模型的端点。
AI.result: 在评估的SNR范围内，紧凑CMT学生模型相较一步flow-matching基线将未编码SER降低9.6–20.2%（对数SER降低0.44–0.98 dB），同时参数量减少74.5%、乘加运算减少73.0%。
AI.conclusion: CMT可在显著降低参数与计算量的前提下，以一步推理超越flow-matching基线，兼顾性能与效率。

title: STARE: Scene Text-Aware multimodal Retrieval for Everyday objects
summary: In this study, we focus on service robots that retrieve and transport everyday objects based on free-form instructions that may refer to visual features and scene text. This is challenging because it requires a multimodal understanding of the visual features and spatial relationships of objects, as well as scene text embedded in the environment. To address this, we propose Scene Text-Aware multimodal Retrieval for Everyday objects (STARE), which leverages visual and textual cues in response to free-form instructions. STARE introduces Crosslingual Visual Prompt to enhance scene text interpretation, and models the complex relationships between named entities in the instructions and their corresponding objects. We evaluate STARE using two novel benchmarks, GoGetIt and TextCaps-test, both of which consist of real-world indoor/outdoor images and instructions involving object manipulation and navigation. The results show that STARE outperforms all baseline methods on standard multimodal retrieval metrics. Furthermore, in physical experiments conducted under a zero-shot transfer setting, STARE achieves an overall success rate of 80%. Our project page and code are provided in the Supplementary Materials.

AI.tldr: 提出STARE方法，让服务机器人依据自由形式指令（含视觉特征与场景文字）检索并搬运日常物品，通过跨语言视觉提示与实体关系建模提升多模态检索，新基准上超越所有基线，零样本真机成功率80%。
AI.motivation: 服务机器人需按自由指令取送物品，指令可能同时涉及视觉特征和环境中嵌入的场景文字，要求对物体视觉特征、空间关系及场景文字做多模态理解，现有方法难以应对。
AI.method: STARE框架融合视觉与文本线索响应自由指令；引入Crosslingual Visual Prompt增强场景文字解读，并建模指令中命名实体与对应物体间的复杂关系；在GoGetIt与TextCaps-test两个新基准（真实室内外图像、含物体操作与导航指令）上评估，并进行零样本迁移真机实验。
AI.result: 在标准多模态检索指标上全面优于所有基线方法；零样本迁移的物理实验中整体成功率达80%。
AI.conclusion: 场景文字感知的多模态检索可有效支撑服务机器人的指令式物体取送，且具备良好的零样本真实环境迁移能力。

title: Does Context Compression Preserve Refusal Alignment?
summary: Context compression reduces inference cost by encoding inputs into compact representations while preserving semantic content. An open question is whether semantic preservation alone is sufficient to maintain downstream behaviours such as refusal alignment. We investigate this question and find that encoder-based compression systematically weakens refusal behaviour in instruction-tuned language models, despite high reconstruction fidelity. This effect persists across model families and compression architectures. Mechanistic analysis shows that compression attenuates activation along the decoder's learned refusal direction. We further explore Memory Steering, a lightweight inference-time intervention that restores refusal rates to near-baseline levels without retraining and operates entirely in compressed representation space. These results demonstrate that semantic preservation does not guarantee behavioural preservation under compression, highlighting the need to explicitly preserve alignment-relevant features in compression-aware systems.

AI.tldr: 编码式上下文压缩虽能高保真重建语义，但会系统性削弱指令微调模型的拒答行为；机制上压缩衰减了解码器拒答方向上的激活，Memory Steering可在压缩表示空间中无训练地恢复拒答率。
AI.motivation: 上下文压缩通过将输入编码为紧凑表示降低推理成本。但"语义保真是否足以维持下游行为（如拒答对齐）"仍属开放问题，本文旨在检验压缩是否损害安全对齐行为。
AI.method: 在多模型族与多种压缩架构上评测拒答行为与重建保真度；通过机制分析检验压缩对解码器拒答方向激活的影响；提出Memory Steering——一种完全在压缩表示空间中运行的轻量推理时干预方法。
AI.result: 编码器式压缩在高重建保真度下仍系统性降低拒答率，且跨模型族与架构一致；机制上表现为拒答方向激活被衰减；Memory Steering可将拒答率恢复至接近基线水平，且无需重训练。
AI.conclusion: 语义保真不能保证行为保真，压缩可能破坏对齐相关特征；压缩感知系统需显式保留对齐相关特征，Memory Steering提供了实用的推理时补救方案。

title: The Split Protocol Decides the Result: Re-Evaluating Encrypted Traffic Classification
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables Code and data splits: https://github.com/Mayan10/Flowconx
summary:
Encrypted traffic classifiers are routinely reported at 95-99% accuracy. We show that on one of two public corpora, the same model and code score macro-F1 0.992 under the evaluation protocol standard in the literature and 0.567 under a protocol that keeps flows from one packet capture on one side of the split. Nothing changes but the partition (gap 0.426 over eight seeds, p = 0.008 after Holm-Bonferroni correction).
  The inflation is not a property of random splitting as such. On a month of backbone QUIC traffic, we evaluate five split protocols at eight seeds each: random, temporal and client-disjoint splitting are statistically indistinguishable from session-disjoint, while server-disjoint splitting costs 0.192 macro-F1 (d = 17.0, p = 0.008). Which axis matters depends on how the corpus was collected, in a way invisible from its label space.
  We give a diagnostic that identifies the right axis before any model is trained: single-identifier probes. A decision tree on the capture identifier alone reaches 0.983 under a random split and exactly 0.000 under session-disjoint splitting.
  Under this evaluation, a metric-trained flow embedding leads four deep baselines but does not beat gradient-boosted trees on twenty packet sizes. Five of our own pre-registered architectural claims fail: distance-based rejection of unknown applications beats softmax thresholding, but ablating every metric objective makes rejection better, because class separation correlates at r = -0.88 with rejection quality. Few-shot enrollment is flat within a corpus but, across corpora, five labelled flows per class recover 91% of the deficit left by failed zero-shot transfer.
  All splits, results, code and negative findings are released.

AI.tldr: 加密流量分类器文献常报告95–99%准确率，但本文证明这主要由划分协议（同一抓包内的流被分到训练/测试两侧）制造的泄漏所致；改用会话不相交划分后同一模型宏F1从0.992降到0.567。作者提出"单标识符探针"预诊断方法，并给出多划分协议、多随机种子的系统评估及五项预注册假设失败的负结果。
AI.motivation: 加密流量分类领域普遍报告近乎饱和的准确率，但这些数字可能反映数据泄漏而非真实泛化能力；需要弄清究竟是哪种划分轴（随机、时间、客户端、服务器、会话）导致性能虚高，并在训练模型之前就能识别出正确的划分轴。
AI.method: 在两个公开语料与一个月骨干网QUIC流量上，以8个随机种子对比随机、时间、客户端不相交、会话不相交、服务器不相交五种划分协议；提出"单标识符探针"——仅用抓包标识符训练决策树作为诊断；并评测度量学习的流嵌入与梯度提升树在20种包长下的表现。
AI.result: 同一模型随机划分宏F1 0.992、会话不相交划分0.567（差距0.426，p=0.008，Holm-Bonferroni校正）；随机/时间/客户端不相交划分与会话不相交在统计上无差异，而服务器不相交划分损失0.192宏F1（d=17.0，p=0.008）；单标识符探针随机划分达0.983、会话不相交恰为0.000；度量训练嵌入优于四个深度基线但在20种包长上不及梯度提升树；五项预注册架构主张失败，其中基于距离的未知应用拒识虽优于softmax阈值，但消融全部度量目标反而更好，类分离度与拒识质量相关 r=-0.88；跨语料每类5条标注流可恢复零样本迁移失败的91%差距。
AI.conclusion: 加密流量分类的高分很大程度源于划分协议的泄漏，正确的评估轴取决于语料采集方式且从标签空间无法察觉；建议在训练前用单标识符探针确定划分轴，并采用会话/服务器不相交等更严格的协议。作者公开全部划分、代码、结果与负结果发现。

title: Drift-adaptive Representation Preservation for Domain-Incremental Learning
summary: Pretrained vision models provide strong general-purpose representations, but in Domain-Incremental Learning (DIL), where the input distribution changes sequentially, adapting to new domains often degrades performance on previously learned ones. We observe that forgetting is not uniform across domains and classes and is not explained by training order alone. This motivates us to track each past domain-class concept individually. We use representation drift, defined as the deviation of a past concept's current representation from a fixed anchor, as a measurable surrogate for forgetting risk. The measured drift then serves two complementary roles. A consolidation loss assigns stronger preservation to high-drift pairs, while prototype construction down-weights highly drifted domains to reduce their influence on the class reference. Preservation is thus allocated by measured drift rather than assumed importance. To obtain this signal during training without storing past raw data, we repurpose a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA). For each domain-class pair, we store only a compact context summary in the backbone feature space and rerun it through the learned context-to-target relation to measure its drift from the fixed anchor. Across DomainNet, Office-Home, CORe50, and CDDB-Hard, our method sustains a strong accuracy-forgetting balance on every benchmark, using substantially less training memory than accuracy-competitive methods and the smallest storage among compared methods.

AI.tldr: 提出以"表征漂移"作为遗忘风险的可测代理，利用JEPA在无原始数据下测量每个域-类概念的漂移，并按漂移分配巩固强度与原型权重，在DIL基准上取得准确率-遗忘的良好平衡。
AI.motivation: 域增量学习中遗忘并非均匀分布于各域与各类，也非仅由训练顺序决定，现有方法按假设的重要性分配保持力度，缺乏对单个域-类概念遗忘风险的精细度量。
AI.method: 将过去概念的当前表征与固定锚点的偏差定义为表征漂移，作为遗忘风险代理；据此设计两方面机制：(1) 巩固损失对高漂移域-类对施加更强保持；(2) 原型构建时对高漂移域降权，减小其对类参考的影响。为在不存原始数据的条件下获取漂移信号，复用JEPA：为每个域-类对仅存骨干特征空间中的紧凑上下文摘要，并通过学习到的上下文-目标关系重跑以测量其相对固定锚点的漂移。
AI.result: 在DomainNet、Office-Home、CORe50与CDDB-Hard上均保持较强的准确率-遗忘平衡，训练内存显著低于准确率相当的方法，且存储开销为对比方法中最小。
AI.conclusion: 以可测漂移而非假设重要性来分配保持资源，是可解释且高效的DIL遗忘缓解思路，配合JEPA式上下文摘要可实现低内存、低存储的持续域适应。

title: LegalEvolver: Agentic Legal Judgment Prediction via Rubric-Guided Self-Evolution
summary: As LLM-based agents develop, they have been increasingly applied in the legal domain. Legal Judgment Prediction~(LJP) requires models to conduct multi-step reasoning and external legal evidence retrieval. Existing legal search agents' performance is often constrained by the quality of retrieval queries. They often formulate queries directly from the initial user request, overlooking latent legal issues and legally salient details. To address this issue, we propose \emph{LegalEvolver}, a query optimization framework specifically designed to generate legally informative queries for LJP-oriented retrieval. Sampling high-quality optimized queries and their corresponding search trajectories is challenging, as relying solely on unguided high-temperature rollouts is both inefficient and constrained by the model's initial capabilities. We therefore heuristically optimize queries as seeds, improving the efficiency of trajectory generation. Furthermore, we summarize rollout experience into rubrics and use them to guide multi-round iterative self-evolution. Iteratively performing rubric optimization and rubric-guided RL enables the model to surpass its initial performance ceiling. End-to-end performance on extensive benchmarks demonstrates the effectiveness of query optimization on LJP. Comparisons with direct SFT followed by RL demonstrate the effectiveness of rubric guidance. Evolving rubrics further outperform fixed rubrics, confirming the benefits of self-evolution.

AI.tldr: LegalEvolver：面向法律判决预测(LJP)检索的查询优化框架，通过启发式种子查询+评分准则(rubrics)引导的多轮自我进化RL，提升检索查询的法律信息量。
AI.motivation: 现有法律检索智能体直接用用户初始请求构造查询，忽略潜在法律争点与法律上显著的细节，导致检索质量受限；同时高质量查询及搜索轨迹难以采样——单纯高温无引导采样效率低且受模型初始能力上限约束。
AI.method: 1) 启发式优化查询作为种子，提高轨迹生成效率；2) 将rollout经验总结为rubrics，用于指导多轮迭代自我进化；3) 交替进行rubric优化与rubric引导的强化学习，使模型突破初始性能上限。
AI.result: 在大量基准上的端到端实验证明查询优化对LJP有效；与"直接SFT+RL"对比验证了rubric引导的作用；进化rubrics优于固定rubrics，证实自我进化的收益。
AI.conclusion: 面向LJP的检索查询优化是关键增益点，rubric引导+自我进化的训练范式可有效提升法律检索智能体的推理与检索表现。

title: When Does Risk-Controlled Throughput Forecasting Actually Control Risk? A Reproduction Study on LEO Satellite Link
summary: Risk-budgeted throughput forecasting converts a point forecast of LEO satellite capacity into a conservative bound whose overestimation rate is held at a user-specified budget, so that admission control can act on it safely. We reproduce the state of the art, BG-CFQS, on the three Starlink traces its authors used and on an independent fourth dataset, and report four findings. First, its risk guarantee is reproducible but conditional on the calibration split: under a random split we recover every published quantity, including risk-pass on 3 of 3 datasets, but under a contiguous temporal split, which is what a deployed terminal faces, it holds on 1 of 3. Second, independent of any split, the method cannot serve a risk budget below 0.15, the low end of its candidate quantile set. On all four datasets the achieved rate is identical at budgets of 0.05, 0.10 and 0.15, overshooting by 1.4x to 3.7x at the tightest. Third, static conformal calibration cannot improve a ranking, only shift an operating point; we confirm this exactly on latency spike detection, where online calibration improves AUPRC by up to 51%. Fourth, group-conditional online recalibration splits into two mechanisms. The online part replicates: it tracks the budget within 1% from 0.05 to 0.35, where static calibration is 16 to 21% off. The group-conditional part does not: on three of four datasets, conditioning on any available covariate, including measured serving-satellite geometry, is worse than not conditioning, and our attempt to predict which datasets benefit failed. What is new here is empirical, not algorithmic: we claim the findings, not the methods.

AI.tldr: 本文复现并检验LEO卫星容量风险预算吞吐预测方法BG-CFQS，发现其风险保证依赖随机划分、无法服务低于0.15的风险预算、静态共形校准不能改善排序，且分组条件在线重校准中的"分组"部分基本失效；结论以经验发现为主而非算法创新。
AI.motivation: 将LEO卫星容量的点预测转化为风险受控的保守下界，可让接纳控制安全决策。作者希望检验当前SOTA方法BG-CFQS的声称保证在真实部署条件下是否成立，并探究其局限。
AI.method: 在原作者使用的三条Starlink轨迹及一条独立第四数据集上复现BG-CFQS；对比随机划分与连续时间划分；测试不同风险预算（0.05/0.10/0.15）下的达成率；在延迟尖峰检测任务上比较静态与在线共形校准对AUPRC的影响；拆分并分别检验分组条件在线重校准中的"在线"机制与"分组条件"机制。
AI.result: (1)随机划分下复现全部已发表结果（3/3数据集通过风险检验），但连续时间划分下仅1/3通过；(2)任一划分下都无法服务低于0.15的预算，0.05/0.10/0.15三档达成率相同，最紧预算处超限1.4–3.7倍；(3)静态共形校准只能移动工作点、不能改善排序，在线校准使延迟尖峰检测AUPRC最高提升51%；(4)在线重校准部分可从0.05到0.35将预算控制在1%以内（静态偏差16–21%），但分组条件部分在4个数据集中的3个上均劣于不分组，包括使用服务卫星几何等协变量，且预测哪些数据集会受益的尝试失败。
AI.conclusion: BG-CFQS的风险保证有条件成立，在部署相关的连续划分与低预算场景下失效；静态校准与分组条件机制的实际收益有限。本文贡献是经验性的：提出发现而非新方法，提示需重新审视基于共形预测的风险预算预测评估协议。

title: Many Pixels, One Composition: Self-Supervised Spectra for Specimen-Level Prediction
summary: Can hyperspectral (HS) imaging be used to predict the elemental composition of physical specimens found on the Earth's surface? We approach this problem as a supervised regression task, using an open dataset of specimens, each comprising a HS cube and elemental characterization. In particular, we train an encoder in a self-supervised fashion that operates on pixel-level; then freeze the encoder and train a lightweight attention-based regression head in a supervised manner, by pairing many representations of a given specimen with its corresponding elemental label. In test specimens, our approach significantly outperforms traditional spectral matching and unmixing baselines. It also outperforms supervised learning models based on the mean spectrum (of similar model capacity), while full model fine-tuning achieves the strongest performance, at substantially higher model capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两阶段框架：先用自监督方式在像素级训练编码器，再冻结编码器、用注意力回归头将某标本的多个表示与其元素组成标签配对训练，从而用高光谱成像预测地表标本的元素组成，显著优于传统光谱匹配与解混基线。
AI.motivation: 探索高光谱（HS）成像能否用于预测地表现实物标本的元素组成。作者将该问题建模为监督回归任务，并借助含 HS 立方体与元素表征的开放数据集求解。
AI.method: 采用自监督在像素级训练编码器；随后冻结编码器，以监督方式训练轻量级注意力回归头，将同一标本的多个像素表示与其元素标签配对。与传统光谱匹配、光谱解混基线以及基于均值光谱的监督模型（相近容量）进行对比，并考察全模型微调（更大容量）的效果。
AI.result: 在测试标本上，所提方法显著优于传统光谱匹配与解混基线，也优于基于均值光谱的监督模型（模型容量相近）；全模型微调在显著更高模型容量下取得最强性能。
AI.conclusion: 高光谱成像可用于标本元素组成的回归预测；自监督像素级预训练加注意力聚合的冻结编码器方案在低容量下具有明显优势，而全模型微调可进一步提升性能。

title: MA-Mesh: Resilient Multi-Agent Collaboration via Role-based Self-Healing
summary: Effective collaboration in multi-agent systems requires mechanisms for coordination and adaptability in dynamic and uncertain environments. However, existing multi-agent systems rarely model resilience explicitly, instead relying on ad-hoc output correction that limits systematic, runtime management of robustness. In this work, we propose Multi-Agent Mesh (MA-Mesh), a framework that constructs a role-based self-healing layer on top of a collaboration pattern. Specifically, MA-Mesh generates resilience-aware system specifications and synthesizes them into executable multi-agent policy code. To enhance resilience, we introduce two self-healing mechanisms: Cross-agent reflection, a mechanism that allows agents to evaluate not only their own outcomes but also the performance of their peers, enabling informed behavioral adjustments and collective policy refinement; Role-based failover, a strategy which dynamically reassigns roles and enables agents to substitute for one another when sub-tasks fail or agents underperform, ensuring continuity of task execution. Experimental results across diverse tasks (e.g., software development, tool use, scientific reasoning) demonstrate that MA-Mesh significantly outperforms existing multi-agent systems in both task performance and robustness under system uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 提出 MA-Mesh 框架，在协作模式之上构建基于角色的自愈层，通过跨智能体反思与角色故障转移两种机制提升多智能体系统的韧性与任务表现。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统需在动态不确定环境中实现协调与适应，但现有系统很少显式建模韧性，多依赖临时的输出修正，缺乏系统化、运行时的鲁棒性管理。
AI.method: MA-Mesh 生成具有韧性意识的系统规范，并合成可执行的多智能体策略代码；引入跨智能体反思（智能体除评估自身结果外还评估同伴表现，从而调整行为并协同优化策略）与基于角色的故障转移（子任务失败或智能体表现不佳时动态重分配角色、相互替补以保证任务连续性）。
AI.result: 在软件开发、工具使用、科学推理等多类任务上，MA-Mesh 在任务性能和系统不确定性下的鲁棒性均显著优于现有多智能体系统。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模韧性并结合自愈机制，可系统化地提升多智能体系统在不确定环境中的性能与可靠性。

title: Conformal Prediction for Distribution-to-Distribution Regression
summary: Conformal Prediction (CP) provides a model-agnostic framework for constructing finite-sample prediction sets with coverage guarantees and has become a tool for reliable decision-making in high-risk settings. Recent advances have extended Split Conformal Prediction to increasingly complex learning problems, including multilabel, high-dimensional, and functional outputs. In this work, we study CP for Distribution-to-Distribution Regression, a setting of growing interest across many application domains. We show that a naive application of Split CP yields prediction sets that, while marginally valid, are non-interpretable, e.g., lacking a well-defined volume or a tractable sampling procedure, and of limited practical value. To overcome this, we propose a new conformal framework that operates in an orthogonal basis space, producing interpretable prediction sets while preserving coverage guarantees. We further develop an adaptive variant with asymptotic conditional coverage under mild assumptions. Empirical results on synthetic and real-world datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/tuanhacs/conformal_d2d.

AI.tldr: 该文研究分布到分布回归（D2D）的共形预测，指出朴素Split CP虽边际有效但不可解释，提出在正交基空间中构造可解释预测集的共形框架，并给出渐近条件覆盖的自适应变体，实验验证有效。
AI.motivation: 分布到分布回归在众多领域日益重要，而现有Split Conformal Prediction扩展到复杂输出时，直接套用于D2D会得到缺乏良定义体积、无可行采样过程、实际价值有限的不可解释预测集，因此需要新的共形方法。
AI.method: 提出在正交基空间中操作的共形框架，以生成可解释的预测集并保持覆盖保证；进一步开发自适应变体，在温和假设下具备渐近条件覆盖。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上的实验验证了所提方法的有效性，预测集兼具可解释性与覆盖保证。
AI.conclusion: 正交基空间共形框架解决了D2D回归中预测集不可解释的问题，自适应变体改善条件覆盖，代码已开源。

title: XuanJian-DINOSAR: A SAR Foundation Model Based on Global and Local Semantic Consistency
summary: Self-supervised pre-training on synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery enables transferable representations, but the optical-SAR domain gap and speckle perturbations limit representation stability. Most SAR foundation models use masked image modeling (MIM) through pixel reconstruction or structural feature prediction, which is sensitive to speckle or relies on predefined operators. Joint modeling of cross-view semantics and perturbation stability at corresponding spatial locations remains underexplored. We propose XuanJian-DINOSAR, a SAR foundation model based on global and local semantic consistency. We curate over 360K publicly available SAR target chips, detection images, and scene images spanning diverse targets, scenes, and sensors, and adapt an optically pre-trained DINOv2 model to SAR through self-supervised learning. The framework combines DINO global semantic self-distillation, iBOT local masked modeling, and KoLeo feature-distribution regularization to learn globally discriminative and locally structure-aware representations. We introduce a local semantic consistency branch tailored to SAR intensity statistics and coherent imaging characteristics. Shared geometric transformations produce spatially aligned teacher weak views and student strong views. Intensity transformations and Gamma multiplicative speckle perturbations are applied to student views, while a cosine consistency loss aligns patch tokens at corresponding locations, promoting stability under radiometric perturbations. This objective complements the cross-region and cross-scale semantic consistency of DINOv2 multi-crop training, jointly enforcing global and local semantic consistency. Experiments on multiple downstream classification and detection datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on most evaluation metrics, validating the generality and transferability of the learned representations.

AI.tldr: 提出 XuanJian-DINOSAR，基于 DINOv2 适配的 SAR 基础模型，通过全局-局部语义一致性（DINO 自蒸馏 + iBOT 掩码建模 + 局部语义一致性分支）提升对散斑与辐射扰动的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有 SAR 基础模型多用 MIM（像素重建或结构特征预测），对散斑敏感且依赖预定义算子；跨视角语义与对应空间位置的扰动稳定性联合建模仍不足。
AI.method: 构建 36 万+ SAR 图像（目标切片、检测图、场景图）数据集；将光学预训练 DINOv2 通过自监督适配到 SAR；结合 DINO 全局语义自蒸馏、iBOT 局部掩码建模与 KoLeo 特征分布正则；新增面向 SAR 强度统计与相干成像特性的局部语义一致性分支：共享几何变换生成对齐的教师弱视图与学生强视图，对学生施加强度变换与 Gamma 乘性散斑扰动，用余弦一致性损失对齐对应位置的 patch token，与 DINOv2 多裁剪的跨区域/跨尺度一致性互补。
AI.result: 在多个下游分类与检测数据集上，多数评价指标达到 SOTA，验证了所学表示的泛化性与可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 将全局语义自蒸馏与面向散斑/辐射扰动的局部一致性结合，是提升 SAR 基础模型表示稳定性和迁移性的有效途径。

title: GIST: Gibbs-Targeted Hierarchical Data Selection for Offline RLVR
summary: Offline reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains on a fixed pool of sampled responses and typically supervises every token of every response, although responses and tokens are not equally informative. We study which ones to supervise through the Gibbs-optimal policy of KL-regularized RLVR, which offline training targets, and measure the mismatch between a policy and this target with a bidirectional KL divergence. At the reference policy, this mismatch factorizes exactly and separates the two outcomes: correct responses contribute mainly through the forward term, concentrated on their low-probability tokens, and incorrect responses through the reverse term, concentrated on the responses the policy generates often and on their high-probability tokens. Based on this analysis, we propose GIST (Gibbs-Targeted Hierarchical Data Selection), a two-level selection method that approximates these principles with signals available before training. GIST uses the sampling temperature to select correct responses on-policy and incorrect responses near the policy's mode, and it uses the initial policy's token probabilities to supervise only the tokens where the mismatch lies. Applied to two offline training objectives, GIST raises the average accuracy over GSM8K, MATH-500, and MBPP for all three models under both objectives. In a controlled comparison on Qwen3-0.6B/GSM8K, it outperforms seven selection baselines that choose from the same candidates while supervising 66.6% fewer tokens than training on all candidates of the same prompts.

AI.tldr: 论文分析离线RLVR中哪些响应和token值得监督，基于KL正则化RLVR的Gibbs最优策略，提出GIST两级数据选择方法，在多个基准上提升准确率并显著减少监督token数量。
AI.motivation: 离线RLVR在固定采样响应池上训练，通常对每个响应的每个token都监督，但响应和token的信息量并不相同。需要弄清哪些响应和token更值得监督。
AI.method: 以KL正则RLVR的Gibbs最优策略作为离线训练目标，用双向KL散度衡量策略与该目标的失配。在参考策略处，失配可精确分解：正确响应主要通过前向项贡献，集中在低概率token；错误响应主要通过反向项贡献，集中在策略常生成的响应及其高概率token上。据此提出GIST（Gibbs-Targeted Hierarchical Data Selection）两级选择方法：用采样温度在策略上选择正确响应、选择接近策略众数的错误响应；用初始策略的token概率只监督失配所在的token。
AI.result: 应用于两种离线训练目标时，GIST在三个模型的GSM8K、MATH-500和MBPP上平均准确率均有提升。在Qwen3-0.6B/GSM8K的受控比较中，优于七个从相同候选池中选择的基线，且比在同一prompt全部候选上训练少监督66.6%的token。
AI.conclusion: GIST通过理论分析指导的两级数据选择，在不增加训练成本的前提下提升离线RLVR效果，并大幅降低监督token数量，说明选择性地监督高信息量响应和token是有效的。

title: Learning to Tune with Biased Gradients: Iterative Feedback Tuning of Model-Free Control on Throttle Valves
summary: Iterative feedback tuning (IFT) learns the parameters of a fixed-structure controller by stochastic gradient descent. At each iteration, two closed-loop experiments are run on the plant: the first one measures the tracking error, and the second one, driven by this error, provides the sensitivities from which the gradient of the cost is estimated. This estimate is unbiased for linear plants only. We study the biased case on automotive electronic throttle valves, whose friction and stiction vary between valves and runs, controlled by an intelligent proportional (model-free) controller, which is an incremental PI controller. We show that the mismatch of the controller state at the start of the two experiments, which stiction makes unavoidable, adds an error inversely proportional to the amplitude of the second experiment. On digital twins of ten valves, the IFT gradient is a descent direction in only 69\% of the low-cost region, friction being the cause, and all update rules plateau and then drift. On two hardware valves, the best update rule depends on the noise structure of the gradient. On the first valve, where one gradient component is buried in noise, Adam outperforms Gauss--Newton, its normalisation and its momentum each improving one parameter. On the second valve, where both components are consistent, the same normalisation amplifies a direction that Gauss--Newton rightly discounts, and Adam drifts to a controller worse than the initial one. The twins reproduce the mechanism but not this ranking.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于无模型控制器(iP)的迭代反馈整定(IFT)在存在摩擦/爬行的电子节气门上的有偏梯度问题：分析了两实验初始状态失配引入的、与第二实验幅值成反比的误差；数字孪生显示梯度仅在69%低成本区为下降方向且各更新规则先平台后漂移；硬件上最优更新规则取决于梯度噪声结构（Adam 或 Gauss–Newton 各有胜负）。
AI.motivation: IFT的标准梯度估计仅对线性对象无偏，而真实节气门存在摩擦与爬行(stiction)，导致两次闭环实验初始控制器状态不可对齐，梯度估计有偏，更新规则可能失效甚至漂移。
AI.method: 理论上推导初始状态失配导致的有偏梯度误差项；在十个节气门数字孪生上评估IFT梯度是否为下降方向并比较多种更新规则；在两个真实硬件节气门上比较Adam、Gauss–Newton、归一化与动量等更新规则。
AI.result: 失配误差与第二实验幅值成反比；数字孪生上梯度仅69%低成本区为下降方向（摩擦为主因），所有规则先平台后漂移；硬件上第一阀梯度一分量被噪声淹没时Adam优于Gauss–Newton，第二阀两分量一致时归一化放大应被折扣的方向致Adam漂移变差；孪生再现机理但不复现排序。
AI.conclusion: 摩擦/爬行使IFT梯度有偏，更新规则优劣依赖噪声结构而非仿真可预测；数字孪生可用于机理分析但不足以预测硬件上规则排序。

title: Semantic Prior-Guided Incomplete Cross-Modal Retrieval with Noisy Labels
summary: Cross-modal retrieval (CMR) aims to bridge the semantic gaps between modalities by learning shared representations. Unfortunately, due to the dynamism and inconsistencies in real-world data acquisition, multimodal datasets frequently encounter severe modality incompleteness. Existing incomplete CMR methods adhere to a label-driven paradigm, relying heavily on categorical annotations as the semantic benchmark. However, label noise is difficult to avoid and often coexists with modality incompleteness. To address this challenge, we propose a novel semantic prior-guided framework for incomplete cross-modal retrieval with noisy labels, termed SPIRN. Specifically, SPIRN uses fixed semantic priors as a consistent reference for robust representation learning, noisy-label handling, and missing-modality completion. Based on this reference, Semantic Priors Guidance (SPG) establishes a stable category-level semantic space, Quality-aware Robust Learning (QRL) dynamically evaluates sample quality to distinguish clean samples from noisy ones and handles noise via reverse learning, Prior-guided Global Label Calibration (PGLC) rectifies corrupted annotations for refined supervision, and Confidence-driven Selective Imputation (CSI) recovers missing modalities from a cross-modal memory bank while filtering unreliable imputations with an increasing threshold. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first framework to jointly tackle the dual challenges of modality incompleteness and label noise in the CMR community. Extensive experiments on four widely used benchmark datasets demonstrate that SPIRN outperforms 11 state-of-the-art methods in various scenarios involving both missing modalities and noisy labels.

AI.tldr: SPIRN是一个语义先验引导框架，首次联合解决跨模态检索中的模态不完整与标签噪声双重挑战，在四个基准数据集上优于11种SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现实数据采集导致多模态数据集常有严重模态缺失，同时标签噪声难以避免并与模态缺失共存。现有不完整CMR方法采用标签驱动的范式，过度依赖类别标注作为语义基准，因而对噪声标签极为脆弱。
AI.method: 以固定语义先验作为一致参考，包含四个模块：SPG（语义先验引导）建立稳定的类别级语义空间；QRL（质量感知鲁棒学习）动态评估样本质量、区分干净与噪声样本并用反向学习处理噪声；PGLC（先验引导全局标签校正）修正被污染的标注以获得精炼监督；CSI（置信度驱动的选择性插补）从跨模态记忆库中恢复缺失模态并用递增阈值过滤不可靠插补。
AI.result: 在四个广泛使用的基准数据集上，于多种模态缺失与噪声标签场景下，SPIRN均优于11种最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次在CMR领域同时处理模态不完整与标签噪声，验证了语义先验作为统一参考在鲁棒表示学习、噪声处理与缺失补全中的有效性。

title: D3D: Decoupled Diffusion Drafting for Asynchronous Speculative Decoding
summary: Target-conditioned diffusion drafters predict candidate tokens in parallel, yet each new block must wait for updated target-model hidden states. This forces drafting and verification to run sequentially, limiting speedup even though each block is generated in one pass. We introduce D3D, a standalone diffusion drafter that removes this inter-round dependency. D3D combines blockwise denoising with auxiliary autoregressive supervision to achieve long accepted prefixes without target hidden states. This independence lets D3D draft successor blocks during verification in one packed pass, enabling asynchronous speculative decoding. We progressively prune layers according to their effect on acceptance length to reduce the cost of packed drafting. Removing five of 36 layers retains over 99\% of mean acceptance length across three benchmarks with Qwen3-8B as the target. Across seven benchmarks, D3D averages 5.00$\times$ and 5.71$\times$ decoding speedup with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B targets, compared with 4.03$\times$ and 3.67$\times$ for DFlash. On GSM8K with Qwen3-32B, speedup reaches 7.48$\times$. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/fudan-generative-vision/D3D.

AI.tldr: D3D：一种不依赖目标模型隐状态的独立扩散草稿器，通过块内去噪+自回归辅助监督实现长接受前缀，从而让草稿与验证异步并行。
AI.motivation: 现有目标条件扩散草稿器虽能并行生成候选token，但每个新块都必须等待更新后的目标模型隐状态，导致起草与验证串行执行，限制了整体加速比。
AI.method: 提出D3D——独立扩散草稿器，去除轮间依赖；结合块级去噪与辅助自回归监督，在无目标隐状态下获得长接受前缀；利用独立性在一次打包传递中于验证期间预生成后继块，实现异步投机解码；并按各层对接受长度的影响逐步剪枝，降低打包起草开销（36层中剪去5层）。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B目标下，剪去5/36层仍保留超99%平均接受长度；七个基准上，Qwen3-8B与Qwen3-32B目标平均达5.00×和5.71×加速，优于DFlash的4.03×和3.67×；Qwen3-32B在GSM8K上达7.48×。
AI.conclusion: 消除草稿对目标隐状态的依赖可有效解除起草-验证串行瓶颈，配合层剪枝实现显著且低开销的异步投机解码加速。

title: Flexible Intensities Matter: A Comprehensive Re-evaluation of Hawkes Processes and Neural Temporal Point Processes
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 36 pages, 3 figures, 25 tables. Code: https://github.com/PMBio/torchPP (paper reproduction on branch neurips2026)
summary: Temporal point processes (TPPs) are the canonical framework for event sequence data, with applications spanning seismology, social media, and electronic health records. Recently, neural TPPs have been reported to substantially outperform classical TPPs, such as Hawkes processes, but these comparisons pitted flexible neural models against Hawkes processes in their most restricted form, and did not consider large-scale medical data. Here, we revisit this comparison through a systematic evaluation of Poisson and Hawkes processes of increasing flexibility against neural TPPs, on five established benchmark datasets and on two large-scale medical evaluation tasks derived from UK Biobank disease histories and MIMIC-IV ICU records, under autoregressive next-event prediction. First, the previously reported gap between Hawkes processes and neural TPPs largely disappears once Hawkes processes are equipped with flexible, learnable baselines and kernels. Second, the flexibility of the intensity parametrization also limits prior neural TPPs: a Transformer with a spline-based intensity head outperforms previous intensity-based neural TPPs and is on par with the intensity-free model. Decomposing the log-likelihood into a time term $\log p(t)$ and a type term $\log p(d \mid t)$, we find that this flexibility advantage lies almost entirely in the time density: more flexibility does not improve the type term. On these benchmarks, the gains of neural TPPs thus lie mostly in modeling when events occur, not which. Third, our results underscore the value of complex datasets for evaluating TPPs: only on the MIMIC-IV ICU records do neural TPPs retain an advantage in the type term. Our results inform both future method development and model choice. We release our framework, TorchPP, as an open-source package with consistent implementations of classical and neural TPPs.

AI.tldr: 在5个标准基准和2个大规模医疗任务上系统比较不同灵活度的Poisson/Hawkes与神经TPP，发现Hawkes配上可学习基线和核后差距基本消失，且神经TPP的优势主要来自时间密度而非类型分布。
AI.motivation: 已有"神经TPP显著优于Hawkes"的结论建立在把Hawkes限制在最受限形式、且未使用大规模医疗数据的对比之上，需要公平、系统的重新评估。
AI.method: 在自回归下一事件预测设定下，对逐渐增加灵活度的Poisson和Hawkes过程与神经TPP进行系统对比；数据集包括5个已有基准、UK Biobank疾病史和MIMIC-IV ICU记录；并将对数似然分解为时间项log p(t)与类型项log p(d|t)分析；提出基于样条强度头的Transformer；发布开源框架TorchPP。
AI.result: 1）Hawkes配备灵活可学习基线与核后，与神经TPP的差距基本消失；2）带样条强度头的Transformer优于以往基于强度的神经TPP并与无强度模型相当；3）灵活性带来的增益几乎全部来自时间项，类型项未受益；仅在MIMIC-IV ICU上神经TPP保留类型项优势。
AI.conclusion: 神经TPP的优势主要体现在"何时发生"而非"发生什么"；评估TPP需要复杂大规模数据集；结果为方法开发与模型选择提供指导，并开源TorchPP。

title: ReactWorld: Structuring Interaction Responses for Embodied Video Generation
summary: Embodied video world models predict scene changes caused by robot actions, yet generated object responses may remain inconsistent with task intent and contact dynamics. Critical responses in embodied scenes often concentrate in local regions and specific time intervals. Inspired by chain-of-thought reasoning, we introduce ReactWorld, an embodied video generation model guided by structured interaction anticipation. In the generation backbone's feature space, an interaction response field predictor anticipates how the interaction will unfold, explicitly describing participant roles, future motion response intensity, and local motion changes. A response feedback adapter forms increments to object features from the difference between the object branch's outputs with predicted and zeroed local dynamics inputs. It also converts predicted displacements into positional biases for temporal attention. These two mechanisms guide object feature updates and information retrieval across frames, respectively. Through interaction anticipation and generative feedback, ReactWorld achieves an average score of 77.51 on RBench, outperforming PhysisForcing by 3.29 points with improvements in all nine categories. On EZS-Bench, it achieves a Domain score of 86.98 and an average score of 81.87.

AI.tldr: 提出ReactWorld，一种以结构化交互预测引导的具身视频世界模型生成框架，通过交互响应场预测器与响应反馈适配器，提升生成物体响应与任务意图、接触动力学的一致性。
AI.motivation: 具身视频世界模型虽能预测机器人动作引起的场景变化，但生成的对象响应可能与任务意图和接触动力学不一致；且关键响应常集中于局部区域和特定时间段，需有针对性的引导。
AI.method: 受思维链启发，在生成主干特征空间中引入交互响应场预测器，显式描述参与者角色、未来运动响应强度与局部运动变化；并设计响应反馈适配器，以"预测局部动力学输入"与"置零输入"下物体分支输出的差异形成物体特征增量，同时将预测位移转换为时间注意力的位置偏置，分别引导物体特征更新与跨帧信息检索。
AI.result: 在RBench上平均得分77.51，较PhysisForcing提升3.29分，九个类别全部提升；在EZS-Bench上Domain得分86.98，平均得分81.87。
AI.conclusion: 通过交互预测与生成反馈相结合，ReactWorld有效增强了具身视频生成中物体响应与动作意图、接触动力学的一致性，并在多个基准上取得领先表现。

title: EviSeek: An Evidence-Centric Agentic Framework for Embodied Active Information Seeking
summary: Active embodied question answering requires agents to acquire evidence through viewpoint changes and physical interaction. The central challenge is to avoid undirected interaction: taking plausible actions without specifying what evidence they should reveal for answering the question. Action plans and accumulated histories alone can leave the informational purpose of an interaction implicit. We introduce EviSeek, a training-free framework that makes question-derived evidence demands explicit acquisition objectives, linking observation-conditioned actions and selectively retained evidence to the information the agent seeks. On 3,436 ESI-Bench questions, EviSeek improves accuracy over the Single-model agent by 7.1 percentage points with Qwen3-VL-32B and 3.7 points with Gemini 3.1 Pro, while improving visual-support-weighted accuracy and reducing mean token usage. These findings support making the informational purpose of interaction explicit, with action selection and evidence retention organized around what the agent needs to learn to answer the question.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架EviSeek，将问题转化为显式的证据需求作为获取目标，指导具身问答中的动作选择与证据保留，在ESI-Bench上显著提升准确率并降低token用量。
AI.motivation: 主动具身问答的核心难点在于避免"无方向交互"：智能体可能采取看似合理但未说明要揭示何种证据的动作；仅靠动作计划和历史累积，交互的信息性目的仍然是隐含的。
AI.method: 免训练框架EviSeek：从问题中推导证据需求（question-derived evidence demands），并将其作为显式获取目标，把观察条件下的动作与选择性保留的证据同智能体所寻求的信息联系起来。
AI.result: 在3,436个ESI-Bench问题上，相比单模型智能体，Qwen3-VL-32B准确率提升7.1个百分点，Gemini 3.1 Pro提升3.7个百分点，同时提升视觉支撑加权准确率并降低平均token消耗。
AI.conclusion: 显式化交互的信息性目的是有效的，动作选择与证据保留应围绕"智能体为回答问题需要了解什么"来组织。

title: EEGDash Corpus: A Training-Ready Public Corpus for EEG Foundation Models
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at the Workshop on Machine Learning for EEG Signal Processing (MLESP 2026), IEEE BIBM 2026
summary: Foundation models for electroencephalography (EEG) are pretrained on tens of thousands of hours of recordings, and their accuracy grows with that amount. Such data is hard to assemble. The largest sources are clinical archives that cannot be redistributed, and the public sources are spread over several archives, file formats, and licences. We release eegdash-corpus-v0, a training-ready corpus of 77 public EEG datasets, as the gated Hugging Face dataset EEGDash/eegdash-corpus-v0 with the SHA-256 of every file. REVE, the largest published EEG foundation model, names 89 datasets as its pretraining corpus. Twelve cannot be redistributed: four clinical archives that hold 82% of its hours, and eight under no-derivatives licences. The corpus holds the 76 others that REVE's sampling rate allows and one more from REVE's release card: 77 datasets, 14,075 hours from 7,272 subjects, 5.0 million 10-second samples and 6.21 billion tokens per epoch. Every dataset is fetched through EEGDash, converted once with REVE's recipe, and stored in its own buckets of a chunked Zarr store with its licence recorded beside it, so a model can train on the whole store or on any subset of datasets. To test that the store pretrains a model, we retrain REVE-Base from scratch twice with the authors' code, changed only in how it reads data, and score it on seven public OpenEEGBench tasks. It reaches 0.331 under linear probing and 0.273 after fine-tuning, against 0.333 and 0.325 for the released model and 0.200 and 0.205 for an untrained encoder. The converter, the conversion reports, and the loader changes are released with the corpus.

AI.tldr: 发布 eegdash-corpus-v0：77 个公开 EEG 数据集、14,075 小时、62.1 亿 token/epoch 的即训语料，并用作者原始代码重训 REVE-Base 验证其可用性。
AI.motivation: EEG 基础模型需大量数据，但临床档案无法再分发、公开数据分散于多档案/格式/许可，导致数据难以整合。
AI.method: 通过 EEGDash 获取 76+1 个数据集（避开 REVE 中 12 个不可再分发者），按 REVE 配方一次性转换，按数据集分桶存入分块 Zarr 存储并旁附许可证；改动读取逻辑后从头重训 REVE-Base 两次。
AI.result: 线性探测 0.331、微调 0.273；对比发布模型 0.333/0.325、未训练编码器 0.200/0.205（7 个 OpenEEGBench 任务）。
AI.conclusion: 该语料可在缺少临床数据的情况下基本复现 REVE-Base 的线性探测性能（微调仍有差距），转换器、转换报告与加载器改动均随语料开源。

title: RDT-3D: Resolution-Decoupled Training for High-Fidelity 3D Geometry Generation
summary: High-fidelity 3D geometry generation requires maintaining global structural coherence alongside fine-grained surface details. While recent coarse-to-fine frameworks leverage Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) to condition local queries, we reveal a critical training-inference resolution discrepancy: coordinate guidance and geometric supervision are aligned during training, whereas inference decodes high-resolution geometry from coarse spatial coordinates. This mismatch introduces a severe distribution shift that degrades fine details. To overcome this, we propose Resolution-Decoupled Training (RDT), which anchors RoPE guidance at 512 resolution while supervising geometry at 1536, enabling robust detail extrapolation. Additionally, to eliminate high-resolution data bottlenecks, we present Dual3D-300K, a large-scale paired dataset comprising 300K watertight 3D point clouds explicitly aligned across 512 and 1536 resolutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RDT substantially improves sharp geometric regions, while Dual3D-300K offers a scalable benchmark for high-resolution 3D generation.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示粗到细3D生成中RoPE引导与几何监督的训练-推理分辨率不一致问题，提出 Resolution-Decoupled Training (RDT)（引导用512、监督用1536）以及配套的 Dual3D-300K 大规模成对数据集，显著提升高分辨率几何细节。
AI.motivation: 高保真3D几何生成需兼顾全局结构一致性与局部细节。现有粗到细框架用RoPE对局部query做条件，但训练时坐标引导与几何监督分辨率一致，推理时却由粗坐标解码高分辨率几何，产生分布偏移，导致细粒度细节退化；同时缺乏高分辨率配对数据。
AI.method: 提出 Resolution-Decoupled Training (RDT)：将RoPE引导锚定在512分辨率，而几何监督在1536分辨率进行，使模型可稳健外推细节；并构建 Dual3D-300K 数据集，含30万封闭3D点云，在512与1536分辨率上显式对齐。
AI.result: 大量实验表明RDT显著改善尖锐几何区域的重建质量；Dual3D-300K 为高分辨率3D生成提供可扩展的基准。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦训练与推理的分辨率，并配套高分辨率配对数据集，可有效缓解分布偏移、提升细节生成质量，为高保真3D生成提供方法与数据双重支撑。

title: SUMONE: A Simple and Efficient Summarizer for Plug-and-Play Agent Memory
summary: Long-horizon language-model agents accumulate increasingly large interaction histories, making context compaction essential for efficient execution. Existing learned compaction methods often rely on downstream task outcomes or solver behavior, coupling training to specific tasks or agents. We introduce SumOne, a standalone summarizer trained to preserve information in agent histories through masked reconstruction. Given a summary of the expired history, a frozen reconstructor recovers randomly masked portions of the original trajectory; reconstruction quality, combined with a length penalty, provides a task-agnostic reward for optimizing the summarizer with GRPO. This yields self-supervision directly from raw trajectories, without reference summaries or downstream task execution. At inference time, only the lightweight summarizer is retained, enabling plug-and-play context compression for otherwise unchanged agents. We conduct a systematic evaluation of SumOne in long-horizon search and software-engineering tasks. SumOne reduces estimated inference cost by approximately 78\% on DeepSearchQA and 75\% on SWE-bench Verified relative to operating with full context, with absolute decreases of 0.04. The same checkpoint also transfers across downstream models and agent harnesses without additional fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: SumOne 是一个独立训练的摘要器，通过掩码重建从原始 agent 轨迹中自监督学习上下文压缩，无需下游任务反馈，实现可插拔的即用式上下文压缩。
AI.motivation: 长程语言模型 agent 的交互历史不断增长，上下文压缩对效率至关重要。但现有学习式压缩方法依赖下游任务结果或求解器行为，把训练与特定任务/agent 耦合，限制了通用性和可迁移性。
AI.method: 提出 SumOne：给定过期历史的摘要，用一个冻结的重建器恢复原轨迹中随机掩码的部分；以重建质量加长度惩罚作为任务无关奖励，用 GRPO 优化摘要器。奖励完全来自原始轨迹自监督，无需参考摘要或下游执行；推理时仅保留轻量摘要器，实现即插即用压缩。
AI.result: 在长程搜索与软件工程任务上系统评估：相对全上下文运行，DeepSearchQA 估计推理成本降低约 78%，SWE-bench Verified 降低约 75%，绝对性能下降仅 0.04；同一 checkpoint 无需额外微调即可跨下游模型与 agent 框架迁移。
AI.conclusion: 掩码重建可作为有效的任务无关自监督信号来训练压缩摘要器，兼具高效率、低性能损失与良好的可迁移性，为长程 agent 提供通用、可插拔的上下文压缩方案。

title: Give Up to Get More: Priors, Not Policies, Govern Test-Time Compute Allocation
comment: 36 pages, 6 figures. Code, results and survey coding: https://github.com/nepersoned/priors-not-policies
summary: When many inputs share a budget of repeated attempts by a large language model (LLM), a common rule gives harder inputs more. On public math, code and formal-proof samples, the best published difficulty-proportional rule captures half or more of the oracle gain on benchmarks the model mostly solves, but at most 13% on hard workloads, even given true pass rates. Because the value of one more attempt peaks at intermediate difficulty, the optimal static allocation is inverted-U and gives little to inputs that are hopeless at the current budget. In a strict survey of 221 LLM allocation papers, at least 13 give the hardest inputs the most attempts; their easier settings sit at budgets where this is near-optimal, so the cost appears on harder workloads. Acting on it requires knowing which inputs are solvable, so information, not the policy, drives the gain. With a verifier and a prior from a related model's past runs on the same inputs, Thompson Sampling raises the solved share on the hardest workload from 14% to 27%; without such a prior, no policy we tested beats round-robin. For the policies we tested, the gain vanishes between prior rank correlations of about 0.3 and 0.55, which cheap text-based priors barely reach on the weakest models, and it requires a verifier whose false acceptances are rare relative to the pass rate. On new Qwen2.5 samples the pattern holds, and tempering the prior avoids losses on easy workloads. We turn these results into a decision guide.

AI.tldr: 在给定预算重复尝试LLM时，按难度分配尝试次数的"越难越多"规则在难题工作负载上失效（仅获≤13% oracle增益），原因是单次尝试价值随难度呈倒U型；有效分配的关键是"信息"而非策略本身，需借助验证器与相关模型先验的Thompson Sampling。
AI.motivation: 现有实践普遍将更多尝试预算分配给更难输入，但作者发现该规则在模型大都解不出的难题上增益极低，需要重新审视难度-尝试分配的合理性并给出可靠决策依据。
AI.method: 在公开数学、代码、形式证明样本上评估难度比例分配规则；对221篇LLM分配论文做严格综述（至少13篇给最难输入最多尝试）；提出以验证器真值反馈+相关模型历史先验驱动的Thompson Sampling分配策略，并测试先验秩相关、验证器误接受率、round-robin等对照。
AI.result: 难度比例规则在模型基本能解的基准上捕获≥50% oracle增益，但难题工作负载≤13%；Thompson Sampling将最难工作负载解出率从14%提升到27%；无先验时无策略胜过round-robin；先验秩相关在0.3–0.55间增益消失；需验证器误接受率远低于通过率。Qwen2.5样本上趋势一致，先验降温可避免简单负载损失。
AI.conclusion: 难度越高越多的静态分配在难题上代价显著；真正决定增益的是对可解性的信息掌握。作者将结论整理为决策指南：有可靠先验与低误接受验证器时用TS，否则round-robin更稳，并需对先验做温度调节。

title: PTQ4SAM3: Semantics-Preserving Post-Training Quantization for Segment Anything Model 3
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to WACV 2027. Includes supplementary material
summary: Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) can segment objects from text prompts and track them across video, but its memory and computation costs make deployment difficult. Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces these costs by using fewer bits. However, a quantized model can select the wrong object or lose track of its target across frames. We call this prompt-alignment drift. Controlled tests show that perturbing low-variance feature directions strongly affects target selection. We propose Semantics-Preserving Quantization (SPQ), which gives more calibration weight to concept-sensitive parameters, preserves residual features, and corrects the mean error in video memory. Fixed text concepts guide calibration without task annotations. All three components operate offline and add no inference operators. With a W4A8 image encoder, SPQ improves RefCOCO Pr@0.5 from 42.1 to 72.5 over PTQ4SAM while retaining 54.8 COCO mask AP. Experiments on LVIS, RefCOCO variants, and SA-V show consistent gains. A CLIP study also shows improved image-text retrieval.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出语义保持量化（SPQ）方法，解决 SAM 3 在训练后量化（PTQ）下出现的"提示对齐漂移"问题，通过校准加权、残差特征保护和视频记忆均值误差校正三项离线组件，显著提升量化模型的目标选择与跨帧跟踪能力。
AI.motivation: SAM 3 能根据文本提示分割对象并在视频中跟踪，但其记忆与计算开销使部署困难。PTQ 虽可降低开销，但量化模型可能选错目标或在跨帧中丢失目标（即"提示对齐漂移"）。受控实验表明，扰动低方差特征方向会强烈影响目标选择，说明量化对概念敏感参数尤其脆弱。
AI.method: SPQ 包含三个组件：（1）对概念敏感参数给予更高校准权重；（2）保护残差特征；（3）校正视频记忆中的均值误差。校准由固定文本概念引导，无需任务标注。三个组件均离线运行，不增加任何推理算子。
AI.result: 在 W4A8 图像编码器下，SPQ 将 RefCOCO Pr@0.5 从 PTQ4SAM 的 42.1 提升至 72.5，同时保持 54.8 的 COCO mask AP。在 LVIS、RefCOCO 各变体及 SA-V 上均取得一致增益。CLIP 研究还显示图文检索性能改善。
AI.conclusion: 通过保护概念敏感特征并离线校正量化误差，SPQ 能在不引入推理开销的前提下大幅缓解量化带来的提示对齐漂移，显著提升量化 SAM 3 的分割与跟踪性能，并具有跨数据集的泛化性。

title: AmbiHTMLBench: A Benchmark for HTML-based Visually Rich Document parsing
comment: Check latest benchmark info on https://ambihtmlbench.tech
summary: Traditional document parsing systems use Markdown as their output representation, which is effective for linear text but does not fully preserve fine-grained spatial structure, table geometry, visual hierarchy, or rendering semantics. We show that HTML is advantageous for heterogeneous and layout-sensitive documents whose representations must remain editable, inspectable, and reusable, and introduce AmbiHTMLBench to systematically study this setting. In this benchmark, given a real-world document, a model must recover executable HTML that preserves its content, organization, and visual appearance. The benchmark contains 1,115 diverse pages with structured annotations and evaluates predictions in two different ways: The objective protocol aligns ground-truth and predicted rendered blocks and measures table fidelity, page-level text error, and a two-dimensional layout consistency; a complementary reference-anchored protocol measures perceived fidelity by aligning LLM judges with human preferences. Across ten primary multimodal systems, the best objective score is 0.8092, while the subjective winner is different, demonstrating that automatic decomposition and human-perceived fidelity capture complementary properties. We further fine-tune a small-parameter expert model and find that task-specific adaptation yields good performance on document-to-HTML reconstruction task. These results position AmbiHTMLBench as a diagnostic testbed for building smarter and more logical document parsing systems.

AI.tldr: 论文指出以Markdown为输出表示的文档解析难以保留细粒度空间结构、表格几何与视觉层级，提出以HTML为表示的AmbiHTMLBench基准（1,115页，含结构化标注），用客观指标与LLM裁判主观指标双重评测十个多模态系统，并微调小参数专家模型验证任务适配的有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统文档解析系统以Markdown作为输出表示，虽适合线性文本，但无法完整保留细粒度空间结构、表格几何、视觉层级与渲染语义；对于异构、版式敏感的文档，需要一种可编辑、可检查、可复用的表示形式。
AI.method: 构建AmbiHTMLBench基准：给定真实文档，要求模型输出可执行HTML，保留内容、组织结构与视觉外观。包含1,115个多样页面及结构化标注。评测采用两种协议：(1)客观协议，对齐真值与预测的渲染块，测量表格保真度、页面级文本误差与二维布局一致性；(2)参考锚定协议，将LLM裁判与人类偏好对齐以衡量感知保真度。评测十个主流多模态系统，并微调一个小参数专家模型。
AI.result: 十个主要多模态系统中最佳客观得分为0.8092；主观评测的优胜者与客观最优者不同，说明自动分解与人类感知保真度捕捉的是互补属性。任务特定的微调使小参数专家模型在文档到HTML重建任务上取得良好性能。
AI.conclusion: AmbiHTMLBench可作为诊断性测试平台，用于构建更智能、更符合逻辑的文档解析系统；HTML表示在版式敏感文档的重建任务中具有优势，主客观评测互补，任务特定适配对小模型有效。
