title: From hydrological laws to catchment models: A process-based model matches deep-learning accuracy on three continents
comment: 61 pages, 12 figures, 13 tables, plus 19 pages of Supporting Information
summary: Dooge asked whether hydrology has laws at the catchment scale. We ask whether a low-dimensional system built under physical laws can match the accuracy of neural networks that outperform process-based models on the same inputs. Three laws constrain a lumped catchment model. Conservation makes it a flux-connected storage network, dissipation fixes the sign of every flux and aggregation determines how the unresolved composition enters the fluxes, through effective laws over threshold distributions and a memory of the forcing. These laws admit four kinds of refinement. A parsimonious model under them, CaRT (11 parameters per catchment), is refined in a loop assisted by AI agents. Each refinement addresses an observed deficit through a hypothesis from the literature. The result, CaRT+, has fourteen states, 35 parameters per catchment and no daily neural network. Most refinements follow from aggregation over thresholds or from variables that carry no water but modulate fluxes. On 602 British and 593 US gauged catchments, single CaRT+ models reach median Nash-Sutcliffe efficiencies of 0.863 and 0.765 in held-out years. A stateful LSTM reaches 0.869 and 0.751 and an entity-aware LSTM 0.862 and 0.754, while three-seed LSTM ensembles remain ahead of the CaRT+ ensemble by 0.003-0.012 in median paired NSE. On 505 drier Australian gauged catchments unused in development, single CaRT+ models reach 0.778 against 0.762 and 0.753 for the two LSTMs. The results suggest that catchment-scale laws exist as laws of form, with the constitutive families shared and only their parameters learned.

AI.tldr: 提出受三条物理定律约束的低维集总流域模型CaRT+（14状态、每流域35参数，无日尺度神经网络），在英、美、澳共1700个流域上与LSTM精度相当甚至更优，表明流域尺度存在“形式定律”，仅参数需学习。
AI.motivation: 回应Dooge关于流域尺度是否存在水文学定律的问题，并检验一个由物理定律构建的低维系统能否达到甚至超越在同输入下优于过程模型的神经网络精度。
AI.method: 以三条定律约束集总模型：守恒使其成为通量连通的储水网络；耗散固定各通量符号；聚合定律通过阈值分布上的有效定律与强迫记忆，刻画未解析组分的贡献方式。由此衍生四类改进，在AI智能体辅助的循环中，依据文献假设针对每个可观测缺陷逐步精化简约模型CaRT（11参数），得到CaRT+（14状态、35参数）。
AI.result: 在602个英国和593个美国测站上，单个CaRT+模型在留出年份的中位NSE为0.863和0.765；有状态LSTM为0.869和0.751，实体感知LSTM为0.862和0.754；三种子LSTM集成在配对中位NSE上仍领先CaRT+集成0.003–0.012。在未参与开发的505个较干旱澳大利亚流域上，单个CaRT+为0.778，优于两个LSTM的0.762与0.753。
AI.conclusion: 流域尺度定律以“形式定律”存在：本构族共享，仅其参数需从数据学习；低维物理约束模型可与神经网络精度相抗衡，且在分布外/干旱流域更具优势。

title: Grounding in the Dark: Text-Only Training for Zero-Shot Video Temporal Localization
summary: Video-LLMs are typically trained on paired video-text data for temporal tasks, yet collecting precise temporal annotations and training on large-scale video datasets are both costly. We investigate whether a text-only LLM, with no vision-language pretraining, can be trained on textual video descriptions alone to perform temporal grounding and receive video only at inference time. This setting removes paired video data from training altogether and is a step toward training multimodal models without paired annotations. We generate a 134K-example corpus of textual sequences with up to 100 time steps, adapt Qwen3-8B with LoRA on CLIP or LLM2CLIP text embeddings, and evaluate on Charades-STA and QV-Highlights without training on videos from either benchmark. LLM2CLIP, whose text encoder supports longer inputs, represents detailed descriptions better than CLIP (61.54 versus 53.86 mtIoU on Temporal-TextVid) and transfers them better to video. Still, replacing text with frame embeddings at inference yields only 4.99 mtIoU on Charades-STA and 11.12 on QV-Highlights, revealing a large modality gap. To bridge it, we propose Nearest Entity Replacement (NER), a training-free mapping that represents each video frame by the normalized mean of its nearest text-entity embeddings, so that the model receives the kind of input it was trained on. NER reaches 14.45 mtIoU on Charades-STA and 20.72 on QV-Highlights, outperforming the strongest of four families of modality-gap baselines by 5.00 and 1.71 points. NER thus enables partial transfer from text to video, while more reliable grounding will likely require encoders with better-aligned text and visual representations.

AI.tldr: 该论文探索仅用纯文本视频描述训练LLM做时序定位，推理时才输入视频，并提出无需训练的Nearest Entity Replacement（NER）方法缓解模态鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 视频-LLM通常依赖配对视频-文本数据训练，但精确时序标注与大规摸视频数据成本高昂。作者想验证：无视觉-语言预训练的纯文本LLM，能否仅靠文本视频描述训练后，在推理时接收视频完成时序定位，从而摆脱配对视频数据。
AI.method: 构建134K、最多100时间步的文本序列语料；用LoRA将Qwen3-8B适配到CLIP或LLM2CLIP文本嵌入上；推理时用帧嵌入替代文本嵌入。为缩小模态鸿沟，提出免训练的NER：每帧用其最近文本实体嵌入的归一化均值表示。
AI.result: LLM2CLIP因文本编码器支持更长输入，能更好表示细节描述（Temporal-TextVid上61.54 vs 53.86 mtIoU）并更好迁移到视频。直接替换为帧嵌入时Charades-STA仅4.99、QV-Highlights 11.12 mtIoU。NER提升至14.45和20.72，比四类模态鸿沟基线中最强者分别高5.00和1.71。
AI.conclusion: NER实现了从文本到视频的部分迁移，但可靠定位仍需文本与视觉表示更好对齐的编码器。

title: FPTR: Feasibility-Preserving Transactional Refinement for Deadline-Constrained Joint Beam and Resource Allocation
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures; includes appendix. Code: https://github.com/rudykon/FPTR_Scheduler
summary: Short-interval wireless schedulers must return a complete, feasible beam-and-resource allocation before each execution deadline, and a late or invalid output gives no utility in the current control cycle. Searching longer can increase transmitted traffic, but it may also miss the deadline or leave only an infeasible intermediate solution. We propose Feasibility-Preserving Transactional Refinement (FPTR), which always keeps a validated feasible allocation, the incumbent. Each refinement stage builds a separate candidate and leaves the incumbent unchanged. A candidate replaces the incumbent only if it is complete, passes the feasibility validator before its stage cutoff, and strictly improves the objective; otherwise it is discarded. Four refinement stages use this rule: buffer-aware resource selection, compatibility-group (CG) user sharing, beam-mask rebuilding from remaining demand, and joint reassignment of two resources. On 150 fixed synthetic instances, the full pipeline (Full) raises traffic by 3.83% on average over a lightweight beam-first reference and by 1.79% over its Base constructor. In a separate suite with matched inputs, Full exceeds six independent search baselines (ALNS, tabu search, GA, simulated annealing, iterated local search, and GRASP) by 6.68-8.35%, where outputs later than 100 ms receive zero utility. All 750 Full runs in the internal suite returned feasible allocations, and none exceeded 100 ms. Separating mandatory output construction from optional refinement lets spare computation time improve the allocation without endangering the incumbent. The open-source implementation supports independent reproduction.

AI.tldr: 提出 Feasibility-Preserving Transactional Refinement（FPTR），在严格截止时间内始终保留一个已验证可行的波束-资源分配，并用"候选-校验-替换"的事务式精化逐步提升目标值。
AI.motivation: 短间隔无线调度必须在每个执行截止前输出完整可行的波束与资源分配，超时或不可行输出在本控制周期内无任何效用。延长搜索虽可能提升流量，却可能错过截止时间，或只留下不可行的中间解。
AI.method: FPTR 始终维护一个已验证的可行解（incumbent）。每个精化阶段独立构建候选解，不修改 incumbent；仅当候选完整、在阶段截止前通过可行性校验、且严格改进目标时才替换 incumbent，否则丢弃。共四个阶段：缓冲感知的资源选择、兼容组（CG）用户共享、基于剩余需求的波束掩码重建、两资源的联合重分配。强制输出构造与可选精化解耦。
AI.result: 150 个固定合成实例上，完整流水线（Full）平均流量较轻量 beam-first 基线高 3.83%，较其 Base 构造器高 1.79%。在匹配输入的另一组测试中，Full 在"超过 100 ms 记零效用"条件下较 ALNS、禁忌搜索、GA、模拟退火、迭代局部搜索、GRASP 六个独立基线高 6.68%–8.35%。内部套件中 750 次 Full 运行全部返回可行解，且无一超过 100 ms。
AI.conclusion: 将必需的输出构造与可选精化分离，可在不危及 incumbent 的前提下用剩余计算时间改善分配；实现已开源，支持独立复现。

title: KolTa: A Physics-Informed Active Learning Framework for Formulation Discovery with Limited Data
comment: 21 pages, including 11 pages of supplementary material; 4 figures
summary: Finding high-performing formulations is difficult when few have been measured and experimental budgets are limited. We propose KolTa, an active learning framework that selects batches to discover the top 5% of formulations at a target temperature under a fixed query budget. KolTa combines a three-stage predictor of component contributions, role-conditioned interactions, and anchored temperature response with task-specific soft physics constraints. Its Physics-Residual-Calibrated Upper Confidence Bound (PRC-UCB) acquisition rule combines predicted utility, ensemble disagreement, and a target-temperature physics residual, with nonnegative exploration weights fitted to out-of-fold signed errors. We evaluate the framework on three measured tasks and one simulated task covering binary-mixture viscosity, drug solubility, ionic-liquid viscosity, and electrolyte conductivity. KolTa ranks first or second in mean area under the learning curve (AULC) on every task and outperforms seven of the eight comparator strategies in paired tests, winning 75 of 78 paired comparisons across tasks and seeds against those seven strategies. Across the three measured tasks, its largest gap to the best mean AULC is 0.032, compared with at least 0.056 for every comparator. On Drug, reaching 80% average recovery of the remaining targets across drugs requires an estimated median of 348 additional formulation queries, about 18% fewer than the fastest comparator. Researchers can adapt the framework to diverse formulation problems through component roles and physical constraints.

AI.tldr: KolTa：面向少量测量数据与有限实验预算的配方主动学习框架，用三阶段预测器+软物理约束与PRC-UCB采集规则，在固定查询预算下发现目标温度下Top 5%配方。
AI.motivation: 高性能配方在已测量样本极少、实验预算有限时很难找到；需要高效选择批次实验的主动学习方法来定位目标温度下的最优配方。
AI.method: 三阶段预测器（组分贡献→角色条件交互→锚定温度响应）加任务特定软物理约束；采集规则PRC-UCB融合预测效用、集成不确定度与目标温度物理残差，探索权重非负并由折外有符号误差拟合。
AI.result: 在二元混合黏度、药物溶解度、离子液体黏度、电解质电导率四任务上，平均AULC均列第一或第二；78次配对比较胜75次，优于8种基线中的7种；三个实测任务中与最优均值AULC最大差0.032（对比方法≥0.056）；Drug任务达80%回收率中位仅需348次查询，比最快基线少约18%。
AI.conclusion: 通过组分角色与物理约束的可迁移设计，KolTa在少量数据与有限预算下稳定高效地发现Top 5%配方，且可适配多样配方问题。

title: DSRS: Teaching MLLMs to Perceive, Reason, and Segment in Complex Driving Scenes
summary: Existing reasoning segmentation frameworks typically employ multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with broad world knowledge to extract semantics in a human-like manner and generate corresponding segmentation masks. Nevertheless, these frameworks lack the necessary scene-specific awareness. This paper introduces driving scene reasoning segmentation (DSRS), a scene-specific task that requires models to interpret implicit instructions, infer spatial relations, detect potential risks, handle challenging conditions, and comprehend underlying traffic rules, ultimately generating accurate segmentation masks. Meanwhile, we establish a benchmark dataset to facilitate future research on the DSRS task. To pioneer this task, we propose DSRS-Net, a novel architecture with advanced reasoning segmentation capability for automated driving. Specifically, DSRS-Net seamlessly infuses geometric features for deeper reasoning segmentation, without compromising the original multimodal fusion mechanism. This strategy effectively mitigates the modality representation mismatch in MLLMs caused by RGB-only pretraining, while enhancing the integration of geometric, contextual, and linguistic features. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of DSRS-Net in both driving scene reasoning segmentation and other language-driven segmentation tasks across various public datasets. The source code and dataset will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出驾驶场景推理分割任务DSRS及基准数据集，并设计DSRS-Net，通过无缝注入几何特征缓解MLLM因纯RGB预训练导致的模态表征失配，在DSRS和多个语言驱动分割任务上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有推理分割框架依赖具备广泛世界知识的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）以类人方式提取语义并生成掩码，但缺乏必要的场景特定意识，难以处理驾驶场景中的隐含指令、空间关系推理、潜在风险与交通规则理解。
AI.method: 提出驾驶场景推理分割任务DSRS并构建基准数据集；设计DSRS-Net架构，在不破坏原有跨模态融合机制的前提下无缝注入几何特征，以缓解纯RGB预训练造成的模态表征失配，并增强几何、上下文与语言特征的整合。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DSRS-Net在驾驶场景推理分割以及多个公开数据集上的其他语言驱动分割任务中均取得更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 场景特定意识对推理分割至关重要，引入几何特征可有效弥补MLLM的驾驶场景感知不足；DSRS任务、数据集与DSRS-Net为自动驾驶推理分割研究提供了新基准与思路。

title: Tools Need Not Speak in Text: Latent Context Compression for Agents
summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents typically append raw tool outputs to their context. Over multi-step interactions, long and noisy observations incur substantial context overhead and dilute the agent's attention to task-relevant information. Existing token pruning and summarization methods remain constrained by discrete text representations, limiting the achievable compression ratios.
  In this work, we challenge the prevailing assumption that agents must consume tool observations as explicit text tokens. To this end, we propose Coca-Cola, a continuous latent context compression model for LLM agents. Coca-Cola compresses tool observations into latent tokens and embeds them into the input embedding space of the agent. We further introduce Action-Preserving Training, which aligns the agent's next-action distributions under full and compressed observations. This trains the compression model to learn action-sufficient latent tokens that retain decision-critical information. Experiments with web-search agents on four QA benchmarks and two model families show that Coca-Cola reduces the agent's token consumption by 70.01%-89.24% and end-to-end runtime by 24.45%-55.97%, while consistently improving task performance. These results suggest that Coca-Cola offers a promising approach for context compression in agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/THU-Agent/Coca-cola.

AI.tldr: 提出Coca-Cola，将工具观测压缩为连续潜在token嵌入LLM agent的输入空间，并用Action-Preserving Training对齐动作分布，大幅降低token消耗与运行时间且提升任务表现。
AI.motivation: LLM agent通常将原始工具输出直接追加到上下文，多步交互中冗长且有噪声的观测带来巨大上下文开销并稀释对任务相关信息的注意力；现有token剪枝与摘要方法受限于离散文本表示，压缩率有限。
AI.method: 挑战"agent必须以显式文本token消费工具观测"的假设，将工具观测压缩为潜在token并嵌入agent的输入embedding空间；引入Action-Preserving Training，在完整与压缩观测下对齐agent的下一步动作分布，使压缩模型学到保留决策关键信息、动作充分的潜在token。
AI.result: 在四个QA基准和两个模型家族的web-search agent上，token消耗降低70.01%-89.24%，端到端运行时间降低24.45%-55.97%，同时任务性能持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 连续潜在上下文压缩是agent上下文压缩的有前景方向，代码已开源。

title: Zero-Shot Coordination among LLM Agents
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Poster. ICLR 26 MALGAI Workshop Oral. The first two authors contributed equally
summary: We study zero-shot coordination (ZSC), where independently developed agents must coordinate at test time. While ZSC has been well studied in the RL literature, far less is known about the performance of LLM agents despite their increasing deployment in such settings. Existing work on LLM coordination often relies on specialised scaffolding that independently developed agents are unlikely to share in practice. Moreover, evaluations on complex environments (e.g., Hanabi) make it difficult to pinpoint the sources of coordination failure. In contrast, we focus on simple, general-purpose scaffolds in minimal environments designed to isolate specific coordination challenges. Our results show that even in these controlled settings, frontier LLM agents struggle to coordinate, largely due to limited understanding of the coordination problem and weak reasoning about their partner's beliefs. While LLMs introduce semantic information as an additional axis for coordination, they nonetheless fail to exploit this structure effectively. Towards this, we propose Coordination-friendly definitions (CFDs) as a principled approach for enabling robust coordination among LLM agents. Finally, we show that CFDs can be discovered automatically, removing the need for manual engineering. Code is available at https://github.com/ahayler/zsc-llm-agents.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM智能体的零样本协调(ZSC)，用极简环境与通用脚手架隔离协调难点，发现前沿LLM在协调理解与伙伴信念推理上存在明显缺陷，并提出"协调友好定义(CFDs)"及自动发现方法来改善协调。
AI.motivation: ZSC在RL中研究充分，但LLM智能体在独立开发、测试时协作的场景下表现如何尚不清楚。现有LLM协调工作依赖专门脚手架（现实中独立智能体难以共享），且在Hanabi等复杂环境中难以定位失败原因，因此需要可控的极简设定来隔离具体协调挑战。
AI.method: 采用简单、通用的脚手架与极简环境，专门设计以隔离特定协调问题；系统评估前沿LLM的ZSC表现，并分析其失败来源（对协调问题的理解、对伙伴信念的推理、以及语义信息这一额外协调维度的利用）。在此基础上提出"协调友好定义(CFDs)"，并给出自动发现CFD的方法以避免人工设计。
AI.result: 即使在受控的简单环境中，前沿LLM仍难以实现协调，主要源于对协调问题理解有限、对伙伴信念推理薄弱；LLM虽引入语义信息作为新的协调轴，但未能有效利用该结构。CFDs可自动发现，无需人工工程即可获得。
AI.conclusion: LLM的ZSC能力被高估，瓶颈在于问题理解与心智推理而非脚手架复杂度；CFDs为构建稳健的LLM间协调提供了有原则的解决路径，并可通过自动发现落地。

title: Reasoning-Aware Cross-Modal Association Unlearning in Multimodal Large Reasoning Models
summary: Multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs) integrate visual inputs with textual and parametric knowledge, allowing sensitive information to be accessed through cross-modal associations during reasoning. This raises privacy concerns when a visual input should no longer provide access to such information. Machine unlearning can remove this influence without retraining the model from scratch. However, multimodal unlearning methods mainly target samples, concepts, or knowledge content, without separating the knowledge from the cross-modal association through which it is accessed. In reasoning models, target information may disappear from the final answer while remaining in intermediate reasoning, or be replaced by incorrect substitute knowledge. We therefore study cross-modal association unlearning, where the forget target is a designated visual-to-knowledge association: the model should suppress target-bearing behavior under the designated visual context while preserving access to the same knowledge in permitted contexts. We propose Visual-Keyed Counterfactual Rebinding (VKCR), a parameter-efficient framework for cross-modal association editing. VKCR first localizes the edit to a compact association-conditioned parameter subspace. It then reduces support for the designated target at task outputs and counterfactually rebinds the affected reasoning behavior by discouraging target-bearing or unsupported continuations while favoring valid non-sensitive alternatives. We further introduce CLEAR-R and MLLMU-R to evaluate target leakage, hallucinated reassociation, reasoning preservation, and modality-specific utility. Experiments show that VKCR substantially reduces image-conditioned target leakage and hallucinated reassociation, including across heterogeneous task formulations, while preserving non-sensitive visual reasoning and permitted text-only knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨模态关联遗忘任务，并设计VKCR框架，在参数子空间内对视觉-知识关联进行反事实重绑定，减少图像条件下的目标泄露同时保留非敏感推理能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大推理模型（MLRMs）通过跨模态关联可访问敏感信息，而现有遗忘方法主要针对样本、概念或知识内容，未分离"知识"与"访问该知识的跨模态关联"；在推理模型中目标信息可能从最终答案消失但残留在中间推理中，或被错误的替代知识替换。
AI.method: 定义"跨模态关联遗忘"：遗忘目标是特定的视觉→知识关联，需在指定视觉上下文中抑制目标行为，同时在允许上下文中保留同一知识。提出Visual-Keyed Counterfactual Rebinding (VKCR)：1）将编辑定位到紧凑的、以关联为条件的参数子空间；2）在任务输出端降低对指定目标的支持；3）通过抑制承载目标或无依据的续写、偏好有效的非敏感替代，对受影响推理行为进行反事实重绑定。并引入CLEAR-R与MLLMU-R两个评测基准。
AI.result: 实验表明VKCR显著降低了图像条件下的目标泄露与幻觉性重关联，且在异构任务表述下依然有效，同时保留非敏感视觉推理能力和允许的纯文本知识。
AI.conclusion: 将遗忘对象从"知识内容"转向"跨模态访问关联"，配合参数高效的反事实重绑定，是解决多模态推理模型隐私问题的有效途径。

title: ElecLoad: Adaptive Electricity Load Forecasting Guided by Multiple Events
summary: Accurate electricity load forecasting provides critical decision support for energy procurement, generation scheduling, and supply-demand balancing, contributing to the economic efficiency and operational reliability of power systems. However, future electricity demand can be affected by the complex interplay of multiple events described in Web notices, weather alerts, and event schedules. Their effects vary over time and can reinforce or offset one another, making electricity load difficult to forecast accurately. While existing methods can incorporate context as additional input, how to use the effects of multiple events and their interactions to guide the load forecasting process itself remains to be explored. To address this gap, we propose ElecLoad, a context-aware agent for multi-event electricity load forecasting that adaptively organizes the forecasting process. Specifically, we train ElecLoad to combine historical load with context to analyze each event's relevance to the target load, the timing of its effects, and potential interactions among events. Guided by this analysis, ElecLoad adaptively chooses to forecast the entire forecast horizon directly or to partition it into segments according to changes in event effects. When the horizon is partitioned, sub-agents independently generate initial forecasts for each segment. The main agent then reviews these forecasts, and the sub-agents perform selective refinement guided by its feedback. Experiments on multiple electricity load datasets show that ElecLoad achieves state-of-the-art performance in most evaluation scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/zhjai/ElecLoad.

AI.tldr: 提出 ElecLoad——一个上下文感知的智能体，通过分析多事件相关性、时序与交互自适应组织预测流程（整体预测或分段预测+子代理初测+主代理反馈精修），在多个电力负荷数据集上取得多数场景的 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 未来电力需求受网络公告、天气预警、事件日程等多事件复杂交互影响，效应随时间变化且相互增强或抵消；现有方法仅把上下文作为额外输入，未利用多事件及其交互效应来指导负荷预测过程本身。
AI.method: 训练 ElecLoad 将历史负荷与上下文结合，分析每个事件与目标负荷的相关性、影响发生的时间及事件间潜在交互；据此自适应选择直接预测整个horizon，或按事件效应变化分段。分段时子代理独立给出各段初测，主代理审阅并反馈，子代理据此选择性精修。
AI.result: 在多个电力负荷数据集上，ElecLoad 在大多数评估场景中达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
AI.conclusion: 利用多事件效应及其交互来驱动预测流程的自适应组织是有效的，Agent 式"分段初测+主代理审阅+选择性精修"框架优于仅在输入端加上下文的方法。

title: Partially Interpretable Decision Trees
summary: Partially interpretable models extend simple interpretable models with the option to defer complicated inputs to an accurate but uninterpretable black-box model. By deferring more inputs, the model gets more accurate; by deferring fewer, it gets more interpretable. Existing procedures to train such partially interpretable models build on linear models or decision rules. We propose three algorithms for decision trees: a partially interpretable extension of the existing Branches algorithm, which performs exact search to optimize the tree; a conversion algorithm that we run on top of standard CART, which is computationally more efficient; and a generalized CART whose splitting criterion takes into account the option to defer while growing the tree. Perhaps surprisingly, the performance of the three algorithms is similar across many realworld datasets. We can explain this through a formal bound on the potential gain of smart tree construction, provided the black box accuracy is sufficiently homogeneous across the domain. We also construct a synthetic dataset where the accuracy of the black box is deliberately inhomogeneous. There, our deferral-aware generalization of CART does outperform regular CART and matches the performance of exact search. Finally, we evaluate an application to concept bottleneck models. Partially interpretable decision trees can replace uninterpretable neural networks after the bottleneck. On undeferred inputs, the model is fully interpretable, and deferring preserves accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出三种部分可解释决策树算法（Branch扩展、CART转换、泛化CART），在多数真实数据上表现相近，并用理论界解释；当黑盒精度分布不均时，deferral-aware CART更优。
AI.motivation: 部分可解释模型允许将复杂输入交给准确但不可解释的黑盒，从而在准确性与可解释性间权衡。已有训练方法基于线性模型或决策规则，缺乏针对决策树的方案。
AI.method: 提出三种决策树算法：1) Branch算法的部分可解释扩展，做精确搜索优化树；2) 在标准CART上运行的转换算法，计算更高效；3) 在树生长时即考虑defer选项的广义CART分裂准则。
AI.result: 三种算法在多数真实数据集上性能相近，可由关于"智能树构建潜在增益"的形式化界解释（前提是黑盒精度在域内足够均匀）。在人为构造黑盒精度不均的合成数据集上，广义CART优于普通CART并达到精确搜索水平。在概念瓶颈模型应用中，部分可解释决策树可替代瓶颈后的神经网络，未defer输入完全可解释，defer保留准确性。
AI.conclusion: deferral感知的树构建仅在黑盒精度异质时带来显著收益；形式化界揭示了不同算法的适用条件，并验证了在概念瓶颈模型中的应用价值。

title: Rohbau3D-Semantics: Dense Semantic and Instance Labels for Point Clouds of Indoor Shell Construction Scenes
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)
summary:
We present the Rohbau3D-Semantics dataset, which adds dense semantic and instance-level labels to laser scans of the previously released Rohbau3D domain data from shell construction sites. The dataset comprises 504 point cloud scenes from 14 survey sites, each captured with a terrestrial laser scanner and stored in a scanner-centered local coordinate system. Unlike point clouds sampled from reconstructed meshes or synthetic building models, the data preserve the characteristic properties of real laser scanning, including non-uniform sampling, measurement artifacts, reflections, and fine geometric detail. Combined with manual labels, expert oversight during pointwise annotation, and full-scene review, this yields a high-quality benchmark for semantic scene understanding in complex built environments. The dataset includes 17 class labels of building components and one background class, along with instance annotations for object-level analysis. In addition to the 3D point clouds, the release also provides scripts for deriving geometrically aligned panoramic and cube-map representations of color, LiDAR reflection intensity, depth, surface normals, semantic labels, and instance labels from the 3D arrays. We describe the acquisition pipeline, annotation protocol, quality-control process, and panorama-generation procedure, and provide benchmark splits and baseline experiments for semantic segmentation. By combining precise terrestrial laser scans, dense annotations, and a wide variety of shell-construction scenes, Rohbau3D-Semantics bridges the gap among synthetic indoor datasets, mesh-derived benchmarks, and smaller construction-specific resources. The dataset is intended to support research on 3D scene understanding, construction-site analytics, and multimodal scene analysis in the built environment.
  Access and download the full dataset via https://github.com/RauchLukas/rohbau3d

AI.tldr: Rohbau3D-Semantics 是一个面向毛坯建筑工地的真实激光扫描点云数据集，在原有 Rohbau3D 数据基础上增加了稠密语义与实例标注，含 504 个场景、14 个测站、17 类建筑构件加背景类，并提供多模态全景/立方图表示生成工具与分割基准。
AI.motivation: 现有资源存在空白：合成室内数据集与网格推导基准缺乏真实激光扫描特性，而建筑专用数据集规模小。作者希望用一个兼具真实扫描特性、稠密标注与多场景多样性的毛坯工地数据集，弥合三者之间的差距，支撑三维场景理解、工地分析与多模态研究。
AI.method: 采用地面激光扫描仪采集 14 个测站共 504 个点云场景，统一存于以扫描仪为中心的局部坐标系；保留非均匀采样、测量伪影、反射与细几何细节等真实特性。人工逐点标注并辅以专家监督与全场景复核，给出 17 类建筑构件与 1 个背景类，以及实例标注；同时提供从三维数组生成几何对齐的全景与立方图表示的脚本（颜色、反射强度、深度、法向、语义与实例标签）。
AI.result: 构建了高质量基准：包含稠密语义/实例标签的真实扫描点云，配套全景与立方图多模态数据，给出基准划分与语义分割基线实验；并系统描述了采集流程、标注协议、质量控制与全景生成过程。
AI.conclusion: Rohbau3D-Semantics 以精确地面激光扫描、稠密标注和多样化毛坯工地场景，填补合成室内数据集、网格推导基准与小规模建筑专用资源之间的空白，可用于三维场景理解、工地分析与多模态场景分析研究，数据已公开发布。

title: Using Experience Twice: Dynamic Process Rubrics for Privileged Token-Level Credit Assignment
summary: Agent trajectories often contain both successful decisions and failed attempts, yet optimization with sparse trajectory-level rewards struggles to identify which critical decisions should be reinforced or suppressed. We observe that meaningful distinctions among on-policy trajectories can be distilled into natural-language process rubrics and used as process supervision signals. Based on this insight, we propose Online Rubric Self-Distillation (ORSD), which leverages self-derived process rubrics for dense token-level supervision, thereby augmenting outcome-centric reinforcement learning. Specifically, the current policy independently generates multiple rubric bundles at each step according to the same group of trajectories, extracting candidate process rubrics from cross-trajectory behavioral differences. A frozen verifier then evaluates all rubric items against each trajectory in the group, and selects one candidate bundle based on bundle-level alignment between rubric satisfaction and task success. ORSD treats the selected rubric bundle as privileged information during training, then compares the log-likelihoods of the original tokens with and without the rubric. The resulting likelihood gap provides token-specific process credit, which is added to the original trajectory-level GRPO advantage through additive advantage shaping. ORSD thus bridges trajectory-level outcome supervision and fine-grained process supervision, enabling token-level credit assignment using process signals. Extensive experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that ORSD accelerates policy improvement and boosts final task performance for both Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B under the same environment-interaction budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/AnnaXChun/ORSD.

AI.tldr: ORSD利用策略自身生成的"过程评分标准"(process rubrics)作为密集的token级过程监督，与GRPO的轨迹级优势相加，实现细粒度信用分配，在ALFWorld和WebShop上加速并提升智能体训练效果。
AI.motivation: 智能体轨迹既含成功决策也含失败尝试，但稀疏的轨迹级奖励难以辨别哪些关键决策应被强化或抑制，缺乏过程级信用分配信号。
AI.method: 观察到同策略轨迹间的差异可用自然语言过程评分标准刻画。ORSD在每个步骤基于同一组轨迹独立生成多个rubric bundle，从跨轨迹行为差异中提取候选项；冻结验证器逐项评估并与任务成功做bundle级对齐，选出最佳bundle；将其视作特权信息，比较有/无rubric条件下原始token的对数似然差，得到token级过程信用，以加性方式叠加到GRPO轨迹级优势上。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld与WebShop上，相同环境交互预算下，Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3-4B的策略改进更快、最终任务性能更高。
AI.conclusion: ORSD在轨迹级结果监督与细粒度过程监督之间架起桥梁，无需额外人工标注即可实现token级信用分配，是一种可扩展的自蒸馏式过程监督方法。

title: Understanding the Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in LLMs
summary:
Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning substantially improves Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization mechanism remains theoretically underexplored. We study CoT as compositional OOD generalization: the target task lacks complete reasoning trajectories or direct input-output pairs, while training provides only in-distribution (ID) atomic step data. We show that CoT generalizes by repeatedly applying a shared single-step predictor to compose reusable ID transitions. Theoretically, let $T$ denote the number of reasoning steps in the target task, $n$ the number of training samples per sub-task, and $k$ the number of output tokens per step; then the OOD task risk is controlled by the sum of the ID sub-task risks, scaled by a coefficient of order $\mathcal{O}(k)$ that is independent of $T$, although the summed risk itself may still grow with $T$. A Rademacher-complexity analysis further shows that the estimation term is of order $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T/n})$, rather than linear in $T$, due to predictor sharing under a uniform capacity control on the shared class. For autoregressive Next-Token Prediction, the final-task risk is bounded by the best-in-class step-level risk scaled by the same coefficient of order $\mathcal{O}(k)$, plus an estimation term of order $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\big(k\sqrt{T/n}\big)$. A parity-coupled construction further shows that, for the sub-task empirical risk minimizer, the expected final-task risk is at least the best in-class risk plus $Ω(\sqrt{T/n})$ when $T\le n$. Experiments on Atom-Task and GSM8K support the theory: CoT enables short-to-long and compositional generalization, while explicit state tracking is crucial.
  Our code is available at https://github.com/maxliang114514/CoT-OOD.

AI.tldr: 该论文从组合式分布外(OOD)泛化视角理论分析思维链(CoT)机制，证明CoT通过反复复用共享的单步预测器来组合ID原子步骤，其OOD风险由ID子任务风险之和乘以与T无关的O(k)系数控制，估计项为O(√(T/n))而非线性增长，并用实验验证了从短到长及组合泛化能力。
AI.motivation: CoT显著提升LLM性能，但其OOD泛化机制缺乏理论解释。论文希望回答：CoT为何能泛化，风险如何随推理长度T、样本量n、每步token数k变化。
AI.method: 将CoT建模为组合式OOD泛化：目标任务的完整推理轨迹或直接输入输出对缺失，训练仅有ID原子步骤数据。理论上证明CoT通过重复应用共享的单步预测器组合可复用的ID转移；使用Rademacher复杂度分析估计项，给出自回归下一token预测下的最终任务风险界；并构造奇偶耦合(parity-coupled)下界实例。
AI.result: OOD风险≤sum(ID子任务风险)乘以O(k)系数（与T无关）；估计项为O(√(T/n))，来自共享预测器与统一容量控制而非线性于T；自回归NTP下最终风险界为最优步级风险×O(k)+Õ(k√(T/n))；下界证明期望最终风险至少为最优类内风险加Ω(√(T/n))（当T≤n）。Atom-Task与GSM8K实验支持理论，CoT实现短到长及组合泛化，显式状态跟踪至关重要。
AI.conclusion: CoT的OOD泛化源自共享单步预测器的组合复用，风险主要随T以√T缓慢增长而非线性增长；理论界基本紧致（上下界匹配量级）；显式状态跟踪是CoT成功泛化的关键实践要素。

title: Annotator-Free Object Detection via Foundation Model Collaboration
summary: Object detection research remains constrained by high annotation costs and the closed-set assumptions of supervised models, limiting scalability to novel categories. We present a target-dataset annotation-free object detection framework that eliminates the need for human labeling on the target dataset by leveraging the complementary strengths of pretrained foundation models, including segmentation and vision-language systems, combined with a self-refining training loop. To further reduce reliance on expensive LVLM queries, we introduce a landmark-based clustering mechanism that amortizes labeling across image clusters, improving label consistency while lowering computational cost. Our method autonomously generates segmentation proposals, assigns semantic labels through multimodal reasoning, and iteratively improves both localization and classification using a lightweight open-set detector. This modular pipeline enables adaptation to completely unseen object classes and domains without any human-provided target-dataset annotations, while maintaining compatibility with existing detection architectures. Evaluations on COCO, LVIS, ODinW-35, and Roboflow-100 demonstrate substantial performance gains over state-of-the-art open-vocabulary and long-tail detection methods, achieving 60.8 AP on COCO and 47.4 AP on LVIS under zero-shot settings. Beyond strong benchmark results, our approach provides a scalable foundation for real-world detection systems in unknown environments, where annotation is infeasible.

AI.tldr: 提出一种目标数据集免标注的检测框架，借助分割与视觉语言等基础模型加自精炼训练循环，并用基于landmark的聚类摊薄LVLM查询成本，实现零样本检测。
AI.motivation: 目标检测受高昂标注成本与有监督模型闭集假设的制约，难以扩展到新类别与新领域。
AI.method: 结合预训练基础模型（分割、视觉语言系统）与自精炼训练循环：自动生成分割提案，通过多模态推理赋予语义标签，用轻量开放集检测器迭代提升定位与分类；并引入landmark聚类机制将标注摊薄到图像簇，提升标签一致性、降低计算成本。
AI.result: 在COCO、LVIS、ODinW-35、Roboflow-100上显著优于SOTA开放词汇与长尾检测方法；零样本设置下COCO达60.8 AP、LVIS达47.4 AP。
AI.conclusion: 该模块化流水线无需目标数据集人工标注即可适配全新类别和领域，兼容现有检测架构，为无法标注的真实场景提供可扩展基础。

title: Addition by Subtraction: Toward Mitigating Fragile Safety Alignment in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) undergo safety alignment to prevent harmful generations, yet they remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. Recent work reveals a deeper structural weakness: safety alignment can be highly sparse, such that pruning a small number of safety-critical neurons or ablating a single refusal direction can substantially undermine aligned behavior. In this work, we take the first steps toward strengthening safety alignment such that it is less dependent on sparse model components. We propose Addition by Subtraction, which gradually removes identified safety-critical neurons during finetuning and uses preference optimization to re-establish safety-aligned behavior through other parts of the model. Our results show that the resulting models are substantially more robust to pruning-based attacks. Remarkably, these benefits generalize beyond the white-box attacks motivating our design: Addition by Subtraction improves robustness against other sparsity-based interventions, including refusal-direction ablation, as well as a broad range of black-box jailbreak attacks. The finetuned models also exhibit improved truthfulness while largely preserving general capabilities. Comprehensive experiments across four models from three vendors demonstrate consistent improvements in safety robustness, reducing attack success rates by up to 90% for some attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出"Addition by Subtraction"方法，在微调中逐步剪除安全关键神经元并用偏好优化重建安全行为，使安全对齐不再依赖稀疏组件，显著提升对剪枝、方向消融及黑盒越狱攻击的鲁棒性且保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐高度稀疏：剪掉少量安全关键神经元或消融单一拒绝方向即可大幅削弱对齐行为，模型易受越狱攻击。作者希望强化对齐，使其不依赖稀疏的模型组件。
AI.method: 先识别安全关键神经元，在微调过程中逐步将其移除（subtraction），同时利用偏好优化（preference optimization）让模型其余部分重新建立安全对齐行为，从而将安全性分散到更广的参数中。
AI.result: 对剪枝类攻击显著更鲁棒；且泛化到白盒之外的稀疏干预（如拒绝方向消融）和多种黑盒越狱攻击；真实性提升，通用能力基本保留。跨3家厂商4个模型实验一致提升，部分攻击成功率最高降低90%。
AI.conclusion: 通过主动去除安全关键神经元并重训练，可将安全对齐从稀疏依赖转为分布式表征，是一种有效且可泛化的鲁棒性增强策略。

title: Graph Foundation Models Can Become Effective Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detectors
summary: Multivariate time series anomaly detection (MTSAD) relies on modeling both temporal dynamics and inter-sensor dependencies to identify complex system faults. Although graph-based detectors explicitly model sensor topologies, they train task-specific networks from scratch on limited target-domain data, remaining vulnerable to spurious correlations and unable to reuse transferable priors. While pretrained Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) offer transferable topological priors and anomaly discriminability, directly adapting them to MTSAD is hindered by cross-modal feature-topology mismatch, unreliable pseudo-anomaly supervision, and decision distortion during node-to-window aggregation. To fill these gaps, we propose a novel adaptation framework, Gfm4Mtsad, which unleashes pretrained GFMs for MTSAD. We introduce the Structure-and-Information Contract Alignment (SICA) module to bridge continuous time series and the pretrained GFM space. This module harmonizes principal subspace token projection, normal-prior-guided graph construction, and residual recovery to suppress spurious edges while retaining fine-grained temporal details. We propose a Mechanism-Aligned Pseudo-Anomaly Screening strategy (MAPS) to steer unsupervised learning. It applies localized dependency breaks while preserving empirical residuals, selecting hard negatives near the normal boundary for targeted supervision. We develop a Tail-Gated Evidence Calibration mechanism (TGEC) to eliminate node-to-window aggregation distortion. It calibrates multi-granular graph responses against normal operational references, strictly preserving benign score rankings while selectively refining extreme anomaly candidates in the tail distribution for reliable window detection and interpretable sensor evidence. Extensive evaluations with two GFM backbones demonstrate that Gfm4Mtsad achieves superior detection performance over existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出Gfm4Mtsad框架，通过SICA、MAPS、TGEC三个模块解决跨模态特征-拓扑失配、伪异常监督不可靠、节点到窗口聚合决策失真三大问题，将预训练图基础模型迁移用于多变量时间序列异常检测，在两种GFM骨干上均优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 基于图的MTSAD检测器需在有限目标域数据上从零训练任务专用网络，易受伪相关影响且无法复用可迁移先验；预训练图基础模型（GFM）虽具备可迁移拓扑先验和异常判别能力，但直接迁移面临跨模态特征-拓扑失配、伪异常监督不可靠、节点到窗口聚合时决策失真三大障碍。
AI.method: 1) SICA（结构与信息契约对齐）：融合主子空间token投影、正态先验引导的图构建与残差恢复，抑制虚假边并保留细粒度时序细节以桥接时序与GFM空间；2) MAPS（机制对齐伪异常筛选）：在保留经验残差的同时施加局部依赖断裂，选取靠近正常边界的困难负样本进行定向监督；3) TGEC（尾部门控证据校准）：以正常运行参考校准多粒度图响应，保持良性分数排序不变，仅在尾部分布选择性修正极端异常候选。
AI.result: 在两个GFM骨干网络上进行了广泛评估，Gfm4Mtsad的检测性能优于现有基线方法，同时保持可解释的传感器证据。
AI.conclusion: 通过适配而非从头训练，预训练图基础模型可被有效用于多变量时间序列异常检测；所提三重对齐/筛选/校准机制协同解决了迁移中的关键失配问题。

title: BiCG-Net: Target-Specific Image Quality Assessment via Observation Modeling and In-Image Differencing
summary:
We estimate the quality of a specific target region (e.g., a train body) in an image, rather than the whole image. This differs fundamentally from whole-image No-Reference Image Quality Assessment (NR-IQA): when the target occupies a small fraction of the frame, the whole-image score is dominated by background, and no public benchmark provides target-level human Mean Opinion Score (MOS). We estimate target quality via nested sampling - a sequence of patches expanding outward from the target box - and infer quality from the relative structure of this sequence.
  This motivates BiCG-Net, a student network that distills an 11-teacher ensemble through a linear observation model and an in-image differencing mechanism, which provably cancels the target term and teacher-specific bias. We train and test the student independently on each dataset, and evaluate zero-shot transfer across benchmarks. On CSIQ and LIVEC, the student reaches PLCCs of 0.9009 and 0.9133 against human MOS, exceeding the best single teacher and the teacher consensus. On a self-built MOS-free railway dataset, the student reaches a PLCC of 0.9855 against a weak label.
  The student exceeds its teachers because it learns a new mapping from the relative structure of teacher readings to the ground-truth label, rather than mimicking them. Residual analysis on CSIQ and LIVEC shows the prediction residual is significantly correlated with background contamination, teacher dispersion, and label extremity, demonstrating the student extracts information the consensus does not contain. Under CSIQ-to-LIVEC transfer, the frozen student reaches a PLCC of 0.8416, exceeding the consensus by 0.1947. We position BiCG-Net as an offline target-level quality auditing and label-generation engine; its 39,482-parameter student is compact by design, acting as a unifying layer mapping heterogeneous teacher readings onto a common quality scale.

AI.tldr: 提出BiCG-Net，用嵌套采样与11教师蒸馏实现目标区域级无参考质量评估，学生网络超越教师集成。
AI.motivation: 现有NR-IQA只评估整图，当目标（如车厢）只占画面小部分时评分被背景主导；且无公开的目标级人类MOS基准。
AI.method: 对目标框向外扩展的补丁序列做嵌套采样，从序列的相对结构中推断质量；用线性观测模型与图像内差分机制（可证明抵消目标项与教师偏差）将11个教师模型蒸馏到一个39,482参数的学生网络；各数据集独立训练测试，并做零样本迁移。
AI.result: CSIQ、LIVEC上PLCC达0.9009、0.9133，超过最佳单教师与教师共识；自建无MOS铁路数据集上对弱标签PLCC 0.9855；CSIQ→LIVEC迁移PLCC 0.8416，超出共识0.1947；残差与背景污染、教师离散度、标签极端性显著相关。
AI.conclusion: 学生网络学得教师读数的相对结构到真值的新映射而非模仿教师，故优于教师；定位为离线目标级质量审计与标签生成引擎，小型学生充当异构教师读数的统一映射层。

title: RAGAM-AI: A Hybrid Reinforcement Learning based Agentic approach powered by Generative AI for Edge Resource Management
summary: Resource management for distributed edge networks hosting different services has been handled efficiently using Reinforcement learning (RL). Reward generalization in complex workflows is still an open issue within the RL realm. Therefore, this work proposes RAGAM-AI, a hybrid framework that combines the capabilities of RL algorithms and Generative-AI (Gen-AI) for powering an Agentic AI workflow that optimizes resource allocation at the Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC) units. This framework further resolves the reward generalization issue by utilizing Large Language Model (LLM) for feedback. A Multi- Agent Soft-Actor Critic (MASAC) using MathΣtral as a reward oracle is implemented for managing resource allocations at the MEC. RAGAM-AI interprets system state information and evaluates multi-objective trade-offs guiding the resource orchestration loop over distributed edge server agents. The complexity of the framework is further brought down by incorporating surrogate reward model. The overall performance is evaluated against the single agent SAC, REINFORCE and random policies for benchmarking. On using RAGAM-AI, lower allocation deviations for CPU, memory and bandwidth resources are reported while minimizing the latency and data rate costs. A scalable AI as a feedback (AIAF) solution optimizing network resources with significant performance improvement is thus presented.

AI.tldr: 提出RAGAM-AI混合框架，结合强化学习与生成式AI，用LLM作为奖励预言机解决奖励泛化问题，优化MEC资源分配。
AI.motivation: 分布式边缘网络中不同服务的资源管理已用RL高效处理，但复杂工作流下的奖励泛化（reward generalization）仍是开放问题。
AI.method: RAGAM-AI用MathΣtral作为奖励预言机的多智能体Soft-Actor Critic（MASAC），解释系统状态、评估多目标权衡以指导分布式边缘服务器智能体的资源编排，并引入代理奖励模型（surrogate reward model）降低复杂度；LLM提供反馈解决奖励泛化。
AI.result: 与单智能体SAC、REINFORCE及随机策略对比，CPU、内存、带宽的分配偏差更低，同时降低时延和数据速率成本，性能显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 提出可扩展的"AI即反馈"（AIAF）方案，用LLM反馈优化网络资源分配，实现显著性能提升。

title: The Alignment Tax Is Graded: Task-Selective Capability Loss Under Length-Normalized DPO with SFT Retention
summary: Setting. This is an empirical characterization study; we propose no new method and run no comparisons against alternative objectives. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-4B with sparse LoRA and length-normalized DPO plus an SFT retention term (the RPO objective) on structured financial-filing tasks, and track downstream capability as the implicit reward margin grows to $\sim 7$ $β$-scaled units (nf4 training; $\sim 3$ under fp16 measurement on the unquantized base). Question. Does margin growth degrade capability uniformly across tasks, or selectively? Findings. In a pre-registered study (8 seeds, 6 unseen at freeze) with artifact-aware scoring and TOST equivalence testing, the alignment tax is graded and task-selective: extraction is preserved ($Δ= -0.55$ pts, equivalent at $\pm5$ pts), json loses little ($Δ= -3.52$ pts, equivalence fails on a clustered item-level interval), and router degrades severely ($Δ= -30$ pts). Router's loss concentrates in a margin 1-3 damage window containing a transient format-break spike. The margin is accounted for almost entirely ($\geq 96\%$) by suppression of rejected completions, with chosen reward approximately flat, consistent with the retention term anchoring it; we do not attribute the behavioral damage to any single gradient channel. Gold-logp deflation is task-selective (extraction $-0.15$, json $-1.04$, router $-1.47$ nats/token under fp16), with gold selectively protected relative to incorrect controls on extraction (8/8 seeds). QLoRA reward margins differ up to $3.4\times$ between nf4 training and unquantized fp16 measurement, with an axis-dependent gap. Scope. Length-normalized rewards with SFT retention, sparse LoRA on 8/32 layers, one 4B model, easily-separable synthetic preferences, three structured tasks. A no-retention control and a measured format-alignment metric are left to future work.

AI.tldr: 在结构化金融申报任务上微调Qwen3.5-4B（稀疏LoRA + 长度归一化DPO + SFT保留项），实证发现随隐式奖励margin增长，对齐税是分级且任务选择性的：抽取基本不受影响、json小幅退化、router严重退化，且损害集中在margin 1–3窗口内。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐研究多把"对齐税"当作统一效应，缺乏任务层面、margin层面的精细刻画；本文不提出新方法，而是要回答margin增长导致的性能退化是均匀的还是有选择性的。
AI.method: 预注册实证研究（8个随机种子，冻结时6个未见任务），采用artifact-aware打分与TOST等价性检验；在nf4下用稀疏LoRA（8/32层）和带SFT保留项的长度归一化DPO（RPO目标）训练，margin追踪至约7个β单位（fp16、未量化基座上实测约3）；并用gold-logp与QLoRA/fp16对照做诊断。
AI.result: 抽取任务保持（Δ=-0.55pt，±5pt内等价）；json略有损失（Δ=-3.52pt，聚类区间上等价性不成立）；router严重退化（Δ=-30pt），损失集中在margin 1–3的"损伤窗口"并伴随短暂的格式崩塌尖峰。margin增长≥96%来自拒绝样本被压制（chosen奖励近似持平）；gold-logp下降具任务选择性（抽取-0.15、json-1.04、router-1.47 nats/token），且抽取任务上gold相对错误对照被选择性保护（8/8种子）。nf4与未量化fp16测得的reward margin差距最高达3.4倍，且随轴不同。
AI.conclusion: 对齐税并非均匀，而是分级、任务选择性的，并存在明确的margin损伤窗口；行为损害不能归因于单一梯度通道。结论限于长度归一化奖励+SFT保留、稀疏LoRA、单一4B模型、易于区分的合成偏好与三个结构化任务，无保留项对照与格式对齐指标留待后续。

title: FedXCrop: Privacy-Preserving Crop Disease Detection via Federated Learning with Post-Aggregation Explainability under Non-IID Farm Distributions
comment: 26 pages. Includes 38-class crop disease classification experiments, federated learning evaluation under non-IID client distributions, and quantitative explainability analysis using Grad-CAM and SmoothGrad. Code and experimental results: https://github.com/Kriti2709/fedxcrp
summary: Deep learning can classify crop diseases accurately from benchmark leaf images, but centralized training requires farms to share raw data, and predictions without explanations offer limited support for treatment decisions. We present FedXCrop, a federated crop disease classification pipeline that quantitatively evaluates explanations of the aggregated global model. A MobileNetV2 model trained centrally on PlantVillage achieved 99.38% test accuracy (standard deviation 0.05 over three seeds) on a fixed test set of 5,428 images across 38 classes. Federated models initialized with ImageNet weights were trained for 30 rounds across five clients. FedAvg achieved 98.81% accuracy with identically distributed clients and 98.81%, 98.59%, and 97.78% under Dirichlet label skew (alpha = 1, 0.5, and 0.1, respectively). FedProx was not significantly different from FedAvg at any heterogeneity level (McNemar p > 0.3). Grad-CAM and SmoothGrad explanations were evaluated on 380 test images. Both attributed more energy to the leaf than chance (0.70-0.78 versus 0.60), while Grad-CAM maps from federated and centralized models showed Spearman correlations of 0.74-0.76. Agreement decreased as heterogeneity increased, lesion localization was only modestly above chance, and a model-randomization test indicated that SmoothGrad maps depended substantially on image structure rather than learned parameters. In this setting, label skew reduced federated accuracy by 0.6-1.6 percentage points relative to centralized training. FedAvg largely preserved Grad-CAM behavior, while FedProx provided no measurable benefit.

AI.tldr: 提出FedXCrop联邦农作物病害分类流程，并量化评估聚合全局模型的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 集中式训练要求农场共享原始数据，且缺乏解释的预测对治疗决策支持有限。
AI.method: MobileNetV2 + ImageNet初始化，5客户端30轮联邦训练；对比FedAvg与FedProx，在Dirichlet标签偏斜(α=1,0.5,0.1)下测试；用Grad-CAM与SmoothGrad在380张图像上评估解释性。
AI.result: 集中式99.38%；FedAvg同分布98.81%，偏斜下98.81%/98.59%/97.78%；FedProx无显著差异(p>0.3)。解释更多能量落在叶片(0.70-0.78 vs 0.60)，Grad-CAM与集中式Spearman相关0.74-0.76；异质性增加则一致性下降，病灶定位仅略高于随机，随机化测试显示SmoothGrad依赖图像结构而非学习参数。
AI.conclusion: 此设定下标签偏斜使精度下降0.6-1.6个百分点；FedAvg基本保持Grad-CAM行为，FedProx无增益。

title: One Scale, Four Texts: Gaps, Overlaps and Silent Repairs in Published Grading Schemes
summary: Category systems often reach their users as text, and readers apply them with tacit repairs. We ask what such a text determines once the repairs are removed, using diabetic retinopathy grading, where one international scale circulates in several documents. We transcribe four texts (the English screening definitions of 2025, the international scale as tabulated in 2017 and as published in 2003, and an Italian guideline of 2015) into one rule language over 24 finding variables, and make every point a text leaves open a named precisification. Exhaustive enumeration of 1,425,807,360 finding profiles, re-derived by an SMT solver and spot-checked by an OWL reasoner, shows that every text that assigns actions leaves some eyes without a category under every reading; that the 2017 tabulation has a proliferative class that is empty when read literally and a macular gap that the 2003 text lacks, so that no function maps the 2003 grades onto the 2017 grades; and that on image findings alone the English and Italian texts order some pairs of eyes in opposite ways. On 927 annotated photographs from three public datasets, with retinal thickening assumed absent, the English text and the 2017 tabulation disagree on referral for 26.8% of the eyes of one dataset (DDR) on which both decide, and in a pre-registered experiment classifiers trained on each text's labels side with their own text. Thickening cannot be seen on a colour photograph; left free, every disagreement involving England becomes undecidable, so it rests on what the camera cannot show. In a second pre-registered study, language models that answered without deliberating repaired most gap and overlap items even when told to read literally, while Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Opus 5.5 reported the defects far more often; within two models, deliberation reduced silent repair without removing it.

AI.tldr: 本文将四份糖尿病视网膜病变分级文本转写为统一规则语言（24个发现变量），把每处文本空白命名化，穷举14亿余种发现组合，揭示各类分级文本存在无类别眼睛、2017版增殖类空集与黄斑缺口、英意文本排序相反等问题，并以927张照片标注与两项预注册实验验证文本差异的实际后果。
AI.motivation: 分级系统以文本形式到达用户，读者会进行"不成文修补"（tacit repairs）。作者想知道：一旦剥离这些修补，文本本身究竟确定了什么。以糖尿病视网膜病变分级为案例，因为同一国际量表在多个文档中流传。
AI.method: 将四份文本（2025年英文筛查定义、2017年表格化国际量表、2003年发表版本、2015年意大利指南）转写为同一规则语言，覆盖24个发现变量；把每处文本未明确之处设为具名精确化（precisification）。穷举1,425,807,360种发现组合，由SMT求解器重新推导并用OWL推理机抽查。另在三个公开数据集的927张标注照片上验证（假设无视网膜增厚），并进行两项预注册实验：分类器实验与语言模型阅读实验。
AI.result: (1) 所有给出处置建议的文本在任何解读下都会留下无类别的眼睛；(2) 2017表格的增殖类按字面解读为空集，且有2003文本所无的黄斑缺口，故不存在把2003分级映射到2017分级的函数；(3) 仅凭图像发现，英文与意大利文本对部分眼睛对的排序相反；(4) 假设无视网膜增厚时，英文文本与2017表格在DDR数据集上对26.8%双方均作决定的眼睛给出不同转诊结论，预注册实验显示各文本训练的分类器偏向自身文本；因彩色照片无法显示增厚，涉及英国文本的争议一律不可判定，取决于相机看不见的东西；(5) 语言模型不作推理时即便被要求字面阅读也修补了多数缺口与重叠项，Claude Sonnet 5.5与Opus 5.5更常报告缺陷，推理可减少但未消除"无声修补"。
AI.conclusion: 分级文本并不唯一决定分级结果：其未言明部分（尤其无法从照片获得的视网膜增厚）决定了大量实际分歧。文本缺陷是可检测的，但人类式（及模型式）的沉默修补难以根除，故分级系统的规范性须显式化其精确化假设，并对自动解读保持审慎。

title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
summary: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了多轮智能体RL对交互预算(回合数T、采样宽度K)的敏感性，发现轨迹级优势依赖充足回合预算，且RL收益集中于错误恢复与长程韧性而非单步决策质量，并提出BudgetMix RL通过在训练中变化交互预算来缓解部署风险。
AI.motivation: 多轮智能体强化学习虽在长程任务上表现优异，但其性能提升对交互约束高度敏感，部署时回合预算受限会导致性能明显下降，需要理解并缓解这种预算依赖带来的风险。
AI.method: 通过Pass@(K,T)在采样宽度K与交互深度T两个维度上评估智能体RL的表现；分析轨迹级优势与回合预算的关系及RL收益来源；初步讨论过程监督信号的利弊；提出BudgetMix RL，在训练中动态变化交互预算。
AI.result: 实验显示轨迹级RL优势依赖足够的回合预算，预算收紧时增益显著衰减；智能体RL并不均匀提升单步决策质量，其优势集中在错误恢复与长程韧性；BudgetMix RL在多种执行设置下均取得稳健性能。
AI.conclusion: 智能体RL存在预算依赖问题，其收益偏向长程恢复能力；训练时变化交互预算(BudgetMix RL)是一种有效缓解部署风险、提升跨执行设置鲁棒性的可行方案。

title: Homology Features for X-Ray Hyperspectral Images Segmentation
summary: Characterizing Multi-Energy X-ray Transmission (XRT) hyperspectral images presents significant challenges for traditional classification frameworks due to high-dimensional redundancy and non-linear spectral overlaps. Although manifold learning techniques such as UMAP enhance spectral representation by preserving non-linear correlations, they do not explicitly utilize the geometric structure of the embedded manifold for segmentation. This study introduces a hybrid architecture that integrates topological features derived from persistent homology with convolutional and graph neural networks. The approach computes Vietoris-Rips persistent homology on UMAP-projected superpixel point clouds to capture H 1 cyclic structures that encode spectral heterogeneity. These topological descriptors are combined with pixel-level CNN features through a broadcasting mechanism that propagates superpixel-level graph representations to full spatial resolution. Experimental results on XRT multi-energy imagery demonstrate that the proposed hybrid model significantly outperforms both CNN-only and superpixel-pooling fusion baselines, suggesting that topological features provide complementary discriminative information to local spectralspatial descriptors.

AI.tldr: 提出融合持续同调拓扑特征与卷积/图神经网络的混合架构，用于多能X射线透射高光谱图像分类，性能优于纯CNN及超像素池化融合基线。
AI.motivation: 多能XRT高光谱图像存在高维冗余与非线性光谱重叠，传统分类框架难以应对；UMAP等流形学习虽改善光谱表示，但未显式利用嵌入流形的几何结构进行分割。
AI.method: 在UMAP投影的超像素点云上计算Vietoris-Rips持续同调，提取编码光谱异质性的H1环状结构拓扑描述子；再通过广播机制将超像素级图表示传播到全空间分辨率，与像素级CNN特征融合。
AI.result: 在XRT多能成像数据上，混合模型显著优于纯CNN和超像素池化融合基线。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑特征可为局部光谱-空间描述子提供互补的判别信息，验证了持续同调在XRT高光谱分类中的有效性。

title: Time-Division Multiplexing: The Operational Rhythm and Temporal Organization Layer of Digital Life
summary: Continual agents must handle urgent interaction while retaining alternatives, replaying errors, and committing safe long-term changes. A previous digital-life framework distinguishes online (busy) and offline (idle) channels, but leaves open whether these are separate programs or phases of a common process and how their operations should be ordered. Motivated by recent observations of rapidly alternating perceptual representations in primate cortex, we develop a temporal organization layer with phase-tagged micro-epochs, an observable duty cycle, independent content and resource controls, and three nested clocks separating candidate exploration from durable commitment. We give a projected duty-cycle update, state its deterministic descent guarantee and the additional noise term required for a stochastic guarantee, and specify coupled busy/idle execution contracts. Five synthetic experiments (64 seeds each) examine descent and noise, objective misalignment, gain asymmetry, resource coupling, and dropped replay logs. In the gain/noise model the best tested gain ratio is 1.55; decoupled scheduling yields 26.6% versus 11.1% success on a constructed urgent/high-load subset. A frozen-backbone Qwen3-8B prototype further checks orchestration, but its proxy outcomes are not task-benchmark evidence. The results establish a testable scheduling design and identify its conditions of validity, not machine consciousness or general-purpose agent superiority.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个"时间组织层"，用带相位标签的微纪元、可观测占空比、独立内容/资源控制与三层嵌套时钟来统一持续智能体的在线（忙碌）与离线（空闲）通道，并给出占空比更新的确定性下降保证、随机噪声项及耦合执行契约。合成实验验证调度设计，并非通用智能体优越性或机器意识的证据。
AI.motivation: 持续智能体需同时处理紧急交互、保留备选方案、回放错误并提交安全长期变更。既有"数字生命"框架区分在线/离线通道，但未说明二者是独立程序还是同一过程的两个阶段，也未规定操作顺序；灵长类皮层快速交替的知觉表征提供了组织启发。
AI.method: 构建时间组织层：相位标签微纪元、可观测占空比、独立内容与资源控制、三层嵌套时钟（候选探索与持久承诺分离）；推导投影占空比更新及其确定性下降保证，给出随机保证所需噪声项，并规定耦合的忙碌/空闲执行契约。用5组合成实验（各64种子）考察下降与噪声、目标错配、增益不对称、资源耦合、回放日志丢失；另加冻结骨干Qwen3-8B原型做编排检查。
AI.result: 增益/噪声模型中最优测试增益比为1.55；解耦调度在构造的紧急/高负载子集上成功率达26.6%，对比11.1%。Qwen3-8B原型仅验证编排流程，其代理结果明确不构成任务基准证据。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了一个可检验的调度设计并界定其有效条件，而非主张机器意识或通用智能体的整体优越性。

title: Model Merging Does Not Require Uniform LoRA Ranks
summary: Model merging combines separately fine-tuned experts into a single model without retraining. Standard practice trains every expert at the same LoRA rank, which couples the rank choice across experts even though each domain has its own best rank. We show this coupling is a property of the merge method, not of merging. We train 36 experts on three domains (mathematics, instruction following, multilingual) at four ranks and three model scales, then merge with six methods at uniform ranks and at each domain's own best rank. Giving experts different ranks costs averaging and utility-based selection nothing, and gains them up to 1.8 pp of multi-domain accuracy, while the conflict-resolution methods are inconsistent and can lose up to 4 pp. The split has a simple cause. Merging keeps only a fixed share of the pooled spectral components, and methods that choose them by size discard many that would have reduced loss. They also tend to discard the same expert: the instruction adapter has the smallest singular values, so it is dropped almost entirely and IFEval falls by 16 to 25 pp. Choosing components by their effect on loss instead keeps all three experts, and leaves accuracy nearly flat across an 8$\times$ rank range (0.7 pp, against 6.7 pp for TIES at 4B scale). Rank can therefore be chosen per expert whenever the merge operator does not select by magnitude.

AI.tldr: 模型合并中"所有专家用同一LoRA秩"的耦合并非合并本身必需，而是源于合并算子按幅值选择谱分量；按损失影响选择分量即可让各专家独立选秩，并避免指令适配器被丢弃。
AI.motivation: 标准做法让所有专家用相同LoRA秩，但各领域各有最优秩，这种耦合限制了合并效果。作者要厘清：秩耦合是合并方法的内在性质，还是可去除的实现选择。
AI.method: 在数学、指令遵循、多语言三个领域，4种秩、3种模型规模下训练36个专家；用6种合并方法分别在统一秩与各领域最优秩下合并，对比平均/效用选择类方法与冲突消解类方法的表现，并分析谱分量选择机制与IFEval下降原因。
AI.result: 异秩对平均和效用选择类方法无损，多域精度最多提升1.8pp；冲突消解类方法不一致、最多掉4pp。原因：合并只保留固定比例的池化谱分量，按幅值选分量会丢弃可降损失的分量，且指令适配器奇异值最小几乎被完全丢弃，IFEval下降16–25pp。按损失影响选分量可保留三专家，在8倍秩范围内精度波动仅0.7pp（TIES在4B下为6.7pp）。
AI.conclusion: 只要合并算子不按幅值选择分量，秩就可以按专家独立选择；这为每专家定制秩、提升多域合并性能提供了依据。

title: CAPE-JEPA - Cross-modal Adversarial Probabilistic Embedding JEPA
comment: Accepted for publication at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)
summary: Cross-modal remote sensing image retrieval (RS-CMIR) requires representations that are simultaneously modality-invariant and semantically discriminative, despite the profound physical gap between heterogeneous sensors such as Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and multispectral imagery. Recent JEPA-based Predictive self-supervised approaches such as X-JEPA formulate cross-modal alignment as a deterministic latent forecasting task, implicitly assuming uniform patch predictability and leaving cross-modal distributional alignment unaddressed. We propose CAPE-JEPA, a probabilistic cross-modal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture with three contributions: (i) a cross-attentional Gaussian predictor outputting per-patch parameters (mu, sigma^2) conditioned on opposite-modality context, trained via negative log-likelihood to model inherent cross-sensor prediction uncertainty; (ii) adversarial distributional regularization combining unimodal isotropic Gaussian regularization with a novel cross-modal adversarial variant that aligns modality distributions via worst-case Epps-Pulley characteristic function tests without explicit sample pairing; and (iii) in-training contrastive learning with attention-pooled heads for scene-level discriminative grounding. Evaluated on BigEarthNet-14K (BEN-14K) and fMoW across SAR, multispectral, and RGB modalities, CAPE-JEPA surpasses X-JEPA by up to 13.74 points on BEN-14K and 15.59 points on fMoW, outperforming all baselines including SkySense and CROMA across both unimodal and cross-modal directions while using fewer parameters (407.30M vs. 432.72M).

AI.tldr: CAPE-JEPA：用概率化跨模态高斯预测器 + 对抗式分布正则，替代X-JEPA的确定性潜在预测，实现SAR/多光谱/RGB统一表征，检索性能显著超越X-JEPA及SkySense、CROMA等基线。
AI.motivation: SAR与多光谱等异构传感器间物理鸿沟巨大，需同时具备模态不变性与语义判别性的表征；现有JEPA式方法（如X-JEPA）把跨模态对齐当作确定性潜在预测，隐含假设各patch可预测性一致，且未解决跨模态分布对齐问题。
AI.method: (1) 交叉注意力高斯预测器：以对侧模态为条件输出每patch的(μ,σ²)，用负对数似然训练以建模跨传感器预测不确定性；(2) 对抗分布正则：单模态各向同性高斯正则 + 新的跨模态对抗变体，用最坏情况Epps-Pulley特征函数检验对齐模态分布，无需显式样本配对；(3) 训练中对比学习 + 注意力池化头，提供场景级判别性监督。
AI.result: 在BEN-14K与fMoW上，覆盖SAR、多光谱、RGB模态：较X-JEPA在BEN-14K最高提升13.74点、fMoW提升15.59点；单模态与跨模态双向检索均超过含SkySense、CROMA在内的全部基线，且参数量更少（407.30M vs 432.72M）。
AI.conclusion: 将跨模态对齐由确定性预测转为概率化不确定性建模并显式对齐分布，是提升遥感跨模态检索的有效路径，且可在更小模型下取得更优性能。

title: Interactive World Simulation with Cosmos for Physical AI
summary: We present a shared framework that adapts Cosmos world foundation models for real-time interactive world simulation in Physical AI. By streaming visual observations in response to actions and scene controls, the framework enables users and embodied agents to interact with evolving virtual environments. It supports both predicting the visual consequences of actions and generating observations from physical state maintained by an external simulator. We demonstrate this approach across camera navigation and robot manipulation, controllable video transfer, and multi-view autonomous vehicle (AV) simulation. These examples provide a shared foundation for developing interactive virtual environments for Physical AI training and evaluation. Our code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos and https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3-examples. The project website is available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos-simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出一个共享框架，将Cosmos世界基础模型改造为Physical AI的实时交互式世界仿真器，支持动作/场景控制下的流式视觉预测。
AI.motivation: Physical AI训练与评测需要可交互、可控的虚拟环境；现有世界模型难以实时响应动作与场景控制，也缺乏统一框架兼顾"动作预测视觉"与"外部仿真器状态驱动生成"两类需求。
AI.method: 以Cosmos世界基础模型为基础构建流式框架：根据动作与场景控制实时流式输出视觉观测；支持两种模式——(1)预测动作的视觉后果，(2)由外部仿真器维护的物理状态生成观测。
AI.result: 在相机导航、机器人操作、可控视频迁移和多视角自动驾驶仿真等任务上进行了演示；开源代码与模型权重（GitHub/HuggingFace）及项目主页。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为构建面向Physical AI训练与评测的交互式虚拟环境提供了共享基础，连接了生成式世界模型与传统物理仿真。

title: Nowcasting Future Performance for Population Pruning in Survival-of-the-Fittest Training
comment: Accepted at: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality
summary: Training high-performing neural networks often involves evaluating populations of candidate models with varying hyperparameters, architectures, or random seeds. Training every candidate to completion is computationally expensive, yet stopping seemingly weaker runs early risks discarding models that would ultimately perform better, as learning curves can cross. To address this challenge, we investigate whether intermediate training checkpoints can predict future model accuracy and enable more informed pruning decisions. Our nowcasters predict test accuracy five epochs ahead or at the end of training. They are trained with accuracy and loss histories, weight statistics, and SANE representations as inputs. SANE is a transformer autoencoder that encodes a checkpoint as a sequence of latent tokens. We then use the nowcasters in Survival-of-the-Fittest (SOTF) training. SOTF repeatedly ranks runs during training by predicted accuracy and stops the lowest-ranked ones. Our results show that weight statistics work best for five-epoch forecasts, and SANE representations work best for final accuracy prediction. For evaluation, we compare SOTF with pruning the population by current accuracy. In homogeneous model zoos such as the CNN zoos, pruning by current accuracy already retains a final model only slightly worse than the best. Model zoos with a larger spread in performance, such as the ResNet-18 and ViT zoos, are more difficult to prune by current accuracy alone. In these zoos, SOTF with nowcasted final accuracy almost closes the gap to the best model.

AI.tldr: 研究用中间checkpoint预测未来精度（nowcaster），并在SOTF训练中提前剪枝弱模型；权重统计适合5轮预测，SANE表示适合最终精度预测，在异构模型动物园中接近最优模型。
AI.motivation: 训练大量候选模型（不同超参、架构、随机种子）成本高昂，但提前停止可能误删学习曲线会交叉、最终更优的模型，需要可靠地预测未来精度以指导剪枝。
AI.method: 训练nowcaster预测5轮后或训练结束时的测试精度，输入包括精度/损失历史、权重统计和SANE表示（将checkpoint编码为潜变量token序列的transformer自编码器）；再将nowcaster用于Survival-of-Fittest（SOTF）训练，按预测精度反复排序并淘汰排名最低的运行。
AI.result: 5轮预测中权重统计效果最好，最终精度预测中SANE表示效果最好；与按当前精度剪枝相比，同质CNN动物园中当前精度剪枝已接近最优，而性能差异较大的ResNet-18和ViT动物园中SOTF用预测最终精度几乎消除了与最佳模型的差距。
AI.conclusion: 中间checkpoint可有效预测未来精度并支持早期剪枝，nowcaster+SOTF在异构模型集合中优于按当前精度剪枝。

title: CrossPressor: Scalable Cross-View Fusion for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS) becomes increasingly difficult to scale to long multi-view sequences. Anchor-based compression methods such as ZPressor alleviate representation growth by decoding Gaussians only from a compact set of anchor feature maps, but keeping these anchors fixed forces each one to aggregate an increasing number of support views. We identify this representation--fusion mismatch and introduce \textbf{CrossPressor}, a training-free method for scalable anchor-based fusion. CrossPressor preserves all decoder-facing anchor queries while constraining the view-growing support sequence through coverage-cycled evidence routing, distributing retained spatial evidence across support views and fusion layers while keeping all support views represented. Routing before K/V projection, together with joint context packing, further reduces support-side fusion cost without retraining. CrossPressor maintains reconstruction quality close to dense fusion while achieving up to $26.12\times$ faster cross-view fusion and $1.43\times$ end-to-end acceleration on long input sequences. Our project page is at: https://yuhsihu.github.io/CrossPressor.

AI.tldr: CrossPressor 是一种免训练方法，通过覆盖友好循环的证据路由，将不断增长的支撑视图证据分散到各视图和融合层，缓解锚点固定带来的表示-融合失配，从而高效扩展到长多视图序列。
AI.motivation: 前馈 3D-GS 在长多视图序列上规模扩展困难。ZPressor 等锚点压缩方法虽控制了表示增长，但锚点数量固定，导致每个锚点需聚合越来越多支撑视图，形成“表示-融合失配”，融合成本急剧上升。
AI.method: 保留所有面向解码器的锚点查询，对不断增长的支撑序列采用覆盖友好循环（coverage-cycled）的证据路由，将保留的空间证据分散到多个支撑视图与融合层，并保证所有支撑视图均被表示；在 K/V 投影前进行路由，并结合联合上下文打包，降低支撑侧融合开销，且无需重新训练。
AI.result: 重建质量接近稠密融合；跨视图融合最高提速 26.12×，长输入序列端到端加速达 1.43×。
AI.conclusion: CrossPressor 以即插即用、免训练的方式解决锚点固定导致的表示-融合失配，在保持质量的同时显著提升长序列下的融合效率。

title: Turns Matter: Advancing Streaming Video RL via Turn-Level Credit
summary: Streaming video understanding requires models to repeatedly decide whether to respond or continue observing. Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been applied to this setting, with existing approaches emphasizing reward design while retaining a single trajectory-level advantage across turns. Such shared credit can reinforce redundant replies after earlier successes and discourage useful follow-ups after earlier failures. We propose TurnWise, a turn-level GRPO framework that aligns learning with individual streaming decisions. TurnWise addresses the mismatch between trajectory-level feedback and turn-level interaction, promoting informative responses and reducing redundancy. Specifically, turn-level credit assignment uses silence-completed prefix scoring to construct group-relative advantages from each decision's remaining return, separating its learning signal from earlier rewards. Turn-mean policy optimization averages token losses within each turn and then across turns, giving response and waiting decisions equal weight regardless of output length. These complementary designs improve streaming policy learning without a learned critic or additional rollouts. Extensive experiments show our method outperforms prior RL approaches for streaming video understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出TurnWise，一种turn级GRPO框架，用silence-completed前缀评分构造turn级相对优势，并对每个turn内token损失取均值再加权，使流式视频理解中的"回应/继续观察"决策获得细粒度、等权的学习信号，无需critic或额外rollout，性能优于现有RL方法。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解需模型在多轮中反复决定"回应还是继续观察"。现有GRPO方法沿用整条轨迹的单一优势值，对每轮共享信用，会导致早期成功后强化冗余回复、早期失败后抑制有用后续回应，与turn级交互不匹配。
AI.method: TurnWise包含两项互补设计：(1) turn级信用分配——用silence-completed prefix scoring，基于每个决策点剩余回报构造group-relative优势，将当前决策学习信号与历史奖励解耦；(2) turn-mean策略优化——先在每个turn内对token损失取平均，再跨turn平均，使回应与等待决策无论输出长度均等权。无需学习critic或额外rollout。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TurnWise在流式视频理解任务上优于已有的强化学习方法。
AI.conclusion: turn级信用分配与等权损失设计能有效改善流式策略学习，鼓励有信息量的回应并减少冗余，为流式多轮决策的RL训练提供轻量高效的方案。

title: From Certified Pairs to a Certified Hub: Reasoner-Checked Crosswalks for the Information Exchange Standard
summary: A national digital twin was conceived as an ecosystem of twins connected through mappings to a common foundation, but the roadmap that promises to confirm those mappings are valid never says what valid means. We give the test a precise form, coherence and conservativity of the merged ontology, borrowed from logic-based alignment repair, and apply it to the Information Exchange Standard (IES), first pair by pair and then to whole hubs. Crosswalks from IES into thirteen ontologies across seven sector groups, anchored on the building ontologies BOT, Brick, and SAREF4BLDG, pass through separate stages of matching, human review, certification of each SKOS correspondence against the two class hierarchies, and reasoning with HermiT. Pair by pair, the stages catch different failures: certification alone removed all 526 conservativity violations of the raw crosswalks, review alone left 73, and together they made eleven of twelve overlapping pairs coherent and conservative. Pairwise certification does not compose. Merging the three certified building crosswalks into one hub made five Brick classes unsatisfiable, through a homonym between the IES and Brick notions of a floor that only BOT's disjointness axioms expose; rejecting that one row gave a coherent and conservative hub that entails 290 cross-ontology links nobody wrote down. The core hub is inconsistent before any crosswalk is added, because two published standards, the Open Energy Ontology and BFO 2020, contradict each other; with either one left out it is coherent and conservative. A hub, not a pair, is the unit an ecosystem of twins has to certify.

AI.tldr: 该论文为"国家数字孪生"生态中的孪生映射验证提出精确判据——合并本体的一致性与保守性，并以IES对13个本体的跨域映射实证检验，发现"逐对认证不可组合"，须以枢纽（hub）为认证单元。
AI.motivation: 数字孪生生态依赖映射连接到共同基础，但现有路线图只承诺"确认映射有效"却未定义"有效"，缺少可操作、形式化的验证标准。
AI.method: 借鉴基于逻辑的对齐修复，将"有效"定义为合并本体的一致性与保守性；对IES到13个本体（7个部门组、以BOT/Brick/SAREF4BLDG为锚）的映射，依次进行匹配、人工评审、将每条SKOS对应关系对照两个类层次结构认证，并用HermiT推理；先逐对检验，再检验整个枢纽。
AI.result: 逐对时各阶段捕获不同故障：仅认证消除了原始映射全部526处保守性违规，仅评审剩余73处，二者合使12对中11对既一致又保守。将三条已认证的建筑映射合并为一个枢纽后，因IES与Brick对"floor"的同名异义（仅BOT的不相交公理暴露），导致5个Brick类不可满足；删除该行后枢纽一致且保守，并蕴含290条无人写下的跨本体链接。核心枢纽在加入任何映射前即不一致，因Open Energy Ontology与BFO 2020相互矛盾；舍其一则恢复一致与保守。
AI.conclusion: 逐对认证无法组合成枢纽级有效性；孪生生态应认证的单位是枢纽而非映射对，需引入形式化的合并一致性与保守性检验作为"有效"的操作定义。

title: An Interaction-Aware Decision Framework for FDIC-Assisted Distressed Bank Acquisitions: Empirical Evidence from the FDIC Failed-Bank Panel and the SVB-First Citizens Case
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures, 15 tables. Research code, datasets, and reproducibility materials are available at https://github.com/malihealiasgari20/FDIC-SNFF-Decision-Framework
summary: Acquirers of failed banks weigh acquisition value, regulatory protection, risk, buyer strength, and execution difficulty jointly, because each signal's meaning depends on the others: high non-performing loans matter less when government loss sharing absorbs the losses. The proposed Spider Network Filtering Framework encodes such dependencies as four interpretable interaction rules among five dimensions, yielding graph-inspired features for a logistic model and a Pursue/Caution/Avoid decision rule. We evaluate it on 55 acquisitions assisted by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation in 2008-2024 by acquirers with a parent listed in the United States. Six financial inputs come from regulatory reports published before each failure; two deal terms, which the winning bidder knows when it bids but investors learn at the announcement, come from the regulator's press releases. The outcome, a positive three-day abnormal return around the announcement, records the market's initial reception, not realized success. Under grouped, nested cross-validation, the Spider-enhanced model reaches a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.594, against 0.615 for logistic regression on the same inputs and 0.632 for ridge regression; permutation tests that repeat the full model selection give at most weak evidence that any of them ranks better than chance. The Spider score used directly does not rank better than chance, and an apparent link between target distress and higher returns disappears against a bank-sector benchmark. Thresholds tuned for the F1 score approve most acquisitions with negative returns and realize negative utility when each costs three times what a positively received acquisition gains.

AI.tldr: 提出Spider Network Filtering Framework，用四条交互规则刻画收购决策五维度依赖，对2008–2024年FDIC协助的55宗银行收购预测市场反应。增强模型AUC均值0.594，低于逻辑回归(0.615)与岭回归(0.632)，置换检验仅提供微弱优于随机的证据。
AI.motivation: 失败银行收购方需同时权衡收购价值、监管保护、风险、买家实力与执行难度，而单一信号含义依赖其他信号（如高不良贷款在政府损失分担下影响减弱）。作者希望显式编码这种维度间依赖关系，形成可解释的决策支持工具。
AI.method: 构建Spider Network Filtering Framework，将五维度间依赖编码为四条可解释交互规则，导出图启发式特征输入逻辑模型，并给出Pursue/Caution/Avoid决策规则。样本为2008–2024年55宗由在美上市母公司参与的FDIC协助收购；六个财务输入取自失败前监管报告，两项交易条款取自监管新闻稿；结果为公告前后三日正的异常收益。采用分组嵌套交叉验证、置换检验、F1阈值调优与效用分析。
AI.result: Spider增强模型平均AUC为0.594，低于同一输入的逻辑回归(0.615)和岭回归(0.632)；置换检验重复完整模型选择后，至多只能提供任何模型优于随机的微弱证据。直接使用Spider得分并不优于随机；目标困境与更高回报之间的表面关联在对照银行板块基准后消失。按F1调优的阈值会批准多数负回报收购，并在单次成本为正向收益三倍时实现负效用。
AI.conclusion: 在所给样本上，显式交互建模未带来预测增益，加权的"可解释"结构也未能转化为可排序信号；研究表明失败银行收购的公告反应难以用这些信号预测，基于F1的阈值在实践中亦不可靠。

title: NextGAN: Towards Simple and Scalable GAN Training for Image and Video Generation
summary: Adversarial training enables one- and few-step image and video generation, but conventional adversarial losses supervise critic values without directly specifying the gradients used to update the generator. We present NEXTGAN, which trains a scalar critic by regressing its input gradient onto displacements between independently paired reference and generated features at interpolated locations in frozen representation spaces. For a fixed generator, this regression is equivalent to an adversarial objective with a gradient-energy penalty, while the generator retains the standard potential-based GAN update. The same objective adapts pre-trained image and video generators with up to 14B parameters, without auxiliary losses, online teacher scores, or trajectories. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$, NEXTGAN achieves one-step FIDs of 2.87 with pixel-space JiT-B and 1.54 with latent-space DiT-XL/1; its adversarial form further reaches 1.36. For text-to-video generation, a single trained Wan2.1-1.3B model supports one-, two-, and four-step sampling, achieving the highest VBench total scores among the compared 1.3B methods at one and two steps. At two steps, NEXTGAN scores 83.13, exceeding rCM and AnyFlow by 1.25 and 0.47 points, respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/LINs-lab/NextGAN.git.

AI.tldr: NEXTGAN通过将专家critic的输入梯度回归到冻结表征空间中参考特征与生成特征间的位移，实现一步/少步图像与视频生成，在ImageNet 256×256上一���FID达1.54（DiT-XL/1），并在文生视频两歩采样上取得83.13的VBench总分。
AI.motivation: 传统对抗损失只监督critic的数值输出，并未直接指定生成器更新所用的梯度，导致训练信号不够明确。作者希望设计一种直接对梯度进行监督的目标，使预训练大模型无需辅助损失、在线教师分数或轨迹即可高效适配为少步生成器。
AI.method: 提出NEXTGAN：训练一个标量critic，使其在冻结表征空间内的插值位置上、将输入梯度回归到独立配对的参考特征与生成特征之间的位移。对固定生成器而言，该回归等价于带有梯度能量惩罚的对抗目标，而生成器仍采用标准的基于势函数的GAN更新。整个目标不含辅助损失、在线教师评分或轨迹，可直接微调规模达14B的预训练图像与视频生成器。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256上，NEXTGAN取得一步FID：像素空间JiT-B为2.87，潜空间DiT-XL/1为1.54，其对抗形式进一步达到1.36。在文生视频任务中，单个训练好的Wan2.1-1.3B模型同时支持一步、两步与四步采样，并在一步与两步设置下取得所比较1.3B方法中最高的VBench总分；两步时得分83.13，分别比rCM和AnyFlow高1.25和0.47分。
AI.conclusion: NEXTGAN表明，通过对critic梯度进行位移回归的直接监督，可以在不依赖辅助损失、教师模型或轨迹的条件下，高效地将大规模预训练扩散/流模型转化为高质量的一步或少步生成器，并在图像与视频生成任务上取得优于现有方法的性能。

title: Template Gap Reconstruction for Shell Output Simulation with Small Language Models
summary: Small language models offer a compact basis for shell simulation without executing submitted commands, but full-output decoding requires them to predict recurring utility structure alongside content that varies across executions. We introduce template gap reconstruction (TGR), which supplies reusable output literals interspersed with sentinels to be interleaved with autoregressively generated gaps. A template selector chooses which template to be reconstructed, with the empty template retaining full-output decoding. We construct a template bank from 18.7 million outputs collected across heterogeneous execution environments and train a template selector and five reconstruction models initialized from various small language model checkpoints on a target environment excluded from bank construction. Evaluation demonstrates that TGR improves output edit similarity (O-ES) over full-output decoding (FOD) when the optimal template covers more than 25\% of the template, while performing similarly for lower-coverage outputs. Additionally, TGR outperforms FOD for shorter gap sequences, with O-ES values of 0.964 and 0.812, respectively, while maintaining similar performance for longer sequences. TGR reduces the number of tokens generated by 26.3--38.3\% across used tokenizer families. These results support using a reusable output structure as a practical design choice for small shell simulators, improving response fidelity and shortening generation targets while keeping template selection and residual prediction central to response quality.

AI.tldr: TGR 用模板+缝隙重建替代全输出解码，提升 shell 模拟器的编辑相似度并减少生成 token 26–38%。
AI.motivation: 小模型做 shell 模拟（不执行命令）时，全输出解码需同时预测重复出现的实用程序结构与每次执行变化的内容，负担较重。
AI.method: 提出模板缝隙重建（TGR）：提供可复用输出字面量并以哨兵标记，间隙由自回归生成填充；模板选择器择模板（空模板退化为 FOD）。从 1870 万跨异构环境输出构建模板库，在库外目标环境上训练模板选择器和 5 个由不同小模型初始化的重建模型。
AI.result: 最优模板覆盖>25% 时 O-ES 优于 FOD，低覆盖时相当；短间隙序列上 O-ES 0.964 vs 0.812；token 生成量减少 26.3–38.3%。
AI.conclusion: 可复用输出结构是小 shell 模拟器的实用设计选择，兼顾保真度与更短生成目标；模板选择与残差预测仍是质量核心。

title: Where Search Agents Go Off the Rails: Graph-Grounded Step-Level Verification
summary: Search-augmented reasoning systems can reach correct answers while making errors in intermediate steps. Reliable auditing must check whether evidence $D$ covers the question $Q$, reasoning $T$ addresses $Q$, and $T$ is grounded in $D$. We introduce GraphRail, which represents requirements, evidence, and reasoning as structured claims and compares them without a generative judge or gold answer. Across three multi-hop QA benchmarks and three reasoning frameworks, GraphRail improves error recall over generative verifiers while remaining stable under stochastic extraction. Its diagnoses can also guide online reasoning, providing a traceable way to detect and correct intermediate errors.

AI.tldr: 提出 GraphRail，将需求、证据与推理表示为结构化 claim 图进行比对，无需生成式评判器或标准答案即可审计检索增强推理过程中的中间步骤可靠性。
AI.motivation: 检索增强推理系统即使最终答对，中间步骤也可能出错；可靠审计需检查证据 D 是否覆盖问题 Q、推理 T 是否回应 Q、T 是否基于 D，而现有生成式验证器存在不稳定与依赖 gold answer 的问题。
AI.method: GraphRail 把问题需求、检索证据和推理轨迹分别结构化为一组 claim，并构建图结构进行比对，以覆盖度与接地关系判定中间步骤错误；不依赖生成式 judge 与标准答案，并设计了在随机抽取下的稳定性机制。
AI.result: 在三个多跳 QA 基准与三种推理框架上，GraphRail 的错误召回率优于生成式验证器，且在随机抽取条件下表现稳定；其诊断结果还能指导在线推理。
AI.conclusion: 结构化 claim 比对提供了可追溯的中间错误检测与纠正途径，是审计检索增强推理的一种有效且稳健的替代方案。

title: IDSISA: Influence-Distilled Sharded Training for Efficient Machine Unlearning
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Machine unlearning removes the influence of specific training examples to comply with privacy regulations. Full retraining gives strong guarantees but is computationally prohibitive at scale; approximate methods are efficient but lack formal guarantees. SISA (Sharded, Isolated, Sliced, and Aggregated training) achieves certified deletion through data sharding and independent retraining, but random partitioning scatters forget requests across most shards, and isolated retraining degrades utility. We introduce IDSISA (Influence-Distilled SISA), which uses influence functions to concentrate forget-prone samples into few shards and distillation from unaffected shards to recover utility lost to isolation. The deletion guarantee inherited from SISA's retraining step remains exact and requires no probabilistic qualification; the distillation-based utility recovery is a separately quantified, empirically bounded approximation ($ε_{\text{cert}} \leq 0.015$ in expectation). We further formalize certification under sequences of repeated deletion requests, where cross-shard distillation can create dependencies between shards; we prove that a closure-based cascading retraining procedure restores the deletion guarantee to the full aggregated model under any deletion sequence.
