Experiments on ResNet-18/CIFAR-10, ResNet-18/CIFAR-100, BiLSTM/IMDB, TCN/IMDB, and a fully connected network on Fashion-MNIST show $14-91\%$ better selective forgetting, up to $50\%$ better utility retention in relative terms (with consistent percentage-point gains on the other architectures, where a relative baseline is undefined), and unlearning-time changes ranging from $-6.7\%$ to $+6.4\%$ depending on architecture, relative to SISA.

AI.tldr: IDSISA 用影响函数把易遗忘样本集中到少数分片，并用未受影响分片的蒸馏恢复效用，从而在保持 SISA 精确删除保证的同时提升选择性遗忘效果与效用保留。
AI.motivation: 机器遗忘需合规删除特定训练样本影响。全量重训保证强但代价高，近似方法高效却无形式化保证。SISA 通过分片独立重训实现认证删除，但随机划分使遗忘请求分散到多数分片，且隔离重训导致效用下降。
AI.method: 提出 IDSISA：利用影响函数将易遗忘样本集中到少数分片；从未受影响分片蒸馏以恢复隔离造成的效用损失；删除保证严格继承 SISA 重训步骤，无概率性限定；蒸馏效用恢复作为单独量化的经验有界近似（期望 ε_cert ≤ 0.015）；并形式化重复删除请求序列下的认证问题，证明基于闭包的级联重训能在任意删除序列下把删除保证恢复到完整聚合模型。
AI.result: 在 ResNet-18/CIFAR-10、ResNet-18/CIFAR-100、BiLSTM/IMDB、TCN/IMDB 及 Fashion-MNIST 上的全连接网络上，相比 SISA 选择性遗忘提升 14–91%，效用保留相对提升最高 50%（其他架构上为稳定百分点增益），遗忘时间变化为 −6.7% 至 +6.4%。
AI.conclusion: IDSISA 在保持精确删除保证的前提下显著改善遗忘选择性与效用保留，并给出重复删除序列下可认证的级联重训方案，但蒸馏带来的效用恢复仅为经验有界近似。

title: Quo Vadis, Driving Scene Reconstruction? Occlusion-Aware Gaussian Densification
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Computer Vision for Developing Countries (CV4DC), ACCV 2026 (Proceedings Track)
summary: While recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting methods enable efficient driving-scene reconstruction from surround-view images, their reliance on a single observation fundamentally hinders novel-view synthesis. Regions occluded in the input can become visible from novel viewpoints, leaving the reconstructed Gaussians under-constrained and incomplete. Moving beyond image-space inpainting for rendered views, we introduce OccSplat, a feed-forward framework whose core contribution is Occlusion-Aware Gaussian Densification, explicitly targeting missing scene geometry rather than missing pixels. By predicting new Gaussian primitives for unsupported regions, OccSplat completes the scene directly in the 3D representation. Specifically, OccSplat first identifies occluded regions that lack Gaussian support through Gaussian Occlusion Mapping. Gaussian Occlusion Completion then generates new primitives for these regions. The predicted primitives are integrated into the original representation to improve novel-view synthesis while retaining feed-forward inference without per-scene optimization. Experiments on the nuScenes benchmark demonstrate that OccSplat improves on the compared methods and yields particularly large gains in occluded regions, leading to more accurate and visually coherent driving-scene reconstruction.

AI.tldr: OccSplat提出前馈框架，通过遮挡感知高斯致密化（Occlusion-Aware Gaussian Densification）在3D表示中直接补全被遮挡区域的新高斯原语，从而提升驾驶场景新视角合成质量，无需逐场景优化。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈3D高斯泼溅方法仅依赖单次观测做环视重建，输入中被遮挡的区域在新视角下可能暴露，导致对应高斯欠约束、几何不完整。仅靠渲染图像空间修补无法解决几何缺失问题。
AI.method: OccSplat由两部分组成：1）Gaussian Occlusion Mapping，识别缺乏高斯支撑的遮挡区域；2）Gaussian Occlusion Completion，为这些区域生成新的高斯原语，并融合进原始表示，保持前馈推理、无需逐场景优化。
AI.result: 在nuScenes基准上优于对比方法，在被遮挡区域增益尤为显著，重建更准确、视觉更连贯。
AI.conclusion: 核心思想是从"补像素"转向"补几何"：将补全放在3D高斯表示层面，为遮挡区域显式生成原语，是提升前馈驾驶场景新视角合成的有效途径。

title: LongBanana: An Expert-Verified Benchmark for Long-Context Multi-Reference Image Synthesis
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Project page: https://long-banana.com/
summary: We introduce LongBanana, to our knowledge the first expert-designed and expert-verified benchmark for long-context multi-reference image synthesis in the age of agent-driven image generation. The task requires retrieving dispersed visual evidence, rejecting distractors, binding entities and relations, and composing one coherent final image from multiple references. LongBanana contains 90 carefully designed tasks organized by a 3-by-3 taxonomy; each task includes about 32 reference images, 20 constraints, and 50 evaluation items, yielding 4,670 expert-specified atomic evaluation items in total. Its graph-grounded evaluation design instantiates each task with reference images and an entity-relation graph, then converts node, edge, and whole-graph obligations into checklist items for Content Fidelity, Relational Binding, and Global Constraint Satisfaction. Reviewed expert labels include a 15% double-labeled subset with 89.4% exact agreement and 0.83 quadratic weighted kappa. We further introduce LongBanana-Gen, an agent-harness framework for long-horizon image generation; experiments show that minimal agent harnesses improve over direct generation, while a ReAct-Plan-Exec-Reflect (RPR) workflow yields harness-dependent gains by strengthening evidence grounding and repair. Together, LongBanana provides an auditable testbed for measuring dense visual evidence use and a shared target for developing stronger agent-driven image-generation systems. Code and data are available at the project page: https://long-banana.com/.

AI.tldr: LongBanana是首个由专家设计并验证的长上下文多参考图像合成基准，含90个任务、约32张参考图/任务、共4670条原子评估项；同时提出LongBanana-Gen智能体框架，实验显示agent harness优于直接生成，RPR工作流可通过强化证据 grounding 与修复带来依赖 harness 的增益。
AI.motivation: 在agent驱动图像生成时代，长上下文多参考图像合成需要检索分散的视觉证据、排除干扰项、绑定实体与关系并组合成连贯图像，但缺少可审计的评测基准与共享目标。
AI.method: 构建90个任务、按3×3分类学组织，每任务约32张参考图、20条约束、50个评估项；采用图接地评估设计：为任务实例化参考图与实体-关系图，将节点、边、全图义务转为检查项，覆盖Content Fidelity、Relational Binding、Global Constraint Satisfaction；15%双标注子集达89.4%精确一致与0.83二次加权kappa。另提出LongBanana-Gen的agent-harness框架，含ReAct-Plan-Exec-Reflect(RPR)工作流。
AI.result: 专家标签一致性良好（89.4%精确一致，QWK 0.83）；实验表明最小agent harness优于直接生成，RPR工作流通过增强证据grounding与修复带来依赖harness的增益。
AI.conclusion: LongBanana为衡量密集视觉证据使用提供可审计测试平台，并为发展更强的agent驱动图像生成系统提供共同目标；代码与数据已公开。

title: LifeVal: Evaluating AI Model Performance on Personalized Agentic Consumer Tasks
summary: We introduce LifeVal, a benchmark evaluating AI model performance on personalized agentic consumer tasks. LifeVal covers the most valuable life tasks that a personalized digital superassistant could automate, representing over 1.7 trillion US dollars in annual willingness-to-pay across 148 consumer task categories (e.g., managing finances, moving apartments, searching for a job, finding childcare). To construct our activity distribution, we conducted a new survey of willingness-to-pay for a digital superassistant across a demographically representative sample of over 3,800 consumers, cross-referencing our results against the American Time Use Survey (Bureau of Labor Statistics, 2025) and the Multinational Time Use Study (Fisher et al., 2025). For the most valuable consumer activities, we recruited task creators to create AI evaluation tasks personalized using real ChatGPT conversations and memories, reference files, and personal context. Task creators had to pass our expertise threshold (including personally completing the task multiple times and seeing the results through in their real lives for over a year) and also write a rubric, ensuring that our evaluation measured the best personalized completion for that task. All tasks had to pass at least three rounds of human quality-control before acceptance into our final evaluation sets.

AI.tldr: LifeVal 是评估 AI 模型在个性化消费级智能体任务上表现的基准，覆盖年支付意愿超 1.7 万亿美元、共 148 类消费者任务，任务基于真实 ChatGPT 对话与个人记忆构建并通过严格人工质控。
AI.motivation: 个性化数字超级助理可自动化的高价值生活任务缺乏评估标准，需要一个与经济价值挂钩、贴近真实个人情境的基准来衡量 AI 表现。
AI.method: 对 3800 余名代表性消费者开展支付意愿调查，并与美国时间使用调查及多国时间使用研究交叉验证，构建活动分布；针对最高价值活动招募任务创建者，用真实 ChatGPT 对话、记忆、参考文件与个人背景个性化定制任务，创建者需通过专业门槛（亲身多次完成并持续一年以上）并撰写评分细则；所有任务须通过至少三轮人工质控方可入选。
AI.result: 构建了覆盖 148 类消费任务、对应超 1.7 万亿美元年支付意愿的 LifeVal 基准，任务具真实个性化背景并经多轮人工质控。
AI.conclusion: LifeVal 提供了一个高价值、真实可用的个性化智能体任务评测平台，为衡量和推进数字超级助理能力奠定基础。

title: EvoOPD: Evolving Privileged Information Strategies for Black-Box On-Policy Distillation
summary: Proprietary language models exhibit strong reasoning and coding capabilities, but their output distributions are inaccessible, making fine-grained distillation methods that rely on teacher logits difficult to apply directly to black-box models. We observe that rich textual feedback from a black-box teacher can be treated as privileged information (PI) and converted, through a PI-conditioned privileged teacher, into dense supervision signals on the student's own trajectories. However, what PI should be acquired from the teacher to most effectively support student learning remains unclear. PI strategies that differ in where they focus, what information they request, and how much detail they provide can have substantially different effects on the current student, and their relative effectiveness can further change as training progresses. Based on this observation, we propose Evolving Privileged Information Strategies for Black-Box On-Policy Distillation (EvoOPD), which treats PI acquisition itself as an optimization problem and maintains a PI Strategy Bank that evolves with the student state. EvoOPD uses the measured repair utility of PI on the current student to adapt the focus, information type, and granularity of teacher feedback, allowing the acquired information to continually match the student's learning needs. We systematically evaluate EvoOPD on mathematical reasoning and code generation with Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B students. EvoOPD achieves the best overall performance in all six model-task settings, improving over the strongest baseline in each setting by an average of 2.14 percentage points in mathematics and 1.30 points in code. Further analysis shows that the relative effectiveness of PI acquisition strategies changes with student state, making a fixed strategy difficult to sustain as the best choice throughout distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出EvoOPD，将黑盒教师模型的「特权信息(PI)获取」本身视为优化问题，用PI策略库随学生状态演化，自适应调整教师反馈的焦点、信息类型与粒度，实现黑盒模型的在线策略蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 专有模型只有输出文本、logits不可得，依赖教师logit的细粒度蒸馏难以直接使用。虽然可把教师文本反馈当作特权信息(PI)，再经PI条件化的特权教师转成学生轨迹上的稠密监督，但「应向教师获取什么PI」缺乏研究：不同焦点、内容、粒度的PI策略效果差异大，且最优策略会随训练进程变化，固定策略难以持续最优。
AI.method: EvoOPD把PI获取当作优化问题，维护一个PI策略库(Strategy Bank)，随学生状态演化；以PI对当前学生的实测「修复效用(repair utility)」为信号，自适应调整教师反馈的焦点(focus)、信息类型(information type)和粒度(granularity)，使获得的PI持续匹配学生当下学习需求；再经PI条件化的特权教师转成学生自身轨迹上的稠密监督用于在线策略蒸馏。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B学生的数学推理与代码生成共六个模型-任务设置上，EvoOPD全部取得最佳总体表现；相比各设置最强基线，数学平均提升2.14个百分点，代码平均提升1.30个百分点。
AI.conclusion: PI获取策略的相对有效性随学生状态变化，固定策略无法在整个蒸馏过程中保持最优；将PI获取作为随学生演化的优化问题，能更有效地利用黑盒教师反馈。

title: MonoLaDN: Language-Guided DeNoising for Monocular 3D Object Detection
summary: Monocular 3D object detection offers a low-cost route to 3D perception, but it remains fundamentally ill-posed, since depth must be inferred from a single view. Recent transformer-based detectors learn geometry purely from image features and 3D box annotations, lacking the high-level semantic priors that vision-language models (VLMs) acquire from large-scale pretraining. VLMs offer such priors, but deploying one directly as a detector is impractical due to its heavy inference cost. We propose MonoLaDN, a language-guided denoising framework that transfers the geometric reasoning of a VLM into a monocular 3D detector while keeping the deployed model purely vision-based. During training, a frozen VLM produces structured reasoning about each object's occlusion, depth, dimension, and angle from the image and its ground-truth boxes. We encode this reasoning into queries, perturb them with noise, and train the detector to reconstruct the clean reasoning. Reconstructing the corrupted reasoning forces the detector's depth-guided features to internalize the VLM's geometric priors, so this knowledge remains available even after the reasoning path is discarded at inference, adding no latency or parameters to the deployed model. Experiments on KITTI 3D and nuScenes show that MonoLaDN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art detectors and generalizes well to new domains.

AI.tldr: MonoLaDN 提出一种语言引导的去噪框架，在训练时借助冻结 VLM 的结构化几何推理来监督单目3D检测器，推理时模型仍为纯视觉，无额外开销。
AI.motivation: 单目3D检测本质上是病态问题（需从单视图推断深度）。现有 transformer 检测器仅从图像特征和3D框标注学习几何，缺乏 VLM 通过大规模预训练获得的高层语义先验；而直接部署 VLM 作为检测器推理代价过高。
AI.method: 训练阶段由冻结的 VLM 根据图像和真值框生成关于遮挡、深度、尺寸、角度的结构化推理；将该推理编码为 query，加噪扰动后训练检测器重建干净推理。通过重建被破坏的推理，迫使检测器的深度引导特征内化 VLM 的几何先验，推理时丢弃推理路径。
AI.result: 在 KITTI 3D 和 nuScenes 上，MonoLaDN 持续超越 SOTA 检测器，并具备良好的跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MonoLaDN 在不增加部署模型延迟与参数的前提下，将 VLM 的几何先验有效迁移到纯视觉单目3D检测器中，实现了性能与泛化性的提升。

title: ConceptARC at Scale: Studying Conceptual Understanding in Reasoning Models
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) perform well on challenging benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether they form generalizable abstractions across conceptually related reasoning tasks. The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) provides a controlled testbed for studying abstraction, requiring solvers to infer transformation rules over two-dimensional grids from a small set of examples. While ARC evaluates rule abstraction within individual tasks, different tasks may share higher-level structure despite requiring different transformations$\unicode{x2014}$for example, several tasks may involve reasoning about objects contained within other objects. Benchmarks such as ConceptARC capture this structure by grouping ARC-style tasks into recurring spatial and semantic concepts, but they often contain only a few manually constructed tasks per concept. We introduce ConceptARC at Scale, a generator for creating thousands of ARC-style tasks targeting a specific concept. Using this generator, we construct ConceptARC-100, a dataset of 1,600 new, manually reviewed tasks, with 100 tasks for each of the 16 concepts defined by ConceptARC$\unicode{x2014}$ten times the size of the original benchmark. We evaluate a range of recent LRMs and models trained from scratch on ConceptARC-100 to characterize which concepts they solve reliably and where they struggle. We further analyze the models' internal representations and find clear semantic structure: task representations cluster according to the operations applied to objects, such as recoloring, removal, or translation, even when realized through substantially different rules and scenarios. Together, our results suggest that models form stable abstractions of transformation operations that generalize across diverse tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出可扩展的ARC风格任务生成器ConceptARC at Scale，并构建了包含1600个任务的ConceptARC-100数据集（16个概念各100个），用于评估大型推理模型的概念级抽象能力。
AI.motivation: 现有ARC基准只考察单任务内的规则抽象，而ConceptARC虽按空间/语义概念分组任务，却每个概念仅有少量人工构建任务，规模不足以系统评估LRM是否形成可泛化的概念抽象。
AI.method: 设计ConceptARC at Scale生成器，针对特定概念自动生成数千个ARC风格任务；据此构建经人工审核的ConceptARC-100（16概念×100任务=1600个）；在此基准上评测多种近期LRM及从头训练的模型，并分析其内部表示结构。
AI.result: 识别出模型能可靠解决与易失败的具体概念；内部表示呈现清晰语义结构——任务表示按对象操作（如变色、移除、平移）聚类，即使底层规则和场景差异很大。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明模型能够形成关于变换操作的稳定抽象，并跨多样任务泛化；生成器方法也为大规模、可控的抽象推理评测提供了新途径。

title: From Fixed Defaults to Calibrated Activation Policies for Long-Term Time-Series Forecasting
comment: 36 pages, 2 figures. Shijie Xu and Boyan Tang contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/Tt200411/From-Fixed-Defaults-to-Calibrated-Activation-Policies-for-Long-Term-Time-Series-Forecasting
summary: Long-term time-series forecasting supports decisions in energy, transportation, and other applications where reliable predictions are needed beyond the observed data. Although forecasting research has advanced model architectures, fixed activation configurations provide limited guidance on how activation choices should vary across datasets and prediction horizons. This study aims to establish when task-specific activation choices improve forecasting accuracy and how previous experiments can guide the selection of suitable configurations for new tasks. We develop a calibrated selection policy that learns a reliable default from prior experiments, adapts the activation function and its location to each task, and retains the default when evidence for a change is insufficient. In an evaluation supported by 1,225 Informer training runs across 17 dataset variants and 51 forecasting tasks, the policy reduces mean squared error by 7.86% on average relative to the conventional fixed-activation baseline and improves 72.55% of tasks. These findings establish activation choice and placement as practical opportunities for improving existing forecasting models and show how accumulated experimental evidence can guide configuration decisions without repeating an exhaustive search for every task.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种校准式激活函数选择策略，依据历史实验结果学习可靠默认配置，并按任务自适应调整激活函数及其位置，在51个长时预测任务上平均降低MSE 7.86%。
AI.motivation: 长时时间序列预测中，现有研究多聚焦模型架构，而激活函数配置通常固定不变，缺乏关于激活选择应如何随数据集和预测步长变化的指导。
AI.method: 构建校准选择策略：从既往实验中学习可靠默认配置，对每个任务自适应调整激活函数类型及其插入位置，当改变证据不足时保留默认配置。
AI.result: 基于17个数据集变体、51个预测任务、1225次Informer训练的评估，策略相较固定激活基线平均降低MSE 7.86%，并在72.55%的任务上取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 激活函数的选择与位置是改进现有预测模型的实用切入点，且积累的实验证据可指导新任务配置决策，无需对每个任务重复穷举搜索。

title: Beyond Scene Shortcuts: Action-Centric Video-Text Alignment for Fine-Grained Action Understanding
summary: Fine-grained action understanding requires vision-language models to ground what an agent does, how it acts, and why it acts in spatio-temporal evidence. However, richer supervision can backfire: fine-tuned models may generate detailed action descriptions grounded in static scenes and salient objects rather than motion, a failure we call Environment-Grounded Action Hallucination (EGAH). To mitigate EGAH, we propose Staged Attention Rectification and Reinforcement (STARR), an action-centric video-text alignment framework that breaks scene-action shortcuts through Action-Environment Dissociation and reinforces action-focused grounding with an Attention Consistency Reward within Group Relative Policy Optimization. We further construct FineActionR&R, combining temporally localized captions with hierarchical and temporal-causal reasoning data. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, FineActionVLM-R1 improves average MotionBench accuracy by 3.01 percentage points over its base model and achieves 91.50% on HAU-MCQ-Bench. Qualitative comparisons further indicate more faithful fine-grained action descriptions with fewer environment-induced hallucinations.

AI.tldr: 针对视频细粒度动作理解中的"环境接地动作幻觉"(EGAH)问题，提出以动作为中心的STARR对齐框架（动作-环境解耦 + 注意力一致性奖励的GRPO强化），并构建FineActionR&R数据集；基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B的FineActionVLM-R1在MotionBench平均提升3.01个百分点，HAU-MCQ-Bench达91.50%。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在细粒度动作理解中需要将"做什么、怎么做、为什么做"扎根于时空证据。但更丰富的监督反而可能适得其反：微调后的模型往往依据静态场景与显著物体生成动作描述，而非依赖运动本身，导致"环境接地动作幻觉"(EGAH)。
AI.method: 提出STARR（分阶段注意力纠偏与强化）：1) 通过Action-Environment Dissociation打破场景-动作捷径；2) 在GRPO中引入Attention Consistency Reward强化以动作为焦点的接地。同时构建FineActionR&R数据，融合时间定位字幕与层级化、时序因果推理数据。
AI.result: 基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B构建的FineActionVLM-R1，在MotionBench上平均准确率较基座模型提升3.01个百分点，HAU-MCQ-Bench达到91.50%；定性对比显示细粒度动作描述更忠实，环境诱导幻觉更少。
AI.conclusion: 以动作为中心的对齐与强化可有效抑制环境接地动作幻觉，验证了数据解耦与注意力奖励机制在细粒度视频动作理解中的有效性。

title: Task-Efficient Agent Evaluation Using Cached Traces
summary: Efficient benchmarking estimates a system's full benchmark performance from a small number of task executions. Standard approaches rely solely on the binary correctness of executions from a collection of already-evaluated reference systems. An agentic system, however, produces a rich trace for each execution that can reveal substantially more about its capabilities. Leveraging this information requires useful trace representations. We propose representing a trace by extracting a structured summary of it with an LLM and embedding the summary with a standard text encoder. These representations preserve correctness- and task-related signal while minimizing the presence of system identity-, model family- and harness-related signals that dominate raw trace embeddings. Given this representation for each task execution from all reference systems, we construct low-dimensional representations of the systems and predict a new system's score from its position among the reference systems. On SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0, augmenting an item-response model with this geometry-based prediction reduces mean absolute error from 0.13 to 0.08 (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-4}$) and from 0.14 to 0.12 (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-3}$), respectively, when provided a single random executed task. Further, given access to the full set of reference systems, our approach dominates baselines for any given number of executed tasks on both benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 用LLM提取执行轨迹的结构化摘要并编码，构建参考系统的低维几何表示，从而由少量任务执行高效预测agentic系统整体基准分数。
AI.motivation: 传统高效基准测试仅利用执行结果的二元正确性，浪费了agentic系统执行轨迹中蕴含的丰富能力信息；而直接嵌入原始轨迹又被系统身份、模型家族和评测框架等无关信号主导。
AI.method: 用LLM从每条执行轨迹中抽取结构化摘要，再用标准文本编码器嵌入；该表示保留正确性与任务相关信号、抑制系统身份类信号。基于所有参考系统的这些表示构建系统低维几何表示，根据新系统在参考系统中的位置预测其分数，并与项目反应模型（IRM）结合。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified上，仅给定单个随机执行任务时，MAE从0.13降至0.08（Wilcoxon p<10⁻⁴）；Terminal-Bench 2.0上从0.14降至0.12（p<10⁻³）。在任意给定执行任务数下均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹结构化摘要表示能有效提取能力信号并压制混淆信号，配合几何化系统建模显著提升少量执行下的基准预测精度，为agentic系统高效评测提供新思路。

title: Thermodynamics-Informed Learning Captures Hierarchical Hydrogen-Bond Networks in Deep Eutectic Solvents
summary: Deep eutectic solvents (DESs) offer a tunable platform for lignocellulose refining, but their solvation behavior depends on multicomponent hydrogen-bond networks rather than individual constituent properties. We develop TiNN, a thermodynamics-informed neural network that hierarchically represents HBA-HBD association and solute accommodation through a learned free-energy pathway. Trained on 938 records, TiNN achieves a test-set $R^2$ of 0.917 and generalizes to new HBA-HBD combinations and sparse conditions. Ablation identifies solute-specific stabilization as the largest contributor to prediction accuracy, while the importance of hydrogen-bond compatibility depends on the dissolution mechanism. Experimental measurements of glucose, xylan, and Kraft lignin in acidic, basic, and neutral DESs show that TiNN reduces the geometric mean solubility error from more than 23-fold with COSMO-RS to approximately 1.5-fold. Without training on fractionation data, TiNN also distinguishes DES formulations with high and low lignin and hemicellulose removal from corn stover. These results support chemically grounded solvent screening for lignocellulose fractionation.

AI.tldr: TiNN是一种热力学信息神经网络，通过学习自由能路径分层表征HBA-HBD缔合与溶质容纳，实现DES中木质纤维素组分溶解度的准确预测与溶剂筛选。
AI.motivation: DES的溶解行为取决于多组分氢键网络而非单一组分性质，传统模型难以刻画这种复杂溶剂化环境，且现有COSMO-RS误差过大致使溶剂筛选不可靠。
AI.method: 构建TiNN模型，分层表示氢键受体-氢键供体（HBA-HBD）缔合与溶质容纳，基于可学习的自由能路径；用938条数据训练，并通过消融实验分析各模块贡献。
AI.result: 测试集R²达0.917，可泛化到新HBA-HBD组合与稀疏条件；实验验证葡萄糖、木聚糖和硫酸盐木质素的溶解度几何平均误差由COSMO-RS的>23倍降至约1.5倍；未训练分离数据也能区分玉米秸秆中木质素与半纤维素脱除效果高低。
AI.conclusion: TiNN为木质纤维素分级的化学可解释溶剂筛选提供了有效工具，表明溶质特异性稳定化是预测精度的主要贡献因素。

title: Prism: Bidirectional Self-Teaching for Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) aim to support visual understanding and generation within a single model. Existing post-training methods either use understanding as a fixed teacher to improve generation, or rely on ground-truth trajectories to supervise both understanding and generation. Prism instead derives bidirectional supervision from self-generated interleaved rollouts, constructing training targets according to the reliability of their text and image chains. We propose Prism, a bidirectional self-teaching post-training method for UMMs. Like a prism decomposing mixed light, Prism decouples a coupled interleaved trajectory into a text chain and an image chain, assesses the reliability of each chain, and constructs a corresponding training target from their reliability states. Experiments on both SenseNova-U1 and BAGEL show that Prism improves both understanding and generation. On the generation side, GenEval improves from 85.8 to 89.2 (+3.4), and DPG improves from 86.1 to 87.3 (+1.2) on SenseNova-U1. On the understanding side, the total MME score improves from 2282.6 to 2311.6, and MMVP improves from 58.0 to 62.0. Consistent improvements are observed on BAGEL. These results highlight that Prism enables coordinated improvements in generation and understanding by constructing reliability-guided self-training targets from self-generated trajectories, without relying on an external verifier or externally annotated corrected trajectories during target construction.

AI.tldr: Prism 提出一种面向统一多模态模型的双向自教学后训练方法，通过自我生成的交织轨迹构建可靠度引导的训练目标，实现理解与生成的协同提升。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练方法要么把理解当作固定教师来提升生成，要么依赖真实标注轨迹同时监督理解与生成，难以实现双向协同且依赖外部信号。
AI.method: 将自我生成的交织轨迹解耦为文本链与图像链，分别评估其可靠度，并根据可靠度状态构建对应的训练目标，从而从自我生成轨迹中获得双向监督，不依赖外部验证器或人工修正轨迹。
AI.result: 在 SenseNova-U1 上生成方面 GenEval 由 85.8 提升至 89.2（+3.4），DPG 由 86.1 提升至 87.3（+1.2）；理解方面 MME 总分由 2282.6 提升至 2311.6，MMVP 由 58.0 提升至 62.0；在 BAGEL 上也观察到一致提升。
AI.conclusion: Prism 通过可靠度引导的自我生成轨迹自训练目标，在不依赖外部验证器和外部标注修正轨迹的情况下，实现生成与理解的协调改进。

title: Rules, Traces and Routing Statistics: Training and Calibration Data for Open Models on ARC-AGI-2
summary: We study which training and calibration data help three open models solve ARC-AGI-2 tasks when the solver runs offline on four L4 GPUs for at most 12 hours. We compare data offline on public tasks and report 189 runs on the 120 hidden semi-private tasks. For the NVARC Qwen3-4B grid model, we built a corpus of 12,000 executable rules in a typed language and 95,993 tasks; a rule is admitted only if its behaviour on a fixed probe set differs from that of every admitted rule, and a task only if its pairs refute a shortlist of nearest competing rules and defeat 12 shortcut solvers. Continued fine-tuning on 1,920 real task records with revised four-GPU scheduling raised the semi-private score from 28.96 (mean of the released model) to 33.06 (mean of five runs, best 34.86); no checkpoint trained with synthetic tasks, even all 95,993 of them, improved on the real-task model. For the Qwen3.8-27B reasoning model, we fine-tuned on 1,036 of its own reasoning traces with correct final answers and compared sets that add traces of other models and synthetic tasks. With an inference procedure built around the model (a thinking cap enforced in the serving engine, a Python program checked on the demonstrations after each answer, a long first attempt per input), the score rose from 26.81 to 44.03, the level the ARC Prize Foundation measured for the base model without a time limit (42.36); most of the gain came from the inference procedure. For the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next mixture-of-experts model (125B parameters, 6B active), GPU memory limited concurrency. Pruning from 512 to 384 experts per layer by router-weighted activation saliency grew the key-value cache from 0.55M to 1.39M tokens; a 296-expert list adapted with ARC routing statistics, keeping experts for program tokens, plus an FP8 indexer cache, reached 1.96M. With a tool that checks programs, the model scored 56.67, our best result.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在离线4×L4 GPU、12小时限制下，何种训练与校准数据能帮助三个开源模型求解ARC-AGI-2任务，并在120个隐藏半私有任务上报告189次运行结果。
AI.motivation: 在严格的计算与时间预算下，开源模型求解ARC-AGI-2的能力受制于数据选择、推理流程与显存/并发瓶颈，需要实证弄清各类训练与校准数据的实际贡献。
AI.method: 1) NVARC Qwen3-4B网格模型：构建12,000条类型化语言可执行规则与95,993个任务，规则需在探针集上行为唯一，任务需能反驳最近竞争规则并击败12个捷径求解器；用1,920条真实任务记录继续微调。2) Qwen3.8-27B推理模型：在其1,036条自身正确答案推理轨迹上微调，并对比加入他模型轨迹与合成任务；推理流程含思考上限、Python程序演示校验与长首次尝试。3) Qwen3.8-Flash-Next MoE(125B/6B激活)：按路由加权激活显著性从512剪枝至384专家扩大KV缓存，结合ARC路由统计适应的296专家列表与FP8索引器缓存。
AI.result: 4B模型半私有分数从28.96提升至33.06（五次均值，最佳34.86），合成任务无增益；27B模型从26.81升至44.03，超过基础模型无限时的42.36，增益主要来自推理流程；MoE模型KV缓存从0.55M增至1.96M tokens，配合程序校验工具得分56.67，为最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: 真实任务数据优于合成数据，推理流程设计比微调贡献更大，而针对MoE的专家剪枝与缓存优化可显著提升并发与最终成绩；三者结合在受限算力下实现最佳ARC-AGI-2表现。

title: A trust layer for fast pedestal-stability surrogates: calibrated error bars, out-of-distribution alarms and few-shot recalibration
summary: Machine-learning surrogates of linear peeling-ballooning stability now run in milliseconds, but they are mostly deployed as point estimators: they do not say how wrong they may be, or when a query lies outside what they were trained on. For a fusion company designing a new device, every equilibrium of interest is outside the training data of existing surrogates, so this is the case that matters. We describe a model-agnostic trust layer for stability surrogates, made of conformal error bars, out-of-distribution alarms that route doubtful cases to the physics code, and recalibration from a few simulations of a new design, and we test it with pre-registered hypotheses. On a large public dataset of JET-like equilibria with ideal-MHD growth rates, the error bars hold their nominal coverage in distribution and fall short under a shift in plasma shape; a few dozen simulations of the new shape, or routing the cases the alarms flag, restore it. On resistive BOUT++ surrogates, the bars stay calibrated on held-out runs, the alarm flags tokamaks absent from training, and a scenario scan is screened in seconds instead of hours. Across equilibria from the SPARC library and the DIII-D coil set, a surrogate trained on our own graded BOUT++ labels beats the baseline on unseen equilibria, while a surrogate trained elsewhere ranks the same cases backwards and its alarm declines them. Building our own neural-operator surrogate, the harness exposed two input defects whose fix closed its gap to a simple network. For every surrogate tested, the trust layer keeps coverage near target, with a bar width set by that surrogate's own error. Not every pre-registered hypothesis held, and we report those results and the limits of all of them.

AI.tldr: 提出一个与模型无关的"信任层"，为聚变等离子体剥离-气球模稳定性代理模型提供共形误差棒、分布外报警与少量样本重校准，并用预注册假设在多个数据集上验证。
AI.motivation: 线性剥离-气球模稳定性机器学习代理模型虽已达毫秒级，但只给点估计，不告知误差大小与查询是否超出训练分布；对设计新装置的聚变公司而言，感兴趣的平衡几乎全在训练分布之外，这正是关键情形。
AI.method: 构建模型无关的信任层：(1) 共形预测误差棒；(2) 分布外（OOD）报警，将可疑样本转交物理代码；(3) 用新设计少量模拟进行重校准。在JET类理想MHD增长率公开大数据集、BOUT++电阻性代理、SPARC库与DIII-D线圈组平衡上，以预注册假设测试；并自建神经算子代理作为诊断。
AI.result: 误差棒在分布内覆盖率达标，等离子体形状偏移下失效，但几十个新形状模拟或按报警路由即可恢复；BOUT++代理在留出运行上保持校准，报警可识别未见托卡马克，扫描由数小时缩短至数秒；自训练标签的代理在未见平衡上优于基线，外部训练代理排序反而颠倒且其报警予以拒收；神经算子对比暴露两个输入缺陷，修复后缩小与简单网络的差距。
AI.conclusion: 信任层对所有测试代理均使覆盖率接近目标，误差棒宽度由各代理自身误差决定；并非所有预注册假设成立，论文如实报告了失败结果及其局限性。

title: Traffic-VL: Reinforced Vision-Language Models for Generalizable End-to-End Traffic Signal Control
summary: Existing traffic signal control methods typically rely on structured traffic states produced by dedicated perception pipelines. Emerging visual approaches often use idealized simulator images and convert them into intermediate representations before control, limiting their ability to directly exploit roadside visual observations. To bridge both the visual-domain and perception-to-decision gaps, we introduce SynTra-V and Traffic-VL. SynTra-V converts physics-based traffic simulations into photorealistic multi-view surveillance imagery across diverse road topologies and sensing conditions, and automatic semantic auditing checks that control-critical geometry, vehicle movements, and lane semantics match the simulator state. Traffic-VL is an eight-billion-parameter vision-language model that directly maps synchronized multi-view images and natural-language phase descriptions to signal decisions without intermediate structured states. Building on Traffic-R1's two-stage reinforced reasoning framework, Traffic-VL adapts its vision encoder via offline reinforcement learning on SynTra-V and freezes it during online visual stepwise trajectory policy optimization in closed-loop simulation. Experiments show that Traffic-VL matches structured-state Traffic-R1 while outperforming image-based controllers and general-purpose vision-language models, including Gemini 3 Pro. Evaluations on unseen topologies, degraded sensing conditions, real surveillance footage, and a three-week deployment across ten intersections further demonstrate robust visual generalization and effective constrained online control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SynTra-V（物理仿真转真实感多视角路侧图像的数据集，带自动语义审计）和Traffic-VL（8B视觉语言模型，直接由多视角图像+自然语言相位描述输出信号决策），在闭环仿真中达到与结构化状态方法Traffic-R1相当的性能，并在未见拓扑、退化感知、真实监控和十路口三周部署中展现鲁棒泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有信号控制方法依赖专用感知流程产生的结构化状态；视觉方法多用理想化仿真图像并转换中间表示，难以直接利用路侧视觉观测。需同时弥合"视觉域差距"与"感知到决策差距"。
AI.method: SynTra-V将基于物理的交通仿真渲染为逼真多视角监控图像，覆盖多拓扑与感知条件，并用自动语义审计校验关键几何、车辆运动与车道语义与仿真状态一致；Traffic-VL基于Traffic-R1两阶段强化推理框架，在SynTra-V上离线强化学习适配视觉编码器并在闭环在线视觉逐步轨迹策略优化中冻结编码器，端到端由图像与语言描述输出决策。
AI.result: 匹配结构化状态的Traffic-R1，优于图像类控制器与通用视觉语言模型（含Gemini 3 Pro）；在未见拓扑、退化感知条件、真实监控视频及十路口三周部署中表现出稳健的视觉泛化与受限在线控制能力。
AI.conclusion: 端到端视觉语言信号控制可绕过中间结构化状态，借助高保真仿真数据与分阶段强化学习实现可比性能与更强泛化，具备真实路侧部署可行性。

title: ServerBench: How can your coding agents design specialized LLM serving systems?
summary: Large language model (LLM) coding agents develop software through experimentation, offering an opportunity to design the serving systems supporting their own operation. Effective serving requires coordinating implementation and operating decisions under session dependencies, latency constraints, and correctness requirements. We introduce ServerBench, a benchmark for agentic design of complete, specialized LLM serving systems. Agents experiment against a common objective, dollars per dollar: latency-qualified token value per dollar of GPU cost. Stateful replay preserves session dependencies, and independent verification checks the submitted system. Across 11 coding-agent models and three deployments, Claude Sonnet 5.5 achieves 2.97 dollars per dollar on Gemma E4B, $4.87\times$ the vLLM reference; 22 of 33 runs yield verified systems, and 13 exceed the strongest baseline. Our analysis identifies three findings: high-value designs coordinate capacity improvements with load selection; agents interpret performance feedback through workload-relevant experiments; and reliable delivery requires verification of the execution paths introduced by optimization. Overall, ServerBench supports systematic study of how agents translate service objectives and feedback into effective, verified serving systems for given task specifications.

AI.tldr: 提出 ServerBench，一个用于评测 LLM 编程智能体设计完整专用 LLM 服务系统的基准，以"每美元延迟合格 token 价值"为统一目标，通过有状态回放保留会话依赖并用独立验证检查提交系统。
AI.motivation: LLM 编码智能体通过实验开发软件，因而有机会设计支撑自身运行的服务系统；但有效服务需在会话依赖、延迟约束与正确性要求下协同实现与运维决策，缺乏系统化评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 ServerBench 基准：智能体针对统一目标（每美元 GPU 成本下的延迟合格 token 价值，即 dollars per dollar）实验；采用有状态回放保持会话依赖；对提交系统进行独立验证；评测 11 个编码智能体模型与 3 种部署。
AI.result: Claude Sonnet 5.5 在 Gemma E4B 上达到 2.97 dollars per dollar，为 vLLM 参考的 4.87 倍；33 次运行中 22 次产出通过验证的系统，13 次超过最强基线。
AI.conclusion: 分析得出三点发现：高价值设计将容量提升与负载选择协同；智能体通过负载相关实验解读性能反馈；可靠交付需验证优化引入的执行路径。ServerBench 支持系统研究智能体如何将服务目标与反馈转化为有效且经验证的专用服务系统。

title: The Behavioral Rate of Fine-Tuning: Compression as a Measure of Useful Information
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapts a frozen language model through a compact learned update, making it a natural setting for asking how much information fine-tuning needs to write. Yet adapter rank, parameter count, or numerical reconstruction error do not directly tell us how many bits are required to preserve the acquired behavior. We therefore define an operational behavioral rate $R^\star$ as the smallest serialized size of a compressed adapter that, once reloaded into the frozen base model, retains a fixed fraction of its held-out fine-tuning gain. Across LoRA fine-tuning experiments, this rate increases with distinct training content at fixed optimization budgets, but is not determined by intuitive metrics like source description length, fine-tuning gain, or weight-space reconstruction error. Most importantly, the same datasets exhibit substantially different, and even reordered, rates across frozen base models, showing that fine-tuning compressibility is a property of the dataset--receiver pair rather than of the dataset alone. However, we show that correction spectra measured on the data are able to rank these rates within a receiver. Finally, we study a striking noise-reducing effect of compression: adapters trained on deliberately corrupted datasets fall far below the frozen model, yet after compression score above it (23.7% to 82.9% on GSM8K, against 77.6% for frozen Qwen2.5-7B), consistently across tested families and sizes. The damage is unevenly concentrated in the adapter's leading singular directions, which compression appears to filter. Away from its training task, the compressed corrupted adapter also generalizes better than a clean fine-tune: on harder math it retains 97% of base accuracy, versus 44% for the clean adapter.

AI.tldr: 论文提出可操作的行为速率 R*——把压缩后的 LoRA 适配器重新载入冻结基座后仍能保留固定比例微调增益所需的最小序列化比特数，并发现该速率取决于"数据集–接收者"配对而非数据集本身，且压缩能意外修复被污染数据训练出的适配器。
AI.motivation: 现有指标（秩、参数量、重建误差）无法回答"微调到底需要写入多少比特信息"这一问题，因此需要一个以行为保持为标准的压缩率度量。
AI.method: 定义行为速率 R*：压缩适配器序列化后重载，在留出集上保留固定比例微调增益的最小大小。在不同基座模型、不同数据内容与优化预算下做 LoRA 微调实验，并测量校正谱（correction spectra）以排序速率；另外用故意损坏的数据训练适配器以研究压缩的降噪效应。
AI.result: R* 随训练内容多样性增加而上升，但与源描述长度、微调增益、权重重建误差无直接关系；同一数据集在不同基座模型上速率显著不同甚至顺序反转。数据上测得的校正谱可在单一接收者内排序这些速率。压缩显著降噪：损坏数据适配器在 GSM8K 上从 23.7% 提升至 82.9%（冻结 Qwen2.5-7B 为 77.6%），跨模型族与规模一致；损伤集中于适配器的主要奇异方向，被压缩过滤。压缩后的损坏适配器在更难数学任务上保留基座 97% 准确率，而干净适配器仅 44%。
AI.conclusion: 微调可压缩性是数据集与接收者模型的联合属性；校正谱可作为接收者内的速率预测指标；压缩不仅保留行为，还可能滤除污染数据带来的有害方向，从而改善鲁棒性与分布外泛化。

title: FlashRelight: Portrait Video Relighting with Dynamic Lighting
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, including appendix
summary: Portrait video relighting aims to modify the illumination of a portrait video while preserving photorealism and temporal stability. The task becomes particularly challenging under dynamic lighting, where illumination direction, intensity, and color vary over time. To tackle this problem, we introduce FlashRelight, a novel two-stage framework for dynamic portrait video relighting. FlashRelight first suppresses the source illumination through delighting, and then synthesizes the target dynamic lighting on an illumination-neutral portrait video. FlashRelight supports three complementary control modalities: envmap sequences for explicit frame-level lighting control, dynamic lighting text for semantic illumination editing, and lighting reference videos for visual lighting transfer. Training follows a low-cost hybrid strategy that combines static one-light-at-a-time (OLAT) data with generated dynamic-lighting portrait videos, covering both controlled illumination variation and realistic portrait motion. Extensive experiments show that FlashRelight achieves temporally coherent and photorealistic dynamic relighting while enabling flexible cross-video lighting transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/vivoCameraResearch/FlashRelight

AI.tldr: FlashRelight：两阶段动态人像视频重打光框架，先去光照再合成目标动态光照，支持环境贴图序列、文本、参考视频三种控制方式。
AI.motivation: 动态光照下（方向、强度、颜色随时间变化）的人像视频重打光需同时保证真实感与时间稳定性，现有方法难以兼顾；且需要灵活多样的光照控制方式。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：先通过delighting抑制源光照得到光照中性视频，再在其上合成目标动态光照。支持三种互补控制模态——envmap序列（逐帧显式控制）、动态光照文本（语义编辑）、光照参考视频（视觉迁移）。训练采用低成本混合策略，结合静态OLAT（单光逐次）数据与生成的动态光照人像视频。
AI.result: 大量实验表明可实现时间连贯、照片级真实的动态重打光，并支持跨视频光照迁移；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 解耦式两阶段设计配合混合数据训练，能有效解决动态人像视频重打光问题，并提供多模态灵活控制。

title: CompressionBench: How can your coding agents compress LLMs?
summary: Recursive self-improvement requires AI systems to improve the models and infrastructure used by subsequent systems. LLM compression offers a concrete efficiency objective: retain a pretrained model's behavior within a smaller model storage budget. We study whether coding agents can carry out this step autonomously. We formulate compression as a terminal task in which an agent receives a source checkpoint, storage limit, inference environment, and time budget, then constructs compressed weights and executable inference code. The agent controls its algorithm and experiments; perplexity feedback guides search, and independent verification checks the final model. Across six agents and six model--size settings, 29 of 36 submissions pass verification. Selecting the lowest-perplexity agent design per task yields an average 3.4% perplexity increase over BF16 and 77.33% downstream accuracy, compared with 79.56% for BF16. Recorded experiments reveal how agents achieve these outcomes and where improvement breaks down. Agents lower PPL in 21 of 24 revisions at nearly fixed storage; complete-model feedback reverses 17 of 79 prior local rankings; and generation and inference tests expose failures that likelihood alone misses. The results identify representation design, experimental judgment, and capability validation as central to agent-driven model compression, a measurable component of efficiency-oriented self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 该文研究编码智能体能否自主完成LLM压缩这一"递归自我改进"的效率子任务：36次提交中29次通过验证，最优设计平均仅比BF16困惑度高3.4%，下游准确率77.33%（BF16为79.56%）。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进需要AI系统能改进后续系统所用的模型与基础设施。LLM压缩提供了一个具体的效率目标：在更小的存储预算内保留预训练模型的行为，作者希望检验编码智能体能否自主完成这一步。
AI.method: 将压缩形式化为终端任务：智能体获得源检查点、存储上限、推理环境和时间预算，需产出压缩权重和可执行推理代码，自主选择算法与实验；用困惑度反馈引导搜索，并用独立验证检查最终模型。共测试6个智能体、6种模型-规模设置。
AI.result: 36份提交中29份通过验证；每个任务选最低PPL的智能体设计，平均困惑度比BF16高3.4%，下游准确率为77.33%（BF16为79.56%）。24次修订中21次在存储近乎不变时降低PPL；完整模型反馈逆转了79个先前局部排序中的17个；生成与推理测试揭示出仅靠似然无法发现的失败。
AI.conclusion: 表征设计、实验判断与能力验证是智能体驱动模型压缩的核心，可作为面向效率的自我改进的一个可度量组成部分。

title: Verifier-Guided Self-Consistency: Test-Time Reasoning with Imperfect Generators and Verifiers
summary:
Large language models can solve many multi-step reasoning problems, but their reasoning remains brittle: plausible intermediate steps often lead to incorrect answers. Improving reasoning at test time requires balancing two imperfect signals: the generator, which provides diversity, and the verifier, which guides correctness. Existing approaches largely favor one side of this tradeoff. Verifier-weighted voting relies on trajectories sampled from the generator and cannot steer generation toward correct ones. By contrast, beam-style verifier-guided search can steer generation, but may over-concentrate on narrow trajectory sets and amplify verifier errors.
  We propose Verifier-Guided Self-Consistency (VGSC), a stochastic decoding framework that combines step-level correctness and future-outcome estimates to guide reasoning during generation. VGSC repeatedly proposes candidate next steps from the base language model and uses both signals in an acceptance/resampling procedure, while maintaining multiple trajectories for final answer-level self-consistency. We provide a probabilistic interpretation of VGSC as approximate sampling from a verifier-tilted trajectory distribution. Across multiple reasoning benchmarks, generator models, and verifier families, VGSC achieves higher average accuracy than representative baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 Verifier-Guided Self-Consistency (VGSC)，一种随机解码框架，在生成过程中融合步骤级正确性与未来结果估计来引导推理，同时保留多条轨迹做答案级自一致性投票。
AI.motivation: LLM 多步推理脆弱，中间步骤看似合理却导致错误答案。测试时提升推理需平衡生成器（多样性）与验证器（正确性）两个不完美信号：验证器加权投票无法引导生成，而束搜索式验证器引导又易过度集中于狭窄轨迹并放大验证器错误。
AI.method: VGSC 反复从基础模型采样候选下一步，在接受/重采样过程中同时使用步骤级正确性与未来结果估计两个信号，并维护多条轨迹用于最终答案级自一致性。作者还给出其作为"验证器倾斜轨迹分布"近似采样的概率解释。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准、多种生成器模型和验证器家族上，VGSC 的平均准确率优于代表性基线。
AI.conclusion: VGSC 通过随机解码兼顾生成多样性与验证器引导，缓解了验证器加权投票与束搜索引导各自的缺陷，为测试时推理提供更稳健的方案。

title: NanoKV: High-Ratio KV Cache Compression for Autoregressive Video Generation
comment: 25 pages, 13 figures. Project page: https://jiacheng-lu03.github.io/NanoKV/ . Code: https://github.com/jiacheng-lu03/NanoKV
summary: Autoregressive video models rely on historical key-value (KV) caches to preserve scene consistency over extended rollouts, making KV storage and repeated attention over history a growing memory and computational bottleneck. Aggressive compression can degrade generation quality, while reconstructing full-dimensional KV leaves attention computation largely unchanged. We introduce NanoKV, a frozen-backbone framework for generation-aware high-ratio KV compression. NanoKV exploits redundancy across tokens and attention heads by storing shared content in cluster centers and encoding joint head-channel residuals into low-bit coefficients. Crucially, NanoKV uses different fitting objectives for Keys and Values according to their distinct roles in attention: Key decoders are optimized to preserve downstream block outputs, whereas Value encoders and decoders are fitted for faithful reconstruction through the deployed quantization path. Building on the same compressed representation, the optional NanoKV-Fast variant reuses the stored coefficients for mixed-dimensional attention, reducing computation without modifying the video backbone. Across three autoregressive video backbones, NanoKV consistently improves the quality-storage trade-off. On HY-WorldPlay, NanoKV achieves $26.09\times$ effective KV compression, nearly twice that of KVTC, while improving PSNR by 1.0 dB. NanoKV-Fast retains $20.53\times$ effective compression and achieves an approximately $1.15\times$ end-to-end speedup over KVTC.

AI.tldr: NanoKV 是一个冻结骨干的框架，通过跨 token 和注意力头的冗余利用，将 KV 缓存压入共享聚类中心和低比特残差系数，实现生成感知的高倍率 KV 压缩。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频模型依赖历史 KV 缓存维持长时程场景一致性，导致存储与重复注意力计算成为瓶颈；激进压缩会损伤生成质量，而重建完整维度 KV 又几乎不减少计算开销。
AI.method: 将 token 与注意力头间的共享内容存入聚类中心，并把联合的头-通道残差编码为低比特系数；针对 Key 与 Value 在注意力中的不同角色采用不同拟合目标——Key 解码器优化下游 block 输出保真，Value 编解码器则通过实际量化路径做重建拟合；NanoKV-Fast 变体复用同一压缩表示实现混合维度注意力以降低计算。
AI.result: 在三个自回归视频骨干上均改善质量-存储权衡；HY-WorldPlay 上达到 26.09× 有效 KV 压缩（约为 KVTC 的两倍）且 PSNR 提升 1.0 dB；NanoKV-Fast 保持 20.53× 压缩并相对 KVTC 获得约 1.15× 端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 生成感知的分角色压缩策略可在不修改视频骨干的前提下显著提升 KV 压缩率与质量，并兼顾计算加速。

title: On Turn-Level Best-of-N Sampling for Scaling LLM Agents
summary: In this work, we evaluate a simple inference-time scaling approach based on \textit{turn-level best-of-N sampling} (\method) for large language model (LLM) agents on complex, long-horizon tasks. We instantiate this using a \textit{generator-selector} framework with two LLMs; at each turn, a \emph{generator} model generates $N$ candidate actions and a \emph{selector} model selects one of them, which is then executed in the environment. This paper is closely related to the work of \cite{zainullina2025guided} who used critic models for guided search at inference time. Different from their work, we evaluate if off-the-shelf, open-weight LLMs can be effective at comparing different candidate actions directly. Experiments on long-horizon terminal tasks show that \method can lead to significant performance improvements, both in terms of accuracy (5--10\%) and consistency across repeated attempts. Analysis of agent trajectories reveal a shift in agent behaviour towards desirable patterns such as reduction in number of attempts to solve the task, improved task instruction following, debugging and testing.

AI.tldr: 本文评估一种简单的推理时缩放方法——回合级 best-of-N 采样（turn-level best-of-N sampling），用于提升大语言模型智能体在复杂长程任务上的表现。实验表明该方法在准确率和一致性上均有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有工作（如 zainullina2025guided）使用 critic 模型进行推理时引导搜索。本文希望探究现成的开源权重 LLM 是否能直接有效比较不同候选动作，从而以更简单的方式提升长程任务表现。
AI.method: 采用生成器-选择器（generator-selector）框架，使用两个 LLM：每一回合中，生成器模型产生 N 个候选动作，选择器模型从中挑选一个执行到环境中。整个过程在推理时进行，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在长程终端任务上的实验显示，该方法在准确率上提升约 5-10%，且在重复尝试间的一致性上有显著改善。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹分析表明智能体行为向更优模式转变，包括减少解题尝试次数、更好地遵循任务指令以及改进调试与测试行为。说明现成开源 LLM 可作为有效的动作选择器。

title: A Bag of Tricks for Defending Deep Learning-based Face Recognition Pipelines against Backdoor Attacks
summary: The protection of mature, multi-stage Face Recognition Systems is crucial to system providers. This technical report targets the threat model most relevant to industry practitioners: although model training is performed in-house, training data is sourced from possibly-compromised third parties. Given this setting, we present three practical defense "tricks" against data poisoning-based backdoor attacks. The first operates at training-time, detecting poisoned identities during training or prior to a pipeline's deployment. The last two operate at inference-time, filtering suspicious inputs before an answer can be sent back to a potential attacker. Each method is presented with their motivation, algorithms and computational impact, and evaluated on realistic face recognition workloads. Our goal is to provide actionable hardening techniques to system providers.

AI.tldr: 本文面向工业界真实威胁模型——模型内部训练、但训练数据来自可能被攻陷的第三方——提出三种针对数据投毒后门攻击的实用防御技巧：一种训练时检测"被投毒身份"，两种推理时过滤可疑输入，并在真实人脸识别负载上评估。
AI.motivation: 成熟的、多阶段的人脸识别系统保护对系统提供商至关重要；实践者最相关的威胁是数据供应链不可信，而现有防御多为学术设置下提出，缺少可直接落地的加固方案。
AI.method: 三种技巧：①训练时方法，在训练中或流水线部署前检测被投毒的身份（identity）；②③两种推理时方法，在返回答案给潜在攻击者之前过滤可疑输入。每种方法均给出动机、算法与计算开销分析。
AI.result: 在贴近真实的人脸识别工作负载上对三种方法进行了评估（报告为技术报告，摘要未给出具体量化指标）。
AI.conclusion: 旨在为系统提供商提供可操作的加固（hardening）技术，形成训练时+推理时的多层防御组合。

title: Learning to Decode Linear Codes with Generalized Belief Propagation Network
summary: Error correcting codes are a fundamental component of communication systems, enabling reliable data transmission over noisy channels. Recently, neural decoders have demonstrated notable performance gains over classical iterative algorithms. In this paper, we propose a Generalized Belief Propagation Network (GBPNet) that preserves message-passing symmetry while enhancing the decoder's learning capability. The architecture uses cascaded variable-node updates and learned element-wise message scaling while retaining the Tanner graph structure. We also introduce two training strategies, progressive training and high-SNR training, that improve decoding accuracy. Experimental results on several linear codes show that GBPNet achieves lower bit error rates than conventional belief propagation and the evaluated state-of-the-art neural decoders.

AI.tldr: 提出 GBPNet——一种保持消息传递对称性的广义信念传播网络神经译码器，通过级联变量节点更新、可学习的逐元素消息缩放以及渐进训练和高 SNR 训练策略，在多种线性码上取得比传统 BP 和现有神经译码器更低的误码率。
AI.motivation: 纠错码是通信系统可靠传输的基础，而经典迭代译码算法性能有限；近年神经译码器虽优于经典方法，但需在保持 Tanner 图消息传递结构的同时提升学习能力，以兼顾性能与可解释性。
AI.method: 构建结构保留于 Tanner 图上的网络：采用级联的变量节点更新（cascaded variable-node updates）与可学习的逐元素消息缩放（learned element-wise message scaling），从而保持消息传递对称性；并提出渐进训练（progressive training）与高 SNR 训练（high-SNR training）两种训练策略以提升译码精度。
AI.result: 在多种线性码上的实验表明，GBPNet 的误码率（BER）低于传统信念传播（BP）以及所对比的当前最优神经译码器。
AI.conclusion: 在保持消息传递对称性的前提下增强网络的表达能力，并辅以针对性训练策略，可有效提升神经译码器性能，说明结构化神经网络设计是改进纠错码译码的可行方向。

title: From Reconstruction to Imputation: Test-Time Optimization for Missing Time-Series Channels
summary: Complete sensor-channel failures create a difficult form of time-series missingness: local interpolation is unavailable, and deploying a separately trained imputer for every failure pattern may be impractical. We ask whether a sequence reconstructor trained without artificial mask augmentation and then frozen can be converted into an imputer at inference time. Our method treats the missing entries of each test window as optimization variables, clamps all observations, and backpropagates through the frozen model to minimize reconstruction error only on observed coordinates. The resulting observed-self-consistency objective requires neither artificial mask augmentation nor full-channel dropout during reconstructor training. We characterize when this refinement is informative through the cross-Jacobian from missing inputs to observed residuals, and use an optional temporal-smoothness prior when that coupling is weak. Across five real-world datasets with exactly one channel synthetically masked per test window and four reconstruction architectures, no-prior test-time refinement reduces MAE relative to one-pass reconstruction in 19 of 20 dataset-backbone combinations. Compared with mask-aware imputers trained under either standard structured masks or matched full-channel dropout, the best refined reconstructor achieves the lowest MAE on two datasets and trails the strongest baseline on three. These gains require substantially more inference time and are sensitive to cross-channel coupling. Our results establish test-time self-consistency as a conditional inference-time adapter for frozen reconstruction models that complements mask-aware imputation without retraining the reconstructor.

AI.tldr: 将冻结的、未做人工掩码增强训练的重构模型在推理时转化为插补器：把测试窗口缺失项作为优化变量、固定观测值，通过冻结模型反向传播，仅在观测坐标上最小化重构误差（观测自一致性目标）。
AI.motivation: 完整传感器信道失效导致局部插值不可用，且为每种失效模式单独训练插补器不现实；希望复用已有的、未做掩码增强训练的重构器来直接完成插补。
AI.method: 测试时精调（test-time refinement）：每个测试窗口的缺失条目作为可优化变量，观测值保持不变，经冻结模型反向传播，仅在观测坐标上最小化重构误差；用"缺失输入→观测残差"的交叉雅可比刻画该精调何时有效，耦合弱时加入可选的时间平滑先验。无需人工掩码增强或全信道丢弃。
AI.result: 5 个真实数据集、每窗口恰好掩蔽 1 个信道、4 种重构架构（20 种组合）：无先验测试时精调在 19/20 组合中相比单次重构降低 MAE。与结构化掩码或匹配全信道丢弃训练的掩码感知插补器相比，最佳精调重构器在 2 个数据集上 MAE 最低，3 个上落后于最强基线。代价是推理时间显著增加，且对跨信道耦合敏感。
AI.conclusion: 测试时自一致性可作为冻结重构模型的条件性推理期适配器，补充掩码感知插补而无需重新训练重构器。

title: Dull, Dirty, Dangerous? Working Conditions and the Limits of Occupational AI Exposure
summary: Automation is often justified as relief from dull, dirty, and dangerous work. I examine how these conditions relate to occupational AI exposure using 21 O*NET items across 754 US occupations. Higher exposure is associated with lower condition scores under a large language model (LLM) measure and AI Occupational Exposure (AIOE), with equal occupation weights and employment weights. Adjustment for physical demands, required education, training and experience, and wages reduces the composite association. The adjusted confidence intervals include zero for LLM exposure and remain below zero for AIOE. Separating repetition from restricted discretion also changes what the combined Dull score conveys. These comparisons show how item groupings and occupational characteristics shape the interpretation of exposure estimates. Occupational profiles offer a starting point for selecting contrasting research settings. Establishing desired automation or realized relief requires evidence about workers' preferences and specific interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文用 O*NET 21 个条目衡量 754 个美国职业的"枯燥、脏、危险"程度，并与两种 AI 暴露度指标对比：高暴露职业的条件得分更低，但控制体力需求、教育、培训和工资后，LLM 暴露的关联变得不显著，AIOE 的关联仍为负。
AI.motivation: 自动化常以"替代枯燥、肮脏、危险工作"作为正当性理由，但少有研究检验 AI 暴露度是否真的与这些工作条件相关；作者希望厘清职业特征与条目分组如何影响暴露指标的解读。
AI.method: 使用 21 个 O*NET 条目在 754 个美国职业上构建"枯燥、脏、危险"条件得分；分别采用 LLM 暴露度量与 AIOE 指标，在职业等权和就业等权两种加权方式下计算相关性；并逐步控制体力需求、所需教育、培训与经验、工资，考察关联是否稳健；此外将"重复性"与"自主性受限"拆分，检验合成"枯燥"分数的含义。
AI.result: AI 暴露越高，条件得分越低（两种加权下一致）。调整协变量后复合关联减弱：LLM 暴露的调整后置信区间包含零，AIOE 仍显著低于零。将重复性与受限自主性分开后，合并的 Dull 分数所传达的信息发生变化。
AI.conclusion: 暴露估计的解读高度依赖条目分组与职业特征控制方式；职业画像可作为筛选对比性研究场景的起点，但"自动化是否带来理想中的解脱"需依赖工人偏好与实际干预的证据才能判定。

title: Dimension-Free Private Mean Estimation is Impossible Without the Covariance
summary: We study the limits of differentially private Gaussian mean estimation when the covariance matrix is unknown. Prior work shows that when the covariance $Σ$ is known, the optimal sample complexity can depend only on its spectrum, rather than on the ambient dimension $d$. We establish new lower bounds for Gaussian mean estimation with Euclidean error which show that private estimators cannot achieve similar guarantees when the covariance is unknown. First, when the sample size $n$ is smaller than the effective dimension $\mathrm{trace}(Σ)/\|Σ\|_{\text{op}}$, the optimal error when the covariance is unknown can be larger than the optimal error when it is known by a factor of $\sqrt{d/n}$. Second, when the sample size is larger than the effective dimension, even for diagonal covariance matrices with effective dimension bounded by $\log d$, the optimal error when the covariance is unknown can be larger than the optimal error when it is known by a factor of $\sqrt{d}/n^{3/2}$. Together, these results show that in the unknown covariance setting, exploiting anisotropic structure under differential privacy can require a dimension-dependent error or sample complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了协方差矩阵未知时差分隐私高斯均值估计的极限，证明了未知协方差下私有估计器无法像已知协方差那样仅依赖谱（有效维度）而避免维度依赖的误差/样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明协方差已知时，最优样本复杂度只依赖Σ的谱（如有效维度trace(Σ)/‖Σ‖_op），而与环境维度d无关。作者想知道这种各向异性结构优势在协方差未知时是否仍能在差分隐私下保持。
AI.method: 针对欧氏误差下的高斯均值估计建立新的下界：分别分析样本量n小于有效维度和大于有效维度两种情形，给出未知协方差与已知协方差最优误差之间的比值下界（√(d/n) 与 √d/n^{3/2}），后者即使对有效维度≤log d的对角协方差也成立。
AI.result: 当n小于有效维度时，未知协方差的最优误差可比已知情形大√(d/n)倍；当n大于有效维度时，即使是对角协方差且有效维度≤log d，未知协方差的最优误差仍可比已知情形大√d/n^{3/2}倍。
AI.conclusion: 在协方差未知的情形下，差分隐私中利用各向异性结构必然带来依赖维度d的误差或样本复杂度，已知协方差时的谱依赖保证无法推广到未知协方差。

title: Unaligned Image Guided Denoising via Cross-modal Conditional Flow Matching
summary: This work presents UGD-FM, a novel unaligned image guided denoising framework based on cross-modal conditional flow matching. Unlike previous approaches that assume spatially aligned inputs or only handle small-baseline rectified pairs, we address a more challenging setting where severe target noise and large-range two-dimensional cross-modal misalignment coexist. Specifically, we formulate guided denoising as a progressive flow matching process, allowing image restoration and aligned guidance aggregation to mutually reinforce each other. To support efficient few-step inference, we introduce a stage-focused and inference-consistent training strategy that focuses on task-critical denoising stages, and mitigates the training-inference mismatch. We further propose adaptive sparse guidance propagation for efficient and reliable large-range matching, regularized by perceptual and geometric auxiliary losses. Experiments demonstrate that UGD-FM achieves state-of-the-art denoising performance with only one or two inference steps, and is compatible with modern single-image restoration backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出UGD-FM，基于跨模态条件流匹配的非对齐图像引导去噪框架，应对强噪声与二维大范围跨模态错位共存场景，一两步推理即达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 已有引导去噪方法假设输入空间对齐或仅处理小基线校正图像对；实际场景中目标噪声严重且存在大范围二维跨模态错位，二者并存更具挑战性，现有方法难以应对。
AI.method: 将引导去噪建模为渐进式流匹配过程，使图像恢复与对齐引导聚合互相促进；引入聚焦关键去噪阶段且推理一致的训练策略以支持少步推理并缓解训练-推理失配；提出自适应稀疏引导传播实现高效可靠的大范围匹配，并用感知与几何辅助损失正则化。
AI.result: 仅需一到两步推理即可取得SOTA去噪性能，并可兼容现代单图复原主干网络。
AI.conclusion: UGD-FM以流匹配统一建模去噪与跨模态对齐，为强噪声大错位场景提供高效少步SOTA方案，具良好主干兼容性。

title: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
comment: 41 pages (10 pages main text), 19 figures, 11 tables
summary: AI agents are playing an increasingly important role in physics research. However, existing physics benchmarks only evaluate fixed questions, isolated sub-tasks, or paper reproduction with given solutions, and rarely check research quality alongside correctness. We introduce FrontierPhysics, an end-to-end benchmark with 56 tasks made by 42 physicists based on their own research, covering nine domains across theoretical, computational, and experimental physics. Each task requires agents to review the literature, develop a research plan, conduct research and experiments, and produce structured outputs and scientific manuscripts. Combining deterministic verifiers with expert-authored rubrics, FrontierPhysics evaluates whether agents' research is correct and publishable. Across 22 models in 26 configurations, no configuration passes more than 46 of its 168 rollouts. Manual review of agent trajectories shows that frontier agents' main weaknesses are insufficiently rigorous reasoning and limited expert intuition, rather than gaps in physics knowledge or execution errors.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FrontierPhysics，一个由42位物理学家基于自身研究构建的端到端基准，含56个跨九个领域（理论/计算/实验物理）的任务，要求AI智能体完成文献综述、研究规划、实验执行并产出结构化输出与科学论文，同时用确定性验证器与专家评分量表评估正确性与可发表性。测试22个模型26种配置，无一配置通过超过168次rollout中的46次；主要瓶颈是推理不够严谨与专家直觉不足，而非物理知识或执行错误。
AI.motivation: 现有物理基准只评估固定问题、孤立子任务或给定解法的论文复现，很少在检验正确性的同时评估研究质量，无法反映AI智能体真实科研能力。
AI.method: 构建56个真实科研任务（42位物理学家自研，覆盖理论、计算、实验物理九大领域）；每个任务要求智能体完成文献调研、研究规划、研究与实验、结构化输出与科学手稿撰写；采用确定性验证器结合专家撰写的评分量表，评价研究既正确又可发表；在22个模型、26种配置上进行大规模评测，并对智能体轨迹做人工审阅。
AI.result: 共168次rollout中，没有任何一种配置通过超过46次；人工轨迹分析显示前沿智能体的主要弱点是推理不够严谨和专家直觉有限，而不是物理知识欠缺或执行错误。
AI.conclusion: FrontierPhysics为端到端物理科研智能体提供了兼顾正确性与研究质量的严格基准，揭示了当前模型在科研严谨性和物理直觉上的根本短板，为后续智能体能力提升指明方向。

title: Fingerprinting the Dispatchers behind Distributed Model Extraction
summary: API distillation campaigns try to hide model-stealing traffic by splitting requests across thousands of load-balanced accounts, which standard content classifiers often miss. However, request timestamps, specifically arrival time and stream completion time, reveal the underlying dispatching strategy, such as round-robin counters or key-shuffling pools. Using a 20 percent seed set, this timing analysis can forensically rank the remaining accounts of a campaign with 0.92 to 1.00 AUC within 20 minutes, even across thousands of real production accounts. While adaptive attackers struggle to hide rotating dispatchers using jitter, pinning keys successfully evades detection, though it can severely throttle throughput when quotas bind. Ultimately, timing exposes shared infrastructure patterns even when content filters fail.

AI.tldr: 针对跨数千账号分流隐藏的API蒸馏攻击，作者提出基于请求时序（到达时间与流完成时间）的取证方法，仅用20%种子账号即可对其余账号排名，20分钟内AUC达0.92–1.00；而jitter难以隐藏轮转调度，key pinning可规避检测但受配额限制严重降低吞吐。
AI.motivation: API蒸馏活动通过把请求拆分到数千个负载均衡账号来隐藏模型窃取流量，常规内容分类器往往无法识别。作者希望寻找内容之外更稳健的取证信号，因请求时间戳可暴露底层调度策略（如轮转计数器、键打乱池），从而识别共享基础设施。
AI.method: 分析请求的到达时间与流完成时间戳，反推分发/调度策略；以20%账号作为种子集，对同一campaign剩余账号进行时序相似性推断与取证排序；在数千个真实生产账号上评估，并测试自适应攻击者的jitter与key pinning等规避手段及其吞吐代价。
AI.result: 仅凭时序分析，在20分钟内对campaign剩余账号排序达到0.92–1.00 AUC，且在数千真实生产账号中依然有效；自适应攻击者用jitter难以隐藏轮转调度器，采用key pinning可成功规避检测，但当配额受限时会严重压制吞吐。
AI.conclusion: 即使内容过滤失效，请求时序仍能暴露共享基础设施模式；时序取证为检测API蒸馏campaign提供了有效补充手段，同时揭示了规避与吞吐之间的权衡。

title: DreamRealm: Exploring and Materializing Hallucination Worlds for Trustworthy Vision-Language Models
comment: 28 pages, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/Alibaba-VELLDEPTH/DreamRealm . Model: https://huggingface.co/Alibaba-VELLDEPTH/Qwen35-9b-DreamRealm
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain prone to visual hallucinations when correct responses depend on subtle visual details. One line of post-training methods constructs visual contrasts through image retrieval, generation, or editing to improve fine-grained perception. However, these contrasts are not built around the model's own hallucinations, making it difficult to ensure that supervision targets its actual perceptual confusions. Another line suppresses hallucinated outputs through response correction or preference learning under fixed image conditions, but leaves the design of supervision signals on the image-input side underexplored. Inspired by how humans correct misconceptions, we introduce DreamRealm, a post-training framework that explores diverse latent hallucinated responses, minimally edits original images to make them valid, and trains the model to assign each response to its supporting image. Our data construction pipeline, RealmForgePipe, mines observed and latent hallucinations from a target model and materializes them through image editing. Using hallucinations mined from Qwen3.5-9B, we construct the Realized Hallucination Dataset (RealmSet). Our training objective, RealmMatch, constructs a likelihood score matrix across image--response combinations and combines supervised learning with bidirectional contrastive losses to reinforce correct matches and suppress mismatches. Compared with the original Qwen3.5-9B model, DreamRealm improves performance across six visual perception and hallucination benchmarks, including gains of 7.26 percentage points in HallusionBench accuracy and 11.34 percentage points in MMVP pair accuracy. Together with ablation studies on data construction and training methods, these results demonstrate that hallucination assignment is a promising paradigm for improving visual perception and mitigating hallucinations.

AI.tldr: DreamRealm 是一个后训练框架：先挖掘目标模型已观测和潜在的幻觉，用最小图像编辑把幻觉响应"变成正确"，再训练模型把每个响应匹配到其支持的图像（RealmMatch），在六个视觉感知与幻觉基准上提升 Qwen3.5-9B，如 HallusionBench +7.26、MMVP 配对准确率 +11.34。
AI.motivation: MLLM 在依赖细微视觉细节时仍易产生视觉幻觉。现有后训练方法分两类：一类靠图像检索/生成/编辑构造视觉对比，但对比并非围绕模型自身幻觉构建，监督难以对准其真实的感知混淆；另一类在固定图像下通过答案纠正或偏好学习抑制幻觉输出，但图像输入侧的监督信号设计被忽视。作者受人类纠正误解方式的启发，希望让监督直接针对模型自身（包括潜在）的幻觉。
AI.method: 提出 DreamRealm 后训练框架，含三部分：1) RealmForgePipe 数据构建流水线，从目标模型中挖掘已观测幻觉与潜在幻觉，并通过图像编辑将其"实体化"；2) 基于 Qwen3.5-9B 挖掘的幻觉构建 Realized Hallucination Dataset（RealmSet）；3) RealmMatch 训练目标，在图像-响应对上构造似然得分矩阵，结合监督学习与双向对比损失，强化正确匹配、抑制错误匹配。
AI.result: 相较原始 Qwen3.5-9B，DreamRealm 在六个视觉感知与幻觉基准上均有提升，其中 HallusionBench 准确率 +7.26 个百分点，MMVP 配对准确率 +11.34 个百分点；数据构建与训练方法的消融实验验证了各组件作用。
AI.conclusion: "幻觉指派"（hallucination assignment）是被验证有效的范式：通过将模型自身幻觉实体化为图像并学习图像-响应匹配，可同时提升细粒度视觉感知并缓解幻觉。未来可进一步扩展幻觉挖掘与编辑的覆盖范围及其他模型规模。

title: BEAKER: An Expert-Curated Benchmark for Embodied Brains in Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 (Track on Evaluations and Datasets, Spotlight)
summary: Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories (SDCLs) are moving chemical experimentation toward embodied automation, where machines must perceive laboratory scenes, reason about experimental states, and act under physical, procedural, and safety constraints. Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly considered as embodied brains for such systems, existing laboratory benchmarks mainly focus on safety, anomaly detection, or general scientific understanding, leaving their execution-oriented embodied capabilities underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce BEAKER, a Benchmark for evaluating Embodied Actionability, Knowledge, Experimentation, and Reasoning in SDCLs. BEAKER contains 1,000 expert-curated question-answer samples across 11 image and video task types, covering key judgments required for chemical laboratory execution, including affordance grounding, trajectory planning, equipment, state, and safety recognition, apparatus setup, operation and step reasoning, and temporal procedure reasoning. All questions and annotations are manually created and reviewed by chemistry and embodied Artificial Intelligence (AI) experts, without AI-assisted generation or annotation. We evaluate 28 general-purpose, science-oriented, chemistry-specialized, and embodied MLLMs in an offline, single-turn setting. Results show that current models can follow coarse experimental procedures in videos, but still struggle to ground actions into operable regions and feasible trajectories, to recognize fine-grained laboratory apparatus, states, and safety norms, and to order steps in mid-length procedures. BEAKER thus reveals a clear gap between coarse procedural understanding and the precise, action-grounded perception required for laboratory execution, providing a diagnostic benchmark for future MLLMs in SDCLs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出BEAKER基准，用于评估多模态大模型在自驱动化学实验室中的具身可执行能力，覆盖11类图像/视频任务、1000个专家人工标注样本，测试28个模型后发现其粗粒度流程理解尚可，但精细动作落地、设备状态识别与步骤排序能力不足。
AI.motivation: 自驱动化学实验室需要机器感知实验场景、推理实验状态并在物理、流程与安全约束下行动，MLLM被视为潜在"具身大脑"，但现有实验室基准多聚焦安全、异常检测或通用科学理解，对执行导向的具身能力评估不足，存在空白。
AI.method: 构建BEAKER基准：包含1000个专家人工编写与复核的问答样本，覆盖11种图像和视频任务类型，涉及可供性定位、轨迹规划、设备/状态/安全识别、装置搭建、操作与步骤推理、时序流程推理等；全部标注由化学与具身AI专家完成，无AI辅助生成；在离线单轮设定下评测28个通用、科学、化学专用及具身MLLM。
AI.result: 现有模型能跟随视频中的粗粒度实验流程，但在将动作定位到可操作区域与可行轨迹、识别细粒度实验器材/状态/安全规范、以及为中等长度流程排序步骤方面仍存在困难。
AI.conclusion: BEAKER揭示了粗粒度流程理解与实验室执行所需的精确、动作落地感知之间的明显差距，为未来面向自驱动化学实验室的MLLM提供了诊断性基准。

title: Self-Directed Apple Tasting
summary: We study the classical apple-tasting setting, a partial feedback model in which the learner observes the true label only when it predicts $1$. A combinatorial characterization for the rates of this problem in the online adversarial setting has been studied by Raman et al. (2024). We study the self-directed setting, in which the learner can adaptively choose the order of the points it predicts on. In the realizable setting, we establish a tetrachotomy on the expected minimax number of mistakes made by any learner. Depending on the VC dimension, the $\emptyset$-centered star number, and the self-directed dimension, we show that the rates could possibly be $Θ(1)$, $O(\log n) \cap ω(1)$, $\tilde Θ(\sqrt{n})$, or $Θ(n)$. In the agnostic setting, the minimax regret is $\tilde Θ(\sqrt{n})$ or $Θ(n)$, depending on the VC dimension.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"自导向苹果品尝"在线学习模型，给出了可实现情形下最优错误数的四分类刻画，以及不可知情形下最优遗憾的两分类结果。
AI.motivation: 经典的苹果品尝（partial feedback）模型此前已有对抗式在线设定下的组合刻画（Raman et al., 2024），但学习器能否自适应选择预测顺序（self-directed）对错误率的影响尚不清楚，本文填补这一空白。
AI.method: 定义self-directed设定，学习器可自适应地安排预测点的顺序；利用VC维、∅-centered star number与self-directed dimension对假设类进行组合刻画，分析可实现与不可知两种情形下的minimax错误/遗憾。
AI.result: 可实现设定下得到四分类：最优错误率依上述三个组合量可能为Θ(1)、O(log n)∩ω(1)、Õ(√n)或Θ(n)。不可知设定下，minimax遗憾为Õ(√n)或Θ(n)，取决于VC维。
AI.conclusion: 自导向顺序选择使问题呈现更丰富的速率分层，三个组合维度量共同决定可实现速率，而不可知情形仅由VC维二分。

title: Within-Family EfficientNet Scaling under Fixed-Resolution Transfer Learning for Spectral-Domain Optical Coherence Tomography Retinal Disease Classification
summary: Background/Objectives: CNNs perform well in retinal disease classification from spectral-domain optical coherence tomography (SD-OCT), but whether EfficientNet's natural-image scaling hierarchy transfers to medical-image transfer learning at fixed resolution remains unclear. This study evaluates EfficientNet-B0-B7 for four-class SD-OCT classification and accuracy-efficiency trade-offs. Methods: Eight ImageNet-pretrained variants (4.05-64.10M instantiated backbone parameters) were evaluated at 224x224 on the Kermany dataset. Grayscale images were replicated to RGB and processed using model-embedded preprocessing and augmentation. Training comprised frozen-backbone head training followed by partial fine-tuning. Metrics covered classification, discrimination, efficiency, and visual analyses. Results: Test accuracy varied non-monotonically from 95.93% (B0) to 96.95% (B1); B7 achieved 96.73%. B1 had the highest accuracy and Drusen F1 (0.8780), while B7 had Drusen F1 of 0.8720 and the highest Drusen recall (0.9177). Drusen had the lowest F1 across all variants and contributed 82.2% of the summed squared deviation in class-specific F1; class ranking remained Normal > CNV > DME > Drusen. The OCT accuracy ranking differed from the reported ImageNet hierarchy, where B7 ranked first. The accuracy-to-parameter ratio fell from 19.82 to 1.48 percentage points per million total parameters. The final train-test gap had a weak, non-significant association with test accuracy (r = 0.26, p = 0.53). Conclusions: Larger EfficientNet variants did not consistently improve SD-OCT classification. B1 achieved the highest accuracy and Drusen F1, whereas B7 showed a secondary accuracy recovery at greater model size and CPU latency, indicating task and protocol dependent scaling effects. As cross-partition duplicates have not been independently audited, results are conditional on the supplied split.

AI.tldr: 本研究在固定224×224分辨率下评估EfficientNet-B0至B7（8个ImageNet预训练变体）用于Kermany数据集四分类SD-OCT，发现精度随规模非单调变化：B1最高（96.95%），B7次高（96.73%），更大模型并未稳定提升性能。
AI.motivation: EfficientNet的缩放层级源于自然图像，其在固定分辨率、医学图像迁移学习场景下是否依然成立尚不明确；同时需权衡精度与效率。
AI.method: 8个ImageNet预训练变体（4.05–64.10M参数），224×224输入，灰度复制为RGB，采用模型内置预处理与增强；训练分两阶段：冻结主干训练分类头，再部分微调；评估涵盖分类、判别、效率与可视化指标。
AI.result: 测试精度95.93%（B0）至96.95%（B1）非单调变化，B7为96.73%；B1精度与Drusen F1最高（0.8780），B7 Drusen召回最高（0.9177）；Drusen在所有变体中F1最低，占类间F1平方偏差总和的82.2%；类别排序为Normal>CNV>DME>Drusen；该排序与ImageNet层级（B7第一）不一致；精度/参数比从19.82降至1.48（百分点/百万参数）；训练-测试差距与测试精度关联微弱且不显著（r=0.26, p=0.53）。
AI.conclusion: 更大EfficientNet变体不能持续改善SD-OCT分类；B1精度与Drusen F1最佳，B7在大模型与更高CPU延迟下出现二次精度回升，说明缩放效应依赖任务与流程；由于跨分区重复样本未独立审计，结果仅对给定划分成立。

title: Do unlearning algorithms learn the right features?
summary: Machine unlearning is commonly evaluated with standard post-deletion metrics that compare an unlearned model to one retrained on the remaining data. Such snapshot evaluations can conceal consequential differences in the features the two models encode. We prove that if an unlearned and a retrained model agree on their outputs but encode different features, a single gradient step on their prediction heads can break this agreement. We further show that deleting an arbitrarily small fraction of the data can cause retraining to select qualitatively different features, so matching retraining can require learning features that the full model never had. We then introduce a measure of feature recovery that separates missing from extraneous features. Across eight unlearning methods, models that perform well on standard metrics often fail to recover the retrained features. This mismatch predicts deviations from retraining under subsequent relearning and downstream adaptation, and directly correcting it systematically reduces these deviations.

AI.tldr: 标准快照式遗忘评估可能掩盖遗忘模型与重训模型在特征表示上的差异；作者提出特征恢复度量并证明修正该差异可减少后续偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘评估主要用删除后的快照指标（比较遗忘模型与重训模型输出），但即使两者输出一致，也可能编码完全不同的特征，从而在后续梯度步、重学习或下游适配中暴露差异。
AI.method: 理论上证明：若两模型输出一致但特征不同，对预测头做单步梯度即可打破一致性；并证明删除极小比例数据即可使重训选择性质不同的特征。随后提出一种区分"缺失特征"与"多余特征"的特征恢复度量，并在八种遗忘方法上评估，且直接修正该不匹配。
AI.result: 八种遗忘方法中，标准指标表现好的模型常未能恢复重训特征；该不匹配可预测重学习与下游适配时的偏差，而直接修正该不匹配能系统性降低这些偏差。
AI.conclusion: 快照指标不足以刻画遗忘质量，需以特征层面恢复为评估与优化目标；特征恢复差距具有预测力且可被直接纠正。

title: CoDecide: Content-Adaptive Video Decoding for High-Throughput Video Analytics
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. 12 pages including supplementary material
summary: Analytics on video archives are bottlenecked by decoding. In a dense pipeline that runs a detector on every frame, decoding is a small fraction of the runtime, but once the detector is restricted to selected frames, decoding takes over as the main cost. We introduce CoDecide, a retrospective analytics system that only decodes the frames where new content appears, using signals from the compressed bitstream to find them. Motion tells us something is moving, but not whether it is new to the scene or has been there the whole time. To make that distinction, we supervise a lightweight compressed-domain student on a label-free novelty signal from a frozen DINOv2 teacher, which fires on semantically new regions rather than on any motion. Consequently, the student model generalizes to new camera deployments without requiring per-camera retraining. At inference, it decides which frames to decode and which regions to reconstruct. Detections from the decoded frames are propagated to the skipped frames using motion vectors. We evaluate CoDecide with a leave-one-dataset-out protocol on VIRAT, MEVA, and ShanghaiTech. Against a dense per-frame detector, CoDecide recovers more moving-object detections than prior compressed-domain selectors at an equivalent decoding budget, outperforming even a competitor trained directly on the target camera. CoDecide runs 15 to 24x faster than a pipeline that decodes and detects every frame. Code is available at https://github.com/shristy51/CoDecide.

AI.tldr: CoDecide是一个回溯式视频分析系统，利用压缩码流信号只解码新内容出现的帧，通过DINOv2教师蒸馏的无监督新颖性信号指导学生模型，实现跨摄像头泛化，比逐帧检测流水线快15-24倍。
AI.motivation: 视频档案分析受解码瓶颈制约。在检测器只处理选定帧的场景下，解码成本反而成为主要开销；而仅靠运动信号无法区分"新出现"与"一直存在"的内容。
AI.method: 从压缩码流提取信号（如运动矢量）；用冻结的DINOv2教师生成无标签的语义新颖性信号，监督轻量级压缩域学生模型（该信号只对语义新区域响应而非任意运动）；推理时由学生模型决定解码哪些帧、重建哪些区域；已解码帧的检测结果通过运动矢量传播到跳过的帧。
AI.result: 在VIRAT、MEVA、ShanghaiTech上采用留一数据集协议评估。在同等解码预算下，相比现有压缩域选择器回收更多运动目标检测，甚至优于直接在目标摄像头上训练的竞争者；比逐帧解码+检测流水线快15-24倍。
AI.conclusion: 语义新颖性可有效替代运动作为帧选择信号，且能零样本泛化到新摄像头部署，无需逐摄像头重训，显著提升视频分析效率。

title: SecureGARD: Dynamic Ontology-Guided Governance for Secure Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents translate model outputs into consequential actions, turning indirect prompt injection into an execution-security problem. Existing defenses constrain tool calls, trajectories, or information flows, but often leave action semantics, state dependencies, and evidence relations implicit, limiting generalization across heterogeneous tools and complicating safe updates. We present \ours{}, a dynamic ontology-guided governance framework. \ours{} grounds heterogeneous calls in a shared semantic representation and combines an executable ontology with episode-level task state to derive deterministic ready, waiting, and forbidden decisions. A waiting decision identifies an unmet but recoverable obligation, enabling bounded replanning without expanding the agent's authorization boundary. \ours{} evolves its ontology offline from verified training executions. An offline LLM proposes instance-independent action--state axioms, which are accepted only if they address ontology errors exposed by training failures, preserve logical consistency and protected entailments, and pass held-out validation before the ontology is frozen. We evaluate \ours{} on AgentDojo, ASB, and AgentDyn under benign and indirect prompt-injection settings. \ours{} achieves a 0\% attack success rate (ASR) across all three benchmarks while improving task utility under attack compared with existing baselines. These results show that explicit semantic governance can strengthen execution security without indiscriminate blocking.

AI.tldr: 提出动态本体引导治理框架（\ours{}），将异构工具调用映射到共享语义表示，结合可执行本体与情节级任务状态给出确定性的 ready/waiting/forbidden 决策，在 AgentDojo、ASB、AgentDyn 上实现 0% 攻击成功率并提升攻击下的任务效用。
AI.motivation: 工具型 LLM 智能体把模型输出转为有后果的动作，使间接提示注入成为执行安全问题。现有防御仅约束工具调用、轨迹或信息流，把动作语义、状态依赖与证据关系留作隐式，难以跨异构工具泛化、难以安全更新。
AI.method: 将异构调用接地到共享语义表示；用可执行本体+情节级任务状态推导 ready/waiting/forbidden 三类确定性决策；waiting 表示未满足但可恢复的义务，触发有界重规划而不扩大授权边界；本体离线演化：离线 LLM 提出实例无关的动作-状态公理，仅当能修复训练失败暴露的本体错误、保持逻辑一致性与受保护蕴含、并通过留出验证时才被接受，随后冻结本体。
AI.result: 在 AgentDojo、ASB、AgentDyn 三个基准的良性及间接提示注入设置下评估，ASR 均为 0%，且在攻击下的任务效用优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式语义治理可在不进行无差别拦截的前提下增强执行安全性，兼顾安全与效用。

title: A 3D foundation model unifying CT interpretation and segmentation
comment: 114 pages, including Supplementary Information; 7 main figures and 2 Extended Data figures
summary: Radiologists interpret computed tomography (CT) scans by jointly determining what a finding represents and where it lies in three-dimensional (3D) anatomy. However, CT models have treated CT interpretation and 3D segmentation as separate tasks, leaving textual findings spatially unverifiable and overlooking potential synergy between clinical understanding and spatial perception. Here we present HoloCT, a generalist 3D foundation model unifying CT interpretation and voxel-level segmentation by jointly modelling whole-volume context and fine-grained anatomical detail, providing 3D masks as evidence. We curated HoloDATA, comprising 195,921 CT scans from 73 public datasets and six clinical cohorts, with 6.2 million instruction dialogues and 2.8 million CT-mask pairs. Across 346 tasks spanning segmentation, lesion screening, visual question answering, and report generation on 61 internal and 12 external datasets, HoloCT outperformed specialist and foundation models. In multicentre validation across 11,455 clinical CT scans from five hospitals, HoloCT outperformed competing models in lesion segmentation and report generation by 18.2 and 15.3 points. It also achieved 85.1% mean accuracy in screening thyroid tumours and colon lesions, exceeding all four participating radiologists in a retrospective reader study. Further analyses revealed bidirectional semantic-spatial synergy: language-guided segmentation delineated unseen anatomical structures and lesions as well as diffuse free-text findings, outperforming the leading approach by 22.1 points, whereas prompting the model to generate corresponding 3D masks alongside its textual outputs significantly improved interpretation performance. HoloCT shows that clinical understanding and spatial perception can be learned together within a single foundation model and offers a path towards more accurate and reliable CT analysis.

AI.tldr: HoloCT是一个统一CT解读与体素级分割的3D基础模型，通过联合建模全容积上下文与细粒度解剖细节，让文本发现具备可空间验证的3D掩码证据，并在346项任务及多中心临床验证中超越专科与基础模型。
AI.motivation: 放射科医生解读CT时同时判断"发现是什么"与"它在3D解剖中的位置"，但现有CT模型将解读与3D分割作为独立任务，导致文本发现无法空间验证，也忽视了临床理解与空间感知之间的潜在协同。
AI.method: 提出HoloCT，统一CT解读与体素级分割的通用3D基础模型，联合建模整体容积上下文与细粒度解剖细节，输出3D掩码作为证据。构建HoloDATA数据集：73个公开数据集与6个临床队列共195,921例CT，含620万条指令对话与280万对CT-掩码对。
AI.result: 在61个内部与12个外部数据集的346项任务（分割、病灶筛查、视觉问答、报告生成）上优于专科和基础模型。五家医院11,455例多中心验证中，病灶分割与报告生成分别领先18.2和15.3分；甲状腺肿瘤与结肠病变筛查平均准确率85.1%，回顾性阅片研究中超过全部四位参与放射科医生。语言引导分割（含未见解剖结构、病灶及弥漫性自由文本发现）领先22.1分；要求模型在文本输出同时生成3D掩码显著提升解读性能。
AI.conclusion: 临床理解与空间感知可在单一基础模型中共同学习，并揭示双向语义-空间协同，为更准确、可靠的CT分析提供路径。

title: Don't Replace, Complement: A Detector-Agnostic Subspace Signal for Near-OOD Detection
summary: Post-hoc out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is mature on far-OOD yet remains weak on near-OOD. These two settings differ in their use of class-characteristic feature directions: far-OOD inputs largely fail to activate those of their predicted class, whereas near-OOD inputs activate them much as in-distribution samples do. Because the axis separating far-OOD leaves near-OOD almost indistinguishable from ID, a score optimized for one setting is misaligned with the other; where a detector already saturates far-OOD, added near-OOD sensitivity is bought partly against it. This divergence motivates a targeted near-OOD signal designed to complement existing scores. We propose PLUS (Per-class Low-dimensional sUbspace Signal). For each class, PLUS selects the $m$ most class-active neurons from a sparse autoencoder, orthonormalizes the corresponding decoder directions to form a low-dimensional subspace, and scores an input by its per-class whitened squared Mahalanobis distance $z$ within the subspace of its predicted class.
